SANDY — the program

The complete source of Sandy (package com.talacore.talatv), the free media player built by James Cochrum with Pearl — gathered into ONE HTML file: the paper-brain form, portable and inspectable, feedable into any code space.

Snapshot of the shipped v0.16.1 tree (THE INSTALLER’S FACE), 2026-10-20 03:51 CDT. 174 source files, 2,214,367 bytes of source. Same program the APKs are built from; same signing line; free as in freedom — a copy makes a holder, never an owner.

app/AndroidManifest.xml

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.talacore.talatv"
    android:versionCode="22"
    android:versionName="0.16.1">

    <uses-sdk android:minSdkVersion="24" android:targetSdkVersion="34" />

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE" />
    <!-- v0.7.0: screen-share — the phone's Wi-Fi address, so the
         watching page can be offered on the home network. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE" />
    <!-- v0.5.0: rumble cues (playback start / verification complete). -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE" />
    <!-- v0.8.0: the book reader is a foreground service — it keeps
         reading with the screen off (the recliner rule), holds a
         wake lock only while speaking, and posts its controls. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK" />
    <!-- v0.14.0: the story room's family voices and journals are
         recorded on the phone's own microphone, at the family's
         hand, and kept as files on the memory hook. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    <!-- v0.14.0: the story room's family voices and journals are
         recorded on the phone's own microphone, at the family's
         hand, and kept as files on the memory hook. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
    <!-- v0.11.0: the VCR timer — re-arm the filed queue after a
         reboot (alarms die with the phone; the queue file doesn't),
         ask for the battery-optimization exemption so a timer can
         record while the phone sleeps, and hold the exact-alarm
         permission for the fallback arming path (the primary path
         is the alarm-clock API, which needs none). -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM" />
    <!-- My Library reads the phone's video index. READ_MEDIA_VIDEO is
         the Android 13+ form; READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE covers older phones. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        android:maxSdkVersion="32" />

    <!-- usesCleartextTraffic: many public free-to-air streams are plain
         http://. A TV guide has to be able to reach them; noted in NOTES. -->
    <!-- v0.4.0: the app is SANDY — named for James's mother, its audience.
         The label is the home-screen name; the package stays
         com.talacore.talatv (invisible plumbing) so installs ride over
         0.1–0.3 and every saved favorite/playlist/verdict carries. -->
    <!-- v0.16.1: THE INSTALLER'S FACE — installers and file managers
         read the APPLICATION icon before install, and many cannot
         draw an adaptive icon at that stage (they fall back to a
         generic picture). So the application wears a plain PNG
         (@drawable/ic_installer, the Sandy picture, 512x512), which
         every installer can draw; the adaptive icon moves onto the
         launcher activity below, where home screens read it.
         Diagnosis by Claude, relayed by James 2026-10-19. -->
    <application
        android:label="Sandy"
        android:icon="@drawable/ic_installer"
        android:roundIcon="@drawable/ic_installer"
        android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Material.NoActionBar"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"
        android:allowBackup="false">

        <!-- v0.4.0: the boot screen is the front door — the picture,
             brief warm-up, then home. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".SplashActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:theme="@style/SplashTheme"
            android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
            android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
            android:label="Sandy">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <activity
            android:name=".HomeActivity"
            android:exported="false" />

        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Live TV" />

        <activity
            android:name=".ShowActivity"
            android:exported="false" />

        <activity
            android:name=".SourcesActivity"
            android:exported="false" />

        <activity
            android:name=".VodActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Movies &amp; VOD" />

        <activity
            android:name=".PlayerActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden"
            android:screenOrientation="sensorLandscape" />

        <activity
            android:name=".PlaylistsActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Playlists" />

        <activity
            android:name=".LibraryActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="My Library" />

        <!-- v0.9.0: My Videos — the local player's shelf: every
             video on the phone, tappable, played by the one player. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".FilesActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="My Videos" />

        <!-- v0.10.0: the language wall's full shelf list + the country door -->
        <activity

        <!-- v0.15.0: THE TWO DOORS — Speak For Me (a voice for a
             person who cannot speak), Listen For Me (the ears:
             speech as big text, kept sound + words), and the

        <activity

        <!-- v0.14.0: a story cartridge leaves the phone only as a
             file, hand to hand through the share sheet, behind
             the grown-up gate. This serves the story room's
             files and share zips; nothing else is reachable. -->
        <provider
            android:name="androidx.core.content.FileProvider"
            android:authorities="com.talacore.talatv.files"
            android:exported="false"
            android:grantUriPermissions="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.support.FILE_PROVIDER_PATHS"
                android:resource="@xml/file_paths" />
        </provider>

        <!-- v0.12.0: the dub kitchen — pick an episode, cook its
             dub on-device (subtitles first, translate-then-speak,
             cast voices), and the dubbed-episodes shelf. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".DubActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Dub an episode" />

        <!-- v0.13.0: the voice coverage page — every catalogue
             language with this phone's voice state for it. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".VoiceCoverageActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Voice coverage" />

        <!-- v0.13.0: sources & credit — the front doors of the
             houses Sandy pulls from, plus the responsibility
             line. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".CreditActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Sources and credit" />

        <!-- v0.8.0: the reading voice — foreground service,
             media-playback type, so a book survives the pocket. -->
        <service
            android:name=".ReaderService"
            android:exported="false"
            android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback" />

        <!-- v0.11.0: every language the catalogue can show. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".LanguageIndexActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Languages" />

        <!-- v0.11.0: the TV Guide + the VCR timer book. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".GuideActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="TV Guide" />

        <activity
            android:name=".TimersActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Timers" />
        <!-- v0.12.1: set a timer — one screen, the whole frame
             (day + start + end) visible before commit. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".SetTimerActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="Set a timer" />

        <!-- v0.11.0: the VCR itself — a foreground recording service
             (media-playback type, like the reader) so a timer
             recording survives the app closing. -->
        <service
            android:name=".TimerRecordService"
            android:exported="false"
            android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback" />

        <!-- v0.11.0: the timer doorbell — our own TIMER_FIRE alarms
             plus BOOT_COMPLETED for re-arming the filed queue. -->
        <receiver
            android:name=".TimerReceiver"
            android:exported="false">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED" />
                <action android:name="com.talacore.talatv.TIMER_FIRE" />
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>
    </application>
</manifest>

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ActivePinger.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/**
 * The Active Pinger (v0.14.1, Addendum 3 + James's naming).
 * While a live stream plays, the buffer is managed ACTIVELY:
 * the pinger knocks on the playing source's door every
 * {@link #PING_INTERVAL_MS} — a light playlist fetch plus the
 * first bytes of the window's first segment — so a dead head
 * is detected INSIDE the buffer runway instead of at
 * starvation, and a frozen window is caught while cover
 * remains. Its evidence feeds three places:
 *
 *   early warning — a playlist terminally gone twice running,
 *   or a window that stopped advancing, starts the player's
 *   maintenance (the Reconnect Doctrine) while the runway is
 *   still full;
 *   door hygiene — a host whose door terminally dies loses its
 *   Hydra learned preference (Net.forgetLearned/HydraStore);
 *   the playback record — every classification-relevant sample
 *   lands in PlaybackRecord, separable by family.
 *
 * What a ping IS, per source class: for HLS (the live shape),
 * the media playlist itself (following the variant hop when
 * the door serves a multivariant list) + a 2 KB range read of
 * its first segment, hashed — the media sequence and the hash
 * together say whether the window is truly advancing, standing
 * still, or recycling names. For a direct media address, the
 * ping is a 2 KB range read of the address itself. A ping
 * never touches the player's own connections; it is a knock,
 * not a second stream.
 */
public final class ActivePinger {

    /** Cadence: a knock every ten seconds while live plays. */
    public static final long PING_INTERVAL_MS = 10_000;
    /** One knock's patience — well inside the runway. */
    public static final int PING_TIMEOUT_MS = 4_000;
    /** Stuck span never judged under fifteen seconds… */
    public static final long STUCK_FLOOR_MS = 15_000;
    /** …and otherwise media3's own stuck math: 3.5 × target. */
    public static final double STUCK_COEFFICIENT = 3.5;

    public interface Listener {
        /** Every sample, good or bad (throttle lives upstream). */
        void onPingSample(Sample s);
        /** The playlist door is terminally gone, twice running. */
        void onPlaylistTerminal(Sample s);
        /** The window stopped advancing across the stuck span. */
        void onWindowStuck(Sample s);
    }

    /** One knock's findings. */
    public static final class Sample {
        public long atMs;
        public String playlistUrl = "";
        public int playlistHttp;          // 0 = no answer at all
        public String failureKind = "";   // FailureWords key when failed
        public boolean ok;                // the playlist was read
        public long mediaSequence = -1;
        public long targetDurationMs = -1;
        public String segmentUrl = "";
        public String segmentHost = "";
        public int segmentHttp;           // 0 = not attempted / silent
        public long segmentCrc = -1;

        /** One-line evidence for the record. */
        public String describe() {
            if (!ok) {
                return "playlist http=" + playlistHttp
                        + (failureKind.isEmpty() ? "" : "/" + failureKind);
            }
            return "playlist http=" + playlistHttp
                    + " seq=" + mediaSequence
                    + " segment http=" + segmentHttp
                    + " crc=" + segmentCrc;
        }
    }

    private final String url;
    private final String userAgent;
    private final Listener listener;
    private volatile boolean running;
    private Thread thread;
    private long generation;

    public ActivePinger(String url, String userAgent, Listener listener) {
        this.url = url;
        this.userAgent = userAgent;
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public synchronized void start() {
        if (running) return;
        running = true;
        final long gen = ++generation;
        thread = new Thread(() -> runLoop(gen), "active-pinger");
        thread.setDaemon(true);
        thread.start();
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        running = false;
        generation++;
        if (thread != null) thread.interrupt();
        thread = null;
    }

    private void runLoop(long gen) {
        Sample lastOk = null;
        long stuckSince = 0;
        boolean stuckFired = false;
        int terminalStreak = 0;
        boolean terminalFired = false;
        while (running && gen == generation) {
            Sample s = pingOnce(url, userAgent);
            if (!running || gen != generation) return;
            if (listener != null) {
                try {
                    listener.onPingSample(s);
                } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
            }
            // ---- terminal door: two final answers in a row
            if (isTerminalHttp(s.playlistHttp)) {
                terminalStreak++;
                if (terminalStreak >= 2 && !terminalFired) {
                    terminalFired = true;
                    fireTerminal(s, gen);
                }
            } else {
                terminalStreak = 0;
                if (s.ok) terminalFired = false;
            }
            // ---- window advance / stuck judgment
            if (s.ok) {
                if (lastOk != null && sameWindow(lastOk, s)) {
                    if (stuckSince == 0) stuckSince = lastOk.atMs;
                    if (!stuckFired
                            && s.atMs - stuckSince >= stuckSpanMs(
                                    s.targetDurationMs)) {
                        stuckFired = true;
                        fireStuck(s, gen);
                    }
                } else {
                    stuckSince = 0;
                    stuckFired = false;
                }
                lastOk = s;
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(PING_INTERVAL_MS);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private void fireTerminal(Sample s, long gen) {
        if (!running || gen != generation || listener == null) return;
        try {
            listener.onPlaylistTerminal(s);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
    }

    private void fireStuck(Sample s, long gen) {
        if (!running || gen != generation || listener == null) return;
        try {
            listener.onWindowStuck(s);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ pure law

    public static boolean isTerminalHttp(int http) {
        return http == 404 || http == 410 || http == 401 || http == 403;
    }

    /** How long a window may stand still before it is "stuck". */
    public static long stuckSpanMs(long targetDurationMs) {
        long byTarget = targetDurationMs > 0
                ? (long) (STUCK_COEFFICIENT * targetDurationMs) : 0;
        return Math.max(STUCK_FLOOR_MS, byTarget);
    }

    /**
     * Two samples show the SAME window when the media sequence
     * stands still AND the first segment is the same address
     * with the same opening bytes. (Same address, DIFFERENT
     * bytes = a recycling source — the window "advances" on
     * paper; the record keeps the CRCs so the family is
     * separable later.)
     */
    public static boolean sameWindow(Sample a, Sample b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) return false;
        if (a.mediaSequence >= 0 && b.mediaSequence >= 0) {
            if (a.mediaSequence != b.mediaSequence) return false;
        }
        if (!a.segmentUrl.equals(b.segmentUrl)) return false;
        return a.segmentCrc == b.segmentCrc;
    }

    /** #EXT-X-MEDIA-SEQUENCE value, -1 when absent/unreadable. */
    public static long mediaSequenceOf(String playlistText) {
        return tagLong(playlistText, "#EXT-X-MEDIA-SEQUENCE:");
    }

    /** #EXT-X-TARGETDURATION in ms, -1 when absent. */
    public static long targetDurationMsOf(String playlistText) {
        long s = tagLong(playlistText, "#EXT-X-TARGETDURATION:");
        return s < 0 ? -1 : s * 1000;
    }

    private static long tagLong(String text, String tag) {
        if (text == null) return -1;
        int i = text.indexOf(tag);
        if (i < 0) return -1;
        int from = i + tag.length();
        int to = from;
        while (to < text.length()) {
            char c = text.charAt(to);
            if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-') to++;
            else break;
        }
        if (to == from) return -1;
        try {
            return Long.parseLong(text.substring(from, to));
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ the knock

    private static final class Got {
        int code;
        String body = "";
        String failureKind = "";
        long crc = -1;      // range reads: CRC32 of the bytes read
    }

    private static Got get(String url, String ua, String range) {
        Got g = new Got();
        HttpURLConnection c = null;
        try {
            c = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(url).openConnection();
            c.setConnectTimeout(PING_TIMEOUT_MS);
            c.setReadTimeout(PING_TIMEOUT_MS);
            c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
            c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent",
                    ua == null || ua.isEmpty() ? "Sandy/0.14.1" : ua);
            if (range != null) c.setRequestProperty("Range", range);
            g.code = c.getResponseCode();
            InputStream in = g.code >= 400
                    ? c.getErrorStream() : c.getInputStream();
            if (in != null) {
                // a ping reads a head, never the whole body
                byte[] buf = new byte[2048];
                java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream all =
                        new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
                int total = 0;
                int n;
                while (total < 65_536
                        && (n = in.read(buf)) != -1) {
                    all.write(buf, 0, n);
                    total += n;
                    if (range != null && total >= 2048) break;
                }
                byte[] bytes = all.toByteArray();
                g.body = new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                if (range != null && bytes.length > 0) {
                    java.util.zip.CRC32 crc = new java.util.zip.CRC32();
                    crc.update(bytes, 0, Math.min(bytes.length, 2048));
                    g.crc = crc.getValue();
                }
                in.close();
            }
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
            g.code = 0;
            g.failureKind = FailureWords.kindForDetail(String.valueOf(e));
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            g.code = 0;
            g.failureKind = FailureWords.NO_ANSWER;
        } finally {
            if (c != null) c.disconnect();
        }
        return g;
    }

    /** One knock, whole. Also the harness's door into the shape. */
    public static Sample pingOnce(String playlistUrl, String ua) {
        Sample s = new Sample();
        s.atMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        s.playlistUrl = playlistUrl == null ? "" : playlistUrl;
        Got g = get(s.playlistUrl, ua, null);
        s.playlistHttp = g.code;
        s.failureKind = g.failureKind;
        if (g.code < 200 || g.code >= 300
                || !LinkHealth.headLooksLikePlaylist(g.body)) {
            // a direct media address: the knock is a range read
            // of the address itself
            if (g.code >= 200 && g.code < 300) {
                s.ok = true;
                s.segmentUrl = s.playlistUrl;
                s.segmentHost = hostOf(s.playlistUrl);
                s.segmentHttp = g.code;
            }
            return s;
        }
        String mediaUrl = s.playlistUrl;
        String mediaBody = g.body;
        String variant = LinkHealth.firstVariantUri(g.body);
        if (variant != null) {
            mediaUrl = resolve(s.playlistUrl, variant);
            Got v = get(mediaUrl, ua, null);
            s.playlistHttp = v.code;
            s.failureKind = v.failureKind;
            if (v.code < 200 || v.code >= 300) return s;
            mediaBody = v.body;
        }
        s.ok = true;
        s.mediaSequence = mediaSequenceOf(mediaBody);
        s.targetDurationMs = targetDurationMsOf(mediaBody);
        String seg = LinkHealth.firstSegmentUri(mediaBody);
        if (seg != null) {
            s.segmentUrl = resolve(mediaUrl, seg);
            s.segmentHost = hostOf(s.segmentUrl);
            Got r = get(s.segmentUrl, ua, "bytes=0-2047");
            s.segmentHttp = r.code;
            if (r.code >= 200 && r.code < 300) s.segmentCrc = r.crc;
        }
        return s;
    }

    private static String resolve(String base, String ref) {
        if (ref == null) return base;
        try {
            return new URL(new URL(base), ref).toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ref;
        }
    }

    static String hostOf(String url) {
        if (url == null) return "";
        try {
            String h = new URL(url).getHost();
            return h == null ? "" : h;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/AudioPcmDecoder.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaExtractor;
import android.media.MediaFormat;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Decode a media file's audio track to PCM for the cooker
 * (v0.6.1). MediaExtractor + MediaCodec decode to a temp WAV in
 * the cache dir (native rate/channels preserved), and WavPcm then
 * serves the cooker's 16 kHz mono reads from it — the same
 * PcmSource the desktop JVM proof uses, so the engine sees no
 * difference between a bench WAV and a decoded film.
 *
 * COMPILE-VERIFIED ONLY in the build environment: no Android
 * device or emulator exists there, so this class has never run.
 * It is written to the standard MediaCodec dequeue pattern and
 * fails loudly (exception up to the Translate gate, which speaks
 * it as the FAILED state) rather than returning partial audio
 * silently.
 */
public final class AudioPcmDecoder {

    private AudioPcmDecoder() {}

    /**
     * Decode the first audio track of {@code url} (file path or
     * http(s) URL MediaExtractor accepts) into {@code tmpDir} and
     * return a PcmSource over the decoded WAV.
     */
    public static PcmSource decode(Context ctx, String url, File tmpDir)
            throws Exception {
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        if (url.startsWith("content://")) {
            ex.setDataSource(ctx, android.net.Uri.parse(url), null);
        } else if (url.startsWith("file://")) {
            ex.setDataSource(android.net.Uri.parse(url).getPath());
        } else {
            ex.setDataSource(url);
        }
        int track = -1;
        MediaFormat fmt = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
            MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
            String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
            if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                track = i;
                fmt = f;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (track < 0 || fmt == null) {
            ex.release();
            throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track in " + url);
        }
        ex.selectTrack(track);
        String mime = fmt.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
        MediaCodec codec = MediaCodec.createDecoderByType(mime);
        codec.configure(fmt, null, null, 0);
        codec.start();
        File out = new File(tmpDir, "cook-" + Math.abs(url.hashCode()) + ".wav");
        long pcmBytes = 0;
        MediaFormat lastOutFormat = fmt;
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(out)) {
            fos.write(new byte[44]); // header placeholder, rewritten at end
            MediaCodec.BufferInfo info = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
            MediaFormat outFmt = fmt;
            boolean inputDone = false, outputDone = false;
            while (!outputDone) {
                if (!inputDone) {
                    int inIdx = codec.dequeueInputBuffer(10000);
                    if (inIdx >= 0) {
                        ByteBuffer ib = codec.getInputBuffer(inIdx);
                        int sz = ex.readSampleData(ib, 0);
                        if (sz < 0) {
                            codec.queueInputBuffer(inIdx, 0, 0, 0,
                                    MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                            inputDone = true;
                        } else {
                            codec.queueInputBuffer(inIdx, 0, sz,
                                    ex.getSampleTime(), 0);
                            ex.advance();
                        }
                    }
                }
                int outIdx = codec.dequeueOutputBuffer(info, 10000);
                if (outIdx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                    outFmt = codec.getOutputFormat();
                    lastOutFormat = outFmt;
                } else if (outIdx >= 0) {
                    ByteBuffer ob = codec.getOutputBuffer(outIdx);
                    if (info.size > 0 && ob != null) {
                        // decoder output may be PCM16 or (API 29+
                        // float) — normalize to PCM16 for the WAV
                        MediaFormat of = codec.getOutputFormat();
                        int enc = of.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING)
                                ? of.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING)
                                : android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT;
                        ob.position(info.offset);
                        ob.limit(info.offset + info.size);
                        if (enc == android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT) {
                            byte[] tmp = new byte[info.size / 2];
                            ByteBuffer src = ob.duplicate().order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
                            ByteBuffer dst = ByteBuffer.wrap(tmp)
                                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                            int n = info.size / 4;
                            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                                float v = src.getFloat(i * 4);
                                if (v > 1f) v = 1f;
                                if (v < -1f) v = -1f;
                                dst.putShort(i * 2, (short) (v * 32767));
                            }
                            fos.write(tmp);
                            pcmBytes += tmp.length;
                        } else {
                            byte[] tmp = new byte[info.size];
                            ob.get(tmp);
                            fos.write(tmp);
                            pcmBytes += tmp.length;
                        }
                    }
                    codec.releaseOutputBuffer(outIdx, false);
                    if ((info.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                        outputDone = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try { codec.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            codec.release();
            ex.release();
        }
        // rewrite the WAV header with the decoder's actual output
        // format (rate/channels can change at INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED)
        MediaFormat f2 = lastOutFormat;
        int rate = f2.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE)
                ? f2.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE) : 44100;
        int chans = f2.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT)
                ? f2.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT) : 2;
        writeHeader(out, rate, chans, pcmBytes);
        return new WavPcm(out);
    }

    private static void writeHeader(File out, int rate, int chans, long pcmBytes)
            throws Exception {
        byte[] h = new byte[44];
        ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(h).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        bb.put(0, (byte) 'R'); bb.put(1, (byte) 'I');
        bb.put(2, (byte) 'F'); bb.put(3, (byte) 'F');
        bb.putInt(4, (int) (36 + pcmBytes));
        bb.put(8, (byte) 'W'); bb.put(9, (byte) 'A');
        bb.put(10, (byte) 'V'); bb.put(11, (byte) 'E');
        bb.put(12, (byte) 'f'); bb.put(13, (byte) 'm');
        bb.put(14, (byte) 't'); bb.put(15, (byte) ' ');
        bb.putInt(16, 16);
        bb.putShort(20, (short) 1);
        bb.putShort(22, (short) chans);
        bb.putInt(24, rate);
        bb.putInt(28, rate * chans * 2);
        bb.putShort(32, (short) (chans * 2));
        bb.putShort(34, (short) 16);
        bb.put(36, (byte) 'd'); bb.put(37, (byte) 'a');
        bb.put(38, (byte) 't'); bb.put(39, (byte) 'a');
        bb.putInt(40, (int) pcmBytes);
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile raf =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(out, "rw")) {
            raf.seek(0);
            raf.write(h);
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/AutoPlay.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Auto-play resolution (v0.12.1, James's auto-play doctrine): tap a
 * tile or an episode and Sandy plays it — she picks the source, in
 * the viewer's already-chosen language, under the viewer's quality
 * POSTURE. The manual source list stays one Back away; auto-pick is
 * the default road, not a wall.
 *
 * Postures (Settings, James's shape):
 *  LOW      — fastest start wins: the lowest adequate WORKING
 *             source first; it plays immediately and smoothly, and
 *             its quality is what it is (labeled, never dressed).
 *  BALANCED — the happy medium: the best quality the connection
 *             can sustain without buffer pain (a measured pipe cap
 *             from PipeMeter), over a 480p floor.
 *  ULTRA    — the highest quality available, period; it may cost
 *             buffer time, and the player says so instead of
 *             silently downgrading.
 *
 * Rules that hold in every posture: a link already filed DEAD
 * (HealthStore verdict) is never picked; language-matching sources
 * form the pool when any exist (the pick is labeled when none
 * matched); when no working source meets the posture's floor, the
 * result is an OFFER — the best working source below the floor,
 * presented to the person — never a silent below-floor serve and
 * never a dead end. Quality evidence is the entry's own tokens
 * (SourceFinder/EpisodeKey tiers: 2160=6, 1080=5, 720=4, HD=3,
 * 480=2, SD=1, unknown=0, CAM=-1); unknown stays unknown.
 *
 * Health tiers ride LinkHealth's scale: DEAD=0, CONNECTS=1,
 * PLAYS=2; an unprobed source is UNKNOWN (-1 here) and ranks
 * between proven-dead (excluded) and proven.
 */
public final class AutoPlay {

    private AutoPlay() {}

    public enum Posture { LOW, BALANCED, ULTRA }

    public static final int HEALTH_UNKNOWN = -1;
    /** The internal floor for BALANCED/ULTRA: 480p (tier 2). */
    public static final int FLOOR_TIER = 2;

    public static Posture parsePosture(String pref) {
        if ("low".equals(pref)) return Posture.LOW;
        if ("ultra".equals(pref)) return Posture.ULTRA;
        return Posture.BALANCED;
    }

    public static String posturePref(Posture p) {
        switch (p) {
            case LOW: return "low";
            case ULTRA: return "ultra";
            default: return "balanced";
        }
    }

    /** One candidate: a source plus its evidence. */
    /** The posture's name as the viewer hears it ("Low First"). */
    public static String postureLabel(Posture p) {
        switch (p) {
            case LOW: return "Low First";
            case ULTRA: return "Ultra";
            default: return "Balanced";
        }
    }

    public static final class Cand {
        public final SourceFinder.Source source;
        public final int health;      // LinkHealth tier, or HEALTH_UNKNOWN
        public final boolean langMatch;
        public Cand(SourceFinder.Source s, int health, boolean langMatch) {
            this.source = s; this.health = health; this.langMatch = langMatch;
        }
    }

    public static final class Pick {
        public SourceFinder.Source source;   // null: nothing workable at all
        public boolean offer;                // true: below the floor — ask first
        public boolean langMatched;          // the pool was language-matched
        public int capTier = -1;             // Balanced's pipe cap (for the label)
    }

    /**
     * Pick for a posture. {@code pipeCapTier} is PipeMeter's honest
     * cap for BALANCED (the best tier the measured pipe sustains);
     * pass 6 when no measurement exists (no cap claimed).
     */
    public static Pick pick(List<Cand> cands, Posture posture, int pipeCapTier) {
        Pick out = new Pick();
        if (cands == null) return out;
        List<Cand> alive = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Cand c : cands) {
            if (c.health != LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD) alive.add(c);
        }
        if (alive.isEmpty()) return out;
        List<Cand> pool = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Cand c : alive) if (c.langMatch) pool.add(c);
        out.langMatched = !pool.isEmpty();
        if (pool.isEmpty()) pool = alive;

        switch (posture) {
            case LOW: {
                pool.sort(AutoPlay::lowOrder);
                out.source = pool.get(0).source;
                return out;
            }
            case ULTRA: {
                pool.sort(AutoPlay::highOrder);
                Cand best = pool.get(0);
                out.source = best.source;
                out.offer = best.source.qualityTier < FLOOR_TIER;
                return out;
            }
            case BALANCED:
            default: {
                int cap = pipeCapTier < 0 ? 6 : Math.min(pipeCapTier, 6);
                out.capTier = cap;
                List<Cand> atFloor = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Cand c : pool) {
                    if (c.source.qualityTier >= FLOOR_TIER) atFloor.add(c);
                }
                if (atFloor.isEmpty()) {
                    pool.sort(AutoPlay::highOrder);
                    out.source = pool.get(0).source;
                    out.offer = true;
                    return out;
                }
                // The measured pipe is a real cap, not a sort hint:
                // the best source the pipe carries clean wins; a
                // source above the cap is taken only when nothing
                // at or under the cap meets the floor (the player
                // can still step down inside an HLS ladder, but a
                // fixed file above the pipe's tier is buffer pain
                // Sandy chose, and Balanced does not choose pain).
                List<Cand> within = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Cand c : atFloor) {
                    if (c.source.qualityTier <= cap) within.add(c);
                }
                List<Cand> ranked = within.isEmpty() ? atFloor : within;
                ranked.sort(AutoPlay::highOrder);
                out.source = ranked.get(0).source;
                return out;
            }
        }
    }

    /** Build candidates from sources + the health book + language wants. */
    public static List<Cand> candidates(List<SourceFinder.Source> sources,
                                        Map<String, Integer> healthByUrl,
                                        String wantFacet, String wantMarc) {
        List<Cand> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (sources == null) return out;
        for (SourceFinder.Source s : sources) {
            Integer h = healthByUrl == null ? null : healthByUrl.get(s.url);
            int health = h == null ? HEALTH_UNKNOWN : h;
            boolean lm = (wantFacet != null && !wantFacet.isEmpty()
                            && wantFacet.equalsIgnoreCase(s.langFacet))
                    || (wantMarc != null && !wantMarc.isEmpty()
                            && wantMarc.equalsIgnoreCase(s.langMarc));
            out.add(new Cand(s, health, lm));
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- ordering

    /** Health first (proven plays > connects > unknown), then evidence. */
    private static int healthRank(int health) {
        if (health == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) return 3;
        if (health == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) return 2;
        if (health == HEALTH_UNKNOWN) return 1;
        return 0;
    }

    /** Fastest start: lowest tier first — but a CAM (tier -1) is the
     *  last resort, never the "fastest" pick while anything else lives. */
    private static int lowOrder(Cand a, Cand b) {
        int ka = a.source.qualityTier < 0 ? 99 : a.source.qualityTier;
        int kb = b.source.qualityTier < 0 ? 99 : b.source.qualityTier;
        if (ka != kb) return ka - kb;
        int h = healthRank(b.health) - healthRank(a.health);
        if (h != 0) return h;
        if (a.source.size != b.source.size) {
            return a.source.size < b.source.size ? -1 : 1;
        }
        return a.source.label.compareToIgnoreCase(b.source.label);
    }

    /** Highest quality first, proven health breaking ties. */
    private static int highOrder(Cand a, Cand b) {
        if (a.source.qualityTier != b.source.qualityTier) {
            return b.source.qualityTier - a.source.qualityTier;
        }
        int h = healthRank(b.health) - healthRank(a.health);
        if (h != 0) return h;
        if (a.source.size != b.source.size) {
            return a.source.size > b.source.size ? -1 : 1;
        }
        return a.source.label.compareToIgnoreCase(b.source.label);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Availability.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Tile-level availability, honestly bounded (v0.10.0).
 *
 * A catalogue tile may call itself "on your shelves" only on evidence
 * this phone already holds: a loaded playlist entry or an indexed
 * library file whose name carries the show. This class turns entry
 * names into candidate show keys — the part of an episode file's name
 * before its SxxExx marker, a movie file's cleaned title (with and
 * without its year) — and answers whether a show's name is carried.
 *
 * What this is NOT: a promise that a specific episode plays. Episode
 * proof still happens in the Sources screen, per episode, as always.
 * And the Archive is not consulted here — a show counts as
 * Archive-proven only after a Sources visit actually found it there
 * (ChannelStore's record), never by guessing.
 */
public final class Availability {

    private Availability() {}

    /** Candidate show keys one playlist/library entry name offers. */
    public static Set<String> candidateKeys(String entryName) {
        Set<String> out = new HashSet<>();
        if (entryName == null || entryName.isEmpty()) return out;
        int[] span = EpisodeKey.parseSpan(entryName);
        if (span != null) {
            // "Bonanza S01E01 - ..." -> the show lives before the marker
            String head = entryName.substring(0, Math.max(0, span[2]));
            String headNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(head);
            if (!headNorm.isEmpty()) out.add(headNorm);
        }
        String cleaned = EpisodeKey.normalize(
                SourceFinder.cleanTitleForSearch(entryName));
        if (!cleaned.isEmpty()) {
            if (span == null) out.add(cleaned);
            // "night of the living dead 1968" also answers to the bare title
            String noYear = cleaned.replaceAll("\\s(19|20)\\d{2}$", "");
            if (!noYear.equals(cleaned) && !noYear.isEmpty()) out.add(noYear);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The key set for a whole shelf of entry names. */
    public static Set<String> buildKeySet(List<String> entryNames) {
        Set<String> out = new HashSet<>();
        if (entryNames == null) return out;
        for (String n : entryNames) out.addAll(candidateKeys(n));
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * True when any candidate key IS this show's name or contains it
     * as a whole phrase ("bonanza the lost episodes" carries "Bonanza";
     * "office space" does not carry "The Office").
     */
    public static boolean carries(Set<String> keys, String showName) {
        return new Shelf(keys).carries(showName);
    }

    /** Any of the show's names (original + alternates) carried. */
    public static boolean carriesAny(Set<String> keys, List<String> showNames) {
        return new Shelf(keys).carriesAny(showNames);
    }

    /**
     * A built shelf of candidate keys with a token index, so asking
     * "carried?" per tile stays cheap even with ten thousand entries:
     * exact key hits answer directly; the phrase fallback only scans
     * keys that contain the show name's first token as a whole token
     * (a necessary condition for a phrase match).
     */
    public static final class Shelf {
        private final Set<String> keys;
        private final java.util.Map<String, List<String>> byFirstToken =
                new java.util.HashMap<>();

        public Shelf(Set<String> keys) {
            this.keys = keys == null ? new HashSet<>() : keys;
            for (String k : this.keys) {
                java.util.Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
                for (String tok : k.split(" ")) {
                    if (!tok.isEmpty() && seen.add(tok)) {
                        byFirstToken.computeIfAbsent(tok,
                                x -> new java.util.ArrayList<>()).add(k);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        public boolean carries(String showName) {
            if (keys.isEmpty() || showName == null) return false;
            String want = EpisodeKey.normalize(showName);
            if (want.isEmpty()) return false;
            if (keys.contains(want)) return true;
            String first = want.split(" ")[0];
            List<String> candidates = byFirstToken.get(first);
            if (candidates == null) return false;
            for (String k : candidates) {
                if (EpisodeKey.containsPhrase(k, want)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public boolean carriesAny(List<String> showNames) {
            if (showNames == null) return false;
            for (String n : showNames) if (carries(n)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        public int size() { return keys.size(); }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookChunker.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Book chunking (v0.8.0) — pure Java. A book becomes a row of
 * speakable chunks: paragraph-first, then sentence-aware, with a
 * hard ceiling so no single utterance runs away. The bookmark the
 * reader keeps is (chunk index + char offset), the same shape as
 * the kept place in a channel: a position in the work, saved as
 * she reads, offered back in words when she returns.
 *
 * Targets: ~700 chars per chunk, never over 900 (CJK text without
 * spaces hard-splits at the ceiling). Sentence ends include the
 * Japanese/Chinese terminators (。！？) alongside . ! ? — the
 * books this reader translates are Japanese first.
 */
public final class BookChunker {

    private BookChunker() {}

    public static final int TARGET = 700;
    public static final int MAX = 900;

    public static final class Chunk {
        public final int index;
        /** Char offset into the book text where this chunk starts. */
        public final int startChar;
        /** Exclusive end char offset. */
        public final int endChar;
        public final String text;
        /** Title of the chapter this chunk belongs to ("" if none). */
        public final String chapterTitle;

        public Chunk(int index, int startChar, int endChar, String text,
                     String chapterTitle) {
            this.index = index;
            this.startChar = startChar;
            this.endChar = endChar;
            this.text = text;
            this.chapterTitle = chapterTitle;
        }
    }

    public static List<Chunk> chunk(String text, List<BookText.Chapter> chapters) {
        List<Chunk> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) return out;
        // Split into paragraphs, remembering offsets.
        List<int[]> paras = new ArrayList<>(); // [start, end)
        int i = 0, len = text.length();
        while (i < len) {
            int j = text.indexOf('\n', i);
            if (j < 0) j = len;
            // a paragraph runs to a blank line or EOF
            int end = j;
            while (end < len) {
                int nj = text.indexOf('\n', end + 1);
                if (nj < 0) { end = len; break; }
                String between = text.substring(end + 1, nj).trim();
                if (between.isEmpty()) { break; }
                end = nj;
            }
            paras.add(new int[]{i, Math.min(end, len)});
            i = end + 1;
            while (i < len && (text.charAt(i) == '\n')) i++;
        }
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();
        int curStart = -1;
        for (int[] p : paras) {
            String para = text.substring(p[0], p[1]);
            // Split an over-long paragraph into sentence units.
            List<String> units = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> unitOff = new ArrayList<>();
            splitUnits(para, p[0], units, unitOff);
            for (int u = 0; u < units.size(); u++) {
                String unit = units.get(u);
                int unitStart = unitOff.get(u);
                if (unit.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
                if (curStart < 0) curStart = unitStart;
                if (cur.length() > 0 && cur.length() + unit.length() + 1 > TARGET) {
                    emit(out, cur, curStart, text, chapters);
                    cur = new StringBuilder();
                    curStart = unitStart;
                }
                if (cur.length() > 0) cur.append(' ');
                cur.append(unit.trim());
            }
        }
        if (cur.length() > 0) emit(out, cur, curStart, text, chapters);
        return out;
    }

    private static void emit(List<Chunk> out, StringBuilder cur, int curStart,
                             String fullText, List<BookText.Chapter> chapters) {
        String t = cur.toString().trim();
        if (t.isEmpty() || curStart < 0) return;
        int end = Math.min(curStart + t.length(), fullText.length());
        // endChar tracks the chunk's own extent in the source; the
        // joins above collapse whitespace, so extent is approximate
        // by the join width — the bookmark stores startChar of the
        // NEXT chunk for resume, which is exact.
        String title = "";
        if (chapters != null) {
            for (BookText.Chapter c : chapters) {
                if (c.charOffset <= curStart) title = c.title;
                else break;
            }
        }
        out.add(new Chunk(out.size(), curStart, end, t, title));
    }

    /** Sentence-split one paragraph; over-long sentences hard-split. */
    private static void splitUnits(String para, int paraOff,
                                   List<String> units, List<Integer> offs) {
        int start = 0, n = para.length();
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            char c = para.charAt(k);
            boolean term = c == '.' || c == '!' || c == '?'
                    || c == '。' || c == '！' || c == '？';
            if (!term) continue;
            // absorb closing quotes/brackets after the terminator
            int e = k + 1;
            while (e < n && "\"'”’）)]」".indexOf(para.charAt(e)) >= 0) e++;
            // Latin terminators need whitespace after (else "3.5"
            // and "e.g." would split); CJK terminators end the
            // sentence outright — Japanese runs sentences together
            // with no space at all, and missing that split once
            // glued whole paragraphs into single units.
            boolean cjkTerm = c == '。' || c == '！' || c == '？';
            if (!cjkTerm && e < n && !Character.isWhitespace(para.charAt(e))) continue;
            addUnit(para, paraOff, start, e, units, offs);
            start = e;
        }
        if (start < n) addUnit(para, paraOff, start, n, units, offs);
    }

    private static void addUnit(String para, int paraOff, int s, int e,
                                List<String> units, List<Integer> offs) {
        while (s < e) {
            int remain = e - s;
            if (remain <= MAX) {
                units.add(para.substring(s, e));
                offs.add(paraOff + s);
                return;
            }
            // hard split at the last word boundary inside the ceiling,
            // else exactly at the ceiling (spaceless scripts).
            int cut = -1;
            for (int k = Math.min(s + MAX, e - 1); k > s; k--) {
                if (Character.isWhitespace(para.charAt(k))) { cut = k; break; }
            }
            if (cut < 0) cut = s + MAX;
            units.add(para.substring(s, cut));
            offs.add(paraOff + s);
            s = cut;
            while (s < e && Character.isWhitespace(para.charAt(s))) s++;
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------- bookmark math

    /** The chunk a char offset belongs to (resume lands here). */
    public static int chunkIndexAt(List<Chunk> chunks, int charOffset) {
        if (chunks == null || chunks.isEmpty()) return 0;
        int idx = 0;
        for (Chunk c : chunks) {
            if (c.startChar <= charOffset) idx = c.index;
            else break;
        }
        return idx;
    }

    /** Where a chunk sits in the whole book, 0..1. */
    public static double progress(List<Chunk> chunks, int chunkIndex, int totalChars) {
        if (chunks == null || chunks.isEmpty() || totalChars <= 0) return 0;
        int idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(chunkIndex, chunks.size() - 1));
        return Math.min(1.0, (double) chunks.get(idx).startChar / totalChars);
    }

    /** The chapter containing a chunk index ("" when the book has none). */
    public static String chapterAt(List<Chunk> chunks, int chunkIndex) {
        if (chunks == null || chunks.isEmpty()) return "";
        int idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(chunkIndex, chunks.size() - 1));
        return chunks.get(idx).chapterTitle;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookLang.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * What language is this book written in? (v0.8.0) — pure Java,
 * script-based detection over a sample, the honest kind: it reads
 * the characters, not a filename.
 *
 *   kana present          -> Japanese ("ja")
 *   hangul present        -> Korean ("ko")
 *   han without kana/hangul -> Chinese ("zh")
 *   otherwise             -> "other" (Latin and everything else)
 *
 * Japanese is the gate that matters for translated reading: the
 * installed engine pack is ja->en, and kana is what proves a book
 * is Japanese rather than Chinese — a han-only book is NOT offered
 * the ja->en engine. It would be a wrong translation wearing a
 * right one's clothes.
 */
public final class BookLang {

    private BookLang() {}

    public static final String JA = "ja";
    public static final String KO = "ko";
    public static final String ZH = "zh";
    public static final String OTHER = "other";

    /** How much of the sample to judge by. */
    public static final int SAMPLE = 4000;

    public static String detect(String text) {
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) return OTHER;
        int n = Math.min(text.length(), SAMPLE);
        int kana = 0, hangul = 0, han = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if ((c >= 0x3040 && c <= 0x30FF)) { // hiragana + katakana
                kana++;
            } else if (c >= 0xAC00 && c <= 0xD7A3) { // hangul syllables
                hangul++;
            } else if (c >= 0x4E00 && c <= 0x9FFF) { // han ideographs
                han++;
            }
        }
        if (kana > 0) return JA;
        if (hangul > 0) return KO;
        if (han > 0) return ZH;
        return OTHER;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookSearchActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Find a book (v0.16.0) — the Reader door's front room. One
 * search runs over every landed BookSource (Internet Archive,
 * Project Gutenberg, Open Library, LibriVox), each hit wearing
 * its own source's name, each availability state resolved from
 * evidence BEFORE a Read promise renders (Display Honesty):
 * Gutenberg and LibriVox hits resolve from their own payload;
 * Archive and Open Library hits resolve through the item's
 * /metadata file list, card by card, in the open.
 *
 * Read (OPEN only) downloads the best sibling through Hydra,
 * keeps it as a file, registers it on the book shelf, and opens
 * the reading room. Listen on a LibriVox hit plays its openly
 * reachable sections in the player.
 */
public class BookSearchActivity extends Activity {

    private EditText queryBox;
    private EditText langBox;
    private Button titleBtn, authorBtn, searchBtn;
    private TextView statusView;
    private LinearLayout resultsBox;
    private boolean byAuthor = false;
    private volatile boolean destroyed = false;
    private volatile int searchGen = 0;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(16);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_find"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(30);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        queryBox = new EditText(this);
        queryBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "books_search_hint"));
        queryBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        queryBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 156, 180));
        queryBox.setTextSize(20);
        root.addView(queryBox, margins());

        LinearLayout modeRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        modeRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        titleBtn = new Button(this);
        authorBtn = new Button(this);
        titleBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_by_title"));
        authorBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_by_author"));
        titleBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> { byAuthor = false; paintMode(); });
        authorBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> { byAuthor = true; paintMode(); });
        modeRow.addView(titleBtn, half());
        modeRow.addView(authorBtn, half());
        root.addView(modeRow);
        paintMode();

        langBox = new EditText(this);
        langBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "books_language_hint"));
        langBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        langBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 156, 180));
        langBox.setTextSize(17);
        root.addView(langBox, margins());

        searchBtn = new Button(this);
        searchBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_search"));
        searchBtn.setTextSize(20);
        searchBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> search());
        root.addView(searchBtn, margins());

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
        statusView.setTextSize(17);
        root.addView(statusView, margins());

        resultsBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        resultsBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.addView(resultsBox);
        setContentView(scroll);
    }

    private void paintMode() {
        titleBtn.setEnabled(byAuthor);
        authorBtn.setEnabled(!byAuthor);
    }

    private void search() {
        final String q = queryBox.getText().toString().trim();
        if (q.isEmpty()) return;
        final String langName = langBox.getText().toString().trim();
        final boolean author = byAuthor;
        final int gen = ++searchGen;
        resultsBox.removeAllViews();
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_searching"));
        searchBtn.setEnabled(false);
        new Thread(() -> {
            List<BookSource.Hit> all = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Exception> errors = new ArrayList<>();
            // Internet Archive (texts).
            try {
                String marc = langName.isEmpty() ? ""
                        : IaClient.iaLanguageCode(langName);
                all.addAll(BookSource.parseIaSearch(Net.getString(
                        BookSource.iaSearchUrl(q, author,
                                marc.isEmpty() && !langName.isEmpty()
                                        ? langName : marc, 20, 1))));
            } catch (Exception e) { errors.add(e); }
            // Project Gutenberg (Gutendex).
            try {
                String iso = langName.isEmpty() ? "" : isoOf(langName);
                all.addAll(BookSource.parseGutSearch(Net.getString(
                        BookSource.gutSearchUrl(q, iso))));
            } catch (Exception e) { errors.add(e); }
            // Open Library.
            try {
                String iso = langName.isEmpty() ? "" : isoOf(langName);
                all.addAll(BookSource.parseOlSearch(Net.getString(
                        BookSource.olSearchUrl(q, author, iso))));
            } catch (Exception e) { errors.add(e); }
            // LibriVox (audiobooks are found by title).
            try {
                all.addAll(BookSource.parseLvSearch(Net.getString(
                        BookSource.lvSearchUrl(q))));
            } catch (Exception e) { errors.add(e); }
            final List<BookSource.Hit> hits = all;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed || gen != searchGen) return;
                searchBtn.setEnabled(true);
                if (hits.isEmpty()) {
                    statusView.setText(errors.isEmpty()
                            ? LangStore.tr(this, "books_none")
                            : LangStore.tr(this, "books_none") + "\n"
                                    + words(errors.get(0)));
                    return;
                }
                statusView.setText("");
                for (BookSource.Hit h : hits) addCard(h, gen);
                resolveCards(hits, gen);
            });
        }, "book-search").start();
    }

    /** Language name (or code) → ISO-1 for Gutenberg/Open Library. */
    private String isoOf(String langName) {
        String marc = IaClient.iaLanguageCode(langName);
        String iso = MARC_TO_ISO.get(marc);
        if (iso != null) return iso;
        String low = langName.trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        return low.length() == 2 ? low : "";
    }

    private static final java.util.Map<String, String> MARC_TO_ISO =
            new java.util.HashMap<>();
    static {
        String[][] pairs = {
                {"eng", "en"}, {"spa", "es"}, {"fre", "fr"}, {"fra", "fr"},
                {"ger", "de"}, {"deu", "de"}, {"por", "pt"}, {"ita", "it"},
                {"rus", "ru"}, {"ara", "ar"}, {"hin", "hi"}, {"chi", "zh"},
                {"zho", "zh"}, {"jpn", "ja"}, {"kor", "ko"}, {"per", "fa"},
                {"fas", "fa"}, {"dut", "nl"}, {"nld", "nl"}, {"swe", "sv"},
                {"dan", "da"}, {"nor", "no"}, {"fin", "fi"}, {"pol", "pl"},
                {"cze", "cs"}, {"ces", "cs"}, {"gre", "el"}, {"ell", "el"},
                {"tur", "tr"}, {"heb", "he"}, {"lat", "la"}, {"cat", "ca"},
        };
        for (String[] pr : pairs) MARC_TO_ISO.put(pr[0], pr[1]);
    }

    /** Plain failure words: Net's Hydra exceptions already carry
     *  them as their message (FailureWords); anything else gets
     *  the honest generic line, never a bare "HTTP error". */
    private String words(Exception e) {
        String m = e == null ? "" : e.getMessage();
        return (m == null || m.trim().isEmpty())
                ? LangStore.tr(this, "reader_failed") : m;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ cards

    private void addCard(final BookSource.Hit h, final int gen) {
        LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
        card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        card.setPadding(dp(14), dp(10), dp(14), dp(10));
        card.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(34, 40, 62));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        cl.topMargin = dp(10);
        card.setLayoutParams(cl);

        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(h.title);
        t.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        t.setTextSize(20);
        t.setTypeface(t.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        card.addView(t);

        TextView meta = new TextView(this);
        StringBuilder mb = new StringBuilder();
        if (!h.author.isEmpty()) mb.append(h.author);
        if (!h.year.isEmpty()) {
            if (mb.length() > 0) mb.append(" · ");
            mb.append(h.year);
        }
        if (BookSource.LV.equals(h.source)) {
            if (mb.length() > 0) mb.append(" · ");
            mb.append(LangStore.tr(this, "books_audiobook"));
            if (h.audioSections > 0) {
                mb.append(" · ").append(h.audioSections).append(' ')
                        .append(LangStore.tr(this, "books_sections"));
            }
        }
        mb.append("\n").append(BookSource.sourceName(h.source));
        meta.setText(mb.toString());
        meta.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 205));
        meta.setTextSize(15);
        card.addView(meta);

        TextView state = new TextView(this);
        state.setTextSize(16);
        state.setTag("state");
        card.addView(state);

        LinearLayout actions = new LinearLayout(this);
        actions.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        card.addView(actions);
        card.setTag(h);
        paintCard(h, card, state, actions, gen);
        resultsBox.addView(card);
    }

    private void paintCard(final BookSource.Hit h, LinearLayout card,
                           TextView state, LinearLayout actions, int gen) {
        actions.removeAllViews();
        if (BookSource.LV.equals(h.source)) {
            state.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_open"));
            state.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 230, 160));
            Button listen = new Button(this);
            listen.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_listen"));
            listen.setOnClickListener(v -> listenAudiobook(h));
            actions.addView(listen);
            return;
        }
        if (h.state == BookSource.OPEN) {
            state.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_open"));
            state.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 230, 160));
            Button read = new Button(this);
            read.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_read"));
            read.setOnClickListener(v -> openBook(h));
            actions.addView(read);
        } else if (h.state == BookSource.WALLED) {
            // Named, never promised: no Read renders here.
            state.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_walled"));
            state.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 190, 90));
        } else {
            state.setText(h.siblingUrl.isEmpty()
                    ? LangStore.tr(this, "books_checking")
                    : LangStore.tr(this, "books_unknown"));
            state.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 205));
        }
    }

    /** Resolve UNKNOWN Archive/Open Library cards from metadata. */
    private void resolveCards(final List<BookSource.Hit> hits, int gen) {
        new Thread(() -> {
            for (final BookSource.Hit h : hits) {
                if (destroyed || gen != searchGen) return;
                if (BookSource.IA.equals(h.source)) {
                    resolveIa(h, h.itemId);
                } else if (BookSource.OL.equals(h.source)
                        && !h.readVia.isEmpty()
                        && h.state == BookSource.UNKNOWN) {
                    resolveIa(h, h.readVia);
                } else {
                    continue;
                }
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed || gen != searchGen) return;
                    refreshCard(h);
                });
            }
        }, "book-resolve").start();
    }

    private void resolveIa(BookSource.Hit h, String iaId) {
        try {
            BookSource.applyIaMetadata(h,
                    Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(iaId)));
            if (h.pageImages && h.pageCount == 0) {
                try {
                    String scandata = Net.getString("https://archive.org"
                            + "/download/" + iaId + "/" + iaId
                            + "_scandata.xml");
                    h.pageCount = BookSource.scandataLeafCount(scandata);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // stays UNKNOWN — no promise was made
        }
    }

    private void refreshCard(BookSource.Hit h) {
        for (int i = 0; i < resultsBox.getChildCount(); i++) {
            View card = resultsBox.getChildAt(i);
            if (card.getTag() == h && card instanceof LinearLayout) {
                LinearLayout cl = (LinearLayout) card;
                for (int j = 0; j < cl.getChildCount(); j++) {
                    View v = cl.getChildAt(j);
                    if (v instanceof TextView && "state".equals(v.getTag())) {
                        LinearLayout actions =
                                (LinearLayout) cl.getChildAt(j + 1);
                        paintCard(h, cl, (TextView) v, actions, searchGen);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ actions

    /** Download the sibling, keep it as a file, open the room. */
    private void openBook(final BookSource.Hit h) {
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_loading"));
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                byte[] data = Net.getBytes(h.siblingUrl);
                if (data == null || data.length == 0) {
                    throw new Exception("empty");
                }
                String key = ReaderBook.keyFor(h.source, h.itemId);
                String ext = h.siblingKind.isEmpty() ? "txt" : h.siblingKind;
                File dir = new File(getFilesDir(), "reader_books");
                dir.mkdirs();
                File f = new File(dir, key + "." + ext);
                java.nio.file.Files.write(f.toPath(), data);
                String buri = f.getAbsolutePath();
                BookStore.addFile(this, buri);
                BookStore.Book book = BookStore.byId(this,
                        BookStore.idFor(buri));
                if (book == null) throw new Exception("not shelved");
                Intent i = new Intent(this, ReaderRoomActivity.class);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_BID, book.id);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_KEY, key);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_TITLE, h.title);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_AUTHOR, h.author);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_SOURCE, h.source);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_ITEM, h.itemId);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_IAID,
                        BookSource.IA.equals(h.source) ? h.itemId
                                : h.readVia);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_PAGES,
                        h.pageImages ? h.pageCount : 0);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_SERIES, h.series);
                String iso = BookSource.IA.equals(h.source)
                        ? MARC_TO_ISO.getOrDefault(h.language, "")
                        : h.language;
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_LANG,
                        iso == null || iso.isEmpty() ? "en" : iso);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    statusView.setText("");
                    startActivity(i);
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                final String failWords = words(e);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_failed")
                            + "\n" + failWords);
                });
            }
        }, "book-open").start();
    }

    /** A LibriVox audiobook: pick a section, play it in the player. */
    private void listenAudiobook(final BookSource.Hit h) {
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_searching"));
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                String json = Net.getString(
                        BookSource.lvSectionsUrl(h.itemId.substring(2)));
                final List<String[]> sections =
                        BookSource.parseLvSections(json);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    statusView.setText("");
                    if (sections.isEmpty()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this,
                                "reader_no_librivox"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    String[] labels = new String[sections.size()];
                    for (int i = 0; i < sections.size(); i++) {
                        labels[i] = sections.get(i)[0];
                    }
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(h.title)
                            .setItems(labels, (d, which) -> {
                                Intent i = new Intent(this,
                                        PlayerActivity.class);
                                i.putExtra("url", sections.get(which)[1]);
                                i.putExtra("name", h.title + " — "
                                        + sections.get(which)[0]);
                                startActivity(i);
                            })
                            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                            .show();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    statusView.setText(words(e));
                });
            }
        }, "librivox-sections").start();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams margins() {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(10);
        return lp;
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams half() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookSource.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * The BookSource framework (v0.16.0) — ONE normalized shape for
 * every lawful, open book source Sandy searches, so the Reader,
 * the Story Fountain and Make-a-Story all drink from the same
 * well. Sources landed in this build, each verified live from
 * the build desk before a line shipped:
 *
 *   ia          Internet Archive — advancedsearch + /metadata.
 *   gutenberg   Project Gutenberg via the Gutendex catalogue —
 *               public file endpoints, formats inline.
 *   openlibrary Open Library search — bibliographic reach; its
 *               readable copies resolve through the Archive leg
 *               (an OL hit carries the IA ids of its editions).
 *   librivox    LibriVox — public-domain audiobooks; openly
 *               reachable section MP3s on the Archive.
 *
 * Named follow-ups (audited, NOT integrated — see the build
 * NOTES): Standard Ebooks (OPDS feeds answered 401 from every
 * public route tried), Wikisource (search works, but a work's
 * text lives across edition subpages — no honest single-text
 * resolution yet), HathiTrust (no credential-free lawful full
 * text verified; metadata only). No logins, no pooled
 * credentials, no wall-bypassing, no pirate/shadow libraries —
 * ever (James's fences, 2026-10-19).
 *
 * DISPLAY HONESTY is the framework's spine: a Hit's state is
 * UNKNOWN until evidence resolves it. OPEN means a readable
 * file is actually accessible (a public sibling in the item's
 * own file list, or a direct public file at the source).
 * WALLED means the book exists but its full text sits behind
 * the source's borrow wall (the Archive's restricted flag, or
 * every readable sibling marked private/encrypted) — named,
 * never circumvented, never promised as readable. A "Read"
 * affordance may render ONLY for OPEN.
 *
 * Pure logic: no Android, no network. The activities fetch
 * through Hydra (Net) and hand the bodies here.
 */
public final class BookSource {

    public static final int UNKNOWN = 0;
    public static final int OPEN = 1;
    public static final int WALLED = 2;

    public static final String IA = "ia";
    public static final String PG = "gutenberg";
    public static final String OL = "openlibrary";
    public static final String LV = "librivox";

    /** The source's own name — worn on every card, never a bucket. */
    public static String sourceName(String sourceId) {
        if (PG.equals(sourceId)) return "Project Gutenberg";
        if (OL.equals(sourceId)) return "Open Library";
        if (LV.equals(sourceId)) return "LibriVox";
        return "Internet Archive";
    }

    /** One normalized book (or audiobook) hit from any source. */
    public static final class Hit {
        public String source = IA;
        public String itemId = "";      // source-local id
        public String title = "";
        public String author = "";
        public String year = "";
        public String language = "";    // as the source states it
        public int state = UNKNOWN;
        public String siblingUrl = "";  // best readable file, OPEN only
        public String siblingKind = ""; // epub / txt / pdf / html
        public boolean pd = false;      // public-domain evidence
        public boolean pageImages = false; // verified page structure
        public int pageCount = 0;       // leaves, 0 = unknown
        public String series = "";      // series name, when metadata carries it
        public final List<String> collections = new ArrayList<>();
        public final List<String> bookshelves = new ArrayList<>();
        public final List<String> iaIds = new ArrayList<>(); // OL editions
        public String readVia = "";     // IA id an OL hit reads through
        public String audioZip = "";    // LibriVox
        public int audioSections = 0;   // LibriVox

        /** The only gate a "Read" promise may hang on. */
        public boolean readable() {
            return state == OPEN && !siblingUrl.isEmpty();
        }
    }

    private BookSource() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------ Internet Archive

    /**
     * advancedsearch over mediatype:texts. Title mode searches
     * title + subject words; author mode searches creator.
     * marcLang (a MARC code like "eng") filters where given.
     */
    public static String iaSearchUrl(String query, boolean byAuthor,
                                     String marcLang, int rows, int page) {
        String q = (byAuthor ? "creator:(" : "title:(")
                + iaQueryWords(query) + ") AND mediatype:(texts)";
        if (marcLang != null && !marcLang.isEmpty()) {
            q += " AND language:(" + marcLang + ")";
        }
        return "https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=" + enc(q)
                + "&fl[]=identifier&fl[]=title&fl[]=creator&fl[]=year"
                + "&fl[]=language&fl[]=collection"
