                + "&rows=" + Math.max(1, rows)
                + "&page=" + Math.max(1, page)
                + "&output=json";
    }

    /**
     * The Story Fountain's IA gate: the International Children's
     * Digital Library collection (identifier "iacl" — measured
     * 3,313 texts on 2026-10-19; the tokens "childrens_library",
     * "childrens" and "childrensbooks" measure ZERO at the
     * Archive, whatever the web calls them). Most-downloaded
     * first, so the shelf fills with the loved books first.
     */
    public static String iaChildrenUrl(int rows, int page) {
        String q = "collection:(iacl) AND mediatype:(texts)";
        return "https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=" + enc(q)
                + "&fl[]=identifier&fl[]=title&fl[]=creator&fl[]=year"
                + "&fl[]=language&fl[]=collection"
                + "&sort[]=downloads+desc"
                + "&rows=" + Math.max(1, rows)
                + "&page=" + Math.max(1, page)
                + "&output=json";
    }

    public static List<Hit> parseIaSearch(String json) {
        List<Hit> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
            JSONObject resp = root.optJSONObject("response");
            if (resp == null) return out;
            JSONArray docs = resp.optJSONArray("docs");
            if (docs == null) return out;
            for (int i = 0; i < docs.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject d = docs.optJSONObject(i);
                if (d == null) continue;
                Hit h = new Hit();
                h.source = IA;
                h.itemId = d.optString("identifier", "");
                h.title = d.optString("title", "");
                h.author = joinNames(d.opt("creator"));
                h.year = yearOf(d.opt("year"));
                h.language = d.optString("language", "");
                Object col = d.opt("collection");
                if (col instanceof JSONArray) {
                    JSONArray a = (JSONArray) col;
                    for (int j = 0; j < a.length(); j++) {
                        h.collections.add(a.optString(j, ""));
                    }
                } else if (col != null) {
                    h.collections.add(String.valueOf(col));
                }
                if (!h.itemId.isEmpty()) out.add(h);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * THE AVAILABILITY DERIVATION (Archive leg). Reads one
     * /metadata body and settles the hit:
     *   - metadata "access-restricted-item": true → WALLED.
     *   - else the best PUBLIC readable sibling (EPUB → TXT →
     *     text-layer PDF; private and encrypted/LCP files never
     *     count) → OPEN.
     *   - readable-format files exist but every one is private
     *     or encrypted → WALLED (the wall's shape without the
     *     flag).
     *   - no readable-format files at all → stays UNKNOWN.
     * Page structure: a PUBLIC scandata file (the Archive's
     * standard book-reader structure) marks pageImages; the
     * leaf count is filled separately from the scandata body.
     */
    public static void applyIaMetadata(Hit h, String metadataJson) {
        try {
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(metadataJson);
            JSONObject meta = root.optJSONObject("metadata");
            boolean restricted = false;
            if (meta != null) {
                Object r = meta.opt("access-restricted-item");
                restricted = r != null && "true".equalsIgnoreCase(
                        String.valueOf(r));
                if (h.series.isEmpty()) {
                    h.series = meta.optString("series", "");
                }
                if (h.title.isEmpty()) {
                    h.title = meta.optString("title", "");
                }
            }
            JSONArray files = root.optJSONArray("files");
            String epub = "", djvu = "", txt = "", pdf = "";
            boolean sawReadable = false;
            boolean scandataPublic = false;
            if (files != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < files.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject f = files.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (f == null) continue;
                    String name = f.optString("name", "");
                    String low = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
                    boolean priv = f.optBoolean("private", false);
                    if (low.endsWith("_scandata.xml")) {
                        if (!priv) scandataPublic = true;
                        continue;
                    }
                    boolean encrypted = low.contains("encrypted")
                            || low.contains(".lcp");
                    boolean isEpub = low.endsWith(".epub");
                    boolean isDjvu = low.endsWith("_djvu.txt");
                    boolean isTxt = low.endsWith(".txt")
                            && !low.contains("searchtext")
                            && !low.endsWith("_djvu.txt");
                    boolean isPdf = low.endsWith(".pdf")
                            && "Text PDF".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                    f.optString("format", ""));
                    if (!(isEpub || isDjvu || isTxt || isPdf)) continue;
                    sawReadable = true;
                    if (priv || encrypted) continue;   // wall evidence
                    String url = iaFileUrl(h.itemId, name);
                    if (isEpub && epub.isEmpty()) epub = url;
                    else if (isDjvu && djvu.isEmpty()) djvu = url;
                    else if (isTxt && txt.isEmpty()) txt = url;
                    else if (isPdf && pdf.isEmpty()) pdf = url;
                }
            }
            h.pageImages = scandataPublic;
            if (restricted) {
                h.state = WALLED;
                h.siblingUrl = "";
                h.siblingKind = "";
                h.pd = false;
            } else if (!epub.isEmpty() || !djvu.isEmpty()
                    || !txt.isEmpty() || !pdf.isEmpty()) {
                h.state = OPEN;
                if (!epub.isEmpty()) {
                    h.siblingUrl = epub; h.siblingKind = "epub";
                } else if (!djvu.isEmpty()) {
                    h.siblingUrl = djvu; h.siblingKind = "txt";
                } else if (!txt.isEmpty()) {
                    h.siblingUrl = txt; h.siblingKind = "txt";
                } else {
                    h.siblingUrl = pdf; h.siblingKind = "pdf";
                }
                h.pd = !collectionsContain(h, LENDING_COLLECTIONS);
            } else if (sawReadable) {
                h.state = WALLED;   // every readable file is locked
                h.pd = false;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static final String[] LENDING_COLLECTIONS = {
            "inlibrary", "printdisabled",
    };

    private static boolean collectionsContain(Hit h, String[] names) {
        for (String c : h.collections) {
            for (String n : names) if (n.equals(c)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** The Archive's standard download door for one file. */
    public static String iaFileUrl(String itemId, String fileName) {
        return "https://archive.org/download/" + itemId + "/"
                + encPath(fileName);
    }

    /** One page of a scanned book, as a picture (BookReader). */
    public static String iaPageUrl(String itemId, int leaf) {
        return "https://archive.org/download/" + itemId
                + "/page/n" + Math.max(0, leaf) + ".jpg";
    }

    /**
     * Leaf count from a scandata body: each page element carries
     * one leafNum attribute. 0 when the structure isn't there —
     * page mode is never offered on an uncounted book.
     */
    public static int scandataLeafCount(String xml) {
        if (xml == null) return 0;
        int count = 0, at = 0;
        while ((at = xml.indexOf("leafNum", at)) >= 0) {
            count++;
            at += 7;
        }
        return count;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ Project Gutenberg

    public static String gutSearchUrl(String query, String langIso1) {
        String u = "https://gutendex.com/books/?search=" + enc(query);
        if (langIso1 != null && !langIso1.isEmpty()) {
            u += "&languages=" + enc(langIso1);
        }
        return u;
    }

    /**
     * Gutendex results resolve AT PARSE: the formats map is the
     * file list. Sibling preference is the house order — EPUB →
     * TXT → HTML (HTML rides BookText's html intake). A book with
     * no readable format stays UNKNOWN, never promised.
     * pd = the catalogue's own copyright flag, inverted.
     */
    public static List<Hit> parseGutSearch(String json) {
        List<Hit> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
            JSONArray results = root.optJSONArray("results");
            if (results == null) return out;
            for (int i = 0; i < results.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject b = results.optJSONObject(i);
                if (b == null) continue;
                Hit h = new Hit();
                h.source = PG;
                h.itemId = "pg" + b.optInt("id", 0);
                h.title = b.optString("title", "");
                JSONArray authors = b.optJSONArray("authors");
                if (authors != null && authors.length() > 0) {
                    h.author = authors.optJSONObject(0) != null
                            ? authors.optJSONObject(0).optString("name", "")
                            : "";
                }
                JSONArray langs = b.optJSONArray("languages");
                if (langs != null && langs.length() > 0) {
                    h.language = langs.optString(0, "");
                }
                h.pd = !b.optBoolean("copyright", true);
                JSONArray shelves = b.optJSONArray("bookshelves");
                if (shelves != null) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < shelves.length(); j++) {
                        h.bookshelves.add(shelves.optString(j, ""));
                    }
                }
                JSONObject formats = b.optJSONObject("formats");
                if (formats != null) {
                    String epub = formats.optString(
                            "application/epub+zip", "");
                    String txt = bestTextFormat(formats);
                    String html = formats.optString("text/html", "");
                    if (!epub.isEmpty()) {
                        h.siblingUrl = epub; h.siblingKind = "epub";
                    } else if (!txt.isEmpty()) {
                        h.siblingUrl = txt; h.siblingKind = "txt";
                    } else if (!html.isEmpty()) {
                        h.siblingUrl = html; h.siblingKind = "html";
                    }
                    if (!h.siblingUrl.isEmpty()) h.state = OPEN;
                }
                if (!h.title.isEmpty()) out.add(h);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    /** text/plain comes in several charset flavors; prefer the
     *  plain .txt file, then any utf-8 variant. */
    private static String bestTextFormat(JSONObject formats) {
        String fallback = "";
        java.util.Iterator<String> keys = formats.keys();
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
            String k = keys.next();
            if (!k.startsWith("text/plain")) continue;
            String v = formats.optString(k, "");
            if (v.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (v.toLowerCase(Locale.US).endsWith(".txt")) return v;
            if (fallback.isEmpty()) fallback = v;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ Open Library

    public static String olSearchUrl(String query, boolean byAuthor,
                                     String langIso1) {
        String u = "https://openlibrary.org/search.json?"
                + (byAuthor ? "author=" : "title=") + enc(query)
                + "&fields=title,author_name,first_publish_year,"
                + "public_scan_b,lending_edition_s,ia,language"
                + "&limit=20";
        if (langIso1 != null && !langIso1.isEmpty()) {
            u += "&language=" + enc(langIso1);
        }
        return u;
    }

    /**
     * Open Library is a catalogue: its hits resolve through the
     * Archive leg. A hit carrying IA edition ids stays UNKNOWN
     * until applyIaMetadata settles it (readVia = the first id).
     * A hit with NO Archive copy but a lending edition is WALLED
     * on the spot; a hit with neither makes no promise at all.
     */
    public static List<Hit> parseOlSearch(String json) {
        List<Hit> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
            JSONArray docs = root.optJSONArray("docs");
            if (docs == null) return out;
            for (int i = 0; i < docs.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject d = docs.optJSONObject(i);
                if (d == null) continue;
                Hit h = new Hit();
                h.source = OL;
                h.title = d.optString("title", "");
                JSONArray an = d.optJSONArray("author_name");
                if (an != null && an.length() > 0) {
                    h.author = an.optString(0, "");
                }
                int yr = d.optInt("first_publish_year", 0);
                h.year = yr > 0 ? String.valueOf(yr) : "";
                JSONArray langs = d.optJSONArray("language");
                if (langs != null && langs.length() > 0) {
                    h.language = langs.optString(0, "");
                }
                JSONArray ia = d.optJSONArray("ia");
                if (ia != null) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < ia.length(); j++) {
                        String id = ia.optString(j, "");
                        if (!id.isEmpty()) h.iaIds.add(id);
                    }
                }
                h.itemId = h.iaIds.isEmpty() ? "" : h.iaIds.get(0);
                h.readVia = h.itemId;
                boolean lending = d.has("lending_edition_s")
                        && !d.isNull("lending_edition_s");
                if (h.iaIds.isEmpty()) {
                    h.state = lending ? WALLED : UNKNOWN;
                } else {
                    h.state = UNKNOWN;   // the Archive leg settles it
                }
                if (!h.title.isEmpty()) out.add(h);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ LibriVox

    public static String lvSearchUrl(String titleQuery) {
        return "https://librivox.org/api/feed/audiobooks?title="
                + enc("^" + (titleQuery == null ? "" : titleQuery.trim()))
                + "&format=json&limit=10";
    }

    public static String lvSectionsUrl(String lvId) {
        return "https://librivox.org/api/feed/audiobooks?id="
                + enc(lvId) + "&format=json&extended=1";
    }

    /**
     * LibriVox hits are audiobooks: OPEN when the recording is
     * openly reachable (the feed's own archive.org zip door and
     * a positive section count are the evidence). LibriVox
     * recordings are public domain by the project's own charter.
     */
    public static List<Hit> parseLvSearch(String json) {
        List<Hit> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
            JSONArray books = root.optJSONArray("books");
            if (books == null) return out;
            for (int i = 0; i < books.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject b = books.optJSONObject(i);
                if (b == null) continue;
                Hit h = new Hit();
                h.source = LV;
                h.itemId = "lv" + b.optString("id", "");
                h.title = b.optString("title", "");
                h.author = lvAuthor(b.optJSONArray("authors"));
                h.language = b.optString("language", "");
                h.year = b.optString("copyright_year", "");
                h.audioZip = b.optString("url_zip_file", "");
                h.audioSections = parseInt(b.optString("num_sections", ""));
                h.pd = true;
                if (!h.audioZip.isEmpty() && h.audioSections > 0) {
                    h.state = OPEN;
                }
                if (!h.title.isEmpty()) out.add(h);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    /** [section title, listen url, seconds] rows, feed order. */
    public static List<String[]> parseLvSections(String json) {
        List<String[]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
            JSONArray books = root.optJSONArray("books");
            if (books == null || books.length() == 0) return out;
            JSONObject b = books.optJSONObject(0);
            JSONArray secs = b != null ? b.optJSONArray("sections") : null;
            if (secs == null) return out;
            for (int i = 0; i < secs.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject s = secs.optJSONObject(i);
                if (s == null) continue;
                String url = s.optString("listen_url", "");
                if (url.isEmpty()) continue;
                String title = s.optString("title", "");
                if (title.isEmpty()) {
                    title = "Section " + s.optString("section_number", "");
                }
                out.add(new String[]{title, url,
                        s.optString("playtime", "0")});
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * The on-book audio sibling, verified: a LibriVox search for
     * the book's title matches only when a returned recording's
     * title equals the book's (normalized) AND the author
     * surnames meet. Anything less is not a match — the button
     * simply never appears.
     */
    public static boolean lvMatches(String searchJson, String title,
                                    String author) {
        for (Hit h : parseLvSearch(searchJson)) {
            if (h.state != OPEN) continue;
            if (!normTitle(h.title).equals(normTitle(title))) continue;
            if (author == null || author.isEmpty()) return true;
            String want = surname(author), got = surname(h.author);
            if (!want.isEmpty() && want.equals(got)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String lvAuthor(JSONArray authors) {
        if (authors == null || authors.length() == 0) return "";
        JSONObject a = authors.optJSONObject(0);
        if (a == null) return "";
        String first = a.optString("first_name", "");
        String last = a.optString("last_name", "");
        return (first + " " + last).trim();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ story gates

    /**
     * The children's collections/shelves the fountain trusts —
     * the gate curation moved to. "iacl" is the Archive's
     * International Children's Digital Library (measured 3,313
     * texts, 2026-10-19). Gutenberg shelves qualify by their own
     * names ("Children's Literature", "Children's Fiction", …).
     */
    public static boolean inChildrensCollection(Hit h) {
        for (String c : h.collections) {
            if ("iacl".equals(c)) return true;
        }
        for (String s : h.bookshelves) {
            if (s != null && s.startsWith("Children")) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * STORY ELIGIBILITY (the fountain gate): named children's
     * collection membership + open + public-domain evidence +
     * a resolvable readable sibling. Anything else is not a
     * story tile, whatever it is.
     */
    public static boolean storyEligible(Hit h) {
        return h != null && h.state == OPEN && h.pd
                && !h.siblingUrl.isEmpty() && inChildrensCollection(h);
    }

    /** Printed shelf counts derive from verified resolutions only. */
    public static int fountainVerified(List<Hit> hits) {
        int n = 0;
        for (Hit h : hits) if (storyEligible(h)) n++;
        return n;
    }

    /**
     * MAKE-A-STORY ELIGIBILITY: any book Sandy can actually read
     * end to end — OPEN with a resolvable text sibling. Walled
     * and unresolved books get the plain no (by never offering).
     */
    public static boolean storyFiable(Hit h) {
        return h != null && h.state == OPEN && !h.siblingUrl.isEmpty();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ helpers

    /** advancedsearch word list: strip Lucene operators, keep words. */
    public static String iaQueryWords(String query) {
        if (query == null) return "";
        String cleaned = query.replaceAll("[+\\-&|!(){}\\[\\]^\"~*?:/\\\\]", " ");
        return cleaned.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
    }

    public static String normTitle(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        return s.toLowerCase(Locale.US)
                .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    /** "Austen, Jane" / "Jane Austen" → "austen". */
    public static String surname(String author) {
        if (author == null) return "";
        String a = author.trim();
        if (a.contains(",")) {
            return normTitle(a.substring(0, a.indexOf(',')));
        }
        String[] parts = a.split("\\s+");
        return normTitle(parts[parts.length - 1]);
    }

    private static String joinNames(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return "";
        if (v instanceof JSONArray) {
            JSONArray a = (JSONArray) v;
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length(); i++) {
                if (b.length() > 0) b.append(", ");
                b.append(a.optString(i, ""));
            }
            return b.toString();
        }
        return String.valueOf(v);
    }

    private static String yearOf(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return "";
        if (v instanceof Number) return String.valueOf(((Number) v).intValue());
        String s = String.valueOf(v).trim();
        return s.length() > 4 ? s.substring(0, 4) : s;
    }

    private static int parseInt(String s) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(s.trim());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    /** Query-component encoding (UTF-8, space as %20). */
    public static String enc(String s) {
        return encode(s, false);
    }

    /** Path-segment encoding (keeps the name readable, escapes rest). */
    public static String encPath(String s) {
        return encode(s, true);
    }

    private static String encode(String s, boolean path) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte by : s.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            int c = by & 0xFF;
            boolean safe = (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
                    || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-' || c == '_'
                    || c == '.' || c == '~' || (path && c == '/');
            if (safe) {
                b.append((char) c);
            } else {
                b.append('%');
                b.append(Character.toUpperCase(Character.forDigit(
                        (c >> 4) & 0xF, 16)));
                b.append(Character.toUpperCase(Character.forDigit(
                        c & 0xF, 16)));
            }
        }
        return b.toString();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.provider.DocumentsContract;
import android.provider.MediaStore;

import org.json.JSONArray;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The book shelf (v0.8.0) — where Sandy's read-aloud finds books.
 * Mirrors LibraryStore's proven shape: the phone's media index
 * (best-effort — Android versions differ in what they expose for
 * documents), folders Mama or James picked on purpose (SAF tree
 * grants, walked with DocumentsContract), and single picked files.
 * The found set is persisted to filesDir/books.tsv so the shelf
 * survives cache clears and reboots alike.
 *
 * Books themselves are never copied or moved: the shelf holds
 * addresses (URIs), and the reader opens the book where it lives.
 */
public final class BookStore {

    private BookStore() {}

    private static final String PREFS = "talatv_books";
    private static final String KEY_FOLDERS = "folders_json";
    private static final String KEY_FILES = "files_json";
    /** Reader-side sanity cap: a book past this is refused in words. */
    public static final int MAX_BOOK_BYTES = 96 * 1024 * 1024;

    public static final class Book {
        public final String id;
        public final String title;
        /** content:// URI string or absolute file path. */
        public final String uri;
        /** epub / txt / pdf (by name; content sniffing happens at read). */
        public final String kind;

        public Book(String id, String title, String uri, String kind) {
            this.id = id;
            this.title = title;
            this.uri = uri;
            this.kind = kind;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ prefs

    private static android.content.SharedPreferences prefs(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    public static List<String> getFolders(Context ctx) {
        return readJsonList(ctx, KEY_FOLDERS);
    }

    public static void addFolder(Context ctx, String treeUri) {
        List<String> cur = getFolders(ctx);
        if (!cur.contains(treeUri)) {
            cur.add(treeUri);
            writeJsonList(ctx, KEY_FOLDERS, cur);
        }
    }

    public static List<String> getFiles(Context ctx) {
        return readJsonList(ctx, KEY_FILES);
    }

    public static void addFile(Context ctx, String uri) {
        List<String> cur = getFiles(ctx);
        if (!cur.contains(uri)) {
            cur.add(uri);
            writeJsonList(ctx, KEY_FILES, cur);
        }
    }

    private static List<String> readJsonList(Context ctx, String key) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            String raw = prefs(ctx).getString(key, "[]");
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(raw);
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) out.add(arr.getString(i));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    private static void writeJsonList(Context ctx, String key, List<String> vals) {
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
            for (String v : vals) arr.put(v);
            prefs(ctx).edit().putString(key, arr.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ shelf

    /** Stable id from the book's address — the bookmark key. */
    public static String idFor(String uri) {
        int h = uri == null ? 0 : uri.hashCode();
        return "b" + Integer.toHexString(h & 0x7fffffff);
    }

    public static String kindForName(String name) {
        String n = name == null ? "" : name.toLowerCase();
        if (n.endsWith(".epub")) return BookText.KIND_EPUB;
        if (n.endsWith(".pdf")) return BookText.KIND_PDF;
        return BookText.KIND_TXT;
    }

    static String titleForName(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) return "A book";
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        String t = slash >= 0 ? name.substring(slash + 1) : name;
        int dot = t.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) t = t.substring(0, dot);
        return t.replace('_', ' ').trim();
    }

    /** The persisted shelf (empty until the first scan). */
    public static List<Book> list(Context ctx) {
        List<Book> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File f = shelfFile(ctx);
        if (!f.isFile()) return out;
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) f.length()];
            int off = 0, n;
            while (off < buf.length && (n = in.read(buf, off, buf.length - off)) > 0) off += n;
            String text = new String(buf, 0, off, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
                if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
                String[] p = line.split("\t", -1);
                if (p.length < 4) continue;
                out.add(new Book(p[0], dec(p[1]), dec(p[2]), p[3]));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    public static Book byId(Context ctx, String id) {
        for (Book b : list(ctx)) if (b.id.equals(id)) return b;
        return null;
    }

    private static File shelfFile(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "books.tsv");
    }

    /** Full rescan: media index + picked folders + picked files. */
    public static List<Book> rescan(Context ctx) {
        Map<String, Book> found = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        scanMediaStore(ctx, found);
        for (String treeUri : getFolders(ctx)) {
            try {
                Uri tree = Uri.parse(treeUri);
                String rootId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree);
                walkTree(ctx, tree, rootId, 0, found);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // A revoked folder is skipped; the shelf keeps the rest.
            }
        }
        for (String uriStr : getFiles(ctx)) {
            String title = displayName(ctx, Uri.parse(uriStr));
            if (title == null) title = titleForName(uriStr);
            found.put(uriStr, new Book(idFor(uriStr), title, uriStr,
                    kindForName(title)));
        }
        List<Book> out = new ArrayList<>(found.values());
        persist(ctx, out);
        return out;
    }

    private static void persist(Context ctx, List<Book> books) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (Book b : books) {
            sb.append(b.id).append('\t')
              .append(enc(b.title)).append('\t')
              .append(enc(b.uri)).append('\t')
              .append(b.kind).append('\n');
        }
        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(shelfFile(ctx))) {
            out.write(sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void scanMediaStore(Context ctx, Map<String, Book> found) {
        try {
            Uri base = MediaStore.Files.getContentUri("external");
            String[] proj = {MediaStore.Files.FileColumns._ID,
                    MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DISPLAY_NAME};
            String sel = MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MIME_TYPE + " IN (?,?)"
                    + " OR " + MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DISPLAY_NAME
                    + " LIKE '%.epub'";
            String[] args = {"application/epub+zip", "text/plain"};
            try (Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(base, proj, sel, args, null)) {
                if (c == null) return;
                int idCol = c.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns._ID);
                int nameCol = c.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                while (c.moveToNext()) {
                    long id = c.getLong(idCol);
                    String name = nameCol >= 0 ? c.getString(nameCol) : null;
                    if (name == null) continue;
                    String kind = kindForName(name);
                    if (BookText.KIND_TXT.equals(kind) && !name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".txt")
                            && !name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".text")) continue;
                    Uri uri = Uri.withAppendedPath(base, String.valueOf(id));
                    found.put(uri.toString(), new Book(idFor(uri.toString()),
                            titleForName(name), uri.toString(), kind));
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            // The index is a courtesy; picked folders are the sure road.
        }
    }

    private static void walkTree(Context ctx, Uri tree, String docId, int depth,
                                 Map<String, Book> out) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        Uri childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, docId);
        try (Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(childrenUri,
                new String[]{DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
                        DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
                        DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE}, null, null, null)) {
            if (c == null) return;
            while (c.moveToNext()) {
                String id = c.getString(0);
                String name = c.getString(1);
                String mime = c.getString(2);
                if (DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR.equals(mime)) {
                    walkTree(ctx, tree, id, depth + 1, out);
                } else if (name != null && isBookName(name)) {
                    Uri docUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, id);
                    out.put(docUri.toString(), new Book(idFor(docUri.toString()),
                            titleForName(name), docUri.toString(), kindForName(name)));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static boolean isBookName(String name) {
        String n = name.toLowerCase();
        return n.endsWith(".epub") || n.endsWith(".txt")
                || n.endsWith(".text") || n.endsWith(".pdf");
    }

    /** Human name for a content URI, or null when the store won't say. */
    public static String displayName(Context ctx, Uri uri) {
        try (Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(uri,
                new String[]{android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                String v = c.getString(0);
                if (v != null && !v.isEmpty()) return v;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ reading

    /** Open the book where it lives. Null on any failure. */
    public static InputStream open(Context ctx, Book b) {
        try {
            if (b.uri.startsWith("content://")) {
                return ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(Uri.parse(b.uri));
            }
            return new FileInputStream(new File(b.uri));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Read the whole book (capped). Null when unreadable or too big. */
    public static byte[] readAll(Context ctx, Book b) {
        try (InputStream in = open(ctx, b)) {
            if (in == null) return null;
            ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buf = new byte[64 * 1024];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) {
                if (bos.size() + n > MAX_BOOK_BYTES) return null;
                bos.write(buf, 0, n);
            }
            return bos.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // TSV field escaping — the same URL-codec shape ChannelStore
    // uses for its caches, kept local so the shelf stands alone.
    private static String enc(String s) {
        try { return java.net.URLEncoder.encode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    private static String dec(String s) {
        try { return java.net.URLDecoder.decode(s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    /** ContentResolver kept referenced for callers that resolve names. */
    static ContentResolver resolver(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getContentResolver();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookText.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.CharBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.CharacterCodingException;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;

/**
 * Book text extraction (v0.8.0, the read-aloud build) — pure Java,
 * no Android imports, so the harness pins it exactly.
 *
 * EPUB: read the zip, follow META-INF/container.xml to the OPF,
 * walk the SPINE in order (the book's own reading order — never zip
 * order, never filename order), take each content document's text.
 * Chapter titles come from the NCX (EPUB 2) or the nav document
 * (EPUB 3) when present, matched to spine items by file name; an
 * item without a mapped title falls back to its own &lt;title&gt; /
 * first heading, then to "Part N". HTML is stripped by walking the
 * parsed DOM; when a content document won't parse as XML, a
 * conservative tag stripper is the fallback (still in spine order).
 *
 * TXT: charset-honest decode — BOMs honored (UTF-8 / UTF-16LE /
 * UTF-16BE); without a BOM, strict UTF-8 first and windows-1252 on
 * malformed input (the usual shape of an old .txt).
 *
 * PDF: read IN THE HOUSE since v0.14.0 (Addendum 7 — extraction
 * comes home) by {@link PdfText}, a lean text-layer reader. A PDF
 * with a real text layer reads like any other book. A PDF whose
 * pages are pictures (scanned images, no text layer) is named
 * plainly — SCANNED_NO_TEXT, a spoken line in the app — never a
 * silent blank and never an errand to another program. Reading
 * scanned pictures (OCR) is a later organ, shared with Eater's
 * ingest, and is named as a gap until it lands.
 *
 * ONE INTAKE (v0.14.0 Addendum 8 — "read any file"): this class
 * is the single mouth of Read Aloud, the Reader, Story Mode book
 * intake, and — when its build comes — Speak For Me. Supported:
 * PDF (text layer), EPUB, TXT, HTML, DOCX, ODT, RTF. Anything
 * outside those classes is named UNSUPPORTED_KIND in plain
 * words, never a dead end or an errand elsewhere.
 */
public final class BookText {

    private BookText() {}

    public static final String KIND_EPUB = "epub";
    public static final String KIND_TXT = "txt";
    public static final String KIND_PDF = "pdf";
    public static final String KIND_HTML = "html";
    public static final String KIND_DOCX = "docx";
    public static final String KIND_ODT = "odt";
    public static final String KIND_RTF = "rtf";
    public static final String KIND_UNSUPPORTED = "unsupported";

    /** A PDF whose pages are pictures — no text layer to read. */
    public static final String SCANNED_NO_TEXT = "scanned-no-text";
    /** A file class this intake does not read; named, never faked. */
    public static final String UNSUPPORTED_KIND = "unsupported-kind";
    public static final String NO_TEXT_FOUND = "no-text-found";

    public static final class Chapter {
        public final String title;
        /** Character offset into Result.text where the chapter starts. */
        public final int charOffset;

        public Chapter(String title, int charOffset) {
            this.title = title;
            this.charOffset = charOffset;
        }
    }

    public static final class Result {
        public boolean ok = false;
        public String kind = "";
        /** When !ok: SCANNED_NO_TEXT / UNSUPPORTED_KIND / NO_TEXT_FOUND. */
        public String failReason = "";
        public String text = "";
        public List<Chapter> chapters = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /** What kind of book do these bytes/name claim to be? */
    public static String kindOf(byte[] data, String name) {
        if (data != null && data.length >= 4
                && data[0] == '%' && data[1] == 'P' && data[2] == 'D' && data[3] == 'F') {
            return KIND_PDF;
        }
        String n = name == null ? "" : name.toLowerCase();
        if (n.endsWith(".pdf")) return KIND_PDF;
        if (n.endsWith(".epub")) return KIND_EPUB;
        if (n.endsWith(".docx")) return KIND_DOCX;
        if (n.endsWith(".odt")) return KIND_ODT;
        if (n.endsWith(".rtf")) return KIND_RTF;
        if (n.endsWith(".html") || n.endsWith(".htm")) return KIND_HTML;
        if (n.endsWith(".txt") || n.endsWith(".text") || n.endsWith(".md")) {
            return KIND_TXT;
        }
        if (data != null) {
            String head = headOf(data, 64);
            if (head.startsWith("{\\rtf")) return KIND_RTF;
            String low = head.toLowerCase();
            if (low.startsWith("<!doctype html") || low.startsWith("<html")) {
                return KIND_HTML;
            }
            // Sniff the zip classes by their insides, whatever the
            // file was renamed to: Word carries word/document.xml,
            // OpenDocument carries content.xml with no OPF, EPUB
            // is the OPF house.
            if (data.length >= 2 && data[0] == 'P' && data[1] == 'K') {
                try {
                    java.util.Map<String, byte[]> z = readZip(data);
                    if (z.containsKey("word/document.xml")) return KIND_DOCX;
                    if (z.containsKey("content.xml")
                            && !hasOpf(z)) return KIND_ODT;
                    return KIND_EPUB;
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return KIND_EPUB;
                }
            }
            if (looksLikeText(data)) return KIND_TXT;
        }
        return KIND_UNSUPPORTED;
    }

    public static Result extract(byte[] data, String name) {
        Result r = new Result();
        String kind = kindOf(data, name);
        r.kind = kind;
        if (data == null || data.length == 0) {
            r.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            return r;
        }
        if (KIND_UNSUPPORTED.equals(kind)) {
            r.failReason = UNSUPPORTED_KIND;
            return r;
        }
        try {
            if (KIND_EPUB.equals(kind)) return extractEpub(data);
            if (KIND_PDF.equals(kind)) return extractPdf(data);
            if (KIND_DOCX.equals(kind)) { r.text = extractDocx(data); }
            else if (KIND_ODT.equals(kind)) { r.text = extractOdt(data); }
            else if (KIND_RTF.equals(kind)) { r.text = rtfToText(data); }
            else if (KIND_HTML.equals(kind)) { r.text = htmlToText(data); }
            else { r.text = decodeText(data); }
            r.ok = !r.text.trim().isEmpty();
            if (!r.ok) r.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            return r;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Result fail = new Result();
            fail.kind = kind;
            fail.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            return fail;
        }
    }

    /** PDF: the text layer, read at home by PdfText. Substantial
     *  text = a readable book, with Page chapters; almost none =
     *  a scanned-image book, named plainly. */
    private static Result extractPdf(byte[] data) {
        Result r = new Result();
        r.kind = KIND_PDF;
        PdfText.Extract ex = PdfText.extract(data);
        // The line: real SHOWN text on a page is a text layer (even a
        // short one — title pages are short). A scanned-image book's
        // streams hold pictures, not text-showing operators, so it
        // yields no pages of text at all.
        if (!ex.pages.isEmpty() && ex.textChars >= 2) {
            r.ok = true;
            r.text = ex.text;
            int offset = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.pages.size(); i++) {
                r.chapters.add(new Chapter("Page " + (i + 1), offset));
                offset += ex.pages.get(i).length() + 2;
            }
        } else {
            r.failReason = SCANNED_NO_TEXT;
        }
        return r;
    }

    private static String headOf(byte[] data, int max) {
        int len = Math.min(data.length, max);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            char c = (char) (data[i] & 0xFF);
            if (c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == ' ') {
                if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(' ');
                continue;
            }
            sb.append(c);
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    /** True when the bytes read as plain text: no NULs and almost
     *  everything printable in the sample. */
    static boolean looksLikeText(byte[] data) {
        int n = Math.min(data.length, 8192);
        if (n == 0) return false;
        int printable = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int b = data[i] & 0xFF;
            if (b == 0) return false;
            if (b == '\n' || b == '\r' || b == '\t'
                    || (b >= 0x20 && b != 0x7F) || b >= 0x80) printable++;
        }
        return printable * 10 >= n * 9;
    }

    private static boolean hasOpf(java.util.Map<String, byte[]> z) {
        for (String k : z.keySet()) if (k.endsWith(".opf")) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /** Zip entries as a map (shared by the DOCX/ODT readers). */
    static java.util.Map<String, byte[]> readZip(byte[] data) throws Exception {
        java.util.Map<String, byte[]> out = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream zin = new java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(
                new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(data));
        java.util.zip.ZipEntry e;
        byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
        while ((e = zin.getNextEntry()) != null) {
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
            int n;
            while ((n = zin.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
            out.put(e.getName(), bos.toByteArray());
        }
        zin.close();
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- DOCX / ODT / RTF

    /** DOCX: word/document.xml — w:t runs inside w:p paragraphs. */
    private static String extractDocx(byte[] data) throws Exception {
        byte[] xml = readZip(data).get("word/document.xml");
        if (xml == null) return "";
        try {
            Document d = parseXml(xml);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            walkDocx(d.getDocumentElement(), sb);
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            String s = new String(xml, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            s = s.replaceAll("</w:p>", "\n");
            return stripAllTags(s);
        }
    }

    private static void walkDocx(Node node, StringBuilder sb) {
        if (node.getNodeType() == Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            sb.append(node.getNodeValue());
            return;
        }
        String tag = node.getNodeName();
        if ("w:tab".equals(tag)) { sb.append('\t'); return; }
        if ("w:br".equals(tag) || "w:cr".equals(tag)) { sb.append('\n'); return; }
        NodeList kids = node.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < kids.getLength(); i++) walkDocx(kids.item(i), sb);
        if ("w:p".equals(tag)) sb.append('\n');
    }

    /** ODT: content.xml — text:p / text:h paragraphs. */
    private static String extractOdt(byte[] data) throws Exception {
        byte[] xml = readZip(data).get("content.xml");
        if (xml == null) return "";
        try {
            Document d = parseXml(xml);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            walkOdt(d.getDocumentElement(), sb);
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            String s = new String(xml, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            s = s.replaceAll("</text:p>", "\n").replaceAll("</text:h>", "\n");
            return stripAllTags(s);
        }
    }

    private static void walkOdt(Node node, StringBuilder sb) {
        if (node.getNodeType() == Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            sb.append(node.getNodeValue());
            return;
        }
        String tag = node.getNodeName();
        if ("text:tab".equals(tag)) { sb.append('\t'); return; }
        if ("text:line-break".equals(tag)) { sb.append('\n'); return; }
        if ("text:s".equals(tag)) { sb.append(' '); return; }
        NodeList kids = node.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < kids.getLength(); i++) walkOdt(kids.item(i), sb);
        if ("text:p".equals(tag) || "text:h".equals(tag)) sb.append('\n');
    }

    private static String stripAllTags(String xml) {
        String s = xml.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", "");
        return s.replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">")
                .replace("&quot;", "\"").replace("&apos;", "'")
                .replace("&amp;", "&");
    }

    /** RTF: a lean reader — destination groups skipped, control
     *  words turned to the text they stand for (\par, \'hh hex,
     *  unicode escapes, fallback skipped). */
    public static String rtfToText(byte[] data) {
        String s = new String(data, Charset.forName("windows-1252"));
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        int i = 0, n = s.length();
        while (i < n) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '{') {
                // destination group? {\* …} or {\fonttbl …} etc.
                int j = i + 1;
                String dest = "";
                if (j < n && s.charAt(j) == '\\') {
                    int k = j + 1;
                    if (k < n && s.charAt(k) == '*') { dest = "*"; }
                    else {
                        int e = k;
                        while (e < n && Character.isLetter(s.charAt(e))) e++;
                        dest = s.substring(k, e);
                    }
                }
                if (dest.equals("*") || dest.equals("fonttbl")
                        || dest.equals("colortbl") || dest.equals("stylesheet")
                        || dest.equals("info") || dest.equals("pict")
                        || dest.equals("object") || dest.equals("themedata")
                        || dest.equals("colorschememapping")) {
                    int depth = 1;
                    i++;
                    while (i < n && depth > 0) {
                        char d = s.charAt(i);
                        if (d == '\\') { i += 2; continue; }
                        if (d == '{') depth++;
                        else if (d == '}') depth--;
                        i++;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                i++;
            } else if (c == '}') {
                i++;
            } else if (c == '\\') {
                i = rtfEscape(s, i, out);
            } else if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
                i++;
            } else {
                out.append(c);
                i++;
            }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static int rtfEscape(String s, int i, StringBuilder out) {
        int n = s.length();
        if (i + 1 >= n) return n;
        char e = s.charAt(i + 1);
        if (e == '\'') {
            if (i + 3 < n) {
                try {
                    int v = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(i + 2, i + 4), 16);
                    byte[] b = { (byte) v };
                    out.append(new String(b, Charset.forName("windows-1252")));
                } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
            }
            return i + 4;
        }
        if (Character.isLetter(e)) {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < n && Character.isLetter(s.charAt(j))) j++;
            String word = s.substring(i + 1, j);
            int k = j;
            boolean neg = false;
            if (k < n && (s.charAt(k) == '-' || s.charAt(k) == '+')) {
                neg = s.charAt(k) == '-'; k++;
            }
            int numStart = k;
            while (k < n && Character.isDigit(s.charAt(k))) k++;
            int num = 0;
            boolean hasNum = k > numStart;
            if (hasNum) {
                try { num = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(numStart, k)); }
                catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
                if (neg) num = -num;
            }
            if (k < n && s.charAt(k) == ' ') k++;
            switch (word) {
                case "par": case "line": out.append('\n'); break;
                case "tab": out.append('\t'); break;
                case "u":
                    if (hasNum) {
                        out.append((char) (num < 0 ? num + 65536 : num));
                        // skip the one fallback char (or \'hh form)
                        if (k + 1 < n && s.charAt(k) == '\\'
                                && s.charAt(k + 1) == '\'') return k + 4;
                        return Math.min(k + 1, n);
                    }
                    break;
                case "emdash": out.append('—'); break;
                case "endash": out.append('–'); break;
                case "lquote": out.append('‘'); break;
                case "rquote": out.append('’'); break;
                case "ldblquote": out.append('“'); break;
                case "rdblquote": out.append('”'); break;
                case "bullet": out.append('•'); break;
                default: break;
            }
            return k;
        }
        // control symbol
        switch (e) {
            case '{': out.append('{'); break;
            case '}': out.append('}'); break;
            case '\\': out.append('\\'); break;
            case '~': out.append(' '); break;
            case '_': out.append('-'); break;
            default: break;
        }
        return i + 2;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ TXT

    /** Charset-honest decode for plain-text books. */
    public static String decodeText(byte[] data) {
        if (data.length >= 3 && (data[0] & 0xFF) == 0xEF
                && (data[1] & 0xFF) == 0xBB && (data[2] & 0xFF) == 0xBF) {
            return new String(data, 3, data.length - 3, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
        if (data.length >= 2 && (data[0] & 0xFF) == 0xFF && (data[1] & 0xFF) == 0xFE) {
            return new String(data, 2, data.length - 2, StandardCharsets.UTF_16LE);
        }
        if (data.length >= 2 && (data[0] & 0xFF) == 0xFE && (data[1] & 0xFF) == 0xFF) {
            return new String(data, 2, data.length - 2, StandardCharsets.UTF_16BE);
        }
        try {
            CharBuffer cb = StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder()
                    .onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                    .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                    .decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(data));
            return cb.toString();
        } catch (CharacterCodingException e) {
            Charset cp1252 = Charset.forName("windows-1252");
            return new String(data, cp1252);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ EPUB

    private static Result extractEpub(byte[] data) throws Exception {
        Map<String, byte[]> entries = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try (ZipInputStream zin = new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(data))) {
            ZipEntry e;
            byte[] buf = new byte[32 * 1024];
            while ((e = zin.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                if (e.isDirectory()) continue;
                ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                int n;
                while ((n = zin.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
                entries.put(e.getName(), bos.toByteArray());
            }
        }
        Result r = new Result();
        r.kind = KIND_EPUB;
        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
            r.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            return r;
        }
        // container.xml -> OPF path
        String opfPath = null;
        byte[] container = entries.get("META-INF/container.xml");
        if (container != null) {
            Document doc = parseXml(container);
            NodeList roots = doc.getElementsByTagName("rootfile");
            if (roots.getLength() > 0) {
                opfPath = ((Element) roots.item(0)).getAttribute("full-path");
            }
        }
        if (opfPath == null || !entries.containsKey(opfPath)) {
            // Fall back to any .opf in the zip (a malformed container
            // shouldn't bury an otherwise readable book).
            for (String k : entries.keySet()) {
                if (k.toLowerCase().endsWith(".opf")) { opfPath = k; break; }
            }
        }
        if (opfPath == null) {
            r.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            return r;
        }
        String opfDir = opfPath.contains("/")
                ? opfPath.substring(0, opfPath.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) : "";
        Document opf = parseXml(entries.get(opfPath));
        // manifest: id -> href + media-type
        Map<String, String> idHref = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, String> idType = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        NodeList items = opf.getElementsByTagName("item");
        for (int i = 0; i < items.getLength(); i++) {
            Element it = (Element) items.item(i);
            idHref.put(it.getAttribute("id"), it.getAttribute("href"));
            idType.put(it.getAttribute("id"), it.getAttribute("media-type"));
        }
        // spine: ordered itemrefs
        List<String> spineHrefs = new ArrayList<>();
        NodeList refs = opf.getElementsByTagName("itemref");
        for (int i = 0; i < refs.getLength(); i++) {
            String idref = ((Element) refs.item(i)).getAttribute("idref");
            String href = idHref.get(idref);
            if (href != null) spineHrefs.add(opfDir + href);
        }
        if (spineHrefs.isEmpty()) {
            r.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            return r;
        }
        // Titles: NCX (epub2) or nav (epub3), keyed by file name.
        Map<String, String> titlesByFile = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        String ncxHref = null;
        NodeList spines = opf.getElementsByTagName("spine");
        if (spines.getLength() > 0) {
            ncxHref = ((Element) spines.item(0)).getAttribute("toc");
        }
        if (ncxHref != null && idHref.containsKey(ncxHref)
                && entries.containsKey(opfDir + idHref.get(ncxHref))) {
            try {
                Document ncx = parseXml(entries.get(opfDir + idHref.get(ncxHref)));
                NodeList points = ncx.getElementsByTagName("navPoint");
                for (int i = 0; i < points.getLength(); i++) {
                    Element p = (Element) points.item(i);
                    String label = firstText(p, "text");
                    NodeList contents = p.getElementsByTagName("content");
                    if (label != null && contents.getLength() > 0) {
                        String src = ((Element) contents.item(0)).getAttribute("src");
                        String file = stripFragment(src);
                        if (!file.isEmpty()) {
                            titlesByFile.put(fileName(file), label.trim());
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Titles are a courtesy; the spine text is the book.
            }
        }
        // Body: spine order, always.
        StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder();
        List<Chapter> chapters = new ArrayList<>();
        int part = 0;
        for (String href : spineHrefs) {
            byte[] raw = entries.get(href);
            if (raw == null) continue;
            String docText = htmlToText(raw);
            String trimmed = docText == null ? "" : docText.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty()) continue;
            part++;
            String title = titlesByFile.get(fileName(href));
            if (title == null || title.isEmpty()) title = docTitle(raw);
            if (title == null || title.isEmpty()) title = "Part " + part;
            if (body.length() > 0) body.append("\n\n");
            chapters.add(new Chapter(title, body.length()));
            body.append(trimmed);
        }
        r.text = body.toString();
        r.chapters = chapters;
        r.ok = !r.text.trim().isEmpty();
        if (!r.ok) r.failReason = NO_TEXT_FOUND;
        return r;
    }

    private static Document parseXml(byte[] raw) throws Exception {
        DocumentBuilderFactory f = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
        f.setNamespaceAware(false);
        // XXE hardening: books are other people's files.
        try { f.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true); }
        catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { f.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", false); }
        catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { f.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities", false); }
        catch (Exception ignored) {}
        f.setExpandEntityReferences(false);
        return f.newDocumentBuilder().parse(new ByteArrayInputStream(raw));
    }

    private static String firstText(Element parent, String tag) {
        NodeList l = parent.getElementsByTagName(tag);
        if (l.getLength() == 0) return null;
        String t = l.item(0).getTextContent();
        return t == null ? null : t;
    }

    private static String stripFragment(String src) {
        if (src == null) return "";
        int h = src.indexOf('#');
        return h >= 0 ? src.substring(0, h) : src;
    }

    private static String fileName(String path) {
        int s = path.lastIndexOf('/');
        return s >= 0 ? path.substring(s + 1) : path;
    }

    /** The content document's own title: &lt;title&gt; or first heading. */
    private static String docTitle(byte[] raw) {
        try {
            Document d = parseXml(raw);
            String t = firstText(d.getDocumentElement(), "title");
            if (t != null && !t.trim().isEmpty()) return t.trim();
            for (String h : new String[]{"h1", "h2"}) {
                String v = firstText(d.getDocumentElement(), h);
                if (v != null && !v.trim().isEmpty()) return v.trim();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * HTML/XHTML to spoken text: DOM walk when it parses (block
     * elements become paragraph breaks), regex strip as fallback.
     */
    public static String htmlToText(byte[] raw) {
        try {
            Document d = parseXml(raw);
            Element body = null;
            NodeList bodies = d.getElementsByTagName("body");
            if (bodies.getLength() > 0) body = (Element) bodies.item(0);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            walkText(body != null ? body : d.getDocumentElement(), sb);
            String out = sb.toString().replaceAll("[ \t\\x0B\f]+", " ")
                    .replaceAll("\n{3,}", "\n\n").trim();
            if (!out.isEmpty()) return out;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // fall through to the stripper
        }
        String s = new String(raw, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        s = s.replaceAll("(?is)<script.*?</script>", " ");
        s = s.replaceAll("(?is)<style.*?</style>", " ");
        s = s.replaceAll("(?i)<br[^>]*>", "\n");
        s = s.replaceAll("(?i)</(p|div|h[1-6]|li|tr)>", "\n\n");
        s = s.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", "");
        s = s.replace("&nbsp;", " ").replace("&amp;", "&")
                .replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">")
                .replace("&quot;", "\"").replace("&#39;", "'").replace("&apos;", "'");
        return s.replaceAll("[ \t\\x0B\f]+", " ")
                .replaceAll("\n{3,}", "\n\n").trim();
    }

    private static void walkText(Node node, StringBuilder sb) {
        if (node == null) return;
        if (node.getNodeType() == Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            sb.append(node.getNodeValue());
            return;
        }
        String name = node.getNodeName() == null ? "" : node.getNodeName().toLowerCase();
        boolean block = name.equals("p") || name.equals("div") || name.equals("h1")
                || name.equals("h2") || name.equals("h3") || name.equals("h4")
                || name.equals("h5") || name.equals("h6") || name.equals("li")
                || name.equals("blockquote") || name.equals("section");
        if (name.equals("script") || name.equals("style")) return;
        if (name.equals("br")) { sb.append('\n'); return; }
        if (block) sb.append("\n\n");
        NodeList kids = node.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < kids.getLength(); i++) walkText(kids.item(i), sb);
        if (block) sb.append("\n\n");
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BookTranslator.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment;

/**
 * Translated reading's engine half (v0.8.0): the ja->en MT from the
 * installed ONNX engine pack, built MT-ONLY (no whisper is loaded —
 * a book needs no ears), exactly the construction OnnxCookerEngine
 * uses for its MT half: SentencePiece over the pack's sp tables and
 * OpusMtOnnx over the pack's mt/ directory.
 *
 * Translation is chunk-wise with a block cap (~480 chars, split on
 * sentence ends) so a long chunk never becomes one giant decode.
 * The MtLoopGuard rides every chunk: loops are dropped and counted,
 * and the count reaches the reader's ears — never a silent skip.
 *
 * Availability is the pack's own truth: EnginePackStore's status.
 * No pack, no offer — the reader says why in one line instead of
 * showing a door that opens onto nothing.
 */
public final class BookTranslator implements AutoCloseable {

    /** Source-block cap for one MT decode. */
    public static final int BLOCK = 480;

    private final OpusMtOnnx mt;
    private final MtLoopGuard guard = new MtLoopGuard();

    private BookTranslator(OpusMtOnnx mt) {
        this.mt = mt;
    }

    /** Is the ja-en engine pack installed and ONNX-shaped? */
    public static boolean available(Context ctx) {
        try {
            EnginePackStore.Status st = EnginePackStore.status(ctx, "ja-en");
            return st != null && st.onnx() && st.dir != null;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Open the MT half of the installed pack. Throws when unusable. */
    public static BookTranslator open(Context ctx) throws Exception {
        EnginePackStore.Status st = EnginePackStore.status(ctx, "ja-en");
        if (st == null || !st.onnx() || st.dir == null) {
            throw new Exception("the ja-en engine pack isn't installed");
        }
        File mtDir = new File(st.dir, "mt");
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        SentencePiece sp = new SentencePiece(
                new File(mtDir, "sp_pieces.tsv"), new File(mtDir, "vocab.tsv"));
        return new BookTranslator(new OpusMtOnnx(env, mtDir, sp));
    }

    /** A new book resets the loop guard. */
    public void beginBook() {
        guard.reset();
    }

    /** Chunks dropped as loops so far in this book. */
    public int droppedLoops() {
        return guard.dropped();
    }

    /**
     * Translate one speakable chunk. Returns the English to speak,
     * or "" when the guard judged it a loop (the caller advances
     * past it; the drop count is spoken in the state line).
     */
    public String translateChunk(String sourceChunk) throws Exception {
        if (sourceChunk == null || sourceChunk.trim().isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (String block : blocks(sourceChunk)) {
            String t = mt.translate(block);
            if (t != null && !t.trim().isEmpty()) {
                if (out.length() > 0) out.append(' ');
                out.append(t.trim());
            }
        }
        String whole = out.toString().trim();
        if (guard.feed(sourceChunk, whole) == MtLoopGuard.Verdict.DROP_LOOP) {
            return "";
        }
        return whole;
    }

    /** Split a chunk into <= BLOCK-char pieces on sentence ends. */
    public static List<String> blocks(String chunk) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();
        int i = 0, n = chunk.length();
        while (i < n) {
            int end = sentenceEnd(chunk, i);
            String sent = chunk.substring(i, end).trim();
            if (!sent.isEmpty()) {
                if (cur.length() > 0 && cur.length() + sent.length() + 1 > BLOCK) {
                    out.add(cur.toString());
                    cur = new StringBuilder();
                }
                if (sent.length() > BLOCK) {
                    // one very long sentence: hard pieces at word edges
                    int s = 0;
                    while (s < sent.length()) {
                        int e = Math.min(s + BLOCK, sent.length());
                        if (e < sent.length()) {
                            int sp = sent.lastIndexOf(' ', e);
                            if (sp > s) e = sp;
                        }
                        if (cur.length() > 0) { out.add(cur.toString()); cur = new StringBuilder(); }
                        out.add(sent.substring(s, e).trim());
                        s = e;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (cur.length() > 0) cur.append(' ');
                    cur.append(sent);
                }
            }
            i = end;
        }
        if (cur.length() > 0) out.add(cur.toString());
        return out;
    }

    private static int sentenceEnd(String s, int from) {
        int n = s.length();
        for (int k = from; k < n; k++) {
            char c = s.charAt(k);
            if (c == '.' || c == '!' || c == '?' || c == '。' || c == '！' || c == '？') {
                int e = k + 1;
                while (e < n && "\"'”’）)]」".indexOf(s.charAt(e)) >= 0) e++;
                boolean cjkTerm = c == '。' || c == '！' || c == '？';
                if (cjkTerm || e >= n || Character.isWhitespace(s.charAt(e))) return e;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { mt.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/BooksActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The book shelf (v0.8.0) — the Read-to-me door inside My Library.
 * Tap a book and Sandy reads it aloud (ReaderActivity + the
 * ReaderService voice). Books arrive three ways: already on the
 * phone (media index), a folder picked on purpose, or a single
 * picked file. Nothing is copied; the shelf holds addresses.
 *
 * Since v0.14.0 every class on the shelf reads at home (PDF text
 * layer included — {@link BookText} is the one intake). A scanned-
 * image PDF or an unsupported file class is named plainly when
 * opened — no silent failures anywhere, no errands elsewhere.
 */
public final class BooksActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_FOLDER = 71;
    private static final int REQ_FILE = 72;

    private ListView list;
    private TextView emptyText;
    private List<BookStore.Book> books = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        CrashGuard.install(this);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setPadding(24, 24, 24, 24);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_title"));
        title.setTextSize(26);
        root.addView(title);

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
        row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button rescan = new Button(this);
        rescan.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_rescan"));
        rescan.setOnClickListener(v -> scan(true));
        row.addView(rescan);
        Button addFolder = new Button(this);
        addFolder.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_add_folder"));
        addFolder.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE);
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_FOLDER);
        });
        row.addView(addFolder);
        Button addFile = new Button(this);
        addFile.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_add_file"));
        addFile.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
            i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
            i.setType("*/*");
            i.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_MIME_TYPES, new String[]{
                    "application/epub+zip", "text/plain", "application/pdf"});
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_FILE);
        });
        row.addView(addFile);
        root.addView(row);

        emptyText = new TextView(this);
        emptyText.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "books_empty"));
        emptyText.setTextSize(18);
        emptyText.setPadding(0, 32, 0, 0);
        root.addView(emptyText);

        list = new ListView(this);
        list.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1));
        list.setOnItemClickListener((parent, view, pos, id) -> {
            BookStore.Book b = books.get(pos);
            Intent i = new Intent(this, ReaderActivity.class);
            i.putExtra(ReaderActivity.X_BOOK, b.id);
            i.putExtra(ReaderActivity.X_AUTOSTART, true);
            startActivity(i);
        });
        root.addView(list);
        setContentView(root);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        books = BookStore.list(this);
        if (books.isEmpty()) scan(false);
        else show();
    }

    private void scan(boolean announce) {
        new Thread(() -> {
            List<BookStore.Book> found = BookStore.rescan(this);
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                books = found;
                show();
            });
        }).start();
    }

    private void show() {
        emptyText.setVisibility(books.isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        list.setAdapter(new ArrayAdapter<BookStore.Book>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1, books) {
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convert, ViewGroup parent) {
                View v = super.getView(pos, convert, parent);
                BookStore.Book b = books.get(pos);
                TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                t1.setText(b.title);
                t1.setTextSize(20);
                t2.setText(subLine(b));
                t2.setTextSize(15);
                return v;
            }
        });
    }

    private static String kindWord(String kind) {
        if (BookText.KIND_EPUB.equals(kind)) return "EPUB";
        if (BookText.KIND_PDF.equals(kind)) return "PDF";
        if (BookText.KIND_DOCX.equals(kind)) return "Word";
        if (BookText.KIND_ODT.equals(kind)) return "OpenDocument";
        if (BookText.KIND_HTML.equals(kind)) return "HTML";
        if (BookText.KIND_RTF.equals(kind)) return "RTF";
        return "Text";
    }

    private String subLine(BookStore.Book b) {
        ReaderStore.Bookmark bm = ReaderStore.bookmark(this, b.id);
        String kindWord = kindWord(b.kind);
        if (bm.finished) {
            return kindWord + " · " + LangStore.tr(this, "reader_finished");
        }
        if (bm.chunk > 0 && bm.totalChunks > 0) {
            int pct = (int) Math.round(100.0 * (bm.chunk + 1) / bm.totalChunks);
            String s = kindWord + " · Part " + (bm.chunk + 1) + " of "
                    + bm.totalChunks + " · " + pct + "%";
            if (!bm.chapter.isEmpty()) s += " · " + bm.chapter;
            return s;
        }
        return kindWord;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int result, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, result, data);
        if (result != RESULT_OK || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
        Uri uri = data.getData();
        int flags = data.getFlags()
                & (Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION
                | Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION);
        try {
            getContentResolver().takePersistableUriPermission(uri, flags);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (req == REQ_FOLDER) {
            BookStore.addFolder(this, uri.toString());
        } else if (req == REQ_FILE) {
            BookStore.addFile(this, uri.toString());
        }
        scan(true);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CardState.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * The Display Honesty Law at the title card (v0.14.0, James,
 * 2026-10-19): A TILE IS A PROMISE. A card's availability binds
 * to a RESOLVED PLAYABLE SOURCE, never to catalogue presence
 * alone. The catalogue (TVmaze) knows a show EXISTS; Sandy's
 * shelves know whether she can PLAY it. A catalogue-only title
 * must not present a play promise: it renders visually
 * distinct — dimmed, plainly worded "Catalog only" BEFORE any
 * tap, no play affordance — and the tap is never where the
 * viewer learns the truth. Where resolution is still running,
 * the card shows its checking state and earns the play promise
 * only when a source resolves; if none resolves, it settles
 * into the catalog-only presentation.
 *
 * This class is the pure state every renderer consults, so
 * walls, lists, and search results cannot drift apart.
 */
public final class CardState {

    /** A playable source stands resolved: the full promise. */
    public static final int PLAYABLE = 0;
    /** Catalogue metadata only: no play promise, dimmed, labeled. */
    public static final int CATALOG_ONLY = 1;
    /** Resolution still running: no promise yet, checking shown. */
    public static final int CHECKING = 2;

    private CardState() {}

    /** The state a show card is in, from its shelf truth. */
    public static int forShow(boolean onShelves, boolean resolutionPending) {
        if (onShelves) return PLAYABLE;
        return resolutionPending ? CHECKING : CATALOG_ONLY;
    }

    /** Only a PLAYABLE card may present as playable. */
    public static boolean playPromise(int state) {
        return state == PLAYABLE;
    }

    /** The whole-card dim a non-playable card renders at. */
    public static float alphaFor(int state) {
        return state == PLAYABLE ? 1.0f : 0.5f;
    }

    /** The availability line's string key for the state. */
    public static String labelKey(int state) {
        switch (state) {
            case PLAYABLE: return "wall_available";
            case CHECKING: return "card_checking";
            default: return "wall_catalog_only";
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CatalogIndex.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
