import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

/**
 * The on-demand index, by language (v0.10.0 — James's expansion order:
 * "more tiles with more availability… organized by language picked").
 *
 * Sandy doesn't download the catalogue's contents; she gathers the
 * INDEX — TVmaze's own show records, walked page by page — and files
 * every show under its own language, so a language wall is that
 * language's real depth, not the English slice wearing a flag. This
 * class is the pure half: records, bucketing, country shelves, sorting,
 * and the on-disk cache format (one JSON file per language + one state
 * file). Fetching and rendering live in the activities.
 *
 * Honesty rules baked in:
 *  - a show's language/country are TVmaze's own fields; a show with
 *    no language listed files under NO_LANGUAGE and is never dressed
 *    up as something it isn't;
 *  - sub-languages stand as their own shelves BY COUNTRY (Spanish
 *    from Spain and Spanish from Mexico are two shelves, not one);
 *  - the state says how many index pages have actually been walked —
 *    counts shown in the app are gathered counts, never index totals
 *    the phone hasn't seen.
 */
public final class CatalogIndex {

    /** Language name TVmaze uses when a show lists none. */
    public static final String NO_LANGUAGE = "";

    /** Shelf label for shows whose network/web channel states no country. */
    public static final String COUNTRY_WEB = "Worldwide (web)";

    private CatalogIndex() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- record

    /** One gathered show, in the compact form the wall needs. */
    public static final class Record {
        public int id;
        public String name = "";
        public String language = "";
        public String countryName = "";
        public String countryCode = "";
        public String image = "";
        public String premiered = "";
        public String status = "";
        // v0.11.1: TVmaze's own show type. Records gathered before
        // 0.11.1 read "" here — "not listed", never guessed — until
        // the format-2 walk re-gathers their page.
        public String type = "";
        public double rating = -1;
        public List<String> genres = new ArrayList<>();

        public JSONObject toJson() throws Exception {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", id);
            o.put("name", name);
            o.put("language", language);
            o.put("countryName", countryName);
            o.put("countryCode", countryCode);
            o.put("image", image);
            o.put("premiered", premiered);
            o.put("status", status);
            o.put("type", type);
            o.put("rating", rating);
            JSONArray g = new JSONArray();
            for (String genre : genres) g.put(genre);
            o.put("genres", g);
            return o;
        }

        public static Record fromJson(JSONObject o) {
            Record r = new Record();
            r.id = o.optInt("id");
            r.name = o.optString("name", "");
            r.language = o.optString("language", "");
            r.countryName = o.optString("countryName", "");
            r.countryCode = o.optString("countryCode", "");
            r.image = o.optString("image", "");
            r.premiered = o.optString("premiered", "");
            r.status = o.optString("status", "");
            r.type = o.optString("type", "");
            r.rating = o.optDouble("rating", -1);
            JSONArray g = o.optJSONArray("genres");
            if (g != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < g.length(); i++) {
                    String s = g.optString(i, "");
                    if (!s.isEmpty()) r.genres.add(s);
                }
            }
            return r;
        }

        public TvMaze.Show toShow() {
            TvMaze.Show s = new TvMaze.Show();
            s.id = id;
            s.name = name;
            s.language = language;
            s.countryName = countryName;
            s.countryCode = countryCode;
            s.imageMedium = image;
            s.premiered = premiered;
            s.status = status;
            s.type = type;
            s.rating = rating;
            s.genres = new ArrayList<>(genres);
            return s;
        }
    }

    public static Record fromShow(TvMaze.Show s) {
        Record r = new Record();
        r.id = s.id;
        r.name = s.name;
        r.language = s.language;
        r.countryName = s.countryName;
        r.countryCode = s.countryCode;
        r.image = s.imageMedium;
        r.premiered = s.premiered;
        r.status = s.status;
        r.type = s.type;
        r.rating = s.rating;
        r.genres = new ArrayList<>(s.genres);
        return r;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- state

    /** How far the index walk has honestly gotten on this phone. */
    public static final class State {
        /** Bucket format this state was written under. Format 1
         *  (through 0.11.0) dropped each show's TYPE; format 2
         *  (0.11.1) carries it. A format-1 state with a finished
         *  walk earns one honest re-walk so the type lands. */
        public static final int FORMAT_TYPE = 2;
        public int format = 1;
        public int pagesWalked;          // next page to fetch = pagesWalked
        public boolean complete;         // a page answered 404/empty
        public long updatedAtMs;
        /** TVmaze language name -> gathered count. */
        public final Map<String, Integer> counts = new TreeMap<>();

        public JSONObject toJson() throws Exception {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("format", format);
            o.put("pagesWalked", pagesWalked);
            o.put("complete", complete);
            o.put("updatedAtMs", updatedAtMs);
            JSONObject c = new JSONObject();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : counts.entrySet()) {
                c.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
            }
            o.put("counts", c);
            return o;
        }

        public static State fromJson(String json) {
            State st = new State();
            if (json == null || json.isEmpty()) return st;
            try {
                JSONObject o = new JSONObject(json);
                st.format = o.optInt("format", 1);
                st.pagesWalked = o.optInt("pagesWalked", 0);
                st.complete = o.optBoolean("complete", false);
                st.updatedAtMs = o.optLong("updatedAtMs", 0);
                JSONObject c = o.optJSONObject("counts");
                if (c != null) {
                    JSONArray names = c.names();
                    if (names != null) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < names.length(); i++) {
                            String k = names.optString(i, "");
                            st.counts.put(k, c.optInt(k, 0));
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            return st;
        }

        public int totalGathered() {
            int n = 0;
            for (int v : counts.values()) n += v;
            return n;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- files

    /** Cache file name for one language bucket ("" -> the no-language file). */
    public static String bucketFileName(String languageName) {
        String key = (languageName == null || languageName.isEmpty())
                ? "none" : languageName.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US)
                        .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "_");
        return "lang_" + key + ".json";
    }

    public static String bucketToJson(List<Record> bucket) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
        for (Record r : bucket) arr.put(r.toJson());
        return arr.toString();
    }

    public static List<Record> bucketFromJson(String json) {
        List<Record> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (json == null || json.isEmpty()) return out;
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                out.add(Record.fromJson(arr.getJSONObject(i)));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- shaping

    /** The TVmaze language name a UI language code opens ("" = none). */
    public static String languageNameForCode(String code) {
        return UiStrings.facetFor(code);
    }

    /** Every show in the bucket for one TVmaze language name. */
    public static List<Record> bucketOf(List<Record> all, String languageName) {
        List<Record> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String want = languageName == null ? "" : languageName;
        for (Record r : all) {
            String lang = r.language == null ? "" : r.language;
            if (lang.equals(want)) out.add(r);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The shelf key a record sits on: its country, or the web shelf. */
    public static String shelfOf(Record r) {
        return (r.countryName == null || r.countryName.isEmpty())
                ? COUNTRY_WEB : r.countryName;
    }

    /**
     * Country shelves for one language bucket: shelf name -> its shows,
     * shelves ordered home country first (when given and present), the
     * web shelf last, the rest A→Z. Shows inside a shelf are wall-sorted.
     */
    public static LinkedHashMap<String, List<Record>> shelves(
            List<Record> bucket, String homeCountryName) {
        Map<String, List<Record>> byShelf = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Record r : bucket) {
            byShelf.computeIfAbsent(shelfOf(r), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);
        }
        List<String> names = sortShelves(byShelf.keySet(), homeCountryName);
        LinkedHashMap<String, List<Record>> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String n : names) {
            List<Record> members = byShelf.get(n);
            sortShows(members);
            out.put(n, members);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static List<String> sortShelves(Collection<String> shelves,
                                           String homeCountryName) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>(shelves);
        Collections.sort(out, (a, b) -> {
            int ra = shelfRank(a, homeCountryName);
            int rb = shelfRank(b, homeCountryName);
            if (ra != rb) return ra - rb;
            return a.compareToIgnoreCase(b);
        });
        return out;
    }

    private static int shelfRank(String shelf, String homeCountryName) {
        if (homeCountryName != null && !homeCountryName.isEmpty()
                && shelf.equalsIgnoreCase(homeCountryName)) return 0;
        if (COUNTRY_WEB.equals(shelf)) return 2;
        return 1;
    }

    /** Wall order inside a shelf: best rated first, newest premieres
     *  break ties, then the title's own name. Unrated goes last. */
    public static void sortShows(List<Record> shows) {
        Collections.sort(shows, (a, b) -> {
            if (a.rating != b.rating) return Double.compare(b.rating, a.rating);
            int byDate = b.premiered.compareTo(a.premiered);
            if (byDate != 0) return byDate;
            return a.name.compareToIgnoreCase(b.name);
        });
    }

    /** Merge freshly walked shows into the gathered set, by show id. */
    public static void mergeInto(Map<Integer, Record> gathered,
                                 List<TvMaze.Show> page) {
        for (TvMaze.Show s : page) {
            if (s.id > 0) gathered.put(s.id, fromShow(s));
        }
    }

    /** Recompute the honest per-language counts for the state file. */
    public static void recount(State st, Collection<Record> all) {
        st.counts.clear();
        for (Record r : all) {
            String lang = r.language == null ? "" : r.language;
            st.counts.merge(lang, 1, Integer::sum);
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------- facets + sorts (v0.11.1)

    /**
     * Findability (James's field order from 0.11.0 in his hands): a
     * wall of two thousand titles nobody can cut is a wall that
     * fails its one job — FINDING. Facets cut any gathered pool by
     * genre / year / type / status; every facet's option list is
     * DERIVED from the pool itself, so a chip never promises a
     * category the pool doesn't hold, and a category the data does
     * hold is never hidden. Fields TVmaze left blank stay blank and
     * answer only to the "not listed" facet — never guessed into a
     * category.
     */
    public enum SortMode { BEST, AZ, ZA, NEWEST, OLDEST }

    /** A facet value meaning "the record lists none" (type/status/
     *  genre). Chosen so it can never collide with TVmaze data. */
    public static final String NOT_LISTED = "\u0001not-listed";

    /** One cut across a pool. Empty string = no cut on that axis. */
    public static final class FacetSet {
        public String genre = "";
        public String type = "";
        public String status = "";
        /** Inclusive premiere-year range; lo < 0 = no year cut. */
        public int yearLo = -1, yearHi = -1;
        /** The year cut means "premiered not listed". */
        public boolean yearNotListed = false;

        public boolean active() {
            return !genre.isEmpty() || !type.isEmpty() || !status.isEmpty()
                    || yearLo >= 0 || yearNotListed;
        }

        public boolean matches(Record r) {
            if (!genre.isEmpty()) {
                if (NOT_LISTED.equals(genre)) {
                    if (!r.genres.isEmpty()) return false;
                } else if (!r.genres.contains(genre)) return false;
            }
            if (!type.isEmpty()) {
                if (NOT_LISTED.equals(type)) {
                    if (!r.type.isEmpty()) return false;
                } else if (!type.equals(r.type)) return false;
            }
            if (!status.isEmpty()) {
                if (NOT_LISTED.equals(status)) {
                    if (!r.status.isEmpty()) return false;
                } else if (!status.equals(r.status)) return false;
            }
            if (yearNotListed) {
                if (yearOf(r) >= 0) return false;
            } else if (yearLo >= 0) {
                int y = yearOf(r);
                if (y < yearLo || y > yearHi) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    /** The pool cut by the facets, in pool order. */
    public static List<Record> applyFacets(List<Record> pool, FacetSet f) {
        List<Record> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (f == null || !f.active()) { out.addAll(pool); return out; }
        for (Record r : pool) if (f.matches(r)) out.add(r);
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Value → count for one text axis over the pool, biggest first,
     * ties A→Z; a "not listed" entry (key NOT_LISTED) is present
     * only when the pool actually holds unlisted records.
     */
    public static LinkedHashMap<String, Integer> facetCounts(
            List<Record> pool, String axis) {
        Map<String, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
        int unlisted = 0;
        for (Record r : pool) {
            switch (axis) {
                case "genre":
                    if (r.genres.isEmpty()) unlisted++;
                    else for (String g : r.genres) {
                        counts.merge(g, 1, Integer::sum);
                    }
                    break;
                case "type":
                    if (r.type.isEmpty()) unlisted++;
                    else counts.merge(r.type, 1, Integer::sum);
                    break;
                case "status":
                    if (r.status.isEmpty()) unlisted++;
                    else counts.merge(r.status, 1, Integer::sum);
                    break;
                default: break;
            }
        }
        List<Map.Entry<String, Integer>> es = new ArrayList<>(counts.entrySet());
        Collections.sort(es, (a, b) -> {
            int byCount = b.getValue() - a.getValue();
            return byCount != 0 ? byCount
                    : a.getKey().compareToIgnoreCase(b.getKey());
        });
        LinkedHashMap<String, Integer> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : es) out.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
        if (unlisted > 0) out.put(NOT_LISTED, unlisted);
        return out;
    }

    /** The premiere year a record states, or -1 when it states none
     *  (or states something that isn't a year). */
    public static int yearOf(Record r) {
        if (r == null || r.premiered == null || r.premiered.length() < 4) {
            return -1;
        }
        try {
            int y = Integer.parseInt(r.premiered.substring(0, 4));
            return (y >= 1800 && y <= 2200) ? y : -1;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    /** The decade bucket a year sits in (1994 → 1990). */
    public static int decadeOf(int year) { return (year / 10) * 10; }

    /** Decade starts present in the pool, oldest first. */
    public static List<Integer> decadesIn(List<Record> pool) {
        java.util.TreeSet<Integer> ds = new java.util.TreeSet<>();
        for (Record r : pool) {
            int y = yearOf(r);
            if (y >= 0) ds.add(decadeOf(y));
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(ds);
    }

    /** Individual years present inside one decade, newest first. */
    public static List<Integer> yearsIn(List<Record> pool, int decade) {
        java.util.TreeSet<Integer> ys = new java.util.TreeSet<>();
        for (Record r : pool) {
            int y = yearOf(r);
            if (y >= 0 && decadeOf(y) == decade) ys.add(y);
        }
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>(ys);
        out.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
        return out;
    }

    /** True when the pool holds records with no premiere year. */
    public static boolean hasNoYear(List<Record> pool) {
        for (Record r : pool) if (yearOf(r) < 0) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /** Sort a list into the picked order. Unknown dates/ratings
     *  always sink to the end of their axis — unknown is never
     *  dressed as oldest, newest, or best. */
    public static void sortBy(List<Record> shows, SortMode mode) {
        if (mode == null || mode == SortMode.BEST) { sortShows(shows); return; }
        switch (mode) {
            case AZ:
                Collections.sort(shows, (a, b) -> {
                    int byName = a.name.compareToIgnoreCase(b.name);
                    return byName != 0 ? byName : Integer.compare(a.id, b.id);
                });
                break;
            case ZA:
                Collections.sort(shows, (a, b) -> {
                    int byName = b.name.compareToIgnoreCase(a.name);
                    return byName != 0 ? byName : Integer.compare(a.id, b.id);
                });
                break;
            case NEWEST:
                Collections.sort(shows, (a, b) -> {
                    int byDate = dateKey(b).compareTo(dateKey(a));
                    if (byDate != 0) return byDate;
                    if (a.rating != b.rating) return Double.compare(b.rating, a.rating);
                    return a.name.compareToIgnoreCase(b.name);
                });
                break;
            case OLDEST:
                Collections.sort(shows, (a, b) -> {
                    String da = dateKey(a), db = dateKey(b);
                    if (da.isEmpty() != db.isEmpty()) return da.isEmpty() ? 1 : -1;
                    int byDate = da.compareTo(db);
                    if (byDate != 0) return byDate;
                    if (a.rating != b.rating) return Double.compare(b.rating, a.rating);
                    return a.name.compareToIgnoreCase(b.name);
                });
                break;
            default: break;
        }
    }

    /** Sortable premiere date: "" when none is stated (sinks last
     *  in NEWEST by plain string order, explicitly last in OLDEST). */
    private static String dateKey(Record r) {
        return (r.premiered == null || yearOf(r) < 0) ? "" : r.premiered;
    }

    /** The A–Z jump letter of a title: its first letter, upper-cased;
     *  anything else (digits, symbols, empty) files under '#'. */
    public static char letterOf(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) return '#';
        char c = Character.toUpperCase(name.charAt(0));
        return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') ? c : '#';
    }

    /** First index in an A–Z-sorted list whose title files under
     *  the letter, or -1 when the list holds none. '#' reads as
     *  "before A" — index 0 when any '#' titles exist. */
    public static int firstIndexForLetter(List<Record> azSorted, char letter) {
        for (int i = 0; i < azSorted.size(); i++) {
            if (letterOf(azSorted.get(i).name) == letter) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /** The jump letters a list actually holds, '#' first, A–Z after. */
    public static List<Character> lettersIn(List<Record> shows) {
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[27];
        for (Record r : shows) {
            char c = letterOf(r.name);
            seen[c == '#' ? 0 : (c - 'A' + 1)] = true;
        }
        List<Character> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 27; i++) {
            if (seen[i]) out.add(i == 0 ? '#' : (char) ('A' + i - 1));
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CatalogStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * On-disk home of the gathered catalogue index (v0.10.0): one JSON
 * bucket per language + the walk state, under files/catalog/. The
 * wall reads from here, so a language wall works fully offline from
 * whatever the walk has honestly gathered so far.
 */
public final class CatalogStore {

    private CatalogStore() {}

    public static File dir(Context ctx) {
        File d = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "catalog");
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    public static File stateFile(Context ctx) {
        return new File(dir(ctx), "index_state.json");
    }

    public static File bucketFile(Context ctx, String languageName) {
        return new File(dir(ctx), CatalogIndex.bucketFileName(languageName));
    }

    public static CatalogIndex.State loadState(Context ctx) {
        return CatalogIndex.State.fromJson(readFile(stateFile(ctx)));
    }

    public static void saveState(Context ctx, CatalogIndex.State st) {
        try {
            st.updatedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
            writeFile(stateFile(ctx), st.toJson().toString());
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    /** Every gathered record on this phone, keyed by TVmaze id. */
    public static Map<Integer, CatalogIndex.Record> loadGathered(Context ctx) {
        Map<Integer, CatalogIndex.Record> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        File[] files = dir(ctx).listFiles(
                (d, name) -> name.startsWith("lang_") && name.endsWith(".json"));
        if (files == null) return out;
        for (File f : files) {
            for (CatalogIndex.Record r : CatalogIndex.bucketFromJson(readFile(f))) {
                if (r.id > 0) out.put(r.id, r);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Rewrite one language's bucket file from the gathered set. */
    public static void saveBucket(Context ctx, Map<Integer, CatalogIndex.Record> gathered,
                                  String languageName) {
        try {
            List<CatalogIndex.Record> bucket =
                    CatalogIndex.bucketOf(new ArrayList<>(gathered.values()), languageName);
            CatalogIndex.sortShows(bucket);
            writeFile(bucketFile(ctx, languageName), CatalogIndex.bucketToJson(bucket));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    /**
     * The availability shelf for this phone right now: candidate keys
     * from every loaded playlist entry + every indexed library file.
     * Built fresh by callers on a background thread (the channel cache
     * parse is the expensive part, and only happens there).
     */
    public static Availability.Shelf shelf(Context ctx) {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        List<M3uParser.Channel> pl = ChannelStore.loadCache(ctx);
        if (pl != null) {
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : pl) names.add(c.name);
        }
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : LibraryStore.loadChannels(ctx)) {
            names.add(c.name);
        }
        return new Availability.Shelf(Availability.buildKeySet(names));
    }

    /** Availability verdict for one record: shelf evidence or a proven Archive find. */
    public static boolean isAvailable(Context ctx, Availability.Shelf shelf,
                                      CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        if (r == null) return false;
        if (shelf != null && shelf.carries(r.name)) return true;
        return ChannelStore.isArchiveProven(ctx, r.id);
    }

    public static String readFile(File f) {
        if (f == null || !f.exists()) return null;
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) f.length()];
            int off = 0, n;
            while (off < buf.length && (n = in.read(buf, off, buf.length - off)) > 0) off += n;
            return new String(buf, 0, off, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static void writeFile(File f, String content) {
        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(f)) {
            out.write(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ChannelNames.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.StringReader;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Real channel names (v0.5.0, Delwin's field report #1: "the names are
 * just more randomized... you can't tell what a station is").
 *
 * The built-in directory's playlist names are feed titles, not station
 * names — 9,538 of the 11,356 carry junk like "(1080p)", "[Not 24/7]"
 * or a trailing "HD". iptv-org's own channels database knows the real
 * name (and a logo) for the channel behind each tvg-id. This class is
 * the join: tvg-id (minus its @feed suffix) -> {canonical name, logo}.
 *
 * The map itself is a plain TSV (key \t urlenc(name) \t urlenc(logo)),
 * seeded from a bundled snapshot (app/assets/channels_map.tsv, built
 * by work/v050/make_map.py) and refreshed from the live API files
 * (buildMapTsv below) whenever the guide refreshes. Measured at build
 * time on the real directory: 11,356 of 11,356 entries mapped to a
 * canonical name; 11,079 also got a logo. User-loaded playlists can
 * carry ids the database doesn't know — those fall back to cleanName.
 *
 * Pure logic only (no Android imports) so the JVM harness can drive
 * it against the real snapshot files.
 */
public final class ChannelNames {

    /** tvg-id key -> {canonical name, logo url}. */
    private static volatile Map<String, String[]> map = new HashMap<>();

    private ChannelNames() {}

    public static void setMap(Map<String, String[]> m) {
        map = m == null ? new HashMap<>() : m;
    }

    public static Map<String, String[]> getMap() {
        return map;
    }

    /** The join key: the database id is the tvg-id before any @feed. */
    public static String keyOf(String tvgId) {
        if (tvgId == null) return "";
        int at = tvgId.indexOf('@');
        return at >= 0 ? tvgId.substring(0, at) : tvgId;
    }

    /** Apply the map to one channel (sets canonName / canonLogo). */
    public static void applyTo(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        if (c == null || c.tvgId == null || c.tvgId.isEmpty()) return;
        String[] hit = map.get(keyOf(c.tvgId));
        if (hit == null) return;
        if (hit.length > 0 && hit[0] != null && !hit[0].isEmpty()) c.canonName = hit[0];
        if (hit.length > 1 && hit[1] != null && !hit[1].isEmpty()) c.canonLogo = hit[1];
        if (hit.length > 2 && hit[2] != null && !hit[2].isEmpty()) c.canonDef = hit[2];
    }

    /**
     * The per-channel DEFINITION line (v0.6.0, field note #2c): one
     * plain phrase saying what the channel is. Source order: the
     * channels database's own categories (joined into the map at
     * build/refresh time); else the playlist's own group when it
     * says something real. When neither knows, this returns "" —
     * honest absence: the row shows no definition rather than an
     * invented one.
     */
    public static String definitionFor(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        if (c == null) return "";
        if (c.canonDef != null && !c.canonDef.isEmpty()) return c.canonDef;
        String g = c.group == null ? "" : c.group.trim();
        if (!g.isEmpty() && !"Undefined".equalsIgnoreCase(g)) return g;
        return "";
    }

    public static void applyToAll(List<M3uParser.Channel> channels) {
        if (channels == null) return;
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) applyTo(c);
    }

    /** Count of channels in the list that the map names. */
    public static int mappedCount(List<M3uParser.Channel> channels) {
        int n = 0;
        if (channels != null) {
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
                if (!c.canonName.isEmpty()) n++;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ search

    /**
     * Live TV search (v0.5.0, Delwin #2): a query matches the canonical
     * name, the raw playlist name, or the group — case-insensitively.
     */
    public static boolean matchesQuery(M3uParser.Channel c, String qLowerTrimmed) {
        if (qLowerTrimmed == null || qLowerTrimmed.isEmpty()) return true;
        if (c.displayName().toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(qLowerTrimmed)) return true;
        if (c.name != null && c.name.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(qLowerTrimmed)) return true;
        if (c.group != null && c.group.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(qLowerTrimmed)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- name cleaner

    private static final Pattern BRACKET_TAG = Pattern.compile("\\[[^\\]]*\\]");
    private static final Pattern PAREN_RES = Pattern.compile(
            "\\(\\s*(\\d{3,4}\\s*[pi]|hd|sd|fhd|uhd|4k|8k|hevc|h\\.?264|h\\.?265|x264|x265)\\s*\\)",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    private static final Pattern TRAILING_QUALITY = Pattern.compile(
            "\\s+(HD|SD|FHD|UHD|4K|HEVC)$", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);

    /**
     * The fallback for unmapped entries: strip the feed-title junk and
     * keep the station. Conservative on purpose — bracketed labels and
     * resolution tokens go; meaningful parentheses (a country, a
     * region) stay; only a trailing standalone quality word is cut.
     * Never returns empty: if cleaning would erase the name, the raw
     * name (trimmed) is the answer.
     */
    public static String cleanName(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return "";
        String s = raw.trim();
        if (s.isEmpty()) return s;
        s = BRACKET_TAG.matcher(s).replaceAll(" ");
        s = PAREN_RES.matcher(s).replaceAll(" ");
        s = s.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        String prev;
        do {
            prev = s;
            s = TRAILING_QUALITY.matcher(s).replaceAll("").trim();
        } while (!s.equals(prev));
        s = s.replaceAll("[\\s·|]+$", "").trim();
        return s.isEmpty() ? raw.trim() : s;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ map TSV

    private static String enc(String s) {
        try { return URLEncoder.encode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    private static String dec(String s) {
        try { return URLDecoder.decode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    public static Map<String, String[]> parseMapTsv(String text) throws IOException {
        Map<String, String[]> out = new HashMap<>();
        BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new StringReader(text == null ? "" : text));
        String line;
        while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String[] p = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (p.length < 2) continue;
            String logo = p.length > 2 ? dec(p[2]) : "";
            String def = p.length > 3 ? dec(p[3]) : "";
            out.put(p[0], new String[]{dec(p[1]), logo, def});
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String toMapTsv(Map<String, String[]> m) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy channel-name map - iptv-org database\n");
        for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> e : m.entrySet()) {
            sb.append(e.getKey()).append('\t')
              .append(enc(e.getValue()[0])).append('\t')
              .append(enc(e.getValue().length > 1 ? e.getValue()[1] : ""))
              .append('\t')
              .append(enc(e.getValue().length > 2 ? e.getValue()[2] : ""))
              .append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /**
     * A channel's definition from its database record (v0.6.0): the
     * first two categories, humanized — "Animation · Kids". Empty
     * when the database lists none (26,262 of 31,632 records carry
     * categories in the 2026-10-17 snapshot; the rest stay honestly
     * undefined here and fall back to the playlist group at display).
     */
    private static String definitionOf(JSONObject c) {
        JSONArray cats = c.optJSONArray("categories");
        if (cats == null || cats.length() == 0) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < cats.length() && i < 2; i++) {
            String cat = cats.optString(i, "");
            if (cat.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(" · ");
            sb.append(Character.toUpperCase(cat.charAt(0)));
            if (cat.length() > 1) sb.append(cat.substring(1));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- build from the API

    /**
     * Build the join map from iptv-org's published API files
     * (https://iptv-org.github.io/api/channels.json + logos.json) —
     * the same rule as work/v050/make_map.py: canonical name from the
     * channels database; logo = an in-use raster (PNG/JPG/WEBP),
     * preferring the smallest that is at least 200 px wide.
     */
    public static Map<String, String[]> buildMap(String channelsJson, String logosJson)
            throws Exception {
        Map<String, String[]> out = new HashMap<>();
        JSONArray chans = new JSONArray(channelsJson);
        for (int i = 0; i < chans.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject c = chans.getJSONObject(i);
            String id = c.optString("id", "");
            String name = c.optString("name", "");
            if (!id.isEmpty() && !name.isEmpty()) {
                out.put(id, new String[]{name, "", definitionOf(c)});
            }
        }
        if (logosJson != null && !logosJson.isEmpty()) {
            Map<String, Integer> bestWidth = new HashMap<>();
            JSONArray logos = new JSONArray(logosJson);
            for (int i = 0; i < logos.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject l = logos.getJSONObject(i);
                if (!l.optBoolean("in_use", true)) continue;
                String fmt = l.optString("format", "").toUpperCase(Locale.US);
                if (!("PNG".equals(fmt) || "JPG".equals(fmt)
                        || "JPEG".equals(fmt) || "WEBP".equals(fmt))) continue;
                String cid = l.optString("channel", "");
                String url = l.optString("url", "");
                if (cid.isEmpty() || url.isEmpty() || !out.containsKey(cid)) continue;
                int w = l.optInt("width", 0);
                Integer cur = bestWidth.get(cid);
                if (cur == null || (cur < 200 && w >= 200) || (w >= 200 && w < cur)) {
                    bestWidth.put(cid, w);
                    out.get(cid)[1] = url;
                }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ChannelStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Owns the durable state: the playlist list, the favorites set, the
 * parsed-channel cache (so the guide opens instantly and only re-fetches
 * on Refresh or first run), and — new in v0.2.0 — the My Shows watchlist,
 * the watched-episode set, and per-title resume positions.
 */
public final class ChannelStore {

    public static final class Playlist {
        public String name;
        public String url;
        public boolean builtin;
        public Playlist(String name, String url, boolean builtin) {
            this.name = name; this.url = url; this.builtin = builtin;
        }
    }

    public static final String BUILTIN_NAME = "iptv-org — free-to-air (world)";
    public static final String BUILTIN_URL = "https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/index.m3u";
    // v0.2.0: the built-in guide is assembled from iptv-org's facet indexes,
    // which carry the same streams as index.m3u (verified: identical URL set)
    // with the group set to category / language / country respectively.
    public static final String FACET_CATEGORY_URL = "https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/index.category.m3u";
    public static final String FACET_LANGUAGE_URL = "https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/index.language.m3u";
    public static final String FACET_COUNTRY_URL = "https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/index.country.m3u";

    private static final String PREFS = "talatv";
    private static final String KEY_PLAYLISTS = "playlists";
    private static final String KEY_FAVS = "favs";
    private static final String KEY_CACHE_WHEN = "cache_when";
    private static final String KEY_WATCHLIST = "watchlist";
    private static final String KEY_WATCHED = "watched_keys";
    private static final String KEY_POSITIONS = "positions";
    private static final String CACHE_FILE = "channels.tsv";    // v0.1.0, 7 cols
    private static final String CACHE_FILE2 = "channels2.tsv";  // v0.2.0, 9 cols (+language, country)
    private static final String CACHE_FILE3 = "channels3.tsv";  // v0.5.0, 11 cols (+canonName, canonLogo)

    /** In-process hand-off of the play queue (Binder can't carry 11k rows). */
    public static volatile List<M3uParser.Channel> playQueue = null;
    public static volatile int playIndex = 0;

    private ChannelStore() {}

    private static SharedPreferences prefs(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- playlists

    public static List<Playlist> getPlaylists(Context ctx) {
        SharedPreferences p = prefs(ctx);
        String raw = p.getString(KEY_PLAYLISTS, null);
        List<Playlist> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (raw != null) {
            try {
                JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(raw);
                for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                    out.add(new Playlist(o.getString("name"), o.getString("url"),
                            o.optBoolean("builtin", false)));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) { /* fall through to default */ }
        }
        if (out.isEmpty()) {
            out.add(new Playlist(BUILTIN_NAME, BUILTIN_URL, true));
            savePlaylists(ctx, out);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static void savePlaylists(Context ctx, List<Playlist> lists) {
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
            for (Playlist pl : lists) {
                JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                o.put("name", pl.name);
                o.put("url", pl.url);
                o.put("builtin", pl.builtin);
                arr.put(o);
            }
            prefs(ctx).edit().putString(KEY_PLAYLISTS, arr.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- favorites

    public static Set<String> getFavorites(Context ctx) {
        Set<String> s = prefs(ctx).getStringSet(KEY_FAVS, null);
        return s == null ? new HashSet<>() : new HashSet<>(s);
    }

    public static void setFavorite(Context ctx, String url, boolean fav) {
        Set<String> s = getFavorites(ctx);
        if (fav) s.add(url); else s.remove(url);
        prefs(ctx).edit().putStringSet(KEY_FAVS, s).apply();
    }

    /**
     * The quality POSTURE (v0.12.1): "low" | "balanced" | "ultra" —
     * James's shape for AutoPlay: low-first (fastest start),
     * balanced (the happy medium the pipe sustains), ultra (highest
     * quality, buffer and all). Default balanced.
     */
    public static String getQualityPosture(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getString("quality_posture", "balanced");
    }

    public static void setQualityPosture(Context ctx, String v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putString("quality_posture", v).apply();
    }

    /**
     * Auto-advance (v0.14.0, James's one-tap rule): when ON, a
     * finished episode rolls straight into the pre-resolved next
     * one; when OFF (the default), the next episode is SHOWN and
     * waits for the viewer's tap — a choice made once in
     * Settings, never a countdown pressing anyone.
     */
    public static boolean getAutoAdvanceNext(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("auto_advance_next", false);
    }

    public static void setAutoAdvanceNext(Context ctx, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("auto_advance_next", v).apply();
    }

    public static boolean getAutoSkip(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("autoskip", true);
    }

    public static void setAutoSkip(Context ctx, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("autoskip", v).apply();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- v0.4.0 operator settings
    // First-run defaults ARE the setup (James is the operator; Mom just
    // surfs): auto-fresh ON, working-links-first ON, 30-minute buffer —
    // a fresh install is already right before anyone touches Settings.

    /** Live timeshift buffer size, minutes (10/30/60). */
    public static int getTimeshiftMinutes(Context ctx) {
        return TimeshiftMath.clampMinutes(
                prefs(ctx).getInt("timeshift_minutes", TimeshiftMath.DEFAULT_MINUTES));
    }

    public static void setTimeshiftMinutes(Context ctx, int v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putInt("timeshift_minutes", TimeshiftMath.clampMinutes(v)).apply();
    }

    /** Re-verify stale verdicts quietly on app start (default ON). */
    public static boolean getAutoFresh(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("autofresh", true);
    }

    public static void setAutoFresh(Context ctx, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("autofresh", v).apply();
    }

    /** Default state of the "Working links only" lists (default ON). */
    public static boolean getWorkingFirst(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("working_first", true);
    }

    public static void setWorkingFirst(Context ctx, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("working_first", v).apply();
    }

    /** When the background auto-fresh last ran (epoch ms; 0 = never). */
    public static long getFreshLastRun(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getLong("fresh_last_run", 0);
    }

    public static void setFreshLastRun(Context ctx, long when, int count) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putLong("fresh_last_run", when)
                .putInt("fresh_last_count", count).apply();
    }

    public static int getFreshLastCount(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getInt("fresh_last_count", 0);
    }

    /**
     * Per-title prepared-dub choice. Default is TRUE: a sidecar exists
     * because the operator prepared it to be heard, so a title with a
     * dub plays the dub until someone picks the original in the menu —
     * that pick is what gets stored here.
     */
    public static boolean getDubChoice(Context ctx, String contentKey) {
        if (contentKey == null) return true;
        try {
            String raw = prefs(ctx).getString("dub_choices", null);
            if (raw == null) return true;
            org.json.JSONObject o = new org.json.JSONObject(raw);
            return o.has(contentKey) ? o.getBoolean(contentKey) : true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    public static void setDubChoice(Context ctx, String contentKey, boolean dub) {
        if (contentKey == null) return;
        try {
            String raw = prefs(ctx).getString("dub_choices", null);
            org.json.JSONObject o = raw == null ? new org.json.JSONObject()
                    : new org.json.JSONObject(raw);
            o.put(contentKey, dub);
            prefs(ctx).edit().putString("dub_choices", o.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- cache

    private static String enc(String s) {
        try { return URLEncoder.encode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    private static String dec(String s) {
        try { return URLDecoder.decode(s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    public static void saveCache(Context ctx, List<M3uParser.Channel> channels) {
        File f = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), CACHE_FILE3);
        try (Writer w = new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(f), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
                w.write(enc(c.name));  w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.group)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.url));   w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.logo));  w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.tvgId)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.userAgent)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.source)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.language)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.country)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.canonName)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(c.canonLogo));
                w.write('\n');
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        prefs(ctx).edit().putLong(KEY_CACHE_WHEN, System.currentTimeMillis()).apply();
    }

    public static List<M3uParser.Channel> loadCache(Context ctx) {
        List<M3uParser.Channel> v3 = readCacheFile(ctx, CACHE_FILE3, 11);
        if (v3 != null) return v3;
        List<M3uParser.Channel> v2 = readCacheFile(ctx, CACHE_FILE2, 9);
        if (v2 != null) return v2;
        return readCacheFile(ctx, CACHE_FILE, 7); // v0.1.0 cache still readable
    }

    private static List<M3uParser.Channel> readCacheFile(Context ctx, String name, int cols) {
        File f = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), name);
        if (!f.exists()) return null;
        List<M3uParser.Channel> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(new FileInputStream(f), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
                String[] p = line.split("\t", -1);
                if (p.length < cols) continue;
                M3uParser.Channel c = new M3uParser.Channel();
                c.name = dec(p[0]); c.group = dec(p[1]); c.url = dec(p[2]);
                c.logo = dec(p[3]); c.tvgId = dec(p[4]); c.userAgent = dec(p[5]);
                c.source = dec(p[6]);
                if (cols >= 9) { c.language = dec(p[7]); c.country = dec(p[8]); }
                if (cols >= 11) { c.canonName = dec(p[9]); c.canonLogo = dec(p[10]); }
                out.add(c);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
        return out.isEmpty() ? null : out;
    }

    public static boolean hasCache(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), CACHE_FILE3).exists()
                || new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), CACHE_FILE2).exists()
                || new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), CACHE_FILE).exists();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- watchlist (My Shows)

    public static List<TvMaze.Show> getWatchlist(Context ctx) {
        List<TvMaze.Show> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String raw = prefs(ctx).getString(KEY_WATCHLIST, null);
        if (raw == null) return out;
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(raw);
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                TvMaze.Show s = new TvMaze.Show();
                s.id = o.optInt("id");
                s.name = o.optString("name", "");
                s.imageMedium = o.optString("image", "");
                s.language = o.optString("language", "");
                s.status = o.optString("status", "");
                String g = o.optString("genres", "");
                if (!g.isEmpty()) {
                    for (String part : g.split(",")) s.genres.add(part);
                }
                out.add(s);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return out;
    }

    public static boolean isWatchlisted(Context ctx, int showId) {
        for (TvMaze.Show s : getWatchlist(ctx)) {
            if (s.id == showId) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void setWatchlisted(Context ctx, TvMaze.Show show, boolean add) {
        List<TvMaze.Show> list = getWatchlist(ctx);
        list.removeIf(s -> s.id == show.id);
        if (add) list.add(0, show);
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
            for (TvMaze.Show s : list) {
                JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                o.put("id", s.id);
                o.put("name", s.name);
                o.put("image", s.imageMedium);
                o.put("language", s.language);
                o.put("status", s.status);
                StringBuilder g = new StringBuilder();
                for (String genre : s.genres) {
                    if (g.length() > 0) g.append(',');
                    g.append(genre);
                }
                o.put("genres", g.toString());
                arr.put(o);
            }
            prefs(ctx).edit().putString(KEY_WATCHLIST, arr.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    // --------------------------------- Archive-proven titles (v0.10.0)

    private static final String KEY_IA_PROVEN = "ia_proven_ids";

    /**
     * Shows a Sources visit actually found on the Internet Archive.
     * This is the only way a catalogue tile may claim Archive
     * availability — proven by a past check, never assumed.
     */
    public static boolean isArchiveProven(Context ctx, int showId) {
        java.util.Set<String> s = prefs(ctx).getStringSet(KEY_IA_PROVEN, null);
        return s != null && s.contains(String.valueOf(showId));
    }

    public static void markArchiveProven(Context ctx, int showId) {
        java.util.Set<String> cur = prefs(ctx).getStringSet(KEY_IA_PROVEN, null);
        java.util.Set<String> next = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        if (cur != null) next.addAll(cur);
        if (next.add(String.valueOf(showId))) {
            prefs(ctx).edit().putStringSet(KEY_IA_PROVEN, next).apply();
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- watched + resume positions

    /** Stable identity for an on-demand title, independent of the source picked. */
    public static String episodeKey(int showId, int season, int number) {
        return "ep:" + showId + ":S" + season + "E" + number;
    }

    public static String titleKey(String title) {
        return "title:" + EpisodeKey.normalize(title);
    }

    public static boolean isWatched(Context ctx, String contentKey) {
        Set<String> s = prefs(ctx).getStringSet(KEY_WATCHED, null);
        return s != null && s.contains(contentKey);
    }

    public static void setWatched(Context ctx, String contentKey, boolean watched) {
        Set<String> s = prefs(ctx).getStringSet(KEY_WATCHED, null);
        Set<String> copy = s == null ? new HashSet<>() : new HashSet<>(s);
        if (watched) copy.add(contentKey); else copy.remove(contentKey);
        prefs(ctx).edit().putStringSet(KEY_WATCHED, copy).apply();
    }

    // v0.11.0: positions live in the filed kept places now (memory
    // hook). The first touch seeds the file from the legacy
    // preferences JSON, once, behind the kind marker — after that
    // the file is the only truth and the prefs copy is frozen.
    private static void seedPlaces(Context ctx) {
        try {
            if (!KeptPlaces.seeded(ctx, "pos")) {
                List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> rows = new ArrayList<>();
                String raw = prefs(ctx).getString(KEY_POSITIONS, null);
                if (raw != null) {
                    JSONObject o = new JSONObject(raw);
                    java.util.Iterator<String> keys = o.keys();
                    while (keys.hasNext()) {
                        String k = keys.next();
                        long pos = o.optLong(k, 0);
                        if (pos > 0) rows.add(new MemoryFiles.KeptPlace(
                                "pos", k, pos, System.currentTimeMillis(), ""));
                    }
                }
                KeptPlaces.seed(ctx, "pos", rows);
            }
            if (!KeptPlaces.seeded(ctx, "live")) {
                List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> rows = new ArrayList<>();
                String raw = prefs(ctx).getString("kept_live", null);
                if (raw != null) {
                    JSONObject o = new JSONObject(raw);
                    rows.add(new MemoryFiles.KeptPlace("live", "live",
                            o.optLong("pos", 0), o.optLong("savedAt", 0), raw));
                }
                KeptPlaces.seed(ctx, "live", rows);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    public static long getPosition(Context ctx, String contentKey) {
        seedPlaces(ctx);
        return KeptPlaces.getPosition(ctx, contentKey);
    }

    public static void savePosition(Context ctx, String contentKey, long positionMs) {
        seedPlaces(ctx);
        KeptPlaces.putPosition(ctx, contentKey, positionMs);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- v0.5.0 state

    /** The chosen UI language code ("en", "es", …) or "" when unchosen. */
    public static String getUiLanguage(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getString("ui_language", "");
    }

    public static void setUiLanguage(Context ctx, String code) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putString("ui_language", code == null ? "" : code).apply();
    }

    public static boolean hasChosenLanguage(Context ctx) {
        return !getUiLanguage(ctx).isEmpty();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------ v0.6.0: the stance

    /** The whole Live TV stance (facets + search + scroll), one record. */
    public static String getStanceJson(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getString("live_stance", "");
    }

    public static void setStanceJson(Context ctx, String json) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putString("live_stance", json == null ? "" : json).apply();
    }

    /** Rumble cues (haptics) — default ON (Settings toggle exists). */
    public static boolean getRumble(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("rumble", true);
    }

    public static void setRumble(Context ctx, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("rumble", v).apply();
    }

    /**
     * What the kept last-channel buffer does when it fills: HOLD the
     * beginning (default — the family's sleep case: "when you wake up,
     * hopefully you caught the whole episode"), or ROLL (the classic
     * sliding window that keeps the latest).
     */
    public static boolean getBufferFullHold(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("buffer_full_hold", true);
    }

    public static void setBufferFullHold(Context ctx, boolean hold) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("buffer_full_hold", hold).apply();
    }

    // ------------------------------------- the kept live place (item 8)

    /**
     * The last live channel's kept place. Live TV can't resume a fixed
     * position — the broadcast moved on — so what is kept is the
     * channel, the moment's distance behind the live edge when Sandy
     * closed, and whether the buffer filled and HELD. Together with
     * the persisted timeshift cache (TimeshiftCache no longer wipes on
     * close for this channel), reopening the channel can offer the
     * place back — honestly recomputed by LiveResumeMath, because the
     * edge kept moving while the app was shut.
     */
    public static final class KeptLive {
        public String url = "";
        public String name = "";
        public String userAgent = "";
        public long positionMs = 0;
        public long behindMs = 0;
        public long savedAtMs = 0;
        public boolean held = false;
    }

    public static KeptLive getKeptLive(Context ctx) {
        seedPlaces(ctx);
        String raw = KeptPlaces.getExtra(ctx, "live", "live");
        if (raw == null) return null;
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject(raw);
            KeptLive k = new KeptLive();
            k.url = o.optString("url", "");
            k.name = o.optString("name", "");
            k.userAgent = o.optString("ua", "");
            k.positionMs = o.optLong("pos", 0);
            k.behindMs = o.optLong("behind", 0);
            k.savedAtMs = o.optLong("savedAt", 0);
            k.held = o.optBoolean("held", false);
            return k.url.isEmpty() ? null : k;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static void setKeptLive(Context ctx, KeptLive k) {
        if (k == null || k.url == null || k.url.isEmpty()) return;
        seedPlaces(ctx);
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("url", k.url);
            o.put("name", k.name == null ? "" : k.name);
            o.put("ua", k.userAgent == null ? "" : k.userAgent);
            o.put("pos", k.positionMs);
            o.put("behind", k.behindMs);
            o.put("savedAt", k.savedAtMs);
            o.put("held", k.held);
            KeptPlaces.putPlace(ctx, "live", "live", k.positionMs, o.toString());
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    public static void clearKeptLive(Context ctx) {
        seedPlaces(ctx);
        KeptPlaces.removePlace(ctx, "live", "live");
    }

    // ------------------------------------- recording display names
    // v0.11.0: recordings metadata is a FILE now (memory/recordings
    // .tsv, via RecordingsMeta). This face stays for its callers;
    // the first touch seeds the file from the legacy record_meta
    // preferences, once (RecordingsMeta.seed no-ops when the file
    // exists). A record-now name lands as the recording's title AND
    // its channel (the caller passes the channel's display name);
    // timer recordings write the fuller row themselves.

    private static void seedRecordings(Context ctx) {
        if (prefs(ctx).getBoolean("record_meta_migrated", false)) return;
        try {
            String raw = prefs(ctx).getString("record_meta", null);
            if (raw != null) {
                JSONObject o = new JSONObject(raw);
                java.util.Iterator<String> keys = o.keys();
                while (keys.hasNext()) {
                    String id = keys.next();
                    JSONObject m = o.optJSONObject(id);
                    if (m == null) continue;
                    if (RecordingsMeta.get(ctx, id) != null) continue;
                    MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta r = new MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta();
                    r.id = id;
                    r.title = m.optString("name", "");
                    r.channel = r.title;
                    r.airedStartMs = m.optLong("startedAt", 0);
                    r.origin = "now";
                    RecordingsMeta.upsert(ctx, r);
                }
            }
            prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("record_meta_migrated", true).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    /** Recordings keep their channel's display name beside the download. */
    public static void putRecordMeta(Context ctx, String id, String name) {
        seedRecordings(ctx);
        MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta r = RecordingsMeta.get(ctx, id);
        if (r == null) {
            r = new MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta();
            r.id = id;
            r.origin = "now";
            r.airedStartMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        r.title = name == null ? "" : name;
        if (r.channel.isEmpty()) r.channel = r.title;
        RecordingsMeta.upsert(ctx, r);
    }

    public static String getRecordName(Context ctx, String id) {
        seedRecordings(ctx);
        MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta r = RecordingsMeta.get(ctx, id);
        if (r == null) return "";
        return r.title.isEmpty() ? r.channel : r.title;
    }

    public static void removeRecordMeta(Context ctx, String id) {
        seedRecordings(ctx);
        RecordingsMeta.remove(ctx, id);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CookedSubs.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Cooked subtitle tracks (v0.6.0) — the translation layer's output
 * form, and the record that keeps the source honest (UTX Law 1: the
 * original is never silently replaced).
 *
 * Two sidecars ride beside a video file (naming in DubTrack):
 *   <video>.tr-<lang>.srt   the playable track: translated lines,
 *                           guard-flagged lines prefixed "~ " so
 *                           uncertainty is visible in ANY player.
 *   <video>.tr-<lang>.json  the full record: per line, the original
 *                           text, the translation, the speaker and
 *                           the flag — what the parallel view and
 *                           the voiced renderer read.
 *
 * Pure logic; harness round-trips both formats.
 */
public final class CookedSubs {

    public static final class Line {
        public long startMs, endMs;
        public String text = "";      // translated
        public String orig = "";      // original-language text (may be "")
        public String speaker = "";   // diarizer key; "" until one exists
        public boolean flagged = false;
        /** Voice-fit disclosure (v0.12.0): how the spoken line met
         *  its window — 0 = natural pace, 1 = re-spoken faster to
         *  fit, 2 = still overran. A squeezed line is disclosed in
         *  the record, never hidden (James's line-fit honesty). */
        public int fit = 0;
    }

    private CookedSubs() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- SRT

    public static String writeSrt(List<Line> lines) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int n = 1;
        for (Line l : lines) {
            sb.append(n++).append('\n');
            sb.append(srtTime(l.startMs)).append(" --> ").append(srtTime(l.endMs)).append('\n');
            if (l.flagged) sb.append("~ ");
            sb.append(l.text == null ? "" : l.text).append("\n\n");
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static List<Line> parseSrt(String text) {
        List<Line> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null) return out;
        String[] blocks = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n\n");
        for (String block : blocks) {
            String[] ls = block.split("\n");
            long start = -1, end = -1;
            StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder();
            for (String raw : ls) {
                String line = raw.trim();
                if (line.contains("-->")) {
                    String[] p = line.split("-->");
                    if (p.length == 2) {
                        start = parseSrtTime(p[0].trim());
                        end = parseSrtTime(p[1].trim());
                    }
                } else if (!line.isEmpty() && !line.matches("\\d+")) {
                    if (body.length() > 0) body.append(' ');
                    body.append(line);
                }
            }
            if (start >= 0 && end > start) {
                Line l = new Line();
                l.startMs = start; l.endMs = end;
                String t = body.toString();
                if (t.startsWith("~ ")) { l.flagged = true; t = t.substring(2); }
                l.text = t;
                out.add(l);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static String srtTime(long ms) {
        long h = ms / 3600000, m = (ms / 60000) % 60, s = (ms / 1000) % 60, x = ms % 1000;
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d:%02d,%03d", h, m, s, x);
    }

    private static long parseSrtTime(String t) {
        try {
            String[] p = t.replace('.', ',').split("[:,]");
            return Long.parseLong(p[0]) * 3600000 + Long.parseLong(p[1]) * 60000
                    + Long.parseLong(p[2]) * 1000 + Long.parseLong(p[3]);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ JSON

    public static String writeJson(String lang, List<Line> lines) throws Exception {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
        o.put("sandy.trsubs", 1);
        o.put("lang", lang);
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
        for (Line l : lines) {
            JSONObject lo = new JSONObject();
            lo.put("s", l.startMs);
            lo.put("e", l.endMs);
            lo.put("t", l.text);
            lo.put("o", l.orig);
            lo.put("sp", l.speaker);
            lo.put("f", l.flagged ? 1 : 0);
            if (l.fit != 0) lo.put("fit", l.fit);
            arr.put(lo);
        }
        o.put("lines", arr);
        return o.toString();
    }

    public static List<Line> parseJson(String text) throws Exception {
        List<Line> out = new ArrayList<>();
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject(text);
        JSONArray arr = o.optJSONArray("lines");
        if (arr == null) return out;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject lo = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            Line l = new Line();
            l.startMs = lo.optLong("s", 0);
            l.endMs = lo.optLong("e", 0);
            l.text = lo.optString("t", "");
            l.orig = lo.optString("o", "");
            l.speaker = lo.optString("sp", "");
            l.flagged = lo.optInt("f", 0) != 0;
            l.fit = lo.optInt("fit", 0);
            out.add(l);
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Cooker.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * The cooker state machine (v0.6.0) — the Translate option's honest
 * heart. It owns no engines and no UI; it is the deterministic set of
 * states the family designed, and every transition is driven by a
 * measured event:
 *
 *   press Translate
 *     -> a track or cooked sidecar already exists  => READY_EXISTING
 *     -> the engine pack is not installed          => NEEDS_PACK
 *     -> pack in, but no engine bound in this app  => ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE
 *     -> otherwise                                 => COOKING
 *   COOKING: chunks land (240 s each); when the cooked lead reaches
 *            the go threshold the state becomes GO — the go sign.
 *   GO --viewer presses play--> RIDING (playback rides the lead)
 *   RIDING: playhead passes the cooking edge before the title is
 *           done => STARVED (said out loud, never spun); when the
 *           lead rebuilds past the resume mark => RIDING again.
 *   cooked == title and played == cooked           => DONE
 *   any stage fails                                => FAILED (reason kept)
 *
 * Resource honesty is a state, not an error string: NEEDS_PACK and
 * ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE are where the machine stops and says exactly
 * what is missing (UTX Law 5). Nothing in here ever fabricates a
 * cooked second: cookedSec only moves when a chunk reports in.
 *
 * Pure logic; the harness drives it with the bench's measured chunk
 * times and with synthetic starve/go sequences.
 */
public final class Cooker {

    public enum State {
        IDLE, READY_EXISTING, NEEDS_PACK, ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE,
        COOKING, GO, RIDING, STARVED, DONE, FAILED
    }

    public enum PackStatus { NOT_INSTALLED, INSTALLED }

    /** The engine seam. 0.6.0 shipped it unbound; 0.6.1 binds the
     *  ONNX engine (OnnxCookerEngine). A null or unbound engine
     *  still answers ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE truthfully. */
    public interface Engine {
        boolean isBound();
    }

    private final double titleDurSec;
    private State state = State.IDLE;
    private String failReason = "";
    private double cookedSec = 0.0;
    private double playedSec = 0.0;
    private final LeadMath.RateTracker rate = new LeadMath.RateTracker();

    public Cooker(double titleDurSec) {
        this.titleDurSec = Math.max(0, titleDurSec);
    }

    public State state() { return state; }
    public String failReason() { return failReason; }
    public double cookedSec() { return cookedSec; }
    public double playedSec() { return playedSec; }
    public double titleDurSec() { return titleDurSec; }
    public double leadSec() { return LeadMath.leadSec(cookedSec, playedSec); }
    public double rate() { return rate.rate(); }
    public boolean goLit() { return state == State.GO || state == State.RIDING
            || state == State.DONE; }

    /** Press Translate. The three honest gates, in order. */
    public State begin(boolean hasExistingTrack, PackStatus pack, Engine engine) {
        if (state != State.IDLE) return state;
        if (hasExistingTrack) {
            state = State.READY_EXISTING;
        } else if (pack != PackStatus.INSTALLED) {
            state = State.NEEDS_PACK;
        } else if (engine == null || !engine.isBound()) {
            state = State.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE;
        } else {
            state = State.COOKING;
        }
        return state;
    }

    /** A 240 s chunk (or the title's tail) finished cooking. */
    public void onChunkCooked(double chunkCookedSec, double chunkWallSec) {
        if (state != State.COOKING && state != State.GO
                && state != State.RIDING && state != State.STARVED) return;
        cookedSec = Math.min(titleDurSec, cookedSec + Math.max(0, chunkCookedSec));
        rate.recordChunk(chunkCookedSec, chunkWallSec);
        if (state == State.COOKING && LeadMath.isGo(cookedSec, playedSec, titleDurSec)) {
            state = State.GO;
        } else if (state == State.STARVED
                && LeadMath.leadSec(cookedSec, playedSec) >= LeadMath.RESUME_LEAD_SEC) {
            state = State.RIDING;
        }
        checkDone();
    }

    /** The viewer pressed play on the translated track. */
    public void onPlayTranslated() {
        if (state == State.GO) state = State.RIDING;
    }

    /** Playback position report (the player's own clock). */
    public void onTick(double played) {
        playedSec = Math.max(0, played);
        if (state == State.RIDING
                && LeadMath.isStarved(cookedSec, playedSec, titleDurSec)) {
            state = State.STARVED;
        }
        checkDone();
    }

    private void checkDone() {
        if ((state == State.RIDING || state == State.GO || state == State.STARVED)
                && titleDurSec > 0 && cookedSec >= titleDurSec
                && playedSec >= titleDurSec - 0.5) {
            state = State.DONE;
        }
    }

    public void onFail(String reason) {
        state = State.FAILED;
        failReason = reason == null ? "" : reason;
    }

    /** Wall seconds until the go sign at the measured rate; -1 = unknown yet. */
    public double etaToGoSec() {
        return rate.etaToGoSec(leadSec(), titleDurSec);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CountryIndexActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The country door, standing on its own (v0.10.0): every country the
 * gathered index holds, biggest first, with its show count and how
 * many languages speak from it. Tapping one opens that country's
 * whole shelf — all its languages together, scrollable to the end.
 * Countries appear here only when the walk has actually gathered
 * their shows; nothing is promised that isn't on the phone.
 */
public class CountryIndexActivity extends Activity {

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final List<String> countries = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Set<String>> langs = new HashMap<>();

    private ListView listView;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private TextView statusView;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText("Countries");
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(19);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        statusView.setTextSize(12);
        statusView.setText("Every country in the gathered catalog — "
                + "tap one to scroll its shows, in all its languages.");
        root.addView(statusView);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        listView = new ListView(this);
        listView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.addView(listView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        listView.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, WallListActivity.class);
            i.putExtra("mode", "country");
            i.putExtra("country", countries.get(pos));
            startActivity(i);
        });
        setContentView(root);

        exec.execute(() -> {
            Map<Integer, CatalogIndex.Record> gathered =
                    CatalogStore.loadGathered(this);
            for (CatalogIndex.Record r : gathered.values()) {
                String shelf = CatalogIndex.shelfOf(r);
                counts.merge(shelf, 1, Integer::sum);
                langs.computeIfAbsent(shelf, k -> new HashSet<>())
                        .add(r.language.isEmpty() ? "—" : r.language);
            }
            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>(counts.keySet());
            names.sort((a, b) -> {
                int byCount = counts.get(b) - counts.get(a);
                return byCount != 0 ? byCount : a.compareToIgnoreCase(b);
            });
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                countries.clear();
                countries.addAll(names);
                ArrayAdapter<String> ad = new ArrayAdapter<String>(this,
                        android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1,
                        countries) {
                    @Override
                    public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                        View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                        String c = countries.get(pos);
                        TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                        t1.setText(c);
                        t1.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                        TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                        Set<String> ls = langs.get(c);
                        t2.setText(counts.get(c) + " shows · "
                                + (ls == null ? 0 : ls.size())
                                + (ls != null && ls.size() == 1 ? " language" : " languages"));
                        t2.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                        return v;
                    }
                    @Override public int getCount() { return countries.size(); }
                };
                listView.setAdapter(ad);
                if (countries.isEmpty()) {
                    statusView.setText("No countries gathered yet — the catalog "
                            + "index walk hasn't brought any shows in. Open the "
                            + "Catalog and let it gather (a connection is needed).");
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CrashGuard.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.io.StringWriter;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Crash-to-file (v0.8.0) — the Tala Ripper pattern, adopted after
 * Sandy 0.7.0 died in James's hands with no evidence attached: the
 * system said "this app has a bug" and the trail ended there.
 *
 * Installs a default uncaught-exception handler that writes the
 * failure to files/logs/crash-<ts>.txt — version stamp as the
