 * FIRST line, so any log that reaches us names its build — then
 * chains to whatever handler Android had before (the system crash
 * dialog still appears; nothing is suppressed or hidden).
 *
 * Also the drop-box for guarded seams: library code that Sandy's
 * screens touch but must never be able to take the app down with
 * (the share stack above all) leaves its Throwable here via
 * {@link #log} instead of vanishing into a bare catch.
 *
 * The logs live in filesDir — they survive the system cache clear
 * that the crash dialog itself suggests.
 */
public final class CrashGuard {

    /** Version stamp written as the first line of every crash log. */
    public static final String VERSION_STAMP = "Sandy 0.16.1 (versionCode 22)";

    private static volatile boolean installed = false;

    private CrashGuard() {}

    /** Idempotent. Safe to call from every activity's onCreate. */
    public static synchronized void install(Context ctx) {
        if (installed || ctx == null) return;
        installed = true;
        final File logDir = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), "logs");
        final Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler previous =
                Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler();
        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, error) -> {
            try {
                writeCrash(logDir, "uncaught on " + thread.getName(), error);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                // The handler itself must never become the crash.
            }
            if (previous != null) previous.uncaughtException(thread, error);
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ reading
    // v0.12.1: the logs used to be write-only — the 0.7.0 field crash
    // left its stack in files/logs on James's phone with NO way in
    // the app to see or share it, so its root cause is still
    // unestablished years later. These readers back the Settings
    // "Crash reports" view: the latest crash, in the open, shareable.

    /** Crash log files, newest first (empty when none). */
    public static java.util.List<File> listCrashes(Context ctx) {
        java.util.List<File> out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            File dir = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), "logs");
            File[] files = dir.listFiles(
                    (d, name) -> name.startsWith("crash-") && name.endsWith(".txt"));
            if (files != null) {
                java.util.Collections.addAll(out, files);
                out.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.lastModified(), a.lastModified()));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return out;
    }

    /** The newest crash log's full text, "" when none/unreadable. */
    public static String readLatest(Context ctx) {
        java.util.List<File> files = listCrashes(ctx);
        if (files.isEmpty()) return "";
        return readFile(files.get(0));
    }

    /** One crash log's full text, "" when unreadable. */
    public static String readFile(File f) {
        if (f == null) return "";
        try {
            byte[] bytes = new byte[(int) Math.min(f.length(), 512 * 1024)];
            int off = 0;
            try (java.io.FileInputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(f)) {
                int n;
                while (off < bytes.length
                        && (n = in.read(bytes, off, bytes.length - off)) > 0) {
                    off += n;
                }
            }
            return new String(bytes, 0, off, "UTF-8");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    /** Leave a caught Throwable in the log instead of swallowing it. */
    public static void log(Context ctx, String where, Throwable t) {
        if (ctx == null || t == null) return;
        try {
            File logDir = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), "logs");
            writeCrash(logDir, "caught at " + where, t);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            // Logging is best-effort by design; never throw from a guard.
        }
    }

    private static void writeCrash(File logDir, String where, Throwable t)
            throws Exception {
        if (!logDir.isDirectory() && !logDir.mkdirs()) return;
        String ts = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US)
                .format(new Date());
        File f = new File(logDir, "crash-" + ts + ".txt");
        StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(sw);
        t.printStackTrace(pw);
        pw.flush();
        try (FileWriter fw = new FileWriter(f, true)) {
            fw.write(VERSION_STAMP + "\n");
            fw.write(where + " at " + new Date().toString() + "\n");
            fw.write(sw.toString());
            fw.write("\n");
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/CreditActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Sources & credit (v0.13.0) — James's order: "leave links in
 * there for people to eventually address the program or these
 * places that house these IPTV places where we're pulling from."
 * One plain page: the real front doors of the houses Sandy pulls
 * from, each named for what it gives her, each opening the place
 * itself in the browser. Every URL below was verified live the
 * day this page was built (a dead credit link is worse than
 * none); the harness pins them verbatim.
 *
 * The foot of the page carries the responsibility line, in the
 * house voice, per James's doctrine stated 2026-10-18: the
 * maker's duty is an honest tool and real precautions; what a
 * person loads, watches, and shares is their own choice and
 * their own responsibility.
 */
public final class CreditActivity extends Activity {

    /** The front doors, in page order — verified live 2026-10-18. */
    public static final String[] LINKS = {
        "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xocvSY7tb8tky1D6oogkApVkh9d-ULmZ",
        "https://archive.org",
        "https://iptv-org.github.io/",
        "https://www.tvmaze.com",
        "https://i.mjh.nz",
        "https://epg.iptvx.one",
        "https://www.gutenberg.org",
        "https://openlibrary.org",
        "https://librivox.org",
    };

    /** The string key naming what each house gives her. */
    public static final String[] NAMES = {
        "sources_brain", "sources_archive", "sources_iptvorg",
        "sources_tvmaze", "sources_mjh", "sources_iptvx",
        "sources_gutenberg", "sources_openlibrary", "sources_librivox",
    };

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "sources_title"));

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = (int) (14 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView intro = new TextView(this);
        intro.setTextSize(15);
        intro.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "sources_intro"));
        root.addView(intro);

        List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String key : NAMES) rows.add(LangStore.tr(this, key));
        ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(
                this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, rows);
        ListView list = new ListView(this);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);
        list.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            if (pos < 0 || pos >= LINKS.length) return;
            Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(LINKS[pos]));
            startActivity(i);
        });
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1));

        TextView foot = new TextView(this);
        foot.setTextSize(14);
        foot.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "sources_responsibility"));
        root.addView(foot);

        setContentView(root);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DiarCore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Diarization math (v0.12.0) — pure logic over the segmentation
 * model's output, mirroring the reference pipeline the pack's
 * models were published with (pyannote segmentation-3.0 + a speaker
 * embedding model, the sherpa-onnx diarization recipe):
 *
 *   the waveform is cut into 10 s windows sliding 1 s; each window
 *   is classified per frame into a POWERSET class over up to 3
 *   local speakers (7 classes: nobody, each single, each pair);
 *   argmax decodes each frame to a set of active local speakers;
 *   per (window, local speaker), the speaker's own active audio —
 *   frames where they speak ALONE — is gathered into one embedding
 *   observation; observations are clustered by embedding cosine;
 *   a cooked LINE is assigned the cluster whose observations speak
 *   the most inside the line's window (James's witness design: the
 *   subtitle timings pre-cut the audio, the diarizer only has to
 *   say WHO is talking inside each cut).
 *
 * Local speaker numbers mean nothing across windows — identity
 * lives in the embeddings and the clusters, never in the labels.
 * Constants are the seg model's own published metadata
 * (window 160000 samples, shift 16000, receptive field 991/270).
 *
 * Pure and deterministic; the harness drives it with the real
 * models over a three-speaker fixture with ground truth
 * (work/v120/diar) and with the reference implementation's own
 * scores as the comparison.
 */
public final class DiarCore {

    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE = 16000;
    public static final int WINDOW_SAMPLES = 160000;      // 10 s
    public static final int WINDOW_SHIFT = 16000;         // 1 s
    public static final int FRAME_SHIFT_SAMPLES = 270;    // receptive_field_shift
    public static final int FRAME_SIZE_SAMPLES = 991;     // receptive_field_size
    public static final int LOCAL_SPEAKERS = 3;
    public static final int NUM_CLASSES = 7;
    /** An observation needs at least this many solo frames (~0.17 s). */
    public static final int MIN_OBS_FRAMES = 10;
    /** A line's dominant speaker needs at least this much attributed
     *  speech inside the line, and this share of all attributed. */
    public static final double LINE_MIN_SEC = 0.30;
    public static final double LINE_MIN_SHARE = 0.40;
    /** Cap on audio gathered into one observation embedding. */
    public static final double OBS_AUDIO_CAP_SEC = 12.0;

    private DiarCore() {}

    /** Frame f of window w centers at this time (seconds). */
    public static double frameCenterSec(int window, int frame) {
        return (window * (double) WINDOW_SHIFT
                + frame * (double) FRAME_SHIFT_SAMPLES
                + FRAME_SIZE_SAMPLES / 2.0) / SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    /** Powerset table [class][localSpeaker] — class 0 nobody,
     *  1..3 the singles in order, 4..6 the pairs (0,1), (0,2), (1,2):
     *  the reference construction order. */
    public static boolean[][] powerset() {
        boolean[][] m = new boolean[NUM_CLASSES][LOCAL_SPEAKERS];
        int k = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < LOCAL_SPEAKERS; j++) m[k++][j] = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < LOCAL_SPEAKERS; j++) {
            for (int n = j + 1; n < LOCAL_SPEAKERS; n++) {
                m[k][j] = true;
                m[k][n] = true;
                k++;
            }
        }
        return m;
    }

    /**
     * Decode window logits [window][frame][class] to activity
     * [window][frame][localSpeaker] by per-frame argmax through the
     * powerset table.
     */
    public static boolean[][][] decode(float[][][] logits) {
        boolean[][] map = powerset();
        boolean[][][] out = new boolean[logits.length][][];
        for (int w = 0; w < logits.length; w++) {
            out[w] = new boolean[logits[w].length][LOCAL_SPEAKERS];
            for (int f = 0; f < logits[w].length; f++) {
                int best = 0;
                float bestV = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
                for (int c = 0; c < NUM_CLASSES; c++) {
                    if (logits[w][f][c] > bestV) { bestV = logits[w][f][c]; best = c; }
                }
                for (int s = 0; s < LOCAL_SPEAKERS; s++) out[w][f][s] = map[best][s];
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Consolidate window runs into speech EVENTS: the same stretch
     * of solo speech is seen by ~7 overlapping windows, and those
     * sightings are one event, embedded ONCE at full length.
     *
     * This step is what makes the prints trustworthy, measured on
     * the fixture both ways: embeddings of short window runs are
     * noisy enough that two genuinely different voices drift over
     * the cluster threshold and merge (3 voices collapsed to 2),
     * while turn-scale prints separate cleanly (same-voice cosine
     * floor 0.667 vs different-voice ceiling 0.279). Runs join an
     * event when they substantially overlap in time (≥ 0.4 s and
     * ≥ half the shorter run); the event's span is the MEDIAN
     * start/end of its sightings, so one bleeding sighting cannot
     * stretch it. An event needs at least two sightings, or one
     * sighting of 1.5 s+, to count — a lone flicker is not speech.
     */
    public static List<Observation> events(List<Observation> runs) {
        List<Observation> sorted = new ArrayList<>(runs);
        sorted.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(
                a.spans.isEmpty() ? 0 : a.spans.get(0)[0],
                b.spans.isEmpty() ? 0 : b.spans.get(0)[0]));
        List<List<Observation>> groups = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Observation run : sorted) {
            if (run.spans.isEmpty()) continue;
            double rs = run.spans.get(0)[0], re = run.spans.get(0)[1];
            List<Observation> joined = null;
            for (List<Observation> g : groups) {
                double gs = Double.MAX_VALUE, ge = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
                for (Observation m : g) {
                    gs = Math.min(gs, m.spans.get(0)[0]);
                    ge = Math.max(ge, m.spans.get(0)[1]);
                }
                double ov = Math.min(re, ge) - Math.max(rs, gs);
                double shorter = Math.min(re - rs, ge - gs);
                if (ov >= 0.4 && shorter > 0 && ov >= 0.5 * shorter) {
                    joined = g;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (joined == null) {
                joined = new ArrayList<>();
                groups.add(joined);
            }
            joined.add(run);
        }
        List<Observation> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<Observation> g : groups) {
            List<Double> starts = new ArrayList<>(), ends = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Observation m : g) {
                starts.add(m.spans.get(0)[0]);
                ends.add(m.spans.get(0)[1]);
            }
            starts.sort(null);
            ends.sort(null);
            double s = starts.get(starts.size() / 2);
            double e = ends.get(ends.size() / 2);
            if (e <= s) continue;
            if (g.size() < 2 && e - s < 1.5) continue;
            Observation ev = new Observation();
            ev.window = -1;
            ev.localSpeaker = g.get(0).localSpeaker;
            ev.spans.add(new double[]{s, e});
            ev.activeSec = e - s;
            out.add(ev);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** One (window, local speaker) voice observation. */
    public static final class Observation {
        public int window;
        public int localSpeaker;
        /** Solo-active spans, seconds [start, end), in title time. */
        public final List<double[]> spans = new ArrayList<>();
        public double activeSec = 0;
        /** Filled by the embedding seam; null until embedded. */
        public float[] embedding;
        /** Cluster index after clustering; -1 until then. */
        public int cluster = -1;
    }

    /**
     * Build observations from decoded activity: per window and local
     * speaker, EACH RUN of frames where that speaker is the ONLY
     * active one is its own observation (overlaps excluded — a
     * voiceprint should be one voice).
     *
     * The run granularity is load-bearing, measured on the fixture
     * (work/v120/diar): the segmentation model's local labels are
     * only per-window conveniences and can be REUSED for a different
     * person later in the same window (in fixture window 2, local
     * speaker 1 covers turns of both A and B). Aggregating a whole
     * window per label mixes voices into prints that cluster as
     * mush (same-voice pairs down to 0.29, different-voice pairs up
     * to 0.97); per-run prints stay pure, and clustering across runs
     * is what gives a voice its global identity — the reference
     * pipeline's own shape. Flicker gaps of up to 3 frames inside a
     * run merge; a run needs MIN_OBS_FRAMES solo frames to count.
     */
    public static List<Observation> observations(boolean[][][] act) {
        List<Observation> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int w = 0; w < act.length; w++) {
            int frames = act[w].length;
            for (int s = 0; s < LOCAL_SPEAKERS; s++) {
                int runStart = -1;
                int gap = 0;
                int lastSolo = -1;
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    boolean solo = act[w][f][s];
                    if (solo) {
                        for (int o = 0; o < LOCAL_SPEAKERS; o++) {
                            if (o != s && act[w][f][o]) { solo = false; break; }
                        }
                    }
                    if (solo) {
                        if (runStart < 0) runStart = f;
                        lastSolo = f;
                        gap = 0;
                    } else if (runStart >= 0) {
                        if (++gap > 3) {
                            emitRun(out, w, s, runStart, lastSolo);
                            runStart = -1;
                            gap = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (runStart >= 0) emitRun(out, w, s, runStart, lastSolo);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static void emitRun(List<Observation> out, int window, int speaker,
                                int f0, int f1) {
        if (f1 - f0 + 1 < MIN_OBS_FRAMES) return;
        Observation ob = new Observation();
        ob.window = window;
        ob.localSpeaker = speaker;
        double half = (FRAME_SHIFT_SAMPLES / 2.0) / SAMPLE_RATE;
        double a = frameCenterSec(window, f0) - half;
        double b = frameCenterSec(window, f1) + half;
        ob.spans.add(new double[]{a, b});
        ob.activeSec = b - a;
        out.add(ob);
    }

    /** A cluster of observations: one voice, as far as the
     *  embeddings can tell. Centroid is the duration-weighted mean
     *  of member embeddings, L2-normalized. */
    public static final class Cluster {
        public final List<Observation> members = new ArrayList<>();
        public float[] centroid;
        public double totalActiveSec = 0;
    }

    /** A cluster needs at least this much attributed solo speech
     *  to count as a voice. Below the floor it is a fragment —
     *  window-edge slivers and decode flicker — never a cast
     *  member (Delwin's law: one-line background voices may not
     *  stabilize, and fragments must not pretend to). */
    public static final double MIN_CLUSTER_SEC = 1.2;
    public static final int MIN_CLUSTER_RUNS = 1;
    /** Centroid-merge margin under the cluster threshold: fragment
     *  clusters of the SAME voice hover just under the join
     *  threshold (measured 0.43–0.51 on the narrator control),
     *  while the fixture's genuinely different voices sit at
     *  0.17–0.24. */
    public static final double MERGE_MARGIN = 0.08;
    /** A cluster with at least this much attributed speech is a
     *  VOICE: fragments may be absorbed into a voice, but two
     *  voices never merge into each other. The first merge design
     *  let absorbed fragments drag a voice's centroid until two
     *  real voices chained together (fixture: 3 voices collapsed
     *  to 2); absorption is judged once, against the voices' own
     *  pass-1 centroids, and never chains. */
    public static final double VOICE_SEC = 4.0;

    /**
     * Clustering, three deterministic passes:
     *   1. greedy — longest observations first (their prints are
     *      the most reliable); an observation joins the cluster
     *      whose centroid it matches best at or above
     *      {@code threshold}, otherwise it founds a new cluster;
     *   2. absorption — a non-voice cluster whose centroid matches
     *      a VOICE cluster's pass-1 centroid at or above
     *      threshold − MERGE_MARGIN folds into that voice (a
     *      voice's fragments reunite; voices never merge);
     *   3. evidence floor — clusters under MIN_CLUSTER_SEC /
     *      MIN_CLUSTER_RUNS dissolve; their observations witness
     *      nothing and lines they alone covered stay honestly
     *      unattributed.
     */
    public static List<Cluster> cluster(List<Observation> obs, double threshold) {
        List<Observation> sorted = new ArrayList<>(obs);
        sorted.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.activeSec, a.activeSec));
        List<Cluster> clusters = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Observation ob : sorted) {
            if (ob.embedding == null) continue;
            Cluster best = null;
            double bestScore = -1;
            for (Cluster c : clusters) {
                double s = VoiceBook.cosine(ob.embedding, c.centroid);
                if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = c; }
            }
            if (best != null && bestScore >= threshold) {
                best.members.add(ob);
                refold(best);
            } else {
                Cluster c = new Cluster();
                c.members.add(ob);
                c.centroid = normalized(ob.embedding.clone());
                clusters.add(c);
            }
        }
        for (Cluster c : clusters) {
            c.totalActiveSec = 0;
            for (Observation ob : c.members) c.totalActiveSec += ob.activeSec;
        }
        // pass 2: fragment absorption into voices, judged once
        List<Cluster> voices = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Cluster c : clusters) {
            if (c.totalActiveSec >= VOICE_SEC) voices.add(c);
        }
        if (!voices.isEmpty()) {
            List<Cluster> rest = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Cluster c : clusters) {
                if (voices.contains(c)) { rest.add(c); continue; }
                Cluster best = null;
                double bestScore = threshold - MERGE_MARGIN;
                for (Cluster v : voices) {
                    double s = VoiceBook.cosine(c.centroid, v.centroid);
                    if (s >= bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = v; }
                }
                if (best != null) {
                    best.members.addAll(c.members);
                    best.totalActiveSec += c.totalActiveSec;
                } else {
                    rest.add(c);
                }
            }
            for (Cluster v : voices) refold(v);
            clusters = rest;
        }
        // pass 3: the evidence floor
        List<Cluster> kept = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Cluster c : clusters) {
            c.totalActiveSec = 0;
            for (Observation ob : c.members) c.totalActiveSec += ob.activeSec;
            if (c.totalActiveSec >= MIN_CLUSTER_SEC
                    && c.members.size() >= MIN_CLUSTER_RUNS) {
                kept.add(c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < kept.size(); i++) {
            for (Observation ob : kept.get(i).members) ob.cluster = i;
        }
        return kept;
    }

    private static void refold(Cluster c) {
        int dim = c.centroid.length;
        double[] acc = new double[dim];
        double wsum = 0;
        for (Observation ob : c.members) {
            double w = Math.max(0.05, ob.activeSec);
            for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) acc[i] += w * ob.embedding[i];
            wsum += w;
        }
        float[] next = new float[dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) next[i] = (float) (acc[i] / wsum);
        c.centroid = normalized(next);
    }

    public static float[] normalized(float[] v) {
        double n = 0;
        for (float f : v) n += f * (double) f;
        n = Math.sqrt(n);
        if (n <= 0) return v;
        float[] out = new float[v.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) out[i] = (float) (v[i] / n);
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Which cluster speaks this line: the cluster whose observations
     * hold the most solo-active time inside [startSec, endSec].
     * Returns the cluster index, or -1 when no cluster clears the
     * dominance bar (LINE_MIN_SEC and LINE_MIN_SHARE) — an unknown
     * line is an honest line; it gets no invented speaker.
     */
    public static int assignLine(List<Cluster> clusters, double startSec, double endSec) {
        if (clusters == null || clusters.isEmpty() || endSec <= startSec) return -1;
        double[] per = new double[clusters.size()];
        double total = 0;
        for (int ci = 0; ci < clusters.size(); ci++) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (Observation ob : clusters.get(ci).members) {
                for (double[] sp : ob.spans) {
                    double a = Math.max(sp[0], startSec);
                    double b = Math.min(sp[1], endSec);
                    if (b > a) sum += b - a;
                }
            }
            per[ci] = sum;
            total += sum;
        }
        int best = -1;
        double bestV = 0;
        for (int ci = 0; ci < per.length; ci++) {
            if (per[ci] > bestV) { bestV = per[ci]; best = ci; }
        }
        if (best < 0 || bestV < LINE_MIN_SEC) return -1;
        if (total > 0 && bestV / total < LINE_MIN_SHARE) return -1;
        return best;
    }

    /**
     * Gather an observation's audio for embedding: its solo spans,
     * longest first, up to OBS_AUDIO_CAP_SEC total, concatenated.
     * The reader supplies samples by (startSec, durSec).
     */
    public interface SliceReader {
        float[] read(double startSec, double durSec) throws Exception;
    }

    public static float[] observationAudio(Observation ob, SliceReader reader)
            throws Exception {
        List<double[]> spans = new ArrayList<>(ob.spans);
        spans.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[1] - b[0], a[1] - a[0]));
        List<float[]> parts = new ArrayList<>();
        double budget = OBS_AUDIO_CAP_SEC;
        int total = 0;
        for (double[] sp : spans) {
            if (budget <= 0) break;
            double len = Math.min(sp[1] - sp[0], budget);
            float[] pcm = reader.read(sp[0], len);
            if (pcm != null && pcm.length > 0) {
                parts.add(pcm);
                total += pcm.length;
                budget -= pcm.length / (double) SAMPLE_RATE;
            }
        }
        float[] out = new float[total];
        int at = 0;
        for (float[] p : parts) {
            System.arraycopy(p, 0, out, at, p.length);
            at += p.length;
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DiarOnnx.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession;

/**
 * The diarization seam (v0.12.0): the pack's two ONNX models behind
 * one door — pyannote segmentation-3.0 (who is speaking, frame by
 * frame) and the 3D-Speaker embedding model (whose voice it is).
 * Adopted components, never rebuilt: the models ride the shelf in
 * the diarization pack (DiarPack) and this class only runs them.
 *
 * Segmentation runs in the reference recipe's windows: 10 s of
 * waveform sliding 1 s, batches of 16 windows. Embeddings run over
 * FbankFeatures (the Kaldi front end the embedding model was
 * trained against — validated number-for-number against the
 * reference extractor in work/v120/diar).
 *
 * Construction IS the binding, like the cooker engine: if the
 * sessions open, the organ exists; if they don't, the caller gets
 * the exception and the dub flow plans without it (single voice,
 * said plainly) — the missing organ is never simulated.
 */
public final class DiarOnnx implements AutoCloseable {

    private final OrtSession seg;
    private final OrtSession emb;
    private final String segIn;
    private final String embIn;

    private DiarOnnx(OrtSession seg, OrtSession emb, String segIn, String embIn) {
        this.seg = seg;
        this.emb = emb;
        this.segIn = segIn;
        this.embIn = embIn;
    }

    /** Open both models from an installed diarization pack dir
     *  (seg/model.onnx + emb/model.onnx). Throws on any failure. */
    public static DiarOnnx open(File packDir) throws Exception {
        File segFile = new File(new File(packDir, "seg"), "model.onnx");
        File embFile = new File(new File(packDir, "emb"), "model.onnx");
        if (!segFile.isFile()) throw new Exception("the voice pack has no segmentation model");
        if (!embFile.isFile()) throw new Exception("the voice pack has no speaker model");
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        OrtSession.SessionOptions opts = new OrtSession.SessionOptions();
        OrtSession seg = env.createSession(segFile.getPath(), opts);
        OrtSession emb = env.createSession(embFile.getPath(), opts);
        return new DiarOnnx(seg, emb,
                seg.getInputNames().iterator().next(),
                emb.getInputNames().iterator().next());
    }

    public boolean isBound() { return seg != null && emb != null; }

    public interface Progress {
        void onWindows(int done, int total);
    }

    /**
     * Segment a whole title: logits [window][frame][class] in the
     * model's own layout. Windows start every WINDOW_SHIFT samples;
     * the tail window is zero-padded (the reference recipe).
     */
    public float[][][] segment(PcmSource src, Progress progress) throws Exception {
        double durSec = src.durationSec();
        int totalSamples = (int) Math.round(durSec * DiarCore.SAMPLE_RATE);
        List<Integer> starts = new ArrayList<>();
        if (totalSamples <= DiarCore.WINDOW_SAMPLES) {
            starts.add(0);
        } else {
            for (int s = 0; s + DiarCore.WINDOW_SAMPLES <= totalSamples;
                 s += DiarCore.WINDOW_SHIFT) {
                starts.add(s);
            }
            int last = starts.get(starts.size() - 1) + DiarCore.WINDOW_SAMPLES;
            if (last < totalSamples) starts.add(starts.get(starts.size() - 1)
                    + DiarCore.WINDOW_SHIFT);
        }
        List<float[][]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        int batch = 16;
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        for (int b = 0; b < starts.size(); b += batch) {
            int n = Math.min(batch, starts.size() - b);
            float[][][] in = new float[n][1][DiarCore.WINDOW_SAMPLES];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                double fromSec = starts.get(b + i) / (double) DiarCore.SAMPLE_RATE;
                double wantSec = DiarCore.WINDOW_SAMPLES / (double) DiarCore.SAMPLE_RATE;
                float[] pcm = src.read(fromSec, wantSec);
                if (pcm != null) {
                    System.arraycopy(pcm, 0, in[i][0], 0,
                            Math.min(pcm.length, DiarCore.WINDOW_SAMPLES));
                }
            }
            try (OnnxTensor tensor = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, in);
                 OrtSession.Result r = seg.run(Collections.singletonMap(segIn, tensor))) {
                float[][][] y = (float[][][]) r.get(0).getValue();
                for (float[][] windowFrames : y) out.add(windowFrames);
            }
            if (progress != null) progress.onWindows(Math.min(b + n, starts.size()), starts.size());
        }
        return out.toArray(new float[0][][]);
    }

    /**
     * One speaker embedding for an audio slice (the model's raw
     * 512-dim output; callers compare with VoiceBook.cosine, which
     * is norm-free). Null when the slice is too short to frame.
     */
    public float[] embed(float[] pcm) throws Exception {
        float[][] feats = FbankFeatures.compute(pcm);
        if (feats.length == 0) return null;
        float[][][] in = new float[1][feats.length][];
        in[0] = feats;
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        try (OnnxTensor tensor = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, in);
             OrtSession.Result r = emb.run(Collections.singletonMap(embIn, tensor))) {
            float[][] out = (float[][]) r.get(0).getValue();
            return out[0];
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { seg.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { emb.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DiarPack.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

/**
 * The diarization (voice) pack slot (v0.12.0) — James's executor
 * rule made literal: the organ that knows WHO is speaking is a
 * component Sandy carries, adopted whole from the proven open
 * models (pyannote segmentation-3.0 + a 3D-Speaker embedding
 * model), never rebuilt and never simulated. When no pack is in,
 * the dub plans single-voice and says so.
 *
 * Same discipline as the engine pack (EnginePack): a ZIP whose
 * first file is pack.txt —
 *
 *   sandy.diarpack=1
 *   version=1
 *   seg.kind=pyannote-segmentation-3.0
 *   emb.kind=eres2net-3dspeaker
 *   cluster.threshold=0.50
 *   voicebook.match=0.55
 *   voicebook.near=0.42
 *   file seg/model.onnx <size> <sha256>
 *   file emb/model.onnx <size> <sha256>
 *
 * Fail-closed with integrity: every carried file listed, every
 * listed file present at its recorded size and SHA-256, both
 * models present, the calibration numbers sane (near < match,
 * all inside (0,1)). A failed validation extracts nothing that
 * stays. The calibration rides the pack because embedding cosine
 * scales are model properties, not universal constants — the
 * numbers in the shipped pack were measured on the diarization
 * fixture in work/v120/diar and are stated in the NOTES.
 */
public final class DiarPack {

    public static final String MANIFEST = "pack.txt";

    public static final class Result {
        public boolean ok = false;
        public int version = 0;
        public String segKind = "", embKind = "";
        public double clusterThreshold = 0.5;
        public double vbMatch = VoiceBook.MATCH_MIN;
        public double vbNear = VoiceBook.NEAR_MIN;
        public long totalBytes = 0;
        public final List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        public final Map<String, long[]> files = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    private DiarPack() {}

    private static final class Listed {
        long size; String sha;
    }

    /** Same contract as EnginePack.validateAndExtract. */
    public static Result validateAndExtract(InputStream in, File destDir) {
        Result r = new Result();
        Map<String, Listed> listed = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, Boolean> seen = new HashMap<>();
        boolean manifestSeen = false;
        try {
            MessageDigest sha = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            ZipInputStream zin = new ZipInputStream(in);
            List<File> written = new ArrayList<>();
            ZipEntry e;
            boolean first = true;
            while ((e = zin.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                String name = e.getName();
                if (e.isDirectory()) continue;
                if (first && !MANIFEST.equals(name)) {
                    r.errors.add("the first file in the pack must be "
                            + MANIFEST + " (the manifest), found: " + name);
                    break;
                }
                first = false;
                if (MANIFEST.equals(name)) {
                    manifestSeen = true;
                    byte[] text = readEntry(zin);
                    parseManifest(new String(text, "UTF-8"), r, listed);
                    if (!r.errors.isEmpty()) break;
                    continue;
                }
                Listed lf = listed.get(name);
                if (lf == null) {
                    r.errors.add("the pack carries a file its manifest "
                            + "does not list: " + name);
                    break;
                }
                seen.put(name, Boolean.TRUE);
                sha.reset();
                long size = 0;
                File out = null;
                FileOutputStream fos = null;
                if (destDir != null) {
                    out = new File(destDir, name);
                    if (!out.getCanonicalPath().startsWith(
                            destDir.getCanonicalPath() + File.separator)) {
                        r.errors.add("a listed path escapes the pack "
                                + "folder: " + name);
                        break;
                    }
                    if (out.getParentFile() != null) out.getParentFile().mkdirs();
                    fos = new FileOutputStream(out);
                    written.add(out);
                }
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = zin.read(buf)) > 0) {
                    sha.update(buf, 0, n);
                    size += n;
                    if (fos != null) fos.write(buf, 0, n);
                }
                if (fos != null) fos.close();
                if (size != lf.size) {
                    r.errors.add(name + ": size is " + size
                            + " but the manifest says " + lf.size);
                    break;
                }
                String digest = hex(sha.digest());
                if (!digest.equalsIgnoreCase(lf.sha)) {
                    r.errors.add(name + ": its SHA-256 does not match "
                            + "the manifest — the file is not what the "
                            + "pack says it is");
                    break;
                }
                r.totalBytes += size;
            }
            zin.close();
            if (r.errors.isEmpty()) {
                if (!manifestSeen) {
                    r.errors.add("the pack has no " + MANIFEST + " manifest.");
                } else {
                    for (String path : listed.keySet()) {
                        if (!seen.containsKey(path)) {
                            r.errors.add("the manifest lists " + path
                                    + " but the pack does not carry it");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!r.errors.isEmpty() && destDir != null) {
                for (File f : written) f.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            r.errors.add("the pack could not be read (" + ex.getMessage() + ")");
        }
        r.ok = r.errors.isEmpty();
        return r;
    }

    private static void parseManifest(String text, Result r, Map<String, Listed> listed) {
        Map<String, String> kv = new HashMap<>();
        List<String> fileLines = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String raw : text.split("\\R")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
            if (line.startsWith("file ")) { fileLines.add(line); continue; }
            int eq = line.indexOf('=');
            if (eq > 0) kv.put(line.substring(0, eq).trim(), line.substring(eq + 1).trim());
        }
        if (!"1".equals(kv.get("sandy.diarpack"))) {
            r.errors.add("not a Sandy voice pack (missing the "
                    + "sandy.diarpack=1 header)");
            return;
        }
        try {
            r.version = Integer.parseInt(kv.getOrDefault("version", "0"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            r.version = 0;
        }
        if (r.version < 1) {
            r.errors.add("the pack's version is missing or not a number");
            return;
        }
        r.segKind = kv.getOrDefault("seg.kind", "");
        r.embKind = kv.getOrDefault("emb.kind", "");
        if (r.segKind.isEmpty() || r.embKind.isEmpty()) {
            r.errors.add("the pack must name both its segmentation "
                    + "model (seg.kind) and its speaker model (emb.kind)");
            return;
        }
        r.clusterThreshold = parseUnit(kv.get("cluster.threshold"), 0.5, r);
        r.vbMatch = parseUnit(kv.get("voicebook.match"), VoiceBook.MATCH_MIN, r);
        r.vbNear = parseUnit(kv.get("voicebook.near"), VoiceBook.NEAR_MIN, r);
        if (!r.errors.isEmpty()) return;
        if (!(r.vbNear < r.vbMatch)) {
            r.errors.add("the pack's voicebook calibration is impossible "
                    + "(near must be below match)");
            return;
        }
        for (String line : fileLines) {
            String[] p = line.split("\\s+");
            if (p.length != 4) {
                r.errors.add("a manifest file line is malformed: " + line);
                return;
            }
            Listed lf = new Listed();
            try {
                lf.size = Long.parseLong(p[2]);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                r.errors.add("a manifest file line has a bad size: " + line);
                return;
            }
            lf.sha = p[3];
            if (!lf.sha.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}") || lf.size < 0) {
                r.errors.add("a manifest file line has a bad SHA-256 "
                        + "or size: " + line);
                return;
            }
            listed.put(p[1], lf);
            r.files.put(p[1], new long[]{lf.size});
        }
        if (listed.isEmpty()) {
            r.errors.add("the manifest lists no files at all");
        } else if (!listed.containsKey("seg/model.onnx")) {
            r.errors.add("the manifest lists no segmentation model "
                    + "(seg/model.onnx)");
        } else if (!listed.containsKey("emb/model.onnx")) {
            r.errors.add("the manifest lists no speaker model "
                    + "(emb/model.onnx)");
        }
    }

    private static double parseUnit(String v, double dflt, Result r) {
        if (v == null || v.isEmpty()) return dflt;
        try {
            double d = Double.parseDouble(v);
            if (d > 0.0 && d < 1.0) return d;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        r.errors.add("a calibration value is not a number inside (0,1): " + v);
        return dflt;
    }

    private static byte[] readEntry(ZipInputStream zin) throws Exception {
        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int n;
        while ((n = zin.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
        return bos.toByteArray();
    }

    private static String hex(byte[] bytes) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : bytes) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DiarPackStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;

/**
 * Where an installed diarization pack lives (v0.12.0):
 *   filesDir/diarize/seg/model.onnx + emb/model.onnx
 *   filesDir/diarize.json           the install record (with the
 *                                   pack's measured calibration)
 * One pack — the organ is singular, like the ear. Install follows
 * the engine pack's law: one streaming pass through DiarPack's
 * fail-closed validation into staging; only a fully valid pack is
 * promoted into place. A refused pack leaves nothing behind.
 */
public final class DiarPackStore {

    public static final class Status {
        public boolean installed = false;
        public int version = 0;
        public String segKind = "", embKind = "";
        public double clusterThreshold = 0.5;
        public double vbMatch = VoiceBook.MATCH_MIN;
        public double vbNear = VoiceBook.NEAR_MIN;
        public long totalBytes = 0;
        public File dir = null;
    }

    private DiarPackStore() {}

    private static File root(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "diarize");
    }

    private static File record(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "diarize.json");
    }

    public static Status status(Context ctx) {
        Status s = new Status();
        File rec = record(ctx);
        if (!rec.isFile()) return s;
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject(new String(
                    EnginePackStore.readAll(rec), "UTF-8"));
            s.version = o.optInt("version", 0);
            s.segKind = o.optString("segKind", "");
            s.embKind = o.optString("embKind", "");
            s.clusterThreshold = o.optDouble("clusterThreshold", 0.5);
            s.vbMatch = o.optDouble("vbMatch", VoiceBook.MATCH_MIN);
            s.vbNear = o.optDouble("vbNear", VoiceBook.NEAR_MIN);
            s.totalBytes = o.optLong("totalBytes", 0);
            s.dir = root(ctx);
            s.installed = new File(new File(s.dir, "seg"), "model.onnx").isFile()
                    && new File(new File(s.dir, "emb"), "model.onnx").isFile();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            s.installed = false;
        }
        return s;
    }

    public interface Callback {
        void onResult(DiarPack.Result result);
    }

    /** Validate + install from a picked file, on a worker thread. */
    public static void install(Context ctx, Uri uri, Callback cb) {
        new Thread(() -> {
            DiarPack.Result r;
            File staging = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "diarize_incoming");
            try {
                EnginePackStore.deleteTree(staging);
                staging.mkdirs();
                InputStream in = ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                r = DiarPack.validateAndExtract(in, staging);
                if (in != null) in.close();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                r = new DiarPack.Result();
                r.errors.add("the pack could not be opened (" + e.getMessage() + ")");
            }
            if (r.ok) {
                try {
                    File dest = root(ctx);
                    EnginePackStore.deleteTree(dest);
                    if (!staging.renameTo(dest)) {
                        r.errors.add("the pack validated but could not be "
                                + "moved into place");
                        r.ok = false;
                    } else {
                        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                        o.put("version", r.version);
                        o.put("segKind", r.segKind);
                        o.put("embKind", r.embKind);
                        o.put("clusterThreshold", r.clusterThreshold);
                        o.put("vbMatch", r.vbMatch);
                        o.put("vbNear", r.vbNear);
                        o.put("totalBytes", r.totalBytes);
                        FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(record(ctx));
                        fos.write(o.toString().getBytes("UTF-8"));
                        fos.close();
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    r.errors.add("the pack validated but its install record "
                            + "could not be written (" + e.getMessage() + ")");
                    r.ok = false;
                }
            }
            if (!r.ok) EnginePackStore.deleteTree(staging);
            DiarPack.Result done = r;
            new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
                    .post(() -> cb.onResult(done));
        }, "diar-pack-install").start();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DisplayCounts.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The QC clause of the Display Honesty Law (v0.14.0, James:
 * "You say you got 2598 links — how many of those are bad?
 * How many do I have to sort through? Should already be done
 * for me."). Link verification is the app's job, completed
 * BEFORE display; the viewer never sorts good from bad.
 *
 * The invariant this class exists to hold: ANY COUNT SANDY
 * PRINTS BESIDE LINKS IS THE COUNT OF VERIFIED-LIVE LINKS ONLY
 * — links that passed the checker (SG-1 semantics: terminal
 * failures out on the spot, slow withheld as unproven, never
 * branded or counted). The checked set IS the shelf. A link
 * with no verdict yet is not counted and not promised; a link
 * that later dies leaves the count at the next check
 * (HealthStore is re-read at render, never cached into the
 * tiles). Renderers ask here; they never count raw lists.
 */
public final class DisplayCounts {

    private DisplayCounts() {}

    /** Is this health tier a verified-live link? */
    public static boolean isVerifiedLive(Integer tier) {
        return tier != null
                && (tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS
                        || tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS);
    }

    /**
     * The only count a surface may print for a set of links:
     * how many of them stand verified-live in the health
     * record. urls and their tiers come from the same read, so
     * displayed count == verified set size, by construction.
     */
    public static int verifiedCount(List<String> urls,
                                    Map<String, Integer> tiersByUrl) {
        if (urls == null || tiersByUrl == null) return 0;
        int n = 0;
        for (String u : urls) {
            if (isVerifiedLive(tiersByUrl.get(u))) n++;
        }
        return n;
    }

    /**
     * The count text a tile may carry: the verified count, or
     * NOTHING (empty string) when no link in the set stands
     * verified yet — an unverified number is never printed,
     * and a printed zero would still be a claim.
     */
    public static String countText(int verified) {
        return verified > 0 ? String.valueOf(verified) : "";
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DoorCoverage.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The Two Doors' coverage truth (v0.15.0) — every promise a door
 * surface makes is DERIVED here from the audited machinery, never
 * hard-coded at the surface (the Display Honesty Law):
 *
 *   VOICE  VoiceResolve over the live sets: installed Sandy voice
 *          packs × the phone speech engine's probed languages.
 *   EAR    the phone's speech-recognition service exists or it
 *          doesn't. Per-language support is the SERVICE's truth,
 *          knowable only when a session runs — so coverage says
 *          TRY (an ear exists) or NO_RECOGNIZER, and the LISTENING
 *          session's own outcome refines it on screen. Sandy's own
 *          on-device whisper exists only inside an installed
 *          engine pack and only for that pack's pair language
 *          (today: Japanese, in the ja-en pack) — it backs the
 *          RECORD road, and only there.
 *   MT     TranslatorCore routes over installed engine pairs.
 *
 * Pure: the Android doors probe the live sets and pass them in;
 * the harness pins the derivation from fixtures.
 */
public final class DoorCoverage {

    private DoorCoverage() {}

    /** What one language can do across the doors. */
    public static final class LangCoverage {
        /** PACK / SYSTEM / NONE — Speak's ladder answer. */
        public VoiceResolve.Voice voice = VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE;
        /** An ear exists on this phone to try (system service). */
        public boolean earTry;
        /** Sandy's own whisper can transcribe this language from
         *  a saved recording (installed pack pair source). */
        public boolean whisper;
    }

    public static LangCoverage forRow(VoiceLangs.Row row,
                                      Set<String> installedPackCodes,
                                      Set<String> systemTtsIso1,
                                      boolean recognizerPresent,
                                      Set<String> installedMtPairs) {
        LangCoverage c = new LangCoverage();
        if (row == null) return c;
        c.voice = SpeakQueue.decide(row, installedPackCodes, systemTtsIso1).voice;
        c.earTry = recognizerPresent;
        c.whisper = whisperCovers(row.iso1, installedMtPairs);
        return c;
    }

    /**
     * Sandy's whisper lives in engine packs, bound to the pack
     * pair's SOURCE language (the ja-en pack hears Japanese —
     * OnnxCookerEngine's language token is the pair's source).
     * A language is whisper-covered exactly when an installed
     * ONNX pair starts with it.
     */
    public static boolean whisperCovers(String iso1, Set<String> installedMtPairs) {
        if (iso1 == null || iso1.isEmpty() || installedMtPairs == null) return false;
        String want = iso1.trim().toLowerCase() + "-";
        for (String p : installedMtPairs) {
            if (p != null && p.startsWith(want)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** The Translator's route for a pair of sides — same truth
     *  the door refuses or proceeds by. */
    public static TranslatorCore.Route route(String fromIso, String toIso,
                                             Set<String> installedMtPairs) {
        return TranslatorCore.resolveRoute(fromIso, toIso, installedMtPairs);
    }

    /** Languages (voice-table rows) that have ANY door coverage —
     *  used to keep pickers honest: a language with no voice, no
     *  ear, and no route is still listed (the table is the
     *  catalogue's truth) but its state line says so. */
    public static boolean anyCoverage(LangCoverage c) {
        return c != null && (c.voice != VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE || c.earTry);
    }

    /** The row for an ISO-1 tag from the voice table. */
    public static VoiceLangs.Row rowFor(List<VoiceLangs.Row> rows, String iso1) {
        return VoiceLangs.byIso1(rows, iso1);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Downloads.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.media3.common.MimeTypes;
import androidx.media3.database.StandaloneDatabaseProvider;
import androidx.media3.datasource.DefaultHttpDataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.CacheDataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.NoOpCacheEvictor;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.SimpleCache;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.DownloadManager;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.DownloadRequest;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * Record what's playing (v0.5.0, item 3 — Delwin's #3, bounded by
 * James: "record what's playing", no scheduled DVR).
 *
 * Uses media3's own DownloadManager to pull the live stream being
 * watched into a recordings cache — for an HLS source that means the
 * downloader follows the live playlist and keeps fetching segments
 * until told to stop, so what lands on the phone is the part of the
 * broadcast that aired while you were recording. Stopping keeps what
 * was caught ("Stop & keep"); the segments are real files in the
 * recordings cache and the Recordings shelf plays them through the
 * player like anything else.
 *
 * Honest edges, by design:
 *  - A source that refuses (403, DRM, a non-HLS protocol the
 *    downloader can't take) fails the download, and the shelf shows
 *    the failure plainly instead of a fake recording.
 *  - One fixed user agent rides on recordings ("Sandy/0.14.1") —
 *    media3's stock downloaders don't take per-request headers, so a
 *    stream that gates on a special user agent can refuse; the
 *    failure is shown, not hidden.
 *  - Recordings run while Sandy is open; closing the app pauses
 *    them (the DownloadManager resumes them next launch).
 *
 * The recordings cache is a separate directory from the timeshift
 * buffer and is never evicted silently — only the viewer deletes a
 * recording.
 */
public final class Downloads {

    private static volatile DownloadManager manager;
    private static volatile SimpleCache cache;
    private static volatile StandaloneDatabaseProvider dbProvider;

    private Downloads() {}

    public static synchronized void init(Context ctx) {
        if (manager != null) return;
        Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            dbProvider = new StandaloneDatabaseProvider(app);
            File dir = new File(app.getFilesDir(), "recordings-cache");
            cache = new SimpleCache(dir, new NoOpCacheEvictor(), dbProvider);
            CacheDataSource.Factory cacheDs = new CacheDataSource.Factory()
                    .setCache(cache)
                    .setUpstreamDataSourceFactory(
                            new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory()
                                    .setUserAgent("Sandy/0.14.1")
                                    .setAllowCrossProtocolRedirects(true))
                    .setFlags(CacheDataSource.FLAG_IGNORE_CACHE_ON_ERROR);
            // (Context, DatabaseProvider, Cache, DataSource.Factory,
            // Executor) — media3 builds its downloader factory from
            // the cache data source internally (verified by javap
            // against the staged 1.4.1 classes).
            manager = new DownloadManager(app, dbProvider, cache, cacheDs,
                    Executors.newCachedThreadPool());
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // Hardened in 0.8.0: store construction must fail closed
            // and quiet (recordings show their refused state), never
            // take the app down — and the failure leaves evidence.
            CrashGuard.log(app, "Downloads.init", t);
            manager = null;
            cache = null;
        }
    }

    public static DownloadManager manager(Context ctx) {
        init(ctx);
        return manager;
    }

    public static SimpleCache cache(Context ctx) {
        init(ctx);
        return cache;
    }

    /** Data source factory for playing a recording back (cache-first). */
    public static CacheDataSource.Factory playbackFactory(Context ctx) {
        init(ctx);
        return new CacheDataSource.Factory()
                .setCache(cache)
                .setUpstreamDataSourceFactory(
                        new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory()
                                .setUserAgent("Sandy/0.14.1")
                                .setAllowCrossProtocolRedirects(true))
                .setFlags(CacheDataSource.FLAG_IGNORE_CACHE_ON_ERROR);
    }

    public static boolean isRecording(Context ctx, String url) {
        Download d = get(ctx, url);
        return d != null && (d.state == Download.STATE_DOWNLOADING
                || d.state == Download.STATE_QUEUED
                || d.state == Download.STATE_RESTARTING);
    }

    public static Download get(Context ctx, String url) {
        DownloadManager m = manager(ctx);
        if (m == null) return null;
        try {
            return m.getDownloadIndex().getDownload(url);
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Start recording a live url. Returns false when refused early. */
    public static boolean start(Context ctx, String url, boolean hls) {
        DownloadManager m = manager(ctx);
        if (m == null) return false;
        try {
            DownloadRequest.Builder b = new DownloadRequest.Builder(url, Uri.parse(url));
            if (hls) b.setMimeType(MimeTypes.APPLICATION_M3U8);
            m.addDownload(b.build());
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Stop & keep what was caught. */
    public static void stopKeep(Context ctx, String url) {
        DownloadManager m = manager(ctx);
        if (m == null) return;
        try { m.setStopReason(url, 1); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    /** Resume a stopped recording (if the source still offers it). */
    public static void resume(Context ctx, String url) {
        DownloadManager m = manager(ctx);
        if (m == null) return;
        try { m.setStopReason(url, Download.STOP_REASON_NONE); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    /** Delete a recording and its bytes. */
    public static void delete(Context ctx, String url) {
        DownloadManager m = manager(ctx);
        if (m == null) return;
        try { m.removeDownload(url); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        ChannelStore.removeRecordMeta(ctx, url);
    }

    /** Plain-language state line for the Recordings shelf. */
    public static String stateLine(Download d) {
        if (d == null) return "";
        long mb = Math.max(0, d.getBytesDownloaded()) / (1024 * 1024);
        switch (d.state) {
            case Download.STATE_DOWNLOADING:
                return "● Recording… " + mb + " MB so far";
            case Download.STATE_QUEUED:
            case Download.STATE_RESTARTING:
                return "● Recording — starting…";
            case Download.STATE_COMPLETED:
                return "Recorded · " + mb + " MB";
            case Download.STATE_STOPPED:
                return "Stopped — " + mb + " MB kept · tap to play";
            case Download.STATE_FAILED:
                return "Failed — the source refused or the connection dropped ("
                        + mb + " MB caught)";
            case Download.STATE_REMOVING:
                return "Deleting…";
            default:
                return mb + " MB";
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DubActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The dub kitchen (v0.12.0) — James's order, built into Sandy
 * herself: RECORD it → COOK the dub → THEN WATCH it. Not real-time,
 * never promised as such; a cooked dub is a FILE in the library.
 *
 * The flow on this screen:
 *   PICK an episode Sandy already has (My Videos' shelf or the
 *   Recordings shelf) or pick a video file;
 *   ANALYZE — the subtitle tracks that travel with the file are
 *   found and read (SubFinder/SubHarvest), the packs' states are
 *   read, and DubGate states the plan as one spoken sentence;
 *   CHOOSE the language to hear (and pin the subtitle language
 *   when a file doesn't declare it — Sandy asks, never guesses);
 *   COOK on this phone, stage by spoken stage: subtitles first
 *   (translate-then-speak), the ear only as the fallback; the
 *   voice pack witnesses who speaks each line; the VoiceBook
 *   casts every character ONCE — per show, per season — and the
 *   casting is saved before the first line is spoken, so episode
 *   two inherits episode one;
 *   DONE: the dubbed track, the translated subtitle file and the
 *   full record sit on the Dubbed-episodes shelf, with every
 *   disclosure attached (near-match voices, re-spoken lines,
 *   lines that ran long, lines the translator garbled silent) —
 *   and one tap plays the episode with its dub.
 *
 * The executor is Sandy: every organ runs on-device through the
 * adopted packs. Nothing here phones home, and nothing fakes an
 * organ that isn't in: a missing pack is a spoken plan change,
 * never a simulated result.
 */
public final class DubActivity extends Activity {

    /** The 13 spoken languages a dub can aim at (code, name). */
    static final String[][] HEARD = {
        {"en", "English"}, {"es", "Spanish"}, {"fr", "French"},
        {"de", "German"}, {"pt", "Portuguese"}, {"it", "Italian"},
        {"ru", "Russian"}, {"ar", "Arabic"}, {"hi", "Hindi"},
        {"zh", "Chinese"}, {"ja", "Japanese"}, {"ko", "Korean"},
        {"fa", "Persian"},
    };

    private static final int REQ_PICK_VIDEO = 4712;
    private static final int REQ_PICK_SUB = 4713;

    private static final class Pick {
        String url = "";
        String name = "";
        boolean recording = false;
    }

    private ExecutorService exec;

    // v0.13.0: the voice table + this target's resolved voice
    private List<VoiceLangs.Row> voiceRows = new ArrayList<>();
    private String targetTv = "English";
    private VoiceResolve.Result voice;
    private final java.util.Set<String> systemProbeOk = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    private final java.util.Set<String> systemProbeAsked = new java.util.HashSet<>();
    private android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech voiceProbe;
    private boolean voiceProbeReady = false;
    private Runnable settleRecheck;

    private TextView statusView;
    private ListView list;
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private final List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private ProgressBar progress;

    private boolean shelfMode = false;
    private List<DubShelf.Entry> shelfEntries = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<Pick> picks = new ArrayList<>();

    // analysis state for the chosen pick
    private Pick chosen;
    private List<SubHarvest.Track> tracks = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<SubFinder.Found> foundSubs = new ArrayList<>();
    private int trackIdx = -1;              // chosen subtitle track; -1 = none
    private String pinnedSubLang = null;    // viewer's pin for an unnamed track
    private String targetLang = "en";
    private DubGate.Decision plan;

    private LinearLayout planBox;
    private TextView planView;
    private TextView analyzeView;
    private LinearLayout subLangBox;
    private LinearLayout targetBox;
    private Button cookBtn;
    private Button cancelBtn;
    private LinearLayout doneBox;
    private TextView doneView;
    private Button watchBtn;
    private DubShelf.Entry lastCooked;

    private volatile boolean cooking = false;
    private volatile boolean cancelFlag = false;
    private TtsDubRenderer activeRenderer;
    private OnnxCookerEngine activeEngine;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ life

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
        shelfMode = "shelf".equals(getIntent().getStringExtra("mode"));
        setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, shelfMode ? "dub_shelf_door" : "title_dub"));

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(14);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(statusView);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(progress);

        list = new ListView(this);
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, rows);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1);
        root.addView(list, lp);

        planBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        planBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        planBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(planBox);

        analyzeView = new TextView(this);
        analyzeView.setTextSize(15);
        planBox.addView(analyzeView);

        subLangBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        subLangBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        planBox.addView(subLangBox);

        targetBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        targetBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        planBox.addView(targetBox);

        planView = new TextView(this);
        planView.setTextSize(16);
        planBox.addView(planView);

        cookBtn = new Button(this);
        cookBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_cook_btn"));
        cookBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> startCook());
        planBox.addView(cookBtn);

        cancelBtn = new Button(this);
        cancelBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_cancel"));
        cancelBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            cancelFlag = true;
            if (activeRenderer != null) activeRenderer.cancel();
            if (activeEngine != null) activeEngine.cancel();
        });
        planBox.addView(cancelBtn);

        doneBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        doneBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        doneBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(doneBox);
        doneView = new TextView(this);
        doneView.setTextSize(15);
        doneBox.addView(doneView);
        watchBtn = new Button(this);
        watchBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_watch_btn"));
        watchBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (lastCooked != null) watch(lastCooked);
        });
        doneBox.addView(watchBtn);
        Button castBtn = new Button(this);
        castBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_cast_btn"));
        castBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, VoiceBookActivity.class)));
        doneBox.addView(castBtn);

        setContentView(root);

        list.setOnItemClickListener((parent, view, pos, id) -> onRow(pos));
        list.setOnItemLongClickListener((parent, view, pos, id) -> onRowLong(pos));

        voiceRows = VoiceLangs.load(this);
        settleRecheck = () -> {
            if (!cooking && chosen != null) refreshPlan();
        };
        // v0.13.0: a preselected pick (the "Make a voiceover…"
        // doors on the episode page, the recordings shelf and My
        // Videos) opens the kitchen already holding its video
        String preUrl = getIntent().getStringExtra("pickUrl");
        if (!shelfMode && preUrl != null && !preUrl.isEmpty()) {
            Pick p = new Pick();
            p.url = preUrl;
            p.name = getIntent().getStringExtra("pickName");
            if (p.name == null || p.name.isEmpty()) p.name = preUrl;
            p.recording = getIntent().getBooleanExtra("pickRecording", false);
            analyze(p);
        } else if (shelfMode) loadShelf(); else loadPicks();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        cancelFlag = true;
        statusView.removeCallbacks(settleRecheck);
        if (voiceProbe != null) {
            try { voiceProbe.shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (exec != null) exec.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    private String tr(String key) { return LangStore.tr(this, key); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ pick list

    private void loadPicks() {
        statusView.setText(tr("dub_pick_hint"));
        rows.clear();
        picks.clear();
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<Pick> out = new ArrayList<>();
            // My Videos' three doors, merged the shelf's own way
            try {
                List<LocalFiles.Row> merged = DubPickSources.merged(this);
                for (LocalFiles.Row r : merged) {
                    Pick p = new Pick();
                    p.url = r.uri;
                    p.name = r.title;
                    out.add(p);
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            // settled recordings
            try {
                androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.DownloadManager m =
                        Downloads.manager(this);
                if (m != null) {
                    try (androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.DownloadCursor cursor =
                                 m.getDownloadIndex().getDownloads()) {
                        while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                            androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download d =
                                    cursor.getDownload();
                            boolean settled = d.state
                                    == androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download.STATE_COMPLETED
                                    || (d.state
                                    == androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download.STATE_STOPPED
                                    && d.getBytesDownloaded() > 0);
                            if (!settled) continue;
                            Pick p = new Pick();
                            p.url = d.request.id;
                            String name = ChannelStore.getRecordName(this, d.request.id);
                            p.name = name.isEmpty() ? d.request.id : name;
                            p.recording = true;
                            out.add(p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                picks = out;
                rows.clear();
                rows.add("＋ " + tr("dub_pick_file"));
                for (Pick p : picks) {
                    rows.add("🎬 " + p.name + (p.recording
                            ? "\n" + tr("dub_from_recording") : ""));
                }
                if (picks.isEmpty()) statusView.setText(tr("dub_pick_empty"));
                adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
            });
        });
    }

    private void loadShelf() {
        statusView.setText(tr("dub_shelf_hint"));
        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<DubShelf.Entry> es = DubShelf.list(this);
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                shelfEntries = es;
                rows.clear();
                if (es.isEmpty()) rows.add(tr("dub_shelf_empty"));
                for (DubShelf.Entry e : es) rows.add("▶ " + e.displayName()
                        + "\n" + e.lineCount + " " + tr("dub_stat_lines")
                        + (e.castCount > 0 ? " · " + e.castCount + " "
                        + tr("dub_stat_cast") : ""));
                adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
            });
        });
    }

    private void onRow(int pos) {
        if (shelfMode) {
            if (pos < shelfEntries.size()) watch(shelfEntries.get(pos));
            return;
        }
        if (cooking) return;
        if (pos == 0) {
            Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
            i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
            i.setType("video/*");
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_VIDEO);
            return;
        }
        if (pos - 1 < picks.size()) analyze(picks.get(pos - 1));
    }

    private boolean onRowLong(int pos) {
        if (!shelfMode || pos >= shelfEntries.size()) return false;
        DubShelf.Entry e = shelfEntries.get(pos);
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(e.displayName())
                .setItems(new CharSequence[]{tr("dub_watch_btn"), tr("dub_delete")},
                        (d, which) -> {
                            if (which == 0) watch(e);
                            else deleteDub(e);
                        })
                .show();
        return true;
    }

    private void deleteDub(DubShelf.Entry e) {
        exec.execute(() -> {
            for (String p : new String[]{e.dubPath, e.srtPath, e.jsonPath}) {
                if (p != null && !p.isEmpty()) new File(p).delete();
            }
            DubShelf.remove(this, e.id);
            runOnUiThread(this::loadShelf);
        });
    }

    private void watch(DubShelf.Entry e) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("url", e.videoUrl);
        i.putExtra("name", e.showTitle);
        i.putExtra("ckey", e.showKey);
        i.putExtra("dubUrl", Uri.fromFile(new File(e.dubPath)).toString());
        i.putExtra("subUrl", Uri.fromFile(new File(e.srtPath)).toString());
        i.putExtra("subMime", "application/x-subrip");
        i.putExtra("subLang", e.targetLang);
        i.putExtra("trJsonUrl", Uri.fromFile(new File(e.jsonPath)).toString());
        if (e.videoUrl.startsWith("content://") || e.videoUrl.startsWith("/")) {
            i.putExtra("localSet", true);
        }
        startActivity(i);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int res, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, res, data);
        if (res != RESULT_OK || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
        Uri uri = data.getData();
        try {
            getContentResolver().takePersistableUriPermission(uri,
                    Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (req == REQ_PICK_VIDEO) {
            Pick p = new Pick();
            p.url = uri.toString();
            p.name = DubPickSources.displayName(this, p.url);
            analyze(p);
        } else if (req == REQ_PICK_SUB) {
            adoptPickedSub(uri);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ analysis

    /** Find + read the subtitle tracks, then state the plan. */
    private void analyze(Pick p) {
        chosen = p;
        tracks = new ArrayList<>();
        foundSubs = new ArrayList<>();
        trackIdx = -1;
        pinnedSubLang = null;
        doneBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        planBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        analyzeView.setText(tr("dub_state_reading"));
        planView.setText("");
        statusView.setText("🎬 " + p.name);
        String uiLang = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
        targetLang = "en";
        targetTv = "English";
        for (String[] h : HEARD) if (h[0].equals(uiLang)) targetLang = uiLang;
        VoiceLangs.Row uiRow = VoiceLangs.byIso1(voiceRows, targetLang);
        if (uiRow != null) targetTv = uiRow.tvName;
        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<SubFinder.Found> found = SubFinder.find(this, p.url, p.name);
            List<SubHarvest.Track> parsed = new ArrayList<>();
            List<SubFinder.Found> kept = new ArrayList<>();
            for (SubFinder.Found f : found) {
                String text = SubFinder.readText(this, f);
                if (text == null) continue;
                SubHarvest.Track t = SubHarvest.parse(f.name, text);
                if (t.lines.size() < 3) continue;   // a stub is not a track
                t.lang = f.lang;
                parsed.add(t);
                kept.add(f);
            }
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                foundSubs = kept;
