                tracks = parsed;
                trackIdx = bestTrack();
                refreshPlan();
            });
        });
    }

    /** The track the plan starts from: one already in, or routable
     *  to, the hearing language; else the longest track; else the
     *  unnamed one (the viewer pins its language). */
    private int bestTrack() {
        if (tracks.isEmpty()) return -1;
        Set<String> pairs = TextMt.installedPairs(this);
        int best = -1;
        int bestScore = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < tracks.size(); i++) {
            SubHarvest.Track t = tracks.get(i);
            int score = t.lines.size();
            if (!t.lang.isEmpty()) {
                DubGate.Route r = DubGate.route(t.lang, targetLang, pairs);
                if (r == DubGate.Route.PASSTHROUGH) score += 100000;
                else if (r == DubGate.Route.DIRECT) score += 50000;
            }
            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = i; }
        }
        return best;
    }

    /** Offer the other found tracks + a hand-picked subtitle file. */
    private void adoptPickedSub(Uri uri) {
        try {
            String name = DubPickSources.displayName(this, uri.toString());
            SubFinder.Found f = new SubFinder.Found();
            f.uri = uri.toString();
            f.name = name;
            f.lang = SubHarvest.langFromName(name,
                    DubTrack.stemOf(chosen == null ? "" : chosen.name));
            String text = SubFinder.readText(this, f);
            if (text == null) {
                Toast.makeText(this, tr("dub_sub_unreadable"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                return;
            }
            SubHarvest.Track t = SubHarvest.parse(name, text);
            if (t.lines.size() < 3) {
                Toast.makeText(this, tr("dub_sub_unreadable"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                return;
            }
            t.lang = f.lang;
            foundSubs.add(f);
            tracks.add(t);
            trackIdx = tracks.size() - 1;
            pinnedSubLang = null;
            refreshPlan();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Toast.makeText(this, tr("dub_sub_unreadable"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    private void refreshPlan() {
        if (chosen == null) return;
        // ---- the analysis sentence
        StringBuilder a = new StringBuilder();
        if (trackIdx >= 0) {
            SubHarvest.Track t = tracks.get(trackIdx);
            a.append("📄 ").append(tr("dub_subs_found")).append(": ")
             .append(foundSubs.get(trackIdx).name)
             .append(" · ").append(t.lines.size()).append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_lines"))
             .append(" · ").append(t.lang.isEmpty()
                     ? tr("dub_sub_lang_undeclared") : langName(t.lang));
            if (t.namedLines > 0) {
                a.append(" · ").append(t.namedLines).append(" ")
                 .append(tr("dub_sub_named"));
            }
            if (tracks.size() > 1) {
                a.append("\n").append(tr("dub_sub_others")).append(" ")
                 .append(tracks.size() - 1);
            }
        } else {
            a.append("📄 ").append(tr("dub_subs_none"));
        }
        DiarPackStore.Status diar = DiarPackStore.status(this);
        a.append("\n").append(diar.installed
                ? "🗣 " + tr("dub_voicepack_in")
                : "🗣 " + tr("dub_voicepack_out"));
        analyzeView.setText(a.toString());

        buildSubLangChips();
        buildTargetChips();
        plan = computePlan();

        // v0.13.0: a recording pick whose copy is still landing
        // cannot cook yet — said plainly, re-checked while it lands
        statusView.removeCallbacks(settleRecheck);
        if (chosen.recording && !recordingSettled(chosen)) {
            planView.setText("⏳ " + tr("dub_still_saving"));
            cookBtn.setEnabled(false);
            statusView.postDelayed(settleRecheck, 4000);
            return;
        }

        // v0.13.0: the voice disclosure — who will speak the
        // target language on THIS phone, resolved before any cook
        voice = resolveTargetVoice();
        StringBuilder pt = new StringBuilder(planText(plan));
        if (voice.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.PACK) {
            pt.append("\n🗣 ").append(String.format(
                    tr("dub_voice_pack"), targetTv));
        } else if (voice.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.SYSTEM) {
            pt.append("\n🗣 ").append(String.format(
                    tr("dub_voice_system"), targetTv));
        } else {
            pt.append("\n🔇 ").append(String.format(
                    tr("dub_voice_none"), targetTv));
        }
        planView.setText(pt.toString());
        cookBtn.setEnabled(plan.cooks()
                && voice.voice != VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE);
    }

    /** Settled = the recording's bytes are all here (or kept). */
    private boolean recordingSettled(Pick p) {
        try {
            androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download d =
                    Downloads.get(this, p.url);
            if (d == null) return false;
            return d.state == androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download.STATE_COMPLETED
                    || (d.state == androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download.STATE_STOPPED
                            && d.getBytesDownloaded() > 0);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Resolve the target's voice; probe the phone's engine when
     *  the answer isn't known yet (the probe's return refreshes
     *  the plan). */
    private VoiceResolve.Result resolveTargetVoice() {
        VoiceLangs.Row row = VoiceLangs.byIso1(voiceRows, targetLang);
        if (row == null) return new VoiceResolve.Result();
        VoiceResolve.Result r = VoiceResolve.resolve(row,
                VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this), systemProbeOk);
        if (r.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE
                && !systemProbeAsked.contains(row.iso1)) {
            probeSystemVoice(row.iso1);
        }
        return r;
    }

    private void probeSystemVoice(String iso1) {
        if (voiceProbe != null && voiceProbeReady) {
            runProbe(iso1);
            return;
        }
        if (voiceProbe != null) return;   // init already in flight
        final android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech[] holder =
                new android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech[1];
        holder[0] = new android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech(this, status -> {
            voiceProbeReady = status == android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech.SUCCESS;
            if (voiceProbeReady) runProbe(iso1);
        });
        voiceProbe = holder[0];
    }

    private void runProbe(String iso1) {
        try {
            int a = voiceProbe.isLanguageAvailable(
                    java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag(iso1));
            if (a >= android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) {
                systemProbeOk.add(iso1);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        // mark "asked, not available" too, so we don't re-probe in
        // a loop: a sentinel with the language's own tag negated
        systemProbeAsked.add(iso1);
        runOnUiThread(() -> { if (chosen != null && !cooking) refreshPlan(); });
    }

    private DubGate.Decision computePlan() {
        Set<String> pairs = TextMt.installedPairs(this);
        String subLang = null;
        boolean named = false;
        if (trackIdx >= 0) {
            SubHarvest.Track t = tracks.get(trackIdx);
            subLang = t.lang.isEmpty() ? (pinnedSubLang == null ? "" : pinnedSubLang)
                    : t.lang;
            named = t.namedLines > 0;
        }
        EnginePackStore.Status engine = EnginePackStore.anyInstalled(this);
        String asrPair = engine != null && engine.onnx() ? engine.pair : null;
        return DubGate.decide(subLang, named, targetLang, pairs,
                DiarPackStore.status(this).installed, asrPair);
    }

    private String planText(DubGate.Decision d) {
        switch (d.plan) {
            case SUB_CAST: return "🧑‍🤝‍🧑 " + tr("dub_plan_cast");
            case SUB_NAMED: return "🧑‍🤝‍🧑 " + tr("dub_plan_named");
            case SUB_SOLO: return "🧑 " + tr("dub_plan_solo_sub");
            case ASR_CAST: return "🧑‍🤝‍🧑 " + tr("dub_plan_asr_cast");
            case ASR_SOLO: return "🧑 " + tr("dub_plan_asr_solo");
            case SUB_LANG_UNKNOWN: return "❓ " + tr("dub_sub_lang_q");
            case NEEDS_MT: return "🧩 " + tr("dub_need_mt").replace("%s", d.detail);
            case NEEDS_ENGINE: return "👂 " + tr("dub_need_engine");
            default: return "";
        }
    }

    private void buildSubLangChips() {
        subLangBox.removeAllViews();
        if (trackIdx < 0) {
            Button pick = new Button(this);
            pick.setText("＋ " + tr("dub_pick_sub"));
            pick.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
                i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
                i.setType("*/*");
                startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_SUB);
            });
            subLangBox.addView(pick);
            return;
        }
        SubHarvest.Track t = tracks.get(trackIdx);
        if (!t.lang.isEmpty()) return;
        TextView q = new TextView(this);
        q.setText(tr("dub_sub_lang_q"));
        subLangBox.addView(q);
        // v0.13.0: the pin is any catalogue language, not 13
        Button pin = new Button(this);
        pin.setText(pinnedSubLang == null
                ? tr("dub_sub_lang_q") : langName(pinnedSubLang));
        pin.setOnClickListener(v -> pickSubLanguage());
        subLangBox.addView(pin);
        Button none = new Button(this);
        none.setText(tr("dub_sub_unusable"));
        none.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // the viewer says this track is no use: plan the ear road
            trackIdx = -1;
            pinnedSubLang = null;
            refreshPlan();
        });
        subLangBox.addView(none);
        Button pick = new Button(this);
        pick.setText("＋ " + tr("dub_pick_sub"));
        pick.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
            i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
            i.setType("*/*");
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_SUB);
        });
        subLangBox.addView(pick);
    }

    private void buildTargetChips() {
        targetBox.removeAllViews();
        TextView q = new TextView(this);
        q.setText(tr("dub_target_q"));
        targetBox.addView(q);
        // v0.13.0: the target is ANY of the 84 catalogue languages,
        // not the 13 of the first dub — one button naming the
        // current choice, a list to pick from (the coverage state
        // of the chosen one is stated in the plan, probed live)
        Button cur = new Button(this);
        java.util.Set<String> packs = VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this);
        VoiceLangs.Row curRow = VoiceLangs.byIso1(voiceRows, targetLang);
        String badge = curRow != null && packs.contains(curRow.packCode)
                ? " · " + tr("voice_state_pack") : "";
        cur.setText("● " + targetTv + badge);
        cur.setOnClickListener(v -> pickTargetLanguage());
        targetBox.addView(cur);
        if (tracks.size() > 1) {
            Button other = new Button(this);
            other.setText(tr("dub_sub_switch"));
            other.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                String[] names = new String[tracks.size()];
                for (int i = 0; i < tracks.size(); i++) {
                    names[i] = foundSubs.get(i).name;
                }
                new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                        .setTitle(tr("dub_subs_found"))
                        .setItems(names, (d, which) -> {
                            trackIdx = which;
                            pinnedSubLang = null;
                            refreshPlan();
                        }).show();
            });
            targetBox.addView(other);
        }
    }

    /** The 83-language list, for target or subtitle pin. */
    private void pickTargetLanguage() {
        String[] names = new String[voiceRows.size()];
        java.util.Set<String> packs = VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this);
        for (int i = 0; i < voiceRows.size(); i++) {
            VoiceLangs.Row r = voiceRows.get(i);
            names[i] = r.tvName + (!r.packCode.isEmpty() && packs.contains(r.packCode)
                    ? " · " + tr("voice_state_pack") : "");
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(tr("dub_target_q"))
                .setItems(names, (d, which) -> {
                    VoiceLangs.Row r = voiceRows.get(which);
                    targetLang = r.iso1;
                    targetTv = r.tvName;
                    int bt = bestTrack();
                    if (bt >= 0) trackIdx = bt;
                    refreshPlan();
                }).show();
    }

    private void pickSubLanguage() {
        String[] names = new String[voiceRows.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < voiceRows.size(); i++) {
            names[i] = voiceRows.get(i).tvName;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(tr("dub_sub_lang_q"))
                .setItems(names, (d, which) -> {
                    pinnedSubLang = voiceRows.get(which).iso1;
                    refreshPlan();
                }).show();
    }

    String langName(String code) {
        for (String[] h : HEARD) if (h[0].equals(code)) return h[1];
        VoiceLangs.Row r = VoiceLangs.byIso1(voiceRows, code);
        if (r != null) return r.tvName;
        return code == null ? "" : code.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.US);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ the cook

    /** Show/episode identity from a file name (EpisodeKey's rules). */
    static final class ShowId {
        String key = "", title = "";
        int season = 0, episode = 0;
    }

    static ShowId showOf(String fileName) {
        ShowId id = new ShowId();
        String name = fileName == null ? "" : fileName;
        String stem = DubTrack.stemOf(name);
        int[] span = EpisodeKey.parseSpan(name);
        String title = stem;
        if (span != null) {
            id.season = span[0];
            id.episode = span[1];
            if (span[2] > 0 && span[2] <= stem.length()) {
                String before = stem.substring(0, span[2])
                        .replaceAll("[._\\-\\s]+$", "").replace('_', ' ')
                        .replace('.', ' ').trim();
                if (!before.isEmpty()) title = before;
            }
            if (id.season == 0 && id.episode > 0) id.season = 1;
        }
        id.title = title;
        id.key = "show:" + EpisodeKey.normalize(title);
        return id;
    }

    private void startCook() {
        if (cooking || chosen == null || plan == null || !plan.cooks()) return;
        cooking = true;
        cancelFlag = false;
        cookBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        cancelBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        doneBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        final Pick pick = chosen;
        final DubGate.Decision thePlan = plan;
        final int tIdx = trackIdx;
        final String tgt = targetLang;
        final String pin = pinnedSubLang;
        final VoiceResolve.Result theVoice = voice;
        new Thread(() -> cook(pick, thePlan, tIdx, tgt, pin, theVoice),
                "dub-cook").start();
    }

    private void stage(String text) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> statusView.setText(text));
    }

    private void checkCancel() throws Exception {
        if (cancelFlag) throw new Exception(tr("dub_cancelled"));
    }

    private void cook(Pick pick, DubGate.Decision thePlan, int tIdx,
                      String tgt, String pin, VoiceResolve.Result theVoice) {
        long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
        try {
            ShowId ident = showOf(pick.name);
            stage(tr("dub_state_reading"));
            File tmpDir = new File(getCacheDir(), "dub-cook");
            tmpDir.mkdirs();
            String decodeUrl = pick.url;
            if (pick.recording) {
                androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download d =
                        Downloads.get(this, pick.url);
                if (d == null) throw new Exception(tr("dub_recording_gone"));
                File outDir = new File(getFilesDir(), "recording-export");
                decodeUrl = RecordingExport.export(this, d, outDir).getAbsolutePath();
            }
            PcmSource src = AudioPcmDecoder.decode(this, decodeUrl, tmpDir);
            checkCancel();

            // ---- the lines: subtitle road first, ear as fallback
            List<CookedSubs.Line> lines = new ArrayList<>();
            String srcLang;
            int loopsDropped = 0;
            if (thePlan.fromSubs()) {
                SubHarvest.Track t = tracks.get(tIdx);
                srcLang = !t.lang.isEmpty() ? t.lang : (pin == null ? "" : pin);
                for (CookedSubs.Line l : t.lines) {
                    CookedSubs.Line c = new CookedSubs.Line();
                    c.startMs = l.startMs;
                    c.endMs = l.endMs;
                    c.orig = l.text;
                    c.text = l.text;
                    c.speaker = l.speaker == null ? "" : l.speaker;
                    lines.add(c);
                }
                if (!srcLang.equals(tgt)) {
                    stage(tr("dub_st_translate"));
                    try (TextMt mt = TextMt.open(this, srcLang + "-" + tgt)) {
                        for (CookedSubs.Line c : lines) {
                            checkCancel();
                            c.text = mt.translate(c.orig);
                        }
                        loopsDropped = mt.droppedLoops();
                    }
                }
            } else {
                stage(tr("dub_st_listen"));
                EnginePackStore.Status ep = EnginePackStore.anyInstalled(this);
                activeEngine = OnnxCookerEngine.open(ep.dir);
                List<CookedSubs.Line> heard = activeEngine.cook(src,
                        (idx, chunkSec, wallSec, soFar) -> stage(
                                tr("dub_st_listen") + " " + soFar.size()
                                        + " " + tr("dub_stat_lines")));
                try { activeEngine.close(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                activeEngine = null;
                srcLang = ep.pair.split("-")[0];
                lines.addAll(heard);
                if (!"en".equals(tgt)) {
                    stage(tr("dub_st_translate"));
                    try (TextMt mt = TextMt.open(this, "en-" + tgt)) {
                        for (CookedSubs.Line c : lines) {
                            checkCancel();
                            String en = c.text;
                            c.text = mt.translate(en);
                        }
                        loopsDropped = mt.droppedLoops();
                    }
                }
            }
            if (lines.isEmpty()) throw new Exception(tr("dub_no_lines"));
            checkCancel();

            // ---- who speaks: casting, saved before a word is spoken
            VoiceBook.Book book = null;
            int nearCount = 0;
            int castCount = 0;
            if (thePlan.plan == DubGate.Plan.SUB_CAST
                    || thePlan.plan == DubGate.Plan.ASR_CAST) {
                stage(tr("dub_st_voices"));
                int[] stats = attributeByEar(src, lines, ident);
                book = VoiceBookStore.load(this, ident.key);
                nearCount = stats[0];
                castCount = stats[1];
            } else if (thePlan.plan == DubGate.Plan.SUB_NAMED) {
                stage(tr("dub_st_cast"));
                book = VoiceBookStore.load(this, ident.key);
                if (book.showTitle == null || book.showTitle.isEmpty()) {
                    book.showTitle = ident.title;
                }
                Map<String, VoiceBook.CastEntry> byName = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                for (VoiceBook.CastEntry e : book.cast) {
                    if (e.name != null && !e.name.isEmpty()) byName.put(e.name, e);
                }
                for (CookedSubs.Line c : lines) {
                    if (c.speaker == null || c.speaker.isEmpty()) continue;
                    String nm = c.speaker;
                    VoiceBook.CastEntry e = byName.get(nm);
                    if (e == null) {
                        e = VoiceBook.enroll(book, "name:" + nm, null, 0);
                        e.name = nm;
                        byName.put(nm, e);
                    }
                    c.speaker = e.speakerKey;
                }
                VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
                castCount = byName.size();
            }
            checkCancel();

            // ---- give them voices
            stage(tr("dub_st_render"));
            File outDir = new File(new File(getFilesDir(), "dubbed"),
                    ident.key.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_"));
            outDir.mkdirs();
            String stem = DubTrack.stemOf(pick.name);
            File wav = new File(outDir, stem + ".dub-" + tgt + ".wav");
            final TtsDubRenderer.Report[] repBox = new TtsDubRenderer.Report[1];
            final String[] errBox = new String[1];
            CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
            activeRenderer = new TtsDubRenderer(this);
            TtsDubRenderer.Callback renderCb = new TtsDubRenderer.Callback() {
                @Override public void onProgress(double cookedSec) {
                    stage(tr("dub_st_render") + " " + (int) cookedSec + "s");
                }
                @Override public void onDone(File f, TtsDubRenderer.Report r) {
                    repBox[0] = r;
                    latch.countDown();
                }
                @Override public void onError(String why) {
                    errBox[0] = why;
                    latch.countDown();
                }
            };
            // the voice the plan disclosed is the voice that
            // speaks: the pack when one is in, the phone's own
            // otherwise (NONE never reaches here — the cook
            // button stays off, per the disclosure law)
            if (theVoice != null
                    && theVoice.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.PACK) {
                activeRenderer.renderPack(lines, book, theVoice.packCode,
                        wav, renderCb);
            } else {
                activeRenderer.render(lines, book, tgt, wav, renderCb);
            }
            latch.await();
            activeRenderer = null;
            if (errBox[0] != null) throw new Exception(errBox[0]);
            TtsDubRenderer.Report rep = repBox[0];
            if (rep != null && rep.lineFit != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < lines.size() && i < rep.lineFit.length; i++) {
                    lines.get(i).fit = rep.lineFit[i];
                }
            }

            // ---- the cooked files + the shelf record
            File srt = new File(outDir, stem + ".tr-" + tgt + ".srt");
            File json = new File(outDir, stem + ".tr-" + tgt + ".json");
            java.nio.file.Files.write(srt.toPath(),
                    CookedSubs.writeSrt(lines).getBytes("UTF-8"));
            java.nio.file.Files.write(json.toPath(),
                    CookedSubs.writeJson(tgt, lines).getBytes("UTF-8"));
            DubShelf.Entry e = new DubShelf.Entry();
            e.id = ident.key + "|" + stem + "|" + tgt;
            e.cookedAtSec = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000;
            e.showKey = ident.key;
            e.showTitle = ident.title;
            e.season = ident.season;
            e.episode = ident.episode;
            e.targetLang = tgt;
            e.videoUrl = pick.url;
            e.dubPath = wav.getAbsolutePath();
            e.srtPath = srt.getAbsolutePath();
            e.jsonPath = json.getAbsolutePath();
            e.lineCount = lines.size();
            e.castCount = castCount;
            e.nearCount = nearCount;
            DubShelf.add(this, e);

            long wallSec = (System.currentTimeMillis() - t0) / 1000;
            StringBuilder done = new StringBuilder();
            done.append("✅ ").append(tr("dub_done_title")).append(" — ")
                .append(e.displayName()).append("\n")
                .append(lines.size()).append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_lines"));
            if (castCount > 0) done.append(" · ").append(castCount)
                    .append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_cast"));
            if (nearCount > 0) done.append("\n⚠ ").append(nearCount)
                    .append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_near"));
            if (rep != null && rep.refits > 0) done.append("\n").append(rep.refits)
                    .append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_refit"));
            if (rep != null && rep.overran > 0) done.append("\n").append(rep.overran)
                    .append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_over"));
            if (loopsDropped > 0) done.append("\n").append(loopsDropped)
                    .append(" ").append(tr("dub_stat_loops"));
            if (thePlan.plan == DubGate.Plan.SUB_SOLO
                    || thePlan.plan == DubGate.Plan.ASR_SOLO) {
                done.append("\n").append(tr("dub_solo_note"));
            }
            done.append("\n⏱ ").append(wallSec).append("s");
            lastCooked = e;
            String doneText = done.toString();
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                cooking = false;
                cancelBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                cookBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                statusView.setText(tr("dub_done_title"));
                doneView.setText(doneText);
                doneBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            });
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            String why = ex.getMessage() == null
                    ? ex.getClass().getSimpleName() : ex.getMessage();
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                cooking = false;
                cancelBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                cookBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                statusView.setText(tr("dub_failed") + why);
                Toast.makeText(this, tr("dub_failed") + why,
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            });
        }
    }

    /**
     * The witness at work: segment the title, embed each solo
     * voice observation, cluster the voices, assign each line its
     * dominant cluster, and settle every cluster into the show's
     * VoiceBook — matched voices fold in, near voices FORK flagged
     * (never silently swapped), new voices enroll. The book is
     * saved before returning, so the casting exists even if the
     * render is stopped afterwards.
     * Returns {nearCount, castCount}.
     */
    private int[] attributeByEar(PcmSource src, List<CookedSubs.Line> lines,
                                 ShowId ident) throws Exception {
        DiarPackStore.Status pack = DiarPackStore.status(this);
        VoiceBook.Book book = VoiceBookStore.load(this, ident.key);
        if (book.showTitle == null || book.showTitle.isEmpty()) {
            book.showTitle = ident.title;
        }
        // the book adopts the pack's measured calibration for its
        // prints (cosine scales belong to the embedding model)
        book.matchMin = pack.vbMatch;
        book.nearMin = pack.vbNear;

        int near = 0;
        try (DiarOnnx diar = DiarOnnx.open(pack.dir)) {
            float[][][] logits = diar.segment(src,
                    (doneW, totalW) -> stage(tr("dub_st_voices")
                            + " " + doneW + "/" + totalW));
            boolean[][][] act = DiarCore.decode(logits);
            List<DiarCore.Observation> obs = DiarCore.events(DiarCore.observations(act));
            for (DiarCore.Observation ob : obs) {
                checkCancel();
                float[] audio = DiarCore.observationAudio(ob,
                        (s, d) -> src.read(s, d));
                if (audio.length >= DiarCore.SAMPLE_RATE / 4) {
                    ob.embedding = diar.embed(audio);
                }
            }
            List<DiarCore.Cluster> clusters =
                    DiarCore.cluster(obs, pack.clusterThreshold);
            // stable keys by how much each cluster speaks
            List<Integer> order = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < clusters.size(); i++) order.add(i);
            order.sort((x, y) -> Double.compare(
                    clusters.get(y).totalActiveSec, clusters.get(x).totalActiveSec));
            Map<Integer, VoiceBook.CastEntry> entryByCluster = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            int season = ident.episode > 0 ? Math.max(1, ident.season) : 0;
            for (int ci : order) {
                DiarCore.Cluster c = clusters.get(ci);
                float[] centroid = c.centroid;
                VoiceBook.Match m = VoiceBook.match(book, centroid, season);
                VoiceBook.CastEntry e;
                if (m.kind == VoiceBook.MatchKind.MATCH) {
                    e = m.entry;
                    VoiceBook.foldVoiceprint(e, centroid, 0.2);
                } else {
                    e = VoiceBook.enroll(book,
                            "dub-spk-" + (book.cast.size() + 1), centroid,
                            m.kind == VoiceBook.MatchKind.NEAR ? season : 0);
                    if (m.kind == VoiceBook.MatchKind.NEAR) {
                        e.nearMatch = true;
                        near++;
                    }
                }
                entryByCluster.put(ci, e);
            }
            // subtitle files that NAME their speakers teach the
            // clusters their names: the dominant name among a
            // cluster's lines names its (still nameless) entry
            Map<Integer, Map<String, Integer>> nameVotes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            String[] lineNames = new String[lines.size()];
            int[] lineCluster = new int[lines.size()];
            for (int li = 0; li < lines.size(); li++) {
                CookedSubs.Line line = lines.get(li);
                lineNames[li] = line.speaker == null ? "" : line.speaker;
                lineCluster[li] = DiarCore.assignLine(clusters,
                        line.startMs / 1000.0, line.endMs / 1000.0);
                if (lineCluster[li] >= 0 && !lineNames[li].isEmpty()) {
                    nameVotes.computeIfAbsent(lineCluster[li],
                            k -> new LinkedHashMap<>())
                            .merge(lineNames[li], 1, Integer::sum);
                }
            }
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Map<String, Integer>> v : nameVotes.entrySet()) {
                VoiceBook.CastEntry e = entryByCluster.get(v.getKey());
                if (e == null || e.name == null || !e.name.isEmpty()) continue;
                String bestName = "";
                int bestCount = 0;
                for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> nv : v.getValue().entrySet()) {
                    if (nv.getValue() > bestCount) {
                        bestCount = nv.getValue();
                        bestName = nv.getKey();
                    }
                }
                if (!bestName.isEmpty()) e.name = bestName;
            }
            VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
            for (int li = 0; li < lines.size(); li++) {
                int ci = lineCluster[li];
                if (ci >= 0) {
                    VoiceBook.CastEntry e = entryByCluster.get(ci);
                    if (e != null) {
                        lines.get(li).speaker = e.speakerKey;
                        if (e.nearMatch) lines.get(li).flagged = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            return new int[]{near, entryByCluster.size()};
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DubFinder.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.provider.DocumentsContract;
import android.provider.MediaStore;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Finds a prepared-dub sidecar for a library video (v0.4.0). The
 * naming convention lives in DubTrack; this class does the looking,
 * across the three ways a library file can sit on the phone:
 *
 *  - a plain path / file:// URI  -> a java.io.File beside it
 *  - a MediaStore content URI    -> an audio row with the sidecar's
 *                                   name in the same folder
 *  - a SAF document URI          -> the sibling document in the
 *                                   same picked folder
 *
 * Every road is best-effort and fails to null: no sidecar found simply
 * means the Subtitles/Audio menu offers the original tracks only.
 */
public final class DubFinder {

    private DubFinder() {}

    /** Sidecar URI for this video, or null when none is on the phone. */
    public static String findDub(Context ctx, LibraryIndex.Entry entry) {
        return findAny(ctx, entry, entry == null ? null
                : DubTrack.sidecarNames(entry.fileName));
    }

    /**
     * A cooked translated-subtitle sidecar (v0.6.0) for this video in
     * the given language; same three roads as the dub lookup.
     */
    public static String findTrSub(Context ctx, LibraryIndex.Entry entry, String lang) {
        return findAny(ctx, entry, entry == null ? null
                : DubTrack.trSubNames(entry.fileName, lang), true);
    }

    /** A prepared dub (v0.6.0) in any target language. */
    public static String findDubLang(Context ctx, LibraryIndex.Entry entry, String lang) {
        return findAny(ctx, entry, entry == null ? null
                : DubTrack.dubNamesFor(entry.fileName, lang));
    }

    /** The shared lookup: any of {@code names} beside this video. */
    public static String findAny(Context ctx, LibraryIndex.Entry entry, List<String> names) {
        return findAny(ctx, entry, names, false);
    }

    /**
     * @param filesTable true when the sidecar is a document (subtitle)
     *        rather than audio — the MediaStore road then queries the
     *        Files table instead of the Audio table.
     */
    public static String findAny(Context ctx, LibraryIndex.Entry entry,
                                 List<String> names, boolean filesTable) {
        if (entry == null || entry.uri == null || entry.uri.isEmpty()) return null;
        String uriStr = entry.uri;
        if (names == null || names.isEmpty()) return null;

        if (!uriStr.contains("://")) {
            return fromPath(uriStr, names);
        }
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(uriStr);
        String scheme = uri.getScheme();
        if ("file".equals(scheme)) {
            return fromPath(uri.getPath(), names);
        }
        if ("content".equals(scheme)) {
            if ("media".equals(uri.getAuthority())) {
                return fromMediaStore(ctx, uri, names, filesTable);
            }
            return fromSaf(ctx, uri, names);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String fromPath(String path, List<String> names) {
        if (path == null) return null;
        File video = new File(path);
        File dir = video.getParentFile();
        if (dir == null) return null;
        for (String name : names) {
            File side = new File(dir, name);
            if (side.isFile()) return Uri.fromFile(side).toString();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String fromMediaStore(Context ctx, Uri videoUri, List<String> names,
                                         boolean filesTable) {
        ContentResolver cr = ctx.getContentResolver();
        String relPath = null;
        try (Cursor c = cr.query(videoUri,
                new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH}, null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) relPath = c.getString(0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (relPath == null) return null;
        for (String name : names) {
            Uri audio = filesTable
                    ? MediaStore.Files.getContentUri("external")
                    : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
            try (Cursor c = cr.query(audio, new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID},
                    MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH + "=? AND "
                            + MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME + "=?",
                    new String[]{relPath, name}, null)) {
                if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                    Uri found = Uri.withAppendedPath(audio, Long.toString(c.getLong(0)));
                    return found.toString();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String fromSaf(Context ctx, Uri docUri, List<String> names) {
        try {
            String docId = DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(docUri);
            int slash = docId.lastIndexOf('/');
            if (slash < 0) return null;
            String parent = docId.substring(0, slash + 1);
            ContentResolver cr = ctx.getContentResolver();
            for (String name : names) {
                Uri sibling = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUri(
                        docUri.getAuthority(), parent + name);
                try (Cursor c = cr.query(sibling,
                        new String[]{DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID},
                        null, null, null)) {
                    if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) return sibling.toString();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DubGate.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The dub cook's decision table (v0.12.0) — pure logic in the
 * TranslateGate tradition: the plan is made HERE, as data, and
 * every outcome is a state the UI must speak. There is no outcome
 * named "nothing", and no outcome fakes an organ Sandy doesn't
 * have.
 *
 * James's pipeline, as ordered:
 *   SUBTITLE FIRST. A subtitle track the video already carries —
 *   in ANY known language — is harvested and moved by the
 *   translation matrix directly between written languages. For
 *   voice: translate FIRST into the language the viewer wants to
 *   hear, THEN read that text aloud (translate-then-speak).
 *   THE EAR IS THE FALLBACK. Only a video with no usable subtitle
 *   track is listened to (ASR), through the engine pack.
 *   CASTING. With the voice (diarization) pack in, the audio
 *   witnesses who speaks each line and the VoiceBook casts them —
 *   a saved voice per character, per show, per season. Without
 *   it, subtitle files that NAME their speakers (ASS/VTT) still
 *   cast by name; anything else is honestly one voice.
 *
 * The matrix routes ONE hop, directly: subtitle language -> the
 * viewer's language, through an installed pack pair. Pivot chains
 * (ja->en->es through two MT hops) compound two models' errors
 * into lines nobody checked; the gate answers NEEDS_MT instead and
 * names the pair that would serve.
 */
public final class DubGate {

    public enum Route { PASSTHROUGH, DIRECT, NONE }

    /** One-hop matrix routing over the installed pack pairs. */
    public static Route route(String srcLang, String dstLang, Set<String> pairs) {
        if (srcLang == null || dstLang == null
                || srcLang.isEmpty() || dstLang.isEmpty()) return Route.NONE;
        if (srcLang.equals(dstLang)) return Route.PASSTHROUGH;
        if (pairs != null && pairs.contains(srcLang + "-" + dstLang)) return Route.DIRECT;
        return Route.NONE;
    }

    public enum Plan {
        /** Subtitles + voice pack: full cast dub from text. */
        SUB_CAST,
        /** Subtitles name their speakers; cast by name, no pack. */
        SUB_NAMED,
        /** Subtitles, no names, no pack: one voice reads the text. */
        SUB_SOLO,
        /** No subtitles: the engine listens, the pack casts. */
        ASR_CAST,
        /** No subtitles: the engine listens; one voice. */
        ASR_SOLO,
        /** A subtitle file was found but its language is not named
         *  and not pinned by the viewer yet — ask, don't guess. */
        SUB_LANG_UNKNOWN,
        /** The needed translation pair is not installed; the plan
         *  names it (detail = "ja-es"). */
        NEEDS_MT,
        /** No subtitles and no listening engine for this file. */
        NEEDS_ENGINE
    }

    public static final class Decision {
        public final Plan plan;
        /** For NEEDS_MT: the missing pair, "src-dst". */
        public final String detail;
        Decision(Plan p, String d) { plan = p; detail = d; }
        public boolean cooks() {
            return plan == Plan.SUB_CAST || plan == Plan.SUB_NAMED
                    || plan == Plan.SUB_SOLO || plan == Plan.ASR_CAST
                    || plan == Plan.ASR_SOLO;
        }
        public boolean cast() {
            return plan == Plan.SUB_CAST || plan == Plan.SUB_NAMED
                    || plan == Plan.ASR_CAST;
        }
        public boolean fromSubs() {
            return plan == Plan.SUB_CAST || plan == Plan.SUB_NAMED
                    || plan == Plan.SUB_SOLO;
        }
    }

    private DubGate() {}

    /**
     * @param subLang     the harvested track's language; null = no
     *                    usable subtitle track; "" = a track exists
     *                    but its language is unnamed/unpinned
     * @param subNamed    the track names its speakers (ASS/VTT)
     * @param targetLang  the language the viewer wants to hear
     * @param pairs       installed MT pack pairs ("ja-en")
     * @param diarPack    the voice (diarization) pack is installed
     * @param asrPair     the installed ASR engine's pair ("ja-en"),
     *                    or null when no engine can listen
     */
    public static Decision decide(String subLang, boolean subNamed,
                                  String targetLang, Set<String> pairs,
                                  boolean diarPack, String asrPair) {
        if (subLang != null) {
            if (subLang.isEmpty()) {
                return new Decision(Plan.SUB_LANG_UNKNOWN, "");
            }
            Route r = route(subLang, targetLang, pairs);
            if (r == Route.NONE) {
                return new Decision(Plan.NEEDS_MT, subLang + "-" + targetLang);
            }
            if (diarPack) return new Decision(Plan.SUB_CAST, "");
            if (subNamed) return new Decision(Plan.SUB_NAMED, "");
            return new Decision(Plan.SUB_SOLO, "");
        }
        // the ear road
        if (asrPair == null || asrPair.isEmpty()) {
            return new Decision(Plan.NEEDS_ENGINE, "");
        }
        String[] p = asrPair.split("-");
        String asrTarget = p.length == 2 ? p[1] : "";
        if (!asrTarget.equals(targetLang)) {
            // the listener cooks into its own pair's target; serving
            // another hearing language needs that pair's pack
            if (route(asrTarget, targetLang, pairs) != Route.DIRECT) {
                return new Decision(Plan.NEEDS_MT, asrTarget + "-" + targetLang);
            }
            // a direct pack onward exists — the ASR road still cooks
            // (its lines ride the second hop as text; the plan is
            // ASR + a matrix hop, casting unchanged)
        }
        if (diarPack) return new Decision(Plan.ASR_CAST, "");
        return new Decision(Plan.ASR_SOLO, "");
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DubPickSources.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.ContentUris;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.provider.OpenableColumns;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The dub kitchen's pick shelf (v0.12.0): the same three doors My
 * Videos merges (Downloads folders, the phone's video index, My
 * Library's picked folders), through LocalFiles' own merge — the
 * dub picks from exactly the shelf the viewer already knows.
 * (FilesActivity keeps its private copies; this seam exists so the
 * two screens can never drift on what "an episode Sandy has"
 * means: same queries, same merge.)
 */
public final class DubPickSources {

    private DubPickSources() {}

    public static List<LocalFiles.Row> merged(Context ctx) {
        List<LocalFiles.Row> downloads = queryDownloads();
        List<LocalFiles.Row> device = hasVideoPermission(ctx)
                ? queryDeviceVideos(ctx) : new ArrayList<>();
        List<LocalFiles.Row> folder = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : LibraryStore.loadEntries(ctx)) {
                if (e.uri == null || e.uri.isEmpty()) continue;
                LocalFiles.Row r = new LocalFiles.Row();
                r.uri = e.uri;
                r.title = e.fileName == null || e.fileName.isEmpty()
                        ? e.displayName : e.fileName;
                r.origin = e.uri.startsWith("content://")
                        ? LocalFiles.Origin.FOLDER : LocalFiles.Origin.DEVICE;
                folder.add(r);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return LocalFiles.mergeShelves(downloads, device, folder);
    }

    private static String videoPermission() {
        return Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                ? android.Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
                : android.Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE;
    }

    private static boolean hasVideoPermission(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.checkSelfPermission(videoPermission())
                == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    private static List<LocalFiles.Row> queryDeviceVideos(Context ctx) {
        List<LocalFiles.Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        Uri collection = MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
        String[] proj = {
                MediaStore.Video.Media._ID,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.DURATION,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.SIZE,
        };
        try (Cursor cur = ctx.getContentResolver().query(collection, proj, null, null,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_ADDED + " DESC")) {
            if (cur == null) return out;
            int idCol = cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media._ID);
            int nameCol = cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME);
            int durCol = cur.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Video.Media.DURATION);
            int sizeCol = cur.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Video.Media.SIZE);
            while (cur.moveToNext()) {
                String name = cur.getString(nameCol);
                if (name == null || !LibraryIndex.isVideoFile(name)) continue;
                LocalFiles.Row r = new LocalFiles.Row();
                r.uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, cur.getLong(idCol)).toString();
                r.title = name;
                r.durationMs = durCol >= 0 ? cur.getLong(durCol) : -1;
                r.sizeBytes = sizeCol >= 0 ? cur.getLong(sizeCol) : -1;
                r.origin = LocalFiles.Origin.DEVICE;
                out.add(r);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    private static List<LocalFiles.Row> queryDownloads() {
        List<LocalFiles.Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File[] dirs = {
                Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS),
                Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_MOVIES),
        };
        for (File dir : dirs) {
            if (dir == null) continue;
            File[] files = null;
            try { files = dir.listFiles(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            if (files == null) continue;
            for (File f : files) {
                if (f == null || !f.isFile() || !LibraryIndex.isVideoFile(f.getName())) continue;
                LocalFiles.Row r = new LocalFiles.Row();
                r.uri = f.getAbsolutePath();
                r.title = f.getName();
                r.sizeBytes = f.length();
                r.origin = LocalFiles.Origin.DOWNLOADS;
                out.add(r);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** A picked file's display name (for the SAF door). */
    public static String displayName(Context ctx, String uriString) {
        try {
            Uri uri = Uri.parse(uriString);
            try (Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(uri,
                    new String[]{OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME}, null, null, null)) {
                if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                    String n = c.getString(0);
                    if (n != null && !n.isEmpty()) return n;
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        String tail = uriString;
        int slash = tail.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash >= 0) tail = tail.substring(slash + 1);
        return tail;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DubShelf.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The dubbed-episodes shelf (v0.12.0) — the cook's output, kept as
 * a FILE through the memory hook like everything Sandy keeps
 * (file in, file out): files/memory/dubs.tsv, one row per cooked
 * dub, pointing at the dubbed audio + translated subtitle files
 * under filesDir/dubbed/<show>/. A cooked dub is a file in the
 * library, listed here, playable from here, deletable from here.
 *
 * Columns (tab-separated, fields sanitized):
 *   id, cookedAtEpochSec, showKey, showTitle, season, episode,
 *   targetLang, videoUrl, dubPath, srtPath, jsonPath,
 *   lineCount, castCount, nearCount
 */
public final class DubShelf {

    public static final String FILE = "dubs.tsv";

    public static final class Entry {
        public String id = "";
        public long cookedAtSec = 0;
        public String showKey = "";
        public String showTitle = "";
        public int season = 0;
        public int episode = 0;
        public String targetLang = "";
        public String videoUrl = "";
        public String dubPath = "";
        public String srtPath = "";
        public String jsonPath = "";
        public int lineCount = 0;
        public int castCount = 0;
        public int nearCount = 0;

        public String displayName() {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.append(showTitle == null || showTitle.isEmpty() ? showKey : showTitle);
            if (season > 0 && episode > 0) {
                sb.append(String.format(java.util.Locale.US, " S%02dE%02d", season, episode));
            } else if (episode > 0) {
                sb.append(" · ").append(episode);
            }
            if (targetLang != null && !targetLang.isEmpty()) {
                sb.append(" → ").append(targetLang.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.US));
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }

    private DubShelf() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ io

    public static List<Entry> list(Context ctx) {
        return parse(MemoryHook.read(ctx, FILE));
    }

    /** Insert or replace the row with this id. */
    public static void add(Context ctx, Entry e) {
        List<Entry> all = list(ctx);
        boolean replaced = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < all.size(); i++) {
            if (all.get(i).id.equals(e.id)) { all.set(i, e); replaced = true; break; }
        }
        if (!replaced) all.add(e);
        MemoryHook.write(ctx, FILE, toTsv(all));
    }

    public static void remove(Context ctx, String id) {
        List<Entry> all = list(ctx);
        List<Entry> kept = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Entry e : all) if (!e.id.equals(id)) kept.add(e);
        MemoryHook.write(ctx, FILE, toTsv(kept));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ tsv (pure)

    public static List<Entry> parse(String text) {
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) return out;
        for (String row : text.split("\n")) {
            if (row.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
            String[] c = row.split("\t", -1);
            if (c.length < 14) continue;
            Entry e = new Entry();
            e.id = c[0];
            e.cookedAtSec = parseLong(c[1]);
            e.showKey = c[2];
            e.showTitle = c[3];
            e.season = (int) parseLong(c[4]);
            e.episode = (int) parseLong(c[5]);
            e.targetLang = c[6];
            e.videoUrl = c[7];
            e.dubPath = c[8];
            e.srtPath = c[9];
            e.jsonPath = c[10];
            e.lineCount = (int) parseLong(c[11]);
            e.castCount = (int) parseLong(c[12]);
            e.nearCount = (int) parseLong(c[13]);
            out.add(e);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String toTsv(List<Entry> entries) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (Entry e : entries) {
            sb.append(clean(e.id)).append('\t')
              .append(e.cookedAtSec).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.showKey)).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.showTitle)).append('\t')
              .append(e.season).append('\t')
              .append(e.episode).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.targetLang)).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.videoUrl)).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.dubPath)).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.srtPath)).append('\t')
              .append(clean(e.jsonPath)).append('\t')
              .append(e.lineCount).append('\t')
              .append(e.castCount).append('\t')
              .append(e.nearCount).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String clean(String s) {
        return s == null ? "" : s.replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' ')
                .replace('\r', ' ').trim();
    }

    private static long parseLong(String s) {
        try { return Long.parseLong(s.trim()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0; }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/DubTrack.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Prepared-dub naming (v0.4.0), pure so the harness can prove it.
 *
 * The convention: a library video named
 *     Show Name S01E01.mkv
 * can carry a prepared English dub as a sidecar audio file in the
 * same folder, same basename, with one of these suffixes:
 *     Show Name S01E01.dub-en.m4a
 *     Show Name S01E01.dub-en.mp3
 * When such a sidecar is found (lookup lives in DubFinder — MediaStore,
 * SAF trees and plain paths), the player offers "English — prepared
 * dub" in the Subtitles/Audio menu and plays it INSTEAD of the
 * original audio, merged onto the same timeline. DUB LAB (on the build
 * machine) is how a sidecar gets made: transcribe the Japanese, translate,
 * render English speech fitted to the subtitle windows, save the .m4a
 * beside the episode. One at a time, on request.
 */
public final class DubTrack {

    public static final String[] SIDECAR_SUFFIXES = {".dub-en.m4a", ".dub-en.mp3"};

    private DubTrack() {}

    /** "Show S01E01.mkv" -> "Show S01E01". Files without an extension keep their name. */
    public static String stemOf(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null) return "";
        int slash = Math.max(fileName.lastIndexOf('/'), fileName.lastIndexOf('\\'));
        String base = slash >= 0 ? fileName.substring(slash + 1) : fileName;
        int dot = base.lastIndexOf('.');
        return dot > 0 ? base.substring(0, dot) : base;
    }

    /** Candidate sidecar file names for a video file name, in preference order. */
    public static List<String> sidecarNames(String videoFileName) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String stem = stemOf(videoFileName);
        if (stem.isEmpty()) return out;
        for (String suffix : SIDECAR_SUFFIXES) out.add(stem + suffix);
        return out;
    }

    /** True when a file name is itself a prepared-dub sidecar. */
    public static boolean isDubSidecar(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null) return false;
        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        for (String suffix : SIDECAR_SUFFIXES) if (lower.endsWith(suffix)) return true;
        return lower.contains(".dub-") && (lower.endsWith(".m4a") || lower.endsWith(".mp3"));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ v0.6.0: translation

    /**
     * Prepared-dub sidecar names for ANY target language (v0.6.0):
     *     Show S01E01.dub-ja.m4a / .mp3
     * The original convention (English) is {@link #sidecarNames}.
     */
    public static List<String> dubNamesFor(String videoFileName, String lang) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String stem = stemOf(videoFileName);
        if (stem.isEmpty() || lang == null || lang.isEmpty()) return out;
        out.add(stem + ".dub-" + lang + ".m4a");
        out.add(stem + ".dub-" + lang + ".mp3");
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Cooked translated-subtitle sidecar names (v0.6.0):
     *     Show S01E01.tr-en.srt   (the playable track)
     *     Show S01E01.tr-en.json  (the full record: original lines,
     *                              speakers, uncertainty flags)
     */
    public static List<String> trSubNames(String videoFileName, String lang) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String stem = stemOf(videoFileName);
        if (stem.isEmpty() || lang == null || lang.isEmpty()) return out;
        out.add(stem + ".tr-" + lang + ".srt");
        out.add(stem + ".tr-" + lang + ".vtt");
        return out;
    }

    /** The rich-record companion of a cooked subtitle sidecar. */
    public static String trJsonName(String videoFileName, String lang) {
        String stem = stemOf(videoFileName);
        if (stem.isEmpty() || lang == null || lang.isEmpty()) return "";
        return stem + ".tr-" + lang + ".json";
    }

    /** True when a file name is a cooked translation sidecar. */
    public static boolean isTrSidecar(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null) return false;
        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        return lower.contains(".tr-") && (lower.endsWith(".srt")
                || lower.endsWith(".vtt") || lower.endsWith(".json"));
    }

    /** True when a file name is a video we would look for a dub beside. */
    public static boolean isVideoName(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null) return false;
        if (isDubSidecar(fileName)) return false;
        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        return lower.endsWith(".mp4") || lower.endsWith(".mkv") || lower.endsWith(".avi")
                || lower.endsWith(".mov") || lower.endsWith(".webm") || lower.endsWith(".m4v")
                || lower.endsWith(".ts");
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/EarCapture.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.speech.RecognitionListener;
import android.speech.RecognizerIntent;
import android.speech.SpeechRecognizer;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * The ear organ for the Two Doors (v0.15.0) — a thin honest body
 * around the phone's speech-recognition service
 * (android.speech.SpeechRecognizer). Shared by Listen For Me and
 * the Translator so both hear through the same organ and report
 * the same states.
 *
 * What this organ IS, said plainly (and again in the NOTES): the
 * device's recognition SERVICE — on most phones a system service
 * that may send the audio over the network to do its work; that
 * is the service's reality, not Sandy's choice, and it is never
 * hidden. Which languages it carries is likewise the service's
 * truth, learned per session: presence is probed here, support
 * is what the session reports, mapped to ListenRecord.State by
 * the pure mapping (unsure is shown as unsure).
 *
 * Live partial results stream to the listener as they arrive —
 * that stream is Listen's "big immediate text". Sandy's own
 * on-device whisper exists only inside installed engine packs
 * and is NOT this organ; it serves the RECORD road in Listen
 * (ListenStore.transcribeWithWhisper), for the pack pair's
 * source language only.
 *
 * Main-thread confined.
 */
public final class EarCapture {

    public interface Listener {
        /** Live words, still forming. */
        void onPartial(String text);
        /** The take ended: final words ("" when none) + state. */
        void onFinal(String text, ListenRecord.State state);
        /** The ear opened and is hearing. */
        void onListening();
    }

    private final Context ctx;
    private SpeechRecognizer rec;
    private Listener listener;
    private boolean active = false;

    public EarCapture(Context ctx) {
        this.ctx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public void setListener(Listener l) { this.listener = l; }

    /** Does this phone have a recognition service at all? */
    public static boolean present(Context ctx) {
        try {
            return SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable(ctx);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean isActive() { return active; }

    /**
     * Open the ear for one take in the given language (ISO-1).
     * False = no recognizer on this phone; the caller shows
     * NO_RECOGNIZER and never pretends to listen.
     */
    public boolean start(String iso1) {
        if (!present(ctx)) return false;
        stop();
        try {
            rec = SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer(ctx);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
        final String lang = iso1 == null || iso1.isEmpty() ? "en" : iso1;
        rec.setRecognitionListener(new RecognitionListener() {
            @Override public void onReadyForSpeech(Bundle b) {
                if (listener != null) listener.onListening();
            }
            @Override public void onBeginningOfSpeech() {}
            @Override public void onRmsChanged(float f) {}
            @Override public void onBufferReceived(byte[] b) {}
            @Override public void onEndOfSpeech() {}
            @Override public void onError(int error) {
                active = false;
                if (listener != null) {
                    listener.onFinal("", ListenRecord.stateForError(error));
                }
            }
            @Override public void onResults(Bundle b) {
                active = false;
                String text = best(b);
                if (listener != null) {
                    listener.onFinal(text, text.isEmpty()
                            ? ListenRecord.State.UNSURE
                            : ListenRecord.State.HEARD);
                }
            }
            @Override public void onPartialResults(Bundle b) {
                String text = best(b);
                if (listener != null && !text.isEmpty()) {
                    listener.onPartial(text);
                }
            }
            @Override public void onEvent(int i, Bundle b) {}
        });
        Intent intent = new Intent(RecognizerIntent.ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH);
        intent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE_MODEL,
                RecognizerIntent.LANGUAGE_MODEL_FREE_FORM);
        intent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE,
                Locale.forLanguageTag(lang).toLanguageTag());
        intent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PARTIAL_RESULTS, true);
        intent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_MAX_RESULTS, 1);
        try {
            active = true;
            rec.startListening(intent);
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            active = false;
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static String best(Bundle b) {
        if (b == null) return "";
        ArrayList<String> all =
                b.getStringArrayList(SpeechRecognizer.RESULTS_RECOGNITION);
        if (all == null || all.isEmpty() || all.get(0) == null) return "";
        return all.get(0).trim();
    }

    public void stop() {
        if (rec != null) {
            try { rec.stopListening(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            try { rec.destroy(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            rec = null;
        }
        active = false;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/EnginePack.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

/**
 * The engine-pack slot (v0.6.0) — the translation layer's delivery
 * form, per the in-vs-shelf ruling: the recognizer and translation
 * models are NOT baked into the APK (the app stays light). They ride
 * the Drive shelf as one pack file and install through this gate.
 *
 * A pack is a ZIP with one manifest, pack.txt, at its root:
 *
 *   # comments start with #
 *   sandy.enginepack=1
 *   pair=ja-en
 *   version=1
 *   asr.kind=whisper-base
 *   asr.format=ctranslate2-int8
 *   mt.kind=opus-mt
 *   mt.format=ctranslate2-int8
 *   file <path-in-pack> <size-bytes> <sha256-hex>
 *   file ... (one line for EVERY payload file)
 *
 * Validation is fail-closed, the same law as the language packs,
 * plus integrity: the header must be right, the pair sane, both an
 * ASR model and an MT model must be listed, EVERY payload file in
 * the ZIP must be listed, and every listed file must be present with
 * exactly its recorded size and SHA-256. One mismatch and nothing
 * installs — the refusal names what failed. Extraction happens in
 * the same streaming pass (a 200+ MB pack is never held in memory),
 * and a failed validation deletes whatever partial extraction it
 * made. Entry names must match the manifest exactly, so a crafted
 * path can never write outside the pack's folder.
 *
 * Pure java.io/java.util.zip — runs identically on the phone and in
 * the JVM harness, which validates the REAL shipped pack file.
 */
public final class EnginePack {

    public static final String MANIFEST = "pack.txt";

    public static final class Result {
        public boolean ok = false;
        public String pair = "";
        public int version = 0;
        public String asrKind = "", asrFormat = "";
        public String mtKind = "", mtFormat = "";
        public long totalBytes = 0;
        public final List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        public final Map<String, long[]> files = new LinkedHashMap<>(); // path -> {size, }
    }

    private EnginePack() {}

    private static final class Listed {
        long size; String sha;
    }

    /**
     * Validate the pack on {@code in}; when {@code destDir} is
     * non-null, also extract into it (only files the manifest lists,
     * under their listed names). On any failure with a destDir, the
     * partial extraction is removed — fail-closed means fail-clean.
     */
    public static Result validateAndExtract(InputStream in, File destDir) {
        Result r = new Result();
        Map<String, Listed> listed = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, Boolean> seen = new HashMap<>();
        boolean manifestSeen = false;
        try {
            MessageDigest sha = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            ZipInputStream zin = new ZipInputStream(in);
            // Pass structure: the manifest must come first in the ZIP
            // (the pack builder writes it first; stated in the NOTES)
            // so extraction decisions are known before payload lands.
            List<File> written = new ArrayList<>();
            ZipEntry e;
            boolean first = true;
            while ((e = zin.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                String name = e.getName();
                if (e.isDirectory()) continue;
                if (first && !MANIFEST.equals(name)) {
                    r.errors.add("the first file in the pack must be "
                            + MANIFEST + " (the manifest), found: " + name);
                    break;
                }
                first = false;
                if (MANIFEST.equals(name)) {
                    manifestSeen = true;
                    byte[] text = readEntry(zin);
                    parseManifest(new String(text, "UTF-8"), r, listed);
                    if (!r.errors.isEmpty()) break;
                    continue;
                }
                Listed lf = listed.get(name);
                if (lf == null) {
                    r.errors.add("the pack carries a file its manifest "
                            + "does not list: " + name);
                    break;
                }
                seen.put(name, Boolean.TRUE);
                sha.reset();
                long size = 0;
                File out = null;
                FileOutputStream fos = null;
                if (destDir != null) {
                    out = new File(destDir, name);
                    if (!out.getCanonicalPath().startsWith(
                            destDir.getCanonicalPath() + File.separator)) {
                        r.errors.add("a listed path escapes the pack "
                                + "folder: " + name);
                        break;
                    }
                    if (out.getParentFile() != null) out.getParentFile().mkdirs();
                    fos = new FileOutputStream(out);
                    written.add(out);
                }
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = zin.read(buf)) > 0) {
                    sha.update(buf, 0, n);
                    size += n;
                    if (fos != null) fos.write(buf, 0, n);
                }
                if (fos != null) fos.close();
                if (size != lf.size) {
                    r.errors.add(name + ": size is " + size
                            + " but the manifest says " + lf.size);
                    break;
                }
                String digest = hex(sha.digest());
                if (!digest.equalsIgnoreCase(lf.sha)) {
                    r.errors.add(name + ": its SHA-256 does not match "
                            + "the manifest — the file is not what the "
                            + "pack says it is");
                    break;
                }
                r.totalBytes += size;
            }
            zin.close();
            if (r.errors.isEmpty()) {
                if (!manifestSeen) {
                    r.errors.add("the pack has no " + MANIFEST + " manifest.");
                } else {
                    for (String path : listed.keySet()) {
                        if (!seen.containsKey(path)) {
                            r.errors.add("the manifest lists " + path
                                    + " but the pack does not carry it");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!r.errors.isEmpty() && destDir != null) {
                for (File f : written) f.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            r.errors.add("the pack could not be read (" + ex.getMessage() + ")");
        }
        r.ok = r.errors.isEmpty();
        return r;
    }

    private static void parseManifest(String text, Result r, Map<String, Listed> listed) {
        Map<String, String> kv = new HashMap<>();
        List<String> fileLines = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String raw : text.split("\\R")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
            if (line.startsWith("file ")) { fileLines.add(line); continue; }
            int eq = line.indexOf('=');
            if (eq > 0) kv.put(line.substring(0, eq).trim(), line.substring(eq + 1).trim());
        }
        if (!"1".equals(kv.get("sandy.enginepack"))) {
            r.errors.add("not a Sandy engine pack (missing the "
                    + "sandy.enginepack=1 header)");
            return;
        }
        String pair = kv.getOrDefault("pair", "");
        if (!pair.matches("[a-z]{2,3}-[a-z]{2,3}")) {
            r.errors.add("the pack's language pair (\"pair=\") is missing "
                    + "or not a pair like ja-en");
            return;
        }
        r.pair = pair;
        try {
            r.version = Integer.parseInt(kv.getOrDefault("version", "0"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            r.version = 0;
        }
        if (r.version < 1) {
            r.errors.add("the pack's version is missing or not a number");
            return;
        }
        r.asrKind = kv.getOrDefault("asr.kind", "");
        r.asrFormat = kv.getOrDefault("asr.format", "");
        r.mtKind = kv.getOrDefault("mt.kind", "");
        r.mtFormat = kv.getOrDefault("mt.format", "");
        if (r.asrKind.isEmpty() || r.mtKind.isEmpty()) {
            r.errors.add("the pack must name both its recognizer "
                    + "(asr.kind) and its translator (mt.kind)");
            return;
        }
        boolean anyAsr = false, anyMt = false;
        for (String line : fileLines) {
            String[] p = line.split("\\s+");
            if (p.length != 4) {
                r.errors.add("a manifest file line is malformed: " + line);
                return;
            }
            Listed lf = new Listed();
            try {
                lf.size = Long.parseLong(p[2]);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                r.errors.add("a manifest file line has a bad size: " + line);
                return;
            }
            lf.sha = p[3];
            if (!lf.sha.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}") || lf.size < 0) {
                r.errors.add("a manifest file line has a bad SHA-256 "
                        + "or size: " + line);
                return;
            }
            listed.put(p[1], lf);
            r.files.put(p[1], new long[]{lf.size});
            if (p[1].startsWith("asr/")) anyAsr = true;
            if (p[1].startsWith("mt/")) anyMt = true;
        }
        if (listed.isEmpty()) {
            r.errors.add("the manifest lists no files at all");
        } else if (!anyAsr) {
            r.errors.add("the manifest lists no recognizer files (asr/…) "
                    + "— a translation pack needs both halves");
        } else if (!anyMt) {
            r.errors.add("the manifest lists no translator files (mt/…) "
                    + "— a translation pack needs both halves");
        }
    }

    private static byte[] readEntry(ZipInputStream zin) throws Exception {
        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int n;
        while ((n = zin.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
        return bos.toByteArray();
    }

    private static String hex(byte[] bytes) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : bytes) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/EnginePackStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;

/**
 * Where an installed engine pack lives (v0.6.0):
 *   filesDir/engine/<pair>/asr/…, mt/…   the model files
 *   filesDir/engine/<pair>.json         the install record
 *
 * Install is one streaming pass through EnginePack's fail-closed
 * validation into a staging folder; only a fully valid pack is
 * promoted to its pair folder. A refused pack leaves nothing behind.
 */
public final class EnginePackStore {

    public static final class Status {
        public boolean installed = false;
        public String pair = "";
        public int version = 0;
        public String asrKind = "", mtKind = "";
        /** v0.6.1: the pack formats (e.g. onnx-int8), so the player
         *  can tell a runnable ONNX pack from a CT2 pack it cannot
         *  bind. Records written by 0.6.0 lack these and read "". */
        public String asrFormat = "", mtFormat = "";
        public long totalBytes = 0;
        public File dir = null;
        /** True when this pack is one the ONNX engine can bind. */
        public boolean onnx() {
            return installed && asrFormat.startsWith("onnx")
                    && mtFormat.startsWith("onnx");
        }
    }

    private EnginePackStore() {}

    private static File engineRoot(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "engine");
    }

    /** The installed pack for a pair like "ja-en", or not-installed. */
    public static Status status(Context ctx, String pair) {
        Status s = new Status();
        if (pair == null) return s;
        File rec = new File(engineRoot(ctx), pair + ".json");
        if (!rec.isFile()) return s;
        try {
            String text = new String(readAll(rec), "UTF-8");
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject(text);
            s.pair = o.optString("pair", pair);
            s.version = o.optInt("version", 0);
            s.asrKind = o.optString("asrKind", "");
            s.mtKind = o.optString("mtKind", "");
            s.asrFormat = o.optString("asrFormat", "");
            s.mtFormat = o.optString("mtFormat", "");
            s.totalBytes = o.optLong("totalBytes", 0);
            s.dir = new File(engineRoot(ctx), pair);
            s.installed = s.dir.isDirectory()
                    && new File(s.dir, "asr").isDirectory()
                    && new File(s.dir, "mt").isDirectory();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            s.installed = false;
        }
        return s;
    }

    /** Any installed pair at all (the player asks this, pair-agnostic). */
    public static Status anyInstalled(Context ctx) {
        File root = engineRoot(ctx);
        File[] recs = root.listFiles((d, n) -> n.endsWith(".json"));
        if (recs != null) {
            for (File rec : recs) {
                String pair = rec.getName().replace(".json", "");
                Status s = status(ctx, pair);
                if (s.installed) return s;
            }
        }
        return new Status();
    }

    public interface Callback {
        void onResult(EnginePack.Result result);
    }

    /** Validate + install from a picked file, on a worker thread. */
    public static void install(Context ctx, Uri uri, Callback cb) {
        new Thread(() -> {
            EnginePack.Result r;
            File staging = new File(engineRoot(ctx), "_incoming");
            try {
                deleteTree(staging);
                staging.mkdirs();
                InputStream in = ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                r = EnginePack.validateAndExtract(in, staging);
                if (in != null) in.close();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                r = new EnginePack.Result();
                r.errors.add("the pack could not be opened (" + e.getMessage() + ")");
            }
            if (r.ok) {
                try {
                    File root = engineRoot(ctx);
                    File dest = new File(root, r.pair);
                    deleteTree(dest);
                    if (!staging.renameTo(dest)) {
