                        r.errors.add("the pack validated but could not be "
                                + "moved into place");
                        r.ok = false;
                    } else {
                        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                        o.put("pair", r.pair);
                        o.put("version", r.version);
                        o.put("asrKind", r.asrKind);
                        o.put("mtKind", r.mtKind);
                        o.put("asrFormat", r.asrFormat);
                        o.put("mtFormat", r.mtFormat);
                        o.put("totalBytes", r.totalBytes);
                        java.io.FileOutputStream fos = new java.io.FileOutputStream(
                                new File(root, r.pair + ".json"));
                        fos.write(o.toString().getBytes("UTF-8"));
                        fos.close();
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    r.errors.add("the pack validated but its install record "
                            + "could not be written (" + e.getMessage() + ")");
                    r.ok = false;
                }
            }
            if (!r.ok) deleteTree(staging);
            EnginePack.Result done = r;
            new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
                    .post(() -> cb.onResult(done));
        }, "engine-pack-install").start();
    }

    static byte[] readAll(File f) throws Exception {
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
            return bos.toByteArray();
        }
    }

    static void deleteTree(File f) {
        if (f == null || !f.exists()) return;
        if (f.isDirectory()) {
            File[] kids = f.listFiles();
            if (kids != null) for (File k : kids) deleteTree(k);
        }
        f.delete();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/EpisodeKey.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Parses season/episode markers and quality labels out of the free-form
 * names found in playlists (and archive file names). This is a matching
 * technique, not a source of truth: when nothing parses, the answer is
 * null / "unknown quality" — never a guess dressed up as a fact.
 */
public final class EpisodeKey {

    public final int season;   // 0 = no season stated, or an explicit S00 (specials)
    public final int episode;
    /**
     * True when the marker actually named a season (SxxExx, "Season N
     * Episode M", NxNN). False for episode-only word markers ("Episode
     * 7"), whose season is unstated. An explicit "S00E01" has
     * seasonKnown=true with season 0 — it is a specials numbering, NOT
     * season 1, and matchers must not promote it.
     */
    public final boolean seasonKnown;

    public EpisodeKey(int season, int episode) {
        this(season, episode, true);
    }

    public EpisodeKey(int season, int episode, boolean seasonKnown) {
        this.season = season;
        this.episode = episode;
        this.seasonKnown = seasonKnown;
    }

    // Boundaries are "not preceded by a letter/digit" + "not followed by
    // a digit" rather than \b: real file names glue markers with
    // underscores ("Bonanza_s01e01_-_..."), and \b does not exist next to
    // '_' (a word character), which silently un-parsed exactly the
    // underscore-heavy names the Internet Archive and phones produce.
    private static final Pattern P_SE =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)(?<![A-Za-z0-9])S[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,2})[\\s._\\-]*E[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,3})(?![0-9])");
    private static final Pattern P_SEASON_EP =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)(?<![A-Za-z0-9])season[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,2})\\b[^A-Za-z0-9]{0,12}?episode[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,3})(?![0-9])");
    private static final Pattern P_X =
            Pattern.compile("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(\\d{1,2})x(\\d{1,3})(?![0-9])");
    private static final Pattern P_EP_WORD =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)(?<![A-Za-z0-9])episode[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,3})(?![0-9])");
    private static final Pattern P_EP_SHORT =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)(?<![A-Za-z0-9])ep\\.?[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,3})(?![0-9])");

    /** First marker found wins, in SxxExx > "Season N Episode M" > NxNN > "Episode N" > "Ep. N" order. */
    public static EpisodeKey parse(String name) {
        int[] s = parseSpan(name);
        return s == null ? null : new EpisodeKey(s[0], s[1], s[4] == 1);
    }

    /**
     * Like parse(), but also reports where the marker sits:
     * {season, episode, startIndex, endIndex, seasonKnown?1:0} of the
     * matched marker in the input, or null when no marker is present.
     * Library file-name parsing splits show name / episode title around
     * the marker.
     */
    public static int[] parseSpan(String name) {
        if (name == null) return null;
        Matcher m = P_SE.matcher(name);
        if (m.find()) return span(m, false);
        m = P_SEASON_EP.matcher(name);
        if (m.find()) return span(m, false);
        m = P_X.matcher(name);
        if (m.find()) return span(m, false);
        m = P_EP_WORD.matcher(name);
        if (m.find()) return span(m, true);
        m = P_EP_SHORT.matcher(name);
        if (m.find()) return span(m, true);
        return null;
    }

    private static int[] span(Matcher m, boolean episodeOnly) {
        if (episodeOnly) {
            return new int[]{0, num(m.group(1)), m.start(), m.end(), 0};
        }
        return new int[]{num(m.group(1)), num(m.group(2)), m.start(), m.end(), 1};
    }

    /** True when this key can stand for (season, number) in a matcher:
     *  exact season, or an episode-only marker (season unstated) when the
     *  wanted season is 1. An explicit S00 never stands for season 1. */
    public boolean matches(int wantSeason, int wantEpisode) {
        if (episode != wantEpisode) return false;
        if (season == wantSeason) return true;
        return !seasonKnown && wantSeason == 1;
    }

    private static int num(String s) {
        try { return Integer.parseInt(s); } catch (Exception e) { return 0; }
    }

    /** Title comparison form: lowercase, punctuation -> space, collapsed. */
    public static String normalize(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        String lower = s.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(lower.length());
        boolean lastSpace = true; // also trims leading space
        for (int i = 0; i < lower.length(); i++) {
            char c = lower.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) {
                b.append(c);
                lastSpace = false;
            } else if (!lastSpace) {
                b.append(' ');
                lastSpace = true;
            }
        }
        int len = b.length();
        if (len > 0 && b.charAt(len - 1) == ' ') b.setLength(len - 1);
        return b.toString();
    }

    /** Whole-phrase containment on normalized text (space-padded both sides). */
    public static boolean containsPhrase(String haystackNorm, String needleNorm) {
        if (needleNorm.isEmpty() || haystackNorm.isEmpty()) return false;
        return (" " + haystackNorm + " ").contains(" " + needleNorm + " ");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- quality

    /**
     * Quality parsed from name/URL tokens only. Explicit numbers beat
     * letters; a CAM tag poisons the entry to the bottom tier no matter
     * what else it claims; nothing found = "unknown quality" (tier 0),
     * ranked with the bottom, above only CAM.
     */
    public static int qualityTier(String text) {
        return quality(text)[0];
    }

    public static String qualityLabel(String text) {
        int tier = quality(text)[0];
        switch (tier) {
            case 6: return "2160p";
            case 5: return "1080p";
            case 4: return "720p";
            case 3: return "HD";
            case 2: return "480p";
            case 1: return "SD";
            case -1: return "CAM";
            default: return "unknown quality";
        }
    }

    private static int[] quality(String text) {
        if (text == null) return new int[]{0};
        String t = " " + text.toUpperCase(Locale.US) + " ";
        // CAM-family tags poison the entry to the bottom, whatever else it
        // claims. A bare ".ts" is NOT read as telesync — it is a common
        // container suffix on legitimate streams.
        if (hasToken(t, "CAM") || t.contains("HDCAM") || t.contains("HDTS")
                || t.contains("TELESYNC")) {
            return new int[]{-1};
        }
        if (t.contains("2160") || hasToken(t, "4K") || hasToken(t, "UHD")) return new int[]{6};
        if (t.contains("1080")) return new int[]{5};
        if (t.contains("720")) return new int[]{4};
        if (hasToken(t, "HD") || hasToken(t, "HDTV")) return new int[]{3};
        if (t.contains("480")) return new int[]{2};
        if (hasToken(t, "SD")) return new int[]{1};
        return new int[]{0};
    }

    /** True if the (space-padded, uppercase) text contains the token as a word. */
    private static boolean hasToken(String paddedUpper, String token) {
        String[] parts = paddedUpper.split("[^A-Z0-9]+");
        for (String p : parts) {
            if (p.equals(token)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/EpisodeMatch.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Episode identity in the wild (v0.14.0 Addenda 9–11). The catalogue
 * knows the TRUE identity of an episode (season, number, title,
 * airdate, runtime from guide data); files on sources name
 * themselves chaotically. This is the tolerant matcher that weighs
 * the evidence instead of trusting the name:
 *
 *   - numbering schemes, parsed by {@link EpisodeKey} (S01E03,
 *     1x03, "Season 1 Episode 3", ep.7) plus the two it doesn't
 *     carry: AIRDATES (2024-03-05 / 05.03.2024) and the bare
 *     trailing number ("Dragnet 12");
 *   - title evidence: the episode's own title words found in the
 *     file name, after the show's name and the scheme tokens are
 *     taken out;
 *   - duration corroboration where a duration is actually known
 *     (a size in bytes is NOT a duration and is never used as one);
 *   - conflicts VETO: a name whose numbers clearly say a DIFFERENT
 *     episode is evidence AGAINST, weighted heavier than silence.
 *
 * The verdict is a TIER, never a silent rounding-up (the Lying
 * Tile family): RESOLVED (best choices — identity settled),
 * MOSTLY (middle ground — strong evidence, minor doubt), CLOSE
 * (the maybe pen — shown for the viewer's own eyes, NEVER
 * auto-played, NEVER counted as playable), UNMATCHED (with the
 * reason reachable). A wrong episode silently played under the
 * right title is a lie of the same species as a dead link under
 * a pretty card, so a candidate only BINDS to an episode through
 * matchAll — one candidate per episode, one episode per
 * candidate, best evidence first — and CLOSE never binds at all.
 */
public final class EpisodeMatch {

    private EpisodeMatch() {}

    public static final int TIER_RESOLVED = 0;
    public static final int TIER_MOSTLY = 1;
    public static final int TIER_CLOSE = 2;
    public static final int TIER_UNMATCHED = 3;

    /** UiStrings key naming a tier in the house voice. */
    public static String tierKey(int tier) {
        switch (tier) {
            case TIER_RESOLVED: return "tier_best";
            case TIER_MOSTLY: return "tier_middle";
            case TIER_CLOSE: return "tier_maybe";
            default: return "tier_maybe";
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- model

    /** The catalogue's truth about one episode. */
    public static final class EpisodeRef {
        public final int season, number;
        public final String name;        // may be ""
        public final String airdate;     // "YYYY-MM-DD" or ""
        public final int runtimeSec;     // 0 = unknown

        public EpisodeRef(int season, int number, String name,
                          String airdate, int runtimeSec) {
            this.season = season; this.number = number;
            this.name = name == null ? "" : name;
            this.airdate = airdate == null ? "" : airdate;
            this.runtimeSec = runtimeSec;
        }
    }

    /** One candidate file/item found out in the wild. */
    public static final class Candidate {
        public final String label;       // file name / item title
        public final int durationSec;    // 0 = unknown (sizes don't count)
        public boolean verified;         // link proven live (Hydra/health)

        public Candidate(String label, int durationSec) {
            this.label = label == null ? "" : label;
            this.durationSec = durationSec;
        }
    }

    /** What a wild name actually says, once parsed. */
    public static final class Parsed {
        public int season = -1;          // -1 = not stated
        public int episode = -1;
        public String airdate = "";      // "YYYY-MM-DD" or ""
        public int bareNumber = -1;      // trailing bare number, if any
        public String titleWords = "";   // normalized residue (title hunt)
    }

    private static final Pattern P_DATE_ISO = Pattern.compile(
            "(?<!\\d)((?:19|20)\\d{2})[-._](\\d{1,2})[-._](\\d{1,2})(?!\\d)");
    private static final Pattern P_DATE_DMY = Pattern.compile(
            "(?<!\\d)(\\d{1,2})[-._](\\d{1,2})[-._]((?:19|20)\\d{2})(?!\\d)");
    private static final Pattern P_BARE = Pattern.compile(
            "(?:^|[\\s._\\-])(\\d{1,3})(?:\\s*(?:of\\s*\\d{1,3})?)?"
                    + "(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]{2,4})?\\s*$");

    public static Parsed parse(String name, String showName) {
        Parsed p = new Parsed();
        if (name == null) return p;
        EpisodeKey k = EpisodeKey.parse(name);
        if (k != null) {
            // seasonKnown=false (episode-only markers) = unstated;
            // an explicit S00 is a stated season (specials).
            p.season = k.seasonKnown ? k.season : -1;
            p.episode = k.episode;
        }
        Matcher iso = P_DATE_ISO.matcher(name);
        if (iso.find()) {
            p.airdate = String.format("%04d-%02d-%02d",
                    Integer.parseInt(iso.group(1)),
                    Integer.parseInt(iso.group(2)),
                    Integer.parseInt(iso.group(3)));
        } else {
            Matcher dmy = P_DATE_DMY.matcher(name);
            if (dmy.find()) {
                p.airdate = String.format("%04d-%02d-%02d",
                        Integer.parseInt(dmy.group(3)),
                        Integer.parseInt(dmy.group(2)),
                        Integer.parseInt(dmy.group(1)));
            }
        }
        if (p.episode < 0 && p.airdate.isEmpty()) {
            // (an airdate already explains the trailing digits —
            // the day of a date is not a bare episode number)
            Matcher b = P_BARE.matcher(name.trim());
            if (b.find()) p.bareNumber = Integer.parseInt(b.group(1));
        }
        // residue for the title hunt: drop the scheme span, the
        // airdate, the show's own words — what remains should be
        // the episode's title if the name carries one.
        String residue = name;
        int[] span = EpisodeKey.parseSpan(name);
        if (span != null) {
            // parseSpan: {season, episode, startIdx, endIdx, seasonKnown}
            residue = residue.substring(0, span[2])
                    + " " + residue.substring(span[3]);
        }
        residue = P_DATE_ISO.matcher(residue).replaceAll(" ");
        residue = P_DATE_DMY.matcher(residue).replaceAll(" ");
        String norm = EpisodeKey.normalize(residue);
        String showNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(showName);
        if (!showNorm.isEmpty()) {
            Set<String> showWords = wordSet(showNorm);
            StringBuilder keep = new StringBuilder();
            for (String w : norm.split(" ")) {
                if (w.isEmpty() || showWords.contains(w)) continue;
                if (keep.length() > 0) keep.append(' ');
                keep.append(w);
            }
            norm = keep.toString();
        }
        p.titleWords = norm;
        return p;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- score

    public static final class Scored {
        public int score;
        public boolean conflict;         // the name argues AGAINST
        public String reason = "";       // plain words, reachable
    }

    /** Weigh one candidate against one episode. */
    public static Scored score(Parsed p, EpisodeRef ep) {
        Scored s = new Scored();
        StringBuilder why = new StringBuilder();
        // numbering
        if (p.episode > 0) {
            boolean seasonOk = p.season < 0 || p.season == ep.season;
            if (p.episode == ep.number && seasonOk) {
                s.score += 50;
                why.append("numbers match");
            } else if (p.season >= 0 && p.season != ep.season) {
                s.score -= 60; s.conflict = true;
                why.append("numbers say season ").append(p.season);
            } else {
                s.score -= 60; s.conflict = true;
                why.append("numbers say episode ").append(p.episode);
            }
        } else if (p.bareNumber > 0) {
            if (p.bareNumber == ep.number) {
                s.score += 20;
                addWhy(why, "bare number matches");
            } else {
                s.score -= 25; s.conflict = true;
                addWhy(why, "bare number says " + p.bareNumber);
            }
        }
        // airdate
        if (!p.airdate.isEmpty() && !ep.airdate.isEmpty()) {
            if (p.airdate.equals(ep.airdate)) {
                s.score += 45;
                addWhy(why, "airdate matches");
            } else {
                s.score -= 40; s.conflict = true;
                addWhy(why, "airdate differs");
            }
        }
        // title
        if (!ep.name.isEmpty() && !p.titleWords.isEmpty()) {
            double cov = coverage(p.titleWords,
                    EpisodeKey.normalize(ep.name));
            if (cov >= 0.99) { s.score += 30; addWhy(why, "title matches"); }
            else if (cov >= 0.6) { s.score += 18; addWhy(why, "title close"); }
            else if (cov > 0) { s.score += (int) Math.round(cov * 12); }
        }
        s.reason = why.toString();
        return s;
    }

    /** Duration corroboration, applied when BOTH durations are
     *  honestly known. Returns a delta for the score. */
    public static int durationDelta(int candidateSec, int episodeSec) {
        if (candidateSec <= 0 || episodeSec <= 0) return 0;
        double ratio = (double) candidateSec / episodeSec;
        if (ratio >= 0.9 && ratio <= 1.1) return 10;
        if (ratio < 0.5 || ratio > 2.0) return -15;
        return 0;
    }

    /** The tier a score earns. Margin = lead over the runner-up
     *  candidate FOR THE SAME EPISODE (or over this candidate's
     *  next-best episode, in matchAll); a conflict caps at CLOSE —
     *  doubt is never rounded up. */
    public static int tierFor(int score, int margin, boolean conflict) {
        if (conflict) return score > 0 ? TIER_CLOSE : TIER_UNMATCHED;
        if (score >= 60 && margin >= 15) return TIER_RESOLVED;
        if (score >= 35) return TIER_MOSTLY;
        if (score > 0) return TIER_CLOSE;
        return TIER_UNMATCHED;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- assignment

    public static final class Binding {
        public int episodeIdx, candidateIdx, score, tier;
        public String reason = "";
    }

    public static final class Assignment {
        /** One binding per episode (or null): episodeIdx -> Binding. */
        public final java.util.Map<Integer, Binding> byEpisode =
                new java.util.HashMap<>();
        /** Candidates bound to nothing, with reasons (the maybe pen
         *  plus the plainly unmatched). */
        public final List<Binding> unbound = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /**
     * Bind candidates to episodes: every (episode, candidate) pair
     * scored, best pairs claimed first, each side used once
     * (Addendum 10: the union dedupes BY EPISODE IDENTITY — five
     * uploads of S01E03 are one episode, not five). CLOSE pairs
     * never bind; they go to the pen with their reasons.
     */
    public static Assignment matchAll(List<EpisodeRef> episodes,
                                      List<Candidate> candidates,
                                      String showName) {
        Assignment out = new Assignment();
        int ne = episodes.size(), nc = candidates.size();
        Parsed[] parsed = new Parsed[nc];
        for (int j = 0; j < nc; j++) {
            parsed[j] = parse(candidates.get(j).label, showName);
        }
        int[][] scores = new int[ne][nc];
        boolean[][] conflicts = new boolean[ne][nc];
        String[][] reasons = new String[ne][nc];
        int[][] tiers = new int[ne][nc];
        for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
            // margin per candidate vs its runner-up episode is
            // computed column-wise below; first pass: raw scores.
            for (int j = 0; j < nc; j++) {
                Scored s = score(parsed[j], episodes.get(i));
                s.score += durationDelta(candidates.get(j).durationSec,
                        episodes.get(i).runtimeSec);
                scores[i][j] = s.score;
                conflicts[i][j] = s.conflict;
                reasons[i][j] = s.reason;
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < nc; j++) {
            // per candidate: best and second-best episode scores
            int best = Integer.MIN_VALUE, second = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
                if (scores[i][j] > best) { second = best; best = scores[i][j]; }
                else if (scores[i][j] > second) { second = scores[i][j]; }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
                int margin = scores[i][j]
                        - (scores[i][j] == best ? second : best);
                if (margin == Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2) margin = 999;
                tiers[i][j] = tierFor(scores[i][j], Math.max(margin, 0),
                        conflicts[i][j]);
            }
        }
        // claim pairs best-first; RESOLVED and MOSTLY may bind.
        List<int[]> pairs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < nc; j++) {
                if (tiers[i][j] == TIER_RESOLVED || tiers[i][j] == TIER_MOSTLY) {
                    pairs.add(new int[]{scores[i][j], i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        pairs.sort((a, b) -> b[0] - a[0]);
        Set<Integer> usedEp = new HashSet<>(), usedCand = new HashSet<>();
        for (int[] pr : pairs) {
            int i = pr[1], j = pr[2];
            if (usedEp.contains(i) || usedCand.contains(j)) continue;
            usedEp.add(i); usedCand.add(j);
            Binding b = new Binding();
            b.episodeIdx = i; b.candidateIdx = j;
            b.score = scores[i][j]; b.tier = tiers[i][j];
            b.reason = reasons[i][j];
            out.byEpisode.put(i, b);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < nc; j++) {
            if (usedCand.contains(j)) continue;
            // the pen entry: this candidate's best look, honestly told
            int bi = -1, bs = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
                if (scores[i][j] > bs) { bs = scores[i][j]; bi = i; }
            }
            Binding b = new Binding();
            b.episodeIdx = bi; b.candidateIdx = j;
            b.score = Math.max(bs, 0);
            b.tier = bi < 0 ? TIER_UNMATCHED : tiers[bi][j];
            if (b.tier == TIER_RESOLVED || b.tier == TIER_MOSTLY) {
                b.tier = TIER_CLOSE;   // lost the claim — a maybe now
            }
            b.reason = bi < 0 ? "no episode evidence in the name"
                    : reasons[bi][j];
            if (b.reason == null || b.reason.isEmpty()) {
                b.reason = "no episode evidence in the name";
            }
            out.unbound.add(b);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Addendum 10(2) + 11: the playable count a show card may print.
     * An episode counts ONLY when its bound candidate is RESOLVED
     * tier AND its link is verified live — middle ground and
     * maybes never inflate the number. Returns {playable, total};
     * total 0 means "print nothing" (Display Honesty).
     */
    public static int[] playableCount(Assignment a,
                                      List<Candidate> candidates,
                                      int totalEpisodes) {
        int playable = 0;
        for (Binding b : a.byEpisode.values()) {
            if (b.tier == TIER_RESOLVED
                    && candidates.get(b.candidateIdx).verified) {
                playable++;
            }
        }
        return new int[]{playable, totalEpisodes};
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- words

    private static void addWhy(StringBuilder why, String s) {
        if (why.length() > 0) why.append("; ");
        why.append(s);
    }

    private static Set<String> wordSet(String norm) {
        Set<String> out = new HashSet<>();
        for (String w : norm.split(" ")) if (!w.isEmpty()) out.add(w);
        return out;
    }

    /** Fraction of the needle's words present in the haystack. */
    static double coverage(String haystackNorm, String needleNorm) {
        Set<String> hay = wordSet(haystackNorm);
        Set<String> needle = wordSet(needleNorm);
        if (needle.isEmpty()) return 0;
        int hit = 0;
        for (String w : needle) if (hay.contains(w)) hit++;
        return (double) hit / needle.size();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/EstimateMath.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * Estimates integrity (v0.12.1, James's law): any number Sandy
 * prints about time must be a number somebody can trust.
 *
 *  - MEASURED BASIS ONLY: an estimate is derived from rates this
 *    device actually observed (its own throughput/fetch history).
 *    No basis → NO number: callers print "still working — no honest
 *    estimate yet" instead of a comforting invention.
 *  - ONE MODEST PAD: the stated figure carries a single ~15% pad,
 *    so the time it names means FINISHED — a person would rather
 *    come back early than come back to another 30 minutes. Never
 *    padded twice, never inflated past the buffer.
 *  - LABELED: callers always present the number as an estimate.
 *  - PRECISION EXCEPTION: moments that need an exact time (a timer
 *    fires at 8:00 PM) never pass through here — exact stays exact.
 *
 * Pure math so the harness pins the law, not just the intent.
 */
public final class EstimateMath {

    private EstimateMath() {}

    /** The one pad: +1/6 (≈16.7%), applied exactly once. */
    public static long pad(long measuredMs) {
        if (measuredMs <= 0) return measuredMs;
        return measuredMs + measuredMs / 6;
    }

    /**
     * Estimated milliseconds for {@code bytesRemaining} at a
     * MEASURED {@code bytesPerSecond}, padded once. -1 when there
     * is no measured basis (rate unknown) — the caller must then
     * print no number at all.
     */
    public static long estimateMs(long bytesRemaining, double bytesPerSecond) {
        if (bytesPerSecond <= 0 || bytesRemaining < 0) return -1;
        long raw = (long) Math.ceil(bytesRemaining / bytesPerSecond * 1000.0);
        return pad(raw);
    }

    /** "about 45 sec" / "about 12 min" / "about 1 h 5 min". */
    public static String formatDuration(long ms) {
        if (ms < 0) return "";
        long sec = (ms + 999) / 1000;
        if (sec < 90) return "about " + Math.max(1, sec) + " sec";
        long min = (sec + 59) / 60;
        if (min < 90) return "about " + min + " min";
        long h = min / 60;
        long m = min % 60;
        return m == 0 ? "about " + h + " h"
                : "about " + h + " h " + m + " min";
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/FailureWords.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * Failure words (v0.14.0, James: a bare "HTTP error" is
 * banned). When a play or a resolve fails, the viewer's surface
 * states the actual result in plain words — the status the
 * server spoke, or the silence it left — so a field failure
 * reports ITSELF instead of hiding behind a code word. The same
 * words are what Hydra's exhaustion report carries and what
 * gets logged with the failure.
 *
 * Each kind has a UiStrings key (all 13 tables) for the viewer
 * surfaces that localize, and a plain-English sentence for the
 * surfaces that speak English in this house's code (status
 * lines). The kind is decided from the real outcome: the HTTP
 * status when the server answered, the wire failure when it
 * didn't.
 */
public final class FailureWords {

    public static final String REFUSED = "refused";     // 401/403: it said no
    public static final String GONE = "gone";           // 404/410: not there
    public static final String SERVER = "server";       // 5xx: their side broke
    public static final String TIMEOUT = "timeout";     // answered too slowly
    public static final String ADDRESS = "address";     // no such host / refused connect
    public static final String CLEARTEXT = "cleartext"; // the OS door barred plain http
    public static final String NO_ANSWER = "noanswer";  // silence, retries spent

    private FailureWords() {}

    /** The kind for an HTTP status (0 = no answer at all). */
    public static String kindForHttp(int code) {
        if (code == 404 || code == 410) return GONE;
        if (code == 401 || code == 403) return REFUSED;
        if (code == 408) return TIMEOUT;
        if (code >= 500) return SERVER;
        if (code >= 400) return REFUSED;
        return NO_ANSWER;
    }

    /** The kind for a wire failure's detail text. */
    public static String kindForDetail(String detail) {
        if (detail == null) return NO_ANSWER;
        String d = detail.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        if (d.contains("cleartext")) return CLEARTEXT;
        if (d.contains("unknownhost") || d.contains("unknown host")
                || d.contains("connectexception")
                || d.contains("connection refused")) return ADDRESS;
        if (d.contains("timeout") || d.contains("timed out")
                || d.contains("didn't answer")) return TIMEOUT;
        if (d.contains("http 404") || d.contains("http 410")) return GONE;
        if (d.contains("http 403") || d.contains("http 401")) return REFUSED;
        if (d.contains("http 5")) return SERVER;
        return NO_ANSWER;
    }

    /** The kind a finished LinkHealth result carries. */
    public static String kindFor(LinkHealth.Result r) {
        if (r == null) return NO_ANSWER;
        if (r.httpCode > 0) return kindForHttp(r.httpCode);
        if (r.slow) return TIMEOUT;
        return kindForDetail(r.detail);
    }

    /** The UiStrings key a viewer surface localizes with. */
    public static String keyFor(String kind) {
        switch (kind == null ? "" : kind) {
            case REFUSED: return "fail_refused";
            case GONE: return "fail_gone";
            case SERVER: return "fail_server";
            case TIMEOUT: return "fail_timeout";
            case ADDRESS: return "fail_address";
            case CLEARTEXT: return "fail_cleartext";
            default: return "fail_no_answer";
        }
    }

    /** The plain-English sentence (status-line surfaces). */
    public static String englishFor(String kind, int httpCode) {
        switch (kind == null ? "" : kind) {
            case REFUSED:
                return "The server refused (HTTP " + httpCode + ") — it said no.";
            case GONE:
                return "It's gone (HTTP " + httpCode + ") — the server says it isn't there.";
            case SERVER:
                return "The server is in trouble (HTTP " + httpCode + ") — their side, not yours.";
            case TIMEOUT:
                return "It didn't answer in time — the server is slow.";
            case ADDRESS:
                return "That address doesn't answer — it may be written wrong, or the host is down.";
            case CLEARTEXT:
                return "This phone barred the plain (unencrypted) connection the source needs.";
            default:
                return "No answer — every way in was tried and none answered.";
        }
    }

    /** Words for a finished probe result, in one call. */
    public static String englishFor(LinkHealth.Result r) {
        return englishFor(kindFor(r), r == null ? 0 : r.httpCode);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/FbankFeatures.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * Kaldi-style 80-bin log filterbank features (v0.12.0) — the front
 * end the 3D-Speaker speaker-embedding model eats, reproducing the
 * recipe sherpa-onnx's speaker embedding extractor implements
 * (Kaldi / kaldi-native-fbank), step for step:
 *
 *   samples scaled to the int16 range (the embedding model's own
 *   metadata says normalize_samples=1 — the extractor works on
 *   Kaldi-scale waveforms);
 *   frames of 400 samples (25 ms) every 160 (10 ms), snip-edges;
 *   per frame: DC offset removed, pre-emphasis 0.97, Povey window
 *   (the Hann window raised to 0.85 — Kaldi's default), zero-padded
 *   to a 512 FFT, power spectrum;
 *   80 triangular mel filters between 20 Hz and Nyquist, spaced on
 *   the Kaldi mel scale (1127 ln(1 + f/700)), energy floored at
 *   float epsilon, natural log;
 *   and the model's declared feature normalization: the per-bin
 *   mean over the segment's frames subtracted (global-mean), which
 *   is what the 3D-Speaker export was trained against.
 *
 * Pure math, no Android and no ONNX: the desktop harness compares
 * embeddings computed through these features against the reference
 * extractor's own, number for number (work/v120/diar).
 */
public final class FbankFeatures {

    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE = 16000;
    public static final int FRAME_LEN = 400;
    public static final int FRAME_SHIFT = 160;
    public static final int NUM_BINS = 80;
    public static final double PREEMPH = 0.97;
    public static final double LOW_FREQ = 20.0;
    /** Kaldi's default top: Nyquist − 400 Hz. Measured load-bearing
     *  (work/v120/diar/sweep_fbank.py): at 8000 the embeddings sit at
     *  cosine ~0.83 to the reference extractor's; at 7600, ~0.99. */
    public static final double HIGH_FREQ = 7600.0;
    public static final double LOG_EPS = 1.1920929e-7;   // float epsilon, Kaldi's floor

    private FbankFeatures() {}

    private static double mel(double freq) {
        return 1127.0 * Math.log(1.0 + freq / 700.0);
    }

    /** Mel filter weights [bin][fftBin] over the 257 positive bins
     *  of a 512 FFT — Kaldi's triangular construction. */
    public static float[][] melFilters() {
        int nFftBins = 257;
        double fftBinWidth = (SAMPLE_RATE / 2.0) / (nFftBins - 1); // 31.25 Hz
        double melLow = mel(LOW_FREQ), melHigh = mel(HIGH_FREQ);
        double melStep = (melHigh - melLow) / (NUM_BINS + 1);
        float[][] w = new float[NUM_BINS][nFftBins];
        for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BINS; b++) {
            double left = melLow + b * melStep;
            double center = melLow + (b + 1) * melStep;
            double right = melLow + (b + 2) * melStep;
            for (int i = 0; i < nFftBins; i++) {
                double m = mel(i * fftBinWidth);
                if (m > left && m < center) {
                    w[b][i] = (float) ((m - left) / (center - left));
                } else if (m >= center && m < right) {
                    w[b][i] = (float) ((right - m) / (right - center));
                }
            }
        }
        return w;
    }

    /** Number of frames snip-edges framing yields for n samples. */
    public static int frameCount(int numSamples) {
        if (numSamples < FRAME_LEN) return 0;
        return 1 + (numSamples - FRAME_LEN) / FRAME_SHIFT;
    }

    /**
     * Features for one audio segment: float[frames][80], log
     * filterbank energies with the global-mean normalization the
     * embedding model declares. Input samples are floats in
     * -1..1 (the PcmSource convention); they are scaled to the
     * Kaldi range inside.
     */
    public static float[][] compute(float[] samples) {
        int n = samples == null ? 0 : samples.length;
        int frames = frameCount(n);
        float[][] out = new float[frames][NUM_BINS];
        if (frames == 0) return out;
        float[][] filters = melFilters();
        double[] window = new double[FRAME_LEN];
        for (int i = 0; i < FRAME_LEN; i++) {
            double hann = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / (FRAME_LEN - 1));
            window[i] = Math.pow(hann, 0.85);   // Povey
        }
        double[] frame = new double[FRAME_LEN];
        double[] re = new double[512];
        double[] im = new double[512];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int off = f * FRAME_SHIFT;
            double mean = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < FRAME_LEN; i++) {
                frame[i] = samples[off + i] * 32768.0;
                mean += frame[i];
            }
            mean /= FRAME_LEN;
            for (int i = 0; i < FRAME_LEN; i++) frame[i] -= mean;
            // pre-emphasis, Kaldi's order (backwards, first sample scaled)
            for (int i = FRAME_LEN - 1; i > 0; i--) frame[i] -= PREEMPH * frame[i - 1];
            frame[0] *= (1.0 - PREEMPH);
            for (int i = 0; i < FRAME_LEN; i++) frame[i] *= window[i];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(re, 0);
            java.util.Arrays.fill(im, 0);
            System.arraycopy(frame, 0, re, 0, FRAME_LEN);
            fft(re, im);
            for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BINS; b++) {
                double e = 0;
                float[] w = filters[b];
                for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++) {
                    if (w[i] != 0) e += w[i] * (re[i] * re[i] + im[i] * im[i]);
                }
                if (e < LOG_EPS) e = LOG_EPS;
                out[f][b] = (float) Math.log(e);
            }
        }
        // global-mean normalization (the model's declared recipe)
        double[] mean = new double[NUM_BINS];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BINS; b++) mean[b] += out[f][b];
        }
        for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BINS; b++) mean[b] /= frames;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BINS; b++) out[f][b] -= (float) mean[b];
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Iterative radix-2 FFT, in place; length must be a power of 2. */
    static void fft(double[] re, double[] im) {
        int n = re.length;
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                double t = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = t;
                t = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = t;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            double ang = -2 * Math.PI / len;
            double wr = Math.cos(ang), wi = Math.sin(ang);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double cwr = 1, cwi = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < len / 2; k++) {
                    double ur = re[i + k], ui = im[i + k];
                    double vr = re[i + k + len / 2] * cwr - im[i + k + len / 2] * cwi;
                    double vi = re[i + k + len / 2] * cwi + im[i + k + len / 2] * cwr;
                    re[i + k] = ur + vr; im[i + k] = ui + vi;
                    re[i + k + len / 2] = ur - vr; im[i + k + len / 2] = ui - vi;
                    double nwr = cwr * wr - cwi * wi;
                    cwi = cwr * wi + cwi * wr;
                    cwr = nwr;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/FilesActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.ContentUris;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * My Videos (v0.9.0) — the local video player, as a citizen of Sandy.
 *
 * James's order (2026-10-18): "I want everything we've talked about
 * for THE APP" — one app, whole. The audit found the one real gap:
 * Sandy's library INDEX knew the phone's videos, but its rows were
 * text on an index screen — a file you could see, you could not
 * simply PLAY. This screen closes that: every video on the phone is
 * a row with a big tap target, and tapping plays it in the one
 * PlayerActivity, with the whole shelf as the opened set (next /
 * previous walk it), a resume place kept per file, and the full
 * player treatment (±10s, speed, fullscreen).
 *
 * The shelf merges three doors, merged and deduped by the pure
 * LocalFiles model (Downloads first, then the phone's own videos,
 * then My Library's picked folders). Nothing is copied; rows are
 * pointers. A "Pick a video file…" door (SAF) plays a single file —
 * or several at once — immediately, indexed or not.
 */
public class FilesActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_PICK_FILES = 901;
    private static final int REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION = 902;

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private TextView statsView, noteView;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private ListView list;
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private final List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<LocalFiles.Row> shelf = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean loading = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        int pad = dp(12);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "files_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(22);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView help = new TextView(this);
        help.setText("Every video on this phone, in one list. Tap one and "
                + "it plays — the list becomes the set, so Next and "
                + "Previous walk it, and Sandy remembers where you left "
                + "off in each file. Nothing is copied or uploaded.");
        help.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160, 160, 170));
        help.setTextSize(13);
        help.setPadding(0, dp(6), 0, 0);
        root.addView(help);

        Button pickBtn = new Button(this);
        pickBtn.setText("Pick a video file…");
        pickBtn.setContentDescription("Pick a video file");
        pickBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickFiles());
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams pickLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        pickLp.topMargin = dp(8);
        pickLp.bottomMargin = dp(4);
        root.addView(pickBtn, pickLp);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        statsView = new TextView(this);
        statsView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(220, 220, 228));
        statsView.setTextSize(15);
        statsView.setPadding(0, dp(8), 0, 0);
        root.addView(statsView);

        noteView = new TextView(this);
        noteView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 200, 120));
        noteView.setTextSize(13);
        noteView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(noteView);

        list = new ListView(this);
        list.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, rows);
        adapter.setNotifyOnChange(false);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        list.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> playAt(pos));
        // v0.13.0: the voiceover door — any held video can be
        // cooked, not just anime: a wedding speech in a language
        // you don't know is the case James named
        list.setOnItemLongClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            if (pos < 0 || pos >= shelf.size()) return false;
            LocalFiles.Row r = shelf.get(pos);
            new android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle(r.title)
                    .setItems(new CharSequence[]{
                            LangStore.tr(this, "auto_offer_play"),
                            LangStore.tr(this, "dub_make_voiceover")},
                            (d, which) -> {
                                if (which == 0) {
                                    playAt(pos);
                                } else {
                                    Intent i = new Intent(this, DubActivity.class);
                                    i.putExtra("pickUrl", r.uri);
                                    i.putExtra("pickName", r.title);
                                    i.putExtra("pickRecording", false);
                                    startActivity(i);
                                }
                            })
                    .show();
            return true;
        });

        setContentView(root);
        if (!hasVideoPermission()) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{videoPermission()}, REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION);
        } else {
            load();
        }
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- permission

    private String videoPermission() {
        return Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                ? android.Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
                : android.Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE;
    }

    private boolean hasVideoPermission() {
        return checkSelfPermission(videoPermission()) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, String[] permissions,
                                           int[] grantResults) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
        if (requestCode == REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION) load();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- loading

    private void load() {
        if (loading) return;
        loading = true;
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        statsView.setText("Looking for the videos on this phone…");
        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<LocalFiles.Row> downloads = queryDownloads();
            List<LocalFiles.Row> device = hasVideoPermission()
                    ? queryDeviceVideos() : new ArrayList<>();
            List<LocalFiles.Row> folder = folderRows();
            List<LocalFiles.Row> merged =
                    LocalFiles.mergeShelves(downloads, device, folder);
            boolean blocked = !hasVideoPermission();
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                loading = false;
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                shelf = merged;
                render(blocked);
            });
        });
    }

    /** This phone's own video index, asked directly (fresh every open). */
    private List<LocalFiles.Row> queryDeviceVideos() {
        List<LocalFiles.Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        Uri collection = MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
        String[] proj = {
                MediaStore.Video.Media._ID,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.DURATION,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.SIZE,
        };
        try (Cursor cur = getContentResolver().query(collection, proj, null, null,
                MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_ADDED + " DESC")) {
            if (cur == null) return out;
            int idCol = cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media._ID);
            int nameCol = cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME);
            int durCol = cur.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Video.Media.DURATION);
            int sizeCol = cur.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Video.Media.SIZE);
            while (cur.moveToNext()) {
                String name = cur.getString(nameCol);
                if (name == null || !LibraryIndex.isVideoFile(name)) continue;
                LocalFiles.Row r = new LocalFiles.Row();
                r.uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, cur.getLong(idCol)).toString();
                r.title = name;
                r.durationMs = durCol >= 0 ? cur.getLong(durCol) : -1;
                r.sizeBytes = sizeCol >= 0 ? cur.getLong(sizeCol) : -1;
                r.origin = LocalFiles.Origin.DEVICE;
                out.add(r);
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            CrashGuard.log(this, "FilesActivity device video query", t);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The public Downloads folders — where fetched files land. */
    private List<LocalFiles.Row> queryDownloads() {
        List<LocalFiles.Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File[] dirs = {
                Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS),
                Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_MOVIES),
        };
        for (File dir : dirs) {
            if (dir == null) continue;
            File[] files = null;
            try { files = dir.listFiles(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
            if (files == null) continue;
            for (File f : files) {
                if (f == null || !f.isFile() || !LibraryIndex.isVideoFile(f.getName())) continue;
                LocalFiles.Row r = new LocalFiles.Row();
                r.uri = f.getAbsolutePath();
                r.title = f.getName();
                r.sizeBytes = f.length();
                r.origin = LocalFiles.Origin.DOWNLOADS;
                out.add(r);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** My Library's indexed picked-folder files (the index's own scan). */
    private List<LocalFiles.Row> folderRows() {
        List<LocalFiles.Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : LibraryStore.loadEntries(this)) {
                if (e.uri == null || e.uri.isEmpty()) continue;
                LocalFiles.Row r = new LocalFiles.Row();
                r.uri = e.uri;
                r.title = e.fileName == null || e.fileName.isEmpty()
                        ? e.displayName : e.fileName;
                r.origin = e.uri.startsWith("content://")
                        ? LocalFiles.Origin.FOLDER : LocalFiles.Origin.DEVICE;
                out.add(r);
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            CrashGuard.log(this, "FilesActivity library rows", t);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private void render(boolean permissionBlocked) {
        rows.clear();
        for (LocalFiles.Row r : shelf) {
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder("▶ ").append(r.title);
            String meta = rowMeta(r);
            if (!meta.isEmpty()) b.append("\n").append(meta);
            rows.add(b.toString());
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
        if (shelf.isEmpty()) {
            statsView.setText(permissionBlocked
                    ? "Sandy can't see this phone's videos yet — the Videos "
                    + "permission wasn't granted. The “Pick a video file…” "
                    + "door above still works without it."
                    : "No videos found on this phone yet. Put video files in "
                    + "the Downloads or Movies folder, add a folder in My "
                    + "Library, or pick a file above.");
        } else {
            statsView.setText(shelf.size()
                    + (shelf.size() == 1 ? " video" : " videos") + " — tap one to play");
        }
        noteView.setVisibility(permissionBlocked && !shelf.isEmpty()
                ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (permissionBlocked && !shelf.isEmpty()) {
            noteView.setText("Note: the phone's own video index is hidden "
                    + "(permission not granted) — these are Downloads and "
                    + "picked-folder files. Grant the Videos permission and "
                    + "reopen this screen for the rest.");
        }
    }

    private String rowMeta(LocalFiles.Row r) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        long saved = ChannelStore.getPosition(this, LocalFiles.keyFor(r));
        if (LocalFiles.ResumePolicy.shouldOffer(saved, r.durationMs)) {
            b.append("⏸ left off at ").append(LocalFiles.formatClock(saved));
        }
        if (r.durationMs > 0) {
            if (b.length() > 0) b.append("  ·  ");
            b.append(LocalFiles.formatClock(r.durationMs));
        }
        String size = LocalFiles.formatSize(r.sizeBytes);
        if (!size.isEmpty()) {
            if (b.length() > 0) b.append("  ·  ");
            b.append(size);
        }
        if (b.length() > 0) b.append("  ·  ");
        b.append(r.origin == LocalFiles.Origin.DOWNLOADS ? "Downloads"
                : r.origin == LocalFiles.Origin.FOLDER ? "My Library folder"
                : "On this phone");
        return b.toString();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- playing

    private void playAt(int pos) {
        if (pos < 0 || pos >= shelf.size()) return;
        List<M3uParser.Channel> queue = new ArrayList<>();
        for (LocalFiles.Row r : shelf) {
            M3uParser.Channel c = new M3uParser.Channel();
            c.name = r.title;
            c.url = r.uri;
            c.source = "My Videos";
            queue.add(c);
        }
        ChannelStore.playQueue = queue;
        ChannelStore.playIndex = pos;
        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        LocalFiles.Row tapped = shelf.get(pos);
        i.putExtra("url", tapped.uri);
        i.putExtra("name", tapped.title);
        i.putExtra("localSet", true);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- the file pickers

    private void pickFiles() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("video/*");
        i.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_ALLOW_MULTIPLE, true);
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION
                | Intent.FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION);
        try {
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_FILES);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone has no file picker — the list "
                    + "and My Library's folders still work.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
        if (requestCode != REQ_PICK_FILES || resultCode != RESULT_OK || data == null) return;
        List<Uri> picked = new ArrayList<>();
        if (data.getClipData() != null) {
            for (int k = 0; k < data.getClipData().getItemCount(); k++) {
                Uri u = data.getClipData().getItemAt(k).getUri();
                if (u != null) picked.add(u);
            }
        } else if (data.getData() != null) {
            picked.add(data.getData());
        }
        if (picked.isEmpty()) return;
        List<M3uParser.Channel> queue = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Uri u : picked) {
            try {
                getContentResolver().takePersistableUriPermission(u,
                        Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            } catch (Exception ignored) { /* may still play this session */ }
            M3uParser.Channel c = new M3uParser.Channel();
            c.name = displayNameFor(u);
            c.url = u.toString();
            c.source = "My Videos";
            queue.add(c);
        }
        ChannelStore.playQueue = queue;
        ChannelStore.playIndex = 0;
        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("url", queue.get(0).url);
        i.putExtra("name", queue.get(0).name);
        i.putExtra("localSet", true);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    /** Best plain name for a picked document URI. */
    private String displayNameFor(Uri u) {
        String name = null;
        try (Cursor cur = getContentResolver().query(u,
                new String[]{android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                null, null, null)) {
            if (cur != null && cur.moveToFirst()) name = cur.getString(0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
            String tail = u.getLastPathSegment();
            name = tail == null || tail.isEmpty() ? "Video" : tail;
        }
        return name;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/FreshVerify.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;

/**
 * Auto-fresh (v0.4.0) — James: "It's gonna resolve and check every
 * time it comes online... things maneuver." On app start, verdicts
 * older than 6 hours quietly re-verify in the background with the
 * deep probe. The queue is ordered the way the household actually
 * watches: FAVORITES first, then channels already carrying verdicts
 * (the surf lists Mom lives in), then never-checked favorites'
 * neighbors by guide order — bounded per launch so the politeness is
 * real, and guarded so it runs at most once per process and never
 * more often than every 30 minutes.
 *
 * Results land in HealthStore like any other probe; the listener (if
 * any) hears about it once, at the end, on the main thread, so a list
 * on screen can quietly re-sort itself.
 */
public final class FreshVerify {

    public static final long STALE_MS = 6L * 3600L * 1000L;
    private static final long MIN_INTERVAL_MS = 30L * 60L * 1000L;
    private static final int MAX_PER_RUN = 250;
    private static final int CONCURRENCY = 6;
    private static final int TIMEOUT_MS = 6000;

    private static final AtomicBoolean running = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    public interface Listener {
        void onFreshDone(int checkedCount);
    }

    private FreshVerify() {}

    /**
     * Starts a background refresh if one is due; returns true when a
     * run was started. Channel supply is a callback so this class
     * stays ignorant of where the guide lives (MainActivity caches it).
     */
    public static boolean maybeRun(Context ctx,
                                   java.util.function.Supplier<List<M3uParser.Channel>> channels,
                                   Listener listener) {
        Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        if (!ChannelStore.getAutoFresh(app)) return false;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - ChannelStore.getFreshLastRun(app) < MIN_INTERVAL_MS) return false;
        if (!running.compareAndSet(false, true)) return false;

        new Thread(() -> {
            int checked = 0;
            try {
                List<M3uParser.Channel> all = channels == null ? null : channels.get();
                List<LinkHealth.Target> queue = buildQueue(app, all, now);
                checked = queue.size();
                if (checked > 0) {
                    LinkHealth.probeAll(queue, CONCURRENCY, TIMEOUT_MS,
                            (t, r) -> HealthStore.recordQuiet(app, t.url, r), null);
                    HealthStore.save(app);
                }
                ChannelStore.setFreshLastRun(app, System.currentTimeMillis(), checked);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // background politeness: a failed refresh is silent
            } finally {
                running.set(false);
                if (listener != null) {
                    int n = checked;
                    new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post(() -> listener.onFreshDone(n));
                }
            }
        }, "sandy-fresh-verify").start();
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * The bounded queue, in the Addendum 10(5) priority order
     * ({@link VerifyPriority}): the kept live channel first, then
     * favorites, then the wider shelves — inside a class, verdicts
     * going stale outrank first looks, stalest first. Capped at
     * MAX_PER_RUN; the whole ocean is never re-probed.
     */
    static List<LinkHealth.Target> buildQueue(Context ctx,
                                              List<M3uParser.Channel> channels,
                                              long now) {
        List<LinkHealth.Target> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (channels == null || channels.isEmpty()) return out;
        Set<String> favs = ChannelStore.getFavorites(ctx);
        ChannelStore.KeptLive kept = ChannelStore.getKeptLive(ctx);
        String keptUrl = kept == null ? "" : kept.url;
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        List<VerifyPriority.Entry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
            if (c == null || !LinkHealth.isRemote(c.url) || !seen.add(c.url)) {
                continue;
            }
            HealthStore.Health h = HealthStore.get(ctx, c.url);
            boolean fav = favs.contains(c.url);
            boolean isKept = c.url.equals(keptUrl);
            int cat = VerifyPriority.category(isKept, fav, false);
            if (h == null) {
                entries.add(new VerifyPriority.Entry(
                        c.url, c.userAgent, cat, 0));
                continue;
            }
            if (now - h.checkedAt < STALE_MS) continue;
            entries.add(new VerifyPriority.Entry(
                    c.url, c.userAgent, cat, h.checkedAt));
        }
        for (VerifyPriority.Entry e : VerifyPriority.order(entries, MAX_PER_RUN)) {
            out.add(new LinkHealth.Target(e.url, e.userAgent));
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/GateQuestions.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * The grown-up gate's question (v0.14.0) — pure logic. The gate
 * is a PLAIN check, not a lock against a determined adult: hold
 * the button AND answer a question a small child can't be
 * expected to answer but any grown-up can. Numbers carry it
 * (they need no language): "which number is biggest?" and "what
 * is 7 + 5?". The gate keeps a child from wandering out of the
 * story room or sending a share by accident; it was never meant
 * to keep a grown-up out of anything.
 */
public final class GateQuestions {

    public static final int KIND_BIGGEST = 0;
    public static final int KIND_SUM = 1;

    public static final class Question {
        public int kind;
        /** For KIND_SUM: the two addends. For KIND_BIGGEST: unused. */
        public int a, b;
        public final List<Integer> options = new ArrayList<>();
        public int correctIndex = -1;
    }

    private GateQuestions() {}

    public static Question generate(Random rnd) {
        Question q = new Question();
        if (rnd.nextBoolean()) {
            q.kind = KIND_BIGGEST;
            int big = 12 + rnd.nextInt(80);        // 12..91
            int s1 = 1 + rnd.nextInt(big - 1);
            int s2 = 1 + rnd.nextInt(big - 1);
            if (s2 == s1) s2 = s2 + 1 < big ? s2 + 1 : s2 - 1;
            q.options.add(s1);
            q.options.add(big);
            q.options.add(s2);
            Collections.shuffle(q.options, rnd);
            q.correctIndex = q.options.indexOf(big);
        } else {
            q.kind = KIND_SUM;
            q.a = 6 + rnd.nextInt(13);             // 6..18
            q.b = 5 + rnd.nextInt(12);             // 5..16
            int sum = q.a + q.b;
            int d1 = sum + (rnd.nextBoolean() ? 2 : -2);
            int d2 = sum + (rnd.nextBoolean() ? 10 : -10);
            if (d2 <= 0 || d2 == d1) d2 = sum + 3;
            q.options.add(sum);
            q.options.add(d1);
            q.options.add(d2);
            Collections.shuffle(q.options, rnd);
            q.correctIndex = q.options.indexOf(sum);
        }
        return q;
    }

    public static boolean isCorrect(Question q, int chosenIndex) {
        return q != null && chosenIndex == q.correctIndex
                && chosenIndex >= 0;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/GrownUpGateActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.Random;

/**
 * The grown-up gate (v0.14.0) — a PLAIN check at the story
 * room's thresholds: leaving the room, sharing a child's story,
 * recording or managing family voices and journals. Two parts:
 * hold the big button down (small hands let go), then answer a
 * grown-up question (GateQuestions — numbers carry it in any
 * language). It is not a lock and doesn't pretend to be one; it
 * keeps a child from wandering out or sending something by
 * accident, which is the job James gave it.
 *
 * Callers launch it for a result; RESULT_OK = a grown-up's hand
 * was here. Extra "why" = a line naming what the gate guards.
 */
public class GrownUpGateActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_WHY = "why";

    private static final long HOLD_MS = 2500;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private ProgressBar holdBar;
    private TextView questionView, statusView;
    private LinearLayout optionsBox;
    private Button holdBtn;
    private long holdStart = 0;
    private boolean holding = false;
    private boolean asked = false;
    private GateQuestions.Question question;
    private final Random rnd = new Random();

    private final Runnable holdTick = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            if (!holding) return;
            long el = System.currentTimeMillis() - holdStart;
            holdBar.setProgress((int) Math.min(100, el * 100 / HOLD_MS));
            if (el >= HOLD_MS) {
                holding = false;
                showQuestion();
            } else {
                handler.postDelayed(this, 40);
            }
        }
    };

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        root.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);
        int pad = dp(24);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_gate_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(26);
        title.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        root.addView(title);

        String why = getIntent().getStringExtra(X_WHY);
        if (why != null && !why.isEmpty()) {
            TextView whyView = new TextView(this);
            whyView.setText(why);
            whyView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(190, 198, 220));
            whyView.setTextSize(17);
            whyView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            lp.topMargin = dp(10);
            root.addView(whyView, lp);
        }

        holdBtn = new Button(this);
        holdBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_gate_hold"));
        holdBtn.setTextSize(22);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams hb = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(96));
        hb.topMargin = dp(28);
        root.addView(holdBtn, hb);
        holdBtn.setOnTouchListener((v, ev) -> {
            if (asked) return false;
            if (ev.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                holding = true;
                holdStart = System.currentTimeMillis();
                handler.post(holdTick);
                return true;
            }
            if (ev.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                    || ev.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                holding = false;
                holdBar.setProgress(0);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        });

        holdBar = new ProgressBar(this, null,
                android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        holdBar.setMax(100);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams pb = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(10));
        pb.topMargin = dp(10);
        root.addView(holdBar, pb);

        questionView = new TextView(this);
        questionView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        questionView.setTextSize(26);
        questionView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        questionView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams ql = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        ql.topMargin = dp(28);
        root.addView(questionView, ql);

        optionsBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        optionsBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        optionsBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(optionsBox, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 190, 120));
        statusView.setTextSize(18);
        statusView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams sl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sl.topMargin = dp(14);
        root.addView(statusView, sl);

        setContentView(root);
    }

    private void showQuestion() {
        asked = true;
        holdBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        holdBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        question = GateQuestions.generate(rnd);
        questionView.setText(question.kind == GateQuestions.KIND_BIGGEST
                ? LangStore.tr(this, "story_gate_biggest")
                : String.format(LangStore.tr(this, "story_gate_sum"),
                        question.a, question.b));
        questionView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        optionsBox.removeAllViews();
        for (int i = 0; i < question.options.size(); i++) {
            final int idx = i;
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText(String.valueOf(question.options.get(i)));
            b.setTextSize(26);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(76));
            lp.topMargin = dp(10);
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (GateQuestions.isCorrect(question, idx)) {
                    setResult(RESULT_OK);
                    finish();
                } else {
                    statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_gate_wrong"));
                    showQuestion();
                }
            });
            optionsBox.addView(b, lp);
        }
        optionsBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        holding = false;
        handler.removeCallbacks(holdTick);
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/GuideActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TimeZone;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The TV Guide (v0.11.0; restructured v0.12.1): what's on now,
 * what's next, and the day's schedule for Sandy's Live TV channels
 * — in the phone's own local time, from hosted XMLTV filed through
 * the memory hook.
 *
 * Coverage is what it is, and it is printed on the face: the header
 * says how many of her channels carry guide data and when the data
 * was fetched and through when it runs; a channel with none says
 * "No guide for this channel" on its own row. Nothing is invented
 * to fill a gap.
 *
 * v0.12.1 restructure (James's field report: "the TV Guide is not
 * coming up"): the shipped screen parsed the whole channel cache
 * on the main thread, then — also on the main thread — linear-
 * scanned the 1,345-row guide map once per channel (~17M compares
 * for a full cache) before the first row could paint. On a phone
 * that reads as a guide that never opens, and courts the system
 * "keeps stopping" dialog. Now: the shell paints immediately;
 * channels, freshness state and guide data load on the executor;
 * bridge lookups are the GuideStore's O(1) index; binding touches
 * only values already in memory. And EVERY path lands somewhere
 * visible — data, cached data with its freshness line, or an
 * honest empty state. The screen itself is never the failure, and
 * a failure while opening is filed to the crash log (Settings ▸
 * Crash reports) instead of taking the app down.
 *
 * A future programme can be set to record right from its row: the
 * tap lands on the set-timer screen with the programme's channel
 * and frame prefilled (TimerFrame visible before commit).
 */
public class GuideActivity extends Activity {

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final List<M3uParser.Channel> channels = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rowTitles = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rowSub = new ArrayList<>();

    private TextView headerView;
    private TextView freshnessView;
    private ListView listView;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;

    private GuideModel.GuideData data;
    private Map<String, GuideStore.SourceState> stateCache = new HashMap<>();
    private volatile boolean channelsLoaded = false;
    private volatile boolean loadFailed = false;
    private boolean dayMode = false;
    private M3uParser.Channel dayChannel;
    private List<GuideModel.Programme> dayRows = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        try {
            buildUi();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashGuard.log(this, "GuideActivity.onCreate", e);
            Toast.makeText(this, "The guide couldn't open — the failure "
                    + "was filed in Settings ▸ Crash reports.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }
        refresh(false);
    }

    private void buildUi() {
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        headerView = new TextView(this);
        headerView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_title"));
        headerView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        headerView.setTextSize(19);
        headerView.setTypeface(headerView.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(headerView);

        freshnessView = new TextView(this);
        freshnessView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        freshnessView.setTextSize(12);
        root.addView(freshnessView);

        LinearLayout buttons = new LinearLayout(this);
        buttons.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button timersBtn = new Button(this);
        timersBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timers_btn"));
        timersBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> startActivity(
                new Intent(this, TimersActivity.class)));
        buttons.addView(timersBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        Button refreshBtn = new Button(this);
        refreshBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "refresh"));
        refreshBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> refresh(true));
        buttons.addView(refreshBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        root.addView(buttons);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null,
                android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        listView = new ListView(this);
        listView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.addView(listView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<String>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1,
                rowTitles) {
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
