                View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                t1.setText(rowTitles.get(pos));
                t1.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                t2.setText(pos < rowSub.size() ? rowSub.get(pos) : "");
                t2.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                return v;
            }
            @Override public int getCount() { return rowTitles.size(); }
        };
        listView.setAdapter(adapter);
        listView.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> onRowTap(pos));
        listView.setOnItemLongClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            if (!dayMode) {
                int idx = rowIndexToChannel(pos);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                    synchronized (channels) { play(channels.get(idx)); }
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        });
        setContentView(root);
        freshnessView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_loading"));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ data

    /** All loading happens here, off the UI thread. */
    private void loadChannelsOffThread() {
        Set<String> favs = ChannelStore.getFavorites(this);
        List<M3uParser.Channel> all = ChannelStore.loadCache(this);
        if (all == null) all = new ArrayList<>();
        List<M3uParser.Channel> fav = new ArrayList<>();
        List<M3uParser.Channel> rest = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : all) {
            if (c.url == null || c.url.isEmpty() || !seen.add(c.url)) continue;
            (favs.contains(c.url) ? fav : rest).add(c);
        }
        synchronized (channels) {
            channels.clear();
            channels.addAll(fav);
            channels.addAll(rest);
        }
        channelsLoaded = true;
    }

    /** Fetch what's stale (or everything, when forced), then rebind. */
    private void refresh(boolean force) {
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        exec.execute(() -> {
            GuideStore.FetchResult fres = null;
            try {
                if (!channelsLoaded) loadChannelsOffThread();
                Set<String> baseIds = new HashSet<>();
                synchronized (channels) {
                    for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
                        baseIds.add(GuideStore.baseId(c.tvgId));
                    }
                }
                List<String> files = GuideStore.filesFor(this, baseIds);
                Map<String, GuideStore.SourceState> st = GuideStore.state(this);
                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                List<String> want = new ArrayList<>();
                for (String f : files) {
                    if (force || GuideStore.stale(st.get(f), now)) want.add(f);
                }
                if (!want.isEmpty()) fres = GuideStore.fetch(this, want);
                stateCache = GuideStore.state(this);
                data = GuideStore.data(this);
                loadFailed = false;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                // The screen must still land somewhere honest: what
                // is already filed (cache) if anything, else the
                // empty state — with the failure on the crash log.
                CrashGuard.log(this, "GuideActivity.refresh", e);
                try {
                    stateCache = GuideStore.state(this);
                    data = GuideStore.data(this);
                } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                loadFailed = true;
            }
            final GuideStore.FetchResult res = fres;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                bindChannels();
                if (force && res != null) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "guide_updated")
                            + " — " + res.filesOk + " sources, "
                            + res.programmes + " programmes"
                            + (res.filesFailed > 0
                                    ? " (" + res.filesFailed + " failed)" : ""),
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ rows

    private void bindChannels() {
        dayMode = false;
        headerView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_title"));
        rowTitles.clear();
        rowSub.clear();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        TimeZone zone = TimeZone.getDefault();

        List<M3uParser.Channel> chans;
        synchronized (channels) { chans = new ArrayList<>(channels); }

        if (chans.isEmpty()) {
            freshnessView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_no_channels"));
            rowTitles.add(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_no_channels"));
            rowSub.add("");
            adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
            return;
        }

        int covered = 0;
        if (data != null) {
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : chans) {
                if (data.hasGuide(GuideStore.baseId(c.tvgId))) covered++;
            }
        }
        long oldest = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (GuideStore.SourceState ss : stateCache.values()) {
            if (ss.fetchedAtMs > 0 && ss.fetchedAtMs < oldest) {
                oldest = ss.fetchedAtMs;
            }
        }
        StringBuilder fresh = new StringBuilder();
        fresh.append(covered).append(" / ").append(chans.size()).append(' ')
             .append(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_covers"));
        if (oldest != Long.MAX_VALUE) {
            fresh.append(" · ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_updated"))
                 .append(' ').append(GuideModel.formatTime(oldest, zone));
        }
        if (data != null && data.throughMs > 0) {
            fresh.append(" · data through ")
                 .append(GuideModel.formatDay(data.throughMs, zone));
        }
        if (loadFailed) {
            fresh.append(" · ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_load_failed"));
        }
        freshnessView.setText(fresh.toString());

        if (covered == 0) {
            rowTitles.add(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_empty"));
            rowSub.add("");
            // The channel rows still follow — no guide data is a
            // fact about the data, never a reason to hide the
            // channels themselves (a tap plays, as before).
        }
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : chans) {
            rowTitles.add(c.displayName());
            String base = GuideStore.baseId(c.tvgId);
            if (data == null || !data.hasGuide(base)) {
                rowSub.add(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_no_guide"));
                continue;
            }
            GuideModel.Programme n = data.now(base, now);
            GuideModel.Programme x = data.next(base, now);
            if (n == null && x == null) {
                rowSub.add(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_no_info"));
            } else {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                if (n != null) {
                    sb.append("▶ ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_now"))
                      .append(": ").append(n.title)
                      .append(" (–").append(GuideModel.formatTime(n.stopMs, zone))
                      .append(')');
                }
                if (x != null) {
                    if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(" · ");
                    sb.append(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_next")).append(": ")
                      .append(x.title).append(' ')
                      .append(GuideModel.formatTime(x.startMs, zone));
                }
                rowSub.add(sb.toString());
            }
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void bindDay(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        dayMode = true;
        dayChannel = c;
        headerView.setText(c.displayName());
        rowTitles.clear();
        rowSub.clear();
        TimeZone zone = TimeZone.getDefault();
        java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance(zone);
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        long dayStart = cal.getTimeInMillis();
        cal.add(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, 1);
        long dayLen = cal.getTimeInMillis() - dayStart; // 23h/25h on DST days
        freshnessView.setText(GuideModel.formatDay(dayStart, zone)
                + " — " + LangStore.tr(this, "guide_title"));
        dayRows = data == null ? new ArrayList<>()
                : data.day(GuideStore.baseId(c.tvgId), dayStart, dayLen);
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (GuideModel.Programme p : dayRows) {
            String mark = p.covers(now) ? "▶ " : (p.startMs > now ? "⏰ " : "");
            rowTitles.add(mark + GuideModel.formatTime(p.startMs, zone)
                    + "–" + GuideModel.formatTime(p.stopMs, zone)
                    + "  " + p.title);
            rowSub.add(p.desc.isEmpty() ? p.category : p.desc);
        }
        if (dayRows.isEmpty()) {
            rowTitles.add(LangStore.tr(this, "guide_no_info"));
            rowSub.add("");
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void onRowTap(int pos) {
        if (dayMode) {
            if (pos >= dayRows.size()) return;
            GuideModel.Programme p = dayRows.get(pos);
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            if (p.covers(now)) {
                play(dayChannel);
            } else if (p.startMs > now) {
                confirmRecord(p);
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "That one already aired.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
            return;
        }
        // Channel rows are offset by the empty-state banner row when
        // nothing is covered.
        int idx = rowIndexToChannel(pos);
        if (idx < 0) return;
        M3uParser.Channel c;
        synchronized (channels) {
            if (idx >= channels.size()) return;
            c = channels.get(idx);
        }
        String base = GuideStore.baseId(c.tvgId);
        if (data != null && data.hasGuide(base)) {
            bindDay(c);
        } else {
            play(c);
        }
    }

    /** Row position → channel index, accounting for the banner row
     *  bindChannels adds when no channel is covered (and for the
     *  no-channels state, where no row is a channel). */
    private int rowIndexToChannel(int pos) {
        List<M3uParser.Channel> chans;
        synchronized (channels) { chans = new ArrayList<>(channels); }
        if (chans.isEmpty()) return -1;
        boolean banner = data == null || coveredCount(chans) == 0;
        int idx = banner ? pos - 1 : pos;
        return idx >= 0 && idx < chans.size() ? idx : -1;
    }

    private int coveredCount(List<M3uParser.Channel> chans) {
        int n = 0;
        if (data != null) {
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : chans) {
                if (data.hasGuide(GuideStore.baseId(c.tvgId))) n++;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }

    /** A future programme lands on the set-timer screen with its
     *  channel and frame prefilled — the frame is VISIBLE (and
     *  editable) before anything is committed (v0.12.1). */
    private void confirmRecord(GuideModel.Programme p) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, SetTimerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra(SetTimerActivity.X_NAME, dayChannel.displayName());
        i.putExtra(SetTimerActivity.X_URL, dayChannel.url);
        i.putExtra(SetTimerActivity.X_TVG, GuideStore.baseId(dayChannel.tvgId));
        i.putExtra(SetTimerActivity.X_TITLE, p.title);
        i.putExtra(SetTimerActivity.X_START, p.startMs);
        i.putExtra(SetTimerActivity.X_STOP, p.stopMs);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    private void play(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        synchronized (channels) {
            ChannelStore.playQueue = new ArrayList<>(channels);
        }
        ChannelStore.playIndex = Math.max(0, ChannelStore.playQueue.indexOf(c));
        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("url", c.url);
        i.putExtra("name", c.displayName());
        i.putExtra("ua", c.userAgent);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        if (dayMode) {
            bindChannels();
        } else {
            super.onBackPressed();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        TimerReconcile.run(getApplicationContext());
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/GuideModel.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TimeZone;

/**
 * The TV guide's pure core (v0.11.0): programmes as epoch rows, and
 * the now/next + day math over them. Everything is stored and
 * compared in epoch milliseconds; the viewer's timezone enters ONLY
 * at render (callers pass the local day's start/length, computed
 * from their own zone) — so guide math can never smuggle a source
 * timezone into a displayed time.
 *
 * Honesty rules baked in: a channel with no rows has NO programme
 * (callers print "no guide data" on its face — nothing is ever
 * interpolated or invented); a gap between programmes is a gap,
 * shown as "no programme information", never papered over.
 *
 * Pure: no Android, no I/O. Harness-tested across timezones and DST.
 */
public final class GuideModel {

    private GuideModel() {}

    /** One programme on one channel. Times are epoch milliseconds. */
    public static final class Programme {
        public final String channelId;   // Sandy's base tvg-id
        public final long startMs;
        public final long stopMs;
        public final String title;
        public final String desc;
        public final String category;

        public Programme(String channelId, long startMs, long stopMs,
                         String title, String desc, String category) {
            this.channelId = channelId;
            this.startMs = startMs;
            this.stopMs = stopMs;
            this.title = title == null ? "" : title;
            this.desc = desc == null ? "" : desc;
            this.category = category == null ? "" : category;
        }

        public boolean covers(long nowMs) {
            return startMs <= nowMs && nowMs < stopMs;
        }

        public long durationMs() { return Math.max(0, stopMs - startMs); }
    }

    /** Programmes for many channels, each channel's rows start-sorted. */
    public static final class GuideData {
        public final Map<String, List<Programme>> byChannel = new HashMap<>();
        /** Latest stop across everything (the "data through" claim). */
        public long throughMs = 0;
        /** Earliest start across everything. */
        public long fromMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        public void add(Programme p) {
            if (p == null || p.channelId == null || p.stopMs <= p.startMs) return;
            List<Programme> rows = byChannel.get(p.channelId);
            if (rows == null) {
                rows = new ArrayList<>();
                byChannel.put(p.channelId, rows);
            }
            rows.add(p);
            if (p.stopMs > throughMs) throughMs = p.stopMs;
            if (p.startMs < fromMs) fromMs = p.startMs;
        }

        /** Sort every channel's rows; call once after bulk adds. */
        public void finish() {
            for (List<Programme> rows : byChannel.values()) {
                Collections.sort(rows, new Comparator<Programme>() {
                    @Override public int compare(Programme a, Programme b) {
                        return Long.compare(a.startMs, b.startMs);
                    }
                });
            }
            if (byChannel.isEmpty()) fromMs = 0;
        }

        public List<Programme> rowsFor(String channelId) {
            List<Programme> rows = byChannel.get(channelId);
            return rows == null ? Collections.<Programme>emptyList() : rows;
        }

        public boolean hasGuide(String channelId) {
            return byChannel.containsKey(channelId);
        }

        public int channelCount() { return byChannel.size(); }

        /**
         * The programme on at {@code nowMs}, or null — including when
         * rows exist but a gap covers now (a gap is information, and
         * it is shown as "no programme information", never filled).
         */
        public Programme now(String channelId, long nowMs) {
            List<Programme> rows = rowsFor(channelId);
            int lo = 0, hi = rows.size() - 1, best = -1;
            while (lo <= hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
                if (rows.get(mid).startMs <= nowMs) { best = mid; lo = mid + 1; }
                else hi = mid - 1;
            }
            if (best < 0) return null;
            Programme p = rows.get(best);
            return p.covers(nowMs) ? p : null;
        }

        /** The next programme after the current one (or after now). */
        public Programme next(String channelId, long nowMs) {
            for (Programme p : rowsFor(channelId)) {
                if (p.startMs > nowMs) return p;
            }
            return null;
        }

        /**
         * Everything overlapping the caller's local day window
         * [dayStartMs, dayStartMs+dayLengthMs) — the caller owns the
         * timezone math (a DST day is 23h or 25h long and still one
         * day). Programmes spanning midnight appear on both days.
         */
        public List<Programme> day(String channelId, long dayStartMs, long dayLengthMs) {
            long end = dayStartMs + dayLengthMs;
            List<Programme> out = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Programme p : rowsFor(channelId)) {
                if (p.startMs < end && p.stopMs > dayStartMs) out.add(p);
            }
            return out;
        }

        /** Drop rows that ended before {@code cutoffMs}. */
        public void prune(long cutoffMs) {
            List<String> empty = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, List<Programme>> e : byChannel.entrySet()) {
                List<Programme> keep = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Programme p : e.getValue()) {
                    if (p.stopMs > cutoffMs) keep.add(p);
                }
                if (keep.isEmpty()) empty.add(e.getKey());
                else e.setValue(keep);
            }
            for (String k : empty) byChannel.remove(k);
            long t = 0, f = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (List<Programme> rows : byChannel.values()) {
                for (Programme p : rows) {
                    if (p.stopMs > t) t = p.stopMs;
                    if (p.startMs < f) f = p.startMs;
                }
            }
            throughMs = t;
            fromMs = byChannel.isEmpty() ? 0 : f;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- XMLTV parsing

    /**
     * Parse an XMLTV timestamp ("20261018220000 +0300", also the
     * offset-less and short forms some files use) to epoch ms.
     * Offset-less times are read as UTC — XMLTV's own convention is
     * that a missing offset means the publisher's zone is unknown,
     * and treating it as UTC at least never invents a local claim.
     * Returns -1 on anything unparseable (the row is dropped, never
     * guessed).
     */
    public static long parseXmltvTime(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return -1;
        String s = raw.trim();
        if (s.length() < 14) return -1;
        String digits = s.substring(0, 14);
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
            if (!Character.isDigit(digits.charAt(i))) return -1;
        }
        String zone = "UTC";
        String rest = s.substring(14).trim();
        if (rest.length() >= 5) {
            // "+0300" / "-0500" — SimpleDateFormat wants "+0300" as Z
            // only in the XXX form; use GMT offset id which always works.
            zone = "GMT" + rest.substring(0, 3) + ":" + rest.substring(3, 5);
        }
        SimpleDateFormat f = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMddHHmmss", Locale.US);
        f.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone(zone));
        f.setLenient(false);
        try {
            return f.parse(digits).getTime();
        } catch (ParseException | NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    /** The house time-of-day format for guide rows ("7:00 PM"). */
    public static String formatTime(long epochMs, TimeZone zone) {
        SimpleDateFormat f = new SimpleDateFormat("h:mm a", Locale.US);
        f.setTimeZone(zone);
        return f.format(new java.util.Date(epochMs));
    }

    /** The house day format for guide headers ("Sun, Oct 18"). */
    public static String formatDay(long epochMs, TimeZone zone) {
        SimpleDateFormat f = new SimpleDateFormat("EEE, MMM d", Locale.US);
        f.setTimeZone(zone);
        return f.format(new java.util.Date(epochMs));
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/GuideStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;

/**
 * The TV guide's store (v0.11.0): hosted XMLTV in, filed programmes
 * out — everything through the memory hook.
 *
 * Coverage is MEASURED, never promised: the bundled bridge
 * (assets/guide_map.tsv, distilled at build time from iptv-org's
 * guides.json against the live hosted files — 1,345 of Sandy's
 * 10,261 built-in channels, 1,228 of them id-verified inside the
 * files themselves; regenerated for 0.11.1 with a HEAD-liveness
 * check on every file, which dropped the 12 dead Flash rows the
 * 0.11.0 map shipped and re-preferred 3 channels onto the living
 * Foxtel file) says which hosted file MIGHT carry a channel.
 * The file is the proof: a channel shows programmes only when its
 * id was actually parsed out of a fetched file. No map row, or a
 * stale one, reads on the channel's face as "No guide for this
 * channel" — nothing is fabricated, ever.
 *
 * Fetches are per-source scoped files (the mjh per-service/country
 * files, a few MB each — never the 63 MB all-countries file), ETag-
 * conditional, parsed streaming, and cached as filed TSV rows
 * (epochs only) under memory/guide/. Freshness is kept per source
 * in memory/guide_state.tsv and stated on the guide's face.
 */
public final class GuideStore {

    private GuideStore() {}

    /** One bridge row: where a channel's guide may live. */
    public static final class MapRow {
        public String tvgId, source, fileUrl, xmlId, evidence;
    }

    /** Per-source freshness. */
    public static final class SourceState {
        public long fetchedAtMs = 0;
        public String etag = "";
    }

    private static List<MapRow> mapCache;
    private static Map<String, MapRow> mapIndex;
    private static GuideModel.GuideData dataCache;

    // --------------------------------------------------------- map

    /** Seed the hook's guide_map.tsv from the bundled asset
     *  whenever the bundled map differs from the filed copy
     *  (v0.11.1: the comparison is the whole text -- the 0.11.0
     *  first-data-line test could leave a regenerated map
     *  unseeded when its first row happened to survive). */
    private static void seedMap(Context ctx) {
        String asset = readAsset(ctx, "guide_map.tsv");
        if (asset.isEmpty()) return;
        String filed = MemoryHook.read(ctx, MemoryHook.GUIDE_MAP);
        if (filed.isEmpty() || !asset.equals(filed)) {
            MemoryHook.write(ctx, MemoryHook.GUIDE_MAP, asset);
            mapCache = null;
            mapIndex = null;
        }
    }


    private static String readAsset(Context ctx, String name) {
        try (InputStream in = ctx.getAssets().open(name);
             BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(
                     new InputStreamReader(in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line).append('\n');
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    public static synchronized List<MapRow> map(Context ctx) {
        if (mapCache != null) return mapCache;
        seedMap(ctx);
        List<MapRow> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        String text = MemoryHook.read(ctx, MemoryHook.GUIDE_MAP);
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String s = line.trim();
            if (s.isEmpty() || s.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String[] c = s.split("\t", -1);
            if (c.length < 5) continue;
            MapRow r = new MapRow();
            r.tvgId = c[0].trim();
            r.source = c[1].trim();
            r.fileUrl = c[2].trim();
            r.xmlId = c[3].trim();
            r.evidence = c[4].trim();
            if (!r.tvgId.isEmpty() && !r.fileUrl.isEmpty()) rows.add(r);
        }
        mapCache = rows;
        return rows;
    }

    /** tvg-id → row index (pure; built once per map). v0.12.1: the
     *  guide screen used to linear-scan the whole 1,345-row map for
     *  EVERY channel (~17M compares on the UI thread for a full
     *  channel cache) — a device-only blowup that read in the hand
     *  as "the guide is not coming up". Lookups are O(1) now. */
    public static Map<String, MapRow> indexById(List<MapRow> rows) {
        Map<String, MapRow> out = new HashMap<>();
        if (rows != null) {
            for (MapRow r : rows) {
                if (r.tvgId != null && !r.tvgId.isEmpty()) {
                    out.putIfAbsent(r.tvgId, r);
                }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Does the bridge carry this channel at all? */
    public static synchronized MapRow rowFor(Context ctx, String tvgBaseId) {
        if (tvgBaseId == null) return null;
        if (mapIndex == null) mapIndex = indexById(map(ctx));
        return mapIndex.get(tvgBaseId);
    }

    /** fileUrl → (xmlId → tvgId) bridges, for the parser. */
    public static Map<String, Map<String, String>> bridges(Context ctx) {
        Map<String, Map<String, String>> out = new HashMap<>();
        for (MapRow r : map(ctx)) {
            Map<String, String> b = out.get(r.fileUrl);
            if (b == null) { b = new HashMap<>(); out.put(r.fileUrl, b); }
            b.put(r.xmlId, r.tvgId);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The distinct hosted files covering any of these channels. */
    public static List<String> filesFor(Context ctx, List<String> tvgBaseIds) {
        return filesFor(ctx, new java.util.HashSet<>(tvgBaseIds));
    }

    /** Set form (v0.12.1): the List form's contains() made the
     *  bridge scan quadratic in the channel count. */
    public static List<String> filesFor(Context ctx,
                                        java.util.Set<String> tvgBaseIds) {
        Map<String, Boolean> wanted = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (MapRow r : map(ctx)) {
            if (tvgBaseIds.contains(r.tvgId)) wanted.put(r.fileUrl, Boolean.TRUE);
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(wanted.keySet());
    }

    /** Cache-file key for a source file URL. */
    public static String sourceKey(String fileUrl) {
        String s = fileUrl.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", "");
        return s.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- state

    public static synchronized Map<String, SourceState> state(Context ctx) {
        Map<String, SourceState> out = new HashMap<>();
        String text = MemoryHook.read(ctx, MemoryHook.GUIDE_STATE);
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String probe = line.trim();
            if (probe.isEmpty() || probe.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String s = line.endsWith("\r")
                    ? line.substring(0, line.length() - 1) : line;
            String[] c = s.split("\t", -1);
            if (c.length < 3) continue;
            try {
                SourceState ss = new SourceState();
                ss.fetchedAtMs = Long.parseLong(c[1]);
                ss.etag = TimerModel.dec(c[2]);
                out.put(TimerModel.dec(c[0]), ss);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static synchronized void saveState(Context ctx,
                                               Map<String, SourceState> st) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy guide freshness - file url, fetched-at ms, etag.\n");
        for (Map.Entry<String, SourceState> e : st.entrySet()) {
            sb.append(TimerModel.enc(e.getKey())).append('\t')
              .append(e.getValue().fetchedAtMs).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(e.getValue().etag)).append('\n');
        }
        MemoryHook.write(ctx, MemoryHook.GUIDE_STATE, sb.toString());
    }

    /** A source is stale when never fetched or fetched > 6h ago. */
    public static boolean stale(SourceState ss, long nowMs) {
        return ss == null || ss.fetchedAtMs == 0
                || nowMs - ss.fetchedAtMs > 6 * 3600_000L;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- fetch

    public static final class FetchResult {
        public int filesOk = 0, filesFailed = 0, programmes = 0;
        public boolean anyOk() { return filesOk > 0; }
    }

    /**
     * Fetch + parse + file the given source files (blocking — call
     * off the UI thread). A failed file keeps its old cache and its
     * old freshness stamp: the label on the guide's face stays true.
     */
    public static synchronized FetchResult fetch(Context ctx, List<String> fileUrls) {
        FetchResult res = new FetchResult();
        Map<String, Map<String, String>> bridges = bridges(ctx);
        Map<String, SourceState> st = state(ctx);
        for (String fileUrl : fileUrls) {
            Map<String, String> bridge = bridges.get(fileUrl);
            if (bridge == null || bridge.isEmpty()) continue;
            try {
                HttpURLConnection c = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(fileUrl).openConnection();
                c.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                c.setReadTimeout(60000);
                c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", Net.UA);
                SourceState old = st.get(fileUrl);
                if (old != null && !old.etag.isEmpty()) {
                    c.setRequestProperty("If-None-Match", old.etag);
                }
                int code = c.getResponseCode();
                if (code == HttpURLConnection.HTTP_NOT_MODIFIED) {
                    SourceState ss = old == null ? new SourceState() : old;
                    ss.fetchedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    st.put(fileUrl, ss);
                    res.filesOk++;
                    continue;
                }
                if (code != HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK) {
                    res.filesFailed++;
                    continue;
                }
                InputStream in = c.getInputStream();
                if (fileUrl.endsWith(".gz")) in = new GZIPInputStream(in);
                // Pipe evidence (v0.12.1): a guide fetch is a real,
                // timed transfer — count it and feed the meter, so
                // the connection statement rests on measurement.
                final long[] byteCount = {0};
                final long fetchStart = System.currentTimeMillis();
                InputStream raw = in;
                in = new java.io.FilterInputStream(raw) {
                    @Override public int read() throws java.io.IOException {
                        int b = super.read();
                        if (b >= 0) byteCount[0]++;
                        return b;
                    }
                    @Override public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len)
                            throws java.io.IOException {
                        int n = super.read(b, off, len);
                        if (n > 0) byteCount[0] += n;
                        return n;
                    }
                };
                GuideModel.GuideData data;
                try {
                    data = XmltvParser.parse(in, bridge);
                } finally {
                    try { in.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                }
                PipeMeter.sample(ctx, byteCount[0],
                        System.currentTimeMillis() - fetchStart);
                writeCache(ctx, fileUrl, data);
                SourceState ss = new SourceState();
                ss.fetchedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
                ss.etag = c.getHeaderField("ETag");
                if (ss.etag == null) ss.etag = "";
                st.put(fileUrl, ss);
                res.filesOk++;
                res.programmes += countProgrammes(data);
                dataCache = null;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                res.filesFailed++;
            }
        }
        saveState(ctx, st);
        return res;
    }

    private static int countProgrammes(GuideModel.GuideData d) {
        int n = 0;
        for (List<GuideModel.Programme> rows : d.byChannel.values()) n += rows.size();
        return n;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- cache

    private static void writeCache(Context ctx, String fileUrl,
                                   GuideModel.GuideData data) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy guide cache - channel, start, stop, title, desc,\n");
        sb.append("# category (epochs, url-encoded text). Source: ")
          .append(fileUrl).append('\n');
        long cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - 6 * 3600_000L;
        for (Map.Entry<String, List<GuideModel.Programme>> e
                : data.byChannel.entrySet()) {
            for (GuideModel.Programme p : e.getValue()) {
                if (p.stopMs <= cutoff) continue;
                sb.append(TimerModel.enc(p.channelId)).append('\t')
                  .append(p.startMs).append('\t')
                  .append(p.stopMs).append('\t')
                  .append(TimerModel.enc(p.title)).append('\t')
                  .append(TimerModel.enc(p.desc)).append('\t')
                  .append(TimerModel.enc(p.category)).append('\n');
            }
        }
        MemoryHook.writeFile(MemoryHook.guideFile(ctx, sourceKey(fileUrl)),
                sb.toString());
    }

    /** All filed programmes, pruned to the live window. Cached. */
    public static synchronized GuideModel.GuideData data(Context ctx) {
        if (dataCache != null) return dataCache;
        GuideModel.GuideData d = new GuideModel.GuideData();
        File dir = MemoryHook.guideDir(ctx);
        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
        if (files != null) {
            for (File f : files) {
                if (!f.getName().endsWith(".tsv")) continue;
                String text = MemoryHook.readFile(f);
                for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
                    // No trim: a programme with an empty category
                    // still has six fields, and trim() would eat
                    // the last separator and drop the row.
                    String probe = line.trim();
                    if (probe.isEmpty() || probe.startsWith("#")) continue;
                    String s = line.endsWith("\r")
                            ? line.substring(0, line.length() - 1) : line;
                    String[] c = s.split("\t", -1);
                    if (c.length < 6) continue;
                    try {
                        d.add(new GuideModel.Programme(
                                TimerModel.dec(c[0]),
                                Long.parseLong(c[1]), Long.parseLong(c[2]),
                                TimerModel.dec(c[3]), TimerModel.dec(c[4]),
                                TimerModel.dec(c[5])));
                    } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
                }
            }
        }
        d.finish();
        d.prune(System.currentTimeMillis() - 6 * 3600_000L);
        dataCache = d;
        return d;
    }

    public static synchronized void invalidateData() { dataCache = null; }

    /** Base tvg-id of a channel (strip any @feed suffix). */
    public static String baseId(String tvgId) {
        if (tvgId == null) return "";
        int at = tvgId.indexOf('@');
        return at < 0 ? tvgId : tvgId.substring(0, at);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/HallucinationGuard.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The hallucination guard (v0.6.0) — a hard requirement from the
 * phone-class bench (work/dub-lab/PHONE-BENCH-2026-10-17.md), not a
 * nicety. On real anime audio, EVERY recognizer tested fabricated
 * lines over dialogue-free music/effects, and the pipeline happily
 * translated the inventions into finished subtitles:
 *
 *   base:  「JR東日本E233系電車」 — "JRE233 train." — three times
 *          (a 2010s Tokyo commuter train, hallucinated into a
 *          1945 film)
 *   tiny:  「王様はワンクにの知ちたりです」 — "The king knows the
 *          mink." — five times
 *   base also turned music-passage filler (「ん」) into "Mm-hmm."
 *          subtitles, four in a row.
 *
 * The fabrications are mechanically detectable: they repeat verbatim
 * and they sit in windows the recognizer itself scores as
 * non-speech / low-confidence. This guard is the mechanical check,
 * run on the SOURCE segments before anything is translated or
 * rendered. A dropped segment is never translated, never voiced,
 * never shown. A flagged segment is kept but marked — uncertainty is
 * shown, never silently polished (UTX Law 3).
 *
 * Pure logic (no Android imports); the harness feeds it the bench's
 * real segment files, fabrications included.
 */
public final class HallucinationGuard {

    /** One recognizer segment, with the scores the recognizer gave it. */
    public static final class Segment {
        public double start, end;
        public String text = "";
        public double avgLogprob = 0.0;
        public double noSpeechProb = 0.0;
        public Segment() {}
        public Segment(double start, double end, String text,
                       double avgLogprob, double noSpeechProb) {
            this.start = start; this.end = end; this.text = text;
            this.avgLogprob = avgLogprob; this.noSpeechProb = noSpeechProb;
        }
        public double duration() { return Math.max(0.0, end - start); }
    }

    public enum Verdict { KEEP, FLAG, DROP }

    public static final class Decision {
        public Verdict verdict = Verdict.KEEP;
        public String reason = "";
    }

    public static final class Result {
        public final List<Decision> decisions = new ArrayList<>();
        public int kept, flagged, dropped;
        /** The segments that survive (KEEP + FLAG), in order. */
        public List<Segment> surviving(List<Segment> in) {
            List<Segment> out = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < in.size(); i++) {
                if (decisions.get(i).verdict != Verdict.DROP) out.add(in.get(i));
            }
            return out;
        }
        /** True when segment i survived but was marked uncertain. */
        public boolean isFlagged(int i) {
            return decisions.get(i).verdict == Verdict.FLAG;
        }
    }

    // Thresholds — named, and justified by the bench numbers:
    /** The recognizer itself says this window is probably not speech. */
    public static final double NO_SPEECH_DROP = 0.60;
    /** Below this average logprob the text is not trustworthy at all. */
    public static final double LOGPROB_DROP = -1.05;
    /** Below this, keep the line but mark it uncertain. */
    public static final double LOGPROB_FLAG = -0.80;
    /** An occurrence counts toward a repetition pattern when suspect. */
    public static final double SUSPECT_NO_SPEECH = 0.35;
    public static final double SUSPECT_DURATION = 1.2;
    /** Unbroken runs longer than this get a second look. */
    public static final double LONG_BLOB_SEC = 25.0;

    private HallucinationGuard() {}

    /** Text identity for repetition detection: letters/digits only. */
    public static String normalize(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) sb.append(Character.toLowerCase(c));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static boolean suspect(Segment s) {
        return s.noSpeechProb >= SUSPECT_NO_SPEECH
                || s.avgLogprob <= LOGPROB_FLAG
                || s.duration() <= SUSPECT_DURATION;
    }

    public static Result apply(List<Segment> in) {
        Result r = new Result();
        int n = in.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) r.decisions.add(new Decision());

        // Repetition census over the whole cook: a line invented over
        // music comes back verbatim, again and again. Real repeated
        // dialogue ("Run! Run!") is short, loud and confidently heard
        // — the suspect test is what separates the two.
        Map<String, List<Integer>> byText = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String key = normalize(in.get(i).text);
            if (key.isEmpty()) continue;
            byText.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(i);
        }
        boolean[] repetitionDrop = new boolean[n];
        boolean[] fillerDrop = new boolean[n];
        for (Map.Entry<String, List<Integer>> e : byText.entrySet()) {
            List<Integer> idxs = e.getValue();
            if (idxs.size() < 3) continue;
            int suspects = 0;
            double noSpeechSum = 0;
            for (int i : idxs) {
                if (suspect(in.get(i))) suspects++;
                noSpeechSum += in.get(i).noSpeechProb;
            }
            if (suspects * 2 >= idxs.size()) {
                for (int i : idxs) repetitionDrop[i] = true;
            } else if (e.getKey().length() <= 2 && idxs.size() >= 4) {
                // A one-or-two-character filler (「ん」) looped over
                // a music passage — the bench's "Mm-hmm." x4 case:
                // base emitted the hum 13 times; the looped copies
                // are the ones the recognizer was lukewarm about
                // (logprob <= -0.50 or noSpeech >= 0.30). A real
                // backchannel said once or twice, confidently,
                // survives untouched.
                for (int i : idxs) {
                    Segment s = in.get(i);
                    if (s.avgLogprob <= -0.50 || s.noSpeechProb >= 0.30) {
                        fillerDrop[i] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Segment s = in.get(i);
            Decision d = r.decisions.get(i);
            if (repetitionDrop[i]) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.DROP;
                d.reason = "the same line came back again and again over "
                        + "windows the recognizer scored as not-speech — "
                        + "an invention, not dialogue";
            } else if (fillerDrop[i]) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.DROP;
                d.reason = "a filler sound looped over a passage with "
                        + "no speech in it";
            } else if (s.noSpeechProb >= NO_SPEECH_DROP) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.DROP;
                d.reason = "the recognizer scored this window as "
                        + "probably not speech";
            } else if (s.avgLogprob <= LOGPROB_DROP) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.DROP;
                d.reason = "the recognizer was too unsure of these "
                        + "words to pass them on";
            } else if (s.duration() > LONG_BLOB_SEC && s.avgLogprob <= LOGPROB_FLAG) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.DROP;
                d.reason = "one long unbroken run the recognizer was "
                        + "unsure of — the run-on blob case";
            } else if (s.duration() > LONG_BLOB_SEC) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.FLAG;
                d.reason = "one long unbroken run — kept, but marked";
            } else if (s.avgLogprob <= LOGPROB_FLAG) {
                d.verdict = Verdict.FLAG;
                d.reason = "the recognizer was unsure of these words — "
                        + "kept, but marked";
            }
            switch (d.verdict) {
                case DROP: r.dropped++; break;
                case FLAG: r.flagged++; break;
                default: r.kept++;
            }
        }
        return r;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Haptics.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.VibrationEffect;
import android.os.Vibrator;

/**
 * The rumble hookups (v0.5.0, item 7): short vibration cues on the
 * events a viewer should be able to FEEL — playback starting, a
 * verification run finishing, a recording starting. James's ruling:
 * built for deaf viewers, good for everybody ("It's more engaging
 * for the experience"). One Settings toggle, default ON; phones
 * without a vibrator simply stay silent.
 */
public final class Haptics {

    private Haptics() {}

    /** One short pulse (~60 ms). */
    public static void pulse(Context ctx) {
        buzz(ctx, new long[]{0, 60}, 40);
    }

    /** Two pulses — the "done / go" shape (verification complete). */
    public static void goSign(Context ctx) {
        buzz(ctx, new long[]{0, 70, 90, 70}, 60);
    }

    private static void buzz(Context ctx, long[] pattern, int amplitudeHint) {
        try {
            if (!ChannelStore.getRumble(ctx)) return;
            Vibrator v = (Vibrator) ctx.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE);
            if (v == null || !v.hasVibrator()) return;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                int[] amps = new int[pattern.length];
                for (int i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
                    amps[i] = i % 2 == 1 ? 160 : 0;
                }
                v.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createWaveform(pattern, amps, -1));
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                v.vibrate(pattern, -1);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // a cue must never crash the thing it announces
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/HealthStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileReader;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Persisted link-health verdicts (v0.3.0, tiered in v0.4.0). Probing a
 * big shelf costs time and goodwill, so verdicts survive the session:
 * every probe — manual Verify, tap-time check, background auto-fresh,
 * and every real play (READY = plays, failure = dead) — writes here,
 * and badges, filters and surf order read from here. James's point
 * stands: "things maneuver," so verdicts also carry WHEN they were
 * earned, and freshness is the caller's business (auto-fresh re-probes
 * anything older than 6 hours).
 *
 * v0.4.0 tiers (LinkHealth.TIER_*): PLAYS / CONNECTS / DEAD replace the
 * 0.3.0 OK/DEAD binary, and each record keeps a dead streak — how many
 * verdicts in a row came back DEAD — because a link that has died
 * three times running is a different animal from one having a bad day.
 *
 * Storage: filesDir/health2.tsv, tab-separated, URL-encoded fields:
 *   enc(url) \t tier \t checkedAt \t deadStreak \t enc(detail)
 * The 0.3.0 health.tsv (url \t status \t checkedAt \t detail) is
 * migrated once, honestly: an old OK only ever proved the playlist
 * answered, so it lands as CONNECTS, never PLAYS; an old DEAD stays
 * DEAD with a streak of 1. Unknown rows are skipped, never guessed.
 */
public final class HealthStore {

    public static final class Health {
        public final int tier;
        public final long checkedAt;
        public final int deadStreak;
        public final String detail;
        Health(int tier, long checkedAt, int deadStreak, String detail) {
            this.tier = tier;
            this.checkedAt = checkedAt;
            this.deadStreak = deadStreak;
            this.detail = detail == null ? "" : detail;
        }
    }

    private static Map<String, Health> cache;
    private static boolean dirty;

    private HealthStore() {}

    private static File file(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "health2.tsv");
    }

    private static File legacyFile(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "health.tsv");
    }

    public static synchronized Map<String, Health> load(Context ctx) {
        if (cache != null) return cache;
        cache = new HashMap<>();
        File f = file(ctx);
        if (f.isFile()) {
            readInto(f, cache, false);
        } else {
            // First 0.4.0 launch: carry the 0.3.0 verdicts forward at
            // their honest new weight (see class doc).
            File legacy = legacyFile(ctx);
            if (legacy.isFile()) {
                readInto(legacy, cache, true);
                dirty = true;
                saveLocked(ctx);
            }
        }
        return cache;
    }

    private static void readInto(File f, Map<String, Health> into, boolean legacy) {
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(f))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
                String[] p = line.split("\t", -1);
                try {
                    if (legacy) {
                        if (p.length < 3) continue;
                        int old = Integer.parseInt(p[1]);
                        int tier = old == 1 ? LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS : LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD;
                        into.put(dec(p[0]), new Health(tier, Long.parseLong(p[2]),
                                tier == LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD ? 1 : 0,
                                p.length > 3 ? dec(p[3]) : ""));
                    } else {
                        if (p.length < 4) continue;
                        int tier = Integer.parseInt(p[1]);
                        into.put(dec(p[0]), new Health(tier, Long.parseLong(p[2]),
                                Integer.parseInt(p[3]),
                                p.length > 4 ? dec(p[4]) : ""));
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // a torn line is skipped, never guessed at
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public static synchronized Health get(Context ctx, String url) {
        if (url == null) return null;
        return load(ctx).get(url);
    }

    /** Records a verdict (called from probe sinks on worker threads). */
    public static synchronized void recordQuiet(Context ctx, String url,
                                                LinkHealth.Result r) {
        if (url == null || r == null) return;
        // v0.11.0: a SLOW outcome is not a verdict on the link's life
        // (James's field report — a slow server got filed DEAD and
        // wore the ✗ until a manual re-tap). Nothing is filed: any
        // earlier verdict stands, and the next probe decides fresh.
        if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD && r.slow) return;
        Map<String, Health> m = load(ctx);
        Health prev = m.get(url);
        int streak = 0;
        if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD) {
            streak = (prev == null ? 0 : prev.deadStreak) + 1;
        }
        m.put(url, new Health(r.tier, r.checkedAt, streak, r.detail));
        dirty = true;
    }

    /** Records a verdict and writes through immediately (tap-time events). */
    public static synchronized void record(Context ctx, String url,
                                           LinkHealth.Result r) {
        recordQuiet(ctx, url, r);
        saveLocked(ctx);
    }

    /** Writes pending verdicts; safe to call any time, no-ops when clean. */
    public static synchronized void save(Context ctx) {
        if (!dirty && cache != null) return;
        saveLocked(ctx);
    }

    private static void saveLocked(Context ctx) {
        if (cache == null) return;
        try (FileWriter w = new FileWriter(file(ctx), false)) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, Health> e : cache.entrySet()) {
                Health h = e.getValue();
                w.write(enc(e.getKey()) + "\t" + h.tier + "\t" + h.checkedAt
                        + "\t" + h.deadStreak + "\t" + enc(h.detail) + "\n");
            }
            dirty = false;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** {plays, connects, dead} over every recorded verdict. */
    public static synchronized int[] counts(Context ctx) {
        int plays = 0, connects = 0, dead = 0;
        for (Health h : load(ctx).values()) {
            if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) plays++;
            else if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) connects++;
            else dead++;
        }
        return new int[]{plays, connects, dead};
    }

    /**
     * Surf rank for lists (Mom-first ordering): segment-proven first,
     * then never-checked, then connects-only, then dead — and a link
     * that has died 3+ verdicts running sinks below everything, bad
     * day or not. Lower is earlier.
     */
    public static int surfRank(Health h) {
        if (h == null) return 1;
        if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) return 0;
        if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) return 2;
        return h.deadStreak >= 3 ? 4 : 3;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- badges

    public static String badgeSymbol(Health h) {
        if (h == null) return "";
        if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) return "✓ ";
        if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) return "~ ";
        return "✗ ";
    }

    /** The second line a row shows; "" when there is no verdict yet. */
    public static String badgeText(Health h, long now) {
        if (h == null) return "";
        String when = LinkHealth.friendlyWhen(h.checkedAt, now);
        if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) return "✓ Plays · verified " + when;
        if (h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) {
            return "~ Connects · video unproven · " + when
                    + (h.detail.isEmpty() ? "" : " (" + h.detail + ")");
        }
        return "✗ Not working · checked " + when
                + (h.detail.isEmpty() ? "" : " (" + h.detail + ")");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- urls

    private static final char[] HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF".toCharArray();

    static String enc(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        byte[] bytes = s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(bytes.length);
        for (byte value : bytes) {
            int c = value & 0xff;
            boolean safe = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')
                    || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
                    || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '~';
            if (safe) b.append((char) c);
            else b.append('%').append(HEX[(c >> 4) & 0xf]).append(HEX[c & 0xf]);
        }
        return b.toString();
    }

    static String dec(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream out = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '%' && i + 2 < s.length()) {
                try {
                    out.write(Integer.parseInt(s.substring(i + 1, i + 3), 16));
                    i += 2;
                    continue;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            out.write((byte) c);
        }
        return new String(out.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    /** For the harness / future callers: a stable snapshot list. */
    public static List<String> knownUrls(Context ctx) {
        return new ArrayList<>(load(ctx).keySet());
    }
}

import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The catalog home — the streaming-service face.
 *
 * v0.10.0 — the ON-DEMAND EXPANSION (James's order): LANGUAGE IS THE
 * FRONT DOOR. The catalogue is the TVmaze index, gathered onto the
 * phone page by page and filed by each show's own language, so picking
 * a language rebuilds the wall around that language's shows — their
 * countries as shelves (Spain and Mexico are two shelves of Spanish,
 * never one), their titles in their own names. Country chips scrub
 * inside the language; a country door stands beside it. Tiles say
 * honestly what they are: "On your shelves" only on evidence (a
 * loaded source, a file on this phone, or an Archive find a past
 * Sources visit actually made) — everything else is marked
 * "Catalog only". Proven-available tiles are never truncated; the
 * gathered counts are the phone's own, stated as gathered.
 */
public class HomeActivity extends Activity {

    private static final long CATALOG_TTL_MS = 12L * 3600L * 1000L;
    private static final int WALK_CHUNK = 12;     // index pages per walk
    private static final int GRID_CHUNK = 90;     // country grid growth
    private static final int SHELF_CAP = 40;      // preview cap per country shelf

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private ScrollView catalogScroll;
    private LinearLayout sectionsBox;
    private LinearLayout langChipRow;
    private HorizontalScrollView countryScroll;
    private LinearLayout countryChipRow;
    private HorizontalScrollView facetScroll;
    private LinearLayout facetChipRow;
    private ListView resultsList;
    private ListView myShowsList;
    private TextView myShowsEmpty;
    private TextView statusView;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private EditText searchBox;
    private Button catalogTab, myShowsTab;

    private List<TvMaze.Show> searchResults = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<TvMaze.Show> watchlist = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean loading = false;

    // v0.11.1 findability: the facet cut + sort standing on the
    // wall right now (persisted, like the wall's language/country).
    // "" = no cut on that axis; CatalogIndex.NOT_LISTED is the
    // "lists none" value. resultsMode steers the results list:
    // "shows" (title search) | "people" | "credits" (actor search).
    private final CatalogIndex.FacetSet facets = new CatalogIndex.FacetSet();
    private CatalogIndex.SortMode facetSort = CatalogIndex.SortMode.BEST;
    private String resultsMode = "shows";
    private List<TvMaze.Person> peopleResults = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<CatalogIndex.Record> creditResults = new ArrayList<>();

    // the gathered index + the wall's stance
    private final Map<Integer, CatalogIndex.Record> gathered = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private CatalogIndex.State indexState = new CatalogIndex.State();
    private List<TvMaze.Show> airingToday = new ArrayList<>();
    private Availability.Shelf shelf;
    private final Set<Integer> availIds = new HashSet<>();
    // v0.11.0: holds the wall's TVmaze LANGUAGE NAME ("" = all
    // languages) — the wall was decoupled from the interface tables,
    // so any language TVmaze carries can stand here, spoken or not.
    // (The field kept its old name to keep the diff honest and small;
    // the persisted pref is the new "wall_lang_name", migrated below.)
    private String wallLangCode = "";   // "" = all languages

    /** A wall pick handed over by LanguageIndexActivity. */
    public static String pendingWallLanguage = "";
    private String wallCountry = "";    // "" = every country shelf
    private int wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
    private final Map<Integer, Boolean> availMemo = new HashMap<>();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        // v0.11.0 migration: the wall key used to be an interface
        // language CODE ("fa"); it is a TVmaze language NAME now
        // ("Persian"). A legacy code translates through the facet
        // bridge exactly once; the name is what gets kept.
        wallLangCode = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).getString("wall_lang_name", null);
        if (wallLangCode == null) {
            String legacy = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString("wall_lang_code", "");
            String facet = UiStrings.facetFor(legacy);
            // Every real interface code has a facet; a longer legacy
            // value can only already be a name (defensive), anything
            // else falls back to All rather than a phantom wall.
            wallLangCode = !facet.isEmpty() ? facet
                    : (legacy.length() > 3 ? legacy : "");
            getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                    .putString("wall_lang_name", wallLangCode).apply();
        }
        wallCountry = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).getString("wall_country", "");

        // v0.11.1: restore the standing facet cut + sort. The
        // "not listed" value rides prefs as plain text (see
        // facetPrefRead) — the sentinel itself never touches XML.
        facets.genre = facetPrefRead("facet_genre");
        facets.type = facetPrefRead("facet_type");
        facets.status = facetPrefRead("facet_status");
        facets.yearLo = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).getInt("facet_year_lo", -1);
        facets.yearHi = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).getInt("facet_year_hi", -1);
        facets.yearNotListed = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getBoolean("facet_year_nl", false);
        int sortOrd = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).getInt("facet_sort", 0);
        CatalogIndex.SortMode[] modes = CatalogIndex.SortMode.values();
        if (sortOrd >= 0 && sortOrd < modes.length) facetSort = modes[sortOrd];

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        int pad = dp(10);

        LinearLayout titleRow = new LinearLayout(this);

        vodBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, VodActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams vodLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        vodLp.topMargin = dp(16);
        catalogBox.addView(vodBtn, vodLp);

        // v0.3.0: the third door — the videos already on this phone
        Button libBtn = new Button(this);
        libBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "home_my_library"));
        libBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, LibraryActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams libLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        libLp.topMargin = dp(8);
        catalogBox.addView(libBtn, libLp);

        // v0.10.0: the country door, standing on its own
        Button countryBtn = new Button(this);
        countryBtn.setText("Browse by country — every language");
        countryBtn.setContentDescription(countryBtn.getText());
        countryBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, CountryIndexActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams countryLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        countryLp.topMargin = dp(8);
        catalogBox.addView(countryBtn, countryLp);
        catalogScroll.addView(catalogBox);
        content.addView(catalogScroll);

        // ---- search results pane
        resultsList = new ListView(this);
        resultsList.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        resultsList.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        resultsList.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            if ("people".equals(resultsMode)) {
                if (pos < peopleResults.size()) openPerson(peopleResults.get(pos));
            } else if ("credits".equals(resultsMode)) {
                if (pos < creditResults.size()) openShow(creditResults.get(pos));
            } else if (pos < searchResults.size()) {
                openShow(searchResults.get(pos));
            }
        });
        content.addView(resultsList);

        // ---- my shows pane
        myShowsList = new ListView(this);
        myShowsList.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        myShowsList.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        myShowsList.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) ->
                openShow(watchlist.get(pos)));
        content.addView(myShowsList);
        myShowsEmpty = new TextView(this);
        myShowsEmpty.setText("No shows saved yet.\n\nOpen any show and tap “+ My Shows” — "
                + "it will wait for you here, with your place kept.");
        myShowsEmpty.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        myShowsEmpty.setTextSize(15);
        myShowsEmpty.setPadding(dp(8), dp(16), dp(8), 0);
        myShowsEmpty.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        content.addView(myShowsEmpty);

        setContentView(root);
        showPane(0);
        loadCatalog(false);
        // Auto-fresh also starts here (the boot screen starts it too;
        // FreshVerify's guards make the double trigger a no-op).
        FreshVerify.maybeRun(this,
                () -> ChannelStore.loadCache(getApplicationContext()), null);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (!pendingWallLanguage.isEmpty()) {
            String pick = pendingWallLanguage;
            pendingWallLanguage = "";
            pickLanguage(pick);
        }
        TimerReconcile.run(getApplicationContext());
        watchlist = ChannelStore.getWatchlist(this);
        ArrayAdapter<String> ad = new ArrayAdapter<>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1,
                new ArrayList<String>()) {
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                TvMaze.Show s = watchlist.get(pos);
                ((TextView) v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1)).setText(s.name);
                ((TextView) v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1)).setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                String meta = String.join(" · ", s.genres)
                        + (s.language.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  " + s.language)
                        + (s.status.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  " + s.status);
                ((TextView) v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2)).setText(meta);
                ((TextView) v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2))
                        .setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                return v;
            }
            @Override public int getCount() { return watchlist.size(); }
        };
        myShowsList.setAdapter(ad);
        if (myShowsList.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            myShowsEmpty.setVisibility(watchlist.isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            myShowsList.setVisibility(watchlist.isEmpty() ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    /** A big front door button, Story-door sized (v0.15.0). */
    private Button doorButton(String label, View.OnClickListener onClick) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setContentDescription(label);
        b.setTextSize(21);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setMinHeight(dp(68));
        b.setOnClickListener(onClick);
        return b;
    }

    private Button tabButton(String label, View.OnClickListener onClick) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setOnClickListener(onClick);
        return b;
    }

    private void showPane(int which) {
        catalogScroll.setVisibility(which == 0 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        resultsList.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        boolean shows = which == 1;
        myShowsList.setVisibility(shows && !watchlist.isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        myShowsEmpty.setVisibility(shows && watchlist.isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        catalogTab.setEnabled(which != 0);
        myShowsTab.setEnabled(which != 1);
    }

    private void openShow(TvMaze.Show s) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, ShowActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("showId", s.id);
        i.putExtra("showName", s.name);
        i.putExtra("showImage", s.imageMedium);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    private void openShow(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, ShowActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("showId", r.id);
        i.putExtra("showName", r.name);
        i.putExtra("showImage", r.image);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- the index walk

    private File catalogFile(String name) {
        File dir = new File(getFilesDir(), "catalog");
        if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
        return new File(dir, name);
    }

    private void loadCatalog(boolean force) {
        if (loading) return;
        loading = true;
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        statusView.setText(force ? "Refreshing the catalog…"
                : "Loading the catalog…");
        exec.execute(() -> {
            Exception failure = null;
            try {
                gathered.clear();
                gathered.putAll(CatalogStore.loadGathered(this));
                indexState = CatalogStore.loadState(this);
                CatalogIndex.recount(indexState, gathered.values());

                // v0.11.1 format heal: records gathered before the
                // TYPE field existed carry no type. A format-1 state
                // earns ONE re-walk from page 0 — mergeInto replaces
                // records by id as pages land, so the type arrives
                // honestly, from TVmaze, page by page; until a page
                // is re-walked its records read "not listed" on the
                // type facet, never a guess. The cache keeps serving
                // the wall the whole time.
                boolean typeHeal = false;
                if (indexState.format < CatalogIndex.State.FORMAT_TYPE
                        && !gathered.isEmpty()) {
                    indexState.format = CatalogIndex.State.FORMAT_TYPE;
                    indexState.pagesWalked = 0;
                    indexState.complete = false;
                    typeHeal = true;
                    CatalogStore.saveState(this, indexState);
                }

                // today's schedule (kept from cache inside its TTL)
                File sf = catalogFile("schedule.json");
                String scheduleJson;
                if (!force && sf.exists()
                        && System.currentTimeMillis() - sf.lastModified() < CATALOG_TTL_MS) {
                    scheduleJson = readFile(sf);
                } else {
                    String today = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US)
                            .format(new Date());
                    try {
                        scheduleJson = Net.getString(TvMaze.scheduleUrl("US", today));
                        writeFile(sf, scheduleJson);
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        scheduleJson = readFile(sf); // stale beats none
                        if (scheduleJson == null && gathered.isEmpty()) throw e;
                    }
                }
                airingToday = scheduleJson == null ? new ArrayList<>()
                        : TvMaze.parseScheduleShows(scheduleJson);

                // the walk: a first chunk on a fresh phone, a deepening
                // chunk on Refresh — afterwards the wall flies offline.
                if (gathered.isEmpty() || force || typeHeal) {
                    walkChunk(WALK_CHUNK);
                }
                shelf = CatalogStore.shelf(this);
                computeAvailIds();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                failure = e;
            }
            final Exception fFailure = failure;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                loading = false;
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                availMemo.clear();
                if (fFailure != null && gathered.isEmpty() && airingToday.isEmpty()) {
                    statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 140, 140));
                    statusView.setText("Couldn't load the catalog (" + shortErr(fFailure)
                            + "). Check the connection and tap Refresh.");
                    return;
                }
                renderWall();
            });
        });
    }

    /**
     * Walk up to maxPages more of the TVmaze index, filing every show
     * into its language bucket as we go. Buckets + walk state are
     * saved page by page, so quitting mid-walk loses nothing. A 404
     * (or an empty page) is the index honestly ending — not an error.
     */
    private void walkChunk(int maxPages) {
        // any walk this version runs writes the format-2 state:
        // its records carry type, fresh or re-gathered alike
        indexState.format = CatalogIndex.State.FORMAT_TYPE;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxPages && !indexState.complete; i++) {
            int page = indexState.pagesWalked;
            String json;
            try {
                json = Net.getString(TvMaze.showsPageUrl(page));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                if (e.getMessage() != null && e.getMessage().contains("404")) {
                    indexState.complete = true;
                }
                break; // connection trouble: keep what we have
            }
            List<TvMaze.Show> shows;
            try {
                shows = TvMaze.parseShows(json);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                break;
            }
            if (shows.isEmpty()) {
                indexState.complete = true;
                break;
            }
            Set<String> touched = new HashSet<>();
            for (TvMaze.Show s : shows) touched.add(s.language == null ? "" : s.language);
            CatalogIndex.mergeInto(gathered, shows);
            indexState.pagesWalked = page + 1;
            for (String lang : touched) {
                CatalogStore.saveBucket(this, gathered, lang);
            }
            CatalogStore.saveState(this, indexState);
        }
        CatalogIndex.recount(indexState, gathered.values());
        CatalogStore.saveState(this, indexState);
    }

    private void gatherMore() {
        if (loading) return;
        loading = true;
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        statusView.setText("Gathering more of the catalog…");
        exec.execute(() -> {
            int before = indexState.pagesWalked;
            walkChunk(WALK_CHUNK + 3);
            computeAvailIds();
            final int walked = indexState.pagesWalked - before;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                loading = false;
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                if (walked == 0 && !indexState.complete) {
                    Toast.makeText(this,
                            "The catalog didn't answer — check the connection.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                }
                renderWall();
            });
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- wall

    /** Precompute shelf-evidence verdicts off the UI thread: with a
     *  full index gathered this pass touches every record once, so
     *  rendering never pays it per tile. */
    private void computeAvailIds() {
        availIds.clear();
        if (shelf == null) return;
        for (CatalogIndex.Record r : gathered.values()) {
            if (shelf.carries(r.name)) availIds.add(r.id);
        }
    }

    private boolean isAvailable(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        Boolean memo = availMemo.get(r.id);
        if (memo != null) return memo;
        boolean v = availIds.contains(r.id)
                || ChannelStore.isArchiveProven(this, r.id);
        availMemo.put(r.id, v);
        return v;
    }

    private List<CatalogIndex.Record> availableOf(List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool) {
        List<CatalogIndex.Record> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CatalogIndex.Record r : pool) if (isAvailable(r)) out.add(r);
        CatalogIndex.sortShows(out);
        return out;
    }

    private String walkStateText() {
        if (indexState.complete) {
            return " The whole TVmaze index is gathered on this phone.";
        }
        return " The index walk has gathered " + indexState.pagesWalked
                + " pages so far — “Gather more” at the bottom walks further.";
    }

    /** The wall stands in LIST MODE when a facet cut or a
     *  non-default sort is standing: the pool flattens into one
     *  cut, sorted, growing grid instead of the curated shelves.
     *  Clearing both brings the shelves back. */
    private boolean listMode() {
        return facets.active() || facetSort != CatalogIndex.SortMode.BEST;
    }

    private void renderWall() {
        buildLangChips();
        sectionsBox.removeAllViews();
        List<CatalogIndex.Record> all = new ArrayList<>(gathered.values());

        if (wallLangCode.isEmpty()) {
            countryScroll.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            buildFacetBar(all);
            if (listMode()) {
                statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
                statusView.setText(facetSummary(all));
                addFacetGrid("Catalog", all);
                addGatherMoreIfNeeded();
                return;
            }
            statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
            statusView.setText("Catalog — " + gathered.size()
                    + " shows gathered from TVmaze." + walkStateText()
                    + " Pick a language above for its own wall.");
            List<CatalogIndex.Record> airing = new ArrayList<>();
            for (TvMaze.Show s : airingToday) airing.add(CatalogIndex.fromShow(s));
            addSection("Airing today", airing, 20);
            List<CatalogIndex.Record> avail = availableOf(all);
            if (!avail.isEmpty()) {
                addSection(LangStore.tr(this, "wall_available"), avail,
                        Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            List<CatalogIndex.Record> rated = new ArrayList<>();
