            for (CatalogIndex.Record r : all) if (r.rating > 0) rated.add(r);
            CatalogIndex.sortShows(rated);
            addSection("Top rated", rated, 24);
            Map<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>> byGenre = new HashMap<>();
            for (CatalogIndex.Record r : all) {
                for (String g : r.genres) {
                    byGenre.computeIfAbsent(g, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);
                }
            }
            List<Map.Entry<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>>> genreRows =
                    new ArrayList<>(byGenre.entrySet());
            Collections.sort(genreRows, (a, b) -> b.getValue().size() - a.getValue().size());
            for (Map.Entry<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>> e : genreRows) {
                if (e.getValue().size() < 4) continue;
                List<CatalogIndex.Record> members = new ArrayList<>(e.getValue());
                CatalogIndex.sortShows(members);
                addSection(e.getKey(), members, 16);
            }
        } else {
            String langName = wallLangCode; // a TVmaze name since v0.11.0
            List<CatalogIndex.Record> bucket = CatalogIndex.bucketOf(all, langName);
            LinkedHashMap<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>> shelves =
                    CatalogIndex.shelves(bucket, homeCountryName());
            if (!shelves.containsKey(wallCountry)) wallCountry = "";
            buildCountryChips(shelves, bucket.size());
            countryScroll.setVisibility(shelves.size() > 1
                    ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            int availCount = availableOf(bucket).size();
            statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
            statusView.setText(langName + " — " + bucket.size() + " shows gathered"
                    + (availCount > 0 ? " · " + availCount + " "
                        + LangStore.tr(this, "wall_available") : "")
                    + "." + walkStateText());

            // v0.11.1: the facet bar's pool is the wall you're
            // standing in — this language, narrowed to the picked
            // country when one is picked.
            List<CatalogIndex.Record> basePool = wallCountry.isEmpty()
                    ? bucket : shelves.get(wallCountry);
            if (basePool == null) basePool = new ArrayList<>();
            buildFacetBar(basePool);
            if (listMode()) {
                statusView.setText(facetSummary(basePool));
                addFacetGrid(wallCountry.isEmpty() ? langName
                        : langName + " · " + wallCountry, basePool);
            } else if (!wallCountry.isEmpty()) {
                addGridSection(wallCountry, shelves.get(wallCountry));
            } else {
                List<CatalogIndex.Record> avail = availableOf(bucket);
                if (!avail.isEmpty()) {
                    // proven-available tiles: present in full, never capped
                    addSection(LangStore.tr(this, "wall_available"), avail,
                            Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                }
                for (Map.Entry<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>> e : shelves.entrySet()) {
                    addSection(e.getKey(), e.getValue(), SHELF_CAP);
                    if (e.getValue().size() > SHELF_CAP) {
                        addSeeAllButton(langName, e.getKey(), e.getValue().size());
                    }
                }
                if (bucket.isEmpty()) {
                    addTextLine("Nothing in " + langName + " has been gathered yet — "
                            + "the index walk hasn't reached it. “Gather more” below "
                            + "walks further; a connection is needed to gather.");
                }
            }
        }

        addGatherMoreIfNeeded();
    }

    private void addGatherMoreIfNeeded() {
        if (!indexState.complete) {
            Button more = new Button(this);
            more.setText("Gather more of the catalog");
            more.setContentDescription(more.getText());
            more.setOnClickListener(v -> gatherMore());
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            lp.topMargin = dp(16);
            sectionsBox.addView(more, lp);
        }
    }

    private String homeCountryName() {
        try {
            return Locale.getDefault().getDisplayCountry(Locale.US);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private void buildLangChips() {
        langChipRow.removeAllViews();
        Button all = chip("All · " + gathered.size(), wallLangCode.isEmpty());
        all.setOnClickListener(v -> pickLanguage(""));
        langChipRow.addView(all);
        Set<String> spokenNames = new HashSet<>();
        for (String[] lang : UiStrings.LANGUAGES) {
            String code = lang[0];
            String name = lang[1];
            String tvName = CatalogIndex.languageNameForCode(code);
            spokenNames.add(tvName);
            int count = indexState.counts.getOrDefault(tvName, 0);
            Button b = chip(name + " · " + count, tvName.equals(wallLangCode));
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> pickLanguage(tvName));
            langChipRow.addView(b);
        }
        // A wall in a language Sandy doesn't speak still shows its
        // own chip while it stands, in its own script where known.
        if (!wallLangCode.isEmpty() && !spokenNames.contains(wallLangCode)) {
            String disp = LangRegistry.nativeNameFor(wallLangCode);
            if (disp.isEmpty()) disp = wallLangCode;
            int count = indexState.counts.getOrDefault(wallLangCode, 0);
            Button b = chip(disp + " · " + count, true);
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> pickLanguage(wallLangCode));
            langChipRow.addView(b);
        }
        Button more = chip(LangStore.tr(this, "home_more_languages") + " ▸", false);
        more.setOnClickListener(v -> startActivity(
                new Intent(this, LanguageIndexActivity.class)));
        langChipRow.addView(more);
    }

    private void pickLanguage(String tvName) {
        wallLangCode = tvName;
        wallCountry = "";
        wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
        availMemo.clear();
        getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putString("wall_lang_name", tvName)
                .putString("wall_country", "")
                .apply();
        renderWall();
    }

    private void buildCountryChips(
            LinkedHashMap<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>> shelves, int total) {
        countryChipRow.removeAllViews();
        Button all = chip("All countries · " + total, wallCountry.isEmpty());
        all.setOnClickListener(v -> pickCountry(""));
        countryChipRow.addView(all);
        for (Map.Entry<String, List<CatalogIndex.Record>> e : shelves.entrySet()) {
            Button b = chip(e.getKey() + " · " + e.getValue().size(),
                    e.getKey().equals(wallCountry));
            String shelfName = e.getKey();
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> pickCountry(shelfName));
            countryChipRow.addView(b);
        }
    }

    private void pickCountry(String shelfName) {
        wallCountry = shelfName;
        wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
        getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putString("wall_country", shelfName).apply();
        renderWall();
    }

    private Button chip(String label, boolean selected) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setEnabled(!selected);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.rightMargin = dp(6);
        b.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return b;
    }

    private void addSection(String title, List<CatalogIndex.Record> shows, int cap) {
        if (shows == null || shows.isEmpty()) return;
        TextView header = new TextView(this);
        header.setText(title);
        header.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
        header.setTextSize(16);
        header.setTypeface(header.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        header.setPadding(0, dp(14), 0, dp(6));
        sectionsBox.addView(header);

        HorizontalScrollView hscroll = new HorizontalScrollView(this);
        hscroll.setHorizontalScrollBarEnabled(false);
        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
        row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        int n = Math.min(cap, shows.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            row.addView(posterCard(shows.get(i)));
        }
        hscroll.addView(row);
        sectionsBox.addView(hscroll);
    }

    /** A whole country's tiles as a grid — scrollable end to end,
     *  growing by chunks; proven and catalogue-only tiles alike. */
    private void addGridSection(String shelfName, List<CatalogIndex.Record> shows) {
        if (shows == null) shows = new ArrayList<>();
        TextView header = new TextView(this);
        header.setText(shelfName + " — " + shows.size() + " shows");
        header.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
        header.setTextSize(16);
        header.setTypeface(header.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        header.setPadding(0, dp(14), 0, dp(6));
        sectionsBox.addView(header);

        int n = Math.min(wallGridShown, shows.size());
        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += 3) {
            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            for (int i = start; i < Math.min(start + 3, n); i++) {
                row.addView(gridCard(shows.get(i)));
            }
            for (int i = Math.min(start + 3, n); i < start + 3; i++) {
                row.addView(new View(this), new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            }
            sectionsBox.addView(row);
        }
        if (shows.size() > n) {
            Button more = new Button(this);
            more.setText("Show more — " + (shows.size() - n) + " more");
            more.setContentDescription(more.getText());
            more.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                wallGridShown += GRID_CHUNK;
                renderWall();
            });
            sectionsBox.addView(more);
        }
    }

    private void addSeeAllButton(String langName, String shelfName, int count) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText("See all " + count + " from " + shelfName + " →");
        b.setContentDescription(b.getText());
        b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, WallListActivity.class);
            i.putExtra("mode", "langCountry");
            i.putExtra("language", langName);
            i.putExtra("country", shelfName);
            startActivity(i);
        });
        sectionsBox.addView(b);
    }

    private void addTextLine(String text) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(text);
        t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        t.setTextSize(13);
        t.setPadding(0, dp(12), 0, 0);
        sectionsBox.addView(t);
    }

    private View posterCard(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
        card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        card.setPadding(dp(4), dp(2), dp(4), dp(2));
        card.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(116),
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        card.addView(posterImage(r, dp(108), dp(152)));
        card.addView(nameLine(r));
        if (r.rating > 0) card.addView(ratingLine(r));
        card.addView(markLine(r));
        applyCardState(card, r);
        card.setOnClickListener(v -> openShow(r));
        return card;
    }

    private View gridCard(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
        card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        card.setPadding(dp(4), dp(2), dp(4), dp(2));
        card.addView(posterImage(r, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(150)));
        card.addView(nameLine(r));
        if (r.rating > 0) card.addView(ratingLine(r));
        card.addView(markLine(r));
        applyCardState(card, r);
        card.setOnClickListener(v -> openShow(r));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        card.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return card;
    }

    /**
     * The Display Honesty Law on the card itself (v0.14.0): a
     * catalogue-only title renders VISIBLY distinct — the whole
     * card dimmed, its spoken description carrying the catalog-
     * only words — so no one mistakes the catalogue's knowledge
     * that a show exists for a promise that Sandy can play it.
     * The tap is never where the viewer learns the truth.
     */
    private void applyCardState(LinearLayout card, CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        int st = CardState.forShow(isAvailable(r), false);
        card.setAlpha(CardState.alphaFor(st));
        card.setContentDescription(CardState.playPromise(st)
                ? r.name
                : r.name + " — " + LangStore.tr(this,
                        CardState.labelKey(st)));
    }

    private ImageView posterImage(CatalogIndex.Record r, int w, int h) {
        ImageView img = new ImageView(this);
        img.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        img.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(34, 34, 42));
        img.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(w, h));
        ImageCache.load(this, r.image, img);
        return img;
    }

    private TextView nameLine(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        TextView name = new TextView(this);
        name.setText(r.name);
        name.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        name.setTextSize(12);
        name.setMaxLines(2);
        return name;
    }

    private TextView ratingLine(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        TextView rating = new TextView(this);
        rating.setText("★ " + String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", r.rating));
        rating.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 60));
        rating.setTextSize(11);
        return rating;
    }

    /** The honest mark every wall tile carries (v0.10.0): green when a
     *  shelf of the user's own actually carries it, grey when it is the
     *  catalogue alone. Never ambiguous, never absent. */
    private TextView markLine(CatalogIndex.Record r) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        int st = CardState.forShow(isAvailable(r), false);
        if (CardState.playPromise(st)) {
            t.setText("✓ " + LangStore.tr(this, "wall_available"));
            t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(120, 220, 120));
            t.setTextSize(10);
        } else {
            // catalog-only is a headline on the card, not a
            // footnote (v0.14.0): bigger, brighter, unmissable
            t.setText(LangStore.tr(this, CardState.labelKey(st)));
            t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 170, 110));
            t.setTextSize(12);
            t.setTypeface(t.getTypeface(), android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        }
        t.setMaxLines(1);
        return t;
    }

    // ------------------------------------- facets (v0.11.1)

    private String facetPrefRead(String key) {
        String v = getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).getString(key, "");
        return "NOT_LISTED".equals(v) ? CatalogIndex.NOT_LISTED : v;
    }

    private static String facetPrefWrite(String v) {
        return CatalogIndex.NOT_LISTED.equals(v) ? "NOT_LISTED" : v;
    }

    private void saveFacetPrefs() {
        getPreferences(MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putString("facet_genre", facetPrefWrite(facets.genre))
                .putString("facet_type", facetPrefWrite(facets.type))
                .putString("facet_status", facetPrefWrite(facets.status))
                .putInt("facet_year_lo", facets.yearLo)
                .putInt("facet_year_hi", facets.yearHi)
                .putBoolean("facet_year_nl", facets.yearNotListed)
                .putInt("facet_sort", facetSort.ordinal())
                .apply();
    }

    /** The standing pick's label for one text axis. */
    private String axisLabel(String v) {
        if (v == null || v.isEmpty()) return LangStore.tr(this, "facet_all");
        if (CatalogIndex.NOT_LISTED.equals(v)) {
            return LangStore.tr(this, "facet_not_listed");
        }
        return v;
    }

    private String yearFacetLabel() {
        if (facets.yearNotListed) return LangStore.tr(this, "facet_not_listed");
        if (facets.yearLo < 0) return LangStore.tr(this, "facet_all");
        if (facets.yearLo == facets.yearHi) return String.valueOf(facets.yearLo);
        if (facets.yearHi - facets.yearLo == 9 && facets.yearLo % 10 == 0) {
            return facets.yearLo + "s";
        }
        return facets.yearLo + "–" + facets.yearHi;
    }

    private String sortLabel() {
        switch (facetSort) {
            case AZ: return LangStore.tr(this, "sort_az");
            case ZA: return LangStore.tr(this, "sort_za");
            case NEWEST: return LangStore.tr(this, "sort_newest");
            case OLDEST: return LangStore.tr(this, "sort_oldest");
            default: return LangStore.tr(this, "sort_best");
        }
    }

    /** The bar itself: one button per axis, labeled with its
     *  standing pick. Options inside the dialogs are cut from the
     *  pool passed here — the wall the user is standing in. */
    private void buildFacetBar(List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool) {
        facetChipRow.removeAllViews();
        facetScroll.setVisibility(pool == null || pool.isEmpty()
                ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        if (pool == null || pool.isEmpty()) return;
        addFacetButton(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_genre") + ": " + axisLabel(facets.genre),
                v -> pickTextFacet("genre", pool));
        addFacetButton(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_year") + ": " + yearFacetLabel(),
                v -> pickYearFacet(pool));
        addFacetButton(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_type") + ": " + axisLabel(facets.type),
                v -> pickTextFacet("type", pool));
        addFacetButton(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_status") + ": " + axisLabel(facets.status),
                v -> pickTextFacet("status", pool));
        addFacetButton(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_sort") + ": " + sortLabel(),
                v -> pickSort());
        if (facets.active()) {
            addFacetButton(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_clear"), v -> {
                facets.genre = "";
                facets.type = "";
                facets.status = "";
                facets.yearLo = -1;
                facets.yearHi = -1;
                facets.yearNotListed = false;
                saveFacetPrefs();
                wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
                renderWall();
            });
        }
    }

    private void addFacetButton(String label, View.OnClickListener onClick) {
        Button b = chip(label, false);
        b.setOnClickListener(onClick);
        facetChipRow.addView(b);
    }

    private void pickTextFacet(String axis, List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool) {
        LinkedHashMap<String, Integer> counts = CatalogIndex.facetCounts(pool, axis);
        List<String> values = new ArrayList<>(counts.keySet());
        String current = "genre".equals(axis) ? facets.genre
                : "type".equals(axis) ? facets.type : facets.status;
        String[] items = new String[values.size() + 1];
        items[0] = LangStore.tr(this, "facet_all") + " · " + pool.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) {
            items[i + 1] = axisLabel(values.get(i)) + " · " + counts.get(values.get(i));
        }
        int checked = current.isEmpty() ? 0 : values.indexOf(current) + 1;
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_" + axis))
                .setSingleChoiceItems(items, checked, (d, which) -> {
                    String v = which == 0 ? "" : values.get(which - 1);
                    if ("genre".equals(axis)) facets.genre = v;
                    else if ("type".equals(axis)) facets.type = v;
                    else facets.status = v;
                    saveFacetPrefs();
                    wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
                    d.dismiss();
                    renderWall();
                })
                .show();
    }

    private void pickYearFacet(List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool) {
        List<Integer> decades = CatalogIndex.decadesIn(pool);
        boolean noYear = CatalogIndex.hasNoYear(pool);
        List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
        labels.add(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_all") + " · " + pool.size());
        for (int d : decades) labels.add(d + "s · " + decadeCount(pool, d));
        if (noYear) {
            int n = 0;
            for (CatalogIndex.Record r : pool) if (CatalogIndex.yearOf(r) < 0) n++;
            labels.add(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_not_listed") + " · " + n);
        }
        int checked = 0;
        if (facets.yearNotListed && noYear) checked = labels.size() - 1;
        else if (facets.yearLo >= 0) {
            int idx = decades.indexOf(CatalogIndex.decadeOf(facets.yearLo));
            if (idx >= 0) checked = idx + 1;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_year"))
                .setSingleChoiceItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]), checked,
                        (d, which) -> {
                            d.dismiss();
                            if (which == 0) {
                                facets.yearLo = -1;
                                facets.yearHi = -1;
                                facets.yearNotListed = false;
                                saveFacetPrefs();
                                wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
                                renderWall();
                            } else if (noYear && which == labels.size() - 1) {
                                facets.yearLo = -1;
                                facets.yearHi = -1;
                                facets.yearNotListed = true;
                                saveFacetPrefs();
                                wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
                                renderWall();
                            } else {
                                pickYearInDecade(pool, decades.get(which - 1));
                            }
                        })
                .show();
    }

    private int decadeCount(List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool, int decade) {
        int n = 0;
        for (CatalogIndex.Record r : pool) {
            int y = CatalogIndex.yearOf(r);
            if (y >= 0 && CatalogIndex.decadeOf(y) == decade) n++;
        }
        return n;
    }

    /** Second step of the year pick: the whole decade, or one year
     *  in it. Skipped when the decade holds a single year — the
     *  decade pick already says everything there is to say. */
    private void pickYearInDecade(List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool, int decade) {
        List<Integer> years = CatalogIndex.yearsIn(pool, decade);
        if (years.size() <= 1) {
            facets.yearLo = decade;
            facets.yearHi = decade + 9;
            facets.yearNotListed = false;
            saveFacetPrefs();
            wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
            renderWall();
            return;
        }
        String[] items = new String[years.size() + 1];
        items[0] = decade + "s — " + LangStore.tr(this, "facet_all");
        for (int i = 0; i < years.size(); i++) items[i + 1] = String.valueOf(years.get(i));
        int checked = 0;
        if (!facets.yearNotListed && facets.yearLo == facets.yearHi
                && years.contains(facets.yearLo)) {
            checked = years.indexOf(facets.yearLo) + 1;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(String.valueOf(decade) + "s")
                .setSingleChoiceItems(items, checked, (d, which) -> {
                    if (which == 0) {
                        facets.yearLo = decade;
                        facets.yearHi = decade + 9;
                    } else {
                        facets.yearLo = years.get(which - 1);
                        facets.yearHi = facets.yearLo;
                    }
                    facets.yearNotListed = false;
                    saveFacetPrefs();
                    wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
                    d.dismiss();
                    renderWall();
                })
                .show();
    }

    private void pickSort() {
        CatalogIndex.SortMode[] modes = CatalogIndex.SortMode.values();
        String[] items = {
                LangStore.tr(this, "sort_best"), LangStore.tr(this, "sort_az"),
                LangStore.tr(this, "sort_za"), LangStore.tr(this, "sort_newest"),
                LangStore.tr(this, "sort_oldest")};
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_sort"))
                .setSingleChoiceItems(items, facetSort.ordinal(), (d, which) -> {
                    facetSort = modes[which];
                    saveFacetPrefs();
                    wallGridShown = GRID_CHUNK;
                    d.dismiss();
                    renderWall();
                })
                .show();
    }

    /** The status line while a cut stands: how much of the pool
     *  survives it, and what the cut is — never a silent narrowing. */
    private String facetSummary(List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool) {
        List<CatalogIndex.Record> cut = CatalogIndex.applyFacets(pool, facets);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(cut.size()).append(" of ").append(pool.size()).append(" shows");
        if (facets.active()) {
            sb.append(" match");
            List<String> parts = new ArrayList<>();
            if (!facets.genre.isEmpty()) {
                parts.add(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_genre") + ": " + axisLabel(facets.genre));
            }
            if (facets.yearLo >= 0 || facets.yearNotListed) {
                parts.add(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_year") + ": " + yearFacetLabel());
            }
            if (!facets.type.isEmpty()) {
                parts.add(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_type") + ": " + axisLabel(facets.type));
            }
            if (!facets.status.isEmpty()) {
                parts.add(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_status") + ": " + axisLabel(facets.status));
            }
            sb.append(" — ").append(String.join(" · ", parts));
        }
        if (facetSort != CatalogIndex.SortMode.BEST) {
            sb.append(" · ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "facet_sort"))
                    .append(": ").append(sortLabel());
        }
        sb.append(".").append(walkStateText());
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** The pool, cut and sorted, as one growing grid — plus the
     *  door to the same cut as a full list (WallListActivity),
     *  where the A–Z jump bar lives. */
    private void addFacetGrid(String label, List<CatalogIndex.Record> pool) {
        List<CatalogIndex.Record> cut = CatalogIndex.applyFacets(pool, facets);
        CatalogIndex.sortBy(cut, facetSort);
        if (cut.isEmpty()) {
            addTextLine("Nothing gathered matches that cut yet — loosen a "
                    + "filter above, or gather more of the catalog below.");
            return;
        }
        addGridSection(label, cut);
        if (cut.size() > 12) {
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText("See the whole list — " + cut.size() + " shows →");
            b.setContentDescription(b.getText());
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, WallListActivity.class);
                i.putExtra("mode", "facet");
                i.putExtra("language", wallLangCode);
                i.putExtra("country", wallCountry);
                i.putExtra("f_genre", facets.genre);
                i.putExtra("f_type", facets.type);
                i.putExtra("f_status", facets.status);
                i.putExtra("f_year_lo", facets.yearLo);
                i.putExtra("f_year_hi", facets.yearHi);
                i.putExtra("f_year_nl", facets.yearNotListed);
                i.putExtra("f_sort", facetSort.ordinal());
                startActivity(i);
            });
            sectionsBox.addView(b);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ actor search

    /** Search the query as a PERSON (v0.11.1): TVmaze live, at
     *  query time — cast data for 90k shows is never baked. When
     *  the network doesn't answer, the screen says so plainly; the
     *  facet filters keep working offline either way. */
    private void doActorSearch() {
        String q = searchBox.getText().toString().trim();
        if (q.isEmpty()) return;
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                List<TvMaze.Person> people = TvMaze.parsePeople(
                        Net.getString(TvMaze.peopleSearchUrl(q)));
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    if (people.isEmpty()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "No people matched that on TVmaze.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    resultsMode = "people";
                    peopleResults = people;
                    ArrayAdapter<TvMaze.Person> ad = new ArrayAdapter<TvMaze.Person>(
                            this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2,
                            android.R.id.text1, people) {
                        @Override
                        public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                            View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                            TvMaze.Person p = people.get(pos);
                            TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                            t1.setText(p.name);
                            t1.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                            TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                            t2.setText(p.countryName.isEmpty() ? "Tap for their shows"
                                    : p.countryName + " — tap for their shows");
                            t2.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                            return v;
                        }
                    };
                    resultsList.setAdapter(ad);
                    catalogScroll.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    resultsList.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    Toast.makeText(this, people.size()
                            + " people — tap one for their shows",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "actor_needs_net"),
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        });
    }

    /** One person's shows, as cast credits — landed as catalogue
     *  records carrying the same honest marks as the wall tiles. */
    private void openPerson(TvMaze.Person p) {
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                List<TvMaze.Show> shows = TvMaze.parseCastCredits(
                        Net.getString(TvMaze.castCreditsUrl(p.id)));
                List<CatalogIndex.Record> recs = new ArrayList<>();
                for (TvMaze.Show s : shows) recs.add(CatalogIndex.fromShow(s));
                CatalogIndex.sortShows(recs);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    if (recs.isEmpty()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "TVmaze lists no shows for "
                                + p.name + " yet.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    resultsMode = "credits";
                    creditResults = recs;
                    resultsList.setAdapter(new android.widget.BaseAdapter() {
                        @Override public int getCount() { return recs.size(); }
                        @Override public Object getItem(int pos) { return recs.get(pos); }
                        @Override public long getItemId(int pos) { return recs.get(pos).id; }
                        @Override
                        public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                            LinearLayout ll;
                            TextView main, sub, mark;
                            if (convertView instanceof LinearLayout) {
                                ll = (LinearLayout) convertView;
                                main = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(0);
                                sub = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(1);
                                mark = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(2);
                            } else {
                                ll = new LinearLayout(HomeActivity.this);
                                ll.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                                ll.setPadding(dp(8), dp(6), dp(8), dp(6));
                                main = new TextView(HomeActivity.this);
                                main.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                                main.setTextSize(15);
                                sub = new TextView(HomeActivity.this);
                                sub.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                                sub.setTextSize(12);
                                mark = new TextView(HomeActivity.this);
                                mark.setTextSize(11);
                                ll.addView(main);
                                ll.addView(sub);
                                ll.addView(mark);
                            }
                            CatalogIndex.Record r = recs.get(pos);
                            main.setText(r.name);
                            StringBuilder meta = new StringBuilder();
                            int y = CatalogIndex.yearOf(r);
                            if (y >= 0) meta.append(y);
                            if (!r.genres.isEmpty()) {
                                if (meta.length() > 0) meta.append(" · ");
                                meta.append(String.join(" · ", r.genres));
                            }
                            if (r.rating > 0) {
                                if (meta.length() > 0) meta.append(" · ");
                                meta.append("★ ").append(String.format(
                                        Locale.US, "%.1f", r.rating));
                            }
                            sub.setText(meta.toString());
                            if (isAvailable(r)) {
                                mark.setText("✓ " + LangStore.tr(
                                        HomeActivity.this, "wall_available"));
                                mark.setTextColor(Color.rgb(120, 220, 120));
                            } else {
                                mark.setText(LangStore.tr(
                                        HomeActivity.this, "wall_catalog_only"));
                                mark.setTextColor(Color.rgb(140, 140, 150));
                            }
                            return ll;
                        }
                    });
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Shows with " + p.name + " — " + recs.size(),
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "actor_needs_net"),
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- search

    private void doSearch() {
        String q = searchBox.getText().toString().trim();
        if (q.isEmpty()) return;
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                List<TvMaze.Show> results = TvMaze.parseSearch(Net.getString(TvMaze.searchUrl(q)));
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    resultsMode = "shows";
                    searchResults = results;
                    if (results.isEmpty()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "No shows matched that on TVmaze.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    ArrayAdapter<TvMaze.Show> ad = new ArrayAdapter<TvMaze.Show>(this,
                            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1, results) {
                        @Override
                        public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                            View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                            TvMaze.Show s = results.get(pos);
                            TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                            t1.setText(s.name);
                            t1.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                            String meta = String.join(" · ", s.genres)
                                    + (s.language.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  " + s.language)
                                    + (s.rating > 0 ? "  ·  ★ "
                                        + String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", s.rating) : "");
                            TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                            t2.setText(meta);
                            t2.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                            return v;
                        }
                    };
                    resultsList.setAdapter(ad);
                    catalogScroll.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    resultsList.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    Toast.makeText(this, results.size() + " shows — tap Catalog to go back",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Search didn't answer (" + shortErr(e) + ")",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- io

    private static String shortErr(Exception e) {
        String m = e.getMessage();
        if (m == null) m = e.getClass().getSimpleName();
        return m.length() > 60 ? m.substring(0, 60) : m;
    }

    private static String readFile(File f) {
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) f.length()];
            int off = 0, n;
            while (off < buf.length && (n = in.read(buf, off, buf.length - off)) > 0) off += n;
            return new String(buf, 0, off, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void writeFile(File f, String content) {
        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(f)) {
            out.write(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Hydra.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * HYDRA — the Connection Law (v0.14.0, James, 2026-10-19:
 * "Can't you write a law that will take care of that issue?
 * If it's the other way, use the other way; if it's another
 * way, use that way."). One body (this law), many heads (the
 * manners). Every resolution in the house routes through here:
 * live tune, catalogue pull, Archive resolve, resume, guide
 * fetch. A head failing never kills the attempt — another head
 * tries — and failure is declared only when the ladder is
 * exhausted, in plain words (FailureWords), never a bare
 * "HTTP error".
 *
 * The manners, per published address, in ladder order:
 *   DIRECT        the address exactly as published
 *   IA_CANONICAL  for an Archive file: the archive.org/download
 *                 door, which redirects to whichever node holds
 *                 the file (the Archive's own rotation — the
 *                 metadata's pinned node is only one door)
 *   SCHEME        the other scheme: many streams are published
 *                 http-only or https-only; the other one is a
 *                 different door, not a retry
 * A RETRY is the same head again (for slowness, SG-1 semantics:
 * terminal answers fail the HEAD fast, slow answers retry in
 * place). An ALTERNATE MANNER is the next head. The whole
 * resolution shares one ~30 s budget (LinkHealth.TOTAL_CAP_MS).
 *
 * LEARNING: the head that answered for a host is remembered —
 * persisted as a file on the memory hook by HydraStore — and
 * the next visit to that host starts at the remembered door.
 * A remembered door that starts failing re-walks the ladder.
 *
 * This class is the pure policy: heads, order, budget, the
 * learned-door file's shape, and the exhaustion report. The
 * network hands are Net (fetches) and HydraResolver (stream
 * proof), both walking exactly this ladder.
 */
public final class Hydra {

    public static final int M_DIRECT = 0;
    public static final int M_IA_CANONICAL = 1;
    public static final int M_SCHEME = 2;

    /** Hard cap across a whole resolution, all heads together. */
    public static final long TOTAL_BUDGET_MS = LinkHealth.TOTAL_CAP_MS;

    private Hydra() {}

    /** One door into a source: a manner and the address it opens. */
    public static final class Head {
        public final int manner;
        public final String url;
        public Head(int manner, String url) {
            this.manner = manner;
            this.url = url;
        }
    }

    /** The ladder for one published address, in try order. */
    public static List<Head> heads(String url) {
        List<Head> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (url == null || url.isEmpty()) return out;
        out.add(new Head(M_DIRECT, url));
        String canon = iaCanonical(url);
        if (canon != null && !canon.equals(url)) {
            out.add(new Head(M_IA_CANONICAL, canon));
        }
        String swap = schemeSwap(url);
        if (swap != null) out.add(new Head(M_SCHEME, swap));
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * For an Archive file address on a pinned node
     * (iaNNNN.us.archive.org/download/&lt;id&gt;/&lt;path&gt; or
     * &lt;id&gt;.us.archive.org/...), the canonical door:
     * https://archive.org/download/&lt;id&gt;/&lt;path&gt;.
     * Null when the address is not an Archive file address, or
     * already is the canonical door.
     */
    public static String iaCanonical(String url) {
        if (url == null) return null;
        int dl = url.indexOf("/download/");
        if (dl < 0) return null;
        String rest = url.substring(dl + "/download/".length());
        if (rest.isEmpty()) return null;
        String host = hostOf(url);
        if (host == null || !host.endsWith("archive.org")) return null;
        if (host.equals("archive.org") || host.equals("www.archive.org")) {
            return null;   // already the canonical door
        }
        return "https://archive.org/download/" + rest;
    }

    /** The same address through the other scheme, or null. */
    public static String schemeSwap(String url) {
        if (url == null) return null;
        if (url.startsWith("https://")) return "http://" + url.substring(8);
        if (url.startsWith("http://")) return "https://" + url.substring(7);
        return null;
    }

    public static String hostOf(String url) {
        if (url == null) return null;
        try {
            String h = new java.net.URL(url).getHost();
            return h == null || h.isEmpty() ? null : h.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ learning

    /** host -> the manner that answered there (the learned door). */
    public static Map<String, Integer> parseDoors(String tsv) {
        Map<String, Integer> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (tsv == null) return out;
        for (String line : tsv.split("\n")) {
            String[] p = line.split("\t");
            if (p.length < 2) continue;
            try {
                out.put(dec(p[0]), Integer.parseInt(p[1].trim()));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String doorsToTsv(Map<String, Integer> doors) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : doors.entrySet()) {
            sb.append(enc(e.getKey())).append('\t')
                    .append(e.getValue()).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /**
     * The ladder as THIS host remembers it: the learned door
     * first (when it is still on the ladder), the rest in law
     * order behind it. A learned door that fails re-walks the
     * whole ladder — the caller simply continues down the list.
     */
    public static List<Head> orderFor(String url, Map<String, Integer> doors) {
        List<Head> ladder = heads(url);
        if (doors == null || ladder.size() < 2) return ladder;
        String host = hostOf(url);
        Integer learned = host == null ? null : doors.get(host);
        if (learned == null) return ladder;
        for (int i = 1; i < ladder.size(); i++) {
            if (ladder.get(i).manner == learned) {
                List<Head> out = new ArrayList<>(ladder);
                Head h = out.remove(i);
                out.add(0, h);
                return out;
            }
        }
        return ladder;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ budget

    /** May another head start? The budget is shared, hard-capped. */
    public static boolean mayAdvance(long startedMs, long nowMs, long nextTimeoutMs) {
        return nowMs - startedMs + nextTimeoutMs <= TOTAL_BUDGET_MS;
    }

    // --------------------------------------- the exhaustion report

    /** One head's answer, kept for the failure report. */
    public static final class Tried {
        public final int manner;
        public final int httpCode;    // 0 = no HTTP answer at all
        public final String kind;     // FailureWords kind, or ""
        public Tried(int manner, int httpCode, String kind) {
            this.manner = manner;
            this.httpCode = httpCode;
            this.kind = kind == null ? "" : kind;
        }
    }

    /**
     * The answer that best explains the failure, for the plain-
     * words report: a TERMINAL answer (the server actually said
     * no — refused, gone) outranks silence, because it is the
     * truth the server spoke; among terminal answers the LAST
     * one wins (the final door's word). Silence (timeouts) is
     * reported only when nothing answered at all.
     */
    public static Tried mostInformative(List<Tried> tried) {
        if (tried == null || tried.isEmpty()) return null;
        Tried lastTerminal = null;
        for (Tried t : tried) {
            if (t.httpCode > 0
                    && LinkHealth.classifyHttp(t.httpCode) == LinkHealth.CLS_TERMINAL) {
                lastTerminal = t;
            }
        }
        if (lastTerminal != null) return lastTerminal;
        return tried.get(tried.size() - 1);
    }

    private static String enc(String s) {
        try {
            return URLEncoder.encode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8");
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static String dec(String s) {
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8");
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/HydraResolver.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Hydra's stream hand (v0.14.0): proving a playable address by
 * walking the Connection Law's ladder (see Hydra) instead of
 * probing the one published manner and giving up. Each head is
 * proven with LinkHealth's patient probe (SG-1 semantics inside
 * the head: terminal fails fast, slow retries); a head that
 * fails ADVANCES THE LADDER — a different door, not the same
 * knock again — and the heads share the ~30 s budget in order.
 * The door that answered is learned (HydraStore) and recorded
 * in the health record under BOTH its own address and the
 * published one, so the display counts (DisplayCounts) bind to
 * what Hydra actually proved.
 *
 * v0.14.1: the outcome also carries the EVIDENCE — every head
 * tried, with its HTTP status and failure kind, plus the best
 * tier any head reached — and a second walk, proveExhaustive,
 * for the player's mid-play maintenance: there the question is
 * not "the first door that answers" but "does ANY door still
 * serve the video" — a connects-only answer (the playlist
 * answers, the video doesn't) must not stop the ladder,
 * because the continuity law classifies on the full evidence.
 *
 * Blocking: call from a worker thread.
 */
public final class HydraResolver {

    private HydraResolver() {}

    /** Fires when the ladder advances: the viewer is told
     *  "Trying another way…" — simple words, no jargon. */
    public interface AdvanceListener {
        void onAdvance(int headNumber, int headCount);
    }

    /** What a resolution came back with. */
    public static final class Outcome {
        /** The address that answered (the door to play), or the
         *  published address when none did. */
        public String url;
        public int manner = Hydra.M_DIRECT;
        /** The best result: a success when any head answered. */
        public LinkHealth.Result result;
        /** Every head tried, in order, with its answer (v0.14.1). */
        public List<Hydra.Tried> tried = new ArrayList<>();
        /** The best tier any head reached (v0.14.1). */
        public int bestTier = LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD;
        public boolean ok() {
            return result != null
                    && (result.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS
                            || result.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS
                            || result.slow);
        }
    }

    public static Outcome prove(Context ctx, String url, String userAgent,
                                AdvanceListener listener) {
        return walk(ctx, url, userAgent, listener, false);
    }

    /**
     * The maintenance walk: only a head proven to the SEGMENT
     * tier (PLAYS) stops the ladder — the full evidence returns
     * either way, so the caller can classify the failure family
     * (PlaybackContinuity) from what every door actually said.
     */
    public static Outcome proveExhaustive(Context ctx, String url,
                                          String userAgent,
                                          AdvanceListener listener) {
        return walk(ctx, url, userAgent, listener, true);
    }

    private static Outcome walk(Context ctx, String url, String userAgent,
                                AdvanceListener listener,
                                boolean exhaustive) {
        Outcome out = new Outcome();
        out.url = url;
        if (!LinkHealth.isRemote(url)) {
            out.result = LinkHealth.probeOnce(url, userAgent, 1000);
            out.bestTier = out.result.tier;
            return out;
        }
        Map<String, Integer> doors = HydraStore.load(ctx);
        List<Hydra.Head> ladder = Hydra.orderFor(url, doors);
        long started = System.currentTimeMillis();
        LinkHealth.Result best = null;
        Hydra.Head slowHead = null;
        LinkHealth.Result slowResult = null;
        Hydra.Head connectsHead = null;
        LinkHealth.Result connectsResult = null;
        int headNo = 0;
        for (Hydra.Head head : ladder) {
            headNo++;
            if (headNo > 1) {
                if (!Hydra.mayAdvance(started,
                        System.currentTimeMillis(), 4000)) break;
                if (listener != null) listener.onAdvance(headNo, ladder.size());
            }
            LinkHealth.Result r = LinkHealth.probe(
                    head.url, userAgent, 6000);
            HealthStore.record(ctx, head.url, r);
            out.tried.add(new Hydra.Tried(head.manner, r.httpCode,
                    FailureWords.kindFor(r)));
            if (r.tier > out.bestTier) out.bestTier = r.tier;
            boolean success = r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS
                    || (!exhaustive && (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS
                            || r.slow));
            if (success) {
                out.url = head.url;
                out.manner = head.manner;
                out.result = r;
                if (!head.url.equals(url)) {
                    HealthStore.record(ctx, url, r);
                }
                Net.noteLearned(Hydra.hostOf(url), head.manner);
                return out;
            }
            if (exhaustive) {
                // a slow head is worth re-preparing on (the
                // tune-in law's judgment: slow is not dead); a
                // connects-only head is evidence, not a door
                if (r.slow && slowResult == null) {
                    slowHead = head;
                    slowResult = r;
                }
                if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS
                        && connectsResult == null) {
                    connectsHead = head;
                    connectsResult = r;
                }
            }
            // a proven-dead head: keep the most informative word
            if (best == null
                    || (best.httpCode == 0 && r.httpCode > 0)) {
                best = r;
            }
            // slow-with-no-answer already returned as success
            // above (r.slow), so reaching here means terminal —
            // advance the ladder instead of ending the attempt.
        }
        if (exhaustive && slowResult != null) {
            out.url = slowHead.url;
            out.manner = slowHead.manner;
            out.result = slowResult;
            if (!slowHead.url.equals(url)) {
                HealthStore.record(ctx, url, slowResult);
            }
            Net.noteLearned(Hydra.hostOf(url), slowHead.manner);
            return out;
        }
        if (exhaustive && connectsResult != null) {
            out.result = connectsResult;
            return out;
        }
        out.result = best != null ? best
                : LinkHealth.probeOnce(url, userAgent, 1000);
        if (out.result != null && out.result.tier > out.bestTier) {
            out.bestTier = out.result.tier;
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/HydraStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Hydra's learned doors, kept as a FILE on the memory hook
 * (files/memory/hydra_doors.tsv) — file in, file out, like
 * everything she keeps. One line per host: the manner (Hydra
 * head) that answered there last. Primed into Net at boot, and
 * Net's successes flow back here to be written down, so the
 * next visit to a host starts at the door that worked.
 */
public final class HydraStore {

    private HydraStore() {}

    private static File doorsFile(Context ctx) {
        File dir = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "memory");
        if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
        return new File(dir, "hydra_doors.tsv");
    }

    public static Map<String, Integer> load(Context ctx) {
        try {
            File f = doorsFile(ctx);
            if (!f.isFile()) return new HashMap<>();
            return Hydra.parseDoors(new String(
                    Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath()), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Forget a host's learned door in the FILE (v0.14.1): the
     * Active Pinger proved the remembered door terminally dead;
     * the preference must not survive into the next session.
     */
    public static void forget(Context ctx, final String host) {
        if (ctx == null || host == null) return;
        final Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        new Thread(() -> {
            synchronized (HydraStore.class) {
                try {
                    Map<String, Integer> doors = load(app);
                    if (doors.remove(host) != null) {
                        Files.write(doorsFile(app).toPath(),
                                Hydra.doorsToTsv(doors)
                                        .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }, "hydra-door-forget").start();
    }

    /** Prime Net's ladder memory + persist every new learning. */
    public static void prime(Context ctx) {
        final Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        Net.primeDoors(load(app), (host, manner) -> {
            // write-through on a thread of its own; the file is
            // small and the writes are rare (a door learned)
            new Thread(() -> {
                synchronized (HydraStore.class) {
                    try {
                        Map<String, Integer> doors = load(app);
                        doors.put(host, manner);
                        Files.write(doorsFile(app).toPath(),
                                Hydra.doorsToTsv(doors)
                                        .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            }, "hydra-door-write").start();
        });
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/IaClient.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Internet Archive (archive.org) — public/open video items only.
 * advancedsearch finds items by title; /metadata/{id} lists the item's
 * files, from which playable video files and sidecar subtitle files
 * (.srt/.vtt) are picked. Parse functions are pure (JVM-testable).
 *
 * v0.3.0 — the free-shelf search got honest about how IA actually looks.
 * Measured on the live index (2026-10-17): a bare title search for a show
 * returns hundreds of hits, the top rows mostly junk (car rentals, drone
 * shows, reaction videos); but adding the EPISODE TITLE as a second
 * title clause collapses it to a handful of hits with the genuine
 * episode on top (Dragnet "The Big Deal": 187 -> 3 hits, 2 genuine;
 * Bonanza S1E1: 2 hits, both genuine; Firefly "Heart of Gold": exactly
 * 1 hit, the episode itself). So episodes search episode-aware first,
 * everything is ranked client-side by title/key/collection evidence,
 * and an opened item only contributes files that match the episode —
 * never every video in a bundle.
 */
public final class IaClient {

    public static final class Item {
        public String identifier = "";
        public String title = "";
        public int year;                                  // 0 = archive didn't say
        /** The Archive's own language tag (MARC code, e.g. "spa"), "" when untagged. */
        public String language = "";
        public final List<String> collections = new ArrayList<>();
        public int score;                                 // set by rankItems()
    }

    public static final class FileEntry {
        public String name = "";
        public String url = "";
        public long size;              // bytes, 0 = archive didn't say
        public String format = "";
        public boolean video;
        public boolean subtitle;
        public String subMime = "";    // for subtitle entries
        public String subLang = "";    // best-effort from the file name
    }

    private IaClient() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ queries

    private static final String FIELDS =
            "&fl%5B%5D=identifier&fl%5B%5D=title&fl%5B%5D=year&fl%5B%5D=collection"
            + "&fl%5B%5D=language";

    private static String buildUrl(String q, int rows) {
        try {
            return "https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=" + URLEncoder.encode(q, "UTF-8")
                    + FIELDS + "&rows=" + rows + "&page=1&output=json";
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return "https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=" + q + "&output=json";
        }
    }

    /** Lucene-hostile characters out of a free-text query term. */
    private static String queryTerm(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return "";
        String s = raw.replaceAll("[\\\\+\\-!(){}\\[\\]^\"~*?:/]", " ");
        return s.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
    }

    /** Movie / plain-title search (v0.2.0 behavior, wider page + year/collection fields). */
    public static String searchUrl(String titleQuery) {
        String q = "title:(" + queryTerm(titleQuery) + ") AND mediatype:(movies)";
        return buildUrl(q, 20);
    }

    /**
     * Episode search, stage 1: show title AND episode title. This is the
     * precision instrument measured above — use it whenever the episode
     * has a name.
     */
    public static String episodeSearchUrl(String showName, String episodeName) {
        String q = "title:(" + queryTerm(showName) + ") AND title:("
                + queryTerm(episodeName) + ") AND mediatype:(movies)";
        return buildUrl(q, 15);
    }

    /**
     * Episode search, stage 2 (fallback): show title scoped to the
     * collections where television actually lives on IA. Wider net —
     * ranking decides what floats.
     */
    public static String showScopedSearchUrl(String showName) {
        String q = "title:(" + queryTerm(showName) + ") AND mediatype:(movies)"
                + " AND (collection:(television) OR collection:(classic_tv)"
                + " OR collection:(opensource_movies) OR collection:(feature_films))";
        return buildUrl(q, 25);
    }

    public static String metadataUrl(String identifier) {
        return "https://archive.org/metadata/" + identifier;
    }

    // --------------------------------------- language leg (v0.10.0)

    /**
     * The Archive's language code for a TVmaze language name. IA tags
     * its items with MARC codes (bibliographic forms: fre/ger/chi,
     * measured live 2026-10-18 — the -T forms fra/deu/zho return
     * almost nothing). "" when we have no honest mapping.
     *
     * Persian is the measured exception (v0.10.1, live 2026-10-18,
     * mediatype:movies): fas 74,338 / per 2,557 / fa 0 — the Archive
     * files Persian under its -T code, so fas is the honest mapping.
     */
    public static String iaLanguageCode(String tvmazeLanguageName) {
        if (tvmazeLanguageName == null) return "";
        switch (tvmazeLanguageName) {
            case "English": return "eng";
            case "Spanish": return "spa";
            case "French": return "fre";
            case "German": return "ger";
            case "Portuguese": return "por";
            case "Italian": return "ita";
            case "Russian": return "rus";
            case "Arabic": return "ara";
            case "Hindi": return "hin";
            case "Chinese": return "chi";
            case "Japanese": return "jpn";
            case "Korean": return "kor";
            case "Persian": return "fas";
            default:
                // v0.11.0: the catalogue opened to every language
                // TVmaze carries; the Archive leg follows where the
                // Archive's own tags were MEASURED (advancedsearch,
                // mediatype:movies, live 2026-10-18 — counts in the
                // build record; e.g. swe 307,229 · hun 109,664 ·
                // ukr 73,254 · dut 13,020). A name absent here has
                // no measured Archive tag: no language leg runs for
                // it — the untagged legs run as always, and nothing
                // is claimed that wasn't counted.
                String c = IA_MARC.get(tvmazeLanguageName);
                return c == null ? "" : c;
        }
    }

    private static final java.util.Map<String, String> IA_MARC =
            new java.util.HashMap<>();
    static {
        IA_MARC.put("Dutch", "dut");
        IA_MARC.put("Thai", "tha");
        IA_MARC.put("Norwegian", "nor");
        IA_MARC.put("Swedish", "swe");
        IA_MARC.put("Turkish", "tur");
        IA_MARC.put("Ukrainian", "ukr");
        IA_MARC.put("Polish", "pol");
        IA_MARC.put("Danish", "dan");
        IA_MARC.put("Hungarian", "hun");
        IA_MARC.put("Tagalog", "tgl");
        IA_MARC.put("Finnish", "fin");
        IA_MARC.put("Czech", "cze");
        IA_MARC.put("Hebrew", "heb");
        IA_MARC.put("Greek", "gre");
        IA_MARC.put("Bengali", "ben");
        IA_MARC.put("Urdu", "urd");
        IA_MARC.put("Serbian", "srp");
        IA_MARC.put("Romanian", "rum");
        IA_MARC.put("Vietnamese", "vie");
        IA_MARC.put("Armenian", "arm");
        IA_MARC.put("Icelandic", "ice");
        IA_MARC.put("Tamil", "tam");
        IA_MARC.put("Slovak", "slo");
        IA_MARC.put("Catalan", "cat");
        IA_MARC.put("Indonesian", "ind");
        IA_MARC.put("Croatian", "hrv");
        IA_MARC.put("Bulgarian", "bul");
        IA_MARC.put("Estonian", "est");
        IA_MARC.put("Malayalam", "mal");
        IA_MARC.put("Telugu", "tel");
        IA_MARC.put("Marathi", "mar");
        IA_MARC.put("Malay", "may");
        IA_MARC.put("Kazakh", "kaz");
        IA_MARC.put("Uzbek", "uzb");
        IA_MARC.put("Latvian", "lav");
        IA_MARC.put("Slovenian", "slv");
        IA_MARC.put("Lithuanian", "lit");
        IA_MARC.put("Georgian", "geo");
        IA_MARC.put("Welsh", "wel");
        IA_MARC.put("Irish", "gle");
        IA_MARC.put("Panjabi", "pan");
        IA_MARC.put("Gujarati", "guj");
        IA_MARC.put("Kannada", "kan");
        IA_MARC.put("Sinhalese", "sin");
        IA_MARC.put("Burmese", "bur");
        IA_MARC.put("Mongolian", "mon");
        IA_MARC.put("Pashto", "pus");
