        IA_MARC.put("Belarusian", "bel");
        IA_MARC.put("Bosnian", "bos");
        IA_MARC.put("Kyrgyz", "kir");
        IA_MARC.put("Malagasy", "mlg");
        IA_MARC.put("Yoruba", "yor");
        IA_MARC.put("Lao", "lao");
        IA_MARC.put("Central Khmer", "khm");
        IA_MARC.put("Zulu", "zul");
        IA_MARC.put("Afrikaans", "afr");
        IA_MARC.put("Fijian", "fij");
        IA_MARC.put("Kongo", "kon");
        IA_MARC.put("Wolof", "wol");
        IA_MARC.put("Chechen", "che");
        IA_MARC.put("Latin", "lat");
        IA_MARC.put("Divehi", "div");
        IA_MARC.put("Scottish Gaelic", "gla");
    }

    /** Episode search restricted to items the Archive tags with this language. */
    public static String episodeLangSearchUrl(String showName, String episodeName,
                                              String iaCode) {
        String q = "title:(" + queryTerm(showName) + ") AND title:("
                + queryTerm(episodeName) + ") AND mediatype:(movies)"
                + " AND language:(" + iaCode + ")";
        return buildUrl(q, 15);
    }

    /** Show-title search restricted to items tagged with this language. */
    public static String showLangSearchUrl(String showName, String iaCode) {
        String q = "title:(" + queryTerm(showName) + ") AND mediatype:(movies)"
                + " AND language:(" + iaCode + ")";
        return buildUrl(q, 20);
    }

    /**
     * Stable partition: items the Archive itself tags with the wanted
     * language float first, everything else keeps its ranked order.
     * An untagged item is NOT promoted — unknown is not a match.
     */
    public static List<Item> preferLanguage(List<Item> ranked, String iaCode) {
        if (iaCode == null || iaCode.isEmpty() || ranked == null) {
            return ranked == null ? new ArrayList<>() : ranked;
        }
        List<Item> tagged = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Item> rest = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Item it : ranked) {
            if (iaCode.equals(it.language)) tagged.add(it);
            else rest.add(it);
        }
        tagged.addAll(rest);
        return tagged;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ ranking

    private static Set<String> tokenSet(String normalized) {
        Set<String> out = new HashSet<>();
        if (normalized == null) return out;
        for (String t : normalized.split(" ")) {
            if (!t.isEmpty()) out.add(t);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Fraction of the needle's tokens that appear in the haystack (both normalized). */
    static double tokenCoverage(String haystackNorm, String needleNorm) {
        Set<String> needle = tokenSet(needleNorm);
        if (needle.isEmpty()) return 0;
        Set<String> hay = tokenSet(haystackNorm);
        int hit = 0;
        for (String t : needle) if (hay.contains(t)) hit++;
        return (double) hit / needle.size();
    }

    private static boolean hasJunkWords(String titleNorm) {
        return titleNorm.contains("reaction") || titleNorm.contains("trailer")
                || titleNorm.contains("review") || titleNorm.contains("unboxing")
                || titleNorm.contains("podcast") || titleNorm.contains("audiobook");
    }

    /**
     * Evidence score for one search hit against what we actually want.
     * Show-title coverage gates everything (zero coverage = not about
     * this show at all, dropped by rankItems). Episode-key and
     * episode-title matches dominate; television collections add a
     * little; news/community/social collections and reaction/trailer
     * bait subtract. Nothing here invents facts — it only orders hits.
     */
    public static int scoreItem(Item it, String showName, String epName,
                                int season, int number, int wantYear) {
        String titleNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(it.title);
        String idNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(it.identifier);
        String showNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(showName);
        if (showNorm.isEmpty()) return 0;
        double cov = Math.max(tokenCoverage(titleNorm, showNorm),
                tokenCoverage(idNorm, showNorm) * 0.9);
        if (cov <= 0) return 0;
        int score = (int) Math.round(cov * 40);

        EpisodeKey k = EpisodeKey.parse(it.title);
        if (k == null) k = EpisodeKey.parse(it.identifier);
        if (number > 0 && k != null && k.matches(season, number)) {
            score += 35;
        }
        if (epName != null && !epName.isEmpty()) {
            score += (int) Math.round(
                    tokenCoverage(titleNorm, EpisodeKey.normalize(epName)) * 25);
        }
        for (String c : it.collections) {
            String cl = c.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            if (cl.equals("television") || cl.equals("feature_films")
                    || cl.startsWith("classic_tv")) {
                score += 6;
            } else if (cl.equals("opensource_movies")) {
                score += 3;
            }
            if (cl.equals("tvnews") || cl.equals("tvarchive")
                    || cl.equals("community_media") || cl.equals("social-media-video")
                    || cl.equals("newsandpublicaffairs")) {
                score -= 8;
            }
        }
        if (hasJunkWords(titleNorm)) score -= 15;
        if (wantYear > 0 && it.year > 0) {
            if (it.year == wantYear) score += 8;
            else if (Math.abs(it.year - wantYear) > 3) score -= 6;
        }
        return score;
    }

    /** Score, drop the zero-evidence hits, sort best-first. Sets Item.score. */
    public static List<Item> rankItems(List<Item> items, String showName, String epName,
                                       int season, int number, int wantYear) {
        List<Item> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Item it : items) {
            it.score = scoreItem(it, showName, epName, season, number, wantYear);
            if (it.score > 0) out.add(it);
        }
        out.sort((a, b) -> b.score - a.score);
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Could this item plausibly BE the episode (as opposed to merely
     * mentioning the show)? True when the item's own title/identifier
     * carries the episode key, or the episode title is fully covered by
     * the item title with no reaction/trailer bait words. Only then may
     * its unmarked video files pass the episode filter.
     */
    public static boolean itemMatchesEpisode(Item it, String epName,
                                             int season, int number) {
        EpisodeKey k = EpisodeKey.parse(it.title);
        if (k == null) k = EpisodeKey.parse(it.identifier);
        if (number > 0 && k != null && k.matches(season, number)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (epName != null && !epName.isEmpty()) {
            String titleNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(it.title);
            return tokenCoverage(titleNorm, EpisodeKey.normalize(epName)) >= 0.99
                    && !hasJunkWords(titleNorm);
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * From one opened item, the video files that are THIS episode:
     * exact key match first; then episode-title phrase match; then —
     * only when the item itself matched the episode and holds just a
     * few videos — all of them (single-episode items carry unmarked
     * files, e.g. "Dragnet_Big_deal_04_26_56.mp4"). Special-features
     * folders (deleted scenes, featurettes, extras) never pass: a
     * deleted scene tagged S01E01 is not S01E01.
     */
    public static List<FileEntry> filterEpisodeFiles(List<FileEntry> files,
                                                     int season, int number,
                                                     String epName,
                                                     boolean itemMatched) {
        List<FileEntry> videos = new ArrayList<>();
        for (FileEntry f : files) {
            if (!f.video) continue;
            if (isSpecialFeaturePath(f.name)) continue;
            videos.add(f);
        }
        List<FileEntry> byKey = new ArrayList<>();
        for (FileEntry f : videos) {
            EpisodeKey k = EpisodeKey.parse(f.name);
            if (k != null && k.matches(season, number)) {
                byKey.add(f);
            }
        }
        if (!byKey.isEmpty()) return byKey;
        String epNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(epName);
        if (!epNorm.isEmpty()) {
            List<FileEntry> byName = new ArrayList<>();
            for (FileEntry f : videos) {
                if (EpisodeKey.containsPhrase(EpisodeKey.normalize(f.name), epNorm)) {
                    byName.add(f);
                }
            }
            if (!byName.isEmpty()) return byName;
        }
        if (itemMatched && videos.size() <= 6) return videos;
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    private static boolean isSpecialFeaturePath(String name) {
        String low = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        return low.contains("deleted scene") || low.contains("featurette")
                || low.contains("/extras/") || low.contains("bonus feature")
                || low.contains("behind the scenes");
    }

    /** A year (1900–2099) sitting in a free-text title, else 0. */
    public static int yearOf(String text) {
        if (text == null) return 0;
        java.util.regex.Matcher m = java.util.regex.Pattern
                .compile("(?<!\\d)((?:19|20)\\d{2})(?!\\d)").matcher(text);
        return m.find() ? Integer.parseInt(m.group(1)) : 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ parsing

    public static List<Item> parseSearch(String json) throws Exception {
        List<Item> out = new ArrayList<>();
        JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
        JSONObject response = root.optJSONObject("response");
        if (response == null) return out;
        JSONArray docs = response.optJSONArray("docs");
        if (docs == null) return out;
        for (int i = 0; i < docs.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject d = docs.getJSONObject(i);
            Item it = new Item();
            it.identifier = d.optString("identifier", "");
            it.title = d.optString("title", "");
            it.year = optYear(d.opt("year"));
            Object lang = d.opt("language");
            if (lang instanceof JSONArray && ((JSONArray) lang).length() > 0) {
                it.language = ((JSONArray) lang).optString(0, "");
            } else if (lang instanceof String) {
                it.language = (String) lang;
            }
            Object coll = d.opt("collection");
            if (coll instanceof JSONArray) {
                JSONArray arr = (JSONArray) coll;
                for (int j = 0; j < arr.length(); j++) {
                    it.collections.add(arr.optString(j, ""));
                }
            } else if (coll instanceof String && !((String) coll).isEmpty()) {
                it.collections.add((String) coll);
            }
            if (!it.identifier.isEmpty()) out.add(it);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static int optYear(Object y) {
        if (y instanceof Number) return ((Number) y).intValue();
        if (y instanceof String) {
            try { return Integer.parseInt(((String) y).trim()); }
            catch (Exception e) { return 0; }
        }
        if (y instanceof JSONArray && ((JSONArray) y).length() > 0) {
            return optYear(((JSONArray) y).opt(0));
        }
        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * From one item's metadata: every playable video file and every sidecar
     * subtitle, with direct download URLs. Derivative/thumbnail clutter is
     * filtered by extension + format, conservatively.
     */
    public static List<FileEntry> parseMetadata(String json, String identifier) throws Exception {
        List<FileEntry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
        JSONArray files = root.optJSONArray("files");
        if (files == null) return out;
        for (int i = 0; i < files.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject f = files.getJSONObject(i);
            String name = f.optString("name", "");
            if (name.isEmpty()) continue;
            String format = f.optString("format", "");
            String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            String ext = lower.contains(".")
                    ? lower.substring(lower.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : "";

            FileEntry e = new FileEntry();
            e.name = name;
            e.format = format;
            e.size = parseLong(f.optString("size", "0"));
            e.url = "https://archive.org/download/" + identifier + "/" + encodePath(name);

            if (ext.equals("srt") || ext.equals("vtt")) {
                e.subtitle = true;
                e.subMime = ext.equals("vtt")
                        ? "text/vtt" : "application/x-subrip";
                e.subLang = guessLang(name);
                out.add(e);
                continue;
            }
            boolean videoExt = ext.equals("mp4") || ext.equals("m4v") || ext.equals("mkv")
                    || ext.equals("avi") || ext.equals("ogv") || ext.equals("mov")
                    || ext.equals("webm");
            boolean videoFmt = format.contains("MPEG4") || format.contains("h.264")
                    || format.contains("Matroska") || format.contains("Ogg Video")
                    || format.contains("QuickTime") || format.contains("Windows Media")
                    || format.contains("WebM");
            // thumbnails / previews / sample clips are not the feature
            if (lower.contains("_thumb") || lower.contains(".thumbs")
                    || format.contains("Thumbnail") || format.contains("Animated GIF")
                    || lower.contains("_sample")) {
                continue;
            }
            if (videoExt || videoFmt) {
                e.video = true;
                out.add(e);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static long parseLong(String s) {
        try { return Long.parseLong(s.trim()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0; }
    }

    /** Encode each path segment, keep the slashes. */
    private static String encodePath(String name) {
        try {
            String[] parts = name.split("/");
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                if (i > 0) b.append('/');
                b.append(URLEncoder.encode(parts[i], "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20"));
            }
            return b.toString();
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return name;
        }
    }

    /** "movie.en.srt" -> "en"; "subs/english.vtt" -> "en"; else "" (unknown). */
    private static String guessLang(String fileName) {
        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        String[] toks = lower.split("[^a-z]+");
        for (String t : toks) {
            if (t.equals("en") || t.equals("eng") || t.equals("english")) return "en";
            if (t.equals("es") || t.equals("spa") || t.equals("spanish")) return "es";
            if (t.equals("fr") || t.equals("fre") || t.equals("french")) return "fr";
            if (t.equals("de") || t.equals("ger") || t.equals("german")) return "de";
            if (t.equals("pt") || t.equals("por") || t.equals("portuguese")) return "pt";
            if (t.equals("it") || t.equals("ita") || t.equals("italian")) return "it";
        }
        return "";
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ImageCache.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.util.LruCache;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * Tiny hand-rolled poster cache (no new dependencies): memory LRU +
 * on-disk copy in the app cache dir + background fetch. An ImageView is
 * only ever handed the bitmap for the URL it is currently tagged with,
 * so a fast-scrolling grid can't paint the wrong poster.
 */
public final class ImageCache {

    private static final LruCache<String, Bitmap> MEM =
            new LruCache<String, Bitmap>(8 * 1024 * 1024) {
                @Override protected int sizeOf(String key, Bitmap value) {
                    return value.getByteCount();
                }
            };

    private static final ExecutorService EXEC = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);

    private ImageCache() {}

    public static void load(Context ctx, String url, ImageView view) {
        if (url == null || url.isEmpty()) {
            view.setTag(null);
            view.setImageBitmap(null);
            return;
        }
        view.setTag(url);
        Bitmap hit = MEM.get(url);
        if (hit != null) {
            view.setImageBitmap(hit);
            return;
        }
        view.setImageBitmap(null);
        final Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        EXEC.execute(() -> {
            Bitmap bmp = null;
            File f = diskFile(app, url);
            if (f.exists()) {
                bmp = decode(f.getAbsolutePath());
            }
            if (bmp == null) {
                try {
                    byte[] bytes = Net.getBytes(url);
                    try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(f)) {
                        out.write(bytes);
                    }
                    bmp = decode(f.getAbsolutePath());
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // a missing poster is cosmetic; the title text carries on
                }
            }
            if (bmp != null) {
                MEM.put(url, bmp);
                final Bitmap done = bmp;
                view.post(() -> {
                    if (url.equals(view.getTag())) view.setImageBitmap(done);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private static Bitmap decode(String path) {
        BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
        bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
        BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path, bounds);
        int sample = 1;
        while (bounds.outWidth / sample > 400) sample *= 2;
        BitmapFactory.Options opts = new BitmapFactory.Options();
        opts.inSampleSize = sample;
        return BitmapFactory.decodeFile(path, opts);
    }

    private static File diskFile(Context ctx, String url) {
        File dir = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "posters");
        if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
        return new File(dir, md5(url) + ".img");
    }

    private static String md5(String s) {
        try {
            MessageDigest d = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
            byte[] digest = d.digest(s.getBytes("UTF-8"));
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
            for (byte x : digest) b.append(String.format("%02x", x));
            return b.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return String.valueOf(s.hashCode());
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/JournalsActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.media.MediaPlayer;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.text.DateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Voice journals (v0.14.0) — recorded letters and tellings left
 * for the children, and for the children's children. A journal
 * is data: a voice kept as a file on the memory hook, so it
 * persists, copies, and hands down. Playback is open inside the
 * story room; RECORDING and DELETING pass the grown-up gate,
 * the way everything that changes the family's record does.
 *
 * (The ORIGINALS of journals are destined for the family's own
 * TALA monolith under the family's keys; Sandy holds the
 * household copies — see the 0.14.0 NOTES.)
 */
public class JournalsActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_GATE_RECORD = 45;
    private static final int REQ_GATE_DELETE = 46;

    private LinearLayout root;
    private MediaPlayer player;
    private MediaRecorder recorder;
    private File recTarget;
    private String pendingId = "";
    private boolean recording = false;

    private EditText nameBox;
    private Button recBtn;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(16);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root);
        setContentView(scroll);
        showList();
    }

    private void showList() {
        stopPlayer();
        root.removeAllViews();
        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_journals"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(30);
        root.addView(title);

        Button newBtn = new Button(this);
        newBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_journals_record"));
        newBtn.setTextSize(21);
        newBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams nl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(76));
        nl.topMargin = dp(12);
        newBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent gate = new Intent(this, GrownUpGateActivity.class);
            startActivityForResult(gate, REQ_GATE_RECORD);
        });
        root.addView(newBtn, nl);

        List<StoryData.Journal> journals = StoryFiles.journals(this);
        if (journals.isEmpty()) {
            TextView empty = new TextView(this);
            empty.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_journal_empty"));
            empty.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
            empty.setTextSize(18);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            lp.topMargin = dp(18);
            root.addView(empty, lp);
        }
        DateFormat df = DateFormat.getDateInstance(DateFormat.MEDIUM);
        // newest first
        List<StoryData.Journal> sorted = new ArrayList<>(journals);
        sorted.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.dateMs, a.dateMs));
        for (StoryData.Journal j : sorted) {
            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams rl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rl.topMargin = dp(10);
            Button play = new Button(this);
            play.setText("▶  " + j.name + " · " + df.format(new Date(j.dateMs)));
            play.setTextSize(19);
            play.setAllCaps(false);
            play.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL | Gravity.START);
            play.setPadding(dp(14), 0, dp(14), 0);
            play.setMinHeight(dp(72));
            play.setOnClickListener(v -> play(j));
            row.addView(play, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            Button del = new Button(this);
            del.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_delete"));
            del.setTextSize(15);
            del.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                pendingId = j.id;
                Intent gate = new Intent(this, GrownUpGateActivity.class);
                startActivityForResult(gate, REQ_GATE_DELETE);
            });
            row.addView(del);
            root.addView(row, rl);
        }
    }

    private void play(StoryData.Journal j) {
        stopPlayer();
        File f = new File(StoryFiles.journalsDir(this), j.file);
        if (!f.isFile()) return;
        try {
            player = new MediaPlayer();
            player.setDataSource(f.getAbsolutePath());
            player.setOnCompletionListener(mp -> stopPlayer());
            player.setOnErrorListener((mp, w, e) -> {
                stopPlayer();
                return true;
            });
            player.prepare();
            player.start();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stopPlayer();
        }
    }

    private void stopPlayer() {
        if (player != null) {
            try { player.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { player.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            player = null;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ record

    private void showRecorder() {
        root.removeAllViews();
        TextView whoLabel = new TextView(this);
        whoLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_who_q"));
        whoLabel.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        whoLabel.setTextSize(20);
        root.addView(whoLabel);
        nameBox = new EditText(this);
        nameBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "story_name_hint"));
        nameBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        nameBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 158, 185));
        nameBox.setTextSize(20);
        nameBox.setSingleLine(true);
        root.addView(nameBox);
        recBtn = new Button(this);
        recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_record"));
        recBtn.setTextSize(22);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams rl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(84));
        rl.topMargin = dp(20);
        recBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> toggleRecord());
        root.addView(recBtn, rl);
        Button back = new Button(this);
        back.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_back"));
        back.setTextSize(17);
        back.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (recording) stopRecording(false);
            showList();
        });
        root.addView(back);
    }

    private void toggleRecord() {
        if (recording) {
            stopRecording(true);
            return;
        }
        if (nameBox.getText().toString().trim().isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_who_q"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO}, 7);
            return;
        }
        try {
            String id = "j" + System.currentTimeMillis();
            recTarget = new File(StoryFiles.journalsDir(this), id + ".m4a");
            recorder = new MediaRecorder();
            recorder.setAudioSource(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            recorder.setOutputFormat(MediaRecorder.OutputFormat.MPEG_4);
            recorder.setAudioEncoder(MediaRecorder.AudioEncoder.AAC);
            recorder.setOutputFile(recTarget.getAbsolutePath());
            recorder.prepare();
            recorder.start();
            recording = true;
            recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_stop_rec"));
            // stash the pending id on the file name
            pendingId = id;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stopRecording(false);
        }
    }

    private void stopRecording(boolean keep) {
        recording = false;
        if (recorder != null) {
            try { recorder.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { recorder.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            recorder = null;
        }
        if (keep && recTarget != null && recTarget.isFile()) {
            List<StoryData.Journal> js = StoryFiles.journals(this);
            StoryData.Journal j = new StoryData.Journal();
            j.id = pendingId;
            j.name = nameBox.getText().toString().trim();
            j.dateMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
            j.file = recTarget.getName();
            js.add(j);
            StoryFiles.saveJournals(this, js);
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_saved"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            showList();
        } else if (recTarget != null) {
            recTarget.delete();
        }
        recTarget = null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int result, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, result, data);
        if (result != RESULT_OK) return;
        if (req == REQ_GATE_RECORD) {
            showRecorder();
        } else if (req == REQ_GATE_DELETE && !pendingId.isEmpty()) {
            List<StoryData.Journal> js = StoryFiles.journals(this);
            List<StoryData.Journal> kept = new ArrayList<>();
            for (StoryData.Journal j : js) {
                if (j.id.equals(pendingId)) {
                    new File(StoryFiles.journalsDir(this), j.file).delete();
                } else {
                    kept.add(j);
                }
            }
            StoryFiles.saveJournals(this, kept);
            pendingId = "";
            showList();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (recorder != null) stopRecording(false);
        stopPlayer();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/KeptPlaces.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Kept places, filed (v0.11.0): the file-backed store behind
 * memory/kept_places.tsv. ChannelStore (positions, the kept live
 * place) and ReaderStore (book bookmarks) keep their public faces —
 * this class is where the bytes actually live now.
 *
 * Migration is per-kind and marker-guarded: the first time a kind is
 * needed, if no "#seeded" marker for it exists, the caller hands
 * over the legacy rows (read from the old preferences cluster) and
 * they are written into the file with the marker. After that the
 * file is the only truth; the frozen legacy copies are never read
 * again (recorded as a known deviation in the 0.11.0 NOTES).
 * Deleting every row of a kind on purpose can therefore never
 * resurrect the stale preferences — the marker remembers.
 */
public final class KeptPlaces {

    private KeptPlaces() {}

    private static List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> cache;

    private static synchronized List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> load(Context ctx) {
        if (cache == null) {
            cache = MemoryFiles.keptPlacesFromText(
                    MemoryHook.read(ctx, MemoryHook.KEPT_PLACES));
        }
        return cache;
    }

    private static synchronized void save(Context ctx) {
        MemoryHook.write(ctx, MemoryHook.KEPT_PLACES,
                MemoryFiles.keptPlacesToText(cache));
    }

    /** Test/maintenance escape: forget the in-memory copy. */
    public static synchronized void invalidate() { cache = null; }

    public static synchronized boolean seeded(Context ctx, String kind) {
        return MemoryFiles.findKept(load(ctx), "#seeded", kind) != null;
    }

    /** Write legacy rows for {@code kind} once, with the marker. */
    public static synchronized void seed(Context ctx, String kind,
                                         List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> rows) {
        List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> all = new ArrayList<>(load(ctx));
        if (MemoryFiles.findKept(all, "#seeded", kind) != null) return;
        for (MemoryFiles.KeptPlace r : rows) {
            if (MemoryFiles.findKept(all, r.kind, r.key) == null) all.add(r);
        }
        all.add(new MemoryFiles.KeptPlace("#seeded", kind, 0,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), ""));
        cache = all;
        save(ctx);
    }

    public static synchronized long getPosition(Context ctx, String contentKey) {
        MemoryFiles.KeptPlace r = MemoryFiles.findKept(load(ctx), "pos", contentKey);
        return r == null ? 0 : r.position;
    }

    public static synchronized void putPosition(Context ctx, String contentKey,
                                                long positionMs) {
        cache = MemoryFiles.upsertKept(load(ctx),
                new MemoryFiles.KeptPlace("pos", contentKey, positionMs,
                        System.currentTimeMillis(), ""));
        save(ctx);
    }

    public static synchronized String getExtra(Context ctx, String kind, String key) {
        MemoryFiles.KeptPlace r = MemoryFiles.findKept(load(ctx), kind, key);
        return r == null ? null : r.extra;
    }

    public static synchronized long getPlacePosition(Context ctx, String kind,
                                                     String key) {
        MemoryFiles.KeptPlace r = MemoryFiles.findKept(load(ctx), kind, key);
        return r == null ? 0 : r.position;
    }

    public static synchronized void putPlace(Context ctx, String kind, String key,
                                             long position, String extra) {
        cache = MemoryFiles.upsertKept(load(ctx),
                new MemoryFiles.KeptPlace(kind, key, position,
                        System.currentTimeMillis(), extra == null ? "" : extra));
        save(ctx);
    }

    public static synchronized void removePlace(Context ctx, String kind, String key) {
        List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (MemoryFiles.KeptPlace r : load(ctx)) {
            if (!(r.kind.equals(kind) && r.key.equals(key))) out.add(r);
        }
        cache = out;
        save(ctx);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LangPack.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The language-pack slot (v0.5.0; James's pack architecture: "we make
 * those for the larger languages... any sub languages below the main
 * grouping would just have to come in and we'd write 'em — or somebody
 * could put Sandy in their AI and have it written for them").
 *
 * A pack is ONE plain-text file, documented in the NOTES:
 *
 *   # comments start with #
 *   sandy.langpack=1
 *   code=tl
 *   name=Tagalog
 *   home_catalog=Katalogo
 *   ... one line for EVERY key in UiStrings.KEYS ...
 *
 * Validation is fail-closed, exactly as ordered: the header must be
 * present, the code and name must be sane, and EVERY required key
 * must be present with a non-empty value. An incomplete pack is
 * rejected with the missing keys named — never half-installed.
 *
 * Pure logic (no Android imports); the harness drives it with
 * complete, incomplete, and malformed fixtures.
 */
public final class LangPack {

    public static final class Result {
        public boolean ok = false;
        public String code = "";
        public String name = "";
        public final Map<String, String> strings = new HashMap<>();
        public final List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        public String error = "";
    }

    private LangPack() {}

    public static Result parse(String text) {
        Result r = new Result();
        if (text == null) {
            r.error = "The file was empty.";
            return r;
        }
        Map<String, String> kv = new HashMap<>();
        for (String rawLine : text.split("\\R")) {
            String line = rawLine.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
            int eq = line.indexOf('=');
            if (eq <= 0) continue;
            kv.put(line.substring(0, eq).trim(), line.substring(eq + 1).trim());
        }
        if (!"1".equals(kv.get("sandy.langpack"))) {
            r.error = "Not a Sandy language pack (missing the sandy.langpack=1 header).";
            return r;
        }
        String code = kv.getOrDefault("code", "");
        if (!code.matches("[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?")) {
            r.error = "The pack's language code (\"code=\") is missing or not a "
                    + "short language code like tl or pt-BR.";
            return r;
        }
        String name = kv.getOrDefault("name", "");
        if (name.isEmpty()) {
            r.error = "The pack has no display name (\"name=\").";
            return r;
        }
        r.code = code;
        r.name = name;
        for (String key : UiStrings.KEYS) {
            String v = kv.get(key);
            if (v == null || v.isEmpty()) r.missing.add(key);
            else r.strings.put(key, v);
        }
        if (!r.missing.isEmpty()) {
            r.error = "The pack is incomplete — missing " + r.missing.size()
                    + " of " + UiStrings.KEYS.length + " required lines.";
            return r;
        }
        r.ok = true;
        return r;
    }

    /** Serialize a complete pack (used for the sample pack in NOTES/tests). */
    public static String write(String code, String name, Map<String, String> strings) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy language pack\n");
        sb.append("sandy.langpack=1\n");
        sb.append("code=").append(code).append('\n');
        sb.append("name=").append(name).append('\n');
        for (String key : UiStrings.KEYS) {
            sb.append(key).append('=').append(strings.getOrDefault(key, "")).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The catalogue language registry (v0.11.0) — the decoupling James
 * ordered. Before this build a language could only open a wall if it
 * also had a full interface table in UiStrings (the 13 Sandy SPEAKS).
 * The catalogue itself never cared: CatalogIndex buckets any language
 * the walk touches. This registry is the door list between them:
 * every language TVmaze carries gets an entry — name, the name in its
 * own script where we know it, and how much of the index it holds —
 * whether or not Sandy speaks it.
 *
 * The registry is DERIVED, not baked: the seed asset
 * (assets/lang_registry.tsv) carries only the last full-index
 * measurement, and the on-phone walk refreshes the gathered counts
 * from CatalogIndex.State on every open. A language TVmaze adds
 * tomorrow appears the first time the walk touches it, with no code
 * change and no new build.
 *
 * Pure core (parse / merge / order) is static and harness-tested;
 * only the asset read touches Android.
 */
public final class LangRegistry {

    private LangRegistry() {}

    /** One registry entry: a language the catalogue can SHOW. */
    public static final class Entry {
        /** TVmaze's language name ("Persian", "Scottish Gaelic"). */
        public final String tvName;
        /** The name in the language's own script, "" when unknown. */
        public final String nativeName;
        /** Shows in the full TVmaze index (last measurement / walk). */
        public final long indexCount;
        /** Shows the on-phone walk has gathered so far. */
        public final long gatheredCount;
        /** The interface language code when Sandy SPEAKS it, else "". */
        public final String spokenCode;

        Entry(String tvName, String nativeName, long indexCount,
              long gatheredCount, String spokenCode) {
            this.tvName = tvName;
            this.nativeName = nativeName == null ? "" : nativeName;
            this.indexCount = indexCount;
            this.gatheredCount = gatheredCount;
            this.spokenCode = spokenCode == null ? "" : spokenCode;
        }

        /** What a wall/chip shows: own script first, TVmaze's name as the floor. */
        public String displayName() {
            return nativeName.isEmpty() ? tvName : nativeName;
        }

        public boolean spoken() { return !spokenCode.isEmpty(); }
    }

    /** TVmaze's bucket name for shows with no language listed. */
    public static final String NO_LANGUAGE = "(none listed)";

    // ---------------------------------------------------- native names
    // The language's name in its own script, for the languages the
    // index carries. Display only — never a lookup key. A language
    // missing here shows TVmaze's English name (the stated fallback).

    private static final Map<String, String> NATIVE = new HashMap<>();
    static {
        NATIVE.put("English", "English");
        NATIVE.put("Russian", "Русский");
        NATIVE.put("Japanese", "日本語");
        NATIVE.put("Chinese", "中文");
        NATIVE.put("Korean", "한국어");
        NATIVE.put("French", "Français");
        NATIVE.put("Spanish", "Español");
        NATIVE.put("Dutch", "Nederlands");
        NATIVE.put("Thai", "ไทย");
        NATIVE.put("Norwegian", "Norsk");
        NATIVE.put("German", "Deutsch");
        NATIVE.put("Swedish", "Svenska");
        NATIVE.put("Turkish", "Türkçe");
        NATIVE.put("Portuguese", "Português");
        NATIVE.put("Hindi", "हिन्दी");
        NATIVE.put("Italian", "Italiano");
        NATIVE.put("Ukrainian", "Українська");
        NATIVE.put("Polish", "Polski");
        NATIVE.put("Arabic", "العربية");
        NATIVE.put("Danish", "Dansk");
        NATIVE.put("Hungarian", "Magyar");
        NATIVE.put("Tagalog", "Tagalog");
        NATIVE.put("Finnish", "Suomi");
        NATIVE.put("Czech", "Čeština");
        NATIVE.put("Bengali", "বাংলা");
        NATIVE.put("Hebrew", "עברית");
        NATIVE.put("Greek", "Ελληνικά");
        NATIVE.put("Urdu", "اردو");
        NATIVE.put("Serbian", "Српски");
        NATIVE.put("Romanian", "Română");
        NATIVE.put("Vietnamese", "Tiếng Việt");
        NATIVE.put("Scottish Gaelic", "Gàidhlig");
        NATIVE.put("Armenian", "Հայերեն");
        NATIVE.put("Icelandic", "Íslenska");
        NATIVE.put("Tamil", "தமிழ்");
        NATIVE.put("Slovak", "Slovenčina");
        NATIVE.put("Catalan", "Català");
        NATIVE.put("Indonesian", "Bahasa Indonesia");
        NATIVE.put("Croatian", "Hrvatski");
        NATIVE.put("Marathi", "मराठी");
        NATIVE.put("Telugu", "తెలుగు");
        NATIVE.put("Malayalam", "മലയാളം");
        NATIVE.put("Bulgarian", "Български");
        NATIVE.put("Estonian", "Eesti");
        NATIVE.put("Afrikaans", "Afrikaans");
        NATIVE.put("Kazakh", "Қазақша");
        NATIVE.put("Persian", "فارسی");
        NATIVE.put("Malay", "Bahasa Melayu");
        NATIVE.put("Uzbek", "Oʻzbek");
        NATIVE.put("Latvian", "Latviešu");
        NATIVE.put("Slovenian", "Slovenščina");
        NATIVE.put("Lithuanian", "Lietuvių");
        NATIVE.put("Georgian", "ქართული");
        NATIVE.put("Javanese", "Basa Jawa");
        NATIVE.put("Kannada", "ಕನ್ನಡ");
        NATIVE.put("Azerbaijani", "Azərbaycan");
        NATIVE.put("Galician", "Galego");
        NATIVE.put("Panjabi", "ਪੰਜਾਬੀ");

        NATIVE.put("Burmese", "မြန်မာ");
        NATIVE.put("Divehi", "ދިވެހި");
        NATIVE.put("Bosnian", "Bosanski");
        NATIVE.put("Kyrgyz", "Кыргызча");
        NATIVE.put("Malagasy", "Malagasy");
        NATIVE.put("Yoruba", "Èdè Yorùbá");
        NATIVE.put("Albanian", "Shqip");
        NATIVE.put("Pashto", "پښتو");
        NATIVE.put("Kongo", "Kikongo");
        NATIVE.put("Wolof", "Wolof");
        NATIVE.put("Latin", "Latina");
        NATIVE.put("Luxembourgish", "Lëtzebuergesch");
        NATIVE.put("Chechen", "Нохчийн");
        NATIVE.put("Sinhalese", "සිංහල");
        NATIVE.put("Gujarati", "ગુજરાતી");
        NATIVE.put("Swahili", "Kiswahili");
        NATIVE.put("Fijian", "Vosa Vakaviti");
        NATIVE.put("Lao", "ລາວ");
        NATIVE.put("Central Khmer", "ខ្មែរ");
        NATIVE.put("Welsh", "Cymraeg");
        NATIVE.put("Irish", "Gaeilge");
    }

    public static String nativeNameFor(String tvName) {
        String n = NATIVE.get(tvName);
        return n == null ? "" : n;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- spoken
    // The languages Sandy SPEAKS are UiStrings' tables — the registry
    // bridges by TVmaze name so the two lists can never drift apart:
    // a spoken language that exists in UiStrings but not yet in the
    // catalogue data still gets an entry (indexCount 0 until the
    // walk touches it — Persian before v0.10.1 was exactly that case).

    /** tvName -> interface code, derived from UiStrings itself. */
    public static Map<String, String> spokenByTvName() {
        Map<String, String> m = new HashMap<>();
        for (String[] lang : UiStrings.LANGUAGES) {
            String facet = UiStrings.facetFor(lang[0]);
            if (!facet.isEmpty()) m.put(facet, lang[0]);
        }
        return m;
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------- pure core

    /**
     * Parse the seed TSV (name TAB full-index count; '#' comments and
     * blank lines skipped; a malformed line is skipped, never fatal).
     */
    public static Map<String, Long> parseSeed(String tsv) {
        Map<String, Long> out = new HashMap<>();
        if (tsv == null) return out;
        for (String line : tsv.split("\n")) {
            String t = line.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty() || t.startsWith("#")) continue;
            int tab = t.indexOf('\t');
            if (tab <= 0) continue;
            try {
                out.put(t.substring(0, tab).trim(),
                        Long.parseLong(t.substring(tab + 1).trim()));
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * The registry: the union of the seed measurement, the languages
     * the walk has actually gathered, and the spoken set. Ordered for
     * the picker: spoken languages first (in UiStrings picker order),
     * then by full-index size, then A-to-Z; the no-language bucket
     * rides last, always labeled, never hidden.
     */
    public static List<Entry> build(Map<String, Long> seedCounts,
                                    Map<String, Integer> gatheredCounts) {
        Map<String, String> spoken = spokenByTvName();
        Map<String, Entry> byName = new HashMap<>();
        if (seedCounts != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, Long> e : seedCounts.entrySet()) {
                byName.put(e.getKey(), new Entry(e.getKey(),
                        nativeNameFor(e.getKey()), e.getValue(), 0,
                        spoken.getOrDefault(e.getKey(), "")));
            }
        }
        if (gatheredCounts != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : gatheredCounts.entrySet()) {
                Entry old = byName.get(e.getKey());
                if (old == null) {
                    byName.put(e.getKey(), new Entry(e.getKey(),
                            nativeNameFor(e.getKey()), 0, e.getValue(),
                            spoken.getOrDefault(e.getKey(), "")));
                } else {
                    byName.put(e.getKey(), new Entry(old.tvName,
                            old.nativeName, old.indexCount, e.getValue(),
                            old.spokenCode));
                }
            }
        }
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : spoken.entrySet()) {
            if (!byName.containsKey(e.getKey())) {
                byName.put(e.getKey(), new Entry(e.getKey(),
                        nativeNameFor(e.getKey()), 0, 0, e.getValue()));
            }
        }
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>(byName.values());
        final Map<String, Integer> pickerOrder = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < UiStrings.LANGUAGES.length; i++) {
            pickerOrder.put(UiStrings.LANGUAGES[i][0], i);
        }
        Collections.sort(out, new Comparator<Entry>() {
            @Override public int compare(Entry a, Entry b) {
                boolean aNone = NO_LANGUAGE.equals(a.tvName);
                boolean bNone = NO_LANGUAGE.equals(b.tvName);
                if (aNone != bNone) return aNone ? 1 : -1;
                if (a.spoken() && b.spoken()) {
                    return Integer.compare(
                            pickerOrder.getOrDefault(a.spokenCode, 99),
                            pickerOrder.getOrDefault(b.spokenCode, 99));
                }
                if (a.spoken() != b.spoken()) return a.spoken() ? -1 : 1;
                if (a.indexCount != b.indexCount) {
                    return Long.compare(b.indexCount, a.indexCount);
                }
                return a.tvName.compareTo(b.tvName);
            }
        });
        return out;
    }

    /** Find one entry by TVmaze name; null when the registry lacks it. */
    public static Entry find(List<Entry> registry, String tvName) {
        if (registry == null || tvName == null) return null;
        for (Entry e : registry) if (e.tvName.equals(tvName)) return e;
        return null;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------- Android glue

    /** Load the registry for this phone: seed asset + the walk's state. */
    public static List<Entry> load(Context ctx) {
        String tsv = "";
        try (InputStream in = ctx.getAssets().open("lang_registry.tsv");
             BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(
                     new InputStreamReader(in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line).append('\n');
            tsv = sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        CatalogIndex.State st = CatalogStore.loadState(ctx);
        Map<String, Integer> gathered = st == null
                ? Collections.<String, Integer>emptyMap() : st.counts;
        return build(parseSeed(tsv), gathered);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LangStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Installed language packs + the one string lookup every screen uses
 * (v0.5.0). Resolution order for a key: the current language's
 * installed pack (if a holder installed one — their pack wins, it's
 * their shelf) -> the baked table for that language -> English.
 *
 * Packs live in filesDir/langpacks/<code>.pack, imported through
 * Settings and validated fail-closed by LangPack before they land.
 */
public final class LangStore {

    private LangStore() {}

    /** The string lookup: S.tr(ctx, "live_title"). */
    public static String tr(Context ctx, String key) {
        String code = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(ctx);
        if (code != null && !code.isEmpty() && !"en".equals(code)) {
            LangPack.Result pack = loadPack(ctx, code);
            if (pack != null && pack.ok) {
                String v = pack.strings.get(key);
                if (v != null && !v.isEmpty()) return v;
            }
        }
        return UiStrings.lookup(code == null || code.isEmpty() ? "en" : code, key);
    }

    private static File packDir(Context ctx) {
        File d = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "langpacks");
        //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    public static File packFile(Context ctx, String code) {
        return new File(packDir(ctx), code + ".pack");
    }

    /** Load + validate an installed pack; null when absent or invalid. */
    public static LangPack.Result loadPack(Context ctx, String code) {
        File f = packFile(ctx, code);
        if (!f.exists()) return null;
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) f.length()];
            int off = 0, n;
            while (off < buf.length && (n = in.read(buf, off, buf.length - off)) > 0) off += n;
            LangPack.Result r = LangPack.parse(new String(buf, 0, off, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return r.ok && r.code.equals(code) ? r : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Install a validated pack. Only called with parse-ok results. */
    public static boolean install(Context ctx, LangPack.Result pack, String text) {
        try (java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                     new java.io.FileOutputStream(packFile(ctx, pack.code))) {
            out.write(text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** code -> display name for every installed (valid) pack. */
    public static List<String[]> installedPacks(Context ctx) {
        List<String[]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File[] files = packDir(ctx).listFiles();
        if (files == null) return out;
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.getName().endsWith(".pack")) continue;
            String code = f.getName().substring(0, f.getName().length() - 5);
            LangPack.Result r = loadPack(ctx, code);
            if (r != null) out.add(new String[]{r.code, r.name});
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Picker rows: the baked majors first, then installed packs. */
    public static List<String[]> pickerLanguages(Context ctx) {
        List<String[]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String[] l : UiStrings.LANGUAGES) out.add(l);
        for (String[] p : installedPacks(ctx)) {
            boolean baked = false;
            for (String[] l : UiStrings.LANGUAGES) {
                if (l[0].equals(p[0])) { baked = true; break; }
            }
            if (!baked) out.add(p);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Display name for a language code (picker/Settings rows). */
    public static String displayName(Context ctx, String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isEmpty()) return "English";
        for (String[] l : pickerLanguages(ctx)) {
            if (l[0].equals(code)) return l[1];
        }
        return code;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LanguageActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * The language picker (v0.5.0, Delwin #4: "you should be able to
 * choose the language when you install it"). Shown on first run —
 * before anything else, because James's ruling is that a person who
 * picks Sandy up and can't get out of English won't stay — and again
 * from Settings whenever the phone changes hands.
 *
 * Rows are the twelve baked majors (native names) plus any installed
 * packs. Picking sets the UI language: Sandy's chrome speaks it, and
 * the Live TV language facet defaults to it.
 */
public class LanguageActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String EXTRA_FROM_SETTINGS = "fromSettings";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        boolean fromSettings = getIntent().getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_FROM_SETTINGS, false);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        int pad = dp(14);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lang_choose_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(22);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView sub = new TextView(this);
        sub.setText("Sandy speaks your language — pick it once; you can "
                + "change it any time in Settings.");
        sub.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160, 160, 170));
        sub.setTextSize(13);
        sub.setPadding(0, dp(4), 0, dp(8));
        root.addView(sub);

        List<String[]> langs = LangStore.pickerLanguages(this);
        String current = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
        ListView list = new ListView(this);
        list.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        ArrayAdapter<String[]> ad = new ArrayAdapter<String[]>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, langs) {
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                TextView t = (TextView) v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                String[] l = langs.get(pos);
                t.setText(l[1] + (l[0].equals(current) ? "  ✓" : ""));
                t.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                t.setTextSize(19);
                t.setPadding(dp(8), dp(12), dp(8), dp(12));
                t.setContentDescription(l[1]);
                return v;
            }
            @Override public int getCount() { return langs.size(); }
        };
        list.setAdapter(ad);
        list.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            ChannelStore.setUiLanguage(this, langs.get(pos)[0]);
            if (fromSettings) {
                finish();
            } else {
                startActivity(new Intent(this, HomeActivity.class));
                finish();
            }
        });
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        setContentView(root);
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LanguageIndexActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * Every language the catalogue can SHOW (v0.11.0) — the door past
 * the 13 languages Sandy speaks. The list is the LangRegistry:
 * derived from the walked index (seed counts refreshed by what the
 * walk has gathered on this phone), not a baked list, so a language
 * TVmaze adds appears here the first time the walk touches it.
 *
 * Each row tells the truth twice: how much of the whole index the
 * language holds, and how much of it is on this phone so far. Thin
 * languages stand thin — one show reads "1", in the open. Tapping a
 * language opens its wall (HomeActivity), with its country shelves
 * and its titles in their own names, exactly like a spoken one.
 */
public class LanguageIndexActivity extends Activity {

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final List<LangRegistry.Entry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rowTitles = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rowSub = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private ProgressBar progress;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lang_index_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(19);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView note = new TextView(this);
        note.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lang_index_note"));
        note.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        note.setTextSize(12);
        root.addView(note);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null,
                android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        ListView listView = new ListView(this);
        listView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.addView(listView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<String>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1,
                rowTitles) {
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                t1.setText(rowTitles.get(pos));
                t1.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                t2.setText(pos < rowSub.size() ? rowSub.get(pos) : "");
                t2.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                return v;
            }
            @Override public int getCount() { return rowTitles.size(); }
        };
        listView.setAdapter(adapter);
        listView.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            HomeActivity.pendingWallLanguage = entries.get(pos).tvName;
            finish();
        });
        setContentView(root);

        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<LangRegistry.Entry> loaded = LangRegistry.load(this);
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                entries.clear();
                entries.addAll(loaded);
                rowTitles.clear();
                rowSub.clear();
                for (LangRegistry.Entry e : entries) {
                    String name = e.displayName();
                    if (!e.tvName.equals(name)) name += " · " + e.tvName;
                    if (e.spoken()) name += " ◆";
                    rowTitles.add(name);
                    rowSub.add(e.indexCount > 0
                            ? e.indexCount + " in the index · "
                                    + e.gatheredCount + " on this phone"
                            : e.gatheredCount + " on this phone");
                }
                adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
            });
        });
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LeadMath.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * Lead arithmetic for the cooker (v0.6.0). James's model, as measured:
 * not real-time — LEAD-time. The viewer waits a bit; cooking runs
 * ahead of the playhead; the GO SIGN lights when the cooked lead is
 * real. Every number this class produces is either measured on this
 * device (per-chunk wall times the cooker itself records) or plain
 * arithmetic on measured numbers — never a promise dressed as one.
 *
 * The bench numbers this must reproduce when fed bench inputs
 * (PHONE-BENCH-2026-10-17.md): base subtitle path cooks 600 s of
 * anime in 88.8 s of wall (6.76x); chunks of 240 s land every ~35.5 s
 * of wall; a 5-minute wait therefore starts the viewer with the whole
 * episode's subtitles already cooked.
 *
 * Pure logic; harness-driven against the bench's chunk times.
 */
public final class LeadMath {

    /** The cooker works in 240 s chunks — load-bearing (bench). */
    public static final double CHUNK_SEC = 240.0;

    private LeadMath() {}

    /**
     * How much finished translation must sit ahead of the playhead
     * before the go sign may light: one full chunk for a long title,
     * half the title for a short one (never under 30 s, never more
     * than the title holds).
     */
    public static double goThresholdSec(double titleDurSec) {
        if (titleDurSec <= 0) return CHUNK_SEC;
        if (titleDurSec <= CHUNK_SEC * 2) {
            return Math.min(titleDurSec, Math.max(30.0, titleDurSec / 2.0));
        }
        return CHUNK_SEC;
    }

    /** Lead = finished seconds minus watched seconds. Negative = starved. */
    public static double leadSec(double cookedSec, double playedSec) {
        return cookedSec - playedSec;
    }

    public static boolean isGo(double cookedSec, double playedSec, double titleDurSec) {
        return leadSec(cookedSec, playedSec) >= goThresholdSec(titleDurSec);
    }

    /** Playback has reached the cooking edge before the title is done. */
    public static boolean isStarved(double cookedSec, double playedSec, double titleDurSec) {
        return playedSec > cookedSec && cookedSec < titleDurSec;
    }

    /** After a starve, this much rebuilt lead resumes playback. */
    public static final double RESUME_LEAD_SEC = 30.0;

    /**
     * This device's measured cook rate: finished seconds per wall
     * second, accumulated over the chunks it has actually cooked.
     */
    public static final class RateTracker {
        private double cookedTotal = 0.0;
        private double wallTotal = 0.0;
        private int chunks = 0;

        public void recordChunk(double cookedSec, double wallSec) {
            if (cookedSec <= 0 || wallSec <= 0) return;
            cookedTotal += cookedSec;
            wallTotal += wallSec;
            chunks++;
        }

        /** Finished-seconds per wall-second; 0 until a chunk lands. */
        public double rate() {
            return wallTotal <= 0 ? 0.0 : cookedTotal / wallTotal;
        }

        public int chunks() { return chunks; }

        /**
         * Wall seconds until the lead reaches the go threshold at the
         * measured rate, assuming playback hasn't started. -1 when no
         * chunk has landed yet (the rate is honestly unknown).
         */
        public double etaToGoSec(double leadSec, double titleDurSec) {
            double r = rate();
            if (r <= 0) return -1;
            double need = goThresholdSec(titleDurSec) - leadSec;
            return need <= 0 ? 0 : need / r;
        }

        /**
         * Wall seconds until the cooking edge is reached while riding
         * the lead (rate > 1 means never, on current measurements).
         * -1 = will not starve at the measured rate.
         */
        public double etaToStarveSec(double leadSec) {
            double r = rate();
            if (r <= 0 || r >= 1.0) return -1;
            return leadSec / (1.0 - r);
        }
    }

    /** "2:05" for a lead readout. */
    public static String formatLead(double sec) {
        long s = Math.max(0, Math.round(sec));
        return (s / 60) + ":" + String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%02d", s % 60);
    }
}

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * My Library (v0.3.0) — the screen for the source pool that lives on
 * the phone itself. Explains what the index is, shows what it found
 * (files, episodes across shows, movies, unsorted — counted, not
 * asserted), and offers the two controls that matter: pick a folder
 * to include, and Rescan. Folder rows tap-to-remove.
 */
public class LibraryActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_PICK_FOLDER = 701;
    private static final int REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION = 702;

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private TextView statsView, mediaNoteView, foldersHeader, showsHeader;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private ListView foldersList, showsList;
    private Button rescanBtn, pickBtn;

    private List<String> folders = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> folderRows = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> showRows = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayAdapter<String> folderAdapter, showAdapter;
    private boolean scanning = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        int pad = dp(12);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(20);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        // The Recordings shelf (v0.5.0) — one door, right at the top:
        // what "Record what's playing" caught waits behind it.
        Button recBtn = new Button(this);
        recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_recordings_btn"));
        recBtn.setContentDescription(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_recordings_btn"));
        recBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, RecordingsActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams recLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        recLp.topMargin = dp(6);
        recLp.bottomMargin = dp(6);
        root.addView(recBtn, recLp);

        // My Videos (v0.9.0) — the local player's door, right at the
        // top with the other shelves: every video on the phone as a
        // tappable list that plays. (The index below explains itself;
        // this door is for watching, not managing.)
        Button videosBtn = new Button(this);
        videosBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_videos_btn"));
        videosBtn.setContentDescription(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_videos_btn"));
        videosBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, FilesActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams vidLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        vidLp.topMargin = dp(6);
        vidLp.bottomMargin = dp(6);
        root.addView(videosBtn, vidLp);

        // The Books shelf (v0.8.0) — the read-aloud door, right
        // beside Recordings: tap a book and Sandy reads it aloud.
        Button booksBtn = new Button(this);
        booksBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_books_btn"));
        booksBtn.setContentDescription(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_books_btn"));
        booksBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, BooksActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams booksLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        booksLp.topMargin = dp(6);
        booksLp.bottomMargin = dp(6);
        root.addView(booksBtn, booksLp);

        // The dub kitchen (v0.12.0) — James's anime dub, cooked by
        // Sandy herself: pick an episode, cook the dub (subtitles
        // first, translate-then-speak, cast voices saved per show),
        // and the dubbed file lands on its own shelf below.
        Button dubBtn = new Button(this);
        dubBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_dub_btn"));
        dubBtn.setContentDescription(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_dub_btn"));
        dubBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, DubActivity.class)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams dubLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        dubLp.topMargin = dp(6);
        dubLp.bottomMargin = dp(6);
        root.addView(dubBtn, dubLp);

        Button dubShelfBtn = new Button(this);
        dubShelfBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_dubshelf_btn"));
        dubShelfBtn.setContentDescription(LangStore.tr(this, "lib_dubshelf_btn"));
        dubShelfBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, DubActivity.class);
            i.putExtra("mode", "shelf");
            startActivity(i);
        });
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams dubShelfLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        dubShelfLp.topMargin = dp(6);
        dubShelfLp.bottomMargin = dp(6);
        root.addView(dubShelfBtn, dubShelfLp);

        TextView help = new TextView(this);
        help.setText("Videos already on this phone are a source too — the same "
                + "lesson Jellyfin taught: your own shelf counts. Sandy reads "
                + "their file names (show, season, episode, year) into an index, "
                + "and episode pages offer your files alongside playlists and "
                + "the Internet Archive. Nothing is copied or uploaded; the "
                + "index is just names and where each file sits.\n\n"
                + "Prepared English dub: put an audio file next to a video with "
                + "the same name plus “.dub-en.m4a” (for example "
                + "“Show S01E01.dub-en.m4a” beside “Show S01E01.mkv”) and the "
                + "player offers it as “English — prepared dub.”");
        help.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160, 160, 170));
        help.setTextSize(13);
        root.addView(help);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        statsView = new TextView(this);
        statsView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(220, 220, 228));
        statsView.setTextSize(15);
        statsView.setPadding(0, dp(10), 0, 0);
        root.addView(statsView);

        mediaNoteView = new TextView(this);
        mediaNoteView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 200, 120));
        mediaNoteView.setTextSize(13);
        mediaNoteView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(mediaNoteView);

        LinearLayout btnRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        btnRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        pickBtn = new Button(this);
        pickBtn.setText("Pick a folder");
        pickBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickFolder());
        btnRow.addView(pickBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        rescanBtn = new Button(this);
        rescanBtn.setText("Rescan");
        rescanBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> rescan(true));
        btnRow.addView(rescanBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        root.addView(btnRow);

        foldersHeader = sectionHeader("Folders included (tap one to remove)");
        root.addView(foldersHeader);
        foldersList = new ListView(this);
        foldersList.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        folderAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, folderRows);
        folderAdapter.setNotifyOnChange(false);
        foldersList.setAdapter(folderAdapter);
        root.addView(foldersList, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        foldersList.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> confirmRemoveFolder(pos));

        showsHeader = sectionHeader("What the index found");
        root.addView(showsHeader);
        showsList = new ListView(this);
        showsList.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        showAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, showRows);
        showAdapter.setNotifyOnChange(false);
        showsList.setAdapter(showAdapter);
        root.addView(showsList, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 2f));

        setContentView(root);
        folders = LibraryStore.getFolders(this);
        refreshFromIndex();
        // First visit: get the video permission sorted so the MediaStore
        // half of the scan can actually see the phone's videos.
        if (LibraryStore.scannedWhen(this) == 0 && !hasVideoPermission()) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{videoPermission()}, REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION);
        }
    }

    private TextView sectionHeader(String text) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(text);
        t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
        t.setTextSize(14);
        t.setTypeface(t.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        t.setPadding(0, dp(12), 0, dp(4));
        return t;
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- actions

    private String videoPermission() {
        return Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                ? android.Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
                : android.Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE;
    }

    private boolean hasVideoPermission() {
        return checkSelfPermission(videoPermission()) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    private void pickFolder() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE);
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION
                | Intent.FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION);
        try {
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_FOLDER);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone has no folder picker — the library "
                    + "will use the phone's video index only.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
        if (requestCode != REQ_PICK_FOLDER || resultCode != RESULT_OK || data == null) return;
        Uri tree = data.getData();
        if (tree == null) return;
        try {
            getContentResolver().takePersistableUriPermission(tree,
                    Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { /* some providers refuse; it may still work this session */ }
        String uriStr = tree.toString();
        if (!folders.contains(uriStr)) {
            folders.add(uriStr);
            LibraryStore.setFolders(this, folders);
        }
        Toast.makeText(this, "Folder added — rescanning…", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        rescan(false);
    }

    @Override
