    public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, String[] permissions,
                                           int[] grantResults) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
        if (requestCode == REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION) {
            // granted or not, scan: the outcome is reported honestly either way
            rescan(false);
        }
    }

    private void confirmRemoveFolder(int pos) {
        if (pos < 0 || pos >= folders.size()) return;
        String uriStr = folders.get(pos);
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Stop including this folder?")
                .setMessage(prettyFolder(uriStr)
                        + "\n\nIts files leave the index on the next rescan. "
                        + "The files themselves are never touched.")
                .setPositiveButton("Remove", (d, w) -> {
                    folders.remove(pos);
                    LibraryStore.setFolders(this, folders);
                    rescan(false);
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Keep", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void rescan(boolean askPermissionFirst) {
        if (scanning) return;
        if (askPermissionFirst && !hasVideoPermission()) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{videoPermission()}, REQ_VIDEO_PERMISSION);
            return;
        }
        scanning = true;
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        statsView.setText("Scanning the phone's videos and your folders…");
        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<LibraryIndex.Entry> entries = LibraryStore.scan(this);
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                scanning = false;
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                refreshFromIndex();
                Toast.makeText(this, "Index rebuilt: " + entries.size() + " files",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            });
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- display

    private void refreshFromIndex() {
        folders = LibraryStore.getFolders(this);
        folderRows.clear();
        if (folders.isEmpty()) {
            folderRows.add("None yet — the phone's own video index is always included. "
                    + "Pick a folder to add one (an SD card, a downloads folder…).");
        } else {
            for (String f : folders) folderRows.add(prettyFolder(f));
        }
        folderAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();

        List<LibraryIndex.Entry> entries = LibraryStore.loadEntries(this);
        long when = LibraryStore.scannedWhen(this);
        if (when == 0) {
            statsView.setText("Not scanned yet. Tap Rescan and Sandy will index "
                    + "the videos on this phone.");
        } else {
            String stamp = new SimpleDateFormat("MMM d, h:mm a", Locale.US).format(new Date(when));
            statsView.setText(entries.size() + " video files indexed · "
                    + LibraryIndex.countEpisodes(entries) + " episodes across "
                    + LibraryIndex.episodesByShow(entries).size() + " shows · "
                    + LibraryIndex.oneOffs(entries).size() + " movies & one-offs · "
                    + LibraryIndex.countUnsorted(entries) + " unsorted files"
                    + "\nLast scan: " + stamp);
        }
        if (LibraryStore.mediaStoreBlocked(this) && when > 0) {
            mediaNoteView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            mediaNoteView.setText("Note: the phone's video index couldn't be read "
                    + "(permission not granted), so only your picked folders were "
                    + "scanned. Grant the Videos permission and Rescan to include it.");
        } else {
            mediaNoteView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        showRows.clear();
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : LibraryIndex.episodesByShow(entries).entrySet()) {
            showRows.add(e.getKey() + " — " + e.getValue()
                    + (e.getValue() == 1 ? " episode" : " episodes"));
        }
        for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : LibraryIndex.oneOffs(entries)) {
            showRows.add("▸ " + e.displayName);
        }
        int unsorted = LibraryIndex.countUnsorted(entries);
        if (unsorted > 0) {
            showRows.add("Unsorted files (names with no show/episode in them): " + unsorted);
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : entries) {
                if (!e.isSorted()) showRows.add("▸ " + e.fileName);
            }
        }
        if (showRows.isEmpty() && when > 0) {
            showRows.add("Nothing indexed yet — add video files or a folder, then Rescan.");
        }
        showAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    /** "content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/tree/primary%3AMovies" -> "Movies". */
    static String prettyFolder(String treeUri) {
        try {
            String decoded = Uri.decode(treeUri);
            int slash = decoded.lastIndexOf('/');
            String tail = slash >= 0 ? decoded.substring(slash + 1) : decoded;
            int colon = tail.lastIndexOf(':');
            if (colon >= 0 && colon < tail.length() - 1) tail = tail.substring(colon + 1);
            return tail.isEmpty() ? treeUri : tail;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return treeUri;
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LibraryIndex.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * My Library indexing (v0.3.0) — the Jellyfin lesson: the video files
 * James already HAS are a source pool, same as his playlists and the
 * Internet Archive. This class is the pure half: it parses a file NAME
 * into (show, season, episode, episode title, year) with exactly the
 * marker rules SourceFinder trusts (EpisodeKey), cleans release-junk
 * tokens off the human parts, and adapts entries into M3uParser.Channel
 * rows so the existing finders search the library unchanged.
 *
 * Honesty rules, same as everywhere in this app: a name that doesn't
 * parse is KEPT (listed as unsorted, never dropped, never dressed up
 * with a guessed show), and the raw file name stays on the entry.
 * The Android half (MediaStore + picked-folder walking, persistence)
 * lives in LibraryStore.
 */
public final class LibraryIndex {

    public static final String SOURCE_NAME = "My Library";

    public static final class Entry {
        public String fileName = "";      // as found on the device
        public String uri = "";           // content:// or file path — set by the scanner
        public String displayName = "";   // label for the Library screen
        public String showName = "";      // series name, or movie/one-off title; "" = unsorted
        public String episodeTitle = "";  // episodes only, when the name carries one
        public int season = -1;           // -1 = not an episode
        public int episode = -1;
        public int year;                  // 0 = none found

        public boolean isEpisode() { return episode >= 0; }
        public boolean isSorted() { return !showName.isEmpty(); }
    }

    private LibraryIndex() {}

    private static final Set<String> VIDEO_EXTS = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
            "mp4", "mkv", "avi", "m4v", "mov", "webm", "ts", "m2ts", "mpg",
            "mpeg", "wmv", "ogv", "flv", "3gp"));

    public static boolean isVideoFile(String name) {
        if (name == null) return false;
        String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        int dot = lower.lastIndexOf('.');
        return dot >= 0 && VIDEO_EXTS.contains(lower.substring(dot + 1));
    }

    private static final Pattern P_YEAR =
            Pattern.compile("(?<!\\d)((?:19|20)\\d{2})(?!\\d)");
    private static final Pattern P_DISC_SUFFIX =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)[\\s._\\-]*[\\(\\[]?\\s*disc[\\s._\\-]*(\\d{1,2})\\s*[\\)\\]]?\\s*$");
    private static final Pattern P_CAMERA =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)^(vid|img|mov|dsc|pxl|mvimg|screen recording|whatsapp video)[\\s._\\-]*\\d.*");

    /** Release-junk tokens stripped from human title parts — tags only, never title words. */
    private static final Set<String> JUNK = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
            "2160p", "1080p", "720p", "480p", "360p", "4k", "uhd", "bluray",
            "bdrip", "brrip", "dvdrip", "dvdscr", "hdtv", "pdtv", "webdl",
            "webrip", "dl", "x264", "x265", "h264", "h265", "hevc", "avc", "aac",
            "ac3", "dts", "10bit", "8bit", "proper", "repack", "remastered",
            "yify", "rarbg", "fgt", "ettv", "etrg", "galaxyrg", "silence"));

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- parsing

    public static Entry fromFile(String fileName, String uri) {
        Entry e = new Entry();
        e.fileName = fileName == null ? "" : fileName;
        e.uri = uri == null ? "" : uri;

        String base = e.fileName;
        int slash = Math.max(base.lastIndexOf('/'), base.lastIndexOf('\\'));
        if (slash >= 0) base = base.substring(slash + 1);
        String stem = stripExtension(base);
        e.year = yearOf(stem);

        int[] span = EpisodeKey.parseSpan(stem);
        if (span != null) {
            e.season = span[0];
            e.episode = span[1];
            e.showName = stripYearToken(cleanPart(stem.substring(0, span[2])), e.year);
            e.episodeTitle = stripYearToken(cleanPart(stem.substring(span[3])), e.year);
            if (e.showName.isEmpty()) {
                // marker with nothing before it ("S01E01.mkv") — keep the
                // episode numbers, admit we don't know the show
                e.displayName = stem;
            } else {
                e.displayName = e.showName + " — S"
                        + String.format(Locale.US, "%02dE%02d", e.season, e.episode)
                        + (e.episodeTitle.isEmpty() ? "" : " · " + e.episodeTitle);
            }
            return e;
        }

        // Not an episode: a movie, a one-off, or a disc extra.
        String t = stem;
        Matcher dm = P_DISC_SUFFIX.matcher(t);
        if (dm.find()) t = t.substring(0, dm.start());
        String cleaned = stripYearToken(cleanPart(t), e.year);
        if (cleaned.isEmpty() || !hasLetter(cleaned) || P_CAMERA.matcher(base).find()) {
            // unsorted — kept, labeled with its real name, no invented title
            e.showName = "";
            e.displayName = stem;
            return e;
        }
        e.showName = cleaned;
        e.displayName = stem;
        return e;
    }

    private static String stripExtension(String name) {
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) {
            String ext = name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            if (VIDEO_EXTS.contains(ext)) return name.substring(0, dot);
        }
        return name;
    }

    private static int yearOf(String text) {
        Matcher m = P_YEAR.matcher(text);
        return m.find() ? Integer.parseInt(m.group(1)) : 0;
    }

    private static boolean hasLetter(String s) {
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (Character.isLetter(s.charAt(i))) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Human part of a file name with release junk removed: bracketed
     * tags out, separators become spaces, junk tokens dropped. Title
     * words — including digits like the "13" in "Apollo 13" — stay.
     */
    static String cleanPart(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        s = s.replaceAll("\\[[^\\]]*\\]", " ");
        s = s.replaceAll("\\{[^}]*\\}", " ");
        // "WEB-DL" as a compound tag out — but a bare "Web" can be a title
        // word ("Charlotte's Web"), so only the compound is stripped here;
        // "dl" alone is in the junk set as backstop.
        s = s.replaceAll("(?i)\\bweb[\\s._\\-]*dl\\b", " ");
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        boolean first = true;
        for (String tok : s.split("[^A-Za-z0-9']+")) {
            if (tok.isEmpty()) continue;
            String low = tok.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            if (JUNK.contains(low)) continue;
            if (low.matches("\\d{3,4}p")) continue;                    // 1080p as bare token
            if (low.matches("[xh]\\d{3}")) continue;                  // x265 / h264 fragments
            if (b.length() > 0) b.append(' ');
            b.append(titleCaseToken(tok, first));
            first = false;
        }
        return b.toString().trim();
    }

    /** Small words that stay lowercase mid-title ("Heart of Gold", "Night of the Living Dead"). */
    private static final Set<String> STOPWORDS = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
            "of", "the", "a", "an", "and", "or", "for", "to", "in", "on", "at", "vs"));

    /**
     * Scene-style names are often all-lowercase ("firefly.1x03...") or
     * all-caps; a uniform-case token is title-cased so the same show
     * doesn't split into "firefly" and "Firefly" in the census. Mixed
     * case is the author's own and stays; short all-caps tokens read as
     * acronyms (NCIS, SG1) and stay too; stopwords stay lower mid-title.
     */
    private static String titleCaseToken(String tok, boolean first) {
        boolean hasLetter = false, allLower = true, allUpper = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < tok.length(); i++) {
            char ch = tok.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isLetter(ch)) {
                hasLetter = true;
                if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) allUpper = false;
                if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) allLower = false;
            }
        }
        if (!hasLetter || (!allLower && !allUpper)) return tok;
        if (allUpper && tok.length() <= 4) return tok;
        if (allLower && !first && STOPWORDS.contains(tok.toLowerCase(Locale.US))) return tok;
        return Character.toUpperCase(tok.charAt(0)) + tok.substring(1).toLowerCase(Locale.US);
    }

    /** Drop a standalone year token when the part has other words to stand on. */
    private static String stripYearToken(String part, int year) {
        if (year <= 0 || part.isEmpty()) return part;
        String y = String.valueOf(year);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        boolean dropped = false;
        for (String tok : part.split(" ")) {
            if (!dropped && tok.equals(y)) { dropped = true; continue; }
            if (b.length() > 0) b.append(' ');
            b.append(tok);
        }
        String out = b.toString().trim();
        return out.isEmpty() ? part : out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- census

    public static int countEpisodes(List<Entry> entries) {
        int n = 0;
        for (Entry e : entries) if (e.isEpisode() && e.isSorted()) n++;
        return n;
    }

    public static int countUnsorted(List<Entry> entries) {
        int n = 0;
        for (Entry e : entries) if (!e.isSorted()) n++;
        return n;
    }

    /** Show name -> episode count, for the Library screen. Sorted by name. */
    public static Map<String, Integer> episodesByShow(List<Entry> entries) {
        Map<String, Integer> out = new TreeMap<>();
        for (Entry e : entries) {
            if (e.isEpisode() && e.isSorted()) {
                out.merge(e.showName, 1, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Non-episode sorted entries (movies, specials, disc extras). */
    public static List<Entry> oneOffs(List<Entry> entries) {
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Entry e : entries) if (!e.isEpisode() && e.isSorted()) out.add(e);
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- SourceFinder adapter

    /**
     * The library in the shape the source finders already speak. The
     * channel NAME is rebuilt as "Show S01E01 Episode Title" so the
     * phrase + marker matching lands exactly as it does for playlists;
     * source is "My Library" so result rows label it honestly.
     */
    public static M3uParser.Channel toChannel(Entry e) {
        M3uParser.Channel c = new M3uParser.Channel();
        if (e.isEpisode() && e.isSorted()) {
            c.name = e.showName + String.format(Locale.US, " S%02dE%02d", e.season, e.episode)
                    + (e.episodeTitle.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + e.episodeTitle);
        } else if (e.isSorted()) {
            c.name = e.showName + (e.year > 0 ? " (" + e.year + ")" : "");
        } else {
            c.name = e.fileName;   // unsorted: the real name, matchable as-is
        }
        c.url = e.uri;
        c.source = SOURCE_NAME;
        c.group = e.isEpisode() && e.isSorted() ? e.showName : SOURCE_NAME;
        return c;
    }

    public static List<M3uParser.Channel> toChannels(List<Entry> entries) {
        List<M3uParser.Channel> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (entries == null) return out;
        for (Entry e : entries) out.add(toChannel(e));
        return out;
    }

    /** Dedupe helper for the scanner: same URI twice = one file. */
    public static List<Entry> dedupeByUri(List<Entry> entries) {
        Map<String, Entry> byUri = new HashMap<>();
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Entry e : entries) {
            if (e.uri.isEmpty() || byUri.putIfAbsent(e.uri, e) == null) out.add(e);
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LibraryStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.ContentUris;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.provider.DocumentsContract;
import android.provider.MediaStore;

import org.json.JSONArray;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The Android half of My Library (v0.3.0): finds the video files on the
 * device — everything MediaStore knows about, plus every folder the
 * user picks (Storage Access Framework, permission persisted) walked
 * recursively — and hands the names to LibraryIndex for parsing.
 * The index is persisted as a TSV in internal storage, same pattern as
 * the channel cache: names + URIs + parsed fields, nothing copied,
 * nothing uploaded. The scan itself only proves anything on a real
 * device; the parsing it feeds is JVM-tested.
 */
public final class LibraryStore {

    private static final String PREFS = "talatv_library";
    private static final String KEY_FOLDERS = "folders_json";
    private static final String KEY_SCANNED_WHEN = "scanned_when";
    private static final String KEY_MEDIA_BLOCKED = "mediastore_blocked";
    private static final String INDEX_FILE = "library.tsv";
    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 14;

    private LibraryStore() {}

    private static SharedPreferences prefs(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- picked folders

    public static List<String> getFolders(Context ctx) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String raw = prefs(ctx).getString(KEY_FOLDERS, null);
        if (raw == null) return out;
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(raw);
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) out.add(arr.getString(i));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return out;
    }

    public static void setFolders(Context ctx, List<String> folders) {
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
            for (String f : folders) arr.put(f);
            prefs(ctx).edit().putString(KEY_FOLDERS, arr.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    public static long scannedWhen(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getLong(KEY_SCANNED_WHEN, 0);
    }

    /** True when the last scan could not read MediaStore (permission not granted). */
    public static boolean mediaStoreBlocked(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean(KEY_MEDIA_BLOCKED, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- scanning

    /**
     * Full rescan (background thread): MediaStore + every picked folder.
     * Returns the parsed entries and persists them. A SecurityException
     * from MediaStore is recorded, not hidden — the folder half still runs.
     */
    public static List<LibraryIndex.Entry> scan(Context ctx) {
        List<LibraryIndex.Entry> found = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean blocked = false;

        try {
            Uri collection = MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
            String[] proj = {MediaStore.Video.Media._ID, MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME};
            try (Cursor cur = ctx.getContentResolver().query(
                    collection, proj, null, null, null)) {
                if (cur != null) {
                    int idCol = cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media._ID);
                    int nameCol = cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME);
                    while (cur.moveToNext()) {
                        String name = cur.getString(nameCol);
                        if (name == null || !LibraryIndex.isVideoFile(name)) continue;
                        Uri uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, cur.getLong(idCol));
                        found.add(LibraryIndex.fromFile(name, uri.toString()));
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            blocked = true;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // a broken provider shouldn't sink the folder scan
        }

        for (String treeUri : getFolders(ctx)) {
            try {
                Uri tree = Uri.parse(treeUri);
                String rootId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree);
                walkTree(ctx, tree, rootId, 0, found);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // a revoked/dead folder is skipped; the screen says folders
                // can be re-picked, and Rescan drops nothing from the index
                // that another source still provides
            }
        }

        List<LibraryIndex.Entry> entries = LibraryIndex.dedupeByUri(found);
        saveIndex(ctx, entries);
        prefs(ctx).edit()
                .putLong(KEY_SCANNED_WHEN, System.currentTimeMillis())
                .putBoolean(KEY_MEDIA_BLOCKED, blocked)
                .apply();
        return entries;
    }

    private static void walkTree(Context ctx, Uri tree, String docId, int depth,
                                 List<LibraryIndex.Entry> out) {
        if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) return;
        Uri childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, docId);
        String[] proj = {
                DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
                DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
                DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE};
        try (Cursor cur = ctx.getContentResolver().query(childrenUri, proj, null, null, null)) {
            if (cur == null) return;
            while (cur.moveToNext()) {
                String id = cur.getString(0);
                String name = cur.getString(1);
                String mime = cur.getString(2);
                if (id == null) continue;
                if (DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR.equals(mime)) {
                    walkTree(ctx, tree, id, depth + 1, out);
                } else if (name != null && (LibraryIndex.isVideoFile(name)
                        || (mime != null && mime.startsWith("video/")))) {
                    Uri docUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, id);
                    out.add(LibraryIndex.fromFile(name, docUri.toString()));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // unreadable branch of the tree: skip it, keep walking the rest
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- persistence

    private static String enc(String s) {
        try { return URLEncoder.encode(s == null ? "" : s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    private static String dec(String s) {
        try { return URLDecoder.decode(s, "UTF-8"); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    private static void saveIndex(Context ctx, List<LibraryIndex.Entry> entries) {
        File f = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), INDEX_FILE);
        try (Writer w = new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(f), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : entries) {
                w.write(enc(e.uri));         w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(e.fileName));    w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(e.displayName)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(e.showName));    w.write('\t');
                w.write(enc(e.episodeTitle)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(String.valueOf(e.season));  w.write('\t');
                w.write(String.valueOf(e.episode)); w.write('\t');
                w.write(String.valueOf(e.year));
                w.write('\n');
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    /** The persisted index; empty list when never scanned (not an error). */
    public static List<LibraryIndex.Entry> loadEntries(Context ctx) {
        List<LibraryIndex.Entry> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File f = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), INDEX_FILE);
        if (!f.exists()) return out;
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(new FileInputStream(f), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
                String[] p = line.split("\t", -1);
                if (p.length < 8) continue;
                LibraryIndex.Entry e = new LibraryIndex.Entry();
                e.uri = dec(p[0]);
                e.fileName = dec(p[1]);
                e.displayName = dec(p[2]);
                e.showName = dec(p[3]);
                e.episodeTitle = dec(p[4]);
                e.season = parseInt(p[5]);
                e.episode = parseInt(p[6]);
                e.year = parseInt(p[7]);
                out.add(e);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return out;
    }

    /** The library in channel shape for SourceFinder; empty when unscanned. */
    public static List<M3uParser.Channel> loadChannels(Context ctx) {
        return LibraryIndex.toChannels(loadEntries(ctx));
    }

    private static int parseInt(String s) {
        try { return Integer.parseInt(s.trim()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0; }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/LinkHealth.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.UnknownHostException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Link health (v0.3.0, deepened in v0.4.0) — the quality layer the raw
 * directory lacks. James's field report on 0.3.0: verified channels
 * "may connect, but they're not working — no video." He was right: a
 * 0.3.0 probe stopped at the playlist, and a playlist is only a list —
 * the video segments it points to can be dead while the list answers.
 *
 * So the 0.4.0 probe walks the whole chain: playlist -> (master ->
 * first variant) -> media playlist -> FIRST SEGMENT, and the verdict
 * is a tier, not a yes/no:
 *
 *   PLAYS         a piece of the actual video answered just now
 *   CONNECTS_ONLY the playlist answers, but the video pieces don't
 *   DEAD          the playlist itself never answered / wasn't one
 *
 * Result.ok stays in the code as a convenience and means tier==PLAYS —
 * "working" in this app now means proven to the segment, nothing less.
 *
 * Pure java.net — the same class runs in the JVM harness against
 * captured chains. Persistence of verdicts lives in HealthStore.
 */
public final class LinkHealth {

    // Verdict tiers (persisted by HealthStore).
    public static final int TIER_DEAD = 0;
    public static final int TIER_CONNECTS = 1;
    public static final int TIER_PLAYS = 2;

    public static final class Result {
        public int tier = TIER_DEAD;  // verdict tier (v0.4.0)
        public boolean ok;            // == tier == TIER_PLAYS
        public boolean responded;     // any HTTP response arrived at all
        public int httpCode;          // final status, 0 = no response
        public String detail = "";    // plain reason, fit to show a user
        public long checkedAt;        // epoch ms when the probe ran
        /**
         * v0.11.0 (James's field report, 2026-10-18): this outcome was
         * caused by SLOWNESS — a timeout, a reset, an overloaded
         * server — not by a terminal answer. A slow result is NOT a
         * death verdict: HealthStore refuses to file it as DEAD, and
         * callers must word it as what it is ("didn't answer in
         * time — it may just be slow"), never "dead".
         */
        public boolean slow;
        /** How many decisive attempts the patient probe ran (1 = once). */
        public int attempts = 1;

        public Result finish(int tier, boolean responded, String detail) {
            this.tier = tier;
            this.ok = tier == TIER_PLAYS;
            this.responded = responded;
            this.detail = detail;
            return this;
        }

        /** A DEAD-shaped outcome whose cause was slowness, not death. */
        public Result finishSlow(String detail) {
            finish(TIER_DEAD, responded, detail);
            this.slow = true;
            return this;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------- outcome classification
    // v0.11.0: the split the old probe never made. TERMINAL answers
    // are the server (or the address) saying the thing is gone or
    // wrong — declare dead fast and finally. RETRYABLE outcomes are
    // the server not managing to answer — slow, reset, overloaded —
    // and history (James, SG-1 ep 3, 2026-10-18) says they very
    // often play on the next try.

    public static final int CLS_OK = 0;
    public static final int CLS_TERMINAL = 1;
    public static final int CLS_RETRYABLE = 2;

    public static int classifyHttp(int code) {
        if (code >= 200 && code < 300) return CLS_OK;
        if (code == 404 || code == 410) return CLS_TERMINAL;   // gone
        if (code == 408 || code == 429) return CLS_RETRYABLE;  // timeout / throttled
        if (code >= 500) return CLS_RETRYABLE;                 // server in trouble
        return CLS_TERMINAL;                                   // other 4xx: it said no
    }

    public static int classifyIo(IOException e) {
        if (e instanceof SocketTimeoutException) return CLS_RETRYABLE;
        if (e instanceof UnknownHostException) return CLS_TERMINAL;
        if (e instanceof java.net.ConnectException) return CLS_TERMINAL; // refused
        // Resets, dropped tunnels, handshake stalls: the wire failed,
        // not the address — a retry is a fair ask.
        return CLS_RETRYABLE;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- patience
    // Patient but bounded (James's bounds, both directions: retry
    // the slow, never hang forever). Three decisive attempts, short
    // backoffs, and a hard 30s cap across the whole resolution —
    // a retry is only started when the cap can still hold an
    // attempt's first hop.

    public static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
    public static final long TOTAL_CAP_MS = 30_000;
    public static final long[] BACKOFF_MS = {1000, 2000};

    public interface Patience {
        /** Fires before each retry: the server is slow, we're still trying. */
        void onSlow(int nextAttempt, int maxAttempts);
    }

    public interface Sleeper { void sleep(long ms) throws InterruptedException; }

    private static volatile Sleeper sleeper = ms -> Thread.sleep(ms);

    /** Harness hook; the app never calls this. */
    public static void setSleeper(Sleeper s) {
        sleeper = s == null ? (ms -> Thread.sleep(ms)) : s;
    }

    /** The cap math, pure: may another attempt start? */
    public static boolean mayRetry(int attempt, long elapsedMs, int timeoutMs) {
        if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) return false;
        long backoff = BACKOFF_MS[Math.min(attempt - 1, BACKOFF_MS.length - 1)];
        return elapsedMs + backoff + timeoutMs <= TOTAL_CAP_MS;
    }

    public static final class Target {
        public final String url;
        public final String userAgent;
        public Target(String url, String userAgent) {
            this.url = url;
            this.userAgent = userAgent == null ? "" : userAgent;
        }
    }

    public interface Sink {
        void onResult(Target target, Result result);
    }

    /**
     * One HTTP hop: a GET with redirects NOT followed, returning the
     * status, the Location header (for 3xx), and the first bytes of the
     * body. The probe logic — redirect chasing, chain walking, verdicts
     * — lives in probe() and is shared verbatim between the app and the
     * JVM harness; only this hop touches a socket, through
     * HttpURLConnection exactly as the player reaches the network.
     * The seam exists so the harness can replay real captured responses
     * (this build sandbox resets JVM sockets outright — measured).
     */
    public interface Transport {
        Response get(String url, String userAgent, int timeoutMs) throws IOException;
    }

    public static final class Response {
        public final int code;
        public final String location;
        public final String bodyHead;
        public Response(int code, String location, String bodyHead) {
            this.code = code;
            this.location = location;
            this.bodyHead = bodyHead == null ? "" : bodyHead;
        }
    }

    private static volatile Transport transport = new HttpTransport();

    /** Harness hook; the app never calls this. */
    public static void setTransport(Transport t) {
        transport = t == null ? new HttpTransport() : t;
    }

    private static final class HttpTransport implements Transport {
        @Override
        public Response get(String url, String userAgent, int timeoutMs) throws IOException {
            HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(url).openConnection();
            try {
                conn.setConnectTimeout(timeoutMs);
                conn.setReadTimeout(timeoutMs);
                conn.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);   // probe() follows by hand (http->https too)
                conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", userAgent);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String location = conn.getHeaderField("Location");
                String head = "";
                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    head = readHead(conn.getInputStream(), HEAD_BYTES);
                }
                return new Response(code, location, head);
            } finally {
                conn.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    /** Playlists can run long; 64 KB of head is room for the first segment line. */
    private static final int HEAD_BYTES = 65536;

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int done, int total, int working, int answered);
    }

    private LinkHealth() {}

    public static boolean isRemote(String url) {
        return url != null && (url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://"));
    }

    /**
     * Same "is this an HLS stream" heuristic the player uses: an .m3u8 in
     * the address, or no file extension at all (scripts/redirectors that
     * hide the manifest). Direct media files (.mp4/.mkv/…) are not HLS.
     */
    public static boolean looksHls(String url) {
        if (url == null) return false;
        String lower = url.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (lower.contains(".m3u8")) return true;
        String tail = lower.substring(lower.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        return !tail.contains(".") || lower.contains(".php") || lower.contains("play?");
    }

    public static boolean headLooksLikePlaylist(String head) {
        return head != null && head.contains("#EXTM3U");
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- playlist parsing

    /** First variant URI in a master playlist (line after #EXT-X-STREAM-INF), or null. */
    public static String firstVariantUri(String playlistText) {
        if (playlistText == null) return null;
        boolean wantNext = false;
        for (String raw : playlistText.split("\\r?\\n")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            if (line.startsWith("#EXT-X-STREAM-INF")) {
                wantNext = true;
            } else if (wantNext) {
                if (line.startsWith("#")) continue;
                if (!line.isEmpty()) return line;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean isMasterPlaylist(String playlistText) {
        return playlistText != null && playlistText.contains("#EXT-X-STREAM-INF");
    }

    /**
     * First segment URI in a media playlist: the first non-comment line
     * that is not itself a playlist reference (a nested .m3u8 line in a
     * media playlist is a variant, not a segment). Key/map lines
     * (#EXT-X-KEY / #EXT-X-MAP carry URI="..." attributes) are skipped —
     * the segment proper is what proves video.
     */
    public static String firstSegmentUri(String playlistText) {
        if (playlistText == null) return null;
        for (String raw : playlistText.split("\\r?\\n")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String lower = line.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            String path = lower;
            int q = path.indexOf('?');
            if (q >= 0) path = path.substring(0, q);
            if (path.endsWith(".m3u8")) continue;
            return line;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- probe

    /** A hop outcome the chain walker can act on. */
    private static final class Hop {
        Response resp;
        String finalUrl;
        String errorDetail;    // non-null: the hop itself failed (timeout/DNS/IO)
        boolean responded;
        int failureCls = CLS_TERMINAL;  // classifyIo() of the failure
    }

    private static Hop fetchChain(String url, String ua, int timeoutMs) {
        Hop h = new Hop();
        String current = url;
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
                Response resp = transport.get(current, ua, timeoutMs);
                h.resp = resp;
                h.finalUrl = current;
                h.responded = resp.code > 0;
                if (resp.code == 301 || resp.code == 302 || resp.code == 303
                        || resp.code == 307 || resp.code == 308) {
                    if (resp.location == null || resp.location.isEmpty() || i == 5) {
                        return h;
                    }
                    current = new URL(new URL(current), resp.location).toString();
                    continue;
                }
                return h;
            }
        } catch (SocketTimeoutException e) {
            h.errorDetail = "didn't answer in time";
            h.failureCls = classifyIo(e);
        } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
            h.errorDetail = "address didn't resolve";
            h.failureCls = classifyIo(e);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            String m = e.getMessage();
            h.errorDetail = "didn't answer" + (m == null || m.isEmpty()
                    ? "" : " (" + (m.length() > 40 ? m.substring(0, 40) : m) + ")");
            h.failureCls = classifyIo(e);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // The network stack can fail with unchecked exceptions too
            // (malformed redirects, tunnel/parser failures). A probe
            // must never take the app down — any failure is a verdict.
            h.errorDetail = "didn't answer";
            h.failureCls = CLS_TERMINAL;
        }
        return h;
    }

    /**
     * One link, one tiered verdict, ONE attempt (the batch checker
     * and the auto-skip walk use this — breadth over patience).
     * Failures are classified as they land: a retryable failure
     * (timeout, reset, a server in trouble) comes back DEAD-shaped
     * but flagged {@code slow} — it is not a death verdict, and
     * HealthStore will not file it as one.
     */
    public static Result probeOnce(String url, String userAgent, int timeoutMs) {
        Result r = new Result();
        r.checkedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (!isRemote(url)) {
            // on-device file (My Library): it is here by definition
            return r.finish(TIER_PLAYS, true, "on this phone");
        }
        String ua = (userAgent == null || userAgent.isEmpty()) ? "Sandy/0.14.1" : userAgent;

        // Direct media file: the file answering with bytes IS the video
        // answering — there is no playlist layer to hide behind.
        if (!looksHls(url)) {
            Hop h = fetchChain(url, ua, timeoutMs);
            if (h.errorDetail != null) {
                if (h.failureCls == CLS_RETRYABLE) return r.finishSlow(h.errorDetail);
                return r.finish(TIER_DEAD, false, h.errorDetail);
            }
            r.httpCode = h.resp.code;
            r.responded = h.responded;
            if (h.resp.code >= 200 && h.resp.code < 300) {
                return r.finish(TIER_PLAYS, true, "plays");
            }
            if (classifyHttp(h.resp.code) == CLS_RETRYABLE) {
                return r.finishSlow("the server answered HTTP " + h.resp.code
                        + " — it may just be busy");
            }
            return r.finish(TIER_DEAD, h.responded, "HTTP " + h.resp.code);
        }

        // HLS: walk playlist -> variant -> media playlist -> segment.
        Hop h = fetchChain(url, ua, timeoutMs);
        if (h.errorDetail != null) {
            if (h.failureCls == CLS_RETRYABLE) return r.finishSlow(h.errorDetail);
            return r.finish(TIER_DEAD, false, h.errorDetail);
        }
        r.httpCode = h.resp.code;
        r.responded = h.responded;
        if (h.resp.code < 200 || h.resp.code >= 300) {
            if (classifyHttp(h.resp.code) == CLS_RETRYABLE) {
                return r.finishSlow("the server answered HTTP " + h.resp.code
                        + " — it may just be busy");
            }
            return r.finish(TIER_DEAD, h.responded, "HTTP " + h.resp.code);
        }
        if (!headLooksLikePlaylist(h.resp.bodyHead)) {
            return r.finish(TIER_DEAD, true, "answered, but didn't send a playlist");
        }
        String playlistUrl = h.finalUrl;
        String text = h.resp.bodyHead;

        // Master playlist: descend into the first variant.
        if (isMasterPlaylist(text)) {
            String variant = firstVariantUri(text);
            if (variant == null) {
                return r.finish(TIER_CONNECTS, true, "playlist answers, but lists no streams");
            }
            String variantUrl = resolve(playlistUrl, variant);
            Hop vh = fetchChain(variantUrl, ua, timeoutMs);
            if (vh.errorDetail != null || vh.resp == null
                    || vh.resp.code < 200 || vh.resp.code >= 300
                    || !headLooksLikePlaylist(vh.resp.bodyHead)) {
                return r.finish(TIER_CONNECTS, true,
                        "playlist answers, but its video list doesn't");
            }
            playlistUrl = vh.finalUrl;
            text = vh.resp.bodyHead;
        }

        String segment = firstSegmentUri(text);
        if (segment == null) {
            return r.finish(TIER_CONNECTS, true, "playlist answers, but holds no video yet");
        }
        Hop sh = fetchChain(resolve(playlistUrl, segment), ua, timeoutMs);
        if (sh.errorDetail != null) {
            return r.finish(TIER_CONNECTS, true, "playlist answers, but the video didn't");
        }
        if (sh.resp != null && sh.resp.code >= 200 && sh.resp.code < 300
                && sh.resp.bodyHead != null && !sh.resp.bodyHead.isEmpty()) {
            return r.finish(TIER_PLAYS, true, "plays");
        }
        int code = sh.resp == null ? 0 : sh.resp.code;
        return r.finish(TIER_CONNECTS, true,
                code > 0 ? "playlist answers, but the video didn't (HTTP " + code + ")"
                         : "playlist answers, but the video didn't");
    }

    /**
     * The patient probe — what a person's tap gets (v0.11.0, James's
     * field report). A retryable outcome is retried in place, a few
     * attempts over several seconds, before any verdict reaches the
     * user: the word "dead" is never spoken while retries remain.
     * Terminal outcomes return on the first attempt, fast and final.
     * The whole resolution is hard-capped (TOTAL_CAP_MS) so patience
     * can never become a hang.
     */
    public static Result probe(String url, String userAgent, int timeoutMs) {
        return probe(url, userAgent, timeoutMs, null);
    }

    public static Result probe(String url, String userAgent, int timeoutMs,
                               Patience patience) {
        long started = System.currentTimeMillis();
        int attempt = 1;
        while (true) {
            Result r = probeOnce(url, userAgent, timeoutMs);
            r.attempts = attempt;
            if (!r.slow) return r;
            long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - started;
            if (!mayRetry(attempt, elapsed, timeoutMs)) return r;
            if (patience != null) patience.onSlow(attempt + 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS);
            try {
                sleeper.sleep(BACKOFF_MS[Math.min(attempt - 1,
                        BACKOFF_MS.length - 1)]);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return r;
            }
            attempt++;
        }
    }

    private static String resolve(String base, String ref) {
        try {
            return new URL(new URL(base), ref).toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ref;
        }
    }

    private static String readHead(InputStream in, int maxBytes) {
        if (in == null) return "";
        try {
            byte[] buf = new byte[maxBytes];
            int off = 0, n;
            while (off < buf.length && (n = in.read(buf, off, buf.length - off)) > 0) {
                off += n;
            }
            return new String(buf, 0, off, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- batch

    /**
     * Probe a set of links with bounded concurrency and polite timeouts.
     * Every verdict goes to the sink (per target) as it lands; progress
     * fires per completion. Returns {total, answered, plays,
     * connectsOnly, deadButAnswered} where "answered" counts links that
     * produced any HTTP response and "plays" counts tier PLAYS — the
     * numbers the UI reports.
     */
    public static int[] probeAll(List<Target> targets, int concurrency, int timeoutMs,
                                 Sink sink, Progress progress) {
        int total = targets.size();
        AtomicInteger done = new AtomicInteger();
        AtomicInteger plays = new AtomicInteger();
        AtomicInteger connects = new AtomicInteger();
        AtomicInteger deadAnswered = new AtomicInteger();
        AtomicInteger answered = new AtomicInteger();
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(Math.max(1, concurrency));
        for (Target t : targets) {
            pool.execute(() -> {
                // The batch walks single-attempt (probeOnce): breadth
                // over patience — but a slow outcome is not counted
                // or filed as dead either (see Result.slow).
                Result r = probeOnce(t.url, t.userAgent, timeoutMs);
                if (r.tier == TIER_PLAYS) plays.incrementAndGet();
                else if (r.tier == TIER_CONNECTS) connects.incrementAndGet();
                else if (r.responded && !r.slow) deadAnswered.incrementAndGet();
                if (r.responded) answered.incrementAndGet();
                if (sink != null) sink.onResult(t, r);
                int d = done.incrementAndGet();
                if (progress != null) progress.onProgress(d, total, plays.get(), answered.get());
            });
        }
        pool.shutdown();
        try {
            pool.awaitTermination(6, TimeUnit.HOURS);
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
        return new int[]{total, answered.get(), plays.get(), connects.get(), deadAnswered.get()};
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- display

    /** "just now" / "12m ago" / "3h ago" / "2d ago" / "Mar 3" — for badges. */
    public static String friendlyWhen(long checkedAt, long now) {
        long diff = now - checkedAt;
        if (diff < 60_000) return "just now";
        if (diff < 3_600_000) return (diff / 60_000) + "m ago";
        if (diff < 86_400_000) return (diff / 3_600_000) + "h ago";
        if (diff < 7 * 86_400_000L) return (diff / 86_400_000L) + "d ago";
        return new SimpleDateFormat("MMM d", Locale.US).format(new Date(checkedAt));
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ListenActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * LISTEN FOR ME (v0.15.0) — the ears door. Speech becomes big,
 * immediate text on screen (the recognition service's live
 * partials, shown as they form), and every utterance can be
 * handled three ways: issued as TEXT, RECORDED (the sound and
 * the transcript kept together as files on the memory hook), or
 * handed to the Translator.
 *
 * The state surface is honest: listening / heard / unsure / no
 * recognizer — unsure is shown as unsure (the best guess, labeled
 * a guess), never polished into certainty. Whose ear produced
 * the words is part of the record: the phone's listening SERVICE
 * (EarCapture — may use the network; the service's own reality)
 * or Sandy's own on-device whisper from an installed engine
 * pack, which backs the RECORD road for the pack pair's source
 * language (today: Japanese in ja-en).
 */
public final class ListenActivity extends Activity {

    private static final String PREFS = "sandy_doors";
    private static final int REQ_MIC = 7;

    private EarCapture ear;
    private ListenStore.WavRecorder recorder;
    private List<VoiceLangs.Row> langs = new ArrayList<>();
    private VoiceLangs.Row chosen;
    private boolean recordMode = false;
    private String lastText = "";
    private String lastPartial = "";

    private Button langBtn;
    private TextView stateLine;
    private TextView bigText;
    private TextView noteLine;
    private Button listenBtn;
    private Button toTranslatorBtn;
    private boolean listening = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "door_listen"));
        langs = VoiceLangs.load(this);
        String saved = prefs().getString("listen_lang", "");
        chosen = VoiceLangs.byIso1(langs, saved);
        if (chosen == null) {
            String ui = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
            chosen = VoiceLangs.byIso1(langs, ui == null || ui.isEmpty() ? "en" : ui);
        }
        if (chosen == null && !langs.isEmpty()) chosen = langs.get(0);

        int pad = dp(16);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "door_listen"));
        title.setTextSize(24);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView langLabel = new TextView(this);
        langLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_language"));
        langLabel.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(langLabel, topMargin(dp(12)));
        langBtn = new Button(this);
        langBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        langBtn.setTextSize(19);
        langBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickLanguage());
        root.addView(langBtn);

        stateLine = new TextView(this);
        stateLine.setTextSize(17);
        root.addView(stateLine, topMargin(dp(10)));

        bigText = new TextView(this);
        bigText.setTextSize(30);
        root.addView(bigText, topMargin(dp(8)));

        noteLine = new TextView(this);
        noteLine.setTextSize(14);
        root.addView(noteLine, topMargin(dp(4)));

        CheckBox recordBox = new CheckBox(this);
        recordBox.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_record"));
        recordBox.setTextSize(17);
        recordBox.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, on) -> recordMode = on);
        root.addView(recordBox, topMargin(dp(12)));

        listenBtn = new Button(this);
        listenBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_start"));
        listenBtn.setTextSize(22);
        listenBtn.setMinHeight(dp(72));
        listenBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listening) stopListening();
            else startListening();
        });
        root.addView(listenBtn, topMargin(dp(10)));

        toTranslatorBtn = new Button(this);
        toTranslatorBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_to_translator"));
        toTranslatorBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        toTranslatorBtn.setTextSize(18);
        toTranslatorBtn.setEnabled(false);
        toTranslatorBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, TranslatorActivity.class);
            i.putExtra(TranslatorActivity.X_SEED_TEXT, lastText);
            i.putExtra(TranslatorActivity.X_SEED_LANG,
                    chosen == null ? "" : chosen.iso1);
            startActivity(i);
        });
        root.addView(toTranslatorBtn, topMargin(dp(10)));

        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.addView(root);
        setContentView(scroll);

        ear = new EarCapture(this);
        ear.setListener(new EarCapture.Listener() {
            @Override public void onListening() {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(ListenActivity.this,
                        "listen_state_listening"));
            }
            @Override public void onPartial(String text) {
                lastPartial = text;
                bigText.setText(text);
            }
            @Override public void onFinal(String text, ListenRecord.State state) {
                onHeard(text, state);
            }
        });
        refreshLanguageUi();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (ear != null) ear.stop();
        if (recorder != null) recorder.stop();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ language

    private void refreshLanguageUi() {
        if (chosen == null) return;
        langBtn.setText(chosen.tvName);
        if (!EarCapture.present(this)) {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_none"));
        }
    }

    private void pickLanguage() {
        Set<String> pairs = TextMt.installedPairs(this);
        boolean present = EarCapture.present(this);
        List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
        for (VoiceLangs.Row r : langs) {
            StringBuilder s = new StringBuilder(r.tvName);
            if (!present) {
                s.append(" — ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_none"));
            } else if (DoorCoverage.whisperCovers(r.iso1, pairs)) {
                s.append(" — ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_whisper_note"));
            }
            labels.add(s.toString());
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_language"))
                .setItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]), (d, which) -> {
                    chosen = langs.get(which);
                    prefs().edit().putString("listen_lang", chosen.iso1).apply();
                    refreshLanguageUi();
                })
                .show();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ listening

    private void startListening() {
        if (chosen == null) return;
        if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO},
                    REQ_MIC);
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_no_mic"));
            return;
        }
        if (!EarCapture.present(this)) {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_none"));
            return;
        }
        lastPartial = "";
        bigText.setText("");
        noteLine.setText("");
        if (recordMode) {
            recorder = new ListenStore.WavRecorder();
            recorder.start(); // sound kept alongside, whatever the ear does
        }
        if (ear.start(chosen.iso1)) {
            listening = true;
            listenBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_stop"));
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_listening"));
        } else {
            if (recorder != null) { recorder.stop(); recorder = null; }
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_none"));
        }
    }

    private void stopListening() {
        ear.stop();
        listening = false;
        listenBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_start"));
    }

    private void onHeard(String text, ListenRecord.State state) {
        listening = false;
        listenBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_start"));
        short[] pcm = null;
        if (recorder != null) {
            pcm = recorder.stop();
            recorder = null;
        }
        final short[] sound = pcm;
        String words = text == null ? "" : text;
        if (words.isEmpty() && state == ListenRecord.State.HEARD) {
            state = ListenRecord.State.UNSURE;
        }
        // show the take as it stands (best guess stays a guess)
        if (!words.isEmpty()) {
            bigText.setText(words);
            lastText = words;
            toTranslatorBtn.setEnabled(true);
        } else if (!lastPartial.isEmpty()) {
            bigText.setText(lastPartial);
        }
        switch (state) {
            case HEARD:
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_heard"));
                noteLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_system_note"));
                break;
            case UNSURE:
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_unsure"));
                noteLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_unsure_note"));
                break;
            case NO_RECOGNIZER:
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_none"));
                noteLine.setText("");
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
        if (recordMode && sound != null) {
            keepRecord(words, state, sound);
        }
    }

    /**
     * The RECORD road: decide the transcript's true source, then
     * keep sound + words together. When Sandy's whisper covers
     * this language (installed pack pair source), it re-hears the
     * saved sound on-device and its words — labeled — win; the
     * system ear's text stands otherwise, and an unsure take is
     * kept as an unsure take.
     */
    private void keepRecord(final String sysWords,
                            final ListenRecord.State sysState,
                            final short[] sound) {
        final String iso = chosen == null ? "" : chosen.iso1;
        String pair = null;
        for (String p : TextMt.installedPairs(this)) {
            if (p.startsWith(iso + "-")) { pair = p; break; }
        }
        final String whisperPair = pair;
        new Thread(() -> {
            ListenRecord.Record r = new ListenRecord.Record();
            r.id = ListenStore.newId();
            r.iso1 = iso;
            r.createdMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
            r.state = sysState;
            r.source = sysWords.isEmpty()
                    ? ListenRecord.Source.NONE : ListenRecord.Source.SYSTEM_EAR;
            r.text = sysWords;
            if (whisperPair != null) {
                String heard = ListenStore.transcribeWithWhisper(
                        this, sound, whisperPair);
                if (heard != null && !heard.isEmpty()) {
                    r.text = heard;
                    r.source = ListenRecord.Source.SANDY_WHISPER;
                    r.state = ListenRecord.State.HEARD;
                }
            }
            ListenRecord.Record saved = ListenStore.save(this, r, sound);
            final ListenRecord.Record done = saved;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (done == null) return;
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_saved"));
                if (done.source == ListenRecord.Source.SANDY_WHISPER) {
                    noteLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_whisper_note"));
                    bigText.setText(done.text);
                    lastText = done.text;
                    toTranslatorBtn.setEnabled(true);
                } else if (done.source == ListenRecord.Source.SYSTEM_EAR) {
                    noteLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_system_note"));
                }
            });
        }, "listen-keep").start();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private SharedPreferences prefs() {
        return getSharedPreferences(PREFS, MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams topMargin(int m) {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = m;
        return lp;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ListenRecord.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * LISTEN FOR ME's record (v0.15.0) — one heard utterance, kept
 * honestly: what state the ear ended in, whose ear produced the
 * words, and the FILES that carry it (the sound and the transcript
 * together on the memory hook — file in, file out).
 *
 * The states are the door's honest surface, never polished:
 *   LISTENING      the ear is open right now
 *   HEARD          words came back from a recognizer
 *   UNSURE         the ear answered but can't stand behind it
 *                  (no match, a timeout, a whisper pass that
 *                  found nothing it trusts)
 *   NO_RECOGNIZER  this phone has no ear for that language —
 *                  said plainly, before anyone talks at it
 *
 * The transcript's source is part of the record, because the two
 * ears are different machinery and the difference must not hide:
 *   SYSTEM_EAR     the phone's speech-recognition service (may
 *                  use the network — the service's own reality)
 *   SANDY_WHISPER  Sandy's own on-device whisper, from an
 *                  installed engine pack, over the saved sound
 *   NONE           no words at all (an unsure/silent take)
 *
 * Pure: file bodies and the index line are built and parsed here
 * so the harness pins the round-trip; ListenStore does the IO.
 */
public final class ListenRecord {

    public enum State { LISTENING, HEARD, UNSURE, NO_RECOGNIZER }

    public enum Source { SYSTEM_EAR, SANDY_WHISPER, NONE }

    // SpeechRecognizer error codes (android.speech.SpeechRecognizer),
    // copied as literals so this class stays Android-free; the door
    // passes the raw int through stateForError.
    private static final int ERR_NETWORK_TIMEOUT = 1;
    private static final int ERR_NETWORK = 2;
    private static final int ERR_AUDIO = 3;
    private static final int ERR_SERVER = 4;
    private static final int ERR_CLIENT = 5;
    private static final int ERR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT = 6;
    private static final int ERR_NO_MATCH = 7;
    private static final int ERR_RECOGNIZER_BUSY = 8;
    private static final int ERR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS = 9;
    private static final int ERR_LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED = 12;
    private static final int ERR_LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE = 13;

    /**
     * Map a recognizer error to the honest state. A miss or a
     * timeout is UNSURE — the ear was there, the words weren't.
     * A language the service doesn't carry, or the service itself
     * failing, is NO_RECOGNIZER — there was no ear to hear with.
     */
    public static State stateForError(int error) {
        switch (error) {
            case ERR_NO_MATCH:
            case ERR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT:
                return State.UNSURE;
            case ERR_LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED:
            case ERR_LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE:
            case ERR_NETWORK:
            case ERR_NETWORK_TIMEOUT:
            case ERR_SERVER:
            case ERR_CLIENT:
            case ERR_RECOGNIZER_BUSY:
            case ERR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS:
            case ERR_AUDIO:
            default:
                return State.NO_RECOGNIZER;
        }
    }

    /** One kept utterance. */
    public static final class Record {
        public String id = "";          // e.g. 20261019-143022
        public String iso1 = "";        // the language listened in
        public State state = State.UNSURE;
        public Source source = Source.NONE;
        public String text = "";        // the words ("" when none)
        public String audioName = "";   // wav file name ("" = no sound kept)
        public long createdMs = 0;

        public String transcriptName() {
            return id.isEmpty() ? "" : "listen_" + id + ".txt";
        }

        public String audioFileName() {
            return id.isEmpty() ? "" : "listen_" + id + ".wav";
        }
    }

    private ListenRecord() {}

    /** The transcript file body: a small header, then the words. */
    public static String transcriptBody(Record r) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy — Listen For Me record\n");
        sb.append("id: ").append(r.id).append('\n');
        sb.append("language: ").append(r.iso1).append('\n');
        sb.append("state: ").append(r.state.name()).append('\n');
        sb.append("source: ").append(r.source.name()).append('\n');
        sb.append("audio: ").append(r.audioName).append('\n');
        sb.append("---\n");
        sb.append(r.text == null ? "" : r.text).append('\n');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** Parse a transcript file body back into a record. */
    public static Record parseTranscript(String body) {
        Record r = new Record();
        if (body == null) return r;
        StringBuilder words = new StringBuilder();
        boolean inWords = false;
        for (String line : body.split("\n", -1)) {
            if (inWords) {
                if (words.length() > 0) words.append('\n');
                words.append(line);
                continue;
            }
            if (line.equals("---")) { inWords = true; continue; }
            int c = line.indexOf(':');
            if (c < 0) continue;
            String k = line.substring(0, c).trim();
            String v = line.substring(c + 1).trim();
            try {
                if (k.equals("id")) r.id = v;
                else if (k.equals("language")) r.iso1 = v;
                else if (k.equals("state")) r.state = State.valueOf(v);
                else if (k.equals("source")) r.source = Source.valueOf(v);
                else if (k.equals("audio")) r.audioName = v;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        r.text = words.toString().trim();
        return r;
    }

    /** The index line (listen_index.tsv): one row per kept record. */
    public static String indexLine(Record r) {
        return r.id + "\t" + r.iso1 + "\t" + r.state.name() + "\t"
                + r.source.name() + "\t" + r.audioName + "\t"
                + r.createdMs + "\n";
    }

    /** Parse the whole index back into records (order preserved). */
    public static List<Record> parseIndex(String body) {
        List<Record> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (body == null) return out;
        for (String line : body.split("\n")) {
            String t = line.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty() || t.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String[] p = t.split("\t", -1);
            if (p.length < 5) continue;
            Record r = new Record();
            r.id = p[0];
            r.iso1 = p[1];
            try { r.state = State.valueOf(p[2]); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { r.source = Source.valueOf(p[3]); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            r.audioName = p[4];
            if (p.length > 5) {
                try { r.createdMs = Long.parseLong(p[5]); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            out.add(r);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * A complete 16-bit PCM WAV file (RIFF) over the given samples —
     * the sound half of a record. Pure bytes; ListenStore writes
     * them, the harness pins the header.
     */
    public static byte[] toWav(short[] pcm, int sampleRate) {
        if (pcm == null) pcm = new short[0];
        int dataBytes = pcm.length * 2;
        byte[] out = new byte[44 + dataBytes];
        putAscii(out, 0, "RIFF");
        putIntLE(out, 4, 36 + dataBytes);
        putAscii(out, 8, "WAVE");
        putAscii(out, 12, "fmt ");
        putIntLE(out, 16, 16);
        putShortLE(out, 20, (short) 1);          // PCM
        putShortLE(out, 22, (short) 1);          // mono
        putIntLE(out, 24, sampleRate);
        putIntLE(out, 28, sampleRate * 2);       // byte rate
        putShortLE(out, 32, (short) 2);          // block align
        putShortLE(out, 34, (short) 16);         // bits per sample
        putAscii(out, 36, "data");
        putIntLE(out, 40, dataBytes);
        for (int i = 0; i < pcm.length; i++) {
            putShortLE(out, 44 + i * 2, pcm[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static void putAscii(byte[] b, int off, String s) {
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) b[off + i] = (byte) s.charAt(i);
    }

    private static void putIntLE(byte[] b, int off, int v) {
        b[off] = (byte) v;
        b[off + 1] = (byte) (v >> 8);
        b[off + 2] = (byte) (v >> 16);
        b[off + 3] = (byte) (v >> 24);
    }

    private static void putShortLE(byte[] b, int off, short v) {
        b[off] = (byte) v;
        b[off + 1] = (byte) (v >> 8);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ListenStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioRecord;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Listen For Me's shelf work (v0.15.0) — the RECORD road's IO:
 * while the ear listens, the sound is captured alongside it
 * (AudioRecord, 16 kHz mono — whisper's own rate), and a kept
 * utterance lands on the memory hook as a TRIO: the WAV, the
 * transcript file, and one line in listen_index.tsv. Sound and
 * words together, always — ListenRecord builds the bodies, this
 * class writes them.
 *
 * The whisper pass: when the listened language is the source of
 * an installed ONNX engine pair (today Japanese in ja-en), the
 * saved sound is ALSO transcribed by Sandy's own on-device
 * whisper (OnnxCookerEngine — built for cooked files, run here
 * over the short saved WAV through WavPcm), and its words —
 * carried on the cooked lines' orig text — win the transcript,
 * labeled SANDY_WHISPER. Otherwise the transcript is the system
 * ear's final text (SYSTEM_EAR), or the record stands UNSURE
 * with no words. Nothing is ever polished into certainty.
 */
public final class ListenStore {

    public static final String INDEX = "listen_index.tsv";
    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE = 16000;

    private ListenStore() {}

    /** A fresh record id from the clock: 20261019-143022. */
    public static String newId() {
        return new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US)
                .format(new Date());
    }

    /**
     * Keep a record: audio (when pcm != null) + transcript +
     * index line, written together. Returns the record with its
     * file names filled in, or null when the write failed.
     */
    public static ListenRecord.Record save(Context ctx,
                                           ListenRecord.Record r,
                                           short[] pcm) {
        try {
            File root = MemoryHook.root(ctx);
            if (pcm != null && pcm.length > 0) {
                File wav = new File(root, r.audioFileName());
                try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(wav)) {
                    out.write(ListenRecord.toWav(pcm, SAMPLE_RATE));
                }
                r.audioName = r.audioFileName();
            } else {
                r.audioName = "";
            }
            MemoryHook.writeFile(new File(root, r.transcriptName()),
                    ListenRecord.transcriptBody(r));
            File idx = new File(root, INDEX);
            String prev = idx.exists() ? MemoryHook.readFile(idx) : "";
            if (prev == null) prev = "";
            if (prev.isEmpty()) {
                prev = "# Sandy — Listen For Me index"
                        + " (id, language, state, source, audio, when)\n";
            }
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(prev);
            if (!prev.endsWith("\n")) sb.append('\n');
            sb.append(ListenRecord.indexLine(r));
            MemoryHook.writeFile(idx, sb.toString());
            return r;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** The kept records, oldest first (from the index file). */
    public static List<ListenRecord.Record> records(Context ctx) {
        try {
            File idx = MemoryHook.file(ctx, INDEX);
            if (!idx.exists()) return new ArrayList<>();
            String body = MemoryHook.readFile(idx);
            return ListenRecord.parseIndex(body == null ? "" : body);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Run Sandy's whisper over captured samples. pair is the
     * installed engine pair whose source language was heard
     * (e.g. "ja-en"). The samples are fed through a PcmSource, so
     * the whisper hears exactly the sound the record keeps.
     * Returns the heard words (the cooked lines' original text,
     * joined), or "" when the whisper found nothing it trusts,
     * or null when the pass couldn't run at all.
     */
    public static String transcribeWithWhisper(Context ctx, final short[] pcm,
                                               String pair) {
        OnnxCookerEngine engine = null;
        try {
            EnginePackStore.Status st = EnginePackStore.status(ctx, pair);
            if (st == null || !st.onnx() || st.dir == null) return null;
            engine = OnnxCookerEngine.open(st.dir);
            PcmSource src = new PcmSource() {
                @Override public double durationSec() {
                    return pcm == null ? 0 : pcm.length / (double) SAMPLE_RATE;
                }
                @Override public float[] read(double fromSec, double durSec) {
                    if (pcm == null) return new float[0];
                    int from = (int) Math.round(fromSec * SAMPLE_RATE);
                    int count = (int) Math.round(durSec * SAMPLE_RATE);
                    if (from < 0) from = 0;
                    if (from >= pcm.length) return new float[0];
                    int n = Math.min(count, pcm.length - from);
                    float[] out = new float[n];
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = pcm[from + i] / 32768f;
                    return out;
                }
            };
            List<CookedSubs.Line> lines = engine.cook(src, null);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            if (lines != null) {
                for (CookedSubs.Line ln : lines) {
                    String t = ln.orig == null ? "" : ln.orig.trim();
                    if (!t.isEmpty()) {
                        if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(' ');
                        sb.append(t);
                    }
                }
            }
            return sb.toString().trim();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return null;
        } finally {
            if (engine != null) {
                try { engine.close(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ mic capture

    /**
     * The parallel sound capture for the RECORD road: records
     * 16 kHz mono PCM while the recognizer listens, so the kept
     * record holds the actual sound of the utterance. Bounded at
     * 5 minutes — an utterance, not a wiretap.
     */
    public static final class WavRecorder {
        private static final int MAX_SAMPLES = SAMPLE_RATE * 60 * 5;
        private AudioRecord rec;
        private Thread thread;
        private volatile boolean running = false;
        private final List<short[]> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
        private int total = 0;

        public boolean start() {
            try {
                int min = AudioRecord.getMinBufferSize(SAMPLE_RATE,
                        AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO,
                        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT);
                if (min <= 0) return false;
                rec = new AudioRecord(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC,
                        SAMPLE_RATE, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO,
                        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT,
                        Math.max(min, SAMPLE_RATE));
                if (rec.getState() != AudioRecord.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                    rec.release();
                    rec = null;
                    return false;
                }
                chunks.clear();
                total = 0;
                running = true;
                rec.startRecording();
                thread = new Thread(() -> {
                    short[] buf = new short[4096];
