        double[] padded = reflectPad(x, N_FFT / 2);
        double[] win = hann();
        int numFrames = 1 + (padded.length - N_FFT) / HOP;   // 3001
        double[][] power = new double[numFrames][N_BINS];
        double[] frame = new double[N_FFT];
        double[] re = new double[N_FFT];
        double[] im = new double[N_FFT];
        for (int f = 0; f < numFrames; f++) {
            int off = f * HOP;
            for (int n = 0; n < N_FFT; n++) {
                frame[n] = padded[off + n] * win[n];
            }
            dft400(frame, re, im);
            for (int b = 0; b < N_BINS; b++) {
                power[f][b] = re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b];
            }
        }
        // mel + log10, frames 0..2999 (the last of 3001 is dropped,
        // exactly like the extractor's [:, :-1])
        float[][] out = new float[N_MELS][FRAMES];
        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        double[][] log = new double[N_MELS][FRAMES];
        for (int f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) {
            for (int m = 0; m < N_MELS; m++) {
                double s = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < N_BINS; b++) s += filters[b][m] * power[f][b];
                if (s < 1e-10) s = 1e-10;
                double v = Math.log10(s);
                log[m][f] = v;
                if (v > max) max = v;
            }
        }
        double floor = max - 8.0;
        for (int m = 0; m < N_MELS; m++) {
            for (int f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) {
                out[m][f] = (float) ((Math.max(log[m][f], floor) + 4.0) / 4.0);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- DFT of size 400

    /**
     * Real-input DFT of length 400 via Bluestein's chirp-z reduction
     * to a 1024-point radix-2 FFT. Exact (not an approximation of the
     * 400-point transform — a zero-padded 512 FFT would compute the
     * WRONG bins). Double precision throughout, like numpy.
     */
    private static void dft400(double[] in, double[] outRe, double[] outIm) {
        final int n = N_FFT;
        final int m = 1024; // next pow2 >= 2n-1
        double[] aRe = new double[m], aIm = new double[m];
        double[] bRe = new double[m], bIm = new double[m];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            double ang = -Math.PI * i * i / n;
            double c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
            aRe[i] = in[i] * c;
            aIm[i] = in[i] * s;
            double angB = Math.PI * i * i / n;
            bRe[i] = Math.cos(angB);
            bIm[i] = Math.sin(angB);
            if (i > 0) {
                bRe[m - i] = bRe[i];
                bIm[m - i] = bIm[i];
            }
        }
        fft(aRe, aIm, false);
        fft(bRe, bIm, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            double r = aRe[i] * bRe[i] - aIm[i] * bIm[i];
            double j = aRe[i] * bIm[i] + aIm[i] * bRe[i];
            aRe[i] = r;
            aIm[i] = j;
        }
        fft(aRe, aIm, true);
        for (int k = 0; k < N_BINS; k++) {
            double ang = -Math.PI * k * k / n;
            double c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
            outRe[k] = aRe[k] * c - aIm[k] * s;
            outIm[k] = aRe[k] * s + aIm[k] * c;
        }
    }

    /** Iterative radix-2 FFT; inverse scales by 1/n. Length must be 2^k. */
    private static void fft(double[] re, double[] im, boolean inverse) {
        int n = re.length;
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                double t = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = t;
                t = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = t;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            double ang = 2.0 * Math.PI / len * (inverse ? 1 : -1);
            double wr = Math.cos(ang), wi = Math.sin(ang);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double cwr = 1, cwi = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < len / 2; k++) {
                    int u = i + k, v = i + k + len / 2;
                    double vr = re[v] * cwr - im[v] * cwi;
                    double vi = re[v] * cwi + im[v] * cwr;
                    re[v] = re[u] - vr;
                    im[v] = im[u] - vi;
                    re[u] += vr;
                    im[u] += vi;
                    double nwr = cwr * wr - cwi * wi;
                    cwi = cwr * wi + cwi * wr;
                    cwr = nwr;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { re[i] /= n; im[i] /= n; }
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/MemoryFiles.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The memory hook's file formats (v0.11.0) — pure text shapes for
 * the files behind the ONE hook (MemoryHook). James's rule: file in,
 * file out. Everything Sandy keeps that a person might want to see,
 * move, or back up is a file in one place, in formats readable with
 * no tool but eyes:
 *
 *   kept_places.tsv — where she left off, everywhere:
 *     kind TAB key TAB position TAB updated-ms TAB extra
 *     kind "pos"  : on-demand/local resume points (key = content key,
 *                   position = ms)
 *     kind "live" : the kept live place (key = "live", position = ms,
 *                   extra = the kept-place JSON, carried opaquely)
 *     kind "book" : a book's place (key = book id, position = chunk,
 *                   extra = the bookmark JSON, carried opaquely)
 *     kind "#seeded" : migration markers (key = the seeded kind)
 *   recordings.tsv — recordings metadata:
 *     id TAB title TAB channel TAB aired-start TAB aired-stop
 *        TAB origin TAB state
 *     (the bytes and the download bookkeeping stay machinery —
 *     media3's own stores; this file is the shelf's memory of what
 *     a recording IS)
 *   timers.tsv — see TimerModel.
 *   guide/*.tsv — see GuideStore.
 *
 * Free-text fields are URL-encoded (TimerModel.enc/dec), so a title
 * with a tab or a newline in it can never break a row.
 */
public final class MemoryFiles {

    private MemoryFiles() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------- kept places

    public static final class KeptPlace {
        public String kind = "";
        public String key = "";
        public long position = 0;
        public long updatedMs = 0;
        public String extra = "";

        public KeptPlace() {}
        public KeptPlace(String kind, String key, long position,
                         long updatedMs, String extra) {
            this.kind = kind; this.key = key; this.position = position;
            this.updatedMs = updatedMs; this.extra = extra == null ? "" : extra;
        }
    }

    public static String keptPlacesToText(List<KeptPlace> rows) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy kept places - kind, key, position, updated, extra.\n");
        sb.append("# Behind the memory hook (files/memory/kept_places.tsv).\n");
        for (KeptPlace r : rows) {
            sb.append(TimerModel.enc(r.kind)).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(r.key)).append('\t')
              .append(r.position).append('\t')
              .append(r.updatedMs).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(r.extra)).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static List<KeptPlace> keptPlacesFromText(String content) {
        List<KeptPlace> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (content == null) return out;
        for (String line : content.split("\n")) {
            // No trim before the split: the last field may be an
            // empty encoded value whose separator must survive.
            String probe = line.trim();
            if (probe.isEmpty() || probe.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String s = line.endsWith("\r")
                    ? line.substring(0, line.length() - 1) : line;
            String[] c = s.split("\t", -1);
            if (c.length < 5) continue;
            try {
                KeptPlace r = new KeptPlace();
                r.kind = TimerModel.dec(c[0]);
                r.key = TimerModel.dec(c[1]);
                r.position = Long.parseLong(c[2]);
                r.updatedMs = Long.parseLong(c[3]);
                r.extra = TimerModel.dec(c[4]);
                if (!r.kind.isEmpty()) out.add(r);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The row for (kind,key), or null. */
    public static KeptPlace findKept(List<KeptPlace> rows, String kind, String key) {
        for (KeptPlace r : rows) {
            if (r.kind.equals(kind) && r.key.equals(key)) return r;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Insert or replace the (kind,key) row; position<=0 removes a "pos" row. */
    public static List<KeptPlace> upsertKept(List<KeptPlace> rows, KeptPlace row) {
        List<KeptPlace> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (KeptPlace r : rows) {
            if (!(r.kind.equals(row.kind) && r.key.equals(row.key))) out.add(r);
        }
        if (!("pos".equals(row.kind) && row.position <= 0)) out.add(row);
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- recordings

    public static final class RecordingMeta {
        public String id = "";        // the download's request-data id (url)
        public String title = "";
        public String channel = "";
        public long airedStartMs = 0;
        public long airedStopMs = 0;
        public String origin = "";    // "now" or "timer"
        public String state = "";     // RECORDED / PARTIAL_LATE / ... or ""
    }

    public static String recordingsToText(List<RecordingMeta> rows) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy recordings metadata - id, title, channel,\n");
        sb.append("# aired start/stop, origin, state. Behind the memory hook.\n");
        for (RecordingMeta r : rows) {
            sb.append(TimerModel.enc(r.id)).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(r.title)).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(r.channel)).append('\t')
              .append(r.airedStartMs).append('\t')
              .append(r.airedStopMs).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(r.origin)).append('\t')
              .append(TimerModel.enc(r.state)).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static List<RecordingMeta> recordingsFromText(String content) {
        List<RecordingMeta> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (content == null) return out;
        for (String line : content.split("\n")) {
            String probe = line.trim();
            if (probe.isEmpty() || probe.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String s = line.endsWith("\r")
                    ? line.substring(0, line.length() - 1) : line;
            String[] c = s.split("\t", -1);
            if (c.length < 7) continue;
            try {
                RecordingMeta r = new RecordingMeta();
                r.id = TimerModel.dec(c[0]);
                r.title = TimerModel.dec(c[1]);
                r.channel = TimerModel.dec(c[2]);
                r.airedStartMs = Long.parseLong(c[3]);
                r.airedStopMs = Long.parseLong(c[4]);
                r.origin = TimerModel.dec(c[5]);
                r.state = TimerModel.dec(c[6]);
                if (!r.id.isEmpty()) out.add(r);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static RecordingMeta findRecording(List<RecordingMeta> rows, String id) {
        for (RecordingMeta r : rows) if (r.id.equals(id)) return r;
        return null;
    }

    public static List<RecordingMeta> upsertRecording(List<RecordingMeta> rows,
                                                      RecordingMeta row) {
        List<RecordingMeta> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (RecordingMeta r : rows) if (!r.id.equals(row.id)) out.add(r);
        out.add(row);
        return out;
    }

    public static List<RecordingMeta> removeRecording(List<RecordingMeta> rows,
                                                      String id) {
        List<RecordingMeta> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (RecordingMeta r : rows) if (!r.id.equals(id)) out.add(r);
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/MemoryHook.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;

/**
 * THE MEMORY HOOK (v0.11.0) — the one section of hook that goes to
 * memory, per James's architecture rule: file in, file out.
 *
 * Every file Sandy keeps for a person lives under ONE root —
 * filesDir/memory/ — and every feature reaches its files through
 * this class and no other door:
 *
 *   memory/guide_map.tsv     tvg-id → hosted guide file bridge
 *   memory/guide/<src>.tsv   parsed programme cache, per source
 *   memory/guide_state.tsv   per-source freshness (fetched-at, etag)
 *   memory/timers.tsv        the VCR timer queue (TimerModel)
 *   memory/recordings.tsv    recordings metadata (MemoryFiles)
 *   memory/kept_places.tsv   every kept place (MemoryFiles)
 *
 * Writes are atomic (temp file + rename) so a dead battery mid-save
 * never halves a file. Reads of a missing file return "" — a fresh
 * install is an empty memory, not an error.
 *
 * What is NOT here, deliberately: media3's download index and
 * simple cache (machinery — the machine's own bookkeeping, not the
 * family's records), the catalogue buckets (CatalogStore — files
 * already, under files/catalog/, one store with one job), and the
 * SharedPreferences settings cluster (kept settings like playlists,
 * favorites, the UI language — convergence of those is recorded as
 * a known deviation in the 0.11.0 NOTES, not sprawled silently).
 */
public final class MemoryHook {

    private MemoryHook() {}

    public static final String TIMERS = "timers.tsv";
    public static final String RECORDINGS = "recordings.tsv";
    public static final String KEPT_PLACES = "kept_places.tsv";
    public static final String GUIDE_MAP = "guide_map.tsv";
    public static final String GUIDE_STATE = "guide_state.tsv";

    public static File root(Context ctx) {
        File d = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "memory");
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    public static File file(Context ctx, String name) {
        return new File(root(ctx), name);
    }

    public static File guideDir(Context ctx) {
        File d = new File(root(ctx), "guide");
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    public static File guideFile(Context ctx, String sourceKey) {
        // sourceKey is ours (mjh/iptvx + scope), never raw input.
        String safe = sourceKey.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_");
        return new File(guideDir(ctx), safe + ".tsv");
    }

    public static boolean exists(Context ctx, String name) {
        return file(ctx, name).isFile();
    }

    public static String read(Context ctx, String name) {
        return readFile(file(ctx, name));
    }

    public static String readFile(File f) {
        try {
            if (!f.isFile()) return "";
            return new String(Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath()), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    public static void write(Context ctx, String name, String content) {
        writeFile(file(ctx, name), content);
    }

    /** Atomic write: temp beside the target, then rename over it. */
    public static void writeFile(File target, String content) {
        try {
            File tmp = new File(target.getParentFile(),
                    target.getName() + ".tmp");
            try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(tmp)) {
                out.write(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                out.getFD().sync();
            }
            if (!tmp.renameTo(target)) {
                // rename can fail across states on some filesystems;
                // fall back to a plain copy over the target.
                Files.copy(tmp.toPath(), target.toPath(),
                        java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                tmp.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/MtLoopGuard.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The loop guard for machine-translated reading (v0.8.0) — the
 * repetition principle of the cooker's hallucination guard,
 * adapted honestly to MT output.
 *
 * The cooker's guard leans on ASR scores (logprob / no-speech)
 * that a text->text engine never produces, so running it verbatim
 * over translations would be theater. What survives translation
 * is the repetition principle: a healthy translator given
 * DIFFERENT source sentences does not return the SAME sentence
 * again and again. When >= 3 distinct source chunks normalize to
 * one identical target, the target is looping; the first rendering
 * is kept (it may be right), the repeats are dropped, and the
 * drops are COUNTED — the reader hears the count, never a silent
 * skip. Same judgment as the cookbook: repetition is the smoke,
 * whatever the fire.
 */
public final class MtLoopGuard {

    /** Distinct sources mapping to one normalized target before it loops. */
    public static final int LOOP_AT = 3;

    private final Map<String, Set<String>> sourcesByTarget = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, String> keptForTarget = new HashMap<>();
    private int dropped = 0;

    /** Verdict for one translated chunk. */
    public enum Verdict { KEEP, DROP_LOOP }

    /**
     * Feed one (source, translation) pair. KEEP the first rendering
     * of a target and any target with < LOOP_AT distinct sources;
     * DROP_LOOP once LOOP_AT distinct sources have produced it.
     */
    public Verdict feed(String source, String translated) {
        String t = normalize(translated);
        String s = normalize(source);
        if (t.isEmpty()) return Verdict.KEEP; // empties are the caller's state
        Set<String> sources = sourcesByTarget.computeIfAbsent(t, k -> new HashSet<>());
        boolean newSource = sources.add(s);
        if (sources.size() >= LOOP_AT && keptForTarget.containsKey(t)
                && !keptForTarget.get(t).equals(s) && newSource) {
            dropped++;
            return Verdict.DROP_LOOP;
        }
        if (!keptForTarget.containsKey(t)) keptForTarget.put(t, s);
        return Verdict.KEEP;
    }

    /** How many chunks this book's reading has dropped as loops. */
    public int dropped() { return dropped; }

    /** A new book (or a new sitting from the top) resets the guard. */
    public void reset() {
        sourcesByTarget.clear();
        keptForTarget.clear();
        dropped = 0;
    }

    /** Lowercase, letters/digits only, single-spaced — the compare shape. */
    public static String normalize(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        boolean lastSpace = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) {
                sb.append(Character.toLowerCase(c));
                lastSpace = false;
            } else if (!lastSpace) {
                sb.append(' ');
                lastSpace = true;
            }
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/NameStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Where the channel-name map lives on the phone (v0.5.0): a refreshed
 * copy in filesDir wins; otherwise the bundled snapshot asset seeds
 * it. Refresh pulls iptv-org's two API files and rebuilds the map
 * with the same rule the asset was built with (ChannelNames.buildMap)
 * — best-effort: a failed refresh keeps whatever map is already here.
 */
public final class NameStore {

    private static final String MAP_FILE = "channels_map.tsv";
    private static final String API_CHANNELS = "https://iptv-org.github.io/api/channels.json";
    private static final String API_LOGOS = "https://iptv-org.github.io/api/logos.json";

    private static volatile boolean loaded = false;

    private NameStore() {}

    public static synchronized void ensureLoaded(Context ctx) {
        if (loaded) return;
        loaded = true;
        Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            File f = new File(app.getFilesDir(), MAP_FILE);
            String text = null;
            if (f.exists()) {
                text = readAll(new FileInputStream(f));
            } else {
                try (InputStream in = app.getAssets().open(MAP_FILE)) {
                    text = readAll(in);
                }
            }
            if (text != null) ChannelNames.setMap(ChannelNames.parseMapTsv(text));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // no map: display names fall back to cleaned playlist names
        }
    }

    /** Best-effort refresh from the live database; true when it landed. */
    public static synchronized boolean refresh(Context ctx) {
        try {
            String channels = Net.getString(API_CHANNELS);
            String logos = Net.getString(API_LOGOS);
            Map<String, String[]> fresh = ChannelNames.buildMap(channels, logos);
            if (fresh.isEmpty()) return false;
            ChannelNames.setMap(fresh);
            loaded = true;
            File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), MAP_FILE);
            try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(f)) {
                out.write(ChannelNames.toMapTsv(fresh).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static String readAll(InputStream in) throws Exception {
        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int n;
        while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
        return new String(bos.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Net.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The house's fetch hand — and since v0.14.0 it walks HYDRA's
 * ladder (see Hydra): every catalogue fetch, Archive resolve,
 * guide fetch, and story-book pull in the app comes through
 * here, so every one of them inherits the Connection Law.
 * Before Hydra this was a single attempt that threw a bare
 * "HTTP 404" — one manner, one try, no words. Now: the ladder
 * for the address (direct → Archive canonical door → the other
 * scheme), SG-1 semantics per head (terminal fails the HEAD
 * fast; slow retries in place inside the shared ~30 s budget),
 * redirects followed BY HAND so an http→https hop — which
 * HttpURLConnection's auto-follow refuses — is just another
 * step on the chain, and exhaustion throws a HydraException
 * carrying the failure in plain words (FailureWords).
 *
 * Learned doors: the head that answered for a host is
 * remembered (in memory here; persisted to the memory hook by
 * HydraStore, primed at boot from SplashActivity).
 */
public final class Net {

    public static final String UA = "Sandy/0.16.1";

    private Net() {}

    /** A resolution that exhausted its ladder, in plain words. */
    public static class HydraException extends Exception {
        public final String kind;     // FailureWords kind
        public final int httpCode;    // the most informative status, 0 = none
        public HydraException(String kind, int httpCode) {
            super(FailureWords.englishFor(kind, httpCode));
            this.kind = kind;
            this.httpCode = httpCode;
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------- learned doors

    public interface DoorSink {
        void learned(String host, int manner);
    }

    private static volatile Map<String, Integer> doors = new HashMap<>();
    private static volatile DoorSink doorSink;

    /** Primed at boot (SplashActivity) from the memory hook. */
    public static void primeDoors(Map<String, Integer> learned, DoorSink sink) {
        if (learned != null) doors = new HashMap<>(learned);
        doorSink = sink;
    }

    public static void noteLearned(String host, int manner) {
        if (host == null) return;
        Integer cur = doors.get(host);
        if (cur != null && cur == manner) return;
        doors.put(host, manner);
        DoorSink s = doorSink;
        if (s != null) s.learned(host, manner);
    }

    /**
     * Un-learn a door (v0.14.1): the Active Pinger found this
     * host's learned door terminally dead, so the preference is
     * dropped and the next visit walks the ladder from the top.
     * The persisted file is HydraStore.forget's job; callers in
     * the app use both.
     */
    public static void forgetLearned(String host) {
        if (host == null) return;
        doors.remove(host);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- fetching

    private static final int CONNECT_MS = 6000;
    private static final int READ_MS = 10000;
    private static final int MAX_REDIRECTS = 5;

    private static final class Hop {
        int code = 0;
        byte[] body;
        IOException error;
        String finalUrl = "";
    }

    /** One head's chain: a GET, redirects followed by hand —
     *  including across protocols, which the auto-follower
     *  will not do. */
    private static Hop hop(String urlStr) {
        Hop h = new Hop();
        String current = urlStr;
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_REDIRECTS; i++) {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(current).openConnection();
                conn.setConnectTimeout(CONNECT_MS);
                conn.setReadTimeout(READ_MS);
                conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", UA);
                conn.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                h.code = code;
                if (code >= 300 && code < 400) {
                    String loc = conn.getHeaderField("Location");
                    if (loc != null && !loc.isEmpty() && i < MAX_REDIRECTS) {
                        current = new URL(new URL(current), loc).toString();
                        continue;
                    }
                    h.finalUrl = current;
                    return h;
                }
                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    try (InputStream in = conn.getInputStream();
                         ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
                        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                        int n;
                        while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
                        h.body = bos.toByteArray();
                    }
                }
                h.finalUrl = current;
                return h;
            } catch (IOException e) {
                h.error = e;
                return h;
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        }
        h.finalUrl = current;
        return h;
    }

    public static byte[] getBytes(String urlStr) throws Exception {
        long started = System.currentTimeMillis();
        List<Hydra.Head> ladder = Hydra.orderFor(urlStr, doors);
        List<Hydra.Tried> tried = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Hydra.Head head : ladder) {
            int attempt = 0;
            while (true) {
                attempt++;
                Hop h = hop(head.url);
                if (h.error == null && h.code >= 200 && h.code < 300
                        && h.body != null) {
                    noteLearned(Hydra.hostOf(urlStr), head.manner);
                    return h.body;
                }
                int cls;
                String kind;
                int code = h.error == null ? h.code : 0;
                if (h.error != null) {
                    kind = FailureWords.kindForDetail(
                            String.valueOf(h.error));
                    // the OS barring cleartext kills THIS head,
                    // not the attempt — the https head may live
                    cls = FailureWords.CLEARTEXT.equals(kind)
                            ? LinkHealth.CLS_TERMINAL
                            : LinkHealth.classifyIo(h.error);
                } else {
                    kind = FailureWords.kindForHttp(h.code);
                    cls = LinkHealth.classifyHttp(h.code);
                }
                if (cls == LinkHealth.CLS_TERMINAL) {
                    tried.add(new Hydra.Tried(head.manner, code, kind));
                    break;   // this door is dead; another head tries
                }
                long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - started;
                if (!LinkHealth.mayRetry(attempt, elapsed, READ_MS)
                        || !Hydra.mayAdvance(started,
                                System.currentTimeMillis(), READ_MS)) {
                    tried.add(new Hydra.Tried(head.manner, code, kind));
                    break;   // patience spent on this head; advance
                }
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(LinkHealth.BACKOFF_MS[
                            Math.min(attempt - 1,
                                    LinkHealth.BACKOFF_MS.length - 1)]);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw e;
                }
            }
        }
        Hydra.Tried worst = Hydra.mostInformative(tried);
        if (worst != null) {
            throw new HydraException(
                    worst.kind.isEmpty()
                            ? FailureWords.kindForHttp(worst.httpCode)
                            : worst.kind,
                    worst.httpCode);
        }
        throw new HydraException(FailureWords.NO_ANSWER, 0);
    }

    public static String getString(String urlStr) throws Exception {
        return new String(getBytes(urlStr), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/NextEpisode.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * One tap to the next episode (v0.14.0, James: "if we are one
 * click, do you click into the next episode?") — the pure half:
 * given a show's episode list in TVmaze's shape, which episode
 * follows this one? Air order is (season, number); specials
 * (season 0) are a side shelf — the next episode after a regular
 * episode is the next REGULAR episode, and a special's next is
 * the next special. When the current episode isn't in the list
 * (a stale page), the next is the first episode that sorts
 * after it. The last episode has no next: null, said plainly.
 */
public final class NextEpisode {

    private NextEpisode() {}

    public static final Comparator<TvMaze.Episode> AIR_ORDER =
            Comparator.comparingInt((TvMaze.Episode e) -> e.season)
                    .thenComparingInt(e -> e.number);

    public static TvMaze.Episode next(List<TvMaze.Episode> episodes,
                                      int season, int number) {
        if (episodes == null || episodes.isEmpty()) return null;
        List<TvMaze.Episode> sorted = new ArrayList<>(episodes);
        sorted.sort(AIR_ORDER);
        // exact position: the entry right after, in the same shelf
        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.size(); i++) {
            TvMaze.Episode e = sorted.get(i);
            if (e.season == season && e.number == number) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < sorted.size(); j++) {
                    TvMaze.Episode c = sorted.get(j);
                    if ((c.season == 0) == (season == 0)) return c;
                }
                return null;
            }
        }
        // not listed: the first entry that sorts after, same shelf
        for (TvMaze.Episode c : sorted) {
            if ((c.season == 0) != (season == 0)) continue;
            if (c.season > season || (c.season == season && c.number > number)) {
                return c;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** "S02E03 · The One With the List" — how a next tile names it. */
    public static String label(TvMaze.Episode e) {
        if (e == null) return "";
        String base = String.format(Locale.US, "S%02dE%02d", e.season, e.number);
        return e.name == null || e.name.isEmpty() ? base : base + " · " + e.name;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/NextEpisodeResolver.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Pre-resolving the next episode (v0.14.0) — while the current
 * episode plays, quietly find the NEXT one and get its best
 * working source ready, so one tap on "Next episode" PLAYS
 * instead of starting a hunt. The machinery is the source
 * picker's own: the show's names (its own name first, then the
 * alternates TVmaze lists), the loaded playlists, the phone's
 * own library, the Internet Archive's episode shelves; the pick
 * is AutoPlay's under the viewer's quality posture; the proof
 * is LinkHealth's patient probe — terminal answers are dead on
 * the spot, slow answers are retried (3 attempts, ~30 s cap)
 * and a source that merely didn't answer in time is NOT marked
 * dead and still counts as resolved (the player is the ground
 * truth, as on the source picker's own road).
 *
 * Blocking network work: call resolve() from a worker thread.
 * Callbacks arrive on that same thread.
 */
public final class NextEpisodeResolver {

    public interface Callback {
        /** The next episode exists (source may still be looking). */
        void onNextFound(TvMaze.Episode next);
        /** A working source for it stands ready. */
        void onResolved(TvMaze.Episode next, SourceFinder.Source source);
        /** No next episode, or none could be sourced. */
        void onNoNext(TvMaze.Episode next);
    }

    private NextEpisodeResolver() {}

    public static void resolve(Context ctx, int showId, String showName,
                               String showLanguage, int season, int number,
                               Callback cb) {
        TvMaze.Episode next = null;
        try {
            List<TvMaze.Episode> episodes = TvMaze.parseEpisodes(
                    Net.getString(TvMaze.episodesUrl(showId)));
            next = NextEpisode.next(episodes, season, number);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (next == null) {
            cb.onNoNext(null);
            return;
        }
        cb.onNextFound(next);

        // gather candidates for the next episode
        List<SourceFinder.Source> found = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        names.add(showName == null ? "" : showName);
        try {
            List<TvMaze.Aka> akas = TvMaze.parseAkas(
                    Net.getString(TvMaze.akasUrl(showId)));
            names = TitleNames.namesOf(TitleNames.buildSet(showName, akas));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            List<M3uParser.Channel> channels = ChannelStore.loadCache(ctx);
            if (channels != null) {
                for (String nm : names) {
                    for (SourceFinder.Source s : SourceFinder.findEpisode(
                            channels, nm, next.season, next.number, next.name)) {
                        if (seen.add(s.url)) found.add(s);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            List<M3uParser.Channel> lib = LibraryStore.loadChannels(ctx);
            for (String nm : names) {
                for (SourceFinder.Source s : SourceFinder.findEpisode(
                        lib, nm, next.season, next.number, next.name)) {
                    if (seen.add(s.url)) found.add(s);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            List<IaClient.Item> pool = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<String> seenIds = new HashSet<>();
            if (next.name != null && !next.name.trim().isEmpty()) {
                for (IaClient.Item it : IaClient.parseSearch(Net.getString(
                        IaClient.episodeSearchUrl(showName, next.name)))) {
                    if (seenIds.add(it.identifier)) pool.add(it);
                }
            }
            List<IaClient.Item> ranked = IaClient.rankItems(
                    pool, showName, next.name, next.season, next.number, 0);
            if (ranked.isEmpty() || ranked.get(0).score < 50) {
                for (IaClient.Item it : IaClient.parseSearch(Net.getString(
                        IaClient.showScopedSearchUrl(showName)))) {
                    if (seenIds.add(it.identifier)) pool.add(it);
                }
                ranked = IaClient.rankItems(
                        pool, showName, next.name, next.season, next.number, 0);
            }
            int opened = 0;
            for (IaClient.Item item : ranked) {
                if (opened >= 3 || found.size() >= 25) break;
                opened++;
                try {
                    List<IaClient.FileEntry> files = IaClient.parseMetadata(
                            Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(item.identifier)),
                            item.identifier);
                    boolean matched = IaClient.itemMatchesEpisode(
                            item, next.name, next.season, next.number);
                    IaClient.FileEntry firstSub = null;
                    for (IaClient.FileEntry f : files) {
                        if (f.subtitle && firstSub == null) firstSub = f;
                    }
                    for (IaClient.FileEntry v : IaClient.filterEpisodeFiles(
                            files, next.season, next.number, next.name, matched)) {
                        SourceFinder.Source s = SourceFinder.fromArchiveFile(
                                item, v, firstSub);
                        if (seen.add(s.url)) found.add(s);
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            cb.onNoNext(next);
            return;
        }

        // posture pick, then prove it with the patient probe;
        // a proven-dead pick falls to the next candidate.
        AutoPlay.Posture posture =
                AutoPlay.parsePosture(ChannelStore.getQualityPosture(ctx));
        String facet = UiStrings.facetFor(ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(ctx));
        String marc = IaClient.iaLanguageCode(facet);
        int cap = PipeMeter.capTierFor(PipeMeter.measuredBps(ctx));
        List<SourceFinder.Source> pool = new ArrayList<>(found);
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && !pool.isEmpty(); attempt++) {
            List<AutoPlay.Cand> cands = new ArrayList<>();
            for (SourceFinder.Source s : pool) {
                HealthStore.Health h = HealthStore.get(ctx, s.url);
                java.util.Map<String, Integer> health = new java.util.HashMap<>();
                health.put(s.url, h == null ? AutoPlay.HEALTH_UNKNOWN : h.tier);
                cands.add(AutoPlay.candidates(
                        java.util.Collections.singletonList(s), health,
                        facet, marc).get(0));
            }
            AutoPlay.Pick pick = AutoPlay.pick(cands, posture, cap);
            if (pick == null || pick.source == null) break;
            SourceFinder.Source chosen = null;
            for (SourceFinder.Source s : pool) {
                if (s.url.equals(pick.source.url)) { chosen = s; break; }
            }
            if (chosen == null) break;
            if (!LinkHealth.isRemote(chosen.url)) {
                cb.onResolved(next, chosen);
                return;
            }
            // Hydra proves the source (v0.14.0): the published
            // manner failing advances the ladder to another door
            // instead of ending the resolution — and when a
            // different door answers, THAT door is what plays.
            HydraResolver.Outcome o = HydraResolver.prove(
                    ctx, chosen.url, chosen.userAgent, null);
            if (o.ok()) {
                if (!o.url.equals(chosen.url)) {
                    SourceFinder.Source via = new SourceFinder.Source();
                    via.kind = chosen.kind;
                    via.label = chosen.label;
                    via.detail = chosen.detail;
                    via.langFacet = chosen.langFacet;
                    via.langMarc = chosen.langMarc;
                    via.url = o.url;
                    via.userAgent = chosen.userAgent;
                    via.qualityTier = chosen.qualityTier;
                    via.subUrl = chosen.subUrl;
                    via.subMime = chosen.subMime;
                    via.subLang = chosen.subLang;
                    chosen = via;
                }
                cb.onResolved(next, chosen);
                return;
            }
            // proven dead: mark it (HealthStore.record did) and
            // take it out of the pool — the next candidate's turn.
            pool.remove(chosen);
        }
        cb.onNoNext(next);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/OnnxCookerEngine.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment;

/**
 * The bound cooker engine (v0.6.1): whisper-base ASR + opus-mt MT on
 * ONNX Runtime, behind the Cooker.Engine seam. Construction IS the
 * binding — if the sessions open, isBound() is true; the Translate
 * gate constructs it lazily and a construction failure becomes the
 * spoken ENGINE_FAILED state with the reason, never a silent row.
 *
 * The cook loop is the bench recipe end to end:
 *   240 s chunks (load-bearing: whole-file transcription
 *   degenerates); inside a chunk, fixed 30 s windows; VAD OFF (the
 *   bench's VAD finding: the filter ate real speech in 9 of 19
 *   chunks); hallucination guard over every chunk's segments;
 *   unit merge; opus-mt per unit; CookedSubs lines carrying BOTH
 *   the translation and the original (UTX Law 1 — the source is
 *   never silently replaced).
 *
 * Runs synchronously on the caller's thread (the player drives it
 * from a worker); per chunk it reports (chunkSeconds, wallSeconds,
 * lines so far) so the Cooker FSM's lead math gets real events.
 * Proven end-to-end on the desktop JVM against the bench references
 * (work/v061/BINDING-VERDICT.md); on-device execution is NOT
 * run-tested — no device exists in the build environment.
 */
public final class OnnxCookerEngine implements Cooker.Engine, AutoCloseable {

    public static final double CHUNK_SEC = 240.0;
    public static final double WINDOW_SEC = 30.0;
    /** whisper language token for this pack's pair (ja-en): <|ja|>. */
    public static final int LANG_TOKEN_JA = 50266;

    public interface Listener {
        /** A chunk landed: cooked seconds in it, wall seconds it
         *  took, and the subtitle lines produced so far. */
        void onChunk(int chunkIndex, double chunkSec, double wallSec,
                     List<CookedSubs.Line> linesSoFar);
    }

    private final WhisperOnnx asr;
    private final OpusMtOnnx mt;
    private final MelSpectrogram mel;
    private volatile boolean cancelled = false;

    private OnnxCookerEngine(WhisperOnnx asr, OpusMtOnnx mt, MelSpectrogram mel) {
        this.asr = asr;
        this.mt = mt;
        this.mel = mel;
    }

    /**
     * Open the engine from an installed pack directory (the layout
     * EnginePackStore reports): asr/ and mt/ subdirectories holding
     * the ONNX graphs and the token tables. Throws on any missing or
     * unusable piece — fail-closed, like the pack validator.
     */
    public static OnnxCookerEngine open(File packDir) throws Exception {
        File asrDir = new File(packDir, "asr");
        File mtDir = new File(packDir, "mt");
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        WhisperVocab vocab = new WhisperVocab(new File(asrDir, "vocab.tsv"));
        MelSpectrogram mel = new MelSpectrogram(new File(asrDir, "mel_filters.bin"));
        WhisperOnnx asr = new WhisperOnnx(env, asrDir, LANG_TOKEN_JA, vocab);
        SentencePiece sp = new SentencePiece(
                new File(mtDir, "sp_pieces.tsv"), new File(mtDir, "vocab.tsv"));
        OpusMtOnnx mt = new OpusMtOnnx(env, mtDir, sp);
        return new OnnxCookerEngine(asr, mt, mel);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isBound() {
        return asr != null && mt != null;
    }

    public void cancel() { cancelled = true; }

    /**
     * Cook a whole title from a PCM source. Returns the subtitle
     * lines (translation + original on every line). Listener events
     * fire per chunk; wall time is measured around each chunk.
     */
    public List<CookedSubs.Line> cook(PcmSource src, Listener listener)
            throws Exception {
        List<CookedSubs.Line> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        double total = src.durationSec();
        int nChunks = (int) Math.ceil(total / CHUNK_SEC);
        for (int ci = 0; ci < nChunks; ci++) {
            if (cancelled) break;
            long w0 = System.nanoTime();
            double chunkStart = ci * CHUNK_SEC;
            double chunkLen = Math.min(CHUNK_SEC, total - chunkStart);
            double chunkEnd = chunkStart + chunkLen;
            List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> segs = new ArrayList<>();
            // Whisper's seek: each 30 s window starts at the end of
            // the last decoded segment, not on a fixed grid, so
            // window edges land on content boundaries; a window
            // that yields nothing advances the full 30 s.
            double seek = chunkStart;
            while (seek < chunkEnd - 0.05) {
                if (cancelled) break;
                float[] pcm = src.read(seek, WINDOW_SEC);
                float[][] feats = mel.features(pcm);
                List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> ws =
                        asr.transcribeWindow(feats, seek);
                double lastEnd = -1;
                for (HallucinationGuard.Segment s : ws) {
                    if (s.start < chunkEnd) {
                        segs.add(s);
                        if (s.end > lastEnd) lastEnd = s.end;
                    }
                }
                if (lastEnd > seek + 0.5) seek = lastEnd;
                else seek += WINDOW_SEC;
            }
            // guard, then merge the survivors with an index-aligned
            // guard view (the v0.6.0 harness's own pattern)
            HallucinationGuard.Result g = HallucinationGuard.apply(segs);
            List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> surv = g.surviving(segs);
            HallucinationGuard.Result aligned = new HallucinationGuard.Result();
            for (int i = 0; i < segs.size(); i++) {
                HallucinationGuard.Decision d = g.decisions.get(i);
                if (d.verdict == HallucinationGuard.Verdict.DROP) continue;
                HallucinationGuard.Decision nd = new HallucinationGuard.Decision();
                nd.verdict = d.verdict;
                nd.reason = d.reason;
                aligned.decisions.add(nd);
                if (d.verdict == HallucinationGuard.Verdict.KEEP) aligned.kept++;
                else aligned.flagged++;
            }
            List<UnitMerge.Unit> units = UnitMerge.merge(surv, aligned);
            for (UnitMerge.Unit u : units) {
                String en = mt.translate(u.srcText);
                if (en == null || en.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
                CookedSubs.Line ln = new CookedSubs.Line();
                ln.startMs = Math.round(u.start * 1000.0);
                ln.endMs = Math.round(u.end * 1000.0);
                ln.text = en.trim();
                ln.orig = u.srcText;
                ln.speaker = u.speaker == null ? "" : u.speaker;
                ln.flagged = u.flagged;
                lines.add(ln);
            }
            double wall = (System.nanoTime() - w0) / 1e9;
            if (listener != null) {
                listener.onChunk(ci, chunkLen, wall, new ArrayList<>(lines));
            }
        }
        return lines;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { asr.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { mt.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/OnnxVoiceSynth.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.FloatBuffer;
import java.nio.LongBuffer;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession;

/**
 * The pack voice itself (v0.13.0) — a pure-Java MMS-TTS runner
 * over the ONNX Runtime Sandy already carries. A voice pack's
 * model is a VITS network that eats CHARACTER ids, so no native
 * phonemizer is needed: the front end is the rule sherpa-onnx's
 * character front end runs, reproduced exactly (and pinned by the
 * harness against the shipped token tables):
 *
 *   text splits into sentences at . ! ? :
 *   per sentence: ids = [0], then for every character the pack's
 *   tokens.txt knows, (id, 0) — blank between characters;
 *   characters the table does not know are SKIPPED (the MMS
 *   vocabularies genuinely lack some punctuation; the model was
 *   trained that way).
 *
 * The graph contract (measured from the reference models):
 * inputs x int64 [1,L], x_length, noise_scale 0.667,
 * length_scale (the rate knob), noise_scale_w 0.8; output y
 * float [1,1,L] at 16000 Hz. Sentences join with a breath of
 * silence; the spoken PCM is silence-trimmed at both ends.
 *
 * Cast variation rides the VoiceBook's own numbers: rate through
 * length_scale, pitch through a PCM resample — and the caller
 * always measures the PCM it actually got (the duration
 * predictor samples inside the graph; no honest number exists
 * before the run).
 */
public final class OnnxVoiceSynth implements AutoCloseable {

    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE = 16000;
    private static final float NOISE_SCALE = 0.667f;
    private static final float NOISE_SCALE_W = 0.8f;
    private static final int JOIN_SILENCE = SAMPLE_RATE * 15 / 100;

    private final OrtSession session;
    private final Map<String, Integer> tokens;

    private OnnxVoiceSynth(OrtSession session, Map<String, Integer> tokens) {
        this.session = session;
        this.tokens = tokens;
    }

    /** Open an installed voice pack dir (model.onnx + tokens.txt). */
    public static OnnxVoiceSynth open(File packDir) throws Exception {
        File model = new File(packDir, "model.onnx");
        File tokFile = new File(packDir, "tokens.txt");
        if (!model.isFile()) throw new Exception("the voice pack has no model");
        if (!tokFile.isFile()) throw new Exception("the voice pack has no token table");
        Map<String, Integer> tokens = loadTokens(tokFile);
        if (tokens.isEmpty()) throw new Exception("the voice pack's token table is empty");
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        OrtSession.SessionOptions opts = new OrtSession.SessionOptions();
        OrtSession session = env.createSession(model.getPath(), opts);
        return new OnnxVoiceSynth(session, tokens);
    }

    public static Map<String, Integer> loadTokens(File f) throws Exception {
        Map<String, Integer> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(
                new FileInputStream(f), "UTF-8"))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
                int sp = line.lastIndexOf(' ');
                if (sp < 0) continue;
                String tok = line.substring(0, sp);
                try {
                    out.put(tok, Integer.parseInt(line.substring(sp + 1).trim()));
                } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- the front end

    /**
     * The character front end, pure: text -> one id sequence per
     * sentence. Unknown characters are skipped; a sentence with no
     * known characters yields no sequence.
     */
    public static List<long[]> tokenize(Map<String, Integer> tokens, String text) {
        List<long[]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null) return out;
        for (String part : text.split("[.!?:]")) {
            List<Long> ids = new ArrayList<>();
            ids.add(0L);
            for (int i = 0; i < part.length(); i++) {
                String ch = part.substring(i, i + 1);
                Integer id = tokens.get(ch);
                if (id != null) {
                    ids.add((long) id);
                    ids.add(0L);
                }
            }
            if (ids.size() > 1) {
                long[] a = new long[ids.size()];
                for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] = ids.get(i);
                out.add(a);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Pitch a PCM buffer by resampling (factor > 1 = higher). */
    public static float[] pitchShift(float[] in, double factor) {
        if (in.length == 0 || factor <= 0 || Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 0.01) return in;
        int outLen = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(in.length / factor));
        float[] out = new float[outLen];
        for (int i = 0; i < outLen; i++) {
            double pos = i * factor;
            int j = (int) pos;
            double frac = pos - j;
            float a = in[Math.min(j, in.length - 1)];
            float b = in[Math.min(j + 1, in.length - 1)];
            out[i] = (float) (a + (b - a) * frac);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Trim leading/trailing near-silence (with a small pad kept). */
    public static float[] trimSilence(float[] in) {
        if (in.length == 0) return in;
        int first = 0;
        while (first < in.length && Math.abs(in[first]) < 0.004f) first++;
        int last = in.length - 1;
        while (last > first && Math.abs(in[last]) < 0.004f) last--;
        if (first >= in.length) return new float[0];
        int pad = SAMPLE_RATE / 20;
        first = Math.max(0, first - pad);
        last = Math.min(in.length - 1, last + pad);
        float[] out = new float[last - first + 1];
        System.arraycopy(in, first, out, 0, out.length);
        return out;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- synthesis

    /** Speak one line of text; returns 16 kHz mono PCM (trimmed). */
    public float[] synth(String text, double lengthScale) throws Exception {
        List<long[]> sentences = tokenize(tokens, text);
        if (sentences.isEmpty()) return new float[0];
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        List<float[]> parts = new ArrayList<>();
        int total = 0;
        for (long[] ids : sentences) {
            Map<String, OnnxTensor> inputs = new HashMap<>();
            inputs.put("x", OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                    LongBuffer.wrap(ids), new long[]{1, ids.length}));
            inputs.put("x_length", OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                    LongBuffer.wrap(new long[]{ids.length}), new long[]{1}));
            inputs.put("noise_scale", OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                    FloatBuffer.wrap(new float[]{NOISE_SCALE}), new long[]{1}));
            inputs.put("length_scale", OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                    FloatBuffer.wrap(new float[]{(float) lengthScale}), new long[]{1}));
            inputs.put("noise_scale_w", OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                    FloatBuffer.wrap(new float[]{NOISE_SCALE_W}), new long[]{1}));
            try (OrtSession.Result r = session.run(inputs)) {
                float[][][] y = (float[][][]) r.get(0).getValue();
                parts.add(y[0][0]);
                total += y[0][0].length + JOIN_SILENCE;
            } finally {
                for (OnnxTensor t : inputs.values()) {
                    try { t.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            }
        }
        float[] joined = new float[Math.max(0, total - JOIN_SILENCE)];
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) pos += JOIN_SILENCE;
            System.arraycopy(parts.get(i), 0, joined, pos, parts.get(i).length);
            pos += parts.get(i).length;
        }
        return trimSilence(joined);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { session.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/OpusMtOnnx.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtException;
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession;

/**
 * Opus-MT (Marian) ja->en on ONNX Runtime (v0.6.1) — the translator
 * half of the bound engine. The recipe is the phone bench's CT2
 * recipe exactly, ported from the verified desktop prototype
 * (work/v061/proto_mt.py):
 *
 *   source ids = SentencePiece pieces of the text + </s> (appending
 *   </s> is mandatory — without it the decoder loops);
 *   encoder over the ids; the decoder starts from <pad> (60715),
 *   step 0 through decoder_model (which also produces the self- and
 *   cross-attention caches), later steps one token through
 *   decoder_with_past (only the self cache comes back; the cross
 *   cache is re-fed unchanged); BEAM 4; <pad> suppressed at every
 *   step (the generation config's bad_words rule); stop on </s>;
 *   max 200 generated tokens (the bench's max_decoding_length).
 *
 * Past tensors are carried as plain float arrays copied out of each
 * step's result; names are discovered from the graphs at open time
 * and classified self (".decoder.") vs cross (".encoder.").
 */
public final class OpusMtOnnx implements AutoCloseable {

    public static final int EOS = 0;        // </s>
    public static final int PAD = 60715;    // <pad> = decoder start
    public static final int BEAM = 4;
    public static final int MAX_LEN = 200;
    private static final int VOCAB = 60716;
    private static final int HEADS = 8;
    private static final int HEAD_DIM = 64;
    private static final double NEG = -1e30;

    private final OrtEnvironment env;
    private final OrtSession encoder;
    private final OrtSession decoder;
    private final OrtSession decoderPast;
    private final List<String> selfIn;
    private final List<String> crossIn;
    private final SentencePiece sp;

    public OpusMtOnnx(OrtEnvironment env, File mtDir, SentencePiece sp)
            throws OrtException {
        this.env = env;
        this.sp = sp;
        OrtSession.SessionOptions o = new OrtSession.SessionOptions();
        o.setIntraOpNumThreads(2);
        o.setInterOpNumThreads(1);
        encoder = env.createSession(new File(mtDir, "encoder_model.onnx").getPath(), o);
        decoder = env.createSession(new File(mtDir, "decoder_model.onnx").getPath(), o);
        decoderPast = env.createSession(
                new File(mtDir, "decoder_with_past_model.onnx").getPath(), o);
        Map<String, String> self = new TreeMap<>();
        Map<String, String> cross = new TreeMap<>();
        for (String name : decoderPast.getInputNames()) {
            if (!name.startsWith("past_key_values")) continue;
            if (name.contains(".decoder.")) self.put(sortKey(name), name);
            else if (name.contains(".encoder.")) cross.put(sortKey(name), name);
        }
        if (self.isEmpty() || cross.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("decoder_with_past past tensors "
                    + "not found (self=" + self.size() + ", cross=" + cross.size() + ")");
        }
        selfIn = new ArrayList<>(self.values());
        crossIn = new ArrayList<>(cross.values());
    }

    private static String sortKey(String name) {
        String[] p = name.split("\\.");
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 1; i < p.length; i++) {
            String t = p[i];
            if (t.matches("\\d+")) sb.append(String.format("%04d", Integer.parseInt(t)));
            else if (t.equals("key")) sb.append("0");
            else if (t.equals("value")) sb.append("1");
            else sb.append("0");
            sb.append('.');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String presentName(String pastInName) {
        return pastInName.replace("past_key_values", "present");
    }

    /** A past tensor as a FLAT float array + sequence length (see
     *  WhisperOnnx.FlatPast for why: nested-array tensor creation
     *  is reflective and dominated the first bridge version). */
    private static final class FlatPast {
        final float[] data;
        final int len;
        FlatPast(float[] data, int len) { this.data = data; this.len = len; }
    }

    private FlatPast readPast(OrtSession.Result r, String name) throws Exception {
        OnnxTensor t = (OnnxTensor) r.get(name).get();
        long[] shape = t.getInfo().getShape();
        java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = t.getFloatBuffer();
        float[] d = new float[fb.remaining()];
        fb.get(d);
        return new FlatPast(d, (int) shape[2]);
    }

    private static final class Beam {
        int[] tokens;                 // generated tokens only
        double score;
        FlatPast[] selfPast;
        boolean finished;
    }

    /** Translate one merged unit of source text. */
    public String translate(String sourceText) throws Exception {
        // the recipe's mandatory trailing </s> (SentencePiece.encode
        // leaves it off on purpose; without it the decoder loops)
        int[] pieces = sp.encode(sourceText);
        int[] srcIds = Arrays.copyOf(pieces, pieces.length + 1);
        srcIds[pieces.length] = EOS;
        long[][] ids = new long[1][srcIds.length];
        long[][] mask = new long[1][srcIds.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < srcIds.length; i++) {
            ids[0][i] = srcIds[i];
            mask[0][i] = 1;
        }
        float[] encFlat;
        int srcLen = srcIds.length;
        Map<String, OnnxTensor> ef = new HashMap<>();
        OnnxTensor idT = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, ids);
        OnnxTensor maskT = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, mask);
        ef.put("input_ids", idT);
        ef.put("attention_mask", maskT);
        try (OrtSession.Result r = encoder.run(ef)) {
            OnnxTensor t = (OnnxTensor) r.get(0);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = t.getFloatBuffer();
            encFlat = new float[fb.remaining()];
            fb.get(encFlat);
        } finally {
            idT.close();
            maskT.close();
        }
        // ---- step 0: <pad> through decoder_model ----
        FlatPast[] selfPast0;
        FlatPast[] crossPast;
        double[] lp0;
        Map<String, OnnxTensor> f0 = new HashMap<>();
        OnnxTensor startT = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, new long[][]{{PAD}});
        OnnxTensor encT = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                java.nio.FloatBuffer.wrap(encFlat), new long[]{1, srcLen, 512});
        OnnxTensor encMaskT = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, mask);
        f0.put("input_ids", startT);
        f0.put("encoder_hidden_states", encT);
        f0.put("encoder_attention_mask", encMaskT);
        try (OrtSession.Result r = decoder.run(f0)) {
            OnnxTensor lt = (OnnxTensor) r.get("logits").get();
            java.nio.FloatBuffer lb = lt.getFloatBuffer();
            float[] lg = new float[VOCAB];
            lb.position(lb.remaining() - VOCAB);
            lb.get(lg);
            lp0 = logSoftmax(lg);
            selfPast0 = new FlatPast[selfIn.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < selfIn.size(); i++) {
                selfPast0[i] = readPast(r, presentName(selfIn.get(i)));
            }
            crossPast = new FlatPast[crossIn.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < crossIn.size(); i++) {
                crossPast[i] = readPast(r, presentName(crossIn.get(i)));
            }
        } finally {
            startT.close();
            encT.close();
            encMaskT.close();
        }
        lp0[PAD] = NEG;
        // constant per translation: tensorize ONCE (the first
        // bridge version re-created the cross pasts and the mask
        // from nested arrays on every beam step — measured as the
        // runtime dominator; see BINDING-VERDICT.md)
        OnnxTensor[] crossT = new OnnxTensor[crossIn.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < crossIn.size(); i++) {
            FlatPast p = crossPast[i];
            crossT[i] = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                    java.nio.FloatBuffer.wrap(p.data),
                    new long[]{1, HEADS, p.len, HEAD_DIM});
        }
        OnnxTensor maskStepT = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, mask);
        try {
            return translateBeams(lp0, selfPast0, crossT, maskStepT);
        } finally {
            for (OnnxTensor t : crossT) {
                try { t.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            try { maskStepT.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private String translateBeams(double[] lp0, FlatPast[] selfPast0,
                                  OnnxTensor[] crossT, OnnxTensor maskStepT)
            throws Exception {
        List<Beam> beams = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int t : topK(lp0, BEAM)) {
            Beam b = new Beam();
            b.tokens = new int[]{t};
            b.score = lp0[t];
            b.selfPast = selfPast0;
            b.finished = (t == EOS);
            beams.add(b);
        }
        // ---- steps 1.. : one token through decoder_with_past ----
        for (int step = 1; step < MAX_LEN; step++) {
            boolean allFin = true;
            for (Beam b : beams) if (!b.finished) { allFin = false; break; }
            if (allFin) break;
            List<Object[]> cand = new ArrayList<>(); // score, beamIdx, token, newSelfPast
            for (int bi = 0; bi < beams.size(); bi++) {
                Beam b = beams.get(bi);
                if (b.finished) {
                    cand.add(new Object[]{b.score, bi, null, null});
                    continue;
                }
                Map<String, OnnxTensor> feed = new HashMap<>();
                List<OnnxTensor> made = new ArrayList<>();
                OnnxTensor id1 = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                        new long[][]{{b.tokens[b.tokens.length - 1]}});
                made.add(id1);
                feed.put("input_ids", id1);
                feed.put("encoder_attention_mask", maskStepT);
                for (int i = 0; i < selfIn.size(); i++) {
                    FlatPast p = b.selfPast[i];
                    OnnxTensor t = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,
                            java.nio.FloatBuffer.wrap(p.data),
                            new long[]{1, HEADS, p.len, HEAD_DIM});
                    made.add(t);
                    feed.put(selfIn.get(i), t);
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < crossIn.size(); i++) {
                    feed.put(crossIn.get(i), crossT[i]);
                }
                float[] logits;
                FlatPast[] newSelf = new FlatPast[selfIn.size()];
                try (OrtSession.Result r = decoderPast.run(feed)) {
                    OnnxTensor lt = (OnnxTensor) r.get("logits").get();
                    java.nio.FloatBuffer lb = lt.getFloatBuffer();
                    logits = new float[VOCAB];
                    lb.position(lb.remaining() - VOCAB);
                    lb.get(logits);
                    for (int i = 0; i < selfIn.size(); i++) {
                        newSelf[i] = readPast(r, presentName(selfIn.get(i)));
                    }
                } finally {
                    for (OnnxTensor t : made) t.close();
                }
                double[] lp = logSoftmax(logits);
                lp[PAD] = NEG;
                for (int t : topK(lp, BEAM)) {
                    cand.add(new Object[]{b.score + lp[t], bi, t, newSelf});
                }
            }
            cand.sort((a, z) -> Double.compare((Double) z[0], (Double) a[0]));
            List<Beam> next = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Object[] c : cand) {
                if (next.size() >= BEAM) break;
                Beam src = beams.get((Integer) c[1]);
                Beam nb = new Beam();
                if (c[2] == null) {
                    nb.tokens = src.tokens;
                    nb.score = src.score;
                    nb.selfPast = src.selfPast;
                    nb.finished = true;
                } else {
                    int t = (Integer) c[2];
                    nb.tokens = Arrays.copyOf(src.tokens, src.tokens.length + 1);
                    nb.tokens[src.tokens.length] = t;
                    nb.score = (Double) c[0];
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    FlatPast[] np = (FlatPast[]) c[3];
                    nb.selfPast = np;
                    nb.finished = (t == EOS);
                }
                next.add(nb);
            }
            beams = next;
        }
        // Selection: GNMT length penalty — score / ((5 + len) / 6)
        // — among FINISHED hypotheses only. The desktop prototype
        // measured four rules against the CT2 reference; this is
        // the only one reproducing all of CT2's behaviors at once:
        // plain mean logprob preferred a doubled sentence (its
        // second half is near-free logprob) and let an unfinished
        // loop win the chant unit (~200 repetitions of one word);
        // raw cumulative score killed the loops but truncated
        // tails (", Your Highness." lost). Unfinished hypotheses
        // are excluded unless none finished.
        Beam best = null;
        double bestScore = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (Beam b : beams) {
            if (!b.finished || b.tokens.length == 0) continue;
            double s = b.score / ((5 + b.tokens.length) / 6.0);
            if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = b; }
        }
        if (best == null) {
            for (Beam b : beams) {
                if (b.tokens.length == 0) continue;
                double s = b.score / ((5 + b.tokens.length) / 6.0);
                if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = b; }
            }
        }
        if (best == null) return "";
        return sp.decode(best.tokens);
    }

    private static double[] logSoftmax(float[] logits) {
        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (float v : logits) if (v > max) max = v;
        double sum = 0;
        double[] out = new double[logits.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
            out[i] = logits[i] - max;
            sum += Math.exp(out[i]);
        }
        double lse = Math.log(sum);
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] -= lse;
        return out;
    }

    private static int[] topK(double[] lp, int k) {
        int[] out = new int[k];
        boolean[] used = new boolean[lp.length];
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            int best = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < lp.length; i++) {
                if (!used[i] && (best < 0 || lp[i] > lp[best])) best = i;
            }
            used[best] = true;
            out[j] = best;
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { encoder.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { decoder.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { decoderPast.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/PcmSource.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * A source of 16 kHz mono PCM for the cooker (v0.6.1). The desktop
 * JVM proof reads WAV files (WavPcm); on the phone, media files are
 * decoded to PCM by AudioPcmDecoder. The cooker only ever sees this
 * interface, so the engine binding is identical on both.
 */
public interface PcmSource {

    /** Total duration in seconds. */
    double durationSec();

    /**
     * Samples in [fromSec, fromSec + durSec) as floats in -1..1 at
     * 16 kHz mono. Short at end of stream; empty past it.
     */
    float[] read(double fromSec, double durSec) throws Exception;
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/PdfText.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.zip.Inflater;
import java.util.zip.InflaterInputStream;

/**
 * PDF text-layer extraction IN THE HOUSE (v0.14.0 Addendum 7 — extraction
 * comes home; the One-Hole Law applied to us). A lean, dependency-free
 * reader of a PDF's own text layer: content streams (FlateDecode inflated),
 * literal and hex strings, Tj/TJ/'/" showing operators, simple fonts read
 * as windows-1252, and CID fonts decoded through their /ToUnicode CMaps
 * (bfchar + bfrange). Page breaks follow the content streams in file order.
 * No rendering, no images, no OCR: a book that carries no text layer yields
 * almost nothing, and BookText names that honestly (scanned-image book)
 * instead of handing the viewer an errand to another program.
 */
public final class PdfText {

    public static final class Extract {
        public String text = "";
        public List<String> pages = new ArrayList<>();
        public int pageObjects = 0;
        public int textChars = 0;
    }

    private static final Charset LATIN1 = Charset.forName("ISO-8859-1");
    private static final Charset CP1252 = Charset.forName("windows-1252");
    private static final Pattern OBJ_HEAD =
            Pattern.compile("(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+obj");
    private static final Pattern PAGE_TYPE =
            Pattern.compile("/Type\\s*/Page(?![sA-Za-z])");
    private static final Pattern TO_UNICODE =
            Pattern.compile("/ToUnicode\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R");
    private static final Pattern FONT_REF =
            Pattern.compile("/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R");

    private PdfText() {}

    public static Extract extract(byte[] pdf) {
        Extract out = new Extract();
        if (pdf == null || pdf.length < 5) return out;
        String raw = new String(pdf, LATIN1);
        Matcher pm = PAGE_TYPE.matcher(raw);
        while (pm.find()) out.pageObjects++;

        // 1) pull every stream, in file order, with its owning obj number.
        List<int[]> owners = new ArrayList<>();        // obj number per stream
        List<String> streams = new ArrayList<>();      // decoded stream text
        int scan = 0;
        while (true) {
            int sIdx = raw.indexOf("stream", scan);
            if (sIdx < 0) break;
            // "stream" must not be the tail of "endstream"
            if (sIdx >= 3 && raw.regionMatches(sIdx - 3, "end", 0, 3)) {
                scan = sIdx + 6; continue;
            }
            int dataStart = sIdx + 6;
            if (dataStart < raw.length() && raw.charAt(dataStart) == '\r') dataStart++;
            if (dataStart < raw.length() && raw.charAt(dataStart) == '\n') dataStart++;
            int eIdx = raw.indexOf("endstream", dataStart);
            if (eIdx < 0) break;
            int dataEnd = eIdx;
            String dict = raw.substring(Math.max(0, sIdx - 1200), sIdx);
            byte[] data = raw.substring(dataStart, dataEnd).getBytes(LATIN1);
            byte[] decoded = data;
            if (dict.contains("FlateDecode")) {
                // Exact slice first; a whitespace-trimmed slice as the
                // alternate manner (a blind trim can eat a checksum byte).
                byte[] inf = inflate(data);
                if (inf == null) {
                    int tEnd = dataEnd;
                    if (tEnd > dataStart && raw.charAt(tEnd - 1) == '\n') tEnd--;
                    if (tEnd > dataStart && raw.charAt(tEnd - 1) == '\r') tEnd--;
                    inf = inflate(raw.substring(dataStart, tEnd).getBytes(LATIN1));
                }
                if (inf != null) decoded = inf;
            }
            int owner = -1;
            Matcher om = OBJ_HEAD.matcher(raw.substring(0, sIdx));
            while (om.find()) owner = Integer.parseInt(om.group(1));
            owners.add(new int[]{owner});
            streams.add(new String(decoded, LATIN1));
            scan = eIdx + 9;
        }

        // 2) ToUnicode CMaps, by owning object.
        Map<Integer, Map<Integer, String>> cmapByObj = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Integer, String> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < streams.size(); i++) {
            String st = streams.get(i);
            if (st.contains("beginbfchar") || st.contains("beginbfrange")) {
                Map<Integer, String> cm = parseCMap(st);
                if (!cm.isEmpty()) {
                    cmapByObj.put(owners.get(i)[0], cm);
                    for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> e : cm.entrySet()) {
                        if (!merged.containsKey(e.getKey())) {
                            merged.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3) font resource name -> its CMap (via font obj -> /ToUnicode ref).
        Map<String, Map<Integer, String>> fontCMap = new HashMap<>();
        Matcher fm = FONT_REF.matcher(raw);
        while (fm.find()) {
            String name = fm.group(1);
            if (!name.startsWith("F")) continue;
            int obj = Integer.parseInt(fm.group(2));
            if (fontCMap.containsKey(name)) continue;
            String body = objectBody(raw, obj);
            if (body == null || !body.contains("/Font")) continue;
            Matcher tm = TO_UNICODE.matcher(body);
            if (tm.find()) {
                Map<Integer, String> cm = cmapByObj.get(
                        Integer.parseInt(tm.group(1)));
                if (cm != null) fontCMap.put(name, cm);
            }
        }

        // 4) walk content streams; collect text per stream (≈ per page).
        StringBuilder whole = new StringBuilder();
        for (String st : streams) {
            if (!st.contains("BT")) continue;
            String pageText = walkContent(st, fontCMap, merged);
            String trimmed = pageText.trim();
            if (!trimmed.isEmpty()) {
