     *  the maintenance as recovered. */
    private void startRecovery(int family) {
        if (destroyed || recovering) return;
        recovering = true;
        stallWordsShown = false;
        recoveryStartedMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        recoveryFacts = playbackFacts();
        final int gen = ++recoveryGen;
        cancelWatchdog();
        if (player == null || !player.isPlaying()) {
            // The picture is already frozen: say the plain word.
            // (A pinger-triggered start while the picture still
            // plays stays quiet — maintenance under full cover
            // is invisible by design.)
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "player_reconnecting"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        }
        spawnRecoveryLoop(gen, family);
    }

    private void spawnRecoveryLoop(int gen, int family) {
        if (recoveryLoopRunning) return;
        recoveryLoopRunning = true;
        new Thread(() -> recoveryLoop(gen, family),
                "continuity-recovery").start();
    }

    /**
     * The maintenance loop: walk the ladder exhaustively; a door
     * proven to the segment tier (or answering slowly — slow is
     * not dead) means re-prepare and resume; otherwise classify
     * from the full evidence and let the law decide. Cycles are
     * uncapped while any layer answers; the loop dies with its
     * generation (channel change, verdict, destroy).
     */
    private void recoveryLoop(int gen, int family0) {
        int family = family0;
        long backoff = PlaybackContinuity.BACKOFF_START_MS;
        try {
            while (!destroyed && recovering && gen == recoveryGen) {
                if (queue == null || index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) {
                    return;
                }
                final M3uParser.Channel c = queue.get(index);
                HydraResolver.Outcome o = HydraResolver.proveExhaustive(
                        getApplicationContext(), c.url, c.userAgent, null);
                if (destroyed || !recovering || gen != recoveryGen) return;
                PlaybackRecord.Facts f = recoveryFacts == null
                        ? new PlaybackRecord.Facts() : copyFacts(recoveryFacts);
                f.headsTried = PlaybackRecord.headsTriedText(o.tried);
                if (o.result != null
                        && (o.result.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS
                                || o.result.slow)) {
                    // a door serves the video: re-prepare on it
                    final String door = o.url;
                    f.decision = "RECONNECT";
                    f.family = PlaybackContinuity.familyName(family);
                    f.note = door.equals(c.url)
                            ? "the door answered again — re-preparing"
                            : "another door answered — re-preparing there";
                    PlaybackRecord.write(getApplicationContext(),
                            PlaybackRecord.EV_RECONNECT, f);
                    handler.post(() -> {
                        if (destroyed || gen != recoveryGen) return;
                        if (!door.equals(c.url)) c.url = door;
                        maintenanceReprepare = true;
                        playCurrent();
                        if (player != null) player.setPlayWhenReady(true);
                    });
                    return;
                }
                Hydra.Tried worst = Hydra.mostInformative(o.tried);
                int bestHttp = worst != null ? worst.httpCode
                        : (o.result != null ? o.result.httpCode : 0);
                family = PlaybackContinuity.classifyWalk(o.bestTier, bestHttp);
                long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - recoveryStartedMs;
                int decision = PlaybackContinuity.decide(family, true, elapsed);
                f.family = PlaybackContinuity.familyName(family);
                f.decision = decision == PlaybackContinuity.ADVANCE
                        ? "ADVANCE" : decision == PlaybackContinuity.HOLD_STALL
                                ? "HOLD_STALL" : "RECONNECT";
                f.note = "maintenance cycle: best tier " + o.bestTier
                        + ", " + elapsed + " ms in";
                PlaybackRecord.write(getApplicationContext(),
                        PlaybackRecord.EV_RECONNECT, f);
                if (decision == PlaybackContinuity.ADVANCE) {
                    final int fam = family;
                    final HydraResolver.Outcome out = o;
                    handler.post(() -> verdictAdvance(fam, out));
                    return;
                }
                if (decision == PlaybackContinuity.HOLD_STALL
                        && !stallWordsShown) {
                    stallWordsShown = true;
                    handler.post(() -> {
                        if (!destroyed) {
                            Toast.makeText(PlayerActivity.this,
                                    LangStore.tr(PlayerActivity.this,
                                            "player_stream_stalled"),
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        }
                    });
                }
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(backoff);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    return;
                }
                backoff = Math.min(backoff + 2000,
                        PlaybackContinuity.BACKOFF_MAX_MS);
            }
        } finally {
            // A newer generation's loop owns the flag now; only
            // the current generation may clear it.
            if (gen == recoveryGen) recoveryLoopRunning = false;
        }
    }

    private static PlaybackRecord.Facts copyFacts(PlaybackRecord.Facts f) {
        PlaybackRecord.Facts out = new PlaybackRecord.Facts();
        out.channel = f.channel;
        out.playlistUrl = f.playlistUrl;
        out.playlistResult = f.playlistResult;
        out.segmentUrl = f.segmentUrl;
        out.segmentHost = f.segmentHost;
        out.segmentResult = f.segmentResult;
        out.positionMs = f.positionMs;
        out.bufferedMs = f.bufferedMs;
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * The verdict, when the law finally allows one: the words
     * name what ended, the health record files the walked truth,
     * and the advance (when the viewer left auto-skip on) is a
     * verdict, not a strike — consecutiveFails is untouched.
     */
    private void verdictAdvance(int family, HydraResolver.Outcome o) {
        if (destroyed) return;
        recovering = false;
        recoveryGen++;
        PlaybackRecord.Facts f = recoveryFacts == null
                ? playbackFacts() : copyFacts(recoveryFacts);
        f.headsTried = PlaybackRecord.headsTriedText(o.tried);
        f.family = PlaybackContinuity.familyName(family);
        f.decision = "ADVANCE";
        String words;
        if (family == PlaybackContinuity.PLAYLIST_GONE) {
            words = LangStore.tr(this, "player_stream_ended");
            f.note = "the playlist is terminally gone on every door";
            recordHealthTier(LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD, "stream ended mid-play");
        } else if (family == PlaybackContinuity.SEGMENT_REFUSED) {
            words = "This channel's list still answers, but its video "
                    + "stopped coming — the source stopped sending it.";
            f.note = "segments refused on every door; the list answers";
            recordHealthTier(LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS,
                    "played, then the video stopped");
        } else {
            words = FailureWords.englishFor(o.result);
            f.note = "no answer anywhere on the ladder";
            recordHealthTier(LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD, "no answer after playing");
        }
        PlaybackRecord.write(this, PlaybackRecord.EV_VERDICT, f);
        if (player != null) player.stop();
        boolean canSkip = ChannelStore.getAutoSkip(this)
                && queue != null && queue.size() > 1;
        if (canSkip) {
            Toast.makeText(this, words + " Moving on…",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            handler.postDelayed(() -> { if (!destroyed) step(1); }, 1200);
        } else {
            errorText.setText(words + "\n\n" + queue.get(index).name);
            errorBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ the Active Pinger

    private void restartPinger() {
        stopPinger();
        if (!liveNow || isRecordingPlay || destroyed) return;
        if (queue == null || index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) return;
        M3uParser.Channel c = queue.get(index);
        if (c == null || !LinkHealth.isRemote(c.url)) return;
        String ua = (c.userAgent == null || c.userAgent.isEmpty())
                ? "Sandy/0.14.1" : c.userAgent;
        pinger = new ActivePinger(c.url, ua, pingerListener);
        pinger.start();
    }

    private void stopPinger() {
        if (pinger != null) {
            pinger.stop();
            pinger = null;
        }
    }

    /** A door the pinger proved terminally dead loses its
     *  learned preference — in memory and on the memory hook. */
    private void forgetDoorOf(String url) {
        String host = Hydra.hostOf(url);
        if (host == null) return;
        Net.forgetLearned(host);
        HydraStore.forget(getApplicationContext(), host);
    }

    private final ActivePinger.Listener pingerListener =
            new ActivePinger.Listener() {
                @Override
                public void onPingSample(ActivePinger.Sample s) {
                    lastPing = s;
                    String cls = s.ok ? "ok"
                            : s.playlistHttp > 0 ? "http" + s.playlistHttp
                                    : s.failureKind;
                    if (!cls.equals(lastPingClass)) {
                        // record state CHANGES, not the heartbeat
                        lastPingClass = cls;
                        PlaybackRecord.write(getApplicationContext(),
                                PlaybackRecord.EV_PING, pingFacts(s));
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void onPlaylistTerminal(ActivePinger.Sample s) {
                    forgetDoorOf(s.playlistUrl);
                    if (!playedThisChannel || !liveNow
                            || isRecordingPlay || destroyed) return;
                    PlaybackRecord.Facts f = pingFacts(s);
                    f.family = PlaybackContinuity.familyName(
                            PlaybackContinuity.PLAYLIST_GONE);
                    f.note = "the pinger: this door is terminally gone "
                            + "— maintenance starts under full runway";
                    PlaybackRecord.write(getApplicationContext(),
                            PlaybackRecord.EV_ERROR, f);
                    handler.post(() -> startRecovery(
                            PlaybackContinuity.PLAYLIST_GONE));
                }

                @Override
                public void onWindowStuck(ActivePinger.Sample s) {
                    PlaybackRecord.Facts f = pingFacts(s);
                    f.family = PlaybackContinuity.familyName(
                            PlaybackContinuity.PLAYLIST_STUCK);
                    f.note = "the pinger: the window stopped advancing "
                            + "(media sequence and first segment unchanged)";
                    PlaybackRecord.write(getApplicationContext(),
                            PlaybackRecord.EV_STALL, f);
                    if (!playedThisChannel || !liveNow
                            || isRecordingPlay || destroyed) return;
                    handler.post(() -> startRecovery(
                            PlaybackContinuity.PLAYLIST_STUCK));
                }
            };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- failures

    private static String schemeOf(String url) {
        int i = url.indexOf("://");
        return i > 0 ? url.substring(0, i) : "unknown";
    }

    private void armWatchdog(String channelName) {
        watchdog = () -> {
            if (destroyed) return;
            // v0.14.1: while maintenance owns the channel, the
            // startup watchdog stands down — the recovery loop
            // is the watcher now.
            if (recovering) return;
            if (player != null && player.getPlaybackState() != Player.STATE_READY
                    && player.getPlaybackState() != Player.STATE_ENDED) {
                // a stall is a network outcome: Hydra gets its
                // walk, and the words say "didn't answer in time"
                lastFailNetwork = !localMode;
                lastFailWords = localMode ? "" : FailureWords.englishFor(
                        FailureWords.TIMEOUT, 0);
                handleFailure(localMode
                        ? "This file didn't start in time."
                        : "This channel didn't answer in time.");
            }
        };
        handler.postDelayed(watchdog, READY_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }

    /** The plain words for a playback error (v0.14.0): the HTTP
     *  status the server spoke, the cleartext bar, the timeout —
     *  never a bare "HTTP error". "" when the error carries no
     *  such word (a decode failure is a different sentence, and
     *  the caller's own message already says it). */
    private static String wordsOfError(PlaybackException error) {
        Throwable t = error;
        while (t != null) {
            if (t instanceof androidx.media3.datasource.HttpDataSource
                    .InvalidResponseCodeException) {
                int code = ((androidx.media3.datasource.HttpDataSource
                        .InvalidResponseCodeException) t).responseCode;
                return FailureWords.englishFor(
                        FailureWords.kindForHttp(code), code);
            }
            if (t instanceof androidx.media3.datasource.HttpDataSource
                    .CleartextNotPermittedException) {
                return FailureWords.englishFor(FailureWords.CLEARTEXT, 0);
            }
            if (t instanceof java.net.SocketTimeoutException) {
                return FailureWords.englishFor(FailureWords.TIMEOUT, 0);
            }
            if (t instanceof java.net.UnknownHostException) {
                return FailureWords.englishFor(FailureWords.ADDRESS, 0);
            }
            t = t.getCause();
        }
        return "";
    }

    /** Did the wire fail (vs. the phone failing to decode)? */
    private static boolean isNetworkError(PlaybackException error) {
        Throwable t = error;
        while (t != null) {
            if (t instanceof java.io.IOException) return true;
            t = t.getCause();
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void cancelWatchdog() {
        if (watchdog != null) handler.removeCallbacks(watchdog);
        watchdog = null;
    }

    /**
     * Health from real plays (v0.3.0): a stream that reached READY is
     * verified working; one that failed or timed out is marked dead —
     * both feed the same badges the probes write, so the lists learn
     * from every play, not just from Verify runs.
     */
    private void recordHealth(boolean ok, String detail) {
        recordHealthTier(ok ? LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS : LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD,
                detail);
    }

    /**
     * File a health verdict at an explicit tier. v0.14.1: mid-play
     * events file the truth at their own tier — a channel that
     * played and then had its segments refused files CONNECTS
     * ("played, then the video stopped"), NOT the DEAD that the
     * old handleFailure stamped on it before any walk ran; a
     * walked source-ended verdict files DEAD, in those words.
     */
    private void recordHealthTier(int tier, String detail) {
        if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty() || index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) return;
        String url = queue.get(index).url;
        if (!LinkHealth.isRemote(url)) return;
        LinkHealth.Result r = new LinkHealth.Result();
        r.checkedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        // A real play outranks any probe: READY means the video itself
        // answered (top tier); a failure means dead, whatever an
        // earlier probe believed.
        r.finish(tier, true, detail);
        HealthStore.record(this, url, r);
    }

    private void handleFailure(String message) {
        if (destroyed) return;
        cancelWatchdog();
        // The DEAD filed here is a TUNE-IN truth only: since
        // v0.14.1 a failure after the channel PLAYED never
        // reaches this method (onPlayerError routes it to the
        // continuity law) — the old code filed "didn't play" on
        // channels that had just played fine for fifteen
        // seconds, and the health record lied ever after.
        recordHealth(false, "didn't play");
        if (localMode) {
            // A file is not a channel: no auto-skip, no health marks —
            // it says what happened and waits for the viewer.
            if (player != null) player.stop();
            errorText.setText(message + " It may be damaged, or a kind of "
                    + "video this phone can't decode.\n\n" + queue.get(index).name);
            errorBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return;
        }
        // Hydra's walk (v0.14.0, the Connection Law): before any
        // give-up, a NETWORK failure tries the same channel
        // through the ladder's other doors — the manner may be
        // what's dead while the channel lives behind another
        // one. Once per channel; the viewer hears the simple
        // words, never the machinery.
        if (!hydraWalked && lastFailNetwork && queue != null
                && index >= 0 && index < queue.size()
                && LinkHealth.isRemote(queue.get(index).url)) {
            hydraWalked = true;
            final int idx = index;
            final String url = queue.get(idx).url;
            final String ua = queue.get(idx).userAgent;
            if (player != null) player.stop();
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "hydra_trying"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            new Thread(() -> {
                HydraResolver.Outcome o = HydraResolver.prove(
                        getApplicationContext(), url, ua, null);
                handler.post(() -> {
                    if (destroyed || idx != index) return;
                    if (o.ok() && !o.url.equals(url)) {
                        // another door answered: play THAT door
                        queue.get(idx).url = o.url;
                        consecutiveFails = 0;
                        lastFailNetwork = false;
                        lastFailWords = "";
                        playCurrent();
                    } else if (o.ok()) {
                        finishFailure(message);
                    } else {
                        finishFailure(message + " "
                                + FailureWords.englishFor(o.result));
                    }
                });
            }, "hydra-player-walk").start();
            return;
        }
        finishFailure(message
                + (lastFailWords.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + lastFailWords));
    }

    /** The give-up path a failure reaches when Hydra's ladder is
     *  spent (or never applied): auto-skip or the error box, as
     *  before — with the failure's own words in the sentence. */
    private void finishFailure(String message) {
        if (destroyed) return;
        if (player != null) player.stop();
        consecutiveFails++;
        boolean canSkip = ChannelStore.getAutoSkip(this)
                && consecutiveFails <= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILS
                && queue != null && queue.size() > 1;
        if (canSkip) {
            Toast.makeText(this, message + " Skipping…", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            handler.postDelayed(() -> { if (!destroyed) step(1); }, 1200);
        } else {
            errorText.setText(message + "\n\n" + queue.get(index).name);
            errorBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        // v0.14.1: the pinger and the maintenance loop die with
        // the player — their generation bump ends any in-flight
        // walk's claim on this screen.
        recovering = false;
        recoveryGen++;
        stopPinger();
        // The share belongs to what was on this screen: leaving
        // the player ends the fling and closes the watching page.
        if (shareCast != null) shareCast.stopAll();
        if (ttsRenderer != null) ttsRenderer.cancel();
        if (boundEngine != null) {
            boundEngine.cancel();
            boundEngine.close();
            boundEngine = null;
        }
        savePlace();
        saveKept();
        cancelWatchdog();
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        if (player != null) {
            player.release();
            player = null;
        }
        // v0.5.0 (item 8 as amended): the timeshift buffer is NOT
        // wiped here. The last live channel's buffer is the kept
        // place — it survives the close so the place can be offered
        // back on reopen. It is wiped when the channel CHANGES
        // (playCurrent), which is where the "buffer, not a recording"
        // boundary now honestly sits: one channel, the last one.
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/PlaylistsActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The Dispatcharr move: bring your own playlists. Add any M3U URL, it is
 * fetched and counted on the spot, then merged into the one guide.
 * The built-in free-to-air directory can be refreshed but not removed.
 */
public class PlaylistsActivity extends Activity {

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private List<ChannelStore.Playlist> playlists;
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private final List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private EditText nameBox;
    private EditText urlBox;
    private TextView statusView;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private boolean changed = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        playlists = ChannelStore.getPlaylists(this);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        int pad = dp(12);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText("Playlists");
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(20);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView help = new TextView(this);
        help.setText("Every playlist below merges into one channel guide. " +
                "Tap one of your own to remove it. The built-in directory stays.");
        help.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160, 160, 170));
        help.setTextSize(13);
        root.addView(help);

        ListView list = new ListView(this);
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, rows);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        list.setOnItemClickListener((parent, view, position, id) -> {
            ChannelStore.Playlist pl = playlists.get(position);
            if (pl.builtin) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "The built-in directory can't be removed — Refresh rebuilds it.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                return;
            }
            new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle("Remove playlist")
                    .setMessage("Remove \"" + pl.name + "\"?\n" + pl.url +
                            "\n\nIts channels leave the guide on the next refresh.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Remove", (d, w) -> {
                        playlists.remove(position);
                        ChannelStore.savePlaylists(this, playlists);
                        changed = true;
                        rebuildRows();
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Keep", null)
                    .show();
        });

        TextView addLabel = new TextView(this);
        addLabel.setText("Add a playlist by URL (M3U):");
        addLabel.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        addLabel.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(addLabel);

        nameBox = new EditText(this);
        nameBox.setHint("Name (optional)");
        nameBox.setSingleLine(true);
        nameBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        nameBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(140, 140, 150));
        root.addView(nameBox);

        urlBox = new EditText(this);
        urlBox.setHint("https://…/playlist.m3u");
        urlBox.setSingleLine(true);
        urlBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        urlBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(140, 140, 150));
        root.addView(urlBox);

        Button addBtn = new Button(this);
        addBtn.setText("Add playlist");
        addBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> tryAdd());
        root.addView(addBtn);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        progress.setVisibility(android.view.View.GONE);
        root.addView(progress);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        statusView.setTextSize(13);
        root.addView(statusView);

        Button doneBtn = new Button(this);
        doneBtn.setText("Done");
        doneBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        root.addView(doneBtn);

        setContentView(root);
        rebuildRows();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    private void rebuildRows() {
        rows.clear();
        for (ChannelStore.Playlist pl : playlists) {
            rows.add(pl.name + (pl.builtin ? "  (built-in)" : "") + "\n" + pl.url);
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void tryAdd() {
        String url = urlBox.getText().toString().trim();
        String name = nameBox.getText().toString().trim();
        if (!(url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://"))) {
            statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 140, 140));
            statusView.setText("That URL doesn't look right — it should start with http:// or https://");
            return;
        }
        for (ChannelStore.Playlist pl : playlists) {
            if (pl.url.equals(url)) {
                statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 200, 120));
                statusView.setText("That playlist is already in the guide.");
                return;
            }
        }
        progress.setVisibility(android.view.View.VISIBLE);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        statusView.setText("Fetching it to count the channels…");
        final String fUrl = url;
        final String fName = name.isEmpty() ? hostOf(url) : name;
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                byte[] bytes = download(fUrl);
                List<M3uParser.Channel> parsed = M3uParser.parse(
                        new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), fName);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(android.view.View.GONE);
                    if (parsed.isEmpty()) {
                        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 140, 140));
                        statusView.setText("That URL answered, but no channels were found in it. Not added.");
                        return;
                    }
                    playlists.add(new ChannelStore.Playlist(fName, fUrl, false));
                    ChannelStore.savePlaylists(this, playlists);
                    changed = true;
                    rebuildRows();
                    nameBox.setText("");
                    urlBox.setText("");
                    statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 200, 150));
                    statusView.setText("Added \"" + fName + "\" — " + parsed.size() +
                            " channels. The guide refreshes when you go back.");
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(android.view.View.GONE);
                    statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 140, 140));
                    String m = e.getMessage() == null ? e.getClass().getSimpleName() : e.getMessage();
                    statusView.setText("Couldn't fetch that playlist (" + m + "). Not added.");
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private static String hostOf(String url) {
        try {
            String h = new URL(url).getHost();
            return h == null || h.isEmpty() ? url : h;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return url;
        }
    }

    private byte[] download(String urlStr) throws Exception {
        HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(urlStr).openConnection();
        conn.setConnectTimeout(20000);
        conn.setReadTimeout(30000);
        conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", Net.UA);
        conn.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
        int code = conn.getResponseCode();
        if (code < 200 || code >= 300) throw new Exception("HTTP " + code);
        try (InputStream in = conn.getInputStream();
             ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
            return bos.toByteArray();
        } finally {
            conn.disconnect();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void finish() {
        if (changed) setResult(RESULT_OK, new Intent());
        super.finish();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/QrCode.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * A small QR encoder (v0.7.0) — just enough of ISO/IEC 18004 to
 * put the watching-page address on screen as a scannable code:
 * byte mode, error-correction level M, versions 1–10, all eight
 * masks tried and scored by the spec's own penalty rules.
 *
 * It exists because the page-share address is long to type on a
 * TV remote; a TV/phone camera that can scan it saves the
 * typing. The encoder is pure (no Android), and it does not
 * ship on faith: the build harness renders its matrices and a
 * real decoder (ZXing) must read them back byte-for-byte
 * before the code is trusted — see work/v070. If a payload is
 * too long for version 10-M, encode() refuses (returns null)
 * and the caller falls back to the big printed address.
 */
public final class QrCode {

    private QrCode() {}

    // EC level M block table, versions 1..10:
    // {total codewords, ec per block, g1 blocks, g1 data cw,
    //  g2 blocks, g2 data cw}
    private static final int[][] ECC_M = {
        {26, 10, 1, 16, 0, 0},
        {44, 16, 1, 28, 0, 0},
        {70, 26, 1, 44, 0, 0},
        {100, 18, 2, 32, 0, 0},
        {134, 24, 2, 43, 0, 0},
        {172, 16, 4, 27, 0, 0},
        {196, 18, 4, 31, 0, 0},
        {242, 22, 2, 38, 2, 39},
        {292, 22, 3, 36, 2, 37},
        {346, 26, 4, 43, 1, 44},
    };

    private static final int[][] ALIGN = {
        {},
        {6, 18},
        {6, 22},
        {6, 26},
        {6, 30},
        {6, 34},
        {6, 22, 38},
        {6, 24, 42},
        {6, 26, 46},
        {6, 28, 50},
    };

    /**
     * Encode text (UTF-8 bytes) into a module matrix
     * ([row][col], true = dark), WITHOUT quiet zone. Returns
     * null when the payload fits no version ≤ 10 at level M.
     */
    public static boolean[][] encode(String text) {
        byte[] data;
        try {
            data = text.getBytes("UTF-8");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
        for (int version = 1; version <= 10; version++) {
            int[] t = ECC_M[version - 1];
            int dataCw = t[2] * t[3] + t[4] * t[5];
            int lenBits = version == 10 ? 16 : 8;
            int needed = 4 + lenBits + data.length * 8;
            if (needed > dataCw * 8) continue;
            byte[] codewords = buildCodewords(data, version, dataCw, lenBits);
            byte[] interleaved = interleaveWithEcc(codewords, version);
            return drawMatrix(interleaved, version);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static byte[] buildCodewords(byte[] data, int version,
                                         int dataCw, int lenBits) {
        StringBuilder bits = new StringBuilder();
        bits.append("0100"); // byte mode
        String len = Integer.toBinaryString(data.length);
        for (int i = len.length(); i < lenBits; i++) bits.append('0');
        bits.append(len);
        for (byte b : data) {
            String s = Integer.toBinaryString(b & 0xff);
            for (int i = s.length(); i < 8; i++) bits.append('0');
            bits.append(s);
        }
        int cap = dataCw * 8;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4 && bits.length() < cap; i++) bits.append('0');
        while (bits.length() % 8 != 0) bits.append('0');
        byte[] out = new byte[dataCw];
        int n = bits.length() / 8;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            out[i] = (byte) Integer.parseInt(bits.substring(i * 8, i * 8 + 8), 2);
        }
        byte[] pads = {(byte) 0xEC, (byte) 0x11};
        for (int i = n, p = 0; i < dataCw; i++, p++) out[i] = pads[p % 2];
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ reed-solomon

    private static final int[] GF_EXP = new int[512];
    private static final int[] GF_LOG = new int[256];
    static {
        int x = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 255; i++) {
            GF_EXP[i] = x;
            GF_LOG[x] = i;
            x <<= 1;
            if ((x & 0x100) != 0) x ^= 0x11D;
        }
        for (int i = 255; i < 512; i++) GF_EXP[i] = GF_EXP[i - 255];
    }

    private static int gfMul(int a, int b) {
        return (a == 0 || b == 0) ? 0 : GF_EXP[GF_LOG[a] + GF_LOG[b]];
    }

    /** Generator polynomial of the given degree (coefficients). */
    private static int[] rsGenerator(int degree) {
        int[] poly = {1};
        for (int i = 0; i < degree; i++) {
            int[] next = new int[poly.length + 1];
            for (int j = 0; j < poly.length; j++) {
                next[j] ^= gfMul(poly[j], GF_EXP[i]);
                next[j + 1] ^= poly[j];
            }
            poly = next;
        }
        return poly;
    }

    /** The error-correction codewords for one data block. */
    private static byte[] rsRemainder(byte[] data, int ecLen) {
        // gen is ASCENDING (gen[k] = coefficient of x^k, gen[ecLen]
        // the leading 1); the shift register walks DESCENDING
        // degrees, so position i takes gen[ecLen - 1 - i].
        int[] gen = rsGenerator(ecLen);
        int[] res = new int[ecLen];
        for (byte b : data) {
            int factor = (b & 0xff) ^ res[0];
            System.arraycopy(res, 1, res, 0, ecLen - 1);
            res[ecLen - 1] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < ecLen; i++) {
                res[i] ^= gfMul(gen[ecLen - 1 - i], factor);
            }
        }
        byte[] out = new byte[ecLen];
        for (int i = 0; i < ecLen; i++) out[i] = (byte) res[i];
        return out;
    }

    private static byte[] interleaveWithEcc(byte[] data, int version) {
        int[] t = ECC_M[version - 1];
        int total = t[0], ecLen = t[1];
        byte[][] blocks = new byte[t[2] + t[4]][];
        byte[][] eccs = new byte[blocks.length][];
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
            int n = i < t[2] ? t[3] : t[5];
            blocks[i] = new byte[n];
            System.arraycopy(data, pos, blocks[i], 0, n);
            pos += n;
            eccs[i] = rsRemainder(blocks[i], ecLen);
        }
        byte[] out = new byte[total];
        int maxData = Math.max(t[3], t[5]);
        int o = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxData; i++) {
            for (byte[] blk : blocks) if (i < blk.length) out[o++] = blk[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < ecLen; i++) {
            for (byte[] ecc : eccs) out[o++] = ecc[i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ matrix

    private static boolean[][] drawMatrix(byte[] codewords, int version) {
        int size = version * 4 + 17;
        boolean[][] dark = new boolean[size][size];
        boolean[][] fn = new boolean[size][size]; // function modules

        // timing first (alignment/finders overwrite where they sit)
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            setFn(dark, fn, 6, i, i % 2 == 0);
            setFn(dark, fn, i, 6, i % 2 == 0);
        }
        drawFinder(dark, fn, 3, 3);
        drawFinder(dark, fn, size - 4, 3);
        drawFinder(dark, fn, 3, size - 4);
        int[] centers = ALIGN[version - 1];
        if (centers.length >= 2) {
            int first = centers[0], last = centers[centers.length - 1];
            for (int r : centers) {
                for (int c : centers) {
                    // skip only the three finder corners — centers
                    // on the timing lines are still drawn (they
                    // overwrite the timing where they sit)
                    if ((r == first && c == first)
                            || (r == first && c == last)
                            || (r == last && c == first)) continue;
                    drawAlignment(dark, fn, r, c);
                }
            }
        }
        // reserve format areas + the dark module
        drawFormatPlaceholders(dark, fn, size);
        if (version >= 7) drawVersionPlaceholders(dark, fn, size);
        dark[size - 8][8] = true;
        fn[size - 8][8] = true;

        // place data bits, zigzag from the bottom right
        int bits = codewords.length * 8;
        int idx = 0;
        for (int right = size - 1; right >= 1; right -= 2) {
            if (right == 6) right = 5;
            for (int vert = 0; vert < size; vert++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                    int col = right - j;
                    boolean upward = ((right + 1) & 2) == 0;
                    int row = upward ? size - 1 - vert : vert;
                    if (fn[row][col]) continue;
                    boolean bit = false;
                    if (idx < bits) {
                        bit = ((codewords[idx >>> 3] >>> (7 - (idx & 7))) & 1) != 0;
                        idx++;
                    }
                    dark[row][col] = bit;
                }
            }
        }

        // try all eight masks on the data area; keep the best score
        boolean[][] best = null;
        int bestPenalty = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < 8; mask++) {
            boolean[][] m = new boolean[size][size];
            for (int r = 0; r < size; r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < size; c++) {
                    boolean v = dark[r][c];
                    if (!fn[r][c] && maskBit(mask, r, c)) v = !v;
                    m[r][c] = v;
                }
            }
            drawFormatBits(m, size, mask);
            if (version >= 7) drawVersionBits(m, size, version);
            int pen = penalty(m, size);
            if (pen < bestPenalty) {
                bestPenalty = pen;
                best = m;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private static void setFn(boolean[][] dark, boolean[][] fn,
                              int r, int c, boolean v) {
        dark[r][c] = v;
        fn[r][c] = true;
    }

    private static void drawFinder(boolean[][] dark, boolean[][] fn,
                                   int cx, int cy) {
        for (int dr = -4; dr <= 4; dr++) {
            for (int dc = -4; dc <= 4; dc++) {
                int r = cy + dr, c = cx + dc;
                if (r < 0 || r >= dark.length || c < 0 || c >= dark.length) continue;
                int dist = Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc));
                setFn(dark, fn, r, c, dist != 2 && dist != 4);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void drawAlignment(boolean[][] dark, boolean[][] fn,
                                      int cr, int cc) {
        for (int dr = -2; dr <= 2; dr++) {
            for (int dc = -2; dc <= 2; dc++) {
                setFn(dark, fn, cr + dr, cc + dc,
                        Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc)) != 1);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void drawFormatPlaceholders(boolean[][] dark,
                                               boolean[][] fn, int size) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
            if (i != 6) { fn[8][i] = true; fn[i][8] = true; }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            fn[8][size - 1 - i] = true;
            fn[size - 1 - i][8] = true;
        }
    }

    private static void drawVersionPlaceholders(boolean[][] dark,
                                                boolean[][] fn, int size) {
        for (int r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                fn[r][size - 11 + c] = true;
                fn[size - 11 + c][r] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean maskBit(int mask, int r, int c) {
        switch (mask) {
            case 0: return (r + c) % 2 == 0;
            case 1: return r % 2 == 0;
            case 2: return c % 3 == 0;
            case 3: return (r + c) % 3 == 0;
            case 4: return (r / 2 + c / 3) % 2 == 0;
            case 5: return (r * c) % 2 + (r * c) % 3 == 0;
            case 6: return ((r * c) % 2 + (r * c) % 3) % 2 == 0;
            case 7: return ((r + c) % 2 + (r * c) % 3) % 2 == 0;
            default: return false;
        }
    }

    /** Format information for EC level M (indicator bits 00). */
    private static void drawFormatBits(boolean[][] m, int size, int mask) {
        int data = mask; // ecBits(M)=0b00 -> data = 0b00 << 3 | mask
        int rem = data;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            rem = (rem << 1) ^ (((rem >>> 9) & 1) != 0 ? 0x537 : 0);
        }
        int bits = ((data << 10) | rem) ^ 0x5412;
        // first copy (around the top-left finder): bits 0..8 run
        // up column 8 (rows 0..5, 7, 8), bits 9..14 run left
        // along row 8 (cols 5..0)
        for (int i = 0; i <= 5; i++) m[i][8] = bit(bits, i);
        m[7][8] = bit(bits, 6);
        m[8][8] = bit(bits, 7);
        m[8][7] = bit(bits, 8);
        for (int i = 9; i < 15; i++) m[8][14 - i] = bit(bits, i);
        // second copy (split along the other finders)
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) m[8][size - 1 - i] = bit(bits, i);
        for (int i = 8; i < 15; i++) m[size - 15 + i][8] = bit(bits, i);
        m[size - 8][8] = true; // the dark module
    }

    private static boolean bit(int v, int i) { return ((v >>> i) & 1) != 0; }

    private static void drawVersionBits(boolean[][] m, int size, int version) {
        int rem = version;
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            rem = (rem << 1) ^ (((rem >>> 11) & 1) != 0 ? 0x1F25 : 0);
        }
        int bits = (version << 12) | rem;
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            boolean b = bit(bits, i);
            m[i / 3][size - 11 + i % 3] = b;
            m[size - 11 + i % 3][i / 3] = b;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ penalties

    private static int penalty(boolean[][] m, int size) {
        int pen = 0;
        // N1: long runs in rows and columns
        for (int r = 0; r < size; r++) {
            pen += runPenalty(m[r][0], m, size, true, r);
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < size; c++) {
            pen += runPenalty(m[0][c], m, size, false, c);
        }
        // N2: same-color 2x2 blocks
        for (int r = 0; r < size - 1; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < size - 1; c++) {
                if (m[r][c] == m[r][c + 1] && m[r][c] == m[r + 1][c]
                        && m[r][c] == m[r + 1][c + 1]) pen += 3;
            }
        }
        // N3: finder-like patterns with a four-module light guard
        for (int r = 0; r < size; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c + 11 <= size; c++) {
                if (patternAt(m, r, c, true)) pen += 40;
            }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < size; c++) {
            for (int r = 0; r + 11 <= size; r++) {
                if (patternAt(m, r, c, false)) pen += 40;
            }
        }
        // N4: overall dark ratio
        int darkCount = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < size; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < size; c++) if (m[r][c]) darkCount++;
        }
        double pct = darkCount * 100.0 / (size * size);
        int lo = (int) Math.floor(pct / 5) * 5;
        int hi = lo + 5;
        pen += Math.min(Math.abs(lo - 50), Math.abs(hi - 50)) / 5 * 10;
        return pen;
    }

    private static int runPenalty(boolean first, boolean[][] m, int size,
                                  boolean rowWise, int fixed) {
        int pen = 0;
        boolean cur = first;
        int run = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
            boolean v = rowWise ? m[fixed][i] : m[i][fixed];
            if (v == cur) {
                run++;
            } else {
                if (run >= 5) pen += 3 + (run - 5);
                cur = v;
                run = 1;
            }
        }
        if (run >= 5) pen += 3 + (run - 5);
        return pen;
    }

    private static boolean patternAt(boolean[][] m, int r, int c,
                                     boolean rowWise) {
        // 1011101 preceded or followed by four light modules
        int[] pat = {1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1};
        boolean core = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            boolean v = rowWise ? m[r][c + i] : m[r + i][c];
            if (v != (pat[i] == 1)) { core = false; break; }
        }
        if (!core) return false;
        boolean guardBefore = true, guardAfter = true;
        boolean hasBefore = false, hasAfter = false;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
            int before = (rowWise ? c : r) - i;
            if (before < 0) break;
            hasBefore = true;
            boolean v = rowWise ? m[r][before] : m[before][c];
            if (v) guardBefore = false;
        }
        int size = m.length;
        for (int i = 7; i < 11; i++) {
            int after = (rowWise ? c : r) + i;
            if (after >= size) break;
            hasAfter = true;
            boolean v = rowWise ? m[r][after] : m[after][c];
            if (v) guardAfter = false;
        }
        return (hasBefore && guardBefore) || (hasAfter && guardAfter);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/QuickPhrases.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Speak For Me's quick phrases (v0.15.0) — the handful of things a
 * person who cannot speak needs to say OFTEN ("Yes", "I need
 * help", "Thank you"), kept as a plain file on the memory hook
 * (speak_phrases.tsv) — file in, file out, like everything Sandy
 * keeps. One phrase per line; backslash escapes keep a phrase that
 * contains a tab or a newline intact across the round-trip.
 *
 * Pure: the door reads the file, parses here, writes the
 * serialization back. The harness pins the round-trip.
 */
public final class QuickPhrases {

    public static final int MAX = 24;

    private QuickPhrases() {}

    public static String escape(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\t", "\\t")
                .replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "\\n");
    }

    public static String unescape(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.length()) {
                char n = s.charAt(++i);
                if (n == 't') out.append('\t');
                else if (n == 'n') out.append('\n');
                else out.append(n);
            } else {
                out.append(c);
            }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    /** Parse the file body into phrases (blanks and # lines skipped). */
    public static List<String> parse(String fileText) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (fileText == null) return out;
        for (String line : fileText.split("\n")) {
            String t = line.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty() || t.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String p = unescape(t);
            if (!p.isEmpty() && !out.contains(p)) out.add(p);
            if (out.size() >= MAX) break;
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Serialize phrases back to the file body. */
    public static String serialize(List<String> phrases) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy — Speak For Me quick phrases (one per line)\n");
        if (phrases != null) {
            int n = 0;
            for (String p : phrases) {
                if (p == null || p.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
                sb.append(escape(p.trim())).append('\n');
                if (++n >= MAX) break;
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** Add a phrase (deduped, capped); returns the new list. */
    public static List<String> add(List<String> phrases, String phrase) {
        List<String> out = phrases == null
                ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(phrases);
        String p = phrase == null ? "" : phrase.trim();
        if (p.isEmpty() || out.contains(p)) return out;
        out.add(p);
        while (out.size() > MAX) out.remove(0);
        return out;
    }

    /** Remove a phrase; returns the new list. */
    public static List<String> remove(List<String> phrases, String phrase) {
        List<String> out = phrases == null
                ? new ArrayList<>() : new ArrayList<>(phrases);
        out.remove(phrase);
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ReaderActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.speech.tts.Voice;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * The reading screen (v0.8.0) — built for the recliner: one huge
 * play/pause, back/forward a part, speed, a voice pick in plain
 * words, and her place stated in words ("Pick up where you left
 * off — Chapter 3, part 12"). Zero configuration: opening a book
 * from the shelf starts it at her place; this screen is the remote
 * for the ReaderService voice, which keeps reading with the
 * screen off.
 *
 * Translated reading appears only when it's real: the book is
 * Japanese (kana-detected) AND the ja-en engine pack is installed.
 * Otherwise the original is read as written, and if she asks why
 * there's no English door, the state line says why in one line.
 */
public final class ReaderActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_BOOK = "book";
    public static final String X_AUTOSTART = "autostart";

    private String bookId = "";
    private BookStore.Book book;
    private TextView titleText, placeText, stateText, speedText;
    private Button playBtn, voiceBtn, modeBtn;
    private LinearLayout resumeBox;
    private TextView resumeText;

    private volatile String bookLang = null; // detected on a side thread
    private List<Voice> voices = new ArrayList<>();
    private TextToSpeech voiceProbe;
    private final Runnable snapshotListener = () -> runOnUiThread(this::refresh);

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        CrashGuard.install(this);
        bookId = getIntent().getStringExtra(X_BOOK);
        if (bookId == null) bookId = "";
        book = BookStore.byId(this, bookId);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setPadding(28, 28, 28, 28);

        titleText = new TextView(this);
        titleText.setTextSize(26);
        root.addView(titleText);

        placeText = new TextView(this);
        placeText.setTextSize(19);
        placeText.setPadding(0, 8, 0, 0);
        root.addView(placeText);

        stateText = new TextView(this);
        stateText.setTextSize(17);
        stateText.setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8);
        root.addView(stateText);

        // ---- resume offer, in words
        resumeBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        resumeBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        resumeText = new TextView(this);
        resumeText.setTextSize(20);
        resumeBox.addView(resumeText);
        Button startOver = new Button(this);
        startOver.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_start_over"));
        startOver.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            ReaderStore.resetPlace(this, bookId);
            ReaderStore.markFinished(this, bookId, false);
            startReading(0, storedMode());
        });
        resumeBox.addView(startOver);
        root.addView(resumeBox);

        // ---- the big button
        playBtn = new Button(this);
        playBtn.setTextSize(30);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams big = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1);
        playBtn.setLayoutParams(big);
        playBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> onPlayPause());
        root.addView(playBtn);

        // ---- back / forward a part
        LinearLayout stepRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        stepRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button back = new Button(this);
        back.setText("⏮  " + LangStore.tr(this, "reader_back"));
        back.setTextSize(19);
        back.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1));
        back.setOnClickListener(v ->
                ReaderService.send(this, ReaderService.cmd(this, ReaderService.A_PREV)));
        stepRow.addView(back);
        Button fwd = new Button(this);
        fwd.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_forward") + "  ⏭");
        fwd.setTextSize(19);
        fwd.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1));
        fwd.setOnClickListener(v ->
                ReaderService.send(this, ReaderService.cmd(this, ReaderService.A_NEXT)));
        stepRow.addView(fwd);
        root.addView(stepRow);

        // ---- speed
        LinearLayout speedRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        speedRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        TextView speedLabel = new TextView(this);
        speedLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_speed"));
        speedLabel.setTextSize(19);
        speedRow.addView(speedLabel);
        Button slower = new Button(this);
        slower.setText("−");
        slower.setTextSize(22);
        slower.setOnClickListener(v -> stepRate(-0.25f));
        speedRow.addView(slower);
        speedText = new TextView(this);
        speedText.setTextSize(19);
        speedText.setPadding(12, 0, 12, 0);
        speedRow.addView(speedText);
        Button faster = new Button(this);
        faster.setText("+");
        faster.setTextSize(22);
        faster.setOnClickListener(v -> stepRate(0.25f));
        speedRow.addView(faster);
        root.addView(speedRow);

        // ---- voice pick (plain labels)
        voiceBtn = new Button(this);
        voiceBtn.setTextSize(18);
        voiceBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> cycleVoice());
        root.addView(voiceBtn);

        // ---- read it on screen instead (v0.16.0, the Reader room)
        if (book != null) {
            Button screenBtn = new Button(this);
            screenBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_read_screen"));
            screenBtn.setTextSize(18);
            screenBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, ReaderRoomActivity.class);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_BID, bookId);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_KEY,
                        ReaderBook.keyFor("local", bookId));
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_TITLE, book.title);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_SOURCE, "local");
                startActivity(i);
            });
            root.addView(screenBtn);
        }

        // ---- translated reading (only when real)
        modeBtn = new Button(this);
        modeBtn.setTextSize(18);
        modeBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> toggleMode());
        root.addView(modeBtn);

        setContentView(root);

        titleText.setText(book == null ? "" : book.title);
        showRate();
        probeVoices();
        detectLang();

        if (getIntent().getBooleanExtra(X_AUTOSTART, false) && book != null) {
            ReaderStore.Bookmark bm = ReaderStore.bookmark(this, bookId);
            int from = bm.finished ? 0 : bm.chunk;
            if (bm.finished) ReaderStore.markFinished(this, bookId, false);
            startReading(from, bm.mode);
        }
        refresh();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        ReaderService.addListener(snapshotListener);
        refresh();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        ReaderService.removeListener(snapshotListener);
        super.onPause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (voiceProbe != null) {
            try { voiceProbe.shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            voiceProbe = null;
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ actions

    private String storedMode() {
        return ReaderStore.bookmark(this, bookId).mode;
    }

    private void startReading(int fromChunk, String mode) {
        ReaderService.send(this, ReaderService.playIntent(this, bookId, fromChunk, mode));
    }

    private void onPlayPause() {
        ReaderService.Snapshot s = ReaderService.snapshot();
        boolean mine = bookId.equals(s.bookId);
        if (mine && s.state == ReadingSession.State.SPEAKING) {
            ReaderService.send(this, ReaderService.cmd(this, ReaderService.A_PAUSE));
        } else if (mine && (s.state == ReadingSession.State.PAUSED
                || s.state == ReadingSession.State.WAITING)) {
            ReaderService.send(this, ReaderService.cmd(this, ReaderService.A_RESUME));
        } else {
            ReaderStore.Bookmark bm = ReaderStore.bookmark(this, bookId);
            startReading(bm.finished ? 0 : bm.chunk, bm.mode);
        }
    }

    private void stepRate(float d) {
        float r = Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, ReaderStore.rate(this) + d));
        ReaderStore.setRate(this, r);
        Intent i = ReaderService.cmd(this, ReaderService.A_RATE);
        i.putExtra(ReaderService.X_RATE, r);
        ReaderService.send(this, i);
        showRate();
    }

    private void showRate() {
        float r = ReaderStore.rate(this);
        speedText.setText((r == Math.floor(r) ? String.valueOf((int) r)
                : String.valueOf(r)) + "×");
    }

    private void toggleMode() {
        String cur = storedMode();
        String next = ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(cur)
                ? ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL : ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED;
        ReaderStore.Bookmark bm = ReaderStore.bookmark(this, bookId);
        ReaderService.Snapshot s = ReaderService.snapshot();
        int at = bookId.equals(s.bookId) && s.totalChunks > 0 ? s.chunk : bm.chunk;
        // Persist the mode with her place, then (re)start there in it.
        ReaderStore.save(this, bookId, at, bm.charOffset, bm.totalChunks,
                bm.chapter, next);
        startReading(at, next);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ voices

    /** Enumerate the phone's voices with a short-lived probe TTS. */
    private void probeVoices() {
        voiceBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_voice") + ": …");
        voiceProbe = new TextToSpeech(this, status -> runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS && voiceProbe != null) {
                try {
                    List<Voice> vs = new ArrayList<>(voiceProbe.getVoices());
                    vs.sort((a, b) -> plainVoiceLabel(a).compareTo(plainVoiceLabel(b)));
                    voices = vs;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            showVoice();
        }));
    }

    /** Plain-words label: the language, and which voice when several share it. */
    static String plainVoiceLabel(Voice v) {
        Locale loc = v.getLocale();
        String base = loc == null ? "Voice"
                : loc.getDisplayName(Locale.getDefault());
        return base + " · " + v.getName();
    }

    private void showVoice() {
        String want = ReaderStore.voiceName(this);
        String label = null;
        for (Voice v : voices) {
            if (v.getName().equals(want)) { label = plainVoiceLabel(v); break; }
        }
        voiceBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_voice") + ": "
                + (label == null ? "Phone's own voice" : label));
        voiceBtn.setEnabled(!voices.isEmpty());
    }

    private void cycleVoice() {
        if (voices.isEmpty()) return;
        String want = ReaderStore.voiceName(this);
        int idx = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < voices.size(); i++) {
            if (voices.get(i).getName().equals(want)) { idx = i; break; }
        }
        Voice next = voices.get((idx + 1) % voices.size());
        ReaderStore.setVoiceName(this, next.getName());
        Intent i = ReaderService.cmd(this, ReaderService.A_VOICE);
        i.putExtra(ReaderService.X_VOICE, next.getName());
        ReaderService.send(this, i);
        showVoice();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ book facts

    /** Detect the book's language off-thread (for the translate door). */
    private void detectLang() {
        if (book == null) return;
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                byte[] bytes = BookStore.readAll(this, book);
                if (bytes == null) return;
                BookText.Result r = BookText.extract(bytes, book.title);
                if (r.ok) {
                    bookLang = BookLang.detect(r.text);
                    runOnUiThread(this::refresh);
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }).start();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ rendering

    private void refresh() {
        if (book == null) {
            titleText.setText("");
            playBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_play"));
            return;
        }
        ReaderService.Snapshot s = ReaderService.snapshot();
        boolean mine = bookId.equals(s.bookId);
        ReaderStore.Bookmark bm = ReaderStore.bookmark(this, bookId);

        if (mine && s.totalChunks > 0) {
            String place = "";
            if (!s.chapter.isEmpty()) place = s.chapter + " · ";
            place += "Part " + (s.chunk + 1) + " of " + s.totalChunks;
            placeText.setText(place);
            stateText.setText(s.spoken.isEmpty() ? stateWord(s.state) : s.spoken);
            resumeBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        } else {
            if (bm.chunk > 0 && !bm.finished && bm.totalChunks > 0) {
                String offer = LangStore.tr(this, "reader_pick_up");
                if (!bm.chapter.isEmpty()) offer += " — " + bm.chapter;
                offer += " · Part " + (bm.chunk + 1) + " of " + bm.totalChunks;
                resumeText.setText(offer);
                resumeBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                placeText.setText("");
            } else {
                resumeBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                placeText.setText(bm.finished
                        ? LangStore.tr(this, "reader_finished") : "");
            }
            stateText.setText(mine ? s.spoken : "");
        }

        playBtn.setText(mine && s.state == ReadingSession.State.SPEAKING
                ? "⏸  " + LangStore.tr(this, "reader_pause")
                : "▶  " + LangStore.tr(this, "reader_play"));

        // Translated door: shown only when it can be real — a
        // Japanese book; the pack decides whether it's a button or
        // an honest line (the button explains itself when tapped
        // without the pack? No — no dead doors: without the pack it
        // stays a line of text, not a button).
        if (BookLang.JA.equals(bookLang)) {
            if (BookTranslator.available(this)) {
                modeBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                boolean tran = ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(
                        mine ? s.mode : bm.mode);
                modeBtn.setText(tran
                        ? "Reading in English — tap for the original Japanese"
                        : LangStore.tr(this, "reader_read_in_english"));
                modeBtn.setEnabled(true);
            } else {
                modeBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                modeBtn.setText("Reading in English needs the translation "
                        + "engine pack (Settings adds it).");
                modeBtn.setEnabled(false);
            }
        } else {
            modeBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        showVoice();
    }

    private String stateWord(ReadingSession.State st) {
        switch (st) {
            case SPEAKING: return "Reading…";
            case PAUSED: return "Paused — your place is kept.";
            case WAITING: return "Getting the words ready…";
            case FINISHED: return LangStore.tr(this, "reader_finished");
            default: return "";
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ReaderBook.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The reading room's kept state (v0.16.0) — everything a FILE
 * on the memory hook, per the house law (file in, file out):
 *
 *   reading/<key>.pos    where the reader left this book:
 *                        char offset, mode, page leaf, stamp.
 *   reading/<key>.marks  the book's bookmarks: one per line,
 *                        char offset TAB label.
 *   reading/settings.tsv the reader's own settings: theme,
 *                        type size, page-vs-scroll mode — kept
 *                        across every book and every session.
 *
 * Keys are source-qualified (ia_<id>, gutenberg_pg1342,
 * local_<bookstore id>) so the same title from two shelves
 * never shares a place by accident.
 *
 * Pure file logic over a root directory (the app passes the
 * MemoryHook root; the harness passes a temp dir).
 */
public final class ReaderBook {

    public static final String MODE_PAGED = "paged";
    public static final String MODE_SCROLL = "scroll";
    public static final String MODE_PAGES = "pages";   // page pictures

    public static final String THEME_DAY = "day";
    public static final String THEME_NIGHT = "night";
    public static final String THEME_CONTRAST = "contrast";

    public static final int MIN_SP = 14;
    public static final int MAX_SP = 44;

    public static final class Pos {
        public int charOffset = 0;
        public String mode = MODE_PAGED;
        public int leaf = 0;          // page-image leaf, pages mode
        public long updatedMs = 0;
    }

    public static final class Mark {
        public int charOffset = 0;
        public String label = "";
    }

    public static final class Settings {
        public String theme = THEME_DAY;
        public int textSp = 21;
        public String mode = MODE_PAGED;
    }

    private ReaderBook() {}

    /** Source-qualified, filename-safe book key. */
    public static String keyFor(String source, String itemId) {
        String s = (source == null ? "" : source) + "_"
                + (itemId == null ? "" : itemId);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            b.append(Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '-' || c == '_'
                    ? c : '_');
        }
        String key = b.toString();
        if (key.length() > 80) {
            key = key.substring(0, 56) + "_"
                    + Integer.toHexString(key.hashCode());
        }
        return key;
    }

    public static File dir(File root) {
        return new File(root, "reading");
    }

    public static File posFile(File root, String key) {
        return new File(dir(root), key + ".pos");
    }

    public static File marksFile(File root, String key) {
        return new File(dir(root), key + ".marks");
    }

    public static File settingsFile(File root) {
        return new File(dir(root), "settings.tsv");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ positions

    public static String posToText(Pos p) {
        return p.charOffset + "\t" + p.mode + "\t" + p.leaf + "\t"
                + p.updatedMs + "\n";
    }

    public static Pos posFromText(String text) {
        Pos p = new Pos();
        if (text == null) return p;
        String[] f = text.trim().split("\t", -1);
        try {
            if (f.length > 0) p.charOffset = Math.max(0,
                    Integer.parseInt(f[0].trim()));
            if (f.length > 1 && !f[1].trim().isEmpty()) {
                p.mode = f[1].trim();
            }
            if (f.length > 2) p.leaf = Math.max(0,
                    Integer.parseInt(f[2].trim()));
            if (f.length > 3) p.updatedMs = Long.parseLong(f[3].trim());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return p;
    }

    public static Pos loadPos(File root, String key) {
        return posFromText(read(posFile(root, key)));
    }

    public static void savePos(File root, String key, Pos p) {
        write(posFile(root, key), posToText(p));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ bookmarks

    public static String marksToText(List<Mark> marks) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (Mark m : marks) {
            b.append(m.charOffset).append('\t')
                    .append(m.label == null ? "" : m.label.replace('\t', ' ')
                            .replace('\n', ' '))
                    .append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }

    public static List<Mark> marksFromText(String text) {
        List<Mark> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null) return out;
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String[] f = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (f.length == 0) continue;
            try {
                Mark m = new Mark();
                m.charOffset = Integer.parseInt(f[0].trim());
                m.label = f.length > 1 ? f[1] : "";
                if (m.charOffset >= 0) out.add(m);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        out.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a.charOffset, b.charOffset));
        return out;
    }

    public static List<Mark> loadMarks(File root, String key) {
        return marksFromText(read(marksFile(root, key)));
    }

    public static void saveMarks(File root, String key, List<Mark> marks) {
        write(marksFile(root, key), marksToText(marks));
    }

    /** Add-or-replace a bookmark at an offset; returns the list. */
    public static List<Mark> withMark(List<Mark> marks, int charOffset,
                                      String label) {
        List<Mark> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Mark m : marks) {
            if (m.charOffset != charOffset) out.add(m);
        }
        Mark m = new Mark();
        m.charOffset = charOffset;
        m.label = label == null ? "" : label;
        out.add(m);
        out.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a.charOffset, b.charOffset));
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ settings

    public static String settingsToText(Settings s) {
        return "theme\t" + s.theme + "\n"
                + "sp\t" + s.textSp + "\n"
                + "mode\t" + s.mode + "\n";
    }

    public static Settings settingsFromText(String text) {
        Settings s = new Settings();
        if (text == null) return s;
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String[] f = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (f.length < 2) continue;
            String k = f[0].trim(), v = f[1].trim();
            try {
                if ("theme".equals(k) && (THEME_DAY.equals(v)
                        || THEME_NIGHT.equals(v)
                        || THEME_CONTRAST.equals(v))) s.theme = v;
                else if ("sp".equals(k)) s.textSp = Math.max(MIN_SP,
                        Math.min(MAX_SP, Integer.parseInt(v)));
                else if ("mode".equals(k) && (MODE_PAGED.equals(v)
                        || MODE_SCROLL.equals(v))) s.mode = v;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return s;
    }

    public static Settings loadSettings(File root) {
        return settingsFromText(read(settingsFile(root)));
    }

    public static void saveSettings(File root, Settings s) {
        write(settingsFile(root), settingsToText(s));
    }

    /** The next theme in the reader's cycle: day → night → contrast. */
    public static String nextTheme(String theme) {
        if (THEME_DAY.equals(theme)) return THEME_NIGHT;
        if (THEME_NIGHT.equals(theme)) return THEME_CONTRAST;
        return THEME_DAY;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ pagination

    /**
     * Page starts for paged mode: fixed char windows snapped
     * back to a word boundary (a page never opens mid-word
     * when a space is near). Pure, so the harness pins it and
     * the room's page numbers are the same on every device.
     */
    public static List<Integer> pageStarts(String text, int charsPerPage) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) {
            out.add(0);
            return out;
        }
        int cpp = Math.max(120, charsPerPage);
        int at = 0;
        out.add(0);
        while (at + cpp < text.length()) {
            int end = at + cpp;
            int snap = end;
            for (int i = end; i > end - 60 && i > at; i--) {
                if (Character.isWhitespace(text.charAt(i))) {
                    snap = i + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            at = snap;
            out.add(at);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Chars per page for a type size — bigger type, fewer chars. */
    public static int charsPerPage(int textSp) {
        double scale = 21.0 / Math.max(MIN_SP, Math.min(MAX_SP, textSp));
        return Math.max(220, (int) (950 * scale * scale));
    }

    /** Index of the page containing a char offset. */
    public static int pageAtOffset(List<Integer> starts, int charOffset) {
        int page = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < starts.size(); i++) {
            if (starts.get(i) <= charOffset) page = i;
            else break;
        }
        return page;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ io

    private static String read(File f) {
        try {
            if (!f.isFile()) return "";
            return new String(Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath()),
                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static void write(File f, String text) {
        try {
            f.getParentFile().mkdirs();
            File tmp = new File(f.getParentFile(), f.getName() + ".tmp");
            Files.write(tmp.toPath(), text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (!tmp.renameTo(f)) {
                Files.write(f.toPath(), text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                tmp.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ReaderRoomActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The reading room (v0.16.0) — the book ON SCREEN inside Sandy.
 * Native, no WebView: the one BookText intake renders the book
 * as text Sandy lays out herself.
 *
 *   - Paged mode AND continuous scroll, the reader's choice;
 *     chapter navigation wherever the format carries structure.
 *   - Large-print type scaling and three contrast themes (day,
 *     night, high-contrast) — sighted-but-low-vision symmetry
 *     with read-aloud.
 *   - Position + bookmarks kept as FILES on the memory hook
 *     (ReaderBook): leave, come back, land on the same page.
 *   - Listen hands the book to the read-aloud ladder FROM the
 *     current position (the place is written through
 *     ReaderStore, the remote opens already standing there).
 *   - Page pictures: where the Archive item's own book-reader
 *     structure was verified (public scandata, counted leaves),
 *     the scanned pages themselves, turned natively.
 *   - Make a story: any open, readable book becomes a story
 *     cartridge through the Story machinery (Addendum 3), its
 *     cast resolved SERIES-FIRST where the book belongs to a
 *     series (Addendum 5).
 */
public class ReaderRoomActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_BID = "rbid";       // BookStore id
    public static final String X_KEY = "rkey";       // ReaderBook key
    public static final String X_TITLE = "rtitle";
    public static final String X_AUTHOR = "rauthor";
    public static final String X_SOURCE = "rsource"; // BookSource id
    public static final String X_ITEM = "ritem";
    public static final String X_IAID = "riaid";     // for page pictures
    public static final String X_PAGES = "rpages";   // verified leaf count
    public static final String X_SERIES = "rseries"; // metadata series name
    public static final String X_LANG = "rlang";     // iso1

    private String bookId = "", key = "", title = "", author = "";
    private String source = BookSource.IA, iaId = "", lang = "en";
