    private String metaSeries = "";
    private int pageCount = 0;

    private String text = "";
    private List<BookText.Chapter> chapters = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<Integer> pageStarts = new ArrayList<>();
    private int currentPage = 0;
    private int leaf = 0;
    private String mode;                       // paged / scroll / pages
    private ReaderBook.Settings settings;
    private List<ReaderBook.Mark> marks = new ArrayList<>();
    private volatile boolean destroyed = false;
    private volatile boolean loaded = false;

    private TextView titleView, statusView, pagedView, scrollText, pageLabel;
    private ScrollView scroller;
    private ImageView pageImage;
    private LinearLayout pageNav;
    private Button modeBtn, pagesBtn;
    private View rootView;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        CrashGuard.install(this);
        Intent in = getIntent();
        bookId = str(in.getStringExtra(X_BID));
        key = str(in.getStringExtra(X_KEY));
        title = str(in.getStringExtra(X_TITLE));
        author = str(in.getStringExtra(X_AUTHOR));
        source = str(in.getStringExtra(X_SOURCE));
        if (source.isEmpty()) source = BookSource.IA;
        iaId = str(in.getStringExtra(X_IAID));
        metaSeries = str(in.getStringExtra(X_SERIES));
        lang = str(in.getStringExtra(X_LANG));
        if (lang.isEmpty()) lang = "en";
        pageCount = in.getIntExtra(X_PAGES, 0);
        if (key.isEmpty()) key = ReaderBook.keyFor(source, bookId);

        File root = MemoryHook.root(this);
        settings = ReaderBook.loadSettings(root);
        ReaderBook.Pos pos = ReaderBook.loadPos(root, key);
        marks = ReaderBook.loadMarks(root, key);
        mode = (pos.updatedMs > 0 && pos.mode != null && !pos.mode.isEmpty())
                ? pos.mode : settings.mode;
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)
                && (iaId.isEmpty() || pageCount <= 0)) {
            mode = settings.mode;
        }
        leaf = pos.leaf;

        buildLayout();
        applyTheme();
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_loading"));
        final int startOffset = pos.charOffset;
        new Thread(() -> loadBook(startOffset), "reader-load").start();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ layout

    private void buildLayout() {
        LinearLayout rootL = new LinearLayout(this);
        rootL.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        rootL.setPadding(dp(14), dp(12), dp(14), dp(12));
        rootView = rootL;

        titleView = new TextView(this);
        titleView.setText(title);
        titleView.setTextSize(22);
        titleView.setTypeface(titleView.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        rootL.addView(titleView);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextSize(15);
        rootL.addView(statusView);

        LinearLayout row1 = buttonRow(rootL);
        row1.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_contents"),
                v -> showContents()), quarter());
        row1.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_bookmarks"),
                v -> showBookmarks()), quarter());
        row1.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_bookmark"),
                v -> toggleBookmark()), quarter());
        row1.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_listen"),
                v -> listenHandoff()), quarter());

        LinearLayout row2 = buttonRow(rootL);
        row2.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_smaller"),
                v -> bumpType(-2)), fifth());
        row2.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_bigger"),
                v -> bumpType(2)), fifth());
        row2.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_theme"),
                v -> cycleTheme()), fifth());
        modeBtn = btn("", v -> toggleMode());
        row2.addView(modeBtn, fifth());
        pagesBtn = btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_pages"),
                v -> togglePages());
        pagesBtn.setVisibility(iaId.isEmpty() || pageCount <= 0
                ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        row2.addView(pagesBtn, fifth());

        LinearLayout row3 = buttonRow(rootL);
        row3.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_make_story"),
                v -> makeStory()), third());
        row3.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_group_series"),
                v -> groupSeries()), third());
        row3.addView(btn(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_librivox"),
                v -> librivox()), third());

        FrameLayoutHolder body = new FrameLayoutHolder(this);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams bl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f);
        bl.topMargin = dp(8);
        rootL.addView(body, bl);

        scroller = new ScrollView(this);
        scrollText = new TextView(this);
        scrollText.setPadding(dp(6), dp(6), dp(6), dp(24));
        scroller.addView(scrollText);
        body.addView(scroller);

        pagedView = new TextView(this);
        pagedView.setPadding(dp(6), dp(6), dp(6), dp(6));
        pagedView.setOnClickListener(v -> turnPage(1));
        body.addView(pagedView);

        pageImage = new ImageView(this);
        pageImage.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
        pageImage.setAdjustViewBounds(true);
        body.addView(pageImage);

        pageNav = new LinearLayout(this);
        pageNav.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button prev = btn("◀", v -> nav(-1));
        Button next = btn("▶", v -> nav(1));
        pageLabel = new TextView(this);
        pageLabel.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        pageLabel.setTextSize(16);
        pageNav.addView(prev, quarter());
        pageNav.addView(pageLabel, half());
        pageNav.addView(next, quarter());
        rootL.addView(pageNav);
        setContentView(rootL);
        paintModeButton();
    }

    /** FrameLayout without the import weight at every call site. */
    private static final class FrameLayoutHolder
            extends android.widget.FrameLayout {
        FrameLayoutHolder(android.content.Context c) { super(c); }
    }

    private LinearLayout buttonRow(LinearLayout parent) {
        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
        row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(6);
        parent.addView(row, lp);
        return row;
    }

    private Button btn(String label, View.OnClickListener fn) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setTextSize(15);
        b.setOnClickListener(fn);
        return b;
    }

    private void paintModeButton() {
        if (modeBtn != null) {
            modeBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this,
                    ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)
                            ? "reader_mode_scroll" : "reader_mode_paged"));
        }
        if (pagesBtn != null) {
            pagesBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this,
                    ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)
                            ? "reader_text" : "reader_pages"));
        }
    }

    private void applyTheme() {
        int bg, fg;
        if (ReaderBook.THEME_NIGHT.equals(settings.theme)) {
            bg = Color.rgb(10, 10, 14); fg = Color.rgb(216, 210, 192);
        } else if (ReaderBook.THEME_CONTRAST.equals(settings.theme)) {
            bg = Color.BLACK; fg = Color.WHITE;
        } else {
            bg = Color.rgb(250, 247, 238); fg = Color.rgb(24, 24, 24);
        }
        rootView.setBackgroundColor(bg);
        titleView.setTextColor(fg);
        statusView.setTextColor(fg);
        pagedView.setTextColor(fg);
        scrollText.setTextColor(fg);
        pageLabel.setTextColor(fg);
        pagedView.setTextSize(settings.textSp);
        scrollText.setTextSize(settings.textSp);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ loading

    private void loadBook(final int startOffset) {
        try {
            BookStore.Book book = BookStore.byId(this, bookId);
            if (book == null) throw new Exception("no book");
            byte[] bytes = BookStore.readAll(this, book);
            BookText.Result r = BookText.extract(bytes,
                    book.uri == null || book.uri.isEmpty()
                            ? book.title : book.uri);
            if (!r.ok || r.text == null || r.text.isEmpty()) {
                final boolean scanned = BookText.SCANNED_NO_TEXT
                        .equals(r.failReason);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    if (scanned && !iaId.isEmpty() && pageCount > 0) {
                        // Pictures of pages, and the page structure
                        // was verified: the pages themselves serve.
                        mode = ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES;
                        loaded = true;
                        showMode();
                        showLeaf();
                        statusView.setText("");
                    } else {
                        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this,
                                scanned ? "reader_scanned"
                                        : "reader_no_text"));
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
            text = r.text;
            chapters = r.chapters != null ? r.chapters : new ArrayList<>();
            loaded = true;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed) return;
                statusView.setText("");
                repaginate();
                showMode();
                applyPosition(startOffset);
            });
        } catch (Exception e) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed) return;
                statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_failed"));
            });
        }
    }

    private void repaginate() {
        pageStarts = ReaderBook.pageStarts(text,
                ReaderBook.charsPerPage(settings.textSp));
        if (currentPage >= pageStarts.size()) {
            currentPage = pageStarts.size() - 1;
        }
        if (currentPage < 0) currentPage = 0;
    }

    private List<BookText.Chapter> chapters() {
        if (!chapters.isEmpty()) return chapters;
        List<BookText.Chapter> one = new ArrayList<>();
        if (!text.isEmpty()) one.add(new BookText.Chapter(title, 0));
        return one;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ display

    private void showMode() {
        boolean paged = ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode);
        boolean pages = ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode);
        pagedView.setVisibility(paged ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        scroller.setVisibility(!paged && !pages
                ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        pageImage.setVisibility(pages ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        pageNav.setVisibility(paged || pages
                ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (paged) showPage();
        if (pages) showLeaf();
        paintModeButton();
    }

    private void showPage() {
        if (pageStarts.isEmpty()) return;
        int start = pageStarts.get(currentPage);
        int end = currentPage + 1 < pageStarts.size()
                ? pageStarts.get(currentPage + 1) : text.length();
        pagedView.setText(text.substring(start, Math.min(end,
                text.length())));
        pageLabel.setText((currentPage + 1) + " / " + pageStarts.size());
    }

    private void applyPosition(int charOffset) {
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)) {
            currentPage = ReaderBook.pageAtOffset(pageStarts, charOffset);
            showPage();
        } else if (ReaderBook.MODE_SCROLL.equals(mode)) {
            scroller.postDelayed(() -> {
                if (destroyed || scrollText.getLayout() == null) return;
                int line = scrollText.getLayout().getLineForOffset(
                        Math.min(charOffset, Math.max(0,
                                scrollText.getText().length() - 1)));
                scroller.scrollTo(0,
                        scrollText.getLayout().getLineTop(line));
            }, 200);
            scrollText.setText(text);
        }
    }

    private void showLeaf() {
        if (iaId.isEmpty() || pageCount <= 0) return;
        leaf = Math.max(0, Math.min(pageCount - 1, leaf));
        pageLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_page") + " "
                + (leaf + 1) + " / " + pageCount);
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_loading"));
        final int want = leaf;
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                byte[] img = Net.getBytes(
                        BookSource.iaPageUrl(iaId, want));
                final Bitmap bmp = img == null ? null
                        : BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(img, 0, img.length);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed || want != leaf) return;
                    statusView.setText("");
                    if (bmp != null) pageImage.setImageBitmap(bmp);
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_failed"));
                });
            }
        }, "reader-page").start();
    }

    private int currentCharOffset() {
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)) return 0;
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)) {
            return pageStarts.isEmpty() ? 0 : pageStarts.get(currentPage);
        }
        if (scrollText.getLayout() != null) {
            int line = scrollText.getLayout().getLineForVertical(
                    scroller.getScrollY());
            return scrollText.getLayout().getLineStart(line);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private void savePos() {
        if (!loaded) return;
        ReaderBook.Pos p = new ReaderBook.Pos();
        p.mode = mode;
        p.leaf = leaf;
        p.charOffset = ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)
                ? 0 : currentCharOffset();
        p.updatedMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ReaderBook.savePos(MemoryHook.root(this), key, p);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ controls

    private void nav(int dir) {
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)) {
            leaf = Math.max(0, Math.min(pageCount - 1, leaf + dir));
            showLeaf();
        } else {
            turnPage(dir);
        }
        savePos();
    }

    private void turnPage(int dir) {
        currentPage = Math.max(0, Math.min(pageStarts.size() - 1,
                currentPage + dir));
        showPage();
    }

    private void bumpType(int delta) {
        settings.textSp = Math.max(ReaderBook.MIN_SP,
                Math.min(ReaderBook.MAX_SP, settings.textSp + delta));
        ReaderBook.saveSettings(MemoryHook.root(this), settings);
        applyTheme();
        int keep = currentCharOffset();
        repaginate();
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)) {
            currentPage = ReaderBook.pageAtOffset(pageStarts, keep);
            showPage();
        }
        savePos();
    }

    private void cycleTheme() {
        settings.theme = ReaderBook.nextTheme(settings.theme);
        ReaderBook.saveSettings(MemoryHook.root(this), settings);
        applyTheme();
    }

    private void toggleMode() {
        int keep = currentCharOffset();
        mode = ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)
                ? ReaderBook.MODE_SCROLL : ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED;
        settings.mode = mode;
        ReaderBook.saveSettings(MemoryHook.root(this), settings);
        showMode();
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_SCROLL.equals(mode)) {
            scrollText.setText(text);
            applyPosition(keep);
        } else {
            currentPage = ReaderBook.pageAtOffset(pageStarts, keep);
            showPage();
        }
        savePos();
    }

    private void togglePages() {
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)) {
            mode = settings.mode;
        } else {
            mode = ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES;
            showLeaf();
        }
        showMode();
        savePos();
    }

    private void jumpTo(int charOffset) {
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGES.equals(mode)) {
            mode = settings.mode;
            showMode();
        }
        if (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)) {
            currentPage = ReaderBook.pageAtOffset(pageStarts, charOffset);
            showPage();
        } else {
            applyPosition(charOffset);
        }
        savePos();
    }

    private void showContents() {
        List<BookText.Chapter> chs = chapters();
        String[] labels = new String[chs.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < chs.size(); i++) labels[i] = chs.get(i).title;
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_contents"))
                .setItems(labels, (d, w) -> jumpTo(chs.get(w).charOffset))
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    private void toggleBookmark() {
        int at = currentCharOffset();
        boolean exists = false;
        for (ReaderBook.Mark m : marks) {
            if (m.charOffset == at) { exists = true; break; }
        }
        if (exists) {
            marks.removeIf(m -> m.charOffset == at);
        } else {
            String label = LangStore.tr(this, "reader_page") + " "
                    + (ReaderBook.MODE_PAGED.equals(mode)
                            ? (currentPage + 1) : "");
            for (BookText.Chapter c : chapters()) {
                if (c.charOffset <= at) label = c.title;
            }
            marks = ReaderBook.withMark(marks, at, label.trim());
        }
        ReaderBook.saveMarks(MemoryHook.root(this), key, marks);
    }

    private void showBookmarks() {
        if (marks.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "reader_bookmarks"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        String[] labels = new String[marks.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < marks.size(); i++) {
            labels[i] = marks.get(i).label.isEmpty()
                    ? String.valueOf(marks.get(i).charOffset)
                    : marks.get(i).label;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_bookmarks"))
                .setItems(labels, (d, w) -> jumpTo(marks.get(w).charOffset))
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ listen

    /**
     * The read-aloud handoff: the place is written where the
     * reader ladder keeps it (chunk index from the CURRENT char
     * offset — BookChunker tracks offsets for exactly this), and
     * the reader remote opens already standing there.
     */
    private void listenHandoff() {
        if (!loaded || text.isEmpty()) return;
        int at = currentCharOffset();
        List<BookChunker.Chunk> chunks =
                BookChunker.chunk(text, chapters());
        if (chunks.isEmpty()) return;
        int idx = BookChunker.chunkIndexAt(chunks, at);
        ReaderStore.save(this, bookId, idx, chunks.get(idx).startChar,
                chunks.size(), BookChunker.chapterAt(chunks, idx),
                ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL);
        savePos();
        Intent i = new Intent(this, ReaderActivity.class);
        i.putExtra(ReaderActivity.X_BOOK, bookId);
        i.putExtra(ReaderActivity.X_AUTOSTART, true);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    /** A verified LibriVox recording of THIS book, where one exists. */
    private void librivox() {
        Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "books_searching"),
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        new Thread(() -> {
            String foundId = "";
            List<String[]> sections = new ArrayList<>();
            try {
                String json = Net.getString(
                        BookSource.lvSearchUrl(title));
                if (BookSource.lvMatches(json, title, author)) {
                    for (BookSource.Hit h : BookSource.parseLvSearch(json)) {
                        if (BookSource.normTitle(h.title).equals(
                                BookSource.normTitle(title))) {
                            foundId = h.itemId.substring(2);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!foundId.isEmpty()) {
                    sections = BookSource.parseLvSections(
                            Net.getString(BookSource.lvSectionsUrl(foundId)));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            final List<String[]> secs = sections;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed) return;
                if (secs.isEmpty()) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this,
                            "reader_no_librivox"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    return;
                }
                String[] labels = new String[secs.size()];
                for (int i = 0; i < secs.size(); i++) labels[i] = secs.get(i)[0];
                new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                        .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_librivox"))
                        .setItems(labels, (d, w) -> {
                            Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
                            i.putExtra("url", secs.get(w)[1]);
                            i.putExtra("name", title + " — " + secs.get(w)[0]);
                            startActivity(i);
                        })
                        .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                        .show();
            });
        }, "reader-librivox").start();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ story-fy

    /**
     * MAKE A STORY OF ANY BOOK (Addendum 3). This room only ever
     * stands on an open, readable book (BookText resolved it end
     * to end), so eligibility is already proven; a walled or
     * unresolvable book never reaches this button. The telling
     * is cast through the book's VoiceBook — resolved
     * SERIES-FIRST and enrolled back into the series book where
     * the book belongs to one (Addendums 4 + 5) — and the result
     * is a story cartridge on the memory hook, labeled with its
     * provenance, shelved with the made stories in Story Time.
     */
    private void makeStory() {
        if (!loaded || text.isEmpty()) return;
        Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "books_searching"),
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                String rowId = "made_" + key;
                StoryData.Row row = new StoryData.Row();
                row.id = rowId;
                row.title = title;
                row.author = author;
                row.lang = lang;
                row.taleGroup = "";
                row.iaId = BookSource.IA.equals(source) ? iaId : "";
                row.source = source;
                row.illustrated = pageCount > 0;
                StoryFiles.saveBook(this, row, text);
                StoryFiles.addMade(this, row);

                // The cast: book VoiceBook, series tier first.
                StoryCast.Book bookCast = StoryFiles.loadCast(this, row);
                File root = MemoryHook.root(this);
                String skey = SeriesBook.seriesKeyFor(root, key);
                if (skey.isEmpty() && !metaSeries.isEmpty()) {
                    skey = SeriesBook.group(root, key, metaSeries,
                            "metadata");
                }
                StoryCast.Book resolved = bookCast;
                StoryCast.Book seriesBook = null;
                if (!skey.isEmpty()) {
                    String sname = metaSeries;
                    for (SeriesBook.Group g : SeriesBook.loadIndex(root)) {
                        if (g.key.equals(skey)) sname = g.name;
                    }
                    seriesBook = SeriesBook.loadCast(root, skey, sname, lang);
                    resolved = SeriesBook.resolve(seriesBook, bookCast);
                }
                List<String> segments = chapterSegments();
                StoryCast.collectCast(resolved, segments);
                StoryFiles.assignCards(resolved);
                StoryFiles.saveCast(this, resolved);
                if (seriesBook != null) {
                    SeriesBook.saveCast(root,
                            SeriesBook.enrollInto(seriesBook, resolved));
                }

                // The cartridge: one panel per chapter; the card
                // is the chapter's most-heard voice, the caption
                // the chapter's own name.
                StoryData.Cartridge cart = buildCartridge(
                        rowId + "_" + Long.toString(
                                System.currentTimeMillis(), 36),
                        title, System.currentTimeMillis(), rowId,
                        title, BookSource.sourceName(source),
                        resolved, text, chapters());
                StoryFiles.saveCartridge(this, cart);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this,
                            "reader_story_made"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this,
                            "reader_story_failed"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        }, "reader-make-story").start();
    }

    /**
     * The made-story cartridge for a book (pure): one panel per
     * chapter, the panel card the chapter's most-heard voice
     * (the narrator's card when the chapter is all narration),
     * the caption the chapter's own name; provenance stamped —
     * "Made from <book> (<source>)".
     */
    public static StoryData.Cartridge buildCartridge(
            String cartId, String title, long createdMs, String bookRowId,
            String fromBook, String fromSource, StoryCast.Book cast,
            String text, List<BookText.Chapter> chs) {
        StoryData.Cartridge cart = new StoryData.Cartridge();
        cart.id = cartId;
        cart.title = title;
        cart.createdMs = createdMs;
        cart.bookId = bookRowId;
        cart.fromBook = fromBook;
        cart.fromSource = fromSource;
        if (chs != null) {
            for (int ci = 0; ci < chs.size(); ci++) {
                int from = chs.get(ci).charOffset;
                int to = ci + 1 < chs.size()
                        ? chs.get(ci + 1).charOffset : text.length();
                String slice = text.substring(
                        Math.min(from, text.length()),
                        Math.min(to, text.length()));
                String speaker = dominantSpeakerOf(cast, slice);
                StoryData.CartridgePanel p = new StoryData.CartridgePanel();
                p.panel = StoryCast.NARRATOR.equals(speaker)
                        ? StoryPanels.NARRATOR_CARD
                        : StoryPanels.cardFor(bookRowId, speaker);
                p.caption = chs.get(ci).title;
                cart.panels.add(p);
            }
        }
        if (cart.panels.isEmpty()) {
            StoryData.CartridgePanel p = new StoryData.CartridgePanel();
            p.panel = StoryPanels.NARRATOR_CARD;
            p.caption = title;
            cart.panels.add(p);
        }
        return cart;
    }

    /** Chapter-sized slices for casting (bounded when headless). */
    private List<String> chapterSegments() {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        List<BookText.Chapter> chs = chapters();
        if (chs.size() > 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < chs.size(); i++) {
                int from = chs.get(i).charOffset;
                int to = i + 1 < chs.size()
                        ? chs.get(i + 1).charOffset : text.length();
                out.add(text.substring(Math.min(from, text.length()),
                        Math.min(to, text.length())));
            }
        } else {
            for (int at = 0; at < text.length(); at += 60000) {
                out.add(text.substring(at,
                        Math.min(text.length(), at + 60000)));
            }
            if (out.isEmpty()) out.add(text);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The voice heard most in a slice (bounded sample). */
    private String dominantSpeaker(StoryCast.Book cast, String slice) {
        return dominantSpeakerOf(cast, slice);
    }

    public static String dominantSpeakerOf(StoryCast.Book cast, String slice) {
        String sample = slice.length() > 6000
                ? slice.substring(0, 6000) : slice;
        java.util.Map<String, Integer> counts = new java.util.HashMap<>();
        String best = StoryCast.NARRATOR;
        int bestN = 0;
        for (StoryCast.Segment seg : StoryCast.attribute(cast, sample)) {
            int n = counts.getOrDefault(seg.speaker, 0) + seg.text.length();
            counts.put(seg.speaker, n);
            if (n > bestN && !StoryCast.NARRATOR.equals(seg.speaker)) {
                bestN = n;
                best = seg.speaker;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    /** Group this book into a series BY HAND (Addendum 5). */
    private void groupSeries() {
        File root = MemoryHook.root(this);
        String current = "";
        String skey = SeriesBook.seriesKeyFor(root, key);
        for (SeriesBook.Group g : SeriesBook.loadIndex(root)) {
            if (g.key.equals(skey)) current = g.name;
        }
        if (current.isEmpty()) current = metaSeries;
        final EditText box = new EditText(this);
        box.setText(current);
        box.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_series_hint"));
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_series"))
                .setView(box)
                .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, (d, w) -> {
                    String name = box.getText().toString().trim();
                    if (!name.isEmpty()) {
                        SeriesBook.group(MemoryHook.root(this), key,
                                name, "hand");
                        metaSeries = name;
                        Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this,
                                "reader_series_set"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG)
                                .show();
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams quarter() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams half() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 2f);
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams third() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams fifth() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
    }

    private static String str(String s) {
        return s == null ? "" : s;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        savePos();
        super.onPause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ReaderService.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFocusRequest;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.session.MediaSession;
import android.media.session.PlaybackState;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener;
import android.speech.tts.Voice;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The reading voice (v0.8.0) — a foreground service that owns the
 * phone's TTS and reads the book chunk by chunk, screen on or off,
 * until she stops it or the book ends. This is the recliner
 * requirement made literal: a book that dies when the pocket
 * closes is broken, so the reading runs at foreground-service /
 * media-session grade — notification controls, lock-screen
 * controls, a wake lock while speaking, and the place saved on
 * every chunk she hears.
 *
 * The session's shape is the pure ReadingSession state machine;
 * this class is its Android body. Failures speak: no voice for the
 * book's language, a PDF that needs its text pulled first, a
 * translator that stumbled — each is a state line (and, where a
 * voice exists to say it, a spoken line), never a silent stop.
 */
public final class ReaderService extends Service {

    private static final String CHAN = "reader";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 42;
    private static final int LEAD = 4; // translated chunks cooked ahead

    public static final String A_PLAY = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.PLAY";
    public static final String A_PAUSE = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.PAUSE";
    public static final String A_RESUME = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.RESUME";
    public static final String A_NEXT = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.NEXT";
    public static final String A_PREV = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.PREV";
    public static final String A_STOP = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.STOP";
    public static final String A_RATE = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.RATE";
    public static final String A_VOICE = "com.talacore.talatv.reader.VOICE";
    public static final String X_BOOK = "book";
    public static final String X_FROM = "from";
    public static final String X_MODE = "mode";
    public static final String X_RATE = "rate";
    public static final String X_VOICE = "voice";

    // ------------------------------------------------ snapshot (for the screen)

    public static final class Snapshot {
        public final ReadingSession.State state;
        public final String bookId;
        public final String title;
        public final String chapter;
        public final int chunk;
        public final int totalChunks;
        public final String mode;
        /** The last plain-words state line ("" when nothing to say). */
        public final String spoken;
        public final String bookLang;

        Snapshot(ReadingSession.State s, String b, String t, String ch, int c,
                 int total, String m, String sp, String lang) {
            state = s; bookId = b; title = t; chapter = ch; chunk = c;
            totalChunks = total; mode = m; spoken = sp; bookLang = lang;
        }
    }

    private static volatile Snapshot snapshot = new Snapshot(
            ReadingSession.State.IDLE, "", "", "", 0, 0,
            ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL, "", "");
    private static final CopyOnWriteArrayList<Runnable> LISTENERS =
            new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

    public static Snapshot snapshot() { return snapshot; }

    public static void addListener(Runnable r) {
        if (r != null && !LISTENERS.contains(r)) LISTENERS.add(r);
    }

    public static void removeListener(Runnable r) { LISTENERS.remove(r); }

    private static void postSnapshot(Snapshot s) {
        snapshot = s;
        for (Runnable r : LISTENERS) {
            try { r.run(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ command helpers

    public static void send(Context ctx, Intent i) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) ctx.startForegroundService(i);
        else ctx.startService(i);
    }

    public static Intent playIntent(Context ctx, String bookId, int fromChunk,
                                    String mode) {
        return new Intent(ctx, ReaderService.class).setAction(A_PLAY)
                .putExtra(X_BOOK, bookId).putExtra(X_FROM, fromChunk)
                .putExtra(X_MODE, mode);
    }

    public static Intent cmd(Context ctx, String action) {
        return new Intent(ctx, ReaderService.class).setAction(action);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ service body

    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final ExecutorService worker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final ExecutorService mtWorker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final ReadingSession session = new ReadingSession();
    private final Map<Integer, String> translated = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private TextToSpeech tts;
    private boolean ttsReady = false;
    private MediaSession mediaSession;
    private PowerManager.WakeLock wakeLock;
    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioFocusRequest focusRequest;
    private boolean focusHeld = false;

    private BookStore.Book book;
    private List<BookChunker.Chunk> chunks;
    private int totalChars = 0;
    private String bookLang = BookLang.OTHER;
    private String mode = ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL;
    private BookTranslator translator;
    private String spokenLine = "";
    private boolean loadFailed = false;
    private String pendingSay; // a line to speak once TTS is ready, then stop

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        super.onCreate();
        NotificationManager nm = getSystemService(NotificationManager.class);
        if (nm != null && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            nm.createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel(
                    CHAN, "Book reader", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
        }
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(AUDIO_SERVICE);
        mediaSession = new MediaSession(this, "SandyReader");
        mediaSession.setCallback(new MediaSession.Callback() {
            @Override public void onPlay() { doResume(); }
            @Override public void onPause() { doPause(); }
            @Override public void onSkipToNext() { doStep(1); }
            @Override public void onSkipToPrevious() { doStep(-1); }
            @Override public void onStop() { doStop(); }
        });
        mediaSession.setActive(true);
        tts = new TextToSpeech(this, status -> main.post(() -> {
            if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {
                ttsReady = true;
                applyVoiceAndRate();
                tts.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(new UtteranceProgressListener() {
                    @Override public void onStart(String id) {
                        main.post(() -> onChunkStart(id));
                    }
                    @Override public void onDone(String id) {
                        main.post(() -> onChunkDone(id));
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String id) {
                        main.post(() -> onChunkError(id));
                    }
                });
                if (pendingSay != null) {
                    String say = pendingSay;
                    pendingSay = null;
                    speakOneOff(say);
                } else if (session.state() == ReadingSession.State.WAITING
                        && chunks != null && !loadFailed) {
                    // The book landed before the voice did: set the
                    // language now that there's a voice to set it on.
                    if (configureTtsLanguage()) speakCurrent();
                }
            } else {
                spokenLine = "The reading voice couldn't start on this phone.";
                publish();
                stopSelf();
            }
        }));
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        goForeground("Opening the book…");
        if (intent == null || intent.getAction() == null) return START_NOT_STICKY;
        String a = intent.getAction();
        switch (a) {
            case A_PLAY: {
                String bookId = intent.getStringExtra(X_BOOK);
                int from = intent.getIntExtra(X_FROM, 0);
                String m = intent.getStringExtra(X_MODE);
                startBook(bookId, from, m == null ? ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL : m);
                break;
            }
            case A_PAUSE: doPause(); break;
            case A_RESUME: doResume(); break;
            case A_NEXT: doStep(1); break;
            case A_PREV: doStep(-1); break;
            case A_STOP: doStop(); break;
            case A_RATE: {
                float r = intent.getFloatExtra(X_RATE, ReaderStore.rate(this));
                ReaderStore.setRate(this, r);
                if (ttsReady) tts.setSpeechRate(ReaderStore.rate(this));
                break;
            }
            case A_VOICE: {
                String v = intent.getStringExtra(X_VOICE);
                ReaderStore.setVoiceName(this, v == null ? "" : v);
                applyVoiceAndRate();
                break;
            }
            default: break;
        }
        return START_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return null; }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        try { if (tts != null) { tts.stop(); tts.shutdown(); } } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        try { if (translator != null) translator.close(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        releaseWake();
        abandonFocus();
        if (mediaSession != null) {
            mediaSession.setActive(false);
            mediaSession.release();
        }
        worker.shutdownNow();
        mtWorker.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ book loading

    private void startBook(String bookId, int fromChunk, String wantMode) {
        if (tts != null) tts.stop();
        session.stop();
        translated.clear();
        loadFailed = false;
        spokenLine = "";
        mode = wantMode;
        book = bookId == null ? null : BookStore.byId(this, bookId);
        if (book == null) {
            spokenLine = "That book isn't on the shelf anymore.";
            session.start(1, 0);
            session.starve();
            publish();
            sayThenStop(spokenLine);
            return;
        }
        publish();
        worker.execute(() -> {
            byte[] bytes = BookStore.readAll(this, book);
            BookText.Result res = bytes == null ? null
                    : BookText.extract(bytes, book.title);
            main.post(() -> onBookLoaded(res, fromChunk));
        });
    }

    private void onBookLoaded(BookText.Result res, int fromChunk) {
        if (res == null || !res.ok) {
            String reason = res == null ? BookText.NO_TEXT_FOUND : res.failReason;
            if (BookText.SCANNED_NO_TEXT.equals(reason)) {
                spokenLine = LangStore.tr(this, "book_scanned");
            } else if (BookText.UNSUPPORTED_KIND.equals(reason)) {
                spokenLine = LangStore.tr(this, "book_unsupported");
            } else {
                spokenLine = "That book's words couldn't be read on this phone.";
            }
            loadFailed = true;
            session.start(1, 0);
            session.starve();
            publish();
            sayThenStop(spokenLine);
            return;
        }
        chunks = BookChunker.chunk(res.text, res.chapters);
        totalChars = res.text.length();
        bookLang = BookLang.detect(res.text);
        if (chunks.isEmpty()) {
            spokenLine = "That book's words couldn't be read on this phone.";
            loadFailed = true;
            session.start(1, 0);
            session.starve();
            publish();
            sayThenStop(spokenLine);
            return;
        }
        // Translated mode is ja->en only, and only with the pack.
        if (ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(mode)) {
            if (!BookLang.JA.equals(bookLang)) {
                spokenLine = "That book isn't Japanese, so it's read as written.";
                mode = ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL;
            } else if (!BookTranslator.available(this)) {
                spokenLine = "Reading in English needs the translation engine pack.";
                mode = ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL;
            } else {
                try {
                    if (translator != null) translator.close();
                    translator = BookTranslator.open(this);
                    translator.beginBook();
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    CrashGuard.log(this, "BookTranslator.open", t);
                    spokenLine = "The translation engine wouldn't start — reading as written.";
                    mode = ReaderStore.MODE_ORIGINAL;
                    translator = null;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!ttsReady) {
            // Park in WAITING; the TTS-ready callback picks the
            // session up and speakCurrent() starts the first chunk.
            session.start(chunks.size(), fromChunk);
            session.starve();
            savePlace();
            publish();
            return;
        }
        if (!configureTtsLanguage()) return; // line set + stop inside
        session.start(chunks.size(), fromChunk);
        savePlace();
        publish();
        speakCurrent();
    }

    // ---- v0.13.0: the pack voice for read-aloud. When a Sandy
    // voice pack covers the reading language, chunks are spoken
    // by the pack (OnnxVoiceSynth -> AudioTrack) through the same
    // session machinery; the phone's voice is the fallback, and a
    // pack failure is spoken before the fallback takes over.
    private String packCodeWanted = "";
    private OnnxVoiceSynth packSynth;
    private android.media.AudioTrack packTrack;
    private volatile int packGen = 0;

    private VoiceLangs.Row readingRow() {
        String iso1;
        if (ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(mode)) iso1 = "en";
        else if (BookLang.JA.equals(bookLang)) iso1 = "ja";
        else if (BookLang.KO.equals(bookLang)) iso1 = "ko";
        else if (BookLang.ZH.equals(bookLang)) iso1 = "zh";
        else {
            String ui = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
            iso1 = ui == null || ui.isEmpty() ? "en" : ui;
        }
        return VoiceLangs.byIso1(VoiceLangs.load(this), iso1);
    }

    /** Set the TTS language for the current mode/book. False = failed (spoken). */
    private boolean configureTtsLanguage() {
        // v0.13.0: a pack that covers the reading language speaks
        // first; the TTS configuration below still runs so the
        // fallback voice is ready — but a missing TTS language no
        // longer stops a reading the pack can carry.
        VoiceLangs.Row row = readingRow();
        packCodeWanted = row != null
                && VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this).contains(row.packCode)
                ? row.packCode : "";
        Locale loc;
        if (ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(mode)) {
            loc = new Locale("en");
        } else if (BookLang.JA.equals(bookLang)) {
            loc = Locale.JAPANESE;
        } else if (BookLang.KO.equals(bookLang)) {
            loc = Locale.KOREAN;
        } else if (BookLang.ZH.equals(bookLang)) {
            loc = Locale.SIMPLIFIED_CHINESE;
        } else {
            String ui = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
            loc = ui == null || ui.isEmpty() ? Locale.getDefault()
                    : Locale.forLanguageTag(ui);
        }
        int r = tts.setLanguage(loc);
        if (r == TextToSpeech.LANG_MISSING_DATA || r == TextToSpeech.LANG_NOT_SUPPORTED) {
            if (!packCodeWanted.isEmpty()) {
                // the pack carries this language even though the
                // phone's engine can't — read on with the pack
                try { tts.setLanguage(Locale.getDefault()); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                return true;
            }
            spokenLine = "This phone has no reading voice for that language.";
            publish();
            // Say so in the default voice if we can, then stop.
            try { tts.setLanguage(Locale.getDefault()); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            sayThenStop(spokenLine);
            return false;
        }
        applyVoiceAndRate();
        return true;
    }

    private void applyVoiceAndRate() {
        if (!ttsReady || tts == null) return;
        try {
            tts.setSpeechRate(ReaderStore.rate(this));
            String want = ReaderStore.voiceName(this);
            if (want != null && !want.isEmpty()) {
                for (Voice v : tts.getVoices()) {
                    if (want.equals(v.getName())) { tts.setVoice(v); break; }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ speaking flow

    private void speakCurrent() {
        if (chunks == null || session.state() == ReadingSession.State.IDLE
                || session.state() == ReadingSession.State.STOPPED
                || session.state() == ReadingSession.State.FINISHED) return;
        int i = session.currentChunk();
        if (i >= chunks.size()) { finishBook(); return; }
        if (!ttsReady) { session.starve(); publish(); return; }
        if (ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(mode) && translator != null) {
            String t = translated.get(i);
            if (t == null) {
                session.starve();
                publish();
                translateAhead(i);
                return;
            }
            if (t.isEmpty()) {
                // a loop the guard dropped: step past it, count stays spoken
                spokenLine = droppedLine();
                session.chunkStarted(i);
                advance();
                return;
            }
            speakText(t, i);
            return;
        }
        speakText(chunks.get(i).text, i);
    }

    private void speakText(String text, int i) {
        if (!packCodeWanted.isEmpty()) { speakPackText(text, i); return; }
        speakTextTts(text, i);
    }

    private void speakTextTts(String text, int i) {
        grabWake();
        grabFocus();
        session.chunkStarted(i);
        Bundle params = new Bundle();
        params.putFloat(TextToSpeech.Engine.KEY_PARAM_VOLUME, 1.0f);
        int r = tts.speak(text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, params, "c" + i);
        if (r == TextToSpeech.ERROR) {
            spokenLine = "The reading voice stumbled — tap play to try again.";
            session.starve();
        }
        publish();
    }

    /** Speak one chunk with the voice pack: synthesize on a
     *  worker, play through an AudioTrack, and let the marker
     *  advance the session exactly as a finished utterance does.
     *  Any failure speaks the fallback line and hands the rest of
     *  the book to the phone's voice. */
    private void speakPackText(String text, int i) {
        grabWake();
        grabFocus();
        session.chunkStarted(i);
        savePlace();
        if (ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(mode)) translateAhead(i + 1);
        publish();
        final int gen = ++packGen;
        final String code = packCodeWanted;
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                if (packSynth == null) {
                    packSynth = OnnxVoiceSynth.open(
                            VoicePackStore.packDir(this, code));
                }
                float[] pcm = packSynth.synth(text,
                        1.0 / Math.max(0.25, ReaderStore.rate(this)));
                if (gen != packGen) return;
                if (pcm.length == 0) throw new Exception("the pack said nothing");
                short[] s16 = floatToShort(pcm);
                android.media.AudioTrack track = new android.media.AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setAudioFormat(new android.media.AudioFormat.Builder()
                                .setEncoding(android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                                .setSampleRate(OnnxVoiceSynth.SAMPLE_RATE)
                                .setChannelMask(android.media.AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                                .build())
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(Math.max(s16.length * 2,
                                android.media.AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                                        OnnxVoiceSynth.SAMPLE_RATE,
                                        android.media.AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
                                        android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)))
                        .setTransferMode(android.media.AudioTrack.MODE_STATIC)
                        .build();
                track.write(s16, 0, s16.length);
                if (gen != packGen) { track.release(); return; }
                stopPackTrack();
                packTrack = track;
                track.play();
                // completion by polling the play head on this
                // worker thread (no Looper assumptions): when the
                // head passes the last frame, the chunk is done —
                // the same signal a finished utterance gives
                while (gen == packGen
                        && track.getPlayState()
                                == android.media.AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                    if (track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() >= s16.length) break;
                    try { Thread.sleep(90); } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                        return;
                    }
                }
                boolean finished = gen == packGen
                        && track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() >= s16.length;
                stopPackTrack();
                if (finished) {
                    main.post(() -> {
                        if (gen == packGen) onChunkDone("c" + i);
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                if (gen != packGen) return;
                main.post(() -> packFallback(text, i));
            }
        }, "reader-pack").start();
    }

    private static short[] floatToShort(float[] in) {
        short[] out = new short[in.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < in.length; i++) {
            float v = Math.max(-1f, Math.min(1f, in[i]));
            out[i] = (short) Math.round(v * 32767f);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private void stopPackTrack() {
        if (packTrack != null) {
            try { packTrack.pause(); packTrack.flush(); packTrack.release(); }
            catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            packTrack = null;
        }
    }

    /** The pack failed mid-book: say so, then the phone's voice
     *  reads this chunk and the rest. */
    private void packFallback(String text, int i) {
        spokenLine = LangStore.tr(this, "reader_voice_pack_fail");
        packCodeWanted = "";
        if (packSynth != null) {
            try { packSynth.close(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            packSynth = null;
        }
        publish();
        speakTextTts(text, i);
    }

    private void speakOneOff(String line) {
        try {
            tts.speak(line, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, "line");
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        main.postDelayed(this::stopSelf, 3500);
    }

    private void sayThenStop(String line) {
        if (ttsReady) speakOneOff(line);
        else {
            pendingSay = line;
            main.postDelayed(() -> { if (!ttsReady) stopSelf(); }, 6000);
        }
    }

    private void onChunkStart(String id) {
        Integer i = chunkOf(id);
        if (i == null) return;
        session.chunkStarted(i);
        savePlace();
        publish();
        if (ReaderStore.MODE_TRANSLATED.equals(mode)) translateAhead(i + 1);
    }

    private void onChunkDone(String id) {
        Integer i = chunkOf(id);
        if (i == null) return;
        if (session.state() == ReadingSession.State.PAUSED
                || session.state() == ReadingSession.State.STOPPED) return;
        advance();
    }

    private void onChunkError(String id) {
        if (chunkOf(id) == null) return;
        spokenLine = "The reading voice stumbled — tap play to try again.";
        session.starve();
        releaseWake();
        publish();
    }

    private void advance() {
        int next = session.currentChunk() + 1;
        if (chunks == null || next >= chunks.size()) { finishBook(); return; }
        session.seek(next);
        speakCurrent();
    }

    private void finishBook() {
        session.finish();
        if (book != null) {
            ReaderStore.markFinished(this, book.id, true);
            savePlace();
        }
        spokenLine = LangStore.tr(this, "reader_finished");
        releaseWake();
        abandonFocus();
        publish();
        try {
            if (ttsReady) tts.speak(spokenLine, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_ADD, null, "end");
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        main.postDelayed(this::stopSelf, 2500);
    }

    private Integer chunkOf(String utteranceId) {
        if (utteranceId == null || !utteranceId.startsWith("c")) return null;
        try { return Integer.parseInt(utteranceId.substring(1)); }
        catch (NumberFormatException e) { return null; }
    }

    private String droppedLine() {
        int d = translator == null ? 0 : translator.droppedLoops();
        return d > 0 ? d + (d == 1 ? " piece" : " pieces")
                + " repeated and " + (d == 1 ? "was" : "were") + " skipped." : "";
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ translation lead

    private void translateAhead(int from) {
        if (translator == null || chunks == null) return;
        mtWorker.execute(() -> {
            for (int i = from; i < Math.min(from + LEAD, chunks.size()); i++) {
                if (translated.containsKey(i)) continue;
                try {
                    String t = translator.translateChunk(chunks.get(i).text);
                    translated.put(i, t == null ? "" : t);
                } catch (Throwable e) {
                    CrashGuard.log(this, "BookTranslator chunk " + i, e);
                    translated.put(i, "");
                    main.post(() -> {
                        spokenLine = "The translator stumbled — tap play to try again.";
                        session.starve();
                        publish();
                    });
                    return;
                }
                final int doneIdx = i;
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (session.state() == ReadingSession.State.WAITING
                            && session.currentChunk() == doneIdx) speakCurrent();
                    publish();
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ controls

    private void doPause() {
        if (tts != null) tts.stop();
        packGen++;
        stopPackTrack();
        if (session.pause()) {
            savePlace();
            releaseWake();
        }
        publish();
    }

    private void doResume() {
        if (loadFailed) { stopSelf(); return; }
        if (session.resume() || session.state() == ReadingSession.State.WAITING
                || session.isSpeaking()) {
            speakCurrent();
        }
        publish();
    }

    private void doStep(int delta) {
        if (chunks == null || !session.isActive()) return;
        if (tts != null) tts.stop();
        packGen++;
        stopPackTrack();
        int to = Math.max(0, Math.min(session.currentChunk() + delta, chunks.size() - 1));
        session.seek(to);
        savePlace();
        if (session.isSpeaking() || session.state() == ReadingSession.State.WAITING) {
            speakCurrent();
        }
        publish();
    }

    private void doStop() {
        if (tts != null) tts.stop();
        packGen++;
        stopPackTrack();
        session.stop();
        savePlace();
        releaseWake();
        abandonFocus();
        publish();
        stopSelf();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ place + system

    private void savePlace() {
        if (book == null || chunks == null) return;
        int i = session.currentChunk();
        ReaderStore.save(this, book.id, i,
                i < chunks.size() ? chunks.get(i).startChar : 0,
                chunks.size(),
                BookChunker.chapterAt(chunks, i), mode);
    }

    private void grabWake() {
        if (wakeLock != null && wakeLock.isHeld()) return;
        PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(POWER_SERVICE);
        if (pm == null) return;
        wakeLock = pm.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "sandy:reader");
        wakeLock.setReferenceCounted(false);
        try { wakeLock.acquire(6 * 60 * 60 * 1000L); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private void releaseWake() {
        try { if (wakeLock != null && wakeLock.isHeld()) wakeLock.release(); }
        catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        wakeLock = null;
    }

    private void grabFocus() {
        if (audioManager == null || focusHeld) return;
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                focusRequest = new AudioFocusRequest.Builder(AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(fc -> {
                            if (fc == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS) main.post(this::doPause);
                        })
                        .build();
                focusHeld = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusRequest)
                        == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                focusHeld = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(fc -> {
                            if (fc == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS) main.post(this::doPause);
                        }, AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private void abandonFocus() {
        if (audioManager == null || !focusHeld) return;
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && focusRequest != null) {
                audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focusRequest);
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(null);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        focusHeld = false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ notification

    private void publish() {
        ReadingSession.State st = session.state();
        String chapter = chunks == null ? ""
                : BookChunker.chapterAt(chunks, session.currentChunk());
        postSnapshot(new Snapshot(st, book == null ? "" : book.id,
                book == null ? "" : book.title, chapter,
                session.currentChunk(),
                chunks == null ? 0 : chunks.size(), mode,
                spokenLine, bookLang));
        if (st != ReadingSession.State.IDLE) goForeground(stateLine());
        updateMediaState();
    }

    private String stateLine() {
        if (!spokenLine.isEmpty()) return spokenLine;
        switch (session.state()) {
            case SPEAKING: return "Reading…";
            case PAUSED: return "Paused — your place is kept.";
            case WAITING: return "Getting the words ready…";
            case FINISHED: return LangStore.tr(this, "reader_finished");
            default: return "Stopped — your place is kept.";
        }
    }

    private void goForeground(String text) {
        Notification.Builder b = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26
                ? new Notification.Builder(this, CHAN)
                : new Notification.Builder(this);
        Intent open = new Intent(this, ReaderActivity.class)
                .putExtra(ReaderActivity.X_BOOK, book == null ? "" : book.id)
                .setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
        PendingIntent content = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 1, open,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        b.setContentTitle(book == null ? "Sandy reader" : book.title)
                .setContentText(text)
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_media_play)
                .setContentIntent(content)
                .setOngoing(session.isActive());
        if (mediaSession != null) {
            b.setStyle(new Notification.MediaStyle()
                    .setMediaSession(mediaSession.getSessionToken())
                    .setShowActionsInCompactView(0, 1));
        }
        boolean speaking = session.isSpeaking();
        b.addAction(new Notification.Action.Builder(
                        speaking ? android.R.drawable.ic_media_pause
                                : android.R.drawable.ic_media_play,
                        speaking ? "Pause" : "Play",
                        svcIntent(speaking ? A_PAUSE : A_RESUME, 2)).build());
        b.addAction(new Notification.Action.Builder(
                android.R.drawable.ic_media_next, "Next",
                svcIntent(A_NEXT, 3)).build());
        b.addAction(new Notification.Action.Builder(
                android.R.drawable.ic_menu_close_clear_cancel, "Stop",
                svcIntent(A_STOP, 4)).build());
        Notification n = b.build();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK);
        } else {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
        }
    }

    private PendingIntent svcIntent(String action, int req) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, ReaderService.class).setAction(action);
        return PendingIntent.getService(this, req, i,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
    }

    private void updateMediaState() {
        if (mediaSession == null) return;
        int st = session.isSpeaking() ? PlaybackState.STATE_PLAYING
                : session.state() == ReadingSession.State.PAUSED
                ? PlaybackState.STATE_PAUSED : PlaybackState.STATE_STOPPED;
        mediaSession.setPlaybackState(new PlaybackState.Builder()
                .setActions(PlaybackState.ACTION_PLAY | PlaybackState.ACTION_PAUSE
                        | PlaybackState.ACTION_SKIP_TO_NEXT
                        | PlaybackState.ACTION_SKIP_TO_PREVIOUS
                        | PlaybackState.ACTION_STOP)
                .setState(st, session.currentChunk(), 1.0f)
                .build());
        if (book != null) {
            mediaSession.setMetadata(new android.media.MediaMetadata.Builder()
                    .putString(android.media.MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_TITLE, book.title)
                    .putString(android.media.MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_SUBTITLE,
                            chunks == null ? "" : BookChunker.chapterAt(chunks, session.currentChunk()))
                    .build());
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ReaderStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

/**
 * Keeping her place in a book (v0.8.0) — the read-aloud twin of the
 * kept place in a channel. Per-book bookmark in SharedPreferences
 * (survives cache clears; it is settings, not cache): which chunk
 * she reached, the char offset, whether the book is finished, and
 * whether she was hearing it translated. Plus the two global
 * reading comforts: speaking rate and chosen voice.
 */
public final class ReaderStore {

    private ReaderStore() {}

    private static final String PREFS = "talatv_reader";

    public static final String MODE_ORIGINAL = "orig";
    public static final String MODE_TRANSLATED = "tran";

    public static final class Bookmark {
        public int chunk = 0;
        public int charOffset = 0;
        public int totalChunks = 0;
        public String chapter = "";
        public boolean finished = false;
        public String mode = MODE_ORIGINAL;
    }

    private static SharedPreferences prefs(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    // v0.11.0: a book's place is a kept place — it lives in the
    // filed kept places (memory hook, kind "book": position = chunk,
    // extra = the rest as JSON), beside every other kept place in
    // the house. First touch seeds the file from the legacy
    // per-book preference keys, once, behind the kind marker.
    private static void seedBooks(Context ctx) {
        if (KeptPlaces.seeded(ctx, "book")) return;
        java.util.List<MemoryFiles.KeptPlace> rows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = prefs(ctx);
            for (String key : p.getAll().keySet()) {
                if (!key.endsWith(".chunk")) continue;
                String bookId = key.substring(0, key.length() - ".chunk".length());
                Bookmark b = new Bookmark();
                b.chunk = p.getInt(key, 0);
                b.charOffset = p.getInt(bookId + ".char", 0);
                b.totalChunks = p.getInt(bookId + ".total", 0);
                b.chapter = p.getString(bookId + ".chapter", "");
                b.finished = p.getBoolean(bookId + ".finished", false);
                b.mode = p.getString(bookId + ".mode", MODE_ORIGINAL);
                rows.add(new MemoryFiles.KeptPlace("book", bookId, b.chunk,
                        System.currentTimeMillis(), extraOf(b)));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        KeptPlaces.seed(ctx, "book", rows);
    }

    private static String extraOf(Bookmark b) {
        try {
            org.json.JSONObject o = new org.json.JSONObject();
            o.put("char", b.charOffset);
            o.put("total", b.totalChunks);
            o.put("chapter", b.chapter == null ? "" : b.chapter);
            o.put("finished", b.finished);
            o.put("mode", b.mode == null ? MODE_ORIGINAL : b.mode);
            return o.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    public static Bookmark bookmark(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        seedBooks(ctx);
        Bookmark b = new Bookmark();
        b.chunk = (int) KeptPlaces.getPlacePosition(ctx, "book", bookId);
        String extra = KeptPlaces.getExtra(ctx, "book", bookId);
        if (extra != null) {
            try {
                org.json.JSONObject o = new org.json.JSONObject(extra);
                b.charOffset = o.optInt("char", 0);
                b.totalChunks = o.optInt("total", 0);
                b.chapter = o.optString("chapter", "");
                b.finished = o.optBoolean("finished", false);
                b.mode = o.optString("mode", MODE_ORIGINAL);
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        }
        return b;
    }

    public static void save(Context ctx, String bookId, int chunk, int charOffset,
                            int totalChunks, String chapter, String mode) {
        seedBooks(ctx);
        Bookmark b = bookmark(ctx, bookId);
        b.chunk = chunk;
        b.charOffset = charOffset;
        b.totalChunks = totalChunks;
        b.chapter = chapter == null ? "" : chapter;
        b.mode = mode == null ? MODE_ORIGINAL : mode;
        KeptPlaces.putPlace(ctx, "book", bookId, chunk, extraOf(b));
    }

    public static void markFinished(Context ctx, String bookId, boolean finished) {
        seedBooks(ctx);
        Bookmark b = bookmark(ctx, bookId);
        b.finished = finished;
        KeptPlaces.putPlace(ctx, "book", bookId, b.chunk, extraOf(b));
    }

    /** A finished (or started-over) book begins again at chunk 0. */
    public static void resetPlace(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        seedBooks(ctx);
        Bookmark b = bookmark(ctx, bookId);
        b.chunk = 0;
        b.charOffset = 0;
        b.finished = false;
        KeptPlaces.putPlace(ctx, "book", bookId, 0, extraOf(b));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ global comforts

    public static float rate(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getFloat("rate", 1.0f);
    }

    public static void setRate(Context ctx, float rate) {
        float r = Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, rate));
        prefs(ctx).edit().putFloat("rate", r).apply();
    }

    /** The TTS voice's own name ("" = the phone's default voice). */
    public static String voiceName(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getString("voice", "");
    }

    public static void setVoiceName(Context ctx, String name) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putString("voice", name == null ? "" : name).apply();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ReadingSession.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * The reading session as a state machine (v0.8.0) — pure Java, so
 * every transition the recliner depends on is harness-pinned.
 *
 *   IDLE     --start-->            SPEAKING
 *   SPEAKING --pause-->            PAUSED
 *   PAUSED   --resume-->           SPEAKING
 *   SPEAKING --starve-->           WAITING   (TTS/translation not ready)
 *   WAITING  --feed-->             SPEAKING
 *   WAITING  --pause-->            PAUSED    (pause while waiting is real)
 *   PAUSED   --starveStay-->       WAITING   (resume into an empty pipe)
 *   SPEAKING --finish-->           FINISHED  (last chunk done)
 *   any      --stop-->             STOPPED   (incl. the sleep stop)
 *   STOPPED/FINISHED --start-->    SPEAKING  (a new sitting)
 *
 * Illegal transitions are refused (return false), never forced —
 * the same fail-closed shape as every gate in Sandy. The session
 * tracks the current chunk and the furthest chunk heard, which is
 * what the bookmark is written from.
 */
public final class ReadingSession {

    public enum State { IDLE, SPEAKING, PAUSED, WAITING, FINISHED, STOPPED }

    private State state = State.IDLE;
    private int currentChunk = 0;
    private int furthestChunk = 0;
    private int totalChunks = 0;

    public State state() { return state; }
    public int currentChunk() { return currentChunk; }
    public int furthestChunk() { return furthestChunk; }
    public int totalChunks() { return totalChunks; }
    public boolean isSpeaking() { return state == State.SPEAKING; }
    public boolean isActive() {
        return state == State.SPEAKING || state == State.PAUSED
                || state == State.WAITING;
    }

    /** Begin (or begin again) at a chunk. Legal from IDLE/STOPPED/FINISHED. */
    public boolean start(int total, int atChunk) {
        if (state != State.IDLE && state != State.STOPPED
                && state != State.FINISHED) return false;
        if (total <= 0) return false;
        totalChunks = total;
        currentChunk = clamp(atChunk);
        furthestChunk = currentChunk;
        state = State.SPEAKING;
        return true;
    }

    /** The speaker started chunk i (utterance onStart). */
    public boolean chunkStarted(int i) {
        if (state != State.SPEAKING && state != State.WAITING) return false;
        currentChunk = clamp(i);
        if (currentChunk > furthestChunk) furthestChunk = currentChunk;
        if (state == State.WAITING) state = State.SPEAKING;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean pause() {
        if (state != State.SPEAKING && state != State.WAITING) return false;
        state = State.PAUSED;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean resume() {
        if (state != State.PAUSED) return false;
        state = State.SPEAKING;
        return true;
    }

    /** The pipe ran dry (TTS not ready / translation not cooked yet). */
    public boolean starve() {
        if (state == State.SPEAKING) { state = State.WAITING; return true; }
        if (state == State.PAUSED) return true; // stays paused; feed on resume
        return false;
    }

    /** The pipe has words again while waiting. */
    public boolean feed() {
        if (state != State.WAITING) return false;
        state = State.SPEAKING;
        return true;
    }

    /** Step to a chunk while active (or paused): position moves, state stays. */
    public boolean seek(int i) {
        if (!isActive()) return false;
        currentChunk = clamp(i);
        return true;
    }

    /** The last chunk finished speaking. */
    public boolean finish() {
        if (state != State.SPEAKING && state != State.WAITING) return false;
        state = State.FINISHED;
        return true;
    }

    /** Stop — the viewer stopped it, or sleep did. Always legal. */
    public boolean stop() {
        if (state == State.IDLE) return false;
        state = State.STOPPED;
        return true;
    }

    private int clamp(int i) {
        if (totalChunks <= 0) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(i, totalChunks - 1));
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/RecordingExport.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.media3.datasource.DataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.DataSpec;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.CacheDataSource;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Recording → one file (v0.7.0): the bridge BINDING-VERDICT §8
 * named as this build's first job.
 *
 * A recording lives in the recordings cache as spans the
 * DownloadManager wrote — for an HLS source, a media playlist
 * span plus one span per segment, each keyed by its own URI
 * (media3's default cache key is the URI; verified against the
 * staged 1.4.1 classes). The cooker needs a single openable
 * file, so this class assembles one:
 *
 *   HLS recording  -> read the playlist span, walk its segments
 *                     in playlist order, concatenate their bytes
 *                     into one MPEG-TS file. (Concatenating TS
 *                     segments is what an HLS player itself does
 *                     logically; the packets are self-syncing.)
 *   anything else  -> the recording IS one resource: copy its
