 *                     cached bytes into one file.
 *
 * Reads go through a cache-ONLY CacheDataSource — no upstream
 * factory, BLOCK_ON_CACHE set — so a hole in the recording is a
 * loud failure here, never a silent network re-fetch. Encrypted
 * playlists (EXT-X-KEY) refuse plainly: their segments are
 * ciphertext no decoder on this phone can open as-is.
 *
 * The playlist walking and the byte concatenation are pure and
 * harness-pinned; only the span reads need Android.
 */
public final class RecordingExport {

    public static final class ExportException extends Exception {
        public ExportException(String msg) { super(msg); }
    }

    private RecordingExport() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------ pure: names

    /** Stable export base name for a recording request id (a URL). */
    public static String exportBaseFor(String requestId) {
        String safe = (requestId == null ? "recording" : requestId)
                .replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_");
        if (safe.length() > 60) {
            safe = safe.substring(0, 44) + "-"
                    + Integer.toHexString(requestId.hashCode());
        }
        return safe;
    }

    /** File extension for an assembled export of the given kind. */
    public static String extensionFor(boolean hls, String sourceUri) {
        if (hls) return ".ts";
        String s = sourceUri == null ? "" : sourceUri.toLowerCase();
        int q = s.indexOf('?');
        if (q >= 0) s = s.substring(0, q);
        int slash = s.lastIndexOf('/');
        int dot = s.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > slash && dot >= 0) {
            String ext = s.substring(dot);
            if (ext.length() <= 6 && ext.matches("\\.[a-z0-9]+")) return ext;
        }
        return ".bin";
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ pure: HLS

    /** The playlist's segment (or variant) URIs, in order. */
    public static List<String> playlistEntries(String playlistText) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (playlistText == null) return out;
        for (String raw : playlistText.split("\\r?\\n")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            if (!line.isEmpty() && !line.startsWith("#")) out.add(line);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** A master playlist points at variant playlists, not media. */
    public static boolean isMasterPlaylist(String playlistText) {
        return playlistText != null && playlistText.contains("#EXT-X-STREAM-INF");
    }

    /** The encryption method of a media playlist, or null when clear. */
    public static String encryptionMethod(String playlistText) {
        if (playlistText == null) return null;
        for (String raw : playlistText.split("\\r?\\n")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            if (line.startsWith("#EXT-X-KEY:")) {
                int m = line.indexOf("METHOD=");
                if (m >= 0) {
                    String rest = line.substring(m + 7);
                    int cut = rest.indexOf(',');
                    if (cut >= 0) rest = rest.substring(0, cut);
                    String method = rest.trim();
                    return method.equalsIgnoreCase("NONE") ? null : method;
                }
                return "AES-128";
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Resolve a possibly-relative playlist entry against its base. */
    public static String resolveUri(String base, String entry) {
        if (entry == null) return null;
        if (entry.contains("://") || entry.startsWith("data:")) return entry;
        try {
            return new java.net.URI(base).resolve(entry).toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return entry;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ pure: bytes

    /** Concatenate files, in order, into out. Returns bytes written. */
    public static long concatFiles(List<File> parts, File out) throws IOException {
        long total = 0;
        byte[] buf = new byte[64 * 1024];
        try (OutputStream os = new FileOutputStream(out)) {
            for (File part : parts) {
                try (InputStream is = new FileInputStream(part)) {
                    int n;
                    while ((n = is.read(buf)) > 0) {
                        os.write(buf, 0, n);
                        total += n;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ glue: spans

    private static CacheDataSource.Factory cacheOnlyFactory(Context ctx)
            throws ExportException {
        androidx.media3.datasource.cache.SimpleCache cache = Downloads.cache(ctx);
        if (cache == null) {
            throw new ExportException("the recordings store isn't awake");
        }
        return new CacheDataSource.Factory()
                .setCache(cache)
                .setFlags(CacheDataSource.FLAG_BLOCK_ON_CACHE);
    }

    // v0.8.0 fix (found by code reading during the 0.7.0 forensics):
    // 0.7.0 created ONE CacheDataSource for the whole export and
    // closed it in a finally after EVERY span, then reused the closed
    // source for the next span — open-after-close on a stateful
    // media3 class. Each span now gets a fresh data source from the
    // factory, opened and closed inside its own read.

    private static byte[] readSpan(CacheDataSource.Factory factory, String uri)
            throws ExportException {
        DataSource ds = factory.createDataSource();
        DataSpec spec = new DataSpec.Builder().setUri(Uri.parse(uri)).build();
        try {
            long len = ds.open(spec);
            if (len < 0) len = 0;
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream(
                    (int) Math.min(Math.max(len, 8192), 64 * 1024 * 1024));
            byte[] buf = new byte[64 * 1024];
            int n;
            while ((n = ds.read(buf, 0, buf.length)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
            return bos.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ExportException("a piece of the recording is missing "
                    + "from the cache (" + shortUri(uri) + "): "
                    + (e.getMessage() == null ? e.getClass().getSimpleName()
                       : e.getMessage()));
        } finally {
            try { ds.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private static String shortUri(String uri) {
        if (uri == null) return "?";
        int slash = uri.lastIndexOf('/');
        return slash >= 0 && slash < uri.length() - 1
                ? uri.substring(slash + 1) : uri;
    }

    private static void writeSpanTo(CacheDataSource.Factory factory, String uri,
                                    OutputStream os, byte[] buf)
            throws ExportException {
        DataSource ds = factory.createDataSource();
        DataSpec spec = new DataSpec.Builder().setUri(Uri.parse(uri)).build();
        try {
            ds.open(spec);
            int n;
            while ((n = ds.read(buf, 0, buf.length)) > 0) os.write(buf, 0, n);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ExportException("a piece of the recording is missing "
                    + "from the cache (" + shortUri(uri) + "): "
                    + (e.getMessage() == null ? e.getClass().getSimpleName()
                       : e.getMessage()));
        } finally {
            try { ds.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * Assemble the recording into one file inside outDir and
     * return it. The export is cached: an up-to-date export for
     * the recording's current byte count is reused, so a cook
     * after the first pays only for the cook itself.
     */
    public static File export(Context ctx, Download d, File outDir)
            throws ExportException {
        try {
            return exportInner(ctx, d, outDir);
        } catch (ExportException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new ExportException("assembling the recording failed: "
                    + (e.getMessage() == null
                       ? e.getClass().getSimpleName() : e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    private static File exportInner(Context ctx, Download d, File outDir)
            throws ExportException, IOException {
        if (d == null) throw new ExportException("no recording");
        if (d.state == Download.STATE_DOWNLOADING
                || d.state == Download.STATE_QUEUED
                || d.state == Download.STATE_RESTARTING) {
            throw new ExportException("that recording is still being made — "
                    + "stop it first, then cook");
        }
        if (d.getBytesDownloaded() <= 0) {
            throw new ExportException("that recording caught nothing to cook");
        }
        if (!outDir.isDirectory() && !outDir.mkdirs()) {
            throw new ExportException("no room to assemble the recording");
        }
        String id = d.request.id;
        String uri = d.request.uri.toString();
        boolean looksHls = uri.toLowerCase().contains(".m3u8")
                || MimeTypesIsHls(d);
        String base = exportBaseFor(id);
        File stamp = new File(outDir, base + ".stamp");
        String wantStamp = d.getBytesDownloaded() + ":" + d.startTimeMs;
        File tsFile = new File(outDir, base + ".ts");

        CacheDataSource.Factory dsFactory = cacheOnlyFactory(ctx);
        try {
            if (looksHls) {
                if (tsFile.isFile() && tsFile.length() > 0
                        && wantStamp.equals(readStamp(stamp))) {
                    return tsFile;
                }
                byte[] plBytes = readSpan(dsFactory, uri);
                String playlist = new String(plBytes, "UTF-8");
                if (!playlist.contains("#EXTM3U")) {
                    throw new ExportException("the recording's playlist "
                            + "couldn't be read back");
                }
                String mediaPlaylistUri = uri;
                if (isMasterPlaylist(playlist)) {
                    List<String> variants = playlistEntries(playlist);
                    if (variants.isEmpty()) {
                        throw new ExportException("the recording's master "
                                + "playlist names no variants");
                    }
                    mediaPlaylistUri = resolveUri(uri, variants.get(0));
                    playlist = new String(readSpan(dsFactory, mediaPlaylistUri), "UTF-8");
                    if (isMasterPlaylist(playlist)) {
                        throw new ExportException("the recording's playlist "
                                + "nests too deep to assemble");
                    }
                }
                String method = encryptionMethod(playlist);
                if (method != null) {
                    throw new ExportException("that recording is scrambled ("
                            + method + ") — its pieces are locked, and this "
                            + "phone can't cook from them");
                }
                List<String> segments = playlistEntries(playlist);
                if (segments.isEmpty()) {
                    throw new ExportException("the recording's playlist "
                            + "names no pieces");
                }
                File tmp = new File(outDir, base + ".ts.part");
                byte[] buf = new byte[64 * 1024];
                try (OutputStream os = new FileOutputStream(tmp)) {
                    for (String seg : segments) {
                        writeSpanTo(dsFactory, resolveUri(mediaPlaylistUri, seg), os, buf);
                    }
                }
                if (tmp.length() <= 0) {
                    tmp.delete();
                    throw new ExportException("the assembled recording is empty");
                }
                if (!tmp.renameTo(tsFile)) {
                    throw new ExportException("the assembled recording "
                            + "wouldn't settle into place");
                }
                writeStamp(stamp, wantStamp);
                return tsFile;
            }
            // One-resource recording: copy its cached bytes whole.
            String ext = extensionFor(false, uri);
            File out = new File(outDir, base + ext);
            if (out.isFile() && out.length() == d.getBytesDownloaded()
                    && wantStamp.equals(readStamp(stamp))) {
                return out;
            }
            File tmp = new File(outDir, base + ext + ".part");
            try (OutputStream os = new FileOutputStream(tmp)) {
                writeSpanTo(dsFactory, uri, os, new byte[64 * 1024]);
            }
            if (tmp.length() <= 0) {
                tmp.delete();
                throw new ExportException("the assembled recording is empty");
            }
            if (!tmp.renameTo(out)) {
                throw new ExportException("the assembled recording "
                        + "wouldn't settle into place");
            }
            writeStamp(stamp, wantStamp);
            return out;
        } finally {
            // the CacheDataSource itself is closed per-read above;
            // nothing else to release (the factory's source is a
            // lightweight reader over the shared cache)
        }
    }

    private static boolean MimeTypesIsHls(Download d) {
        try {
            return d.request.mimeType != null
                    && d.request.mimeType.toLowerCase().contains("mpegurl");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static String readStamp(File f) {
        try {
            byte[] b = java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath());
            return new String(b, "UTF-8").trim();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static void writeStamp(File f, String s) {
        try {
            java.nio.file.Files.write(f.toPath(), s.getBytes("UTF-8"));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/RecordingsActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.DownloadCursor;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.DownloadManager;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The Recordings shelf (v0.5.0, item 3): everything "Record what's
 * playing" has caught, listed with its real state — still recording,
 * recorded, stopped-and-kept, or failed (with the failure said
 * plainly). Tap plays through the player (positions are kept per
 * recording, like everything else — item 8). Long-press offers
 * resume / delete for the states where those mean something.
 */
public class RecordingsActivity extends Activity {

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private ListView list;
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private final List<Download> downloads = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private Runnable refresher;
    private boolean destroyed = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        int pad = dp(12);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "rec_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(20);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView help = new TextView(this);
        help.setText("What you recorded from live TV lives here, on this "
                + "phone. Tap one to watch it. Press and hold for more "
                + "choices — a finished recording can be cooked into a "
                + "translation, or pieced together into one file.");
        help.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160, 160, 170));
        help.setTextSize(13);
        root.addView(help);

        list = new ListView(this);
        list.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2,
                android.R.id.text1, rows);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        list.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            if (pos >= 0 && pos < downloads.size()) play(downloads.get(pos));
        });
        list.setOnItemLongClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            if (pos >= 0 && pos < downloads.size()) {
                options(downloads.get(pos));
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        });

        setContentView(root);
        refresh();
        refresher = new Runnable() {
            @Override public void run() {
                if (destroyed) return;
                refresh();
                handler.postDelayed(this, 1500);
            }
        };
        handler.postDelayed(refresher, 1500);
    }

    private void refresh() {
        downloads.clear();
        rows.clear();
        DownloadManager m = Downloads.manager(this);
        if (m != null) {
            try (DownloadCursor cursor = m.getDownloadIndex().getDownloads()) {
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) downloads.add(cursor.getDownload());
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        }
        Collections.sort(downloads, (a, b) ->
                Long.compare(b.startTimeMs, a.startTimeMs));
        if (downloads.isEmpty()) {
            rows.add(LangStore.tr(this, "rec_empty"));
        } else {
            for (Download d : downloads) {
                String name = ChannelStore.getRecordName(this, d.request.id);
                if (name.isEmpty()) name = d.request.id;
                rows.add(name + "\n" + Downloads.stateLine(d));
            }
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void play(Download d) { play(d, false); }

    private void play(Download d, boolean autoTranslate) {
        if (d.getBytesDownloaded() <= 0
                && d.state != Download.STATE_COMPLETED) {
            Toast.makeText(this, d.state == Download.STATE_FAILED
                    ? "That recording failed — the source refused."
                    : "Nothing caught yet — give it a moment.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        String name = ChannelStore.getRecordName(this, d.request.id);
        if (name.isEmpty()) name = d.request.id;
        M3uParser.Channel c = new M3uParser.Channel();
        c.url = d.request.uri.toString();
        c.name = name;
        c.source = "Recordings";
        ChannelStore.playQueue = Collections.singletonList(c);
        ChannelStore.playIndex = 0;
        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("url", c.url);
        i.putExtra("name", name);
        i.putExtra("ua", "Sandy/0.14.1");
        i.putExtra("ckey", "rec:" + d.request.id);
        i.putExtra("recording", true);
        if (autoTranslate) i.putExtra("autoTranslate", true);
        startActivity(i);
    }

    private void options(Download d) {
        String name = ChannelStore.getRecordName(this, d.request.id);
        if (name.isEmpty()) name = d.request.id;
        List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Runnable> actions = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean active = Downloads.isRecording(this, d.request.id);
        if (active) {
            labels.add("Stop recording — keep what it caught");
            actions.add(() -> {
                Downloads.stopKeep(this, d.request.id);
                Toast.makeText(this, "Stopped — what's caught is kept.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                refresh();
            });
        } else if (d.state == Download.STATE_STOPPED
                || d.state == Download.STATE_FAILED) {
            labels.add("Try recording again (if the channel still offers it)");
            actions.add(() -> {
                Downloads.resume(this, d.request.id);
                refresh();
            });
        }
        if (d.getBytesDownloaded() > 0 && !active) {
            // v0.7.0: Delwin's door, on the shelf itself — the cook
            // opens in the player, where the Translate sheet lives.
            labels.add("Cook a translation…");
            actions.add(() -> play(d, true));
            // v0.13.0: the voiceover door — a recording is a held
            // video like any other; the dub kitchen takes it as a
            // recording pick (recorded TV was James's second case)
            final String rname = name;
            labels.add(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_make_voiceover"));
            actions.add(() -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, DubActivity.class);
                i.putExtra("pickUrl", d.request.id);
                i.putExtra("pickName", rname);
                i.putExtra("pickRecording", true);
                startActivity(i);
            });
            final String ename = name;
            labels.add("Piece it together into one file…");
            actions.add(() -> exportOneFile(d, ename));
        }
        final String fname = name;
        labels.add("Delete this recording");
        actions.add(() -> new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Delete this recording?")
                .setMessage(fname + "\n\nThe recording's video is deleted "
                        + "from this phone. This can't be undone.")
                .setPositiveButton("Delete", (dlg, w) -> {
                    Downloads.delete(this, d.request.id);
                    refresh();
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Keep", null)
                .show());
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(name)
                .setItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]),
                        (dlg, which) -> actions.get(which).run())
                .show();
    }

    /**
     * v0.7.0: assemble the recording's cached pieces into ONE
     * file on this phone (files/recording-export) — the same
     * file the cooker cooks from, so the viewer can see it,
     * keep it, and copy it off with the rest of Sandy's files.
     */
    private void exportOneFile(final Download d, final String name) {
        Toast.makeText(this, "Piecing “" + name + "” together…",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                java.io.File outDir = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(), "recording-export");
                java.io.File f = RecordingExport.export(this, d, outDir);
                final String msg = "One file, ready: " + f.getName()
                        + " (" + (f.length() / 1024) + " KB)\n"
                        + "In Sandy's files, under recording-export. "
                        + "The translation cooker cooks from this file.";
                handler.post(() -> Toast.makeText(this, msg,
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                final String msg = "Couldn't piece it together: "
                        + e.getMessage();
                handler.post(() -> Toast.makeText(this, msg,
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
            }
        }, "sandy-rec-export").start();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/RecordingsMeta.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Recordings metadata, filed (v0.11.0): the store behind
 * memory/recordings.tsv. What a recording IS — its title, its
 * channel, when it aired, where it came from, how it ended — lives
 * in the file; the download bytes and media3's index stay machinery.
 *
 * ChannelStore's record-meta face (putRecordMeta / getRecordName /
 * removeRecordMeta) delegates here now; the legacy record_meta
 * preferences are seeded in once, on first use, by ChannelStore.
 */
public final class RecordingsMeta {

    private RecordingsMeta() {}

    private static List<MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta> cache;

    private static synchronized List<MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta> load(Context ctx) {
        if (cache == null) {
            cache = MemoryFiles.recordingsFromText(
                    MemoryHook.read(ctx, MemoryHook.RECORDINGS));
        }
        return cache;
    }

    private static synchronized void save(Context ctx) {
        MemoryHook.write(ctx, MemoryHook.RECORDINGS,
                MemoryFiles.recordingsToText(cache));
    }

    public static synchronized void invalidate() { cache = null; }

    public static synchronized boolean fileExists(Context ctx) {
        return MemoryHook.exists(ctx, MemoryHook.RECORDINGS);
    }

    /** One-time seed from the legacy store (ChannelStore supplies rows). */
    public static synchronized void seed(Context ctx,
                                         List<MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta> rows) {
        if (fileExists(ctx)) return;
        cache = rows;
        save(ctx);
    }

    public static synchronized void upsert(Context ctx,
                                           MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta row) {
        cache = MemoryFiles.upsertRecording(load(ctx), row);
        save(ctx);
    }

    public static synchronized MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta get(Context ctx, String id) {
        return MemoryFiles.findRecording(load(ctx), id);
    }

    public static synchronized String title(Context ctx, String id) {
        MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta r = get(ctx, id);
        return r == null ? "" : r.title;
    }

    public static synchronized void remove(Context ctx, String id) {
        cache = MemoryFiles.removeRecording(load(ctx), id);
        save(ctx);
    }

    public static synchronized List<MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta> all(Context ctx) {
        return load(ctx);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SentencePiece.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * SentencePiece, the opus-mt tokenization, in pure Java (v0.6.1).
 *
 * The Helsinki opus-mt models segment with a SentencePiece UNIGRAM
 * model: the best-scoring segmentation wins (Viterbi over piece
 * log-probabilities). This class reproduces that segmentation from
 * two flat tables exported from the model's own files at pack-build
 * time (never re-derived, never hand-copied):
 *
 *   sp_pieces.tsv — one line per source piece: piece \t score
 *                   (from source.spm, the segmenter's own table)
 *   vocab.tsv     — one line per model token id: piece
 *                   (the shared vocabulary order the MT model was
 *                   trained with; id = line number)
 *
 * Encoding: whitespace becomes ▁ and a ▁ is prefixed (SentencePiece's
 * surface convention), then Viterbi picks the highest-scoring piece
 * sequence; a character no piece covers becomes <unk> with the
 * unigram unknown penalty (min piece score − 10). Decoding maps ids
 * back to pieces, joins them, and turns ▁ back into spaces; the
 * special tokens </s>, <s>, <pad> render as nothing.
 *
 * The JVM harness pins this class against the real sentencepiece
 * library's encodings of every bench unit — the port is only
 * trusted because that comparison passes.
 */
public final class SentencePiece {

    private final Map<String, Double> pieceScore = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> pieceId = new HashMap<>();
    private final List<String> idPiece = new ArrayList<>();
    private final double minScore;
    private int maxPieceLen = 0;

    public static final int UNK_ID = 1;
    public static final int EOS_ID = 0;   // </s> in the shared vocab
    public static final int PAD_ID = 60715;

    public SentencePiece(File spPiecesTsv, File vocabTsv) throws Exception {
        double min = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        for (String line : readLines(spPiecesTsv)) {
            int tab = line.lastIndexOf('\t');
            if (tab < 0) continue;
            String piece = line.substring(0, tab);
            double score = Double.parseDouble(line.substring(tab + 1));
            pieceScore.put(piece, score);
            if (score < min) min = score;
            if (piece.length() > maxPieceLen) maxPieceLen = piece.length();
        }
        minScore = min;
        int id = 0;
        for (String line : readLines(vocabTsv)) {
            idPiece.add(line);
            pieceId.put(line, id);
            id++;
        }
    }

    private static List<String> readLines(File f) throws Exception {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(
                new FileInputStream(f), "UTF-8"))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) out.add(line);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Segment + map to model ids (WITHOUT the trailing </s> — the
     *  MT engine adds it, per the recipe). */
    public int[] encode(String text) {
        String norm = "▁" + text.replace(" ", "▁");
        int n = norm.length();
        // Viterbi over characters (code points would be more exact;
        // pieces are matched on UTF-16 substrings, which is exact
        // for the BMP characters Japanese text uses)
        double[] best = new double[n + 1];
        int[] back = new int[n + 1];
        int[] backLen = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) best[i] = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        best[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (best[i] == Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) continue;
            int maxL = Math.min(maxPieceLen, n - i);
            for (int len = 1; len <= maxL; len++) {
                Double sc = pieceScore.get(norm.substring(i, i + len));
                if (sc == null) continue;
                double v = best[i] + sc;
                if (v > best[i + len]) {
                    best[i + len] = v;
                    back[i + len] = i;
                    backLen[i + len] = len;
                }
            }
            // an unknown single character always competes (the
            // unigram lattice carries it with the penalty score)
            double v = best[i] + (minScore - 10.0);
            if (v > best[i + 1]) {
                best[i + 1] = v;
                back[i + 1] = i;
                backLen[i + 1] = -1; // marks <unk>
            }
        }
        // walk back
        List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();
        int i = n;
        List<int[]> path = new ArrayList<>();
        while (i > 0) {
            int len = backLen[i];
            path.add(new int[]{back[i], len});
            i = back[i];
        }
        for (int k = path.size() - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            int start = path.get(k)[0];
            int len = path.get(k)[1];
            if (len < 0) {
                ids.add(UNK_ID);
            } else {
                String piece = norm.substring(start, start + len);
                Integer id = pieceId.get(piece);
                ids.add(id != null ? id : UNK_ID);
            }
        }
        int[] out = new int[ids.size()];
        for (int k = 0; k < out.length; k++) out[k] = ids.get(k);
        return out;
    }

    /** Model ids -> text: join pieces, ▁ back to space, specials dropped. */
    public String decode(int[] ids) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int id : ids) {
            if (id < 0 || id >= idPiece.size()) continue;
            String p = idPiece.get(id);
            if (p.equals("</s>") || p.equals("<s>") || p.equals("<pad>")) continue;
            if (p.equals("<unk>")) continue;
            sb.append(p);
        }
        return sb.toString().replace("▁", " ").trim();
    }

    public int vocabSize() { return idPiece.size(); }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SeriesBook.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.File;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The SERIES tier of the book VoiceBook (v0.16.0, Addendum 5 —
 * James: "Also to carry through the series as a whole").
 *
 * The dub's law, carried to books: a character changing voice
 * mid-series is a failed telling. So above each book's own
 * VoiceBook (StoryCast.Book, kept by StoryFiles) sits a SERIES
 * VoiceBook, resolved FIRST:
 *
 *   series → book → narrator default
 *
 * A character already cast in the series book speaks with that
 * voice in every volume; new characters found in a later
 * volume ENROLL into the series book and are inherited by the
 * volumes after. A deliberate recast is recorded at the SERIES
 * level (one decision, whole series) in the recasts ledger —
 * never a silent per-book drift.
 *
 * Series identity comes from the source metadata where it is
 * carried (the Archive's "series" field, read by BookSource),
 * or the reader groups books into a series BY HAND — both live
 * as files on the memory hook:
 *
 *   story/series/index.tsv       key TAB name TAB source
 *   story/series/membership.tsv  book key TAB series key
 *   story/series/<key>.json      the series VoiceBook (StoryCast JSON)
 *   story/series/<key>.recasts.tsv  name TAB from voice TAB to voice TAB stamp
 *
 * The merge/enroll/recast logic is pure; the IO is thin.
 */
public final class SeriesBook {

    public static final class Group {
        public String key = "";
        public String name = "";
        public String source = "";   // "metadata" or "hand"
    }

    public static final class Recast {
        public String name = "";
        public String fromVoice = "";
        public String toVoice = "";
        public long stampMs = 0;
    }

    private SeriesBook() {}

    /** Name matching key: trimmed, case-folded. */
    public static String norm(String name) {
        return name == null ? "" : name.trim().toLowerCase(
                java.util.Locale.US);
    }

    /** Stable key for a series name ("" for no series). */
    public static String keyFor(String seriesName) {
        if (seriesName == null) return "";
        String s = seriesName.trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            b.append(Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) ? c : '_');
        }
        String key = b.toString().replaceAll("_+", "_");
        while (key.startsWith("_")) key = key.substring(1);
        while (key.endsWith("_")) key = key.substring(0, key.length() - 1);
        if (key.length() > 60) {
            key = key.substring(0, 44) + "_"
                    + Integer.toHexString(key.hashCode());
        }
        return key;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ the merge

    /**
     * SERIES-FIRST resolution: the cast a telling actually
     * uses. Every series entry wins over the book's same-named
     * entry (voice, family, pitch, rate, card); book-only
     * entries ride along (they enroll into the series next).
     * The narrator is a cast member like any other: a series
     * narrator outranks a book narrator.
     */
    public static StoryCast.Book resolve(StoryCast.Book series,
                                         StoryCast.Book book) {
        StoryCast.Book out = StoryCast.newBook(
                book.bookId, book.title, book.lang);
        Map<String, StoryCast.Entry> byName = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (StoryCast.Entry e : book.cast) {
            byName.put(norm(e.name), e);
        }
        if (series != null) {
            for (StoryCast.Entry e : series.cast) {
                byName.put(norm(e.name), e);
            }
        }
        out.cast.addAll(byName.values());
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * Enrollment: everyone in the resolved cast who is not yet
     * in the series book joins it (first voice wins — a later
     * volume never overwrites an earlier casting by accident).
     * Returns the grown series book.
     */
    public static StoryCast.Book enrollInto(StoryCast.Book series,
                                            StoryCast.Book resolved) {
        StoryCast.Book out = StoryCast.newBook(
                series.bookId, series.title, series.lang);
        out.cast.addAll(series.cast);
        for (StoryCast.Entry e : resolved.cast) {
            if (out.byName(e.name) == null) out.cast.add(e);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * A deliberate recast, at the series level: replace one
     * member's voice in the series book and return the ledger
     * line that records the decision. The caller persists both.
     */
    public static Recast recast(StoryCast.Book series, String name,
                                String newVoice, long stampMs) {
        StoryCast.Entry e = series.byName(name);
        if (e == null) return null;
        Recast r = new Recast();
        r.name = e.name;
        r.fromVoice = e.ttsVoice == null ? "" : e.ttsVoice;
        r.toVoice = newVoice == null ? "" : newVoice;
        r.stampMs = stampMs;
        e.ttsVoice = r.toVoice;
        return r;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ ledgers (pure text)

    public static String indexToText(List<Group> groups) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (Group g : groups) {
            b.append(g.key).append('\t').append(clean(g.name)).append('\t')
                    .append(clean(g.source)).append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }

    public static List<Group> indexFromText(String text) {
        List<Group> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null) return out;
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String[] f = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (f.length < 2 || f[0].trim().isEmpty()) continue;
            Group g = new Group();
            g.key = f[0].trim();
            g.name = f[1];
            g.source = f.length > 2 ? f[2] : "";
            out.add(g);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String membershipToText(Map<String, String> map) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : map.entrySet()) {
            b.append(e.getKey()).append('\t').append(e.getValue())
                    .append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }

    public static Map<String, String> membershipFromText(String text) {
        Map<String, String> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (text == null) return out;
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String[] f = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (f.length < 2 || f[0].trim().isEmpty()) continue;
            out.put(f[0].trim(), f[1].trim());
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String recastsToText(List<Recast> recasts) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (Recast r : recasts) {
            b.append(clean(r.name)).append('\t').append(clean(r.fromVoice))
                    .append('\t').append(clean(r.toVoice)).append('\t')
                    .append(r.stampMs).append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }

    public static List<Recast> recastsFromText(String text) {
        List<Recast> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null) return out;
        for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
            String[] f = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (f.length < 3 || f[0].trim().isEmpty()) continue;
            Recast r = new Recast();
            r.name = f[0];
            r.fromVoice = f[1];
            r.toVoice = f[2];
            try {
                r.stampMs = f.length > 3 ? Long.parseLong(f[3].trim()) : 0;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            out.add(r);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ files (thin IO)

    public static File dir(File root) {
        return new File(new File(root, "story"), "series");
    }

    public static File castFile(File root, String seriesKey) {
        return new File(dir(root), seriesKey + ".json");
    }

    public static StoryCast.Book loadCast(File root, String seriesKey,
                                          String seriesName, String lang) {
        File f = castFile(root, seriesKey);
        if (f.isFile()) {
            try {
                StoryCast.Book b = StoryCast.fromJson(read(f));
                if (b != null && b.narrator() != null) return b;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return StoryCast.newBook("series:" + seriesKey, seriesName, lang);
    }

    public static void saveCast(File root, StoryCast.Book seriesBook) {
        String key = seriesBook.bookId.startsWith("series:")
                ? seriesBook.bookId.substring("series:".length())
                : keyFor(seriesBook.title);
        try {
            write(castFile(root, key), StoryCast.toJson(seriesBook));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public static List<Group> loadIndex(File root) {
        return indexFromText(read(new File(dir(root), "index.tsv")));
    }

    public static void saveIndex(File root, List<Group> groups) {
        write(new File(dir(root), "index.tsv"), indexToText(groups));
    }

    public static Map<String, String> loadMembership(File root) {
        return membershipFromText(
                read(new File(dir(root), "membership.tsv")));
    }

    public static void saveMembership(File root, Map<String, String> map) {
        write(new File(dir(root), "membership.tsv"), membershipToText(map));
    }

    /**
     * The series key for a book: hand/metadata membership first
     * (the membership file), "" when the book stands alone.
     */
    public static String seriesKeyFor(File root, String bookKey) {
        if (bookKey == null || bookKey.isEmpty()) return "";
        String k = loadMembership(root).get(bookKey);
        return k == null ? "" : k;
    }

    /**
     * Group a book into a series (by metadata name or by hand —
     * the caller passes which). Writes membership + index and
     * returns the series key.
     */
    public static String group(File root, String bookKey, String seriesName,
                               String source) {
        String key = keyFor(seriesName);
        if (key.isEmpty() || bookKey == null || bookKey.isEmpty()) return "";
        Map<String, String> mem = loadMembership(root);
        mem.put(bookKey, key);
        saveMembership(root, mem);
        List<Group> idx = loadIndex(root);
        boolean found = false;
        for (Group g : idx) if (g.key.equals(key)) { found = true; break; }
        if (!found) {
            Group g = new Group();
            g.key = key;
            g.name = seriesName.trim();
            g.source = source == null ? "" : source;
            idx.add(g);
            saveIndex(root, idx);
        }
        return key;
    }

    public static void appendRecast(File root, String seriesKey,
                                    Recast r) {
        File f = new File(dir(root), seriesKey + ".recasts.tsv");
        List<Recast> all = recastsFromText(read(f));
        all.add(r);
        write(f, recastsToText(all));
    }

    public static List<Recast> loadRecasts(File root, String seriesKey) {
        return recastsFromText(
                read(new File(dir(root), seriesKey + ".recasts.tsv")));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ io

    private static String clean(String s) {
        return s == null ? "" : s.replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' ');
    }

    private static String read(File f) {
        try {
            if (!f.isFile()) return "";
            return new String(Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath()),
                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static void write(File f, String text) {
        try {
            f.getParentFile().mkdirs();
            File tmp = new File(f.getParentFile(), f.getName() + ".tmp");
            Files.write(tmp.toPath(), text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (!tmp.renameTo(f)) {
                Files.write(f.toPath(), text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                tmp.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SetTimerActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.app.DatePickerDialog;
import android.app.TimePickerDialog;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TimeZone;

/**
 * Set a timer — ONE screen, the whole frame visible (v0.12.1).
 *
 * James's field report on the shipped chain (channel dialog → date
 * dialog → time dialog → duration dialog): "the timer will pick a
 * day, but it won't pick a time… needs to be a time frame, a set
 * time frame." The chain stranded the time half four modals deep —
 * behind a channel picker holding ~12,900 entries — and no screen
 * ever showed the frame as one thing. Here the channel, the DATE,
 * the START and the END stand on one screen with a live summary
 * ("Tue Oct 20 · 8:00 PM – 9:30 PM"), and one Set button commits
 * exactly what the summary says. Both doors land here: the Timers
 * screen's "Set a timer", and the guide's tap on a future
 * programme (which arrives prefilled with the programme's own
 * channel and frame, editable before commit).
 *
 * An end at or before the start is an overnight frame: TimerFrame
 * rolls the end to the next day and the summary prints both days.
 */
public class SetTimerActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_NAME = "chName";
    public static final String X_URL = "chUrl";
    public static final String X_TVG = "chTvg";
    public static final String X_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String X_START = "startMs";
    public static final String X_STOP = "stopMs";

    private M3uParser.Channel channel;
    private long startMs, stopMs;
    private EditText titleInput;
    private TextView channelView, summaryView;
    private Button dateBtn, startBtn, endBtn;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        try {
            buildUi();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashGuard.log(this, "SetTimerActivity.onCreate", e);
            Toast.makeText(this, "The timer screen couldn't open — "
                    + "the failure was filed in Settings ▸ Crash reports.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            finish();
        }
    }

    private void buildUi() {
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(14), dp(14), dp(14), dp(14));

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_set_btn"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(19);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        channelView = new TextView(this);
        channelView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 210));
        channelView.setTextSize(15);
        channelView.setPadding(0, dp(12), 0, dp(4));
        root.addView(channelView);
        Button pickBtn = new Button(this);
        pickBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_channel"));
        pickBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickChannel());
        root.addView(pickBtn);

        dateBtn = frameButton(root, LangStore.tr(this, "timer_date"),
                v -> pickDate());
        startBtn = frameButton(root, LangStore.tr(this, "timer_start"),
                v -> pickTime(true));
        endBtn = frameButton(root, LangStore.tr(this, "timer_end"),
                v -> pickTime(false));

        LinearLayout chips = new LinearLayout(this);
        chips.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        String[] labels = {"30 min", "1 h", "1½ h", "2 h", "3 h"};
        long[] mins = {30, 60, 90, 120, 180};
        for (int i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
            final long m = mins[i];
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText(labels[i]);
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                stopMs = TimerFrame.stopFromDuration(startMs, m);
                refresh();
            });
            chips.addView(b, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        }
        root.addView(chips);

        titleInput = new EditText(this);
        titleInput.setHint("Programme name (optional)");
        titleInput.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        titleInput.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
        root.addView(titleInput);

        summaryView = new TextView(this);
        summaryView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 220, 150));
        summaryView.setTextSize(15);
        summaryView.setPadding(0, dp(12), 0, dp(12));
        root.addView(summaryView);

        Button setBtn = new Button(this);
        setBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_set_btn"));
        setBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> commit());
        root.addView(setBtn);

        setContentView(root);
        initFrame();
    }

    private Button frameButton(LinearLayout root, String label,
                               android.view.View.OnClickListener onClick) {
        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
        row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        TextView lab = new TextView(this);
        lab.setText(label);
        lab.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        lab.setTextSize(14);
        row.addView(lab, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                dp(64), ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setOnClickListener(onClick);
        row.addView(b, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        root.addView(row);
        return b;
    }

    private void initFrame() {
        Bundle ex = getIntent().getExtras();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (ex != null && ex.containsKey(X_URL)) {
            channel = new M3uParser.Channel();
            channel.name = ex.getString(X_NAME, "");
            channel.url = ex.getString(X_URL, "");
            channel.tvgId = ex.getString(X_TVG, "");
            startMs = ex.getLong(X_START, now + 3600_000L);
            stopMs = ex.getLong(X_STOP, startMs + 3600_000L);
            titleInput.setText(ex.getString(X_TITLE, ""));
        } else {
            // Default: starts at the next whole hour, one hour long.
            Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();
            c.add(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 1);
            c.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
            c.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
            c.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
            startMs = c.getTimeInMillis();
            stopMs = startMs + 3600_000L;
        }
        if (stopMs <= startMs) stopMs = startMs + 3600_000L;
        refresh();
    }

    private void refresh() {
        TimeZone zone = TimeZone.getDefault();
        channelView.setText(channel == null
                ? LangStore.tr(this, "timer_channel") + ": —"
                : LangStore.tr(this, "timer_channel") + ": "
                        + channel.displayName());
        dateBtn.setText(GuideModel.formatDay(startMs, zone));
        startBtn.setText(GuideModel.formatTime(startMs, zone));
        endBtn.setText(GuideModel.formatTime(stopMs, zone)
                + (TimerFrame.spansMidnight(startMs, stopMs, zone)
                        ? " (" + GuideModel.formatDay(stopMs, zone) + ")" : ""));
        summaryView.setText("● " + TimerFrame.summary(startMs, stopMs, zone));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ picks

    private void pickChannel() {
        Set<String> favs = ChannelStore.getFavorites(this);
        List<M3uParser.Channel> all = ChannelStore.loadCache(this);
        if (all == null) all = new ArrayList<>();
        List<M3uParser.Channel> chans = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        List<M3uParser.Channel> rest = new ArrayList<>();
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : all) {
            if (c.url == null || c.url.isEmpty() || !seen.add(c.url)) continue;
            (favs.contains(c.url) ? chans : rest).add(c);
        }
        chans.addAll(rest);
        if (chans.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "No channels loaded yet — open Live TV first.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(this);
        box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        EditText search = new EditText(this);
        search.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_search_channels"));
        box.addView(search);
        ListView lv = new ListView(this);
        box.addView(lv, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(360)));
        List<M3uParser.Channel> shown = new ArrayList<>(chans);
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : shown) names.add(c.displayName());
        ArrayAdapter<String> ad = new ArrayAdapter<>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, names);
        lv.setAdapter(ad);
        AlertDialog dlg = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_channel"))
                .setView(box)
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, (d, w) -> { })
                .create();
        search.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int a, int b, int c) { }
            @Override public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) { }
            @Override public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int a, int b, int c) {
                String q = s.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
                shown.clear();
                names.clear();
                for (M3uParser.Channel ch : chans) {
                    if (q.isEmpty() || ch.displayName().toLowerCase().contains(q)
                            || (ch.name != null && ch.name.toLowerCase().contains(q))) {
                        shown.add(ch);
                        names.add(ch.displayName());
                    }
                }
                ad.notifyDataSetChanged();
            }
        });
        lv.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            channel = shown.get(pos);
            dlg.dismiss();
            refresh();
        });
        dlg.show();
    }

    private void pickDate() {
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();
        c.setTimeInMillis(startMs);
        new DatePickerDialog(this, (v, y, m, d) -> {
            Calendar day = Calendar.getInstance();
            day.set(y, m, d, 0, 0, 0);
            day.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
            Calendar s = Calendar.getInstance();
            s.setTimeInMillis(startMs);
            long dur = stopMs - startMs;
            s.set(y, m, d);
            startMs = s.getTimeInMillis();
            stopMs = startMs + dur;
            refresh();
        }, c.get(Calendar.YEAR), c.get(Calendar.MONTH),
                c.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)).show();
    }

    private void pickTime(boolean start) {
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();
        c.setTimeInMillis(start ? startMs : stopMs);
        new TimePickerDialog(this, (v, h, min) -> {
            if (start) {
                long dur = stopMs - startMs;
                Calendar s = Calendar.getInstance();
                s.setTimeInMillis(startMs);
                s.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, h);
                s.set(Calendar.MINUTE, min);
                s.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
                s.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
                startMs = s.getTimeInMillis();
                stopMs = startMs + dur;
            } else {
                Calendar day = Calendar.getInstance();
                day.setTimeInMillis(startMs);
                day.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
                day.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
                day.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
                day.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
                long[] frame = TimerFrame.compose(day.getTimeInMillis(),
                        hourOf(startMs), minuteOf(startMs), h, min,
                        TimeZone.getDefault());
                stopMs = frame[1];
            }
            refresh();
        }, c.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY), c.get(Calendar.MINUTE), false).show();
    }

    private int hourOf(long ms) {
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();
        c.setTimeInMillis(ms);
        return c.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
    }

    private int minuteOf(long ms) {
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();
        c.setTimeInMillis(ms);
        return c.get(Calendar.MINUTE);
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------- commit

    private void commit() {
        if (channel == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Pick a channel first.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        if (stopMs <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "That time is already past — pick a "
                    + "future time.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        String t = titleInput.getText().toString().trim();
        TimerUi.commit(this, TimerUi.build(channel.displayName(), channel.url,
                GuideStore.baseId(channel.tvgId), t, startMs, stopMs),
                this::finish);
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SettingsActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.RadioButton;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/**
 * Settings (v0.4.0) — deliberately short. This screen is James's side
 * of the glass (he is the operator); Mom never needs it, because a
 * fresh install already carries his defaults: link checks refresh
 * themselves, working links sort first, the live buffer holds
 * 30 minutes. Each control here explains itself in plain words,
 * including the timeshift buffer's honest nature: a rolling buffer
 * on this phone, discarded when the channel changes — not a recording.
 */
public class SettingsActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_PICK_PACK = 905;
    private static final int REQ_PICK_ENGINE = 906;
    private static final int REQ_PICK_DIAR = 907;
    private static final int REQ_PICK_VOICE = 908;

    private interface BoolChange { void onChange(boolean on); }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(14);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(22);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView sub = new TextView(this);
        sub.setText("Sandy is already set up the right way on a fresh install — "
                + "these are here for the operator, not for everyday watching.");
        sub.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160, 160, 170));
        sub.setTextSize(13);
        sub.setPadding(0, dp(4), 0, dp(8));
        root.addView(sub);

        // ---- language (v0.5.0)
        root.addView(header(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_language")));
        root.addView(body("Sandy speaks: "
                + LangStore.displayName(this, ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this))
                + ". The chosen language is also what Live TV reaches for "
                + "first. Twelve languages are built in; more arrive as "
                + "packs anyone can write (below). Note: the buttons and "
                + "labels speak the chosen language in this version; the "
                + "long explanations in Settings are still English."));
        Button langBtn = new Button(this);
        langBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_change"));
        langBtn.setContentDescription(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_language")
                + " — " + LangStore.tr(this, "settings_change"));
        langBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, LanguageActivity.class);
            i.putExtra(LanguageActivity.EXTRA_FROM_SETTINGS, true);
            startActivity(i);
            // The whole app re-renders in the new language next open;
            // this screen too, so close it rather than show stale text.
            finish();
        });
        root.addView(langBtn);
        Button packBtn = new Button(this);
        packBtn.setText("Import a language pack (.pack file)");
        packBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickPack());
        root.addView(packBtn);
        root.addView(body("A pack is one plain-text file: a header line, "
                + "the language's code and name, then one translated line "
                + "for every label Sandy has. A pack missing any line is "
                + "refused — Sandy will tell you exactly which lines — "
                + "never half-installed."));

        // ---- live buffer
        root.addView(header("Live buffer (pause & rewind)"));
        root.addView(body("While a live channel plays, Sandy keeps a rolling "
                + "buffer on this phone, so you can pause, walk away, come back "
                + "and pick up where you left off — and skip back past the "
                + "commercials. It's a buffer, not a recording — with one "
                + "family rule since 0.5.0: the LAST channel's buffer is "
                + "kept when Sandy closes, so reopening that channel can "
                + "offer your place back (older parts may have rolled off "
                + "— the channel only ever holds its own recent window). "
                + "Change the channel and the old buffer is gone. "
                + "Storage honesty: the 60-minute setting is about "
                + "1.35 GB at a typical stream rate; 30 minutes about "
                + "half that."));
        RadioGroup bufferGroup = new RadioGroup(this);
        bufferGroup.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int current = ChannelStore.getTimeshiftMinutes(this);
        for (int minutes : TimeshiftMath.MINUTE_CHOICES) {
            RadioButton rb = new RadioButton(this);
            rb.setText("Keep about " + minutes + " minutes");
            rb.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            rb.setTextSize(16);
            rb.setId(minutes);
            rb.setPadding(0, dp(6), 0, dp(6));
            if (minutes == current) rb.setChecked(true);
            bufferGroup.addView(rb);
        }
        bufferGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener((g, id) ->
                ChannelStore.setTimeshiftMinutes(this, id));
        root.addView(bufferGroup);

        root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "set_buffer_when_full") + ":"));
        RadioGroup fillGroup = new RadioGroup(this);
        fillGroup.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        boolean hold = ChannelStore.getBufferFullHold(this);
        RadioButton holdRb = new RadioButton(this);
        holdRb.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "set_buffer_hold")
                + " — capture stops and the beginning is kept (for when "
                + "you fall asleep watching: wake up and the start of the "
                + "episode is still there; anything past the window is "
                + "not recorded)");
        holdRb.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        holdRb.setTextSize(15);
        holdRb.setId(1);
        holdRb.setChecked(hold);
        holdRb.setPadding(0, dp(6), 0, dp(6));
        fillGroup.addView(holdRb);
        RadioButton rollRb = new RadioButton(this);
        rollRb.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "set_buffer_roll")
                + " — the window slides; the oldest falls off as new "
                + "video arrives");
        rollRb.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        rollRb.setTextSize(15);
        rollRb.setId(2);
        rollRb.setChecked(!hold);
        rollRb.setPadding(0, dp(6), 0, dp(6));
        fillGroup.addView(rollRb);
        fillGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener((g, id) ->
                ChannelStore.setBufferFullHold(this, id == 1));
        root.addView(fillGroup);

        // ---- link checks
        root.addView(header("Link checks"));
        root.addView(check("Check links again when Sandy opens",
                "Channels move around. With this on, any check older than "
                        + "6 hours quietly re-tests itself in the background — "
                        + "favorites first — so the list you see is the list "
                        + "as it stands now, not last week.",
                ChannelStore.getAutoFresh(this),
                on -> ChannelStore.setAutoFresh(this, on)));
        root.addView(check("Working links first",
                "Lists put channels proven to play at the top, and hide "
                        + "the ones proven dead. Turn off to see everything "
                        + "in plain order, dead links and all.",
                ChannelStore.getWorkingFirst(this),
                on -> ChannelStore.setWorkingFirst(this, on)));
        root.addView(check("Skip dead channels automatically",
                "When a channel fails in the player, move on to the next "
                        + "one instead of stopping.",
                ChannelStore.getAutoSkip(this),
                on -> ChannelStore.setAutoSkip(this, on)));

        // ---- translation (v0.6.0)
        root.addView(header(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_translation")));
        EnginePackStore.Status eps = EnginePackStore.anyInstalled(this);
        root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_engine_pack") + ": "
                + (eps.installed
                        ? eps.pair + " — " + eps.asrKind + " + " + eps.mtKind
                                + " (" + (eps.totalBytes / 1_000_000) + " MB on this phone)"
                        : "not installed")));
        root.addView(body("The translation engine — the part that hears "
                + "one language and writes another — does not ride inside "
                + "Sandy (she stays light). It comes as a pack from the "
                + "shelf (Brain ▸ Programs), one per language pair, and "
                + "installs here. Every file in a pack is checked against "
                + "the pack's own fingerprint list before anything is "
                + "kept; a pack that doesn't match is refused, with the "
                + "reason named."));
        Button engineBtn = new Button(this);
        engineBtn.setText("Install an engine pack (.pack file)");
        engineBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickEnginePack());
        root.addView(engineBtn);

        // ---- the voice pack (v0.12.0): diarization for dubbing
        DiarPackStore.Status dps = DiarPackStore.status(this);
        root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_pack") + ": "
                + (dps.installed
                        ? dps.segKind + " + " + dps.embKind
                                + " (" + (dps.totalBytes / 1_000_000) + " MB on this phone)"
                        : LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_out"))));
        root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_about")));
        Button diarBtn = new Button(this);
        diarBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_import"));
        diarBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickDiarPack());
        root.addView(diarBtn);
        Button vbBtn = new Button(this);
        vbBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_voice_book"));
        vbBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, VoiceBookActivity.class)));
        root.addView(vbBtn);
        root.addView(body("The voice book is where a show's cast lives — "
                + "which voice plays which character — so a character "
                + "sounds like themselves in every episode. Casting is "
                + "set there, by a person, once."));

        // ---- voice packs (v0.13.0): one per language, the voices
        // themselves — the diarization pack's companions. A dub or
        // a reading speaks with an installed pack first, the
        // phone's own voice second, and says so when neither can.
        java.util.Map<String, VoicePackStore.Installed> vps =
                VoicePackStore.installed(this);
        root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_voice_packs") + ": "
                + (vps.isEmpty()
                        ? LangStore.tr(this, "voice_packs_none")
                        : String.format(LangStore.tr(this, "voice_packs_some"),
                                vps.size(),
                                (VoicePackStore.totalBytes(this) / 1_000_000)
                                        + " MB"))));
        root.addView(body("A voice pack is one language's voice "
                + "(Meta's MMS-TTS, an open model trained on the "
                + "language's own writing; CC-BY-NC-4.0). One file "
                + "per language, installed as wanted — the dub and "
                + "read-aloud speak with it first. The coverage "
                + "page shows, for every one of the 84 catalogue "
                + "languages, which voice this phone has for it."));
        Button voiceBtn = new Button(this);
        voiceBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_voice_import"));
        voiceBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickVoicePack());
        root.addView(voiceBtn);
        Button covBtn = new Button(this);
        covBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "voice_coverage_title"));
        covBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, VoiceCoverageActivity.class)));
        root.addView(covBtn);

        // ---- accessibility (v0.5.0)
        root.addView(header("Accessibility"));
        root.addView(check(LangStore.tr(this, "set_rumble"),
                "A short vibration when playback starts, and a double "
                        + "pulse when a link check finishes — the go sign "
                        + "you can feel. Made for viewers who can't hear "
                        + "the TV; good for everybody. Every button and "
                        + "channel in Sandy also carries a spoken label, "
                        + "so TalkBack and refreshable Braille displays "
                        + "can read the whole app.",
                ChannelStore.getRumble(this),
                on -> ChannelStore.setRumble(this, on)));

        // ---- quality posture (v0.12.1)
        // James's shape: the viewer picks a POSTURE, not a number —
        // low-first (fastest start), balanced (the happy medium the
        // pipe sustains), ultra (highest, buffer and all). The
        // connection statement is MEASURED (PipeMeter) or honestly
        // absent — never invented. "The program can only do what
        // the program can do."
        root.addView(header(LangStore.tr(this, "set_quality")));
        root.addView(body("When you tap something to watch, Sandy "
                + "finds a working source in your language and plays "
                + "it — this is how hard she reaches for quality "
                + "while she does it. You can always open the source "
                + "list and pick by hand instead."));
        RadioGroup postureGroup = new RadioGroup(this);
        postureGroup.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        String curPosture = ChannelStore.getQualityPosture(this);
        String[][] postures = {
                {"low", "quality_low", "quality_low_desc"},
                {"balanced", "quality_balanced", "quality_balanced_desc"},
                {"ultra", "quality_ultra", "quality_ultra_desc"},
        };
        for (String[] opt : postures) {
            RadioButton rb = new RadioButton(this);
            rb.setText(LangStore.tr(this, opt[1]) + " — "
                    + LangStore.tr(this, opt[2]));
            rb.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            rb.setTextSize(15);
            rb.setTag(opt[0]);
            rb.setPadding(0, dp(6), 0, dp(6));
            rb.setChecked(opt[0].equals(curPosture));
            postureGroup.addView(rb);
        }
        postureGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener((g, id) -> {
            RadioButton rb = g.findViewById(id);
            if (rb != null && rb.getTag() != null) {
                ChannelStore.setQualityPosture(this, rb.getTag().toString());
            }
        });
        root.addView(postureGroup);
        double bps = PipeMeter.measuredBps(this);
        if (bps > 0) {
            int cap = PipeMeter.capTierFor(bps);
            root.addView(body("Your connection right now: "
                    + PipeMeter.mbpsText(bps) + " Mbps measured — "
                    + PipeMeter.tierLabel(cap) + " will play clean; "
                    + "higher will buffer. That is the connection "
                    + "talking, not a settings problem."));
        } else {
            root.addView(body("Your connection right now: not "
                    + "measured yet — play something or refresh the "
                    + "guide, and Sandy will state it from "
                    + "measurement, not a guess."));
        }

        // ---- auto-advance (v0.14.0): the lean-back choice, made
        // once here — never a countdown in the player.
        root.addView(check(
                LangStore.tr(this, "settings_auto_advance"),
                LangStore.tr(this, "settings_auto_advance_note"),
                ChannelStore.getAutoAdvanceNext(this),
                on -> ChannelStore.setAutoAdvanceNext(this, on)));

        // ---- crash reports (v0.12.1)
        // CrashGuard has filed full stacks since 0.8.0, but nothing
        // in the app could READ them — the 0.7.0 crash's root cause
        // is still unestablished for exactly that reason. Now the
        // latest crash stands in the open here, shareable, so the
        // next field crash arrives WITH its stack.
        root.addView(header(LangStore.tr(this, "crash_reports")));
        java.util.List<java.io.File> crashFiles = CrashGuard.listCrashes(this);
        if (crashFiles.isEmpty()) {
            root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "crash_none")));
        } else {
            root.addView(body(crashFiles.size()
                    + " report(s) on file. Latest:"));
            TextView crashView = new TextView(this);
            crashView.setText(CrashGuard.readLatest(this));
            crashView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 210));
            crashView.setTextSize(11);
            root.addView(crashView);
            Button shareBtn = new Button(this);
            shareBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "crash_share"));
            shareBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent send = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
                send.setType("text/plain");
                send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Sandy crash report");
                send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, CrashGuard.readLatest(this));
                startActivity(Intent.createChooser(send,
                        LangStore.tr(this, "crash_share")));
            });
            root.addView(shareBtn);
        }

        // ---- playback record (v0.14.1)
        // Every tune, failure, stall, reconnect and verdict on a
        // playing stream is written to the playback record with
        // the facts that separate the failure families (playlist
        // result, segment host + HTTP result, position, runway,
        // heads tried). It stands in the open here for the same
        // reason crash reports do: the next field failure should
        // arrive WITH its evidence.
        root.addView(header(LangStore.tr(this, "playback_record")));
        java.util.List<java.io.File> playFiles = PlaybackRecord.listFiles(this);
        if (playFiles.isEmpty()) {
            root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "playback_record_none")));
        } else {
            root.addView(body(playFiles.size()
                    + " day(s) on file. Latest:"));
            TextView playView = new TextView(this);
            playView.setText(PlaybackRecord.readLatest(this));
            playView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 210));
            playView.setTextSize(11);
            root.addView(playView);
            Button playShareBtn = new Button(this);
            playShareBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "crash_share"));
            playShareBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent send = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
                send.setType("text/plain");
                send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Sandy playback record");
                send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, PlaybackRecord.readLatest(this));
                startActivity(Intent.createChooser(send,
                        LangStore.tr(this, "crash_share")));
            });
            root.addView(playShareBtn);
        }

        root.addView(header("About"));
        root.addView(body("Sandy 0.14.1 — a television for the family. It hosts "
                + "nothing: it finds and plays the free channels and the "
                + "shelves you load into it. What it keeps is yours: your "
                + "favorites, your places, your recordings. Made by "
