                + "James, for his mother."));
        Button creditBtn = new Button(this);
        creditBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "sources_title"));
        creditBtn.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, CreditActivity.class)));
        root.addView(creditBtn);

        setContentView(scroll);
    }

    private TextView header(String text) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(text);
        t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
        t.setTextSize(16);
        t.setTypeface(t.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        t.setPadding(0, dp(18), 0, dp(4));
        return t;
    }

    private TextView body(String text) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(text);
        t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 208));
        t.setTextSize(14);
        t.setPadding(0, 0, 0, dp(6));
        return t;
    }

    /** A labelled checkbox with its plain-words explanation under it. */
    private LinearLayout check(String label, String why, boolean initial,
                               BoolChange change) {
        LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(this);
        box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        CheckBox cb = new CheckBox(this);
        cb.setText(label);
        cb.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        cb.setTextSize(16);
        cb.setPadding(0, dp(8), 0, 0);
        cb.setChecked(initial);
        cb.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, on) -> change.onChange(on));
        box.addView(cb);
        TextView hint = new TextView(this);
        hint.setText(why);
        hint.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
        hint.setTextSize(12.5f);
        hint.setPadding(dp(32), 0, 0, dp(4));
        box.addView(hint);
        return box;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- the pack slot

    private void pickPack() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("text/plain");
        try {
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_PACK);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone has no file picker.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    private void pickEnginePack() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("*/*");
        try {
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_ENGINE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone has no file picker.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    private void pickDiarPack() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("*/*");
        try {
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_DIAR);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone has no file picker.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    private void pickVoicePack() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("*/*");
        try {
            startActivityForResult(i, REQ_PICK_VOICE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone has no file picker.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
        if (requestCode == REQ_PICK_VOICE) {
            if (resultCode != RESULT_OK || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_checking"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            VoicePackStore.install(this, data.getData(), r -> {
                if (r.ok) {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_in_title"))
                            .setMessage(r.tvName + " (" + r.lang + ") — "
                                    + r.engine + ", " + r.license)
                            .setPositiveButton("OK", (d, w) -> recreate())
                            .show();
                } else {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_refused"))
                            .setMessage(String.join("\n", r.errors))
                            .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
                            .show();
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (requestCode == REQ_PICK_DIAR) {
            if (resultCode != RESULT_OK || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_checking"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            DiarPackStore.install(this, data.getData(), r -> {
                if (r.ok) {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_in_title"))
                            .setMessage(r.segKind + " + " + r.embKind)
                            .setPositiveButton("OK", (d, w) -> recreate())
                            .show();
                } else {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "settings_diar_refused"))
                            .setMessage(String.join("\n", r.errors))
                            .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
                            .show();
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (requestCode == REQ_PICK_ENGINE) {
            if (resultCode != RESULT_OK || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
            Toast.makeText(this, "Checking the engine pack…",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            EnginePackStore.install(this, data.getData(), r -> {
                if (r.ok) {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle("Engine pack installed")
                            .setMessage(r.pair + " — recognizer: " + r.asrKind
                                    + ", translator: " + r.mtKind + ".\n\n"
                                    + LangStore.tr(this, "tr_engine_unavailable"))
                            .setPositiveButton("OK", (d, w) -> recreate())
                            .show();
                } else {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle("That engine pack can't be used")
                            .setMessage(String.join("\n", r.errors))
                            .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
                            .show();
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (requestCode != REQ_PICK_PACK || resultCode != RESULT_OK || data == null) return;
        Uri uri = data.getData();
        if (uri == null) return;
        try (InputStream in = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while (in != null && (n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
            String text = new String(bos.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            LangPack.Result r = LangPack.parse(text);
            if (!r.ok) {
                // Fail-closed, in plain words, naming what's missing.
                String msg = r.error;
                if (!r.missing.isEmpty()) {
                    msg += "\n\nMissing: " + String.join(", ", r.missing);
                }
                new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                        .setTitle("That pack can't be used")
                        .setMessage(msg)
                        .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
                        .show();
                return;
            }
            if (LangStore.install(this, r, text)) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Pack installed: " + r.name
                        + " — pick it in the language list above.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "The pack was fine, but Sandy couldn't "
                        + "save it on this phone.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Couldn't read that file (" + e.getMessage() + ")",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ShareCast.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.ActivityNotFoundException;
import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.net.wifi.WifiManager;
import android.os.Bundle;

import androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaControlIntent;
import androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaItemStatus;
import androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaRouteSelector;
import androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaRouter;
import androidx.mediarouter.media.MediaSessionStatus;
import androidx.mediarouter.media.RemotePlaybackClient;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.Inet4Address;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.NetworkInterface;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Enumeration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Screen-share to a TV (v0.7.0) — the Android half of TvShare.
 *
 * Owns the three routes' machinery for the player:
 *  - the page-share server (ShareServer) and its token/URL,
 *  - the remote-playback fling (MediaRouter routes +
 *    RemotePlaybackClient — the protocol Android calls remote
 *    playback; TVs/receivers that speak it appear as routes),
 *  - the Miracast hand-off to the system's own Cast settings.
 *
 * Honesty rules, same as everywhere in Sandy: a route that
 * isn't there produces words, not a dead button; the fling
 * reports the receiver's own errors back as speech; the page
 * server says its address or says why it has none (no Wi-Fi).
 *
 * The MediaRouter library's AppCompat chooser dialog is NOT
 * used — Sandy lists routes itself, in its own sheet, so the
 * appcompat closure stays out of the build on purpose.
 */
public final class ShareCast {

    public interface Events {
        void onShareState(String spoken);
    }

    private static ShareCast instance;

    public static synchronized ShareCast get(Context ctx) {
        if (instance == null) instance = new ShareCast(ctx);
        return instance;
    }

    private final Context app;
    private MediaRouter router;
    private boolean discovering = false;

    private ShareServer server;
    private String token = "";
    private int serverPort = -1;
    private String serverPlanUrl = null;

    private RemotePlaybackClient client;
    private MediaRouter.RouteInfo activeRoute;
    private long pendingSeekMs = -1;
    private String activeItemId;

    private ShareCast(Context ctx) {
        app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ discovery

    public void startDiscovery() {
        if (discovering) return;
        try {
            router = MediaRouter.getInstance(app);
            MediaRouteSelector selector = new MediaRouteSelector.Builder()
                    .addControlCategory(MediaControlIntent.CATEGORY_REMOTE_PLAYBACK)
                    .build();
            router.addCallback(selector, new MediaRouter.Callback() {},
                    MediaRouter.CALLBACK_FLAG_REQUEST_DISCOVERY);
            discovering = true;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // Discovery must never take the player down with it —
            // an Error from the router stack stays a share problem.
            router = null;
        }
    }

    /** TVs/receivers that can take a flung stream right now. */
    public List<MediaRouter.RouteInfo> remoteRoutes() {
        List<MediaRouter.RouteInfo> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (router == null) startDiscovery();
        if (router == null) return out;
        try {
            for (MediaRouter.RouteInfo r : router.getRoutes()) {
                if (r.isEnabled() && !r.isDefault()
                        && r.getPlaybackType()
                                == MediaRouter.RouteInfo.PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE
                        && r.supportsControlCategory(
                                MediaControlIntent.CATEGORY_REMOTE_PLAYBACK)) {
                    out.add(r);
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ page server

    public boolean pageLive() { return server != null && server.isRunning(); }

    public String watchUrl() {
        String ip = localIpv4();
        if (ip == null || serverPort < 0) return null;
        return TvShare.watchUrl(ip, serverPort, token);
    }

    public String mediaUrl() {
        String ip = localIpv4();
        if (ip == null || serverPort < 0) return null;
        return TvShare.mediaUrl(ip, serverPort, token);
    }

    /**
     * Start (or reuse) the page server for this plan. A fresh
     * token is minted whenever the shared item changes, so an
     * old link dies when the viewer moves on — household hygiene.
     */
    public void ensurePageServer(final TvShare.Plan plan, final String title)
            throws IOException {
        if (pageLive() && plan.url != null && plan.url.equals(serverPlanUrl)) {
            return;
        }
        stopPageServer();
        token = TvShare.newToken(new Random());
        ShareServer.MediaSource media = mediaSourceFor(plan);
        server = new ShareServer(token, media, new ShareServer.PageSource() {
            @Override public String title() { return title; }
            @Override public boolean playable() {
                return plan.kind != TvShare.Kind.PAGE_ONLY;
            }
        });
        serverPort = server.start();
        serverPlanUrl = plan.url;
    }

    public void stopPageServer() {
        if (server != null) server.stop();
        server = null;
        serverPort = -1;
        serverPlanUrl = null;
    }

    private ShareServer.MediaSource mediaSourceFor(final TvShare.Plan plan) {
        if (plan.kind == TvShare.Kind.REDIRECT) {
            return new ShareServer.MediaSource() {
                @Override public long length() { return -1; }
                @Override public String contentType() {
                    return TvShare.mimeFor(plan.url);
                }
                @Override public InputStream open(long start) throws IOException {
                    throw new IOException("redirect plan has no local bytes");
                }
                @Override public String redirectTo() { return plan.url; }
            };
        }
        if (plan.kind == TvShare.Kind.FILE
                && (plan.url.startsWith("file://") || plan.url.startsWith("/"))) {
            final File file = plan.url.startsWith("file://")
                    ? new File(Uri.parse(plan.url).getPath())
                    : new File(plan.url);
            return new ShareServer.MediaSource() {
                @Override public long length() {
                    return file.isFile() ? file.length() : -1;
                }
                @Override public String contentType() {
                    return TvShare.mimeFor(file.getName());
                }
                @Override public InputStream open(long start) throws IOException {
                    FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(file);
                    long left = start;
                    while (left > 0) {
                        long skipped = in.skip(left);
                        if (skipped <= 0) break;
                        left -= skipped;
                    }
                    return in;
                }
                @Override public String redirectTo() { return null; }
            };
        }
        // content:// (or anything else streamable through the resolver)
        final Uri uri = Uri.parse(plan.url);
        final ContentResolver cr = app.getContentResolver();
        return new ShareServer.MediaSource() {
            @Override public long length() {
                try (android.content.res.AssetFileDescriptor afd =
                             cr.openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "r")) {
                    return afd == null ? -1 : afd.getLength();
                } catch (Throwable e) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
            @Override public String contentType() {
                String t = null;
                try { t = cr.getType(uri); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                return t == null ? TvShare.mimeFor(plan.url) : t;
            }
            @Override public InputStream open(long start) throws IOException {
                InputStream in = cr.openInputStream(uri);
                if (in == null) throw new IOException("the file wouldn't open");
                long left = start;
                while (left > 0) {
                    long skipped = in.skip(left);
                    if (skipped <= 0) break;
                    left -= skipped;
                }
                return in;
            }
            @Override public String redirectTo() { return null; }
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ fling

    public boolean castActive() { return client != null && activeRoute != null; }

    public String activeRouteName() {
        return activeRoute == null ? "" : activeRoute.getName();
    }

    public void fling(MediaRouter.RouteInfo route, String url, String mime,
                      String title, long positionMs, final Events events) {
        stopCast();
        try {
            if (router != null) router.selectRoute(route);
            client = new RemotePlaybackClient(app, route);
            if (!client.isRemotePlaybackSupported()) {
                client.release();
                client = null;
                events.onShareState(route.getName()
                        + " answered, but it doesn't take sent video.");
                return;
            }
            activeRoute = route;
            pendingSeekMs = positionMs > 5000 ? positionMs : -1;
            final RemotePlaybackClient c = client;
            c.setStatusCallback(new RemotePlaybackClient.StatusCallback() {
                @Override
                public void onItemStatusChanged(Bundle data, String sessionId,
                        MediaSessionStatus sessionStatus, String itemId,
                        MediaItemStatus itemStatus) {
                    if (pendingSeekMs > 0 && itemStatus != null
                            && itemStatus.getPlaybackState()
                                    == MediaItemStatus.PLAYBACK_STATE_PLAYING) {
                        long seek = pendingSeekMs;
                        pendingSeekMs = -1;
                        c.seek(itemId, seek, null,
                                new RemotePlaybackClient.ItemActionCallback() {});
                    }
                }
                @Override
                public void onSessionStatusChanged(Bundle data, String sessionId,
                                                   MediaSessionStatus sessionStatus) {}
            });
            c.play(Uri.parse(url), mime, null, 0, null,
                    new RemotePlaybackClient.ItemActionCallback() {
                        @Override
                        public void onResult(Bundle data, String sessionId,
                                MediaSessionStatus sessionStatus, String itemId,
                                MediaItemStatus itemStatus) {
                            activeItemId = itemId;
                            events.onShareState("Playing on "
                                    + route.getName()
                                    + " now — this phone is the remote.");
                        }
                        @Override
                        public void onError(String error, int code,
                                            Bundle extras) {
                            stopCast();
                            events.onShareState(route.getName()
                                    + " couldn't take it: "
                                    + (error == null ? "the receiver refused"
                                       : error));
                        }
                    });
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            stopCast();
            events.onShareState("Sending to " + route.getName()
                    + " failed: " + (e.getMessage() == null
                            ? e.getClass().getSimpleName() : e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    public void stopCast() {
        if (client != null) {
            try {
                client.stop(null, new RemotePlaybackClient.SessionActionCallback() {});
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            try { client.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            client = null;
        }
        activeRoute = null;
        activeItemId = null;
        pendingSeekMs = -1;
    }

    public void stopAll() {
        stopCast();
        stopPageServer();
    }

    public boolean anythingLive() { return castActive() || pageLive(); }

    // ------------------------------------------------ network facts

    /**
     * This phone's Wi-Fi address, or null when it has none (not
     * on Wi-Fi — the page share honestly can't work then).
     * Interface scan first (no permission needed), WifiManager
     * as the fallback.
     */
    public String localIpv4() {
        try {
            Enumeration<NetworkInterface> ifs = NetworkInterface.getNetworkInterfaces();
            String wifiHit = null;
            while (ifs != null && ifs.hasMoreElements()) {
                NetworkInterface ni = ifs.nextElement();
                if (!ni.isUp() || ni.isLoopback()) continue;
                Enumeration<InetAddress> addrs = ni.getInetAddresses();
                while (addrs.hasMoreElements()) {
                    InetAddress a = addrs.nextElement();
                    if (a instanceof Inet4Address && !a.isLoopbackAddress()) {
                        String ip = a.getHostAddress();
                        String name = ni.getName().toLowerCase();
                        if (name.startsWith("wlan")) return ip;
                        if (wifiHit == null) wifiHit = ip;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (wifiHit != null) return wifiHit;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        try {
            WifiManager wm = (WifiManager) app.getSystemService(Context.WIFI_SERVICE);
            if (wm != null && wm.getConnectionInfo() != null) {
                int v = wm.getConnectionInfo().getIpAddress();
                if (v != 0) return TvShare.formatIpv4(v);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ miracast door

    /**
     * Walk the viewer to the phone's own screen-mirroring
     * settings (the app cannot mirror by itself — Miracast is
     * the system's). Returns false when neither settings door
     * exists on this phone, so the caller can say so in words.
     */
    public static boolean openCastSettings(Activity act) {
        String[] actions = {
                "android.settings.CAST_SETTINGS",
                "android.settings.WIFI_DISPLAY_SETTINGS",
        };
        for (String a : actions) {
            try {
                Intent i = new Intent(a);
                i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                act.startActivity(i);
                return true;
            } catch (ActivityNotFoundException ignored) {}
        }
        return false;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ShareServer.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.ServerSocket;
import java.net.Socket;

/**
 * The page-share server (v0.7.0): a small HTTP server the phone
 * runs on the home Wi-Fi so a TV browser can watch what Sandy
 * plays. Plain java.net on purpose — no Android imports — so
 * the desktop harness can run it on a loopback port and prove
 * the wire behavior (token gate, ranges, redirects) for real.
 *
 * Routes:
 *   /watch?k=<token>  the self-contained player page (TvShare)
 *   /media?k=<token>  the media itself:
 *       FILE plan     -> bytes streamed, HTTP Range honored
 *       REDIRECT plan -> 302 to the stream's own address (the
 *                        TV pulls the stream itself; live stays
 *                        live and the phone carries nothing)
 *   anything else     -> 404 in plain words
 * A wrong or missing token answers 403 in plain words — the
 * page is for the household, not the whole street.
 *
 * The media bytes come through the MediaSource seam so the
 * Android side decides what a FILE is (a real file, a content
 * stream, an assembled recording) and this class stays a dumb,
 * honest pipe.
 */
public final class ShareServer {

    public interface MediaSource {
        /** Total bytes, or -1 when unknown (then no ranges). */
        long length() throws IOException;
        String contentType();
        /** Open the body at byte {@code start} (0 = whole body). */
        InputStream open(long start) throws IOException;
        /** Non-null: answer a redirect to this address instead. */
        String redirectTo();
    }

    public interface PageSource {
        String title();
        boolean playable();
    }

    private final String token;
    private final MediaSource media;
    private final PageSource page;
    private volatile ServerSocket socket;
    private volatile boolean running = false;
    private Thread thread;

    public ShareServer(String token, MediaSource media, PageSource page) {
        this.token = token;
        this.media = media;
        this.page = page;
    }

    /** Bind an ephemeral port on all interfaces; returns it. */
    public synchronized int start() throws IOException {
        if (running) return socket.getLocalPort();
        socket = new ServerSocket(0, 8, InetAddress.getByName("0.0.0.0"));
        running = true;
        thread = new Thread(this::acceptLoop, "sandy-share-server");
        thread.setDaemon(true);
        thread.start();
        return socket.getLocalPort();
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        running = false;
        try { if (socket != null) socket.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) {}
        socket = null;
    }

    public boolean isRunning() { return running; }
    public int port() { return socket == null ? -1 : socket.getLocalPort(); }
    public String token() { return token; }

    private void acceptLoop() {
        while (running) {
            try {
                Socket s = socket.accept();
                Thread t = new Thread(() -> serve(s), "sandy-share-conn");
                t.setDaemon(true);
                t.start();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                if (running) {
                    // one bad accept shouldn't kill the server;
                    // loop and try again
                    try { Thread.sleep(50); } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void serve(Socket s) {
        try {
            s.setSoTimeout(15000);
            BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(
                    new InputStreamReader(s.getInputStream(), "ISO-8859-1"));
            String requestLine = in.readLine();
            if (requestLine == null) { s.close(); return; }
            String range = null;
            String line;
            while ((line = in.readLine()) != null && !line.isEmpty()) {
                int colon = line.indexOf(':');
                if (colon > 0 && line.substring(0, colon).trim()
                        .equalsIgnoreCase("Range")) {
                    range = line.substring(colon + 1).trim();
                }
            }
            String[] parts = requestLine.split(" ");
            String target = parts.length >= 2 ? parts[1] : "/";
            OutputStream out = s.getOutputStream();
            handle(target, range, out);
            out.flush();
            s.close();
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            try { s.close(); } catch (IOException ignored2) {}
        }
    }

    private void handle(String target, String range, OutputStream out)
            throws IOException {
        String path = target;
        String query = "";
        int q = target.indexOf('?');
        if (q >= 0) {
            path = target.substring(0, q);
            query = target.substring(q + 1);
        }
        if (!tokenOk(query)) {
            text(out, 403, "Forbidden",
                    "That link isn't the one Sandy is sharing right now.");
            return;
        }
        if (path.equals("/watch")) {
            String html = TvShare.playerPage(page.title(),
                    "/media?k=" + token, page.playable());
            byte[] body = html.getBytes("UTF-8");
            head(out, 200, "OK", "text/html; charset=utf-8", body.length, null);
            out.write(body);
            return;
        }
        if (path.equals("/media")) {
            String redirect = media.redirectTo();
            if (redirect != null) {
                String h = "HTTP/1.1 302 Found\r\nLocation: " + redirect
                        + "\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n";
                out.write(h.getBytes("ISO-8859-1"));
                return;
            }
            long len = media.length();
            long[] r = TvShare.parseRange(range, len);
            long start = r == null ? 0 : r[0];
            long end = r == null ? (len < 0 ? -1 : len - 1) : r[1];
            long count = end < 0 ? -1 : (end - start + 1);
            String extra = null;
            int code = 200;
            if (r != null) {
                code = 206;
                extra = "Content-Range: bytes " + start + "-" + end + "/" + len;
            }
            head(out, code, code == 206 ? "Partial Content" : "OK",
                    media.contentType(), count, extra);
            try (InputStream body = media.open(start)) {
                byte[] buf = new byte[64 * 1024];
                long left = count;
                int n;
                while ((n = body.read(buf, 0,
                        left < 0 ? buf.length
                                : (int) Math.min(buf.length, left))) > 0) {
                    out.write(buf, 0, n);
                    if (left > 0) {
                        left -= n;
                        if (left == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        text(out, 404, "Not Found",
                "Sandy isn't sharing anything at this address.");
    }

    private boolean tokenOk(String query) {
        if (query == null) return false;
        for (String pair : query.split("&")) {
            int eq = pair.indexOf('=');
            if (eq > 0 && pair.substring(0, eq).equals("k")) {
                return pair.substring(eq + 1).equals(token);
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void head(OutputStream out, int code, String msg, String type,
                      long length, String extra) throws IOException {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("HTTP/1.1 ").append(code).append(' ').append(msg).append("\r\n");
        sb.append("Content-Type: ").append(type).append("\r\n");
        if (length >= 0) sb.append("Content-Length: ").append(length).append("\r\n");
        sb.append("Accept-Ranges: bytes\r\n");
        if (extra != null) sb.append(extra).append("\r\n");
        sb.append("Connection: close\r\n\r\n");
        out.write(sb.toString().getBytes("ISO-8859-1"));
    }

    private void text(OutputStream out, int code, String msg, String bodyText)
            throws IOException {
        byte[] body = (bodyText + "\n").getBytes("UTF-8");
        head(out, code, msg, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", body.length, null);
        out.write(body);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/ShowActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.AdapterView;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.BaseAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.Spinner;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * One show's page: poster, plain-language facts, seasons, and the episode
 * list in order — with watched ✓ and resume markers per episode. Tapping
 * an episode goes to the source picker; nothing plays from here directly,
 * because picking the source is the user's call (the TeaTV rule).
 */
public class ShowActivity extends Activity {

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private int showId;
    private TvMaze.Show show;
    private List<TvMaze.Episode> allEpisodes = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<TvMaze.Episode> shownEpisodes = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<Integer> seasons = new ArrayList<>();

    private TextView nameView, metaView, summaryView, statusView;
    private TextView catalogBanner;
    private ImageView posterView;
    private Button watchlistBtn;
    private Spinner seasonSpinner;
    private ListView episodeList;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private EpisodeAdapter adapter;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        showId = getIntent().getIntExtra("showId", -1);
        if (showId < 0) { finish(); return; }
        String preName = getIntent().getStringExtra("showName");
        String preImage = getIntent().getStringExtra("showImage");

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        LinearLayout header = new LinearLayout(this);
        header.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        posterView = new ImageView(this);
        posterView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        posterView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(34, 34, 42));
        header.addView(posterView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(104), dp(146)));
        if (preImage != null) ImageCache.load(this, preImage, posterView);

        LinearLayout headText = new LinearLayout(this);
        headText.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        headText.setPadding(dp(12), 0, 0, 0);
        nameView = new TextView(this);
        nameView.setText(preName == null ? "" : preName);
        nameView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        nameView.setTextSize(20);
        nameView.setTypeface(nameView.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        headText.addView(nameView);
        metaView = new TextView(this);
        metaView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        metaView.setTextSize(13);
        headText.addView(metaView);
        watchlistBtn = new Button(this);
        watchlistBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> toggleWatchlist());
        headText.addView(watchlistBtn);
        header.addView(headText, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        root.addView(header);

        summaryView = new TextView(this);
        summaryView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 208));
        summaryView.setTextSize(13);
        summaryView.setMaxLines(5);
        summaryView.setPadding(0, dp(8), 0, 0);
        root.addView(summaryView);

        // Display Honesty Law (v0.14.0): when this show is
        // catalogue-only — the catalogue knows it exists, but no
        // playable copy stands on the shelves — the page says so
        // at the top, in plain words, BEFORE any episode tap.
        // The tap is never where the viewer learns the truth.
        catalogBanner = new TextView(this);
        catalogBanner.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "wall_catalog_only")
                + " — " + LangStore.tr(this, "show_catalog_only_note"));
        catalogBanner.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 190, 110));
        catalogBanner.setTextSize(14);
        catalogBanner.setPadding(dp(10), dp(8), dp(10), dp(8));
        catalogBanner.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(46, 40, 26));
        catalogBanner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(catalogBanner);

        seasonSpinner = new Spinner(this);
        root.addView(seasonSpinner);
        seasonSpinner.setOnItemSelectedListener(new AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener() {
            @Override public void onItemSelected(AdapterView<?> p, View v, int pos, long id) {
                rebuildEpisodes();
            }
            @Override public void onNothingSelected(AdapterView<?> p) { }
        });

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        episodeList = new ListView(this);
        episodeList.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        adapter = new EpisodeAdapter();
        episodeList.setAdapter(adapter);
        root.addView(episodeList, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        episodeList.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            TvMaze.Episode e = shownEpisodes.get(pos);
            Intent i = new Intent(this, SourcesActivity.class);
            i.putExtra("mode", "episode");
            i.putExtra("showId", showId);
            i.putExtra("showName", show.name);
            i.putExtra("showLanguage", show.language);
            i.putExtra("season", e.season);
            i.putExtra("number", e.number);
            i.putExtra("epName", e.name);
            startActivity(i);
        });
        // v0.13.0: the voiceover door on any episode of any show —
        // picking a source then HOLDS it (the record leg) and
        // opens the dub kitchen with it already in hand
        episodeList.setOnItemLongClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            TvMaze.Episode e = shownEpisodes.get(pos);
            new android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle(e.name)
                    .setItems(new CharSequence[]{
                            LangStore.tr(this, "auto_see_sources"),
                            LangStore.tr(this, "dub_make_voiceover")},
                            (d, which) -> {
                                Intent i = new Intent(this, SourcesActivity.class);
                                i.putExtra("mode", which == 0 ? "episode" : "episodeDub");
                                i.putExtra("showId", showId);
                                i.putExtra("showName", show.name);
                                i.putExtra("showLanguage", show.language);
                                i.putExtra("season", e.season);
                                i.putExtra("number", e.number);
                                i.putExtra("epName", e.name);
                                startActivity(i);
                            })
                    .show();
            return true;
        });

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        statusView.setTextSize(12);
        root.addView(statusView);

        setContentView(root);
        updateWatchlistBtn();
        loadShow();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged(); // watched/resume marks may have changed
        updateWatchlistBtn();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    private void updateWatchlistBtn() {
        if (watchlistBtn == null) return;
        boolean in = ChannelStore.isWatchlisted(this, showId);
        watchlistBtn.setText(in ? "✓ In My Shows — tap to remove" : "+ My Shows");
    }

    private void toggleWatchlist() {
        if (show == null) return;
        boolean in = ChannelStore.isWatchlisted(this, showId);
        ChannelStore.setWatchlisted(this, show, !in);
        updateWatchlistBtn();
        Toast.makeText(this, !in ? "Added to My Shows" : "Removed from My Shows",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- loading

    private File cacheFile(String name) {
        File dir = new File(getFilesDir(), "catalog");
        if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
        return new File(dir, name);
    }

    private void loadShow() {
        statusView.setText("Loading show details…");
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String showJson = readFile(cacheFile("show_" + showId + ".json"));
                if (showJson == null) {
                    showJson = Net.getString(TvMaze.showUrl(showId));
                    writeFile(cacheFile("show_" + showId + ".json"), showJson);
                }
                String epsJson = readFile(cacheFile("eps_" + showId + ".json"));
                if (epsJson == null) {
                    epsJson = Net.getString(TvMaze.episodesUrl(showId));
                    writeFile(cacheFile("eps_" + showId + ".json"), epsJson);
                }
                TvMaze.Show s = TvMaze.parseShow(showJson);
                List<TvMaze.Episode> eps = TvMaze.parseEpisodes(epsJson);
                // shelf truth for the honesty banner: a loaded
                // shelf carries it, or the Archive has proven it
                boolean onShelves = false;
                try {
                    onShelves = CatalogStore.shelf(this).carries(s.name)
                            || ChannelStore.isArchiveProven(this, showId);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                final boolean catalogOnly = !onShelves;
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    catalogBanner.setVisibility(catalogOnly
                            ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    show = s;
                    allEpisodes = eps;
                    nameView.setText(s.name);
                    ImageCache.load(this, s.imageMedium, posterView);
                    String meta = String.join(" · ", s.genres)
                            + (s.language.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  " + s.language)
                            + (s.countryName.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  " + s.countryName)
                            + (s.rating > 0 ? "  ·  ★ "
                                + String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", s.rating) : "")
                            + (s.status.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  " + s.status)
                            + (s.premiered.isEmpty() ? "" : "  ·  since " + s.premiered);
                    metaView.setText(meta);
                    summaryView.setText(s.summaryText);
                    seasons = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (TvMaze.Episode e : eps) {
                        if (!seasons.contains(e.season)) seasons.add(e.season);
                    }
                    Collections.sort(seasons);
                    List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int sn : seasons) labels.add("Season " + sn);
                    seasonSpinner.setAdapter(new ArrayAdapter<>(this,
                            android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item, labels));
                    statusView.setText(eps.size() + " episodes across "
                            + seasons.size() + " seasons — tap an episode to pick a source.");
                    rebuildEpisodes();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 140, 140));
                    statusView.setText("Couldn't load this show (" + shortErr(e) + ").");
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void rebuildEpisodes() {
        shownEpisodes = new ArrayList<>();
        if (seasons.isEmpty()) { adapter.notifyDataSetChanged(); return; }
        int pos = seasonSpinner.getSelectedItemPosition();
        int season = seasons.get(Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, seasons.size() - 1)));
        for (TvMaze.Episode e : allEpisodes) {
            if (e.season == season) shownEpisodes.add(e);
        }
        Collections.sort(shownEpisodes, (a, b) -> a.number - b.number);
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- adapter

    private final class EpisodeAdapter extends BaseAdapter {
        @Override public int getCount() { return shownEpisodes.size(); }
        @Override public Object getItem(int pos) { return shownEpisodes.get(pos); }
        @Override public long getItemId(int pos) { return pos; }

        @Override
        public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
            LinearLayout ll;
            TextView main, sub;
            if (convertView instanceof LinearLayout) {
                ll = (LinearLayout) convertView;
                main = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(0);
                sub = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(1);
            } else {
                ll = new LinearLayout(ShowActivity.this);
                ll.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                ll.setPadding(dp(8), dp(8), dp(8), dp(8));
                main = new TextView(ShowActivity.this);
                main.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                main.setTextSize(15);
                sub = new TextView(ShowActivity.this);
                sub.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                sub.setTextSize(12);
                ll.addView(main);
                ll.addView(sub);
            }
            TvMaze.Episode e = shownEpisodes.get(pos);
            main.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "S%02dE%02d · %s", e.season, e.number, e.name));
            StringBuilder meta = new StringBuilder();
            if (!e.airdate.isEmpty()) meta.append(e.airdate);
            if (e.runtime > 0) {
                if (meta.length() > 0) meta.append("  ·  ");
                meta.append(e.runtime).append(" min");
            }
            String key = ChannelStore.episodeKey(showId, e.season, e.number);
            if (ChannelStore.isWatched(ShowActivity.this, key)) {
                if (meta.length() > 0) meta.append("  ·  ");
                meta.append("✓ watched");
            } else {
                long posMs = ChannelStore.getPosition(ShowActivity.this, key);
                if (posMs > 10000) {
                    if (meta.length() > 0) meta.append("  ·  ");
                    meta.append("▶ resume at ").append(formatMs(posMs));
                }
            }
            sub.setText(meta.toString());
            return ll;
        }
    }

    static String formatMs(long ms) {
        long totalSec = ms / 1000;
        long m = totalSec / 60;
        long s = totalSec % 60;
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%d:%02d", m, s);
    }

    private static String shortErr(Exception e) {
        String m = e.getMessage();
        if (m == null) m = e.getClass().getSimpleName();
        return m.length() > 60 ? m.substring(0, 60) : m;
    }

    private static String readFile(File f) {
        if (!f.exists()) return null;
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) f.length()];
            int off = 0, n;
            while (off < buf.length && (n = in.read(buf, off, buf.length - off)) > 0) off += n;
            return new String(buf, 0, off, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void writeFile(File f, String content) {
        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(f)) {
            out.write(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SourceFinder.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The TeaTV-style engine, lawful sources only: given a catalog title
 * (TVmaze show episode, or a movie title), find playable entries among
 * the playlists the user has loaded, matched by title + SxxExx markers.
 * Results are quality-ranked best-first; the ranking comes only from
 * tokens in the entry's own name/URL — unlabeled stays "unknown quality".
 */
public final class SourceFinder {

    public static final class Source {
        public String kind = "";        // "Playlist", "My Library" or "Internet Archive"
        public String label = "";       // entry name / archive file name
        public String detail = "";      // playlist name / archive item title
        public String url = "";
        public String userAgent = "";
        public String qualityLabel = "unknown quality";
        public int qualityTier = 0;
        public long size;               // bytes when known (archive), else 0
        public String subUrl = "";      // sidecar subtitle (archive items)
        public String subMime = "";
        public String subLang = "";
        /** Language evidence (v0.12.1, for AutoPlay): the playlist
         *  facet name ("English") and/or the Archive MARC code
         *  ("eng") — "" when the source carries neither. */
        public String langFacet = "";
        public String langMarc = "";
    }

    private SourceFinder() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------- episodes

    /**
     * Playlist entries that look like this exact episode of this show.
     * Strong match: title phrase + exact SxxExx. Weaker fallbacks (kept,
     * sorted after strong ones): title phrase + episode-only marker when
     * the wanted season is 1; title phrase + the episode's own name.
     */
    public static List<Source> findEpisode(List<M3uParser.Channel> channels,
                                           String showName, int season, int number,
                                           String episodeName) {
        List<Source> strong = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Source> weak = new ArrayList<>();
        if (channels == null) return strong;
        String showNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(showName);
        String epNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(episodeName);
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
            String nameNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(c.name);
            if (!EpisodeKey.containsPhrase(nameNorm, showNorm)) continue;
            EpisodeKey key = EpisodeKey.parse(c.name);
            if (key != null && key.season == season && key.episode == number) {
                strong.add(fromChannel(c));
            } else if (key != null && !key.seasonKnown && key.episode == number && season == 1) {
                weak.add(fromChannel(c));
            } else if (key == null && !epNorm.isEmpty()
                    && EpisodeKey.containsPhrase(nameNorm, epNorm)) {
                weak.add(fromChannel(c));
            }
        }
        List<Source> out = new ArrayList<>(strong);
        out.addAll(weak);
        sortByQuality(out);
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- movies / titles

    /**
     * Playlist entries matching a plain title (movies, one-off specials).
     * Entries carrying episode markers are excluded — those are episodes,
     * not the movie.
     */
    public static List<Source> findTitle(List<M3uParser.Channel> channels, String title) {
        List<Source> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (channels == null) return out;
        String titleNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(title);
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
            String nameNorm = EpisodeKey.normalize(c.name);
            if (!EpisodeKey.containsPhrase(nameNorm, titleNorm)) continue;
            if (EpisodeKey.parse(c.name) != null) continue;
            out.add(fromChannel(c));
        }
        sortByQuality(out);
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- VOD shelves

    /** Entries that live on a playlist's on-demand shelves (Movies/Series/VOD groups). */
    public static boolean isVodEntry(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        String g = c.group == null ? "" : c.group.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        return g.contains("movie") || g.contains("series") || g.contains("vod")
                || g.contains("show") || g.contains("film");
    }

    public static Source fromChannel(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        Source s = new Source();
        // Library entries carry source "My Library" (LibraryIndex) — the
        // row must say so, not pretend the file came from a playlist.
        s.kind = LibraryIndex.SOURCE_NAME.equals(c.source) ? "My Library" : "Playlist";
        s.label = c.name;
        s.detail = c.source;
        s.url = c.url;
        s.userAgent = c.userAgent;
        s.qualityTier = EpisodeKey.qualityTier(c.name + " " + c.url);
        s.qualityLabel = EpisodeKey.qualityLabel(c.name + " " + c.url);
        s.langFacet = c.language == null ? "" : c.language;
        return s;
    }

    public static Source fromArchiveFile(IaClient.Item item, IaClient.FileEntry f,
                                         IaClient.FileEntry sub) {
        Source s = new Source();
        s.kind = "Internet Archive";
        s.label = f.name;
        s.detail = item.title.isEmpty() ? item.identifier : item.title;
        s.url = f.url;
        s.size = f.size;
        s.qualityTier = EpisodeKey.qualityTier(f.name);
        s.qualityLabel = EpisodeKey.qualityLabel(f.name);
        s.langMarc = item.language == null ? "" : item.language;
        if (sub != null) {
            s.subUrl = sub.url;
            s.subMime = sub.subMime;
            s.subLang = sub.subLang;
        }
        return s;
    }

    private static final java.util.Set<String> JUNK_TOKENS = new java.util.HashSet<>(
            java.util.Arrays.asList("2160p", "1080p", "720p", "480p", "360p", "hd", "sd",
                    "cam", "web", "webrip", "bluray", "bdrip", "dvdrip", "x264", "x265",
                    "h264", "h265", "hevc", "aac", "mp4", "mkv", "avi", "extended",
                    "remastered", "proper", "repack"));

    /**
     * A playlist entry's raw name ("Night of the Living Dead (1968) [1080p]")
     * cleaned into a searchable title ("Night of the Living Dead 1968"):
     * bracketed tags and release-junk tokens out, the year kept.
     */
    public static String cleanTitleForSearch(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return "";
        String s = raw.replaceAll("\\[[^\\]]*\\]", " ");
        s = s.replaceAll("\\((\\d{4})\\)", " $1 ");
        s = s.replaceAll("[\\(\\)]", " ");
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (String tok : s.split("[^A-Za-z0-9]+")) {
            if (tok.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (JUNK_TOKENS.contains(tok.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US))) continue;
            if (b.length() > 0) b.append(' ');
            b.append(tok);
        }
        return b.toString().trim();
    }

    /** Best quality first; ties broken by larger known size, then name. */
    public static void sortByQuality(List<Source> sources) {
        Collections.sort(sources, (a, b) -> {
            if (a.qualityTier != b.qualityTier) return b.qualityTier - a.qualityTier;
            if (a.size != b.size) return a.size > b.size ? -1 : 1;
            return a.label.compareToIgnoreCase(b.label);
        });
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SourcesActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.BaseAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The source picker — the TeaTV moment, lawful sources only. For one
 * episode (or movie title) it gathers: matches from every playlist the
 * user has loaded, and playable files from the Internet Archive's public
 * collection. Quality-ranked best-first. If nothing matches, it says so
 * plainly and explains where sources come from — it never fakes a stream.
 */
public class SourcesActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int IA_ITEMS_TO_OPEN = 5;
    private static final int IA_MAX_SOURCES = 25;

    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final List<SourceFinder.Source> sources = new ArrayList<>();

    private String mode;
    private int showId, season, number;
    private String showName, epName, movieTitle;
    private String showLanguage = "";
    private String directUrl, directName, directUa;
    private String contentKey;
    private String displayTitle;

    private TextView titleView, statusView, emptyView;
    private ListView listView;
    private ProgressBar progress;
    private SourceAdapter adapter;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        mode = getIntent().getStringExtra("mode");
        if (mode == null) mode = "episode";
        showId = getIntent().getIntExtra("showId", -1);
        showName = getIntent().getStringExtra("showName");
        String sl = getIntent().getStringExtra("showLanguage");
        if (sl != null) showLanguage = sl;
        season = getIntent().getIntExtra("season", 0);
        number = getIntent().getIntExtra("number", 0);
        epName = getIntent().getStringExtra("epName");
        movieTitle = getIntent().getStringExtra("movieTitle");
        directUrl = getIntent().getStringExtra("directUrl");
        directName = getIntent().getStringExtra("directName");
        directUa = getIntent().getStringExtra("directUa");

        if ("movie".equals(mode)) {
            contentKey = ChannelStore.titleKey(movieTitle == null ? "" : movieTitle);
            displayTitle = movieTitle;
        } else {
            contentKey = ChannelStore.episodeKey(showId, season, number);
            displayTitle = String.format(Locale.US, "%s — S%02dE%02d · %s",
                    showName, season, number, epName == null ? "" : epName);
        }

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        TextView header = new TextView(this);
        header.setText("episodeDub".equals(mode)
                ? LangStore.tr(this, "dub_voiceover_pick_source") : "Watch");
        header.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
        header.setTextSize(14);
        header.setTypeface(header.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(header);

        titleView = new TextView(this);
        titleView.setText(displayTitle);
        titleView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        titleView.setTextSize(18);
        titleView.setTypeface(titleView.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(titleView);

        progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        root.addView(progress, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)));

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        statusView.setTextSize(12);
        statusView.setText("Looking for sources — your playlists and the "
                + "videos on this phone first, then the Internet Archive…");
        root.addView(statusView);

        listView = new ListView(this);
        listView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        adapter = new SourceAdapter();
        listView.setAdapter(adapter);
        root.addView(listView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        listView.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            // v0.13.0: in voiceover mode a tap does not play — it
            // HOLDS the source (the record leg of the cook) and
            // opens the dub kitchen holding it
            if ("episodeDub".equals(mode)) holdForDub(sources.get(pos));
            else play(sources.get(pos));
        });

        emptyView = new TextView(this);
        emptyView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(220, 220, 228));
        emptyView.setTextSize(15);
        emptyView.setPadding(0, dp(20), 0, 0);
        emptyView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        root.addView(emptyView);

        setContentView(root);
        gather();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- gather

    private void gather() {
        exec.execute(() -> {
            List<SourceFinder.Source> found = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<String> seenUrls = new HashSet<>();
            StringBuilder notes = new StringBuilder();

            // Measured per-source accounting — this is what the dead-end
            // screen reports when nothing is found, so James can see what
            // was actually checked instead of taking emptiness on faith.
            int playlistEntries = 0, playlistCount = 0, libraryFiles = 0;
            boolean guideLoaded = false;
            String iaOutcome = "wasn't reached";

            // v0.10.0: the names this title is looked up under — its
            // own name first, then the alternates TVmaze itself lists.
            // Matching runs in the title's own language world; no name
            // is ever a translation we invented.
            List<TitleNames.Name> nameSet = new ArrayList<>();
            nameSet.add(new TitleNames.Name(showName == null ? "" : showName, ""));
            if (!"movie".equals(mode) && showId > 0) {
                nameSet = TitleNames.buildSet(showName, loadAkas(showId));
                if (nameSet.size() > 1) {
                    StringBuilder nb = new StringBuilder("Also looked under: ");
                    for (int i = 1; i < nameSet.size(); i++) {
                        if (i > 1) nb.append(", ");
                        nb.append(nameSet.get(i).name);
                    }
                    notes.append(nb.append(". "));
                }
            }
            List<String> matchNames = TitleNames.namesOf(nameSet);
            String iaCode = IaClient.iaLanguageCode(showLanguage);

            // the exact playlist entry the user tapped (Movies & VOD shelf)
            if (directUrl != null && !directUrl.isEmpty()) {
                M3uParser.Channel dc = new M3uParser.Channel();
                dc.name = directName == null ? displayTitle : directName;
                dc.url = directUrl;
                dc.userAgent = directUa == null ? "" : directUa;
                dc.source = "Your playlists";
                found.add(SourceFinder.fromChannel(dc));
                seenUrls.add(directUrl);
            }

            // (a) loaded playlists
            playlistCount = ChannelStore.getPlaylists(this).size();
            List<M3uParser.Channel> channels = ChannelStore.loadCache(this);
            if (channels != null) {
                guideLoaded = true;
                playlistEntries = channels.size();
                List<SourceFinder.Source> pm = new ArrayList<>();
                if ("movie".equals(mode)) {
                    pm = SourceFinder.findTitle(channels,
                            SourceFinder.cleanTitleForSearch(movieTitle));
                } else {
                    for (String nm : matchNames) {
                        pm.addAll(SourceFinder.findEpisode(
                                channels, nm, season, number, epName));
                    }
                }
                for (SourceFinder.Source s : pm) {
                    if (seenUrls.add(s.url)) found.add(s);
                }
            }

            // (b) My Library — the video files on this phone (v0.3.0)
            List<M3uParser.Channel> libChannels = LibraryStore.loadChannels(this);
            libraryFiles = libChannels.size();
            if (!libChannels.isEmpty()) {
                List<SourceFinder.Source> lm = new ArrayList<>();
                if ("movie".equals(mode)) {
                    lm = SourceFinder.findTitle(libChannels,
                            SourceFinder.cleanTitleForSearch(movieTitle));
                } else {
                    for (String nm : matchNames) {
                        lm.addAll(SourceFinder.findEpisode(
                                libChannels, nm, season, number, epName));
                    }
                }
                for (SourceFinder.Source s : lm) {
                    if (seenUrls.add(s.url)) found.add(s);
                }
            }

            // (c) Internet Archive — episode-aware and ranked (v0.3.0)
            int iaAdded = 0;
            boolean iaAnswered = false;
            if ("movie".equals(mode)) {
                String cleaned = SourceFinder.cleanTitleForSearch(movieTitle);
                try {
                    List<IaClient.Item> ranked = IaClient.rankItems(
                            IaClient.parseSearch(Net.getString(IaClient.searchUrl(cleaned))),
                            cleaned, "", 0, 0, IaClient.yearOf(cleaned));
                    iaAnswered = true;
                    int opened = 0;
                    for (IaClient.Item item : ranked) {
                        if (opened >= IA_ITEMS_TO_OPEN || found.size() >= IA_MAX_SOURCES) break;
                        opened++;
                        iaAdded += addArchiveItem(found, seenUrls, item, null);
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    iaAnswered = false;
                }
            } else {
                List<IaClient.Item> pool = new ArrayList<>();
                Set<String> seenIds = new HashSet<>();
                if (epName != null && !epName.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    try {
                        for (IaClient.Item it : IaClient.parseSearch(
                                Net.getString(IaClient.episodeSearchUrl(showName, epName)))) {
                            if (seenIds.add(it.identifier)) pool.add(it);
                        }
                        iaAnswered = true;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                }
                List<IaClient.Item> ranked = IaClient.rankItems(
                        pool, showName, epName, season, number, 0);
                if (ranked.isEmpty() || ranked.get(0).score < 50) {
                    // the precision shot missed — cast the scoped wider net
                    try {
                        for (IaClient.Item it : IaClient.parseSearch(
                                Net.getString(IaClient.showScopedSearchUrl(showName)))) {
                            if (seenIds.add(it.identifier)) pool.add(it);
                        }
                        iaAnswered = true;
                        ranked = IaClient.rankItems(pool, showName, epName, season, number, 0);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                }
                // v0.10.0 — the language leg: the Archive's own shelves
                // in the show's language. Items IA tags with the show's
                // language join the pool and float first; untagged
                // items are never promoted on a guess.
                if (!iaCode.isEmpty()) {
                    try {
                        String url = (epName != null && !epName.trim().isEmpty())
                                ? IaClient.episodeLangSearchUrl(showName, epName, iaCode)
                                : IaClient.showLangSearchUrl(showName, iaCode);
                        for (IaClient.Item it : IaClient.parseSearch(Net.getString(url))) {
                            if (seenIds.add(it.identifier)) pool.add(it);
                        }
                        iaAnswered = true;
                        ranked = IaClient.preferLanguage(
                                IaClient.rankItems(pool, showName, epName, season, number, 0),
                                iaCode);
                        notes.append("The Archive was also searched in ")
                                .append(showLanguage).append("-tagged items. ");
                    } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                }
                // v0.10.0 — still weak? Retry under the alternate name
                // the world knows (TVmaze's own AKA record).
                String fallbackName = TitleNames.archiveFallbackName(nameSet);
                if ((ranked.isEmpty() || ranked.get(0).score < 50)
                        && fallbackName != null
                        && epName != null && !epName.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    try {
                        List<IaClient.Item> poolF = IaClient.parseSearch(
                                Net.getString(IaClient.episodeSearchUrl(fallbackName, epName)));
                        List<IaClient.Item> rankedF = IaClient.rankItems(
                                poolF, fallbackName, epName, season, number, 0);
                        Set<String> have = new HashSet<>();
                        for (IaClient.Item it : ranked) have.add(it.identifier);
                        for (IaClient.Item it : rankedF) {
                            if (have.add(it.identifier)) ranked.add(it);
                        }
                        ranked.sort((a, b) -> b.score - a.score);
                        iaAnswered = true;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                }
                int opened = 0;
                for (IaClient.Item item : ranked) {
                    if (opened >= IA_ITEMS_TO_OPEN || found.size() >= IA_MAX_SOURCES) break;
                    opened++;
                    iaAdded += addArchiveItem(found, seenUrls, item, item);
                }
            }
            iaOutcome = iaAdded > 0 ? "found " + iaAdded
                    : iaAnswered ? "searched — no match" : "didn't answer (connection?)";
            // v0.10.0: a proven Archive find is remembered — the
            // catalogue tile may now honestly say "on your shelves".
            if (iaAdded > 0 && showId > 0) {
                ChannelStore.markArchiveProven(this, showId);
            }

            SourceFinder.sortByQuality(found);
            final int fPlaylistEntries = playlistEntries, fPlaylistCount = playlistCount;
            final int fLibraryFiles = libraryFiles;
            final boolean fGuideLoaded = guideLoaded;
            final String fIaOutcome = iaOutcome;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                sources.clear();
                sources.addAll(found);
                adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
                if (found.isEmpty()) {
                    listView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    emptyView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    emptyView.setText(deadEndText(fPlaylistEntries, fPlaylistCount,
                            fLibraryFiles, fGuideLoaded, fIaOutcome));
                    statusView.setText(notes.toString().trim());
                } else {
                    int nPl = 0, nLib = 0, nIa = 0;
                    for (SourceFinder.Source s : found) {
                        if ("My Library".equals(s.kind)) nLib++;
                        else if ("Internet Archive".equals(s.kind)) nIa++;
                        else nPl++;
                    }
                    statusView.setText(found.size() + " source"
                            + (found.size() == 1 ? "" : "s")
                            + ", best quality first. (Playlists " + nPl
                            + " · My Library " + nLib
                            + " · Internet Archive " + nIa + ") Tap one to play. "
                            + notes.toString().trim());
                    gradeEpisodeSources();
                    appendTierLine();
                    maybeAutoPlay();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private static final long AKA_TTL_MS = 7L * 24L * 3600L * 1000L;

    /**
     * TVmaze's alternate names for this show, from a week-long cache
     * (AKAs change rarely). Any failure answers empty — the original
     * name still gets its full search, nothing is blocked on this.
     */
    private List<TvMaze.Aka> loadAkas(int id) {
        java.io.File f = new java.io.File(
                CatalogStore.dir(this), "aka_" + id + ".json");
        try {
            if (f.exists()
                    && System.currentTimeMillis() - f.lastModified() < AKA_TTL_MS) {
                String cached = CatalogStore.readFile(f);
                if (cached != null) return TvMaze.parseAkas(cached);
            }
            String json = Net.getString(TvMaze.akasUrl(id));
            List<TvMaze.Aka> akas = TvMaze.parseAkas(json);
            CatalogStore.writeFile(f, json);
            return akas;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Open one archive item and add its playable files. In episode mode
     * (episodeItem != null) only files that pass the episode filter are
     * added — an item is never a license to offer its whole contents.
     * Returns how many sources were added.
     */
    private int addArchiveItem(List<SourceFinder.Source> found, Set<String> seenUrls,
                               IaClient.Item item, IaClient.Item episodeItem) {
        int added = 0;
        try {
            List<IaClient.FileEntry> files = IaClient.parseMetadata(
                    Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(item.identifier)),
                    item.identifier);
            IaClient.FileEntry firstSub = null;
            List<IaClient.FileEntry> videos = new ArrayList<>();
            for (IaClient.FileEntry f : files) {
                if (f.subtitle && firstSub == null) firstSub = f;
                if (f.video) videos.add(f);
            }
            List<IaClient.FileEntry> keep = videos;
            if (episodeItem != null) {
                boolean matched = IaClient.itemMatchesEpisode(
                        episodeItem, epName, season, number);
                keep = IaClient.filterEpisodeFiles(files, season, number, epName, matched);
            }
            for (IaClient.FileEntry v : keep) {
                if (!seenUrls.add(v.url)) continue;
                found.add(SourceFinder.fromArchiveFile(item, v, firstSub));
                added++;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // one dead archive item shouldn't sink the others
        }
        return added;
    }

    /**
     * The dead-end explanation (v0.3.0): when no shelf has the title,
     * say WHY, show the measured per-source accounting of what was
     * checked, and name the two moves that would fix it.
     */
    private String deadEndText(int playlistEntries, int playlistCount, int libraryFiles,
                               boolean guideLoaded, String iaOutcome) {
        String what = "movie".equals(mode) ? displayTitle
                : String.format(Locale.US, "%s S%02dE%02d%s", showName, season, number,
                        epName == null || epName.isEmpty() ? "" : " · " + epName);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        b.append("No source for ").append(what).append(" yet.\n\n");
        b.append("Why: it's not on the free shelves this app checks, and none "
                + "of your own shelves carry it either.\n\n");
        b.append("Checked:\n");
        if (guideLoaded) {
            b.append("• Your playlists — ").append(playlistEntries)
                    .append(" entries across ").append(playlistCount)
                    .append(playlistCount == 1 ? " list" : " lists").append(": no match\n");
        } else {
            b.append("• Your playlists — the guide hasn't been loaded yet "
                    + "(open Live TV once), so they couldn't be checked\n");
        }
        b.append("• My Library (videos on this phone) — ").append(libraryFiles)
                .append(libraryFiles == 1 ? " file" : " files").append(" indexed: no match\n");
        b.append("• Internet Archive — ").append(iaOutcome).append("\n\n");
        b.append("What would fix it: add a playlist that carries it "
                + "(Live TV → Playlists), or put the video file on this phone "
                + "and index it (Catalog → My Library → Rescan). "
                + "Sandy never fakes a stream.");
        return b.toString();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- play

    /**
     * A tapped source goes through the health layer first (v0.3.0):
     * probe it, and only hand the player a link that answers. A dead
     * source is marked ✗, the user is told, and with auto-skip on the
     * next source down the list is tried — the TeaTV tap should never
     * end at a corpse when another source is sitting right there.
     */
    // ------------------------------------------------- episode tiers
    // v0.14.0 (Addenda 9–11): Archive candidates for THIS episode are
    // graded by EpisodeMatch evidence and carry their tier in the
    // row. CLOSE (the maybe pen) is shown for the viewer's own eyes
    // and is NEVER auto-played; MOSTLY is badged "Middle ground";
    // the playable promise belongs to RESOLVED alone.

    private final java.util.Map<String, Integer> epTiers =
            new java.util.HashMap<>();

    private void gradeEpisodeSources() {
        epTiers.clear();
        if (!"episode".equals(mode) && !"episodeDub".equals(mode)) return;
        EpisodeMatch.EpisodeRef ep = new EpisodeMatch.EpisodeRef(
                season, number, epName == null ? "" : epName, "", 0);
        for (SourceFinder.Source s : sources) {
            if (!"Internet Archive".equals(s.kind)) continue;
            EpisodeMatch.Parsed p = EpisodeMatch.parse(s.label, showName);
            EpisodeMatch.Scored sc = EpisodeMatch.score(p, ep);
