            int tier;
            if (sc.conflict) tier = EpisodeMatch.TIER_CLOSE;
            else if (sc.score >= 60) tier = EpisodeMatch.TIER_RESOLVED;
            else if (sc.score >= 35) tier = EpisodeMatch.TIER_MOSTLY;
            else tier = EpisodeMatch.TIER_CLOSE;
            epTiers.put(s.url, tier);
        }
    }

    private void appendTierLine() {
        if (epTiers.isEmpty()) return;
        int best = 0, mid = 0, maybe = 0;
        for (int t : epTiers.values()) {
            if (t == EpisodeMatch.TIER_RESOLVED) best++;
            else if (t == EpisodeMatch.TIER_MOSTLY) mid++;
            else maybe++;
        }
        StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder();
        line.append(" — ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "tier_best"))
                .append(" ").append(best)
                .append(" · ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "tier_middle"))
                .append(" ").append(mid)
                .append(" · ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "tier_maybe"))
                .append(" ").append(maybe).append(".");
        if (maybe > 0) {
            line.append(" ").append(LangStore.tr(this, "ep_maybe_note"));
        }
        statusView.setText(statusView.getText().toString() + line);
    }

    // Auto-play (v0.12.1, James's doctrine): a tap on a tile/episode
    // means PLAY — Sandy resolves and plays the best WORKING source
    // in the viewer's already-chosen language, under the quality
    // posture from Settings. Auto-pick is the default road, not a
    // wall: the source list stays fully reachable, and when nothing
    // working meets the posture's floor the viewer is OFFERED the
    // best working one — never served below-floor silently, never
    // dead-ended without the offer.
    private boolean autoPlayDone = false;

    private void maybeAutoPlay() {
        if (autoPlayDone || sources.isEmpty()) return;
        autoPlayDone = true;
        AutoPlay.Posture posture =
                AutoPlay.parsePosture(ChannelStore.getQualityPosture(this));
        String facet = UiStrings.facetFor(ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this));
        String marc = IaClient.iaLanguageCode(facet);
        java.util.Map<String, Integer> health = new java.util.HashMap<>();
        java.util.List<AutoPlay.Cand> cands = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        // Addendum 11: the maybe pen is never auto-played, and when
        // a best-choice (RESOLVED) candidate stands, the middle
        // ground waits for the viewer's own tap.
        boolean anyResolved = false;
        for (SourceFinder.Source s : sources) {
            Integer t = epTiers.get(s.url);
            if (t != null && t == EpisodeMatch.TIER_RESOLVED) anyResolved = true;
        }
        for (SourceFinder.Source s : sources) {
            Integer t = epTiers.get(s.url);
            if (t != null && t == EpisodeMatch.TIER_CLOSE) continue;
            if (t != null && anyResolved && t == EpisodeMatch.TIER_MOSTLY) {
                continue;
            }
            HealthStore.Health h = HealthStore.get(this, s.url);
            health.put(s.url, h == null ? AutoPlay.HEALTH_UNKNOWN : h.tier);
            cands.add(AutoPlay.candidates(
                    java.util.Collections.singletonList(s), health,
                    facet, marc).get(0));
        }
        double bps = PipeMeter.measuredBps(this);
        int cap = PipeMeter.capTierFor(bps);
        AutoPlay.Pick pick = AutoPlay.pick(cands, posture, cap);
        if (pick == null || pick.source == null) {
            // Everything on file is proven dead (or nothing found):
            // the list and its honest status line are the answer —
            // no auto-play, no invention.
            return;
        }
        SourceFinder.Source chosen = null;
        for (SourceFinder.Source s : sources) {
            if (s.url.equals(pick.source.url)) { chosen = s; break; }
        }
        if (chosen == null) return;
        final SourceFinder.Source target = chosen;
        if (pick.offer) {
            // Below the floor: say so plainly and OFFER.
            String body = String.format(
                    LangStore.tr(this, "auto_offer_body"),
                    PipeMeter.tierLabel(target.qualityTier),
                    PipeMeter.tierLabel(AutoPlay.FLOOR_TIER));
            new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "auto_offer_title"))
                    .setMessage(body)
                    .setPositiveButton(LangStore.tr(this, "auto_offer_play"),
                            (d, w) -> play(target))
                    .setNegativeButton(LangStore.tr(this, "auto_see_sources"),
                            (d, w) -> { })
                    .show();
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, String.format(
                    LangStore.tr(this, "auto_playing"),
                    PipeMeter.tierLabel(target.qualityTier),
                    AutoPlay.postureLabel(posture)),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            play(target);
        }
    }

    /**
     * v0.13.0: hold a source for the voiceover cook — a remote
     * source starts landing through the recordings door (the same
     * DownloadRequest the timer uses; its id is the URL), a local
     * source is already held. Either way the dub kitchen opens
     * with the pick in hand; if the copy is still landing, the
     * kitchen says so and waits (DubActivity's still-saving plan).
     */
    private void holdForDub(SourceFinder.Source s) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, DubActivity.class);
        String name = String.format(Locale.US, "%s S%02dE%02d",
                showName == null ? "" : showName, season, number);
        i.putExtra("pickName", name);
        if (LinkHealth.isRemote(s.url)) {
            boolean hls = s.url.contains(".m3u8") || "hls".equals(s.kind);
            Downloads.start(this, s.url, hls);
            i.putExtra("pickUrl", s.url);
            i.putExtra("pickRecording", true);
        } else {
            i.putExtra("pickUrl", s.url);
            i.putExtra("pickRecording", false);
        }
        startActivity(i);
        finish();
    }

    /** The same source, reached through the door that answered
     *  (Hydra's winning head) — everything else about it stands. */
    private static SourceFinder.Source copyWithUrl(
            SourceFinder.Source s, String url) {
        SourceFinder.Source c = new SourceFinder.Source();
        c.kind = s.kind;
        c.label = s.label;
        c.detail = s.detail;
        c.url = url;
        c.userAgent = s.userAgent;
        c.qualityLabel = s.qualityLabel;
        c.qualityTier = s.qualityTier;
        c.size = s.size;
        c.subUrl = s.subUrl;
        c.subMime = s.subMime;
        c.subLang = s.subLang;
        c.langFacet = s.langFacet;
        c.langMarc = s.langMarc;
        return c;
    }

    private void play(SourceFinder.Source s) {
        if (!LinkHealth.isRemote(s.url)) {
            launchSource(s);
            return;
        }
        progress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        statusView.setText("Checking that source…");
        java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor().execute(() -> {
            // Hydra proves the source (v0.14.0, the Connection
            // Law): the published manner is proven patiently
            // (SG-1: slow retries in place, the word "dead" is
            // never used while retries remain) — and when that
            // manner is what's dead, the LADDER advances to
            // another door (the Archive's canonical door, the
            // other scheme) instead of ending the attempt. The
            // door that answers is the door that plays.
            HydraResolver.Outcome o = HydraResolver.prove(this, s.url,
                    s.userAgent,
                    (headNo, headCount) -> runOnUiThread(() ->
                            statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this,
                                    "hydra_trying"))));
            LinkHealth.Result r = o.result;
            final SourceFinder.Source playSource =
                    o.url.equals(s.url) ? s : copyWithUrl(s, o.url);
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                progress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
                if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) {
                    launchSource(playSource);
                } else if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) {
                    // The playlist answered but the video is unproven —
                    // the player is the ground truth; try it, honestly.
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(this,
                            "That source answers, but its video is unproven — trying it.",
                            android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    launchSource(playSource);
                } else if (r.slow) {
                    // Not dead — slow. Nothing is marked; the honest
                    // sentence is what happened, and a re-tap (James's
                    // own fix on 2026-10-18) is one tap away.
                    statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 200, 140));
                    statusView.setText("That source didn't answer in time — "
                            + "it may just be slow. It is not marked dead; "
                            + "tap it again to retry.");
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(this,
                            "Didn't answer in time (" + r.detail + ") — "
                                    + "not dead, just slow. Tap again to retry.",
                            android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                } else {
                    // Failure words (v0.14.0): never a bare
                    // "HTTP error" — the surface states what the
                    // server actually said, in plain words.
                    statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 140, 140));
                    statusView.setText("That source is dead. "
                            + FailureWords.englishFor(r) + " Marked ✗.");
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(this,
                            "That source is dead. " + FailureWords.englishFor(r),
                            android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    if (ChannelStore.getAutoSkip(this)) {
                        int idx = sources.indexOf(s);
                        if (idx >= 0 && idx + 1 < sources.size()) {
                            statusView.setText("Trying the next source…");
                            play(sources.get(idx + 1));
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void launchSource(SourceFinder.Source s) {
        M3uParser.Channel ch = new M3uParser.Channel();
        ch.name = displayTitle;
        ch.url = s.url;
        ch.userAgent = s.userAgent == null ? "" : s.userAgent;
        ch.source = s.kind;
        List<M3uParser.Channel> queue = new ArrayList<>();
        queue.add(ch);
        ChannelStore.playQueue = queue;
        ChannelStore.playIndex = 0;

        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("url", s.url);
        i.putExtra("name", displayTitle);
        i.putExtra("ua", ch.userAgent);
        i.putExtra("ckey", contentKey);
        // v0.14.0: the episode context rides along so the player
        // can pre-resolve the NEXT episode while this one plays
        // (one tap to the next episode). Movies carry no next.
        if ("episode".equals(mode) || "episodeDub".equals(mode)) {
            i.putExtra("epShowId", showId);
            i.putExtra("epSeason", season);
            i.putExtra("epNumber", number);
            i.putExtra("epName", epName == null ? "" : epName);
            i.putExtra("epShowName", showName == null ? "" : showName);
            i.putExtra("epShowLang", showLanguage == null ? "" : showLanguage);
        }
        // Posture note (v0.12.1): the player states when the
        // posture materially shaped the pick ("Playing 480p —
        // Low First") and applies the posture to HLS variants.
        {
            AutoPlay.Posture p = AutoPlay.parsePosture(
                    ChannelStore.getQualityPosture(this));
            i.putExtra("posture", AutoPlay.posturePref(p));
            i.putExtra("postureNote", "Playing "
                    + PipeMeter.tierLabel(s.qualityTier) + " — "
                    + AutoPlay.postureLabel(p));
        }
        // Prepared dub (v0.4.0): a library file with a .dub-en sidecar
        // beside it hands the dub to the player.
        if ("My Library".equals(s.kind)) {
            String dub = findDubFor(s.url);
            if (dub != null) i.putExtra("dubUrl", dub);
            // v0.6.0: cooked translation sidecars ride too — the
            // translated subtitle becomes the title's subtitle track
            // (when nothing else already provides one), its rich
            // record goes along for the parallel view + voice render,
            // and a prepared dub in the viewer's own language wins
            // over the English default.
            String lang = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
            if (lang == null || lang.isEmpty()) lang = "en";
            String[] tr = findTrFor(s.url, lang);
            if (tr != null) {
                if (s.subUrl == null || s.subUrl.isEmpty()) {
                    i.putExtra("subUrl", tr[0]);
                    i.putExtra("subMime", tr[0].endsWith(".vtt")
                            ? "text/vtt" : "application/x-subrip");
                    i.putExtra("subLang", lang);
                }
                if (tr[1] != null) i.putExtra("trJsonUrl", tr[1]);
            }
            if (!"en".equals(lang)) {
                String dubLang = findDubLangFor(s.url, lang);
                if (dubLang != null) i.putExtra("dubUrl", dubLang);
            }
        }
        if (s.subUrl != null && !s.subUrl.isEmpty()) {
            i.putExtra("subUrl", s.subUrl);
            i.putExtra("subMime", s.subMime);
            i.putExtra("subLang", s.subLang);
        }
        startActivity(i);
    }

    /** Dub sidecar lookup for a library source URL; null when none. */
    private String findDubFor(String url) {
        try {
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : LibraryStore.loadEntries(this)) {
                if (e.uri != null && e.uri.equals(url)) {
                    return DubFinder.findDub(this, e);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    /** Prepared dub in a specific language for a library source URL. */
    private String findDubLangFor(String url, String lang) {
        try {
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : LibraryStore.loadEntries(this)) {
                if (e.uri != null && e.uri.equals(url)) {
                    return DubFinder.findDubLang(this, e, lang);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Cooked translation sidecars for a library source URL:
     * {playableSrtOrVtt, richJsonOrNull}, or null when neither exists.
     */
    private String[] findTrFor(String url, String lang) {
        try {
            for (LibraryIndex.Entry e : LibraryStore.loadEntries(this)) {
                if (e.uri != null && e.uri.equals(url)) {
                    String sub = DubFinder.findTrSub(this, e, lang);
                    if (sub == null) return null;
                    String json = DubFinder.findAny(this, e,
                            java.util.Collections.singletonList(
                                    DubTrack.trJsonName(e.fileName, lang)), true);
                    return new String[]{sub, json};
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- adapter

    private final class SourceAdapter extends BaseAdapter {
        @Override public int getCount() { return sources.size(); }
        @Override public Object getItem(int pos) { return sources.get(pos); }
        @Override public long getItemId(int pos) { return pos; }

        @Override
        public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
            LinearLayout ll;
            TextView main, sub;
            if (convertView instanceof LinearLayout) {
                ll = (LinearLayout) convertView;
                main = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(0);
                sub = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(1);
            } else {
                ll = new LinearLayout(SourcesActivity.this);
                ll.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                ll.setPadding(dp(8), dp(9), dp(8), dp(9));
                main = new TextView(SourcesActivity.this);
                main.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                main.setTextSize(15);
                sub = new TextView(SourcesActivity.this);
                sub.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                sub.setTextSize(12);
                ll.addView(main);
                ll.addView(sub);
            }
            SourceFinder.Source s = sources.get(pos);
            main.setText("[" + s.qualityLabel + "]  " + s.label);
            StringBuilder d = new StringBuilder();
            // Episode-identity tier badge (Addendum 11): doubt is
            // badged, never hidden; RESOLVED rows need no badge —
            // they are the promise class.
            Integer tier = epTiers.get(s.url);
            if (tier != null && tier != EpisodeMatch.TIER_RESOLVED) {
                d.append(LangStore.tr(SourcesActivity.this,
                        EpisodeMatch.tierKey(tier))).append(" · ");
            }
            // Health badge from the probe record
            HealthStore.Health hh = HealthStore.get(SourcesActivity.this, s.url);
            d.append(hh == null ? "? Not checked yet"
                    : HealthStore.badgeText(hh, System.currentTimeMillis())).append(" · ");
            d.append(s.kind);
            if (s.detail != null && !s.detail.isEmpty()) d.append(" · ").append(s.detail);
            if (s.size > 0) d.append(" · ").append(humanSize(s.size));
            if (s.subUrl != null && !s.subUrl.isEmpty()) {
                d.append(" · + subtitles");
                if (s.subLang != null && !s.subLang.isEmpty()) {
                    d.append(" (").append(s.subLang).append(")");
                }
            }
            sub.setText(d.toString());
            return ll;
        }
    }

    static String humanSize(long bytes) {
        if (bytes >= 1_000_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f GB", bytes / 1e9);
        }
        if (bytes >= 1_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f MB", bytes / 1e6);
        }
        return bytes + " B";
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SpeakActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.provider.OpenableColumns;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * SPEAK FOR ME (v0.15.0) — the door for a person who cannot
 * speak. Type, tap SPEAK, and Sandy says it aloud in the room,
 * through the voice ladder (installed pack → phone voice → a
 * plain refusal shown BEFORE anything is promised — never a
 * silent wrong voice). The words stay on screen as the receipt
 * while and after she speaks.
 *
 * Two roads in: the typed box, and a DOCUMENT through the
 * universal BookText intake (PDF/EPUB/TXT/HTML/DOCX/ODT/RTF) —
 * nobody retypes what already exists as a file. Scanned and
 * unsupported files are named honestly (book_scanned /
 * book_unsupported), never faked.
 *
 * Quick phrases are kept as a FILE on the memory hook
 * (speak_phrases.tsv) — file in, file out.
 */
public final class SpeakActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_DOC = 71;
    private static final String PREFS = "sandy_doors";
    private static final String PHRASES_FILE = "speak_phrases.tsv";

    private VoiceSpeaker speaker;
    private final SpeakQueue queue = new SpeakQueue();
    private List<VoiceLangs.Row> langs = new ArrayList<>();
    private VoiceLangs.Row chosen;
    private List<String> phrases = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText box;
    private TextView voiceLine;
    private TextView stateLine;
    private TextView receiptView;
    private Button langBtn;
    private LinearLayout phraseBox;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "door_speak"));
        langs = VoiceLangs.load(this);
        String saved = prefs().getString("speak_lang", "");
        chosen = VoiceLangs.byIso1(langs, saved);
        if (chosen == null) {
            String ui = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
            chosen = VoiceLangs.byIso1(langs, ui == null || ui.isEmpty() ? "en" : ui);
        }
        if (chosen == null && !langs.isEmpty()) chosen = langs.get(0);

        int pad = dp(16);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "door_speak"));
        title.setTextSize(24);
        root.addView(title);

        // language + its honest coverage state, before speaking
        TextView langLabel = new TextView(this);
        langLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_language"));
        langLabel.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(langLabel, topMargin(dp(12)));
        langBtn = new Button(this);
        langBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        langBtn.setTextSize(19);
        langBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickLanguage());
        root.addView(langBtn);
        voiceLine = new TextView(this);
        voiceLine.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(voiceLine, topMargin(dp(4)));

        box = new EditText(this);
        box.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_hint"));
        box.setTextSize(22);
        box.setMinLines(4);
        box.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.TOP | android.view.Gravity.START);
        root.addView(box, topMargin(dp(12)));

        Button sayBtn = new Button(this);
        sayBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_say"));
        sayBtn.setTextSize(26);
        sayBtn.setMinHeight(dp(80));
        sayBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> speakBox());
        root.addView(sayBtn, topMargin(dp(10)));

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
        row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button clearBtn = smallButton(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_clear"), v -> {
            box.setText("");
            stateLine.setText("");
        });
        Button repeatBtn = smallButton(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_repeat"), v -> repeatLast());
        Button stopBtn = smallButton(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_stop"), v -> {
            speaker.stop();
            queue.clear();
            stateLine.setText("");
        });
        row.addView(clearBtn, weight());
        row.addView(repeatBtn, weight());
        row.addView(stopBtn, weight());
        root.addView(row, topMargin(dp(8)));

        Button docBtn = new Button(this);
        docBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_doc"));
        docBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        docBtn.setTextSize(18);
        docBtn.setMinHeight(dp(60));
        docBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickDocument());
        root.addView(docBtn, topMargin(dp(10)));

        stateLine = new TextView(this);
        stateLine.setTextSize(16);
        root.addView(stateLine, topMargin(dp(10)));

        TextView lastLabel = new TextView(this);
        lastLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_last"));
        lastLabel.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(lastLabel, topMargin(dp(12)));
        receiptView = new TextView(this);
        receiptView.setTextSize(20);
        root.addView(receiptView);

        TextView phrasesLabel = new TextView(this);
        phrasesLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_phrases"));
        phrasesLabel.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(phrasesLabel, topMargin(dp(14)));
        phraseBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        phraseBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.addView(phraseBox);
        Button addPhraseBtn = smallButton(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_phrase_add"), v -> {
            String t = box.getText().toString().trim();
            if (t.isEmpty()) {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_type_first"));
                return;
            }
            phrases = QuickPhrases.add(phrases, t);
            savePhrases();
            showPhrases();
        });
        root.addView(addPhraseBtn, topMargin(dp(6)));

        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.addView(root);
        setContentView(scroll);

        speaker = new VoiceSpeaker(this);
        speaker.setListener(new VoiceSpeaker.Listener() {
            @Override public void onItemStart(SpeakQueue.Item item) {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(SpeakActivity.this, "speak_speaking"));
                receiptView.setText(item.text);
            }
            @Override public void onQueueDone() {
                stateLine.setText("");
                SpeakQueue.Item last = queue.lastSpoken();
                if (last != null) receiptView.setText(last.text);
            }
            @Override public void onPackFailed(String packCode) {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(SpeakActivity.this,
                        "reader_voice_pack_fail"));
            }
            @Override public void onItemFailed(SpeakQueue.Item item) {
                stateLine.setText(voiceStateText());
            }
        });
        speaker.warmUp(this::refreshLanguageUi);
        loadPhrases();
        showPhrases();
        refreshLanguageUi();

        // Handed words from Listen ("take these words to the
        // Translator" is the other door; Speak also accepts a
        // hand-off extra when some other room sends text here).
        String handed = getIntent().getStringExtra("speak_text");
        if (handed != null && !handed.trim().isEmpty()) {
            box.setText(handed);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (speaker != null) speaker.shutdown();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ language

    private void refreshLanguageUi() {
        if (chosen == null) return;
        langBtn.setText(chosen.tvName);
        voiceLine.setText(voiceStateText());
    }

    /** The coverage line for the chosen language — the promise,
     *  made from the ladder BEFORE speaking. */
    private String voiceStateText() {
        if (chosen == null) return "";
        VoiceResolve.Result r = SpeakQueue.decide(chosen,
                VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this), speaker.systemIso1());
        switch (r.voice) {
            case PACK:
                return String.format(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_voice_pack"),
                        chosen.tvName);
            case SYSTEM:
                return String.format(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_voice_system"),
                        chosen.tvName);
            default:
                return String.format(LangStore.tr(this, "dub_voice_none"),
                        chosen.tvName);
        }
    }

    private void pickLanguage() {
        List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
        for (VoiceLangs.Row r : langs) {
            VoiceResolve.Result v = SpeakQueue.decide(r,
                    VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this), speaker.systemIso1());
            String state = v.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.PACK
                    ? LangStore.tr(this, "voice_state_pack")
                    : v.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.SYSTEM
                    ? LangStore.tr(this, "voice_state_system")
                    : LangStore.tr(this, "voice_state_none");
            labels.add(r.tvName + " — " + state);
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_language"))
                .setItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]), (d, which) -> {
                    chosen = langs.get(which);
                    prefs().edit().putString("speak_lang", chosen.iso1).apply();
                    refreshLanguageUi();
                })
                .show();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ speaking

    /** The refusal runs BEFORE the queue accepts anything: with
     *  no voice for the chosen language, nothing is promised. */
    private boolean voiceReady() {
        VoiceResolve.Result r = SpeakQueue.decide(chosen,
                VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this), speaker.systemIso1());
        if (r.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE) {
            stateLine.setText(voiceStateText());
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void speakBox() {
        String t = box.getText().toString().trim();
        if (t.isEmpty()) {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_type_first"));
            return;
        }
        if (!voiceReady()) return;
        queue.enqueue(t, chosen.iso1);
        speaker.speak(queue);
    }

    private void repeatLast() {
        if (!voiceReady()) return;
        if (queue.repeatLast()) {
            speaker.speak(queue);
        } else {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_type_first"));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ phrases

    private void loadPhrases() {
        try {
            String body = MemoryHook.read(this, PHRASES_FILE);
            phrases = QuickPhrases.parse(body == null ? "" : body);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            phrases = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    private void savePhrases() {
        try {
            MemoryHook.write(this, PHRASES_FILE, QuickPhrases.serialize(phrases));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void showPhrases() {
        phraseBox.removeAllViews();
        for (String p : phrases) {
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText(p);
            b.setAllCaps(false);
            b.setTextSize(18);
            b.setMinHeight(dp(56));
            // a tap speaks the phrase at once — that is its job
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (!voiceReady()) return;
                queue.enqueue(p, chosen.iso1);
                speaker.speak(queue);
            });
            b.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
                phrases = QuickPhrases.remove(phrases, p);
                savePhrases();
                showPhrases();
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_phrase_remove") + ": " + p);
                return true;
            });
            phraseBox.addView(b, topMargin(dp(4)));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ document road

    private void pickDocument() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("*/*");
        startActivityForResult(i, REQ_DOC);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int result, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, result, data);
        if (req != REQ_DOC || result != RESULT_OK
                || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
        Uri uri = data.getData();
        String name = displayName(uri);
        stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_working"));
        new Thread(() -> {
            BookText.Result r;
            try {
                byte[] bytes = readAll(uri);
                r = BookText.extract(bytes, name);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                r = new BookText.Result();
                r.ok = false;
                r.failReason = BookText.NO_TEXT_FOUND;
            }
            final BookText.Result res = r;
            runOnUiThread(() -> onDocumentText(res));
        }, "speak-doc").start();
    }

    private void onDocumentText(BookText.Result r) {
        if (r == null || !r.ok) {
            String reason = r == null ? "" : r.failReason;
            if (BookText.SCANNED_NO_TEXT.equals(reason)) {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "book_scanned"));
            } else if (BookText.UNSUPPORTED_KIND.equals(reason)) {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "book_unsupported"));
            } else {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "speak_doc_failed"));
            }
            return;
        }
        box.setText(r.text.length() > 4000
                ? r.text.substring(0, 4000) : r.text);
        receiptView.setText("");
        stateLine.setText("");
        if (!voiceReady()) return;
        queue.enqueueDocument(r.text, chosen.iso1);
        speaker.speak(queue);
    }

    private String displayName(Uri uri) {
        String name = "document";
        try (Cursor c = getContentResolver().query(uri, null, null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                int idx = c.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                    String n = c.getString(idx);
                    if (n != null && !n.isEmpty()) name = n;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return name;
    }

    private byte[] readAll(Uri uri) throws Exception {
        try (InputStream in = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
             ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
            return out.toByteArray();
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private SharedPreferences prefs() {
        return getSharedPreferences(PREFS, MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams topMargin(int m) {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = m;
        return lp;
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams weight() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1);
    }

    private Button smallButton(String label, android.view.View.OnClickListener on) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setTextSize(16);
        b.setOnClickListener(on);
        return b;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SpeakQueue.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * SPEAK FOR ME's queue (v0.15.0) — the words a person hands Sandy
 * to say out loud, in order. Pure model, no Android: the door
 * (SpeakActivity) and the Translator both fill it; VoiceSpeaker
 * drains it through the voice ladder.
 *
 * The ladder decision lives here as data, delegating to
 * VoiceResolve (v0.13.0): PACK (an installed Sandy voice pack) →
 * SYSTEM (the phone's own voice) → NONE. NONE is a refusal the
 * caller must speak BEFORE anything is promised — never a silent
 * wrong-language or glitchy substitute (the Max Headroom floor).
 *
 * Long texts are cut into speakable blocks with the house cutter
 * (BookTranslator.blocks, ~480 chars on sentence ends) so a whole
 * typed paragraph or a document chapter is a run of utterances,
 * not one impossible breath.
 */
public final class SpeakQueue {

    public static final class Item {
        public final String text;
        public final String iso1;
        public Item(String text, String iso1) {
            this.text = text == null ? "" : text;
            this.iso1 = iso1 == null ? "" : iso1;
        }
    }

    private final List<Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
    private int cursor = 0;
    /** The last item actually handed to a voice (the receipt). */
    private Item lastSpoken;

    /** Enqueue one message, cut into blocks when it runs long. */
    public void enqueue(String text, String iso1) {
        if (text == null) return;
        String t = text.trim();
        if (t.isEmpty()) return;
        for (String block : BookTranslator.blocks(t)) {
            String b = block.trim();
            if (!b.isEmpty()) items.add(new Item(b, iso1));
        }
    }

    /** Enqueue document text: many blocks, one language. */
    public void enqueueDocument(String text, String iso1) {
        enqueue(text, iso1);
    }

    public int size() { return items.size(); }

    public boolean isEmpty() { return cursor >= items.size(); }

    /** The next item to speak, or null when the queue is drained. */
    public Item peek() {
        return isEmpty() ? null : items.get(cursor);
    }

    /** Mark the peeked item spoken and move on. */
    public Item advance() {
        Item it = peek();
        if (it != null) {
            lastSpoken = it;
            cursor++;
        }
        return it;
    }

    /** The receipt: the last words Sandy actually said. */
    public Item lastSpoken() { return lastSpoken; }

    /** Repeat = speak the last thing again (re-queued at the head). */
    public boolean repeatLast() {
        if (lastSpoken == null) return false;
        items.add(cursor, lastSpoken);
        return true;
    }

    public void clear() {
        items.clear();
        cursor = 0;
    }

    /** Every item still unspoken, in order (the harness reads this). */
    public List<Item> pending() {
        List<Item> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = cursor; i < items.size(); i++) out.add(items.get(i));
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * The ladder decision for one language, made from live sets:
     * installed pack codes and the phone-voice ISO set, both probed
     * by the caller. NONE means refuse — the door says so before
     * promising a sound.
     */
    public static VoiceResolve.Result decide(VoiceLangs.Row row,
                                             Set<String> installedPackCodes,
                                             Set<String> systemIso1) {
        return VoiceResolve.resolve(row, installedPackCodes, systemIso1);
    }

    public static boolean canSpeak(VoiceLangs.Row row,
                                   Set<String> installedPackCodes,
                                   Set<String> systemIso1) {
        return decide(row, installedPackCodes, systemIso1).voice
                != VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SplashActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.FrameLayout;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/**
 * The boot screen (v0.4.0, James's order: "Make it have a boot screen
 * with that picture on it"). The launcher entry: the recliner-lady
 * picture — James's design, his mother in front of the TV — full-bleed
 * on the art's own dark navy, "Sandy" baked under it as a wordmark.
 *
 * No white flash: the picture is ALSO the window background (theme),
 * so the very first frame the system draws is already the boot screen.
 * On Android 12+ the platform splash uses the same background color
 * and the app icon, handing into this screen without a jolt.
 *
 * The hold is honest, not theater: the screen stays while real
 * startup work runs — the channel-guide warm-up (first install) and
 * the verdict auto-fresh trigger — with a ~1.2 s minimum brand beat,
 * and a hard ~3.5 s cap so a slow network can never trap anyone on
 * it. Then straight into the home screen.
 */
public class SplashActivity extends Activity {

    private static final long MIN_HOLD_MS = 1200;
    private static final long MAX_HOLD_MS = 3500;

    private volatile boolean navigated = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        CrashGuard.install(this);
        // Hydra's learned doors: prime the ladder memory from
        // the memory hook before anything resolves (v0.14.0).
        HydraStore.prime(this);

        FrameLayout root = new FrameLayout(this);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(5, 18, 38));
        ImageView art = new ImageView(this);
        art.setImageResource(R.drawable.splash_art);
        art.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
        art.setContentDescription("Sandy");
        root.addView(art, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
        setContentView(root);

        long started = System.currentTimeMillis();
        CountDownLatch warm = new CountDownLatch(1);
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                // Verdict warm-up: stale checks start re-verifying now
                // (favorites first); it finishes in the background.
                FreshVerify.maybeRun(getApplicationContext(),
                        () -> ChannelStore.loadCache(getApplicationContext()), null);
                // Directory warm-up: first install only — later opens
                // already have the cached guide.
                MainActivity.warmUpDirectory(getApplicationContext());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // warm-up is a head start, never a gate
            } finally {
                warm.countDown();
            }
        }, "sandy-boot").start();

        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                warm.await(MAX_HOLD_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
                long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - started;
                if (elapsed < MIN_HOLD_MS) {
                    Thread.sleep(MIN_HOLD_MS - elapsed);
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
            runOnUiThread(this::goHome);
        }, "sandy-boot-timer").start();
    }

    private void goHome() {
        if (navigated || isFinishing()) return;
        navigated = true;
        // First run (v0.5.0): the language comes before everything —
        // a person who picks Sandy up must be able to leave English
        // in the first ten seconds, or they won't stay (James's ruling).
        Class<?> next = ChannelStore.hasChosenLanguage(this)
                ? HomeActivity.class : LanguageActivity.class;
        startActivity(new Intent(this, next));
        finish();
        overridePendingTransition(android.R.anim.fade_in, android.R.anim.fade_out);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        // The boot screen is a doorway, not a room: back does nothing
        // for the second it is up (and never dumps anyone at a dead end).
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/Stance.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * The Live TV stance (v0.6.0, field note #2d: "BACK LOSES YOUR
 * PLACE"). The complaint was never only the scroll: coming back from
 * a channel, the viewer had to reselect the LANGUAGE though he'd
 * just selected the genre — the whole stance was thrown away.
 *
 * A stance is the viewer's whole place in Live TV, kept as one
 * record: the three facets, the search text, the working-only
 * toggle, and where in the list they were standing (row + offset).
 * Live TV saves it whenever the viewer leaves for the player and
 * restores it on return — navigation gets the same position-hook
 * law as playback (item 8), applied to the list itself.
 *
 * Pure logic; the harness round-trips it.
 */
public final class Stance {

    public String genre = "";
    public String language = "";
    public String country = "";
    public String query = "";
    public boolean workingOnly = false;
    public int firstVisible = 0;
    public int topPx = 0;

    public Stance() {}

    public String toJson() throws Exception {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
        o.put("genre", genre);
        o.put("language", language);
        o.put("country", country);
        o.put("query", query);
        o.put("workingOnly", workingOnly);
        o.put("firstVisible", firstVisible);
        o.put("topPx", topPx);
        return o.toString();
    }

    public static Stance fromJson(String text) {
        Stance s = new Stance();
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) return s;
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject(text);
            s.genre = o.optString("genre", "");
            s.language = o.optString("language", "");
            s.country = o.optString("country", "");
            s.query = o.optString("query", "");
            s.workingOnly = o.optBoolean("workingOnly", false);
            s.firstVisible = o.optInt("firstVisible", 0);
            s.topPx = o.optInt("topPx", 0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // a corrupt stance is no stance — the screen opens fresh
        }
        return s;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

/**
 * The Story door (v0.14.0) — a room in Sandy's house where
 * children are guests. Big tiles, big type, calm colors; entry
 * is free, and LEAVING passes the grown-up gate (the back
 * button included), so a child can't wander out of the room by
 * accident and nothing leaves the room unapproved.
 */
public class StoryActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_EXIT = 41;

    private Button bedtimeBtn;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        int pad = dp(18);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(34);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        title.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        root.addView(title);

        root.addView(tile(LangStore.tr(this, "story_shelf"), v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, StoryShelfActivity.class))));
        root.addView(tile(LangStore.tr(this, "story_make"), v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, StoryMakeActivity.class))));
        root.addView(tile(LangStore.tr(this, "story_my_stories"), v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, StoryPlayActivity.class))));
        root.addView(tile(LangStore.tr(this, "story_family_voices"), v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, StoryRecordActivity.class))));
        root.addView(tile(LangStore.tr(this, "story_journals"), v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(this, JournalsActivity.class))));

        bedtimeBtn = tile("", v -> {
            boolean on = !StoryFiles.bedtime(this);
            StoryFiles.setBedtime(this, on);
            paintBedtime();
        });
        root.addView(bedtimeBtn);
        paintBedtime();

        Button exit = new Button(this);
        exit.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_exit"));
        exit.setTextSize(16);
        exit.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 200));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(56));
        lp.topMargin = dp(22);
        exit.setOnClickListener(v -> askToLeave());
        root.addView(exit, lp);

        setContentView(root);
    }

    private Button tile(String label, android.view.View.OnClickListener on) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setTextSize(24);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(84));
        lp.topMargin = dp(12);
        b.setLayoutParams(lp);
        b.setOnClickListener(on);
        return b;
    }

    private void paintBedtime() {
        boolean on = StoryFiles.bedtime(this);
        bedtimeBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_bedtime")
                + (on ? "  ✓" : ""));
        if (on) {
            bedtimeBtn.setContentDescription(
                    LangStore.tr(this, "story_bedtime_on"));
        }
    }

    private void askToLeave() {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, GrownUpGateActivity.class);
        startActivityForResult(i, REQ_EXIT);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        askToLeave();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int result, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, result, data);
        if (req == REQ_EXIT && result == RESULT_OK) {
            // leave without re-entering the gate
            super.onBackPressed();
        }
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryCast.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The story book's voice book (v0.14.0) — the dub's VoiceBook
 * casting pointed at storybooks. A book is cast ONCE: a narrator
 * and one voice per character, saved as a file on the memory
 * hook, so the witch sounds like the witch in every chapter.
 *
 * A cast entry is one of:
 *   narrator  — reads everything that isn't dialogue
 *   character — a named person in the tale, with a pitch/rate of
 *               their own (applied over the pack or phone voice)
 *   family    — a real person of the house (Grandma, Dad) who
 *               recorded their own reading; where a recording
 *               covers a passage, the recording plays and no
 *               synthesized voice speaks that passage at all.
 *
 * Dialogue attribution is a heuristic and is honest about it:
 * quoted speech is found by the quote marks; the speaker is the
 * name a speech verb leans on ("…," said the Fox / "…" cried
 * Mother); speech nobody claims is read by the narrator. The
 * cast is collected over the whole book before the first telling
 * so voices never swap mid-book.
 *
 * Pure logic + org.json; the harness drives it with fixtures.
 */
public final class StoryCast {

    public static final String NARRATOR = "Narrator";

    /** Deterministic casting palette (pitch, rate) for characters,
     *  in enrollment order — the same book always casts the same. */
    public static final double[][] PALETTE = {
            {1.30, 1.00}, {0.78, 0.95}, {1.50, 1.05}, {0.65, 0.90},
            {1.12, 1.10}, {0.90, 1.00}, {1.65, 0.98}, {0.72, 1.08},
            {1.42, 0.92}, {0.85, 1.12}, {1.22, 0.88}, {0.60, 1.02},
    };

    public static final class Entry {
        public String name = "";
        public boolean narrator = false;
        public boolean family = false;
        public double pitch = 1.0;
        public double rate = 1.0;
        /** The phone-voice name to prefer, "" = the engine default. */
        public String ttsVoice = "";
        /** The bundled picture card that IS this character in this
         *  book (StoryPanels) — assigned once, never changes. */
        public String cardId = "";
        /** Family recordings: chunk index -> audio file name. */
        public final Map<Integer, String> recordings = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    }

    public static final class Book {
        public String bookId = "";
        public String title = "";
        public String lang = "";       // ISO-1 the book is written in
        public final List<Entry> cast = new ArrayList<>();

        public Entry narrator() {
            for (Entry e : cast) if (e.narrator) return e;
            return null;
        }

        public Entry byName(String name) {
            if (name == null) return null;
            for (Entry e : cast) {
                if (e.name.equalsIgnoreCase(name)) return e;
            }
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** One speakable piece of a chunk: who says it, and the words. */
    public static final class Segment {
        public final String speaker;   // a cast name, or NARRATOR
        public final String text;
        public Segment(String speaker, String text) {
            this.speaker = speaker;
            this.text = text;
        }
    }

    private StoryCast() {}

    /** A fresh book with only its narrator cast (calm pace). */
    public static Book newBook(String bookId, String title, String lang) {
        Book b = new Book();
        b.bookId = bookId == null ? "" : bookId;
        b.title = title == null ? "" : title;
        b.lang = lang == null ? "" : lang;
        Entry n = new Entry();
        n.name = NARRATOR;
        n.narrator = true;
        n.pitch = 1.0;
        n.rate = 0.92;
        b.cast.add(n);
        return b;
    }

    /**
     * Cast a character by name — an existing entry wins (by name,
     * case-insensitive); a new name takes the next palette slot.
     * Curated cast names are enrolled through here too, so a
     * curated witch and a discovered witch are the same person.
     */
    public static Entry enroll(Book b, String name) {
        if (b == null || name == null) return null;
        String clean = name.trim();
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return b.narrator();
        Entry found = b.byName(clean);
        if (found != null) return found;
        Entry e = new Entry();
        e.name = clean;
        int slot = 0;
        for (Entry x : b.cast) if (!x.narrator) slot++;
        double[] pr = PALETTE[slot % PALETTE.length];
        e.pitch = pr[0];
        e.rate = pr[1];
        b.cast.add(e);
        return e;
    }

    /** Cast a family member as themselves (their own voice). */
    public static Entry enrollFamily(Book b, String name) {
        Entry e = enroll(b, name);
        if (e != null) {
            e.family = true;
            e.pitch = 1.0;
            e.rate = 1.0;
        }
        return e;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ attribution

    private static final String[] VERBS = {
            "said", "asked", "cried", "whispered", "shouted", "replied",
            "answered", "called", "laughed", "sighed", "exclaimed",
            "murmured", "growled", "begged", "warned", "promised",
            "declared", "remarked", "screamed", "sobbed", "grumbled",
    };

    private static final String OPENQ = "“\"‘«";
    private static final String CLOSEQ = "”\"’»";

    /**
     * Split one chunk of book text into speakable segments.
     * {@code knownNames} are the book's cast names (the curation's
     * list plus everyone enrolled so far); a speech tag naming
     * one of them — or a capitalized name-like tag — enrolls and
     * attributes. Unclaimed speech falls to the narrator, except
     * a quote that directly continues the previous segment's
     * speaker in the same chunk, which stays with that speaker.
     */
    public static List<Segment> attribute(Book book, String text) {
        List<Segment> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null || text.trim().isEmpty()) return out;
        String lastSpeaker = NARRATOR;
        int i = 0, n = text.length();
        StringBuilder narration = new StringBuilder();
        while (i < n) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (OPENQ.indexOf(c) >= 0) {
                int close = findClose(text, i + 1, c);
                if (close < 0) { narration.append(c); i++; continue; }
                String spoken = text.substring(i + 1, close).trim();
                // the tag zone: a little narration on both sides
                String before = narration.toString();
                int afterEnd = close + 1;
                StringBuilder afterBuf = new StringBuilder();
                while (afterEnd < n && text.charAt(afterEnd) != '.'
                        && text.charAt(afterEnd) != '!'
                        && text.charAt(afterEnd) != '?'
                        && OPENQ.indexOf(text.charAt(afterEnd)) < 0
                        && afterBuf.length() < 60) {
                    afterBuf.append(text.charAt(afterEnd));
                    afterEnd++;
                }
                String speaker = findSpeaker(book,
                        before.substring(Math.max(0, before.length() - 60)),
                        afterBuf.toString());
                if (speaker == null) {
                    // unclaimed: a quote opening mid-exchange (the
                    // narration between is only a tag remnant)
                    // stays with the last speaker; otherwise the
                    // narrator reads it.
                    speaker = before.trim().length() <= 3
                            && !lastSpeaker.equals(NARRATOR)
                            ? lastSpeaker : NARRATOR;
                }
                if (!before.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    emit(out, NARRATOR, before);
                    narration = new StringBuilder();
                }
                if (!spoken.isEmpty()) {
                    emit(out, speaker, spoken);
                    if (!speaker.equals(NARRATOR)) lastSpeaker = speaker;
                }
                // the tag remnant after the quote is narration
                narration.append(afterBuf);
                i = afterEnd;
            } else {
                narration.append(c);
                i++;
            }
        }
        if (!narration.toString().trim().isEmpty()) {
            emit(out, NARRATOR, narration.toString());
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static void emit(List<Segment> out, String speaker, String text) {
        String t = text.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (t.isEmpty()) return;
        if (!out.isEmpty() && out.get(out.size() - 1).speaker.equals(speaker)) {
            Segment prev = out.get(out.size() - 1);
            out.set(out.size() - 1, new Segment(speaker, prev.text + " " + t));
            return;
        }
        out.add(new Segment(speaker, t));
    }

    /** The closing quote PAIRED with the opener — an apostrophe
     *  inside dialogue ("don’t") must never end a quote early. */
    private static int findClose(String text, int from, char open) {
        char want;
        switch (open) {
            case '“': want = '”'; break;
            case '‘': want = '’'; break;
            case '«': want = '»'; break;
            case '"': want = '"'; break;
            case '\'': want = '\''; break;
            default: want = 0;
        }
        for (int i = from; i < text.length(); i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (want != 0 ? c == want : CLOSEQ.indexOf(c) >= 0) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /**
     * Find who a speech verb leans on, in the tag before or after
     * a quote. Patterns: "said the Fox", "the Fox said", "said
     * Alice", "Mother cried". A candidate must be a cast name or
     * look like one (a capitalized word or two, optionally led by
     * "the"). Returns the cast entry's canonical name, enrolling
     * a new character when the tag names a plausible new person.
     */
    public static String findSpeaker(Book book, String before, String after) {
        String hit = scanTag(book, after, true);
        if (hit != null) return hit;
        return scanTag(book, before, false);
    }

    private static String scanTag(Book book, String tag, boolean afterQuote) {
        if (tag == null) return null;
        String t = " " + tag.replaceAll("[,;:]", " ").trim() + " ";
        String low = t.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        for (String verb : VERBS) {
            int vi = low.indexOf(" " + verb + " ");
            if (vi < 0) continue;
            String rest = afterQuote
                    ? t.substring(vi + verb.length() + 1)
                    : t.substring(0, vi);
            String name = nameFrom(book, rest, afterQuote);
            if (name != null) return name;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String nameFrom(Book book, String rest, boolean forward) {
        String[] words = rest.trim().split("\\s+");
        if (words.length == 0) return null;
        // known cast names first (longest match, either direction)
        String joined = " " + rest.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.US) + " ";
        String best = null;
        for (Entry e : book.cast) {
            if (e.narrator) continue;
            String nm = " " + e.name.toLowerCase(Locale.US) + " ";
            if (joined.contains(nm) && (best == null
                    || e.name.length() > best.length())) {
                best = e.name;
            }
        }
        if (best != null) return best;
        // a plausible new name: [the] Capitalized [Capitalized]
        List<String> seq = new ArrayList<>();
        if (forward) {
            for (String w : words) {
                String c = cleanWord(w);
                if (c.equalsIgnoreCase("the") && seq.isEmpty()) continue;
                if (isNameWord(c)) { seq.add(c); if (seq.size() == 2) break; }
                else break;
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = words.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                String c = cleanWord(words[i]);
                if (isNameWord(c)) { seq.add(0, c); if (seq.size() == 2) break; }
                else if (c.equalsIgnoreCase("the") && !seq.isEmpty()) break;
                else if (!seq.isEmpty()) break;
            }
        }
        if (seq.isEmpty()) return null;
        String name = String.join(" ", seq);
        if (name.length() < 2 || name.length() > 24) return null;
        Entry e = enroll(book, name);
        return e == null ? null : e.name;
    }

    private static String cleanWord(String w) {
        return w.replaceAll("^[^\\p{L}]+|[^\\p{L}]+$", "");
    }

    private static boolean isNameWord(String w) {
        if (w.length() < 2) return false;
        if (!Character.isUpperCase(w.charAt(0))) return false;
        // sentence furniture that is capitalized but never a name
        String low = w.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        switch (low) {
            case "the": case "and": case "but": case "then": case "so":
            case "when": case "while": case "after": case "before":
            case "suddenly": case "soon": case "now": case "there":
            case "here": case "one": case "it": case "he": case "she":
            case "they": case "we": case "you": case "in": case "on":
            case "at": case "to": case "a": case "an":
                return false;
            default:
                return true;
        }
    }

    /** Collect the cast over the whole book (chunk texts in order)
     *  so the casting stands complete before the first telling. */
    public static void collectCast(Book book, List<String> chunkTexts) {
        if (book == null || chunkTexts == null) return;
        for (String t : chunkTexts) attribute(book, t);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ JSON

    public static String toJson(Book b) throws Exception {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
        o.put("bookId", b.bookId);
        o.put("title", b.title);
        o.put("lang", b.lang);
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
        for (Entry e : b.cast) {
            JSONObject eo = new JSONObject();
            eo.put("name", e.name);
            eo.put("narrator", e.narrator);
            eo.put("family", e.family);
            eo.put("pitch", e.pitch);
            eo.put("rate", e.rate);
            eo.put("ttsVoice", e.ttsVoice);
            eo.put("cardId", e.cardId);
            JSONObject rec = new JSONObject();
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> r : e.recordings.entrySet()) {
                rec.put(String.valueOf(r.getKey()), r.getValue());
            }
            eo.put("recordings", rec);
            arr.put(eo);
        }
        o.put("cast", arr);
        return o.toString();
    }

    public static Book fromJson(String text) throws Exception {
        Book b = new Book();
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject(text);
        b.bookId = o.optString("bookId", "");
        b.title = o.optString("title", "");
        b.lang = o.optString("lang", "");
        JSONArray arr = o.optJSONArray("cast");
        if (arr != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject eo = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                Entry e = new Entry();
                e.name = eo.optString("name", "");
                e.narrator = eo.optBoolean("narrator", false);
                e.family = eo.optBoolean("family", false);
                e.pitch = eo.optDouble("pitch", 1.0);
                e.rate = eo.optDouble("rate", 1.0);
                e.ttsVoice = eo.optString("ttsVoice", "");
                e.cardId = eo.optString("cardId", "");
                JSONObject rec = eo.optJSONObject("recordings");
                if (rec != null) {
                    java.util.Iterator<String> it = rec.keys();
                    while (it.hasNext()) {
                        String k = it.next();
                        try {
                            e.recordings.put(Integer.parseInt(k),
                                    rec.optString(k, ""));
                        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
                    }
                }
                b.cast.add(e);
            }
        }
        if (b.narrator() == null && !b.cast.isEmpty()) {
            // a book with no narrator entry is malformed; the
            // first entry does not silently become the narrator —
            // the caller re-casts from scratch.
            throw new Exception("cast has no narrator");
        }
        return b;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryData.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Story Mode's file formats (v0.14.0) — pure parsing and
 * writing, so the harness can round-trip every one of them.
 * Everything here lives as a plain file on the memory hook
 * (see StoryFiles); these are just the shapes.
 *
 * CURATION — the shelf is curated going IN, not filtered after:
 * the curation file names every book that may stand on the
 * children's shelf. A row:
 *   id \t title \t author \t lang(iso1) \t taleGroup \t iaId \t
 *   search terms \t cast (comma names, narrator first) \t
 *   illustrated (1 when the edition is known to carry pictures)
 * Books are resolved through the Archive's own front door: the
 * row's archive id first; if that door doesn't answer, a search
 * under the row's own terms. Nothing joins the shelf that this
 * file didn't place there.
 *
 * CARTRIDGE — a child's own storyboard: a JSON manifest beside
 * its audio files in one folder. The manifest is the cartridge.
 *
 * JOURNALS — a TSV index: id, the teller's name, the date, the
 * audio file name.
 */
public final class StoryData {

    private StoryData() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------ curation

    public static final class Row {
        public String id = "";
        public String title = "";
        public String author = "";
        public String lang = "";        // iso1
        public String taleGroup = "";   // same tale, another tongue
        public String iaId = "";        // may be "" (search resolves)
        public String search = "";      // the row's own search terms
        public final List<String> cast = new ArrayList<>();
        public boolean illustrated = false;
        /** v0.16.0: a direct readable-file URL (a Gutenberg book a
         *  fountain/made row reads from, bypassing the IA leg). */
        public String directUrl = "";
        /** v0.16.0: the BookSource id this row came from
         *  ("ia" for the legacy curated rows). */
        public String source = "ia";
    }

    /** One row back to its TSV line (columns 10/11 appended in
     *  v0.16.0 — older readers stop at column 9, unharmed). */
    public static String rowToLine(Row r) {
        StringBuilder cast = new StringBuilder();
        for (String nm : r.cast) {
            if (cast.length() > 0) cast.append(',');
            cast.append(nm);
        }
        return r.id + "\t" + clean(r.title) + "\t" + clean(r.author)
                + "\t" + r.lang + "\t" + clean(r.taleGroup) + "\t"
                + r.iaId + "\t" + clean(r.search) + "\t" + cast + "\t"
                + (r.illustrated ? "1" : "0") + "\t"
                + (r.directUrl == null ? "" : r.directUrl) + "\t"
                + (r.source == null ? "ia" : r.source);
    }

    private static String clean(String v) {
        return v == null ? "" : v.replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' ');
    }

    public static List<Row> parseCuration(String tsv) {
        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tsv == null) return out;
        for (String line : tsv.split("\n")) {
            Row r = parseCurationLine(line);
            if (r != null) out.add(r);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static Row parseCurationLine(String line) {
        if (line == null) return null;
        String t = line.trim();
        if (t.isEmpty() || t.startsWith("#")) return null;
        String[] p = t.split("\t", -1);
        if (p.length < 5) return null;
        Row r = new Row();
        r.id = p[0].trim();
        r.title = p[1].trim();
        r.author = p[2].trim();
        r.lang = p[3].trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        r.taleGroup = p[4].trim();
        if (p.length > 5) r.iaId = p[5].trim();
        if (p.length > 6) r.search = p[6].trim();
        if (p.length > 7) {
            for (String nm : p[7].split(",")) {
                String s = nm.trim();
                if (!s.isEmpty()) r.cast.add(s);
            }
        }
        if (p.length > 8) r.illustrated = "1".equals(p[8].trim());
        if (p.length > 9) r.directUrl = p[9].trim();
        if (p.length > 10 && !p[10].trim().isEmpty()) {
            r.source = p[10].trim();
        }
        if (r.id.isEmpty() || r.title.isEmpty() || r.lang.isEmpty()) return null;
        return r;
    }

    public static Row rowById(List<Row> rows, String id) {
        if (rows == null || id == null) return null;
        for (Row r : rows) if (r.id.equals(id)) return r;
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * The same tale in another tongue — the bilingual hearing's
     * pairing. Returns the row in {@code wantLang} sharing this
     * row's tale group, or null (a gap named, never faked).
     */
    public static Row bilingualPair(List<Row> rows, Row row, String wantLang) {
        if (rows == null || row == null || wantLang == null
                || row.taleGroup.isEmpty()) return null;
        String want = wantLang.trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        for (Row r : rows) {
            if (r.taleGroup.equals(row.taleGroup)
                    && r.lang.equals(want) && !r.id.equals(row.id)) {
                return r;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** All the OTHER tongues this tale stands in, on this shelf. */
    public static List<Row> pairOptions(List<Row> rows, Row row) {
        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (rows == null || row == null || row.taleGroup.isEmpty()) return out;
        for (Row r : rows) {
            if (r.taleGroup.equals(row.taleGroup) && !r.id.equals(row.id)) {
                out.add(r);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ cartridge

    public static final class Cartridge {
        public String id = "";
        public String title = "";
        public long createdMs = 0;
        /** v0.16.0 Make-a-Story provenance: the StoryFiles book
         *  this cartridge was made from ("" for a child's own
         *  storyboard), the book's title, and its source's name.
         *  The shelf label reads: Made from <fromBook> (<fromSource>). */
        public String bookId = "";
        public String fromBook = "";
        public String fromSource = "";
        public final List<CartridgePanel> panels = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public static final class CartridgePanel {
        public String panel = "";     // a StoryPanels id
        public String caption = "";   // the child's words for it
        public String audio = "";     // recorded telling file, "" = none
    }

    public static String cartridgeToJson(Cartridge c) throws Exception {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
        o.put("id", c.id);
        o.put("title", c.title);
        o.put("createdMs", c.createdMs);
        o.put("bookId", c.bookId);
        o.put("fromBook", c.fromBook);
        o.put("fromSource", c.fromSource);
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
        for (CartridgePanel p : c.panels) {
            JSONObject po = new JSONObject();
            po.put("panel", p.panel);
            po.put("caption", p.caption);
            po.put("audio", p.audio);
            arr.put(po);
        }
        o.put("panels", arr);
        return o.toString();
    }

    public static Cartridge cartridgeFromJson(String text) throws Exception {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject(text);
        Cartridge c = new Cartridge();
        c.id = o.optString("id", "");
        c.title = o.optString("title", "");
        c.createdMs = o.optLong("createdMs", 0);
        c.bookId = o.optString("bookId", "");
        c.fromBook = o.optString("fromBook", "");
        c.fromSource = o.optString("fromSource", "");
        JSONArray arr = o.optJSONArray("panels");
        if (arr != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject po = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                CartridgePanel p = new CartridgePanel();
                p.panel = po.optString("panel", "");
                p.caption = po.optString("caption", "");
                p.audio = po.optString("audio", "");
                c.panels.add(p);
            }
        }
        if (c.id.isEmpty()) throw new Exception("cartridge has no id");
        return c;
    }

    /** A safe file/folder name from a title + a stamp. */
    public static String safeId(String title, long stamp) {
        String base = title == null ? "" : title.toLowerCase(
                java.util.Locale.US).replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "-");
        base = base.replaceAll("^-+|-+$", "");
        if (base.length() > 24) base = base.substring(0, 24);
        if (base.isEmpty()) base = "story";
        return base + "-" + stamp;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ journals

    public static final class Journal {
        public String id = "";
        public String name = "";      // the teller's name
        public long dateMs = 0;
        public String file = "";      // audio file name
    }

    public static List<Journal> parseJournals(String tsv) {
        List<Journal> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tsv == null) return out;
        for (String line : tsv.split("\n")) {
            String t = line.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty() || t.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String[] p = t.split("\t", -1);
            if (p.length < 4) continue;
            Journal j = new Journal();
            j.id = p[0].trim();
            j.name = p[1].trim();
            try { j.dateMs = Long.parseLong(p[2].trim()); }
            catch (NumberFormatException e) { continue; }
            j.file = p[3].trim();
            if (j.id.isEmpty() || j.file.isEmpty()) continue;
            out.add(j);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String journalsToTsv(List<Journal> journals) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (Journal j : journals) {
            b.append(j.id).append('\t')
             .append(j.name.replace('\t', ' ')).append('\t')
             .append(j.dateMs).append('\t')
             .append(j.file).append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- family voices

    /** The family-voice index for one book: TSV lines
     *  chunkIndex \t castName \t audioFile. */
    public static Map<Integer, String[]> parseVoiceIndex(String tsv) {
        Map<Integer, String[]> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (tsv == null) return out;
        for (String line : tsv.split("\n")) {
            String t = line.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty() || t.startsWith("#")) continue;
            String[] p = t.split("\t", -1);
            if (p.length < 3) continue;
            try {
                out.put(Integer.parseInt(p[0].trim()),
                        new String[]{p[1].trim(), p[2].trim()});
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static String voiceIndexToTsv(Map<Integer, String[]> idx) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, String[]> e : idx.entrySet()) {
            b.append(e.getKey()).append('\t')
             .append(e.getValue()[0].replace('\t', ' ')).append('\t')
             .append(e.getValue()[1]).append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryFetch.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Fetching a curated tale (v0.14.0) — through the Internet
 * Archive's own front door, the way everything in the house is
 * fetched. A curation row resolves: its archive id first; if
 * that door doesn't answer (or carries no readable text), a
 * search under the row's own terms, best public item with a
 * readable text. The text, once fetched, is a FILE on the
 * memory hook (StoryFiles) — fetched once, kept, re-read from
 * the shelf without the network.
 *
 * Illustrations: the edition's own pictures where the Archive
 * exposes them — loose image files in the item's own listing.
 * Never scraped, never invented; when there are none, the
 * storyteller's picture cards carry the telling (StoryPanels).
 *
 * Blocking: call on a worker thread.
 */
public final class StoryFetch {

    private StoryFetch() {}

    /** The item a row resolved to ("" when unresolved). */
    public static String resolveItemId(StoryData.Row row) throws Exception {
        if (row.iaId != null && !row.iaId.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                List<IaClient.FileEntry> files = IaClient.parseMetadata(
                        Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(row.iaId)), row.iaId);
                if (pickText(files) != null) return row.iaId;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        String terms = row.search != null && !row.search.isEmpty()
                ? row.search : row.title;
