        List<IaClient.Item> items = IaClient.parseSearch(
                Net.getString(IaClient.searchUrl(terms)));
        // prefer items whose language the Archive itself declares
        // to be the row's tongue; untagged items keep their rank.
        List<IaClient.Item> ranked = IaClient.rankItems(
                items, terms, "", 0, 0, 0);
        String marc = IaClient.iaLanguageCode(
                tvNameForIso1(row.lang));
        if (!marc.isEmpty()) ranked = IaClient.preferLanguage(ranked, marc);
        for (IaClient.Item it : ranked) {
            try {
                List<IaClient.FileEntry> files = IaClient.parseMetadata(
                        Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(it.identifier)),
                        it.identifier);
                if (pickText(files) != null) return it.identifier;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String tvNameForIso1(String iso1) {
        // IaClient.iaLanguageCode speaks catalogue names; the
        // common children's-shelf tongues map directly.
        switch (iso1 == null ? "" : iso1) {
            case "en": return "English";
            case "es": return "Spanish";
            case "de": return "German";
            case "fr": return "French";
            case "it": return "Italian";
            case "pt": return "Portuguese";
            case "ru": return "Russian";
            default: return "";
        }
    }

    /** The readable text file in an item, or null. Plain text
     *  first (the djvu text is the book itself), then an EPUB the
     *  house's own BookText can open. */
    public static IaClient.FileEntry pickText(List<IaClient.FileEntry> files) {
        IaClient.FileEntry djvu = null, plain = null, epub = null;
        for (IaClient.FileEntry f : files) {
            String n = f.name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
            if (f.subtitle) continue;
            if (n.endsWith("_djvu.txt")) djvu = f;
            else if (n.endsWith(".txt") && !n.contains("scandata")
                    && plain == null) plain = f;
            else if (n.endsWith(".epub") && epub == null) epub = f;
        }
        return djvu != null ? djvu : (plain != null ? plain : epub);
    }

    /**
     * Fetch (or recall) the row's text. Returns the text; saves
     * it to the shelf file on the way. Throws on no readable
     * text anywhere the row points.
     */
    public static String fetchText(Context ctx, StoryData.Row row)
            throws Exception {
        if (StoryFiles.bookHeld(ctx, row.id)) {
            return StoryFiles.bookText(ctx, row.id);
        }
        if (row.directUrl != null && !row.directUrl.isEmpty()) {
            // A BookSource row that reads from a direct public
            // file (Project Gutenberg): one hole — the same
            // Hydra fetch, the same BookText intake.
            byte[] data = Net.getBytes(row.directUrl);
            if (data == null || data.length == 0) {
                throw new Exception("the text didn't arrive");
            }
            BookText.Result r = BookText.extract(data, row.directUrl);
            if (!r.ok || r.text == null || r.text.trim().length() < 200) {
                throw new Exception("the book couldn't be opened");
            }
            StoryFiles.saveBook(ctx, row, r.text);
            return r.text;
        }
        String itemId = resolveItemId(row);
        if (itemId.isEmpty()) throw new Exception("no readable item");
        List<IaClient.FileEntry> files = IaClient.parseMetadata(
                Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(itemId)), itemId);
        IaClient.FileEntry text = pickText(files);
        if (text == null) throw new Exception("item carries no text");
        byte[] data = Net.getBytes(text.url);
        if (data == null || data.length == 0) {
            throw new Exception("the text didn't arrive");
        }
        String body;
        if (text.name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US).endsWith(".epub")) {
            BookText.Result r = BookText.extract(data, text.name);
            if (!r.ok) throw new Exception("the book couldn't be opened");
            body = r.text;
        } else {
            body = BookText.decodeText(data);
        }
        if (body == null || body.trim().length() < 200) {
            throw new Exception("the text was empty");
        }
        StoryFiles.saveBook(ctx, row, body);
        return body;
    }

    /** The edition's own illustration files, in shelf order. */
    public static List<String> illustrations(Context ctx, StoryData.Row row) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            String itemId = row.iaId;
            if (itemId == null || itemId.isEmpty() || !StoryFiles.bookHeld(ctx, row.id)) {
                itemId = resolveItemId(row);
            }
            if (itemId == null || itemId.isEmpty()) return out;
            List<IaClient.FileEntry> files = IaClient.parseMetadata(
                    Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(itemId)), itemId);
            List<IaClient.FileEntry> imgs = new ArrayList<>();
            for (IaClient.FileEntry f : files) {
                String n = f.name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
                if (f.video || f.subtitle) continue;
                if (!(n.endsWith(".jpg") || n.endsWith(".jpeg")
                        || n.endsWith(".png"))) continue;
                if (n.contains("scandata") || n.contains("thumb")
                        || n.contains("__ia_thumb")) continue;
                imgs.add(f);
            }
            imgs.sort((a, b) -> a.name.compareTo(b.name));
            for (IaClient.FileEntry f : imgs) out.add(f.url);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryFiles.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Story Mode's shelf in the house (v0.14.0) — every file the
 * story room keeps lives under the ONE memory hook, reached
 * through MemoryHook and nowhere else:
 *
 *   memory/story/curation.tsv       the curated shelf (seeded
 *                                     once from the app's assets;
 *                                     the file here is the list)
 *   memory/story/books/<id>.txt     a tale's text, once fetched
 *   memory/story/books/<id>.meta    its title/author/lang/group
 *   memory/story/casts/<id>.json    the book's voice book
 *   memory/story/voices/<id>.tsv    family-voice index
 *   memory/story/voices/<id>/…      the family's recordings
 *   memory/story/cartridges/<cid>/  a child's storyboard:
 *                                     manifest.json + its audio
 *   memory/story/journals.tsv       the voice journals index
 *   memory/story/journals/<jid>.m4a the journals themselves
 *
 * Settings-shaped things (the bedtime toggles) live in a small
 * preferences file, as settings do everywhere in the house; the
 * family's records are all files.
 */
public final class StoryFiles {

    private StoryFiles() {}

    private static final String PREFS = "talatv_story";

    public static File storyRoot(Context ctx) {
        File d = new File(MemoryHook.root(ctx), "story");
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    private static File sub(Context ctx, String name) {
        File d = new File(storyRoot(ctx), name);
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    public static File booksDir(Context ctx) { return sub(ctx, "books"); }
    public static File castsDir(Context ctx) { return sub(ctx, "casts"); }
    public static File voicesDir(Context ctx) { return sub(ctx, "voices"); }
    public static File cartridgesDir(Context ctx) { return sub(ctx, "cartridges"); }
    public static File journalsDir(Context ctx) { return sub(ctx, "journals"); }

    private static String safe(String id) {
        return id == null ? "book"
                : id.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ curation

    /** The curated shelf — seeded from assets on first run. */
    public static List<StoryData.Row> curation(Context ctx) {
        File f = new File(storyRoot(ctx), "curation.tsv");
        if (!f.isFile()) {
            String seed = "";
            try (InputStream in = ctx.getAssets().open("story_curation.tsv")) {
                byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
                StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
                int n;
                java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream all = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) all.write(buf, 0, n);
                seed = all.toString("UTF-8");
                b.append(seed);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (!seed.isEmpty()) MemoryHook.writeFile(f, seed);
        }
        return StoryData.parseCuration(MemoryHook.readFile(f));
    }

    // --------------------------------------- fountain + made (v0.16.0)

    /**
     * The Story Fountain's resolved rows (v0.16.0): children's
     * books verified live through the BookSource gate (named
     * children's collection + open + resolvable), cached here
     * so the shelf stands offline for books already held and
     * the fountain deepens instead of restarting.
     */
    public static List<StoryData.Row> fountain(Context ctx) {
        return StoryData.parseCuration(MemoryHook.readFile(
                new File(storyRoot(ctx), "fountain.tsv")));
    }

    public static void saveFountain(Context ctx, List<StoryData.Row> rows) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (StoryData.Row r : rows) b.append(StoryData.rowToLine(r)).append("\n");
        MemoryHook.writeFile(new File(storyRoot(ctx), "fountain.tsv"),
                b.toString());
    }

    /** Books a reader story-fied with Make a Story (v0.16.0). */
    public static List<StoryData.Row> made(Context ctx) {
        return StoryData.parseCuration(MemoryHook.readFile(
                new File(storyRoot(ctx), "made.tsv")));
    }

    public static void addMade(Context ctx, StoryData.Row row) {
        List<StoryData.Row> rows = made(ctx);
        rows.removeIf(r -> r.id.equals(row.id));
        rows.add(row);
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (StoryData.Row r : rows) b.append(StoryData.rowToLine(r)).append("\n");
        MemoryHook.writeFile(new File(storyRoot(ctx), "made.tsv"),
                b.toString());
    }

    /**
     * Every row the story machinery can tell: the curated shelf,
     * the fountain's verified books, and made stories — first
     * occurrence of an id wins (curation outranks).
     */
    public static List<StoryData.Row> allRows(Context ctx) {
        List<StoryData.Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> seen = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (List<StoryData.Row> part : java.util.Arrays.asList(
                curation(ctx), fountain(ctx), made(ctx))) {
            for (StoryData.Row r : part) {
                if (seen.add(r.id)) out.add(r);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ book texts

    public static File bookTextFile(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return new File(booksDir(ctx), safe(bookId) + ".txt");
    }

    public static File bookMetaFile(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return new File(booksDir(ctx), safe(bookId) + ".meta");
    }

    public static boolean bookHeld(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        File f = bookTextFile(ctx, bookId);
        return f.isFile() && f.length() > 0;
    }

    public static String bookText(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return MemoryHook.readFile(bookTextFile(ctx, bookId));
    }

    public static void saveBook(Context ctx, StoryData.Row row, String text) {
        MemoryHook.writeFile(bookTextFile(ctx, row.id), text);
        String meta = row.id + "\t" + row.title + "\t" + row.author + "\t"
                + row.lang + "\t" + row.taleGroup + "\t" + row.iaId + "\n";
        MemoryHook.writeFile(bookMetaFile(ctx, row.id), meta);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ casts

    public static File castFile(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return new File(castsDir(ctx), safe(bookId) + ".json");
    }

    public static StoryCast.Book loadCast(Context ctx, StoryData.Row row) {
        File f = castFile(ctx, row.id);
        if (f.isFile()) {
            try {
                StoryCast.Book b = StoryCast.fromJson(MemoryHook.readFile(f));
                if (b.bookId.equals(row.id) && b.narrator() != null) return b;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        StoryCast.Book b = StoryCast.newBook(row.id, row.title, row.lang);
        for (String nm : row.cast) {
            if (!nm.equalsIgnoreCase(StoryCast.NARRATOR)) {
                StoryCast.enroll(b, nm);
            }
        }
        assignCards(b);
        saveCast(ctx, b);
        return b;
    }

    /** Pin every cast member's picture card (once, in the file). */
    public static void assignCards(StoryCast.Book b) {
        for (StoryCast.Entry e : b.cast) {
            if (e.cardId == null || e.cardId.isEmpty()) {
                e.cardId = e.narrator ? StoryPanels.NARRATOR_CARD
                        : StoryPanels.cardFor(b.bookId, e.name);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void saveCast(Context ctx, StoryCast.Book b) {
        try {
            MemoryHook.writeFile(castFile(ctx, b.bookId), StoryCast.toJson(b));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ family voices

    public static File voiceIndexFile(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return new File(voicesDir(ctx), safe(bookId) + ".tsv");
    }

    public static File bookVoicesDir(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        File d = new File(voicesDir(ctx), safe(bookId));
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    /** chunkIndex -> [castName, audioFileName] for one book. */
    public static Map<Integer, String[]> voiceIndex(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return StoryData.parseVoiceIndex(
                MemoryHook.readFile(voiceIndexFile(ctx, bookId)));
    }

    public static void saveVoiceIndex(Context ctx, String bookId,
                                      Map<Integer, String[]> idx) {
        MemoryHook.writeFile(voiceIndexFile(ctx, bookId),
                StoryData.voiceIndexToTsv(idx));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ cartridges

    public static File cartridgeDir(Context ctx, String cartridgeId) {
        File d = new File(cartridgesDir(ctx), safe(cartridgeId));
        if (!d.exists()) d.mkdirs();
        return d;
    }

    public static void saveCartridge(Context ctx, StoryData.Cartridge c) {
        try {
            MemoryHook.writeFile(
                    new File(cartridgeDir(ctx, c.id), "manifest.json"),
                    StoryData.cartridgeToJson(c));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public static List<StoryData.Cartridge> cartridges(Context ctx) {
        List<StoryData.Cartridge> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File[] dirs = cartridgesDir(ctx).listFiles();
        if (dirs != null) {
            for (File d : dirs) {
                File m = new File(d, "manifest.json");
                if (!m.isFile()) continue;
                try {
                    out.add(StoryData.cartridgeFromJson(MemoryHook.readFile(m)));
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        out.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.createdMs, a.createdMs));
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ journals

    public static File journalsIndexFile(Context ctx) {
        return new File(storyRoot(ctx), "journals.tsv");
    }

    public static List<StoryData.Journal> journals(Context ctx) {
        return StoryData.parseJournals(
                MemoryHook.readFile(journalsIndexFile(ctx)));
    }

    public static void saveJournals(Context ctx, List<StoryData.Journal> js) {
        MemoryHook.writeFile(journalsIndexFile(ctx), StoryData.journalsToTsv(js));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ settings

    private static SharedPreferences prefs(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    /** Bedtime shape: the wind-down is armed for tellings. */
    public static boolean bedtime(Context ctx) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("bedtime", false);
    }

    public static void setBedtime(Context ctx, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("bedtime", v).apply();
    }

    /** Bilingual hearing stands per book (key: the book's id). */
    public static boolean bilingual(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return prefs(ctx).getBoolean("bilingual_" + safe(bookId), false);
    }

    public static void setBilingual(Context ctx, String bookId, boolean v) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putBoolean("bilingual_" + safe(bookId), v).apply();
    }

    /** The kept place inside a story book: a chunk index. */
    public static int storyPlace(Context ctx, String bookId) {
        return prefs(ctx).getInt("place_" + safe(bookId), 0);
    }

    public static void setStoryPlace(Context ctx, String bookId, int chunk) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putInt("place_" + safe(bookId), chunk).apply();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryMakeActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.GridLayout;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Make a story (v0.14.0) — a child builds their own storyboard:
 * pick picture cards from Sandy's bundled set, put words on
 * them (typed, or told out loud and recorded), give the story a
 * name, and SAVE it as a story cartridge — a file on the memory
 * hook, like every kept thing in the house. Their panels, their
 * telling, their ending.
 */
public class StoryMakeActivity extends Activity {

    private final List<StoryData.CartridgePanel> panels = new ArrayList<>();
    private String cartridgeId = "";
    private File workDir;
    private EditText titleBox;
    private LinearLayout stripBox;
    private TextView editorLabel;
    private EditText captionBox;
    private Button recBtn;
    private int editing = -1;
    private MediaRecorder recorder;
    private File recTarget;
    private boolean recording = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        cartridgeId = StoryData.safeId("story", System.currentTimeMillis());
        workDir = StoryFiles.cartridgeDir(this, cartridgeId);

        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(16);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_make"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(30);
        root.addView(title);

        titleBox = new EditText(this);
        titleBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "story_title_hint"));
        titleBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        titleBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 158, 185));
        titleBox.setTextSize(20);
        titleBox.setSingleLine(true);
        root.addView(titleBox);

        TextView pickLabel = new TextView(this);
        pickLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_pick_panels"));
        pickLabel.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
        pickLabel.setTextSize(17);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams pl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        pl.topMargin = dp(14);
        root.addView(pickLabel, pl);

        GridLayout grid = new GridLayout(this);
        grid.setColumnCount(4);
        for (StoryPanels.Panel p : StoryPanels.all()) {
            ImageButton ib = new ImageButton(this);
            ib.setImageResource(resId(StoryPanels.drawableName(p.id)));
            ib.setContentDescription(p.label);
            GridLayout.LayoutParams gl = new GridLayout.LayoutParams();
            gl.width = dp(76);
            gl.height = dp(76);
            gl.setMargins(dp(4), dp(4), dp(4), dp(4));
            ib.setLayoutParams(gl);
            ib.setOnClickListener(v -> addPanel(p.id));
            grid.addView(ib);
        }
        root.addView(grid);

        stripBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        stripBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams sl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sl.topMargin = dp(16);
        root.addView(stripBox, sl);

        editorLabel = new TextView(this);
        editorLabel.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        editorLabel.setTextSize(18);
        root.addView(editorLabel);
        captionBox = new EditText(this);
        captionBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "story_caption_hint"));
        captionBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        captionBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 158, 185));
        captionBox.setTextSize(19);
        root.addView(captionBox);
        recBtn = new Button(this);
        recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_record"));
        recBtn.setTextSize(18);
        recBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> toggleRecord());
        root.addView(recBtn);

        Button saveBtn = new Button(this);
        saveBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_save"));
        saveBtn.setTextSize(22);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams sv = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(72));
        sv.topMargin = dp(18);
        saveBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> save());
        root.addView(saveBtn, sv);

        setContentView(scroll);
        paintStrip();
    }

    private void addPanel(String panelId) {
        StoryData.CartridgePanel p = new StoryData.CartridgePanel();
        p.panel = panelId;
        panels.add(p);
        editing = panels.size() - 1;
        paintStrip();
        paintEditor();
    }

    private void paintStrip() {
        stripBox.removeAllViews();
        for (int i = 0; i < panels.size(); i++) {
            final int idx = i;
            StoryData.CartridgePanel p = panels.get(i);
            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(this);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
            ImageButton thumb = new ImageButton(this);
            thumb.setImageResource(resId(StoryPanels.drawableName(p.panel)));
            thumb.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(56), dp(56)));
            thumb.setOnClickListener(v -> { editing = idx; paintEditor(); paintStrip(); });
            row.addView(thumb);
            TextView cap = new TextView(this);
            cap.setText((idx + 1) + ". " + (p.caption.isEmpty() ? "…" : p.caption)
                    + (p.audio.isEmpty() ? "" : "  🎙"));
            cap.setTextColor(idx == editing ? Color.rgb(255, 224, 150) : Color.WHITE);
            cap.setTextSize(17);
            row.addView(cap, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            Button del = new Button(this);
            del.setText("✕");
            del.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (!p.audio.isEmpty()) new File(workDir, p.audio).delete();
                panels.remove(idx);
                if (editing >= panels.size()) editing = panels.size() - 1;
                paintStrip();
                paintEditor();
            });
            row.addView(del);
            stripBox.addView(row);
        }
    }

    private void paintEditor() {
        if (editing < 0 || editing >= panels.size()) {
            editorLabel.setText("");
            captionBox.setText("");
            return;
        }
        StoryPanels.Panel p = StoryPanels.byId(panels.get(editing).panel);
        editorLabel.setText((editing + 1) + ". " + (p != null ? p.label : ""));
        captionBox.setText(panels.get(editing).caption);
    }

    private void commitCaption() {
        if (editing >= 0 && editing < panels.size()) {
            panels.get(editing).caption = captionBox.getText().toString().trim();
        }
    }

    private void toggleRecord() {
        if (editing < 0) return;
        commitCaption();
        if (recording) {
            stopRecording(true);
            return;
        }
        if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO}, 7);
            return;
        }
        try {
            String name = "p" + editing + "_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".m4a";
            recTarget = new File(workDir, name);
            recorder = new MediaRecorder();
            recorder.setAudioSource(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            recorder.setOutputFormat(MediaRecorder.OutputFormat.MPEG_4);
            recorder.setAudioEncoder(MediaRecorder.AudioEncoder.AAC);
            recorder.setOutputFile(recTarget.getAbsolutePath());
            recorder.prepare();
            recorder.start();
            recording = true;
            recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_stop_rec"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stopRecording(false);
        }
    }

    private void stopRecording(boolean keep) {
        recording = false;
        recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_record"));
        if (recorder != null) {
            try { recorder.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { recorder.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            recorder = null;
        }
        if (keep && recTarget != null && editing >= 0) {
            String old = panels.get(editing).audio;
            if (!old.isEmpty()) new File(workDir, old).delete();
            panels.get(editing).audio = recTarget.getName();
            paintStrip();
        } else if (recTarget != null) {
            recTarget.delete();
        }
        recTarget = null;
    }

    private void save() {
        commitCaption();
        if (panels.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_pick_panels"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        StoryData.Cartridge c = new StoryData.Cartridge();
        c.id = cartridgeId;
        c.title = titleBox.getText().toString().trim();
        if (c.title.isEmpty()) c.title = LangStore.tr(this, "story_my_stories");
        c.createdMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        c.panels.addAll(panels);
        StoryFiles.saveCartridge(this, c);
        Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_saved"),
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        finish();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (recorder != null) stopRecording(false);
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int resId(String drawable) {
        return getResources().getIdentifier(drawable, "drawable", getPackageName());
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryPanels.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The storyboard panels (v0.14.0) — a STORYBOARD, not a movie:
 * still, flat, drawn picture cards that advance as the telling
 * goes. Every panel the app can show is BUNDLED (a vector
 * drawable in the app's own res/), so the set is closed and
 * honest — nothing is rendered up out of thin air.
 *
 * Two kinds of cards:
 *   scene cards     — where we are: forest, sea, night, home…
 *                     picked from the passage's own words.
 *   character cards — who is here: a fox, a bear, a grandmother…
 *                     assigned to a cast member ONCE per book
 *                     (by name, deterministically) and never
 *                     changed inside that book — the visual twin
 *                     of voice continuity.
 *
 * Where a book's own edition carries illustrations and the
 * Archive exposes them, StoryTell shows those instead; the
 * cards are the floor that always exists. Pure logic.
 */
public final class StoryPanels {

    public static final class Panel {
        public final String id;       // drawable name story_<id>
        public final String label;    // the picture's name (English)
        public final boolean scene;
        public Panel(String id, String label, boolean scene) {
            this.id = id;
            this.label = label;
            this.scene = scene;
        }
    }

    private static final List<Panel> SCENES = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final List<Panel> CHARACTERS = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final Map<String, Panel> BY_ID = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private static void scene(String id, String label) {
        Panel p = new Panel(id, label, true);
        SCENES.add(p);
        BY_ID.put(id, p);
    }

    private static void character(String id, String label) {
        Panel p = new Panel(id, label, false);
        CHARACTERS.add(p);
        BY_ID.put(id, p);
    }

    static {
        scene("meadow", "Meadow");
        scene("forest", "Forest");
        scene("sea", "The Sea");
        scene("night", "Night");
        scene("home", "Home");
        scene("garden", "Garden");
        scene("road", "The Road");
        scene("snow", "Snow");
        scene("mountain", "Mountains");
        scene("river", "River");
        scene("village", "Village");
        scene("castle", "Castle");
        scene("kitchen", "Kitchen");
        scene("boat", "Boat");

        character("fox", "Fox");
        character("bear", "Bear");
        character("rabbit", "Rabbit");
        character("owl", "Owl");
        character("wolf", "Wolf");
        character("cat", "Cat");
        character("dog", "Dog");
        character("mouse", "Mouse");
        character("lion", "Lion");
        character("tortoise", "Tortoise");
        character("girl", "Girl");
        character("boy", "Boy");
        character("grandmother", "Grandmother");
        character("grandfather", "Grandfather");
        character("mother", "Mother");
        character("father", "Father");
        character("witch", "Witch");
        character("king", "King");
        character("star", "Star");
    }

    /** The fallback scene when a passage names no place. */
    public static final String DEFAULT_SCENE = "meadow";
    /** The card for narration with no character on stage. */
    public static final String NARRATOR_CARD = "star";

    private StoryPanels() {}

    public static List<Panel> scenes() { return SCENES; }
    public static List<Panel> characters() { return CHARACTERS; }
    public static List<Panel> all() {
        List<Panel> out = new ArrayList<>(SCENES);
        out.addAll(CHARACTERS);
        return out;
    }
    public static Panel byId(String id) {
        return id == null ? null : BY_ID.get(id);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------- scenes

    /** Scene words, in the house's best-covered tongues. The
     *  first scene (in this list's priority order) whose word
     *  the passage carries wins; no hit = the passage keeps
     *  whatever scene came before (the caller passes it in). */
    private static final String[][] SCENE_WORDS = {
            {"night", "night", "midnight", "moon", "stars", "dark",
                    "noche", "luna", "nacht", "mond",
                    "nuit", "lune", "ночь", "夜", "밤"},
            {"sea", "sea", "ocean", "wave", "shore", "beach",
                    "mar", "playa", "meer", "strand", "plage"},
            {"snow", "snow", "winter", "ice", "frost",
                    "nieve", "invierno", "schnee", "winter",
                    "neige", "hiver"},
            {"forest", "forest", "woods", "trees", "wald",
                    "bosque", "forêt", "лес"},
            {"river", "river", "stream", "brook", "río", "fluss",
                    "rivière"},
            {"mountain", "mountain", "hill", "montaña", "berg",
                    "montagne"},
            {"castle", "castle", "palace", "kingdom", "castillo",
                    "schloss", "château"},
            {"village", "village", "town", "market", "pueblo",
                    "dorf", "village"},
            {"garden", "garden", "flowers", "jardín", "garten",
                    "jardin"},
            {"kitchen", "kitchen", "hearth", "fire", "cocina",
                    "küche", "cuisine"},
            {"boat", "boat", "ship", "sail", "barco", "boot",
                    "bateau"},
            {"home", "home", "house", "cottage", "casa", "haus",
                    "maison"},
            {"road", "road", "path", "way", "camino", "weg",
                    "chemin"},
    };

    /** The scene a passage names, or "" when it names none. */
    public static String sceneFor(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String low = " " + text.toLowerCase(Locale.US) + " ";
        for (String[] row : SCENE_WORDS) {
            for (int i = 1; i < row.length; i++) {
                String w = row[i];
                // word-ish match: CJK words match as substrings
                // (no spaces in the script); Latin words need a
                // boundary so "sea" doesn't fire inside "searched".
                if (isCjk(w)) {
                    if (low.contains(w)) return row[0];
                } else if (low.contains(" " + w + " ")
                        || low.contains(" " + w + ",")
                        || low.contains(" " + w + ".")
                        || low.contains(" " + w + "!")
                        || low.contains(" " + w + "?")) {
                    return row[0];
                }
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static boolean isCjk(String w) {
        for (int i = 0; i < w.length(); i++) {
            char c = w.charAt(i);
            if (c >= 0x4E00 && c <= 0x9FFF || c >= 0x3040 && c <= 0x30FF
                    || c >= 0xAC00 && c <= 0xD7AF || c >= 0x0400 && c <= 0x04FF) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ characters

    /**
     * The picture card that IS this character in this book. A
     * name that names a bundled animal/person keeps it (a fox is
     * a fox in every book); any other name takes a card by a
     * stable hash of book + name, so the assignment is the same
     * on every open — and once StoryTell stores it in the cast
     * file, it is pinned there besides.
     */
    public static String cardFor(String bookId, String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) return NARRATOR_CARD;
        String low = name.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        for (Panel p : CHARACTERS) {
            if (low.contains(p.id)) return p.id;
        }
        if (low.contains("grandma") || low.contains("granny")
                || low.contains("abuela") || low.contains("großmutter")
                || low.contains("oma")) return "grandmother";
        if (low.contains("grandpa") || low.contains("abuelo")
                || low.contains("großvater") || low.contains("opa")) {
            return "grandfather";
        }
        if (low.contains("mother") || low.contains("mama")
                || low.contains("madre") || low.contains("mutter")
                || low.contains("maman")) return "mother";
        if (low.contains("father") || low.contains("papa")
                || low.contains("padre") || low.contains("vater")) {
            return "father";
        }
        if (low.contains("princess") || low.contains("queen")) return "girl";
        if (low.contains("prince")) return "boy";
        int h = (bookId + "|" + low).hashCode();
        // humans and creatures share one pool of faces; the hash
        // only picks WHICH, consistently.
        Panel p = CHARACTERS.get(Math.abs(h) % CHARACTERS.size());
        return p.id;
    }

    /** A full panel choice for one passage: scene + up to two
     *  character cards (the ones speaking in it). */
    public static final class Choice {
        public String sceneId = DEFAULT_SCENE;
        public final List<String> charIds = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public static Choice choose(String prevScene, String passageText,
                                List<String> speakerCardIds) {
        Choice c = new Choice();
        String s = sceneFor(passageText);
        c.sceneId = !s.isEmpty() ? s
                : (prevScene == null || prevScene.isEmpty()
                        ? DEFAULT_SCENE : prevScene);
        if (speakerCardIds != null) {
            for (String id : speakerCardIds) {
                if (id != null && !id.isEmpty() && !c.charIds.contains(id)
                        && c.charIds.size() < 2) {
                    c.charIds.add(id);
                }
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    /** Drawable resource name for a panel id. */
    public static String drawableName(String panelId) {
        return "story_" + panelId;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryPlayActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.media.MediaPlayer;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.text.DateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream;

/**
 * My Stories (v0.14.0) — the children's own storyboards, played
 * back panel by panel: the picture big, their words under it,
 * their recorded telling where they made one (else the phone's
 * voice reads their words). Sharing a cartridge leaves ONLY
 * through the grown-up gate, hand to hand, as a file — the
 * room's plain line stands on the share: there is no public
 * shelf yet, and nothing is posted anywhere from here.
 */
public class StoryPlayActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_CARTRIDGE = "cartridge";
    private static final int REQ_SHARE = 43;

    private StoryData.Cartridge cartridge;
    private int panel = 0;
    private MediaPlayer player;
    private TextToSpeech tts;
    private File pendingZip;

    private ImageView picView;
    private TextView captionView, countView;
    private Button playBtn;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        String cid = getIntent().getStringExtra(X_CARTRIDGE);
        if (cid == null || cid.isEmpty()) {
            showList();
            return;
        }
        for (StoryData.Cartridge c : StoryFiles.cartridges(this)) {
            if (c.id.equals(cid)) cartridge = c;
        }
        if (cartridge == null || cartridge.panels.isEmpty()) {
            showList();
            return;
        }
        showPlayer();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ list

    private void showList() {
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(16);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_my_stories"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(30);
        root.addView(title);

        List<StoryData.Cartridge> carts = StoryFiles.cartridges(this);
        if (carts.isEmpty()) {
            TextView empty = new TextView(this);
            empty.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_make_empty"));
            empty.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
            empty.setTextSize(19);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            lp.topMargin = dp(18);
            root.addView(empty, lp);
        }
        DateFormat df = DateFormat.getDateInstance(DateFormat.MEDIUM);
        for (StoryData.Cartridge c : carts) {
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText(c.title + "\n" + df.format(new Date(c.createdMs)));
            b.setTextSize(21);
            b.setAllCaps(false);
            b.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL | Gravity.START);
            b.setPadding(dp(16), 0, dp(16), 0);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(92));
            lp.topMargin = dp(12);
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, StoryPlayActivity.class);
                i.putExtra(X_CARTRIDGE, c.id);
                startActivity(i);
            });
            root.addView(b, lp);
        }
        setContentView(scroll);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ play

    private void showPlayer() {
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        int pad = dp(14);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(cartridge.title);
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(26);
        root.addView(title);

        if (cartridge.bookId != null && !cartridge.bookId.isEmpty()) {
            // A story made from a book (v0.16.0): provenance
            // labeled, and the telling itself one tap away.
            TextView prov = new TextView(this);
            prov.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_made_from") + " "
                    + cartridge.fromBook + " (" + cartridge.fromSource + ")");
            prov.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 205));
            prov.setTextSize(16);
            root.addView(prov);
            Button tell = new Button(this);
            tell.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_tell_it"));
            tell.setTextSize(19);
            tell.setAllCaps(false);
            tell.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, StoryTellActivity.class);
                i.putExtra(StoryTellActivity.X_BOOK, cartridge.bookId);
                startActivity(i);
            });
            root.addView(tell);
        }

        picView = new ImageView(this);
        picView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        picView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(14, 16, 26));
        root.addView(picView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(300)));

        captionView = new TextView(this);
        captionView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        captionView.setTextSize(24);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f);
        cl.topMargin = dp(12);
        root.addView(captionView, cl);

        countView = new TextView(this);
        countView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 200));
        countView.setTextSize(14);
        root.addView(countView);

        LinearLayout controls = new LinearLayout(this);
        controls.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button prev = bigButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_back"), v -> step(-1));
        playBtn = bigButton(LangStore.tr(this, "story_play_story"), v -> tellPanel());
        Button next = bigButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_forward"), v -> step(1));
        controls.addView(prev, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        controls.addView(playBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        controls.addView(next, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        root.addView(controls);

        Button share = new Button(this);
        share.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_share"));
        share.setTextSize(17);
        share.setAllCaps(false);
        share.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent gate = new Intent(this, GrownUpGateActivity.class);
            gate.putExtra(GrownUpGateActivity.X_WHY,
                    LangStore.tr(this, "story_gate_for_share"));
            startActivityForResult(gate, REQ_SHARE);
        });
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams sh = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sh.topMargin = dp(10);
        root.addView(share, sh);

        tts = new TextToSpeech(this, status -> {});
        setContentView(root);
        showPanel(0);
    }

    private Button bigButton(String label, View.OnClickListener on) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setTextSize(18);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setMinHeight(dp(64));
        b.setOnClickListener(on);
        return b;
    }

    private void showPanel(int i) {
        panel = Math.max(0, Math.min(i, cartridge.panels.size() - 1));
        StoryData.CartridgePanel p = cartridge.panels.get(panel);
        picView.setImageResource(
                resId(StoryPanels.drawableName(p.panel)));
        captionView.setText(p.caption);
        countView.setText(String.format(
                LangStore.tr(this, "story_panel_of"),
                panel + 1, cartridge.panels.size()));
    }

    private void step(int dir) {
        stopTelling();
        showPanel(panel + dir);
    }

    private void tellPanel() {
        StoryData.CartridgePanel p = cartridge.panels.get(panel);
        File dir = StoryFiles.cartridgeDir(this, cartridge.id);
        if (!p.audio.isEmpty() && new File(dir, p.audio).isFile()) {
            stopTelling();
            try {
                player = new MediaPlayer();
                player.setDataSource(new File(dir, p.audio).getAbsolutePath());
                player.setOnCompletionListener(mp -> stopTelling());
                player.prepare();
                player.start();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                stopTelling();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (!p.caption.isEmpty() && tts != null) {
            String ui = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
            try {
                tts.setLanguage(ui == null || ui.isEmpty()
                        ? Locale.getDefault() : Locale.forLanguageTag(ui));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            tts.speak(p.caption, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, new Bundle(), "panel");
        }
    }

    private void stopTelling() {
        if (player != null) {
            try { player.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { player.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            player = null;
        }
        if (tts != null) { try { tts.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {} }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ share

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int result, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, result, data);
        if (req == REQ_SHARE && result == RESULT_OK && cartridge != null) {
            shareCartridge();
        }
    }

    /** The cartridge leaves as ONE file (a zip of its folder),
     *  hand to hand through the phone's own share sheet. */
    private void shareCartridge() {
        try {
            File dir = StoryFiles.cartridgeDir(this, cartridge.id);
            File zip = new File(getCacheDir(), cartridge.id + ".zip");
            try (ZipOutputStream zos = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(zip))) {
                File[] files = dir.listFiles();
                if (files != null) {
                    for (File f : files) {
                        zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(f.getName()));
                        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
                            byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
                            int n;
                            while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) zos.write(buf, 0, n);
                        }
                        zos.closeEntry();
                    }
                }
            }
            pendingZip = zip;
            Uri uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(
                    this, "com.talacore.talatv.files", zip);
            Intent send = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
            send.setType("application/zip");
            send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri);
            send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, cartridge.title);
            send.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_share_note"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            startActivity(Intent.createChooser(send,
                    LangStore.tr(this, "story_share")));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "share_unavailable"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        stopTelling();
        if (tts != null) {
            try { tts.shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int resId(String drawable) {
        return getResources().getIdentifier(drawable, "drawable", getPackageName());
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryRecordActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.media.MediaPlayer;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Family voices (v0.14.0) — a grown-up (or a child, through the
 * gate) records their OWN voice reading a story. The recording
 * casts them as THEMSELVES in the book's voice book — "Grandma"
 * reads as Grandma — and is saved as a file on the memory hook:
 * when the telling reaches a passage they read, their voice
 * plays, here in the house, in place of any made voice. A voice
 * kept as a file persists, copies, and hands down.
 *
 * (The ORIGINALS of family voices are destined for the family's
 * own TALA monolith, under the family's keys; Sandy holds the
 * household reading copies — see the 0.14.0 NOTES.)
 *
 * The flow is kept dead simple: the gate, pick a book, say who
 * you are, read the passage on the screen, save. Passage by
 * passage, at kitchen-table pace.
 */
public class StoryRecordActivity extends Activity {

    private static final int REQ_GATE = 44;

    private LinearLayout root;
    private StoryData.Row row;
    private List<BookChunker.Chunk> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
    private StoryCast.Book cast;
    private int chunk = 0;

    private EditText nameBox;
    private TextView passageView, countView, statusView;
    private Button recBtn;
    private MediaRecorder recorder;
    private MediaPlayer preview;
    private File recTarget;
    private boolean recording = false;
    private boolean gated = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        int pad = dp(16);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        setContentView(root);
        Intent gate = new Intent(this, GrownUpGateActivity.class);
        startActivityForResult(gate, REQ_GATE);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int req, int result, Intent data) {
        super.onActivityResult(req, result, data);
        if (req == REQ_GATE) {
            if (result != RESULT_OK) { finish(); return; }
            gated = true;
            showBookPicker();
        }
    }

    private void showBookPicker() {
        root.removeAllViews();
        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_pick_book"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(26);
        root.addView(title);
        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
        statusView.setTextSize(16);
        root.addView(statusView);
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        LinearLayout list = new LinearLayout(this);
        list.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        scroll.addView(list);
        root.addView(scroll, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        for (StoryData.Row r : StoryFiles.curation(this)) {
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText(r.title);
            b.setTextSize(20);
            b.setAllCaps(false);
            b.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL | Gravity.START);
            b.setPadding(dp(14), 0, dp(14), 0);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(76));
            lp.topMargin = dp(10);
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> openBook(r));
            list.addView(b, lp);
        }
    }

    private void openBook(StoryData.Row r) {
        row = r;
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_loading"));
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                String text = StoryFetch.fetchText(this, r);
                List<BookChunker.Chunk> ch = BookChunker.chunk(text, null);
                StoryCast.Book c = StoryFiles.loadCast(this, r);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    chunks = ch;
                    cast = c;
                    chunk = 0;
                    showRecorder();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> statusView.setText(
                        LangStore.tr(this, "story_fetch_fail")));
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void showRecorder() {
        root.removeAllViews();
        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(String.format(
                LangStore.tr(this, "story_record_voice_for"), row.title));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(24);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView here = new TextView(this);
        here.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_your_voice_here"));
        here.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
        here.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(here);

        TextView whoLabel = new TextView(this);
        whoLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_who_q"));
        whoLabel.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        whoLabel.setTextSize(17);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams wl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        wl.topMargin = dp(14);
        root.addView(whoLabel, wl);
        nameBox = new EditText(this);
        nameBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "story_name_hint"));
        nameBox.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        nameBox.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 158, 185));
        nameBox.setTextSize(19);
        nameBox.setSingleLine(true);
        root.addView(nameBox);

        countView = new TextView(this);
        countView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 200));
        countView.setTextSize(14);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        cl.topMargin = dp(12);
        root.addView(countView, cl);

        ScrollView ps = new ScrollView(this);
        passageView = new TextView(this);
        passageView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        passageView.setTextSize(23);
        passageView.setLineSpacing(1.25f, 1f);
        ps.addView(passageView);
        root.addView(ps, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));

        LinearLayout controls = new LinearLayout(this);
        controls.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button prev = navButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_back"), v -> step(-1));
        recBtn = navButton(LangStore.tr(this, "story_record"), v -> toggleRecord());
        Button play = navButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_play"), v -> playPreview());
        Button next = navButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_forward"), v -> step(1));
        controls.addView(prev);
        controls.addView(recBtn);
        controls.addView(play);
        controls.addView(next);
        root.addView(controls);
        showPassage();
    }

    private Button navButton(String label, android.view.View.OnClickListener on) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setTextSize(16);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setMinHeight(dp(60));
        b.setOnClickListener(on);
        b.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        return b;
    }

    private void showPassage() {
        if (chunks.isEmpty()) return;
        chunk = Math.max(0, Math.min(chunk, chunks.size() - 1));
        passageView.setText(chunks.get(chunk).text);
        Map<Integer, String[]> idx = StoryFiles.voiceIndex(this, row.id);
        String[] rec = idx.get(chunk);
        countView.setText(String.format(LangStore.tr(this, "story_passage_of"),
                chunk + 1, chunks.size())
                + (rec != null ? "  ·  🎙 " + rec[0] : ""));
    }

    private void step(int dir) {
        if (recording) stopRecording(false);
        chunk += dir;
        showPassage();
    }

    private void toggleRecord() {
        if (recording) {
            stopRecording(true);
            return;
        }
        String who = nameBox.getText().toString().trim();
        if (who.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_who_q"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO}, 7);
            return;
        }
        try {
            recTarget = new File(StoryFiles.bookVoicesDir(this, row.id),
                    "c" + chunk + ".m4a");
            recorder = new MediaRecorder();
            recorder.setAudioSource(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            recorder.setOutputFormat(MediaRecorder.OutputFormat.MPEG_4);
            recorder.setAudioEncoder(MediaRecorder.AudioEncoder.AAC);
            recorder.setOutputFile(recTarget.getAbsolutePath());
            recorder.prepare();
            recorder.start();
            recording = true;
            recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_stop_rec"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stopRecording(false);
        }
    }

    private void stopRecording(boolean keep) {
        recording = false;
        if (recBtn != null) recBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_record"));
        if (recorder != null) {
            try { recorder.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { recorder.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            recorder = null;
        }
        if (keep && recTarget != null && recTarget.isFile()) {
            String who = nameBox.getText().toString().trim();
            Map<Integer, String[]> idx = StoryFiles.voiceIndex(this, row.id);
            idx.put(chunk, new String[]{who, recTarget.getName()});
            StoryFiles.saveVoiceIndex(this, row.id, idx);
            StoryCast.Entry e = StoryCast.enrollFamily(cast, who);
            e.recordings.put(chunk, recTarget.getName());
            StoryFiles.saveCast(this, cast);
            Toast.makeText(this, LangStore.tr(this, "story_saved"),
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            showPassage();
        } else if (recTarget != null) {
            recTarget.delete();
        }
        recTarget = null;
    }

    private void playPreview() {
        Map<Integer, String[]> idx = StoryFiles.voiceIndex(this, row.id);
        String[] rec = idx.get(chunk);
        if (rec == null) return;
        File f = new File(StoryFiles.bookVoicesDir(this, row.id), rec[1]);
        if (!f.isFile()) return;
        stopPreview();
        try {
            preview = new MediaPlayer();
            preview.setDataSource(f.getAbsolutePath());
            preview.setOnCompletionListener(mp -> stopPreview());
            preview.prepare();
            preview.start();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stopPreview();
        }
    }

    private void stopPreview() {
        if (preview != null) {
            try { preview.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { preview.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            preview = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (recorder != null) stopRecording(false);
        stopPreview();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryShelfActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The Story shelf (v0.14.0; the FOUNTAIN wired in v0.16.0) —
 * three shelves in one room:
 *
 *   THE CURATED SHELF — the hand-picked tales of the curation
 *   file, exactly as before.
 *
 *   THE STORY FOUNTAIN — whole children's BOOKS resolved live
 *   from the BookSource fountain: membership in a named
 *   children's collection at the source (the Archive's
 *   International Children's Digital Library, "iacl") + open
 *   access verified from the item's own file list + a readable
 *   sibling that actually resolves. Curation moved to the
 *   collection gate; abundance comes from the fountain. A tile
 *   renders ONLY for a book that resolved — printed counts are
 *   verified stories only (Display Honesty).
 *
 *   MADE STORIES — cartridges a reader made from a book with
 *   Make a Story, labeled with their provenance.
 *
 * If nothing can resolve (no network, an empty hook), the room
 * says so in plain words — "Story shelf needs the network to
 * fill" — never a bare, lying room.
 */
public class StoryShelfActivity extends Activity {

    private LinearLayout shelfBox, fountainBox, madeBox;
    private TextView statusView;
    private volatile boolean destroyed = false;
    private volatile boolean netFailed = false;
    private volatile int shownTotal = 0;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dp(16);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_shelf"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        title.setTextSize(30);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_loading"));
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
        statusView.setTextSize(18);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams sl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sl.topMargin = dp(14);
        root.addView(statusView, sl);

        shelfBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        shelfBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.addView(shelfBox);

        root.addView(sectionHeader(LangStore.tr(this, "story_fountain")));
        TextView fNote = new TextView(this);
        fNote.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_fountain_note"));
        fNote.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 205));
        fNote.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(fNote);
        fountainBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        fountainBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.addView(fountainBox);

        root.addView(sectionHeader(LangStore.tr(this, "story_made")));
        madeBox = new LinearLayout(this);
        madeBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.addView(madeBox);
        setContentView(scroll);

        showMade();
        List<StoryData.Row> curated = StoryFiles.curation(this);
        List<StoryData.Row> cachedFountain = StoryFiles.fountain(this);
        new Thread(() -> {
            verifyRows(curated, shelfBox);
            verifyRows(cachedFountain, fountainBox);
            fillFountain();
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed) return;
                if (shownTotal == 0) {
                    statusView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this,
                            netFailed ? "story_shelf_network"
                                    : "story_shelf_empty"));
                }
            });
        }, "story-shelf-verify").start();
    }

    private TextView sectionHeader(String text) {
        TextView h = new TextView(this);
        h.setText(text);
        h.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        h.setTextSize(23);
        h.setTypeface(h.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(22);
        h.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return h;
    }

    /** Verify, then surface: tiles only for resolved books. */
    private void verifyRows(List<StoryData.Row> rows,
                            LinearLayout box) {
        List<VoiceLangs.Row> voiceRows = VoiceLangs.load(this);
        for (StoryData.Row row : rows) {
            if (destroyed) return;
            boolean resolved;
            if (StoryFiles.bookHeld(this, row.id)) {
                resolved = true;
            } else {
                try {
                    StoryFetch.fetchText(this, row);
                    resolved = true;
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    resolved = false;   // no tile — the law
                }
            }
            if (!resolved) continue;
            shownTotal++;
            VoiceLangs.Row vr = VoiceLangs.byIso1(voiceRows, row.lang);
            final String tongue = vr != null ? vr.tvName : row.lang;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed) return;
                addTile(row, tongue, box);
                statusView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            });
        }
    }

    /**
     * The fountain fill: one page of the children's collection,
     * each candidate settled by the BookSource gate (collection
     * membership + OPEN + resolvable sibling) before it may
     * stand as a story. Verified rows are cached to the fountain
     * file, so the shelf deepens across opens and stands offline
     * for books already held.
     */
    private void fillFountain() {
        List<StoryData.Row> known = StoryFiles.fountain(this);
        java.util.Set<String> knownIds = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (StoryData.Row r : known) knownIds.add(r.id);
        List<BookSource.Hit> hits;
        try {
            hits = BookSource.parseIaSearch(
                    Net.getString(BookSource.iaChildrenUrl(30, 1)));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            netFailed = true;
            return;
        }
        int added = 0;
        List<StoryData.Row> grown = new ArrayList<>(known);
        for (BookSource.Hit h : hits) {
            if (destroyed || added >= 12) break;
            String rowId = "fc_" + h.itemId;
            if (knownIds.contains(rowId)) continue;
            try {
                BookSource.applyIaMetadata(h,
                        Net.getString(IaClient.metadataUrl(h.itemId)));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                continue;   // unresolved — not eligible, no tile
            }
            if (!BookSource.storyEligible(h)) continue;
            StoryData.Row row = new StoryData.Row();
            row.id = rowId;
            row.title = h.title;
            row.author = h.author;
            row.lang = iso1Of(h.language);
            row.taleGroup = "";
            row.iaId = h.itemId;
            row.source = BookSource.IA;
            row.illustrated = h.pageImages;
            try {
                StoryFetch.fetchText(this, row);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                continue;   // the sibling did not resolve — no tile
            }
            grown.add(row);
            knownIds.add(rowId);
            added++;
            shownTotal++;
            VoiceLangs.Row vr = VoiceLangs.byIso1(
                    VoiceLangs.load(this), row.lang);
            final String tongue = vr != null ? vr.tvName : row.lang;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (destroyed) return;
                addTile(row, tongue, fountainBox);
                statusView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            });
            StoryFiles.saveFountain(this, grown);
        }
        if (added > 0) StoryFiles.saveFountain(this, grown);
    }

    /** MARC code (the Archive's tongue) → ISO-1 (the shelf's). */
    private static String iso1Of(String marc) {
        if (marc == null) return "en";
        switch (marc.trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US)) {
            case "eng": return "en";
            case "spa": return "es";
            case "fre": case "fra": return "fr";
            case "ger": case "deu": return "de";
            case "ita": return "it";
            case "por": return "pt";
            case "rus": return "ru";
            case "jpn": return "ja";
            case "chi": case "zho": return "zh";
            case "kor": return "ko";
            case "ara": return "ar";
            case "hin": return "hi";
            case "per": case "fas": return "fa";
            default: return "en";
        }
    }

    private void addTile(StoryData.Row row, String tongue,
                         LinearLayout box) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(row.title + "\n" + row.author + " · " + tongue + "  ●");
        b.setTextSize(21);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL | Gravity.START);
        b.setPadding(dp(16), 0, dp(16), 0);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(92));
        lp.topMargin = dp(12);
        b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, StoryTellActivity.class);
            i.putExtra(StoryTellActivity.X_BOOK, row.id);
            startActivity(i);
        });
        b.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            // Read the story book on screen, in the reading room.
            try {
                java.io.File f = StoryFiles.bookTextFile(this, row.id);
                String buri = f.getAbsolutePath();
                BookStore.addFile(this, buri);
                BookStore.Book book = BookStore.byId(this,
                        BookStore.idFor(buri));
                if (book == null) return true;
                Intent i = new Intent(this, ReaderRoomActivity.class);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_BID, book.id);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_KEY,
                        ReaderBook.keyFor("story", row.id));
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_TITLE, row.title);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_AUTHOR, row.author);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_SOURCE, row.source);
                i.putExtra(ReaderRoomActivity.X_LANG, row.lang);
                startActivity(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            return true;
        });
        box.addView(b, lp);
    }

    /** Made stories: cartridges made from books, provenance first. */
    private void showMade() {
        for (StoryData.Cartridge c : StoryFiles.cartridges(this)) {
            if (c.bookId == null || c.bookId.isEmpty()) continue;
            shownTotal++;
            Button b = new Button(this);
            String label = c.title + "\n"
                    + LangStore.tr(this, "story_made_from") + " "
                    + c.fromBook + " (" + c.fromSource + ")";
            b.setText(label);
            b.setTextSize(19);
            b.setAllCaps(false);
            b.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL | Gravity.START);
            b.setPadding(dp(16), 0, dp(16), 0);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(92));
            lp.topMargin = dp(12);
            final String cid = c.id;
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, StoryPlayActivity.class);
                i.putExtra(StoryPlayActivity.X_CARTRIDGE, cid);
                startActivity(i);
            });
            madeBox.addView(b, lp);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/StoryTellActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.media.MediaPlayer;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.FrameLayout;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * The telling (v0.14.0) — a storybook read aloud in Sandy's
 * story room, with the storyboard over it:
 *
 *   - the book is cast ONCE (StoryCast): narrator + a voice per
 *     character, persistent across chapters, from the shelf file;
 *   - voices resolve by the house ladder (v0.13.0): an installed
 *     voice pack speaks first, then the phone's voice, and when
 *     neither covers the tongue the room says so BEFORE anything
 *     is read — no silent substitute, ever;
 *   - where a passage is covered by a FAMILY recording (Grandma
 *     read this part herself), the recording plays and no
 *     synthesized voice speaks that passage;
 *   - the storyboard advances with the chunks: the edition's own
 *     illustrations where the Archive exposes them, else Sandy's
 *     bundled picture cards (a scene from the passage's words +
 *     the speakers' cards, and a character's card never changes
 *     inside a book);
 *   - bilingual hearing, where the shelf holds the same tale in
 *     two tongues: the passage in the first tongue, then in the
 *     second — a per-book toggle, and a plain gap where the
 *     shelf holds only one;
 *   - bedtime shape: no autoplay (the play button is a hand's),
 *     no countdowns; with Bedtime armed at the door, the light
 *     dims and the pace slows as the telling goes on.
 *
 * The speech engine lives here, in the room (the grown-ups'
 * reader keeps its own service): pack voices are synthesized
 * per segment (OnnxVoiceSynth -> AudioTrack), phone voices ride
 * the phone's engine with the cast's pitch and rate.
 */
public class StoryTellActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_BOOK = "book";

    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final ExecutorService exec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private StoryData.Row row;
    private StoryCast.Book cast;
    private List<BookChunker.Chunk> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<Integer, List<StoryCast.Segment>> segCache = new HashMap<>();
    private Map<Integer, String[]> voiceIndex = new HashMap<>();

    private StoryData.Row pairRow;
    private StoryCast.Book pairCast;
    private List<BookChunker.Chunk> pairChunks;
    private boolean bilingualOn = false;

    private List<String> illustrations = new ArrayList<>();
    private String prevScene = "";

    private TextToSpeech tts;
    private boolean ttsReady = false;
    private VoiceResolve.Result voice;       // for the book's tongue
    private VoiceResolve.Result pairVoice;   // for the pair's tongue
    private final Map<String, OnnxVoiceSynth> synths = new HashMap<>();
    private AudioTrack packTrack;
