    private MediaPlayer recPlayer;

    private boolean ready = false;
    private boolean playing = false;
    private boolean destroyed = false;
    private int gen = 0;
    private int chunk = 0;
    private int segPos = 0;
    private boolean pairHalf = false;   // speaking the pair tongue now
    private boolean packFailed = false;

    private long sessionStartMs = 0;
    private double paceFactor = 1.0;

    private ImageView illusView, sceneView, charView1, charView2;
    private TextView picNote, speakerView, textView, passageView, statusView;
    private Button playBtn, bilingualBtn;
    private TextView bilingualNote;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        String bookId = getIntent().getStringExtra(X_BOOK);
        for (StoryData.Row r : StoryFiles.allRows(this)) {
            if (r.id.equals(bookId)) row = r;
        }
        buildUi();
        if (row == null) {
            statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_fetch_fail"));
            return;
        }
        List<StoryData.Row> pairs = StoryData.pairOptions(
                StoryFiles.allRows(this), row);
        // the pair tongue: the house's own language first
        String ui = ChannelStore.getUiLanguage(this);
        pairRow = StoryData.bilingualPair(StoryFiles.allRows(this), row,
                ui == null || ui.isEmpty() ? "en" : ui);
        if (pairRow == null && !pairs.isEmpty()) pairRow = pairs.get(0);
        bilingualOn = pairRow != null && StoryFiles.bilingual(this, row.id);
        paintBilingual();

        tts = new TextToSpeech(this, status -> {
            ttsReady = status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS;
            if (ttsReady) {
                tts.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(new UtteranceProgressListener() {
                    @Override public void onStart(String id) {}
                    @Override public void onDone(String id) {
                        main.post(() -> onSegmentDone(id));
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String id) {
                        main.post(() -> onSegmentDone(id));
                    }
                });
            }
            main.post(this::maybeReady);
        });

        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_loading"));
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String text = StoryFetch.fetchText(this, row);
                List<BookChunker.Chunk> ch = BookChunker.chunk(text, null);
                StoryCast.Book c = StoryFiles.loadCast(this, row);
                List<String> texts = new ArrayList<>();
                for (BookChunker.Chunk k : ch) texts.add(k.text);
                StoryCast.collectCast(c, texts);
                StoryFiles.assignCards(c);
                StoryFiles.saveCast(this, c);
                List<String> illus = StoryFetch.illustrations(this, row);
                Map<Integer, String[]> vi = StoryFiles.voiceIndex(this, row.id);
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    chunks = ch;
                    cast = c;
                    illustrations = illus;
                    voiceIndex = vi;
                    chunk = Math.min(StoryFiles.storyPlace(this, row.id),
                            Math.max(0, chunks.size() - 1));
                    maybeReady();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (!destroyed) {
                        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_fetch_fail"));
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ UI

    private void buildUi() {
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 28, 44));
        int pad = dp(14);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        FrameLayout panelBox = new FrameLayout(this);
        panelBox.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(14, 16, 26));
        root.addView(panelBox, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(228)));
        illusView = new ImageView(this);
        illusView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        illusView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        panelBox.addView(illusView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
        sceneView = new ImageView(this);
        sceneView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        panelBox.addView(sceneView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));
        charView1 = cardView(panelBox, Gravity.BOTTOM | Gravity.START);
        charView2 = cardView(panelBox, Gravity.BOTTOM | Gravity.END);

        picNote = new TextView(this);
        picNote.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 158, 185));
        picNote.setTextSize(12);
        root.addView(picNote);

        speakerView = new TextView(this);
        speakerView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 224, 150));
        speakerView.setTextSize(20);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams spl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        spl.topMargin = dp(8);
        root.addView(speakerView, spl);

        ScrollView textScroll = new ScrollView(this);
        textView = new TextView(this);
        textView.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        textView.setTextSize(23);
        textView.setLineSpacing(1.25f, 1f);
        textScroll.addView(textView);
        root.addView(textScroll, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));

        passageView = new TextView(this);
        passageView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 200));
        passageView.setTextSize(14);
        root.addView(passageView);

        LinearLayout controls = new LinearLayout(this);
        controls.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button prev = bigButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_back"), v -> step(-1));
        playBtn = bigButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_play"), v -> togglePlay());
        Button next = bigButton(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_forward"), v -> step(1));
        controls.addView(prev, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        controls.addView(playBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        controls.addView(next, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
        root.addView(controls);

        bilingualBtn = new Button(this);
        bilingualBtn.setTextSize(16);
        bilingualBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        bilingualBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            bilingualOn = !bilingualOn;
            StoryFiles.setBilingual(this, row.id, bilingualOn);
            if (bilingualOn) ensurePairLoaded();
            paintBilingual();
        });
        root.addView(bilingualBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        bilingualNote = new TextView(this);
        bilingualNote.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 178, 200));
        bilingualNote.setTextSize(13);
        root.addView(bilingualNote);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 206, 226));
        statusView.setTextSize(15);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams stl = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        stl.topMargin = dp(8);
        root.addView(statusView, stl);

        setContentView(root);
    }

    private ImageView cardView(FrameLayout box, int gravity) {
        ImageView v = new ImageView(this);
        v.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        FrameLayout.LayoutParams lp = new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dp(92), dp(92), gravity);
        lp.setMargins(dp(8), 0, dp(8), dp(8));
        box.addView(v, lp);
        return v;
    }

    private Button bigButton(String label, View.OnClickListener on) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setTextSize(19);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setMinHeight(dp(64));
        b.setOnClickListener(on);
        return b;
    }

    private void paintBilingual() {
        if (bilingualBtn == null) return;
        if (pairRow == null) {
            bilingualBtn.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            bilingualNote.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        bilingualBtn.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        bilingualBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_bilingual")
                + (bilingualOn ? "  ✓" : ""));
        if (bilingualOn) {
            List<VoiceLangs.Row> vrows = VoiceLangs.load(this);
            VoiceLangs.Row a = VoiceLangs.byIso1(vrows, row.lang);
            VoiceLangs.Row b = VoiceLangs.byIso1(vrows, pairRow.lang);
            bilingualNote.setText(String.format(
                    LangStore.tr(this, "story_bilingual_note"),
                    a != null ? a.tvName : row.lang,
                    b != null ? b.tvName : pairRow.lang));
            bilingualNote.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        } else {
            bilingualNote.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ load

    private void maybeReady() {
        if (ready || destroyed || cast == null || !ttsReady) return;
        ready = true;
        voice = resolveVoice(row.lang);
        if (pairRow != null) pairVoice = resolveVoice(pairRow.lang);
        paintVoiceStatus();
        showChunk(chunk);
        playBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_play"));
    }

    private VoiceResolve.Result resolveVoice(String iso1) {
        VoiceLangs.Row vr = VoiceLangs.byIso1(VoiceLangs.load(this), iso1);
        Set<String> system = new HashSet<>();
        if (vr != null && !vr.iso1.isEmpty() && ttsReady) {
            try {
                int avail = tts.isLanguageAvailable(new Locale(vr.iso1));
                if (avail >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) system.add(vr.iso1);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return VoiceResolve.resolve(vr, VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this), system);
    }

    private void paintVoiceStatus() {
        if (voice == null) return;
        VoiceLangs.Row vr = VoiceLangs.byIso1(VoiceLangs.load(this), row.lang);
        String tongue = vr != null ? vr.tvName : row.lang;
        switch (voice.voice) {
            case PACK:
                statusView.setText(String.format(
                        LangStore.tr(this, "dub_voice_pack"), tongue));
                break;
            case SYSTEM:
                statusView.setText(String.format(
                        LangStore.tr(this, "dub_voice_system"), tongue));
                break;
            default:
                statusView.setText(String.format(
                        LangStore.tr(this, "story_no_voice"), tongue));
                break;
        }
    }

    private boolean voiceUsable(VoiceResolve.Result r) {
        return r != null && r.voice != VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE;
    }

    private void ensurePairLoaded() {
        if (pairRow == null || pairChunks != null) return;
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String text = StoryFetch.fetchText(this, pairRow);
                List<BookChunker.Chunk> ch = BookChunker.chunk(text, null);
                StoryCast.Book c = StoryFiles.loadCast(this, pairRow);
                List<String> texts = new ArrayList<>();
                for (BookChunker.Chunk k : ch) texts.add(k.text);
                StoryCast.collectCast(c, texts);
                StoryFiles.assignCards(c);
                StoryFiles.saveCast(this, c);
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (destroyed) return;
                    pairChunks = ch;
                    pairCast = c;
                });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (!destroyed) {
                        statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_fetch_fail"));
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ show

    private List<StoryCast.Segment> segmentsOf(int i) {
        List<StoryCast.Segment> segs = segCache.get(i);
        if (segs == null) {
            segs = StoryCast.attribute(cast, chunks.get(i).text);
            segCache.put(i, segs);
        }
        return segs;
    }

    private void showChunk(int i) {
        if (chunks.isEmpty()) return;
        chunk = Math.max(0, Math.min(i, chunks.size() - 1));
        StoryFiles.setStoryPlace(this, row.id, chunk);
        List<StoryCast.Segment> segs = segmentsOf(chunk);
        textView.setText(chunks.get(chunk).text);
        speakerView.setText(segs.isEmpty() ? "" : speakerName(segs.get(0).speaker));
        passageView.setText(String.format(
                LangStore.tr(this, "story_passage_of"), chunk + 1, chunks.size()));
        paintPanel(segs);
    }

    private String speakerName(String speaker) {
        if (speaker == null || speaker.equals(StoryCast.NARRATOR)) {
            List<VoiceLangs.Row> vrows = VoiceLangs.load(this);
            return "";
        }
        return speaker;
    }

    private void paintPanel(List<StoryCast.Segment> segs) {
        if (!illustrations.isEmpty()) {
            int idx = Math.min(illustrations.size() - 1,
                    chunk * illustrations.size() / Math.max(1, chunks.size()));
            illusView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            sceneView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            charView1.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            charView2.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            ImageCache.load(this, illustrations.get(idx), illusView);
            picNote.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_illustrated_note"));
            return;
        }
        illusView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        sceneView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        List<String> cards = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder passage = new StringBuilder();
        for (StoryCast.Segment s : segs) {
            passage.append(s.text).append(' ');
            StoryCast.Entry e = cast.byName(s.speaker);
            if (e != null && !e.cardId.isEmpty()) cards.add(e.cardId);
        }
        StoryPanels.Choice choice = StoryPanels.choose(
                prevScene, passage.toString(), cards);
        prevScene = choice.sceneId;
        sceneView.setImageResource(resId(StoryPanels.drawableName(choice.sceneId)));
        ImageView[] views = {charView1, charView2};
        for (int k = 0; k < views.length; k++) {
            if (k < choice.charIds.size()) {
                views[k].setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                views[k].setImageResource(
                        resId(StoryPanels.drawableName(choice.charIds.get(k))));
            } else {
                views[k].setVisibility(View.GONE);
            }
        }
        picNote.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "story_cards_note"));
    }

    private int resId(String drawable) {
        return getResources().getIdentifier(drawable, "drawable", getPackageName());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ play

    private void togglePlay() {
        if (!ready) return;
        if (playing) {
            pauseTelling();
        } else {
            if (!voiceUsable(voice)) {
                paintVoiceStatus();   // the gap, said before any reading
                return;
            }
            playing = true;
            if (sessionStartMs == 0) sessionStartMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
            playBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_pause"));
            speakCurrent();
        }
    }

    private void pauseTelling() {
        playing = false;
        gen++;
        stopSpeech();
        playBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_play"));
    }

    private void stopSpeech() {
        if (tts != null) { try { tts.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {} }
        if (packTrack != null) {
            try { packTrack.stop(); packTrack.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            packTrack = null;
        }
        if (recPlayer != null) {
            try { recPlayer.stop(); recPlayer.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            recPlayer = null;
        }
    }

    private void step(int dir) {
        boolean was = playing;
        pauseTelling();
        showChunk(chunk + dir);
        if (was) togglePlay();
    }

    /** Speak the current chunk from its first segment. */
    private void speakCurrent() {
        if (!playing || destroyed) return;
        pairHalf = false;
        String[] rec = voiceIndex.get(chunk);
        if (rec != null && rec.length >= 2) {
            File f = new File(StoryFiles.bookVoicesDir(this, row.id), rec[1]);
            if (f.isFile()) {
                speakerView.setText(rec[0]);
                playRecording(f, () -> advance());
                return;
            }
        }
        segPos = 0;
        speakSegment();
    }

    private void speakSegment() {
        if (!playing || destroyed) return;
        StoryCast.Book book = pairHalf ? pairCast : cast;
        List<BookChunker.Chunk> bookChunks = pairHalf ? pairChunks : chunks;
        int bookChunk = pairHalf ? pairIndex() : chunk;
        if (book == null || bookChunks == null || bookChunk >= bookChunks.size()) {
            onChunkSpoken();
            return;
        }
        List<StoryCast.Segment> segs = pairHalf
                ? StoryCast.attribute(book, bookChunks.get(bookChunk).text)
                : segmentsOf(chunk);
        if (segPos >= segs.size()) { onChunkSpoken(); return; }
        StoryCast.Segment seg = segs.get(segPos);
        speakerView.setText(speakerName(seg.speaker));
        StoryCast.Entry entry = book.byName(seg.speaker);
        if (entry == null) entry = book.narrator();
        VoiceResolve.Result vr = pairHalf ? pairVoice : voice;
        double pace = paceFactor * windPace();
        if (vr != null && vr.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.PACK && !packFailed) {
            speakPack(seg.text, entry, vr.packCode, pace);
        } else {
            speakTts(seg.text, entry, pairHalf ? pairRow.lang : row.lang, pace);
        }
    }

    private int pairIndex() {
        if (pairChunks == null || pairChunks.isEmpty()) return 0;
        return Math.min(pairChunks.size() - 1,
                chunk * pairChunks.size() / Math.max(1, chunks.size()));
    }

    private void speakTts(String text, StoryCast.Entry entry, String lang,
                          double pace) {
        if (tts == null || !ttsReady) { onSegmentDone(""); return; }
        try {
            Locale loc = new Locale(lang == null ? "en" : lang);
            tts.setLanguage(loc);
            tts.setPitch((float) entry.pitch);
            tts.setSpeechRate((float) Math.max(0.3, entry.rate * pace));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        String id = "s" + chunk + "_" + (pairHalf ? "p" : "a") + segPos;
        int r = tts.speak(text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, new Bundle(), id);
        if (r == TextToSpeech.ERROR) onSegmentDone(id);
    }

    private void speakPack(String text, StoryCast.Entry entry, String code,
                           double pace) {
        final int myGen = ++gen;
        final double rate = Math.max(0.3, entry.rate * pace);
        final double pitch = entry.pitch;
        exec.execute(() -> {
            try {
                OnnxVoiceSynth synth = synths.get(code);
                if (synth == null) {
                    synth = OnnxVoiceSynth.open(VoicePackStore.packDir(this, code));
                    synths.put(code, synth);
                }
                float[] pcm = synth.synth(text, 1.0 / rate);
                pcm = OnnxVoiceSynth.pitchShift(pcm, pitch);
                if (myGen != gen || destroyed) return;
                if (pcm.length == 0) throw new Exception("the pack said nothing");
                short[] s16 = new short[pcm.length];
                for (int i = 0; i < pcm.length; i++) {
                    float v = Math.max(-1f, Math.min(1f, pcm[i]));
                    s16[i] = (short) (v * 32767);
                }
                AudioTrack track = new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setAudioFormat(new AudioFormat.Builder()
                                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                                .setSampleRate(OnnxVoiceSynth.SAMPLE_RATE)
                                .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                                .build())
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(Math.max(s16.length * 2,
                                AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                                        OnnxVoiceSynth.SAMPLE_RATE,
                                        AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
                                        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)))
                        .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STATIC)
                        .build();
                track.write(s16, 0, s16.length);
                if (myGen != gen) { track.release(); return; }
                if (packTrack != null) {
                    try { packTrack.stop(); packTrack.release(); }
                    catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                packTrack = track;
                track.play();
                while (myGen == gen && !destroyed
                        && track.getPlayState() == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                    if (track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() >= s16.length) break;
                    try { Thread.sleep(90); }
                    catch (InterruptedException e) { return; }
                }
                boolean finished = myGen == gen && !destroyed
                        && track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() >= s16.length;
                if (finished) main.post(() -> onSegmentDone("pack"));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                if (myGen != gen || destroyed) return;
                main.post(() -> {
                    // the pack stumbled: say so, and the phone
                    // voice carries the rest of the book
                    packFailed = true;
                    statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_voice_pack_fail"));
                    speakSegment();
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void playRecording(File f, Runnable onDone) {
        stopSpeech();
        try {
            recPlayer = new MediaPlayer();
            recPlayer.setDataSource(f.getAbsolutePath());
            recPlayer.setOnCompletionListener(mp -> {
                if (recPlayer != null) {
                    recPlayer.release();
                    recPlayer = null;
                }
                if (playing && !destroyed) onDone.run();
            });
            recPlayer.setOnErrorListener((mp, w, e) -> {
                if (recPlayer != null) {
                    recPlayer.release();
                    recPlayer = null;
                }
                if (playing && !destroyed) onDone.run();
                return true;
            });
            recPlayer.prepare();
            recPlayer.start();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            if (playing && !destroyed) onDone.run();
        }
    }

    private void onSegmentDone(String id) {
        if (!playing || destroyed) return;
        segPos++;
        speakSegment();
    }

    /** One half (one tongue) of the current chunk is fully spoken. */
    private void onChunkSpoken() {
        if (bilingualOn && !pairHalf && pairChunks != null
                && voiceUsable(pairVoice)) {
            pairHalf = true;
            segPos = 0;
            int pi = pairIndex();
            textView.setText(pairChunks.get(pi).text);
            speakSegment();
            return;
        }
        advance();
    }

    private void advance() {
        if (chunk + 1 >= chunks.size()) {
            pauseTelling();
            statusView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "reader_finished"));
            showChunk(0);
            return;
        }
        showChunk(chunk + 1);
        if (playing) speakCurrent();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ bedtime

    /** The wind-down: as a bedtime telling goes on, the pace
     *  eases in steps. Measured from the session's own start —
     *  no promised numbers, just the shape. */
    private double windPace() {
        if (!StoryFiles.bedtime(this) || sessionStartMs == 0) return 1.0;
        long mins = (System.currentTimeMillis() - sessionStartMs) / 60_000;
        int steps = (int) Math.min(5, mins / 2);
        double pace = 1.0 - 0.04 * steps;
        if (steps > 0) {
            WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = getWindow().getAttributes();
            lp.screenBrightness = Math.max(0.2f, 0.85f - 0.13f * steps);
            getWindow().setAttributes(lp);
        }
        return pace;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        gen++;
        stopSpeech();
        if (tts != null) {
            try { tts.shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        for (OnnxVoiceSynth s : synths.values()) {
            try { s.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        exec.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SubFinder.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Finding the subtitle files a video already carries (v0.12.0) —
 * the harvest's eyes. Same three roads as DubFinder, because
 * subtitles live wherever the video lives: a plain folder path
 * (scan the folder for any subtitle sibling), the media files
 * table (exact sidecar names), and the picked folder tree.
 * A subtitle the finder cannot see is a subtitle the flow will
 * honestly call missing — the ear road then applies.
 */
public final class SubFinder {

    public static final class Found {
        /** content URI string, or an absolute path on the plain road. */
        public String uri = "";
        public String name = "";
        /** Language declared by the file's name; "" when unnamed. */
        public String lang = "";
    }

    private SubFinder() {}

    public static List<Found> find(Context ctx, String videoUrl, String videoName) {
        Map<String, Found> byName = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        String stem = DubTrack.stemOf(videoName == null ? "" : videoName);
        // Road 1: a plain path — scan the folder for subtitle siblings
        if (videoUrl != null && (videoUrl.startsWith("/")
                || videoUrl.startsWith("file://"))) {
            String path = videoUrl.startsWith("file://")
                    ? Uri.parse(videoUrl).getPath() : videoUrl;
            File video = new File(path == null ? "" : path);
            File dir = video.getParentFile();
            if (dir != null && dir.isDirectory()) {
                File[] kids = dir.listFiles();
                if (kids != null) {
                    for (File k : kids) {
                        String n = k.getName();
                        if (!SubHarvest.isSubtitleName(n)) continue;
                        if (!n.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US).startsWith(
                                stem.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US))) continue;
                        if (n.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US).contains(".tr-")) continue;
                        Found f = new Found();
                        f.uri = k.getAbsolutePath();
                        f.name = n;
                        f.lang = SubHarvest.langFromName(n, stem);
                        byName.put(n.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US), f);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Roads 2+3: exact candidate names through DubFinder's own
        // roads (the media files table, then the picked folder
        // tree) — the same machinery that finds prepared dubs.
        if (videoUrl != null && !videoUrl.isEmpty()) {
            LibraryIndex.Entry entry = new LibraryIndex.Entry();
            entry.uri = videoUrl;
            entry.fileName = videoName == null ? "" : videoName;
            for (String name : SubHarvest.candidateNames(videoName)) {
                String key = name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
                if (byName.containsKey(key)) continue;
                String hit = DubFinder.findAny(ctx, entry,
                        java.util.Collections.singletonList(name), true);
                if (hit != null) {
                    Found f = new Found();
                    f.uri = hit;
                    f.name = name;
                    f.lang = SubHarvest.langFromName(name, stem);
                    byName.put(key, f);
                }
            }
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(byName.values());
    }

    /** Read a found subtitle's text (plain path or content URI). */
    public static String readText(Context ctx, Found f) {
        try {
            java.io.InputStream in;
            if (f.uri.startsWith("/")) {
                in = new java.io.FileInputStream(new File(f.uri));
            } else {
                in = ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(Uri.parse(f.uri));
            }
            if (in == null) return null;
            try {
                java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
                return new String(bos.toByteArray(), "UTF-8");
            } finally {
                in.close();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/SubHarvest.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Subtitle harvest (v0.12.0) — James's subtitle-first pipeline,
 * first stage: the text a video ALREADY carries, lifted out whole.
 *
 * Nearly every video ships with subtitles now, often in several
 * languages. If that text is in ANY known language, the translation
 * matrix can move it directly between written languages — no ear
 * involved, no transcription errors inherited, and the timings are
 * the dub's clock for free. The ear (ASR) is the fallback for video
 * with no usable subtitle track, never the first road.
 *
 * Formats, the three anime actually ships: SRT, WebVTT, and ASS —
 * ASS matters doubly: fansub files carry the SPEAKER'S NAME in the
 * dialogue Name field when the subbers bothered, and VTT voice
 * spans (<v Name>) do the same. Named lines feed the casting desk
 * even before a diarizer hears a word.
 *
 * Pure text work; the harness pins all three parsers on fixtures,
 * including the dirty real-world shapes (override blocks, cue
 * settings, multi-line cues, SDH brackets kept — cleaning is
 * conservative: tags and control codes go, words stay).
 */
public final class SubHarvest {

    public static final class Track {
        /** Normalized language code ("ja", "en", …) or "" when the
         *  file's name doesn't say — never guessed from content. */
        public String lang = "";
        public String format = "";      // srt | vtt | ass
        public final List<CookedSubs.Line> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        /** Lines carrying a speaker name (ASS Name / VTT <v>). */
        public int namedLines = 0;
        public double durationSec = 0;
    }

    private SubHarvest() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ names

    private static final Map<String, String> LANG_ALIASES = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    static {
        String[][] pairs = {
            {"eng", "en"}, {"spa", "es"}, {"fre", "fr"}, {"fra", "fr"},
            {"ger", "de"}, {"deu", "de"}, {"por", "pt"}, {"ita", "it"},
            {"rus", "ru"}, {"ara", "ar"}, {"hin", "hi"}, {"chi", "zh"},
            {"zho", "zh"}, {"jpn", "ja"}, {"kor", "ko"}, {"fas", "fa"},
            {"per", "fa"}, {"english", "en"}, {"spanish", "es"},
            {"french", "fr"}, {"german", "de"}, {"portuguese", "pt"},
            {"italian", "it"}, {"russian", "ru"}, {"arabic", "ar"},
            {"hindi", "hi"}, {"chinese", "zh"}, {"japanese", "ja"},
            {"korean", "ko"}, {"persian", "fa"}, {"farsi", "fa"},
        };
        for (String[] p : pairs) LANG_ALIASES.put(p[0], p[1]);
    }

    /** Normalize a raw language tag to a 2-letter code when known;
     *  a clean 2-letter tag passes; anything else returns "". */
    public static String normalizeLang(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return "";
        String t = raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        int dash = t.indexOf('-');
        if (dash > 0) t = t.substring(0, dash);
        int us = t.indexOf('_');
        if (us > 0) t = t.substring(0, us);
        String mapped = LANG_ALIASES.get(t);
        if (mapped != null) return mapped;
        if (t.matches("[a-z]{2}")) return t;
        return "";
    }

    /**
     * The language a subtitle FILE NAME declares: "Show.ja.srt",
     * "Show.eng.srt", "Show.en.forced.srt", "Show.english.srt" all
     * speak; "Show.srt" and "Show.tr-en.srt" (a cooked track — ours,
     * not a source) stay "". The stem is the video's file name.
     */
    public static String langFromName(String subFileName, String videoStem) {
        if (subFileName == null) return "";
        String base = subFileName;
        int slash = Math.max(base.lastIndexOf('/'), base.lastIndexOf('\\'));
        if (slash >= 0) base = base.substring(slash + 1);
        String lower = base.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        String stem = videoStem == null ? "" : videoStem.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (!stem.isEmpty() && lower.startsWith(stem)) {
            base = base.substring(stem.length());
        } else {
            int dot = base.lastIndexOf('.');
            if (dot > 0) base = base.substring(0, dot);
        }
        // base now looks like ".ja", ".en.forced", ".tr-en", ""
        String[] parts = base.split("[.\\-_ ]+");
        for (String p : parts) {
            if (p.isEmpty() || p.equals("srt")
                    || p.equals("vtt") || p.equals("ass")) continue;
            // ".tr-<lang>" is Sandy's own COOKED track, not a source:
            // its declared language is the cooking's output, and the
            // harvest must never mistake it for a track the video
            // carried in.
            if (p.equals("tr")) return "";
            String n = normalizeLang(p);
            if (!n.isEmpty()) return n;
            return "";   // first real token isn't a language: don't guess deeper
        }
        return "";
    }

    /** Exact sidecar names worth probing beside a video file, best
     *  first: bare (any language), then the spoken codes, then the
     *  common 3-letter tags — for each of srt/vtt/ass. */
    public static List<String> candidateNames(String videoFileName) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String stem = DubTrack.stemOf(videoFileName);
        if (stem.isEmpty()) return out;
        String[] exts = {"srt", "vtt", "ass"};
        String[] codes = {"ja", "en", "es", "fr", "de", "pt", "it", "ru",
                "ar", "hi", "zh", "ko", "fa"};
        String[] codes3 = {"jpn", "eng", "spa", "fre", "ger", "por", "ita",
                "rus", "ara", "hin", "chi", "kor", "fas"};
        for (String ext : exts) out.add(stem + "." + ext);
        for (String ext : exts) {
            for (String c : codes) out.add(stem + "." + c + "." + ext);
        }
        for (String ext : exts) {
            for (String c : codes3) out.add(stem + "." + c + "." + ext);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static boolean isSubtitleName(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null) return false;
        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        return lower.endsWith(".srt") || lower.endsWith(".vtt")
                || lower.endsWith(".ass") || lower.endsWith(".ssa");
    }

    /** The format a file name or content declares; "" when neither. */
    public static String sniffFormat(String fileName, String contentHead) {
        String lower = fileName == null ? "" : fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (lower.endsWith(".vtt")) return "vtt";
        if (lower.endsWith(".ass") || lower.endsWith(".ssa")) return "ass";
        if (lower.endsWith(".srt")) return "srt";
        if (contentHead != null) {
            String head = contentHead.trim();
            if (head.startsWith("WEBVTT")) return "vtt";
            if (head.contains("[Script Info]") || head.contains("[Events]")) return "ass";
            if (head.contains("-->")) return "srt";
        }
        return "";
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ parse

    /** Parse a subtitle file's text into a Track. Lines come out in
     *  file order, cleaned; empty-after-cleaning lines drop. */
    public static Track parse(String fileName, String content) {
        Track t = new Track();
        if (content == null) content = "";
        String head = content.substring(0, Math.min(512, content.length()));
        t.format = sniffFormat(fileName, head);
        List<CookedSubs.Line> raw;
        switch (t.format) {
            case "vtt": raw = parseVtt(content, t); break;
            case "ass": raw = parseAss(content, t); break;
            case "srt": raw = CookedSubs.parseSrt(content); break;
            default: raw = new ArrayList<>(); break;
        }
        for (CookedSubs.Line l : raw) {
            l.text = clean(l.text);
            if (l.text.isEmpty() || l.endMs <= l.startMs) continue;
            if (l.speaker == null) l.speaker = "";
            if (!l.speaker.isEmpty()) t.namedLines++;
            t.lines.add(l);
            if (l.endMs / 1000.0 > t.durationSec) t.durationSec = l.endMs / 1000.0;
        }
        return t;
    }

    /** Conservative cleaning: markup and control codes out, words kept. */
    public static String clean(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String s = text;
        s = s.replaceAll("\\{\\\\[^}]*\\}", " ");       // ASS override blocks
        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[NnHh]", " ");            // ASS hard/soft breaks + space
        s = s.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", " ");              // HTML-ish tags (SRT/VTT)
        s = s.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        return s;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ VTT

    public static List<CookedSubs.Line> parseVtt(String content, Track t) {
        List<CookedSubs.Line> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String[] blocks = content.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n\n");
        for (String block : blocks) {
            String[] ls = block.split("\n");
            long start = -1, end = -1;
            StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder();
            String speaker = "";
            for (String rawLine : ls) {
                String line = rawLine.trim();
                if (line.contains("-->")) {
                    String[] p = line.split("-->");
                    if (p.length == 2) {
                        start = parseVttTime(p[0].trim());
                        String endPart = p[1].trim().split("\\s+")[0];
                        end = parseVttTime(endPart);
                    }
                } else if (!line.isEmpty() && !line.equals("WEBVTT")
                        && !line.startsWith("NOTE") && !line.startsWith("STYLE")
                        && !line.startsWith("REGION")) {
                    // a cue identifier line (no timing yet) is skipped
                    if (start < 0 && !line.contains(":")) continue;
                    if (start < 0) continue;
                    String vName = voiceName(line);
                    if (!vName.isEmpty()) speaker = vName;
                    if (body.length() > 0) body.append(' ');
                    body.append(line);
                }
            }
            if (start >= 0 && end > start) {
                CookedSubs.Line l = new CookedSubs.Line();
                l.startMs = start;
                l.endMs = end;
                l.text = body.toString();
                l.speaker = speaker;
                out.add(l);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** "<v Taro>…" → "Taro"; anything else → "". */
    static String voiceName(String line) {
        String s = line.trim();
        if (!s.startsWith("<v ") && !s.startsWith("<v.")) return "";
        int gt = s.indexOf('>');
        if (gt < 0) return "";
        String inner = s.substring(2, gt).trim();
        int dot = inner.indexOf('.');
        if (dot >= 0) inner = inner.substring(dot + 1).trim();
        int sp = inner.indexOf(' ');
        if (sp >= 0) inner = inner.substring(0, sp);
        return inner.trim();
    }

    private static long parseVttTime(String t) {
        try {
            String[] p = t.split("[:.]");
            if (p.length == 4) {
                return Long.parseLong(p[0]) * 3600000 + Long.parseLong(p[1]) * 60000
                        + Long.parseLong(p[2]) * 1000 + Long.parseLong(p[3]);
            }
            if (p.length == 3) {
                return Long.parseLong(p[0]) * 60000 + Long.parseLong(p[1]) * 1000
                        + Long.parseLong(p[2]);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return -1;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ ASS

    public static List<CookedSubs.Line> parseAss(String content, Track t) {
        List<CookedSubs.Line> out = new ArrayList<>();
        String[] fieldOrder = {"Layer", "Start", "End", "Style", "Name",
                "MarginL", "MarginR", "MarginV", "Effect", "Text"};
        boolean inEvents = false;
        for (String rawLine : content.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")) {
            String line = rawLine.trim();
            if (line.startsWith("[")) {
                inEvents = line.equalsIgnoreCase("[Events]");
                continue;
            }
            if (!inEvents) continue;
            if (line.startsWith("Format:")) {
                String[] f = line.substring("Format:".length()).split(",");
                fieldOrder = new String[f.length];
                for (int i = 0; i < f.length; i++) fieldOrder[i] = f[i].trim();
                continue;
            }
            if (!line.startsWith("Dialogue:")) continue;
            String rest = line.substring("Dialogue:".length()).trim();
            String[] parts = rest.split(",", fieldOrder.length);
            if (parts.length < fieldOrder.length) continue;
            Map<String, String> fields = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < fieldOrder.length; i++) {
                fields.put(fieldOrder[i].toLowerCase(Locale.US), parts[i].trim());
            }
            long start = parseAssTime(fields.getOrDefault("start", ""));
            long end = parseAssTime(fields.getOrDefault("end", ""));
            if (start < 0 || end <= start) continue;
            CookedSubs.Line l = new CookedSubs.Line();
            l.startMs = start;
            l.endMs = end;
            l.text = fields.getOrDefault("text", "");
            String name = fields.getOrDefault("name", "");
            l.speaker = name == null ? "" : name;
            out.add(l);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static long parseAssTime(String t) {
        try {
            String[] p = t.split("[:.]");
            if (p.length != 4) return -1;
            long cs = Long.parseLong(p[3]);
            if (p[3].length() == 2) cs *= 10;   // centiseconds
            return Long.parseLong(p[0]) * 3600000 + Long.parseLong(p[1]) * 60000
                    + Long.parseLong(p[2]) * 1000 + cs;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TextMt.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;

import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment;

/**
 * Text-to-text translation (v0.12.0) — the matrix half of James's
 * subtitle-first pipeline: known text in one language, moved
 * directly to another, no ear involved. Same construction as
 * BookTranslator (SentencePiece + OpusMtOnnx over an installed
 * engine pack's mt/ tables), generalized to whichever pair the
 * matrix is asked for: a route exists exactly when its pack is
 * installed, and the dub gate (DubGate) decides from this class's
 * installed-pairs truth — never from hope.
 *
 * The MtLoopGuard rides every call, as it does for books: a line
 * the model loops on is dropped and COUNTED, and the count is
 * reported — never a silent skip.
 */
public final class TextMt implements AutoCloseable {

    public final String pair;
    private final OpusMtOnnx mt;
    private final MtLoopGuard guard = new MtLoopGuard();

    private TextMt(String pair, OpusMtOnnx mt) {
        this.pair = pair;
        this.mt = mt;
    }

    /** The pairs whose packs are installed and ONNX-runnable. */
    public static Set<String> installedPairs(Context ctx) {
        Set<String> out = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        try {
            File root = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "engine");
            File[] recs = root.listFiles((d, n) -> n.endsWith(".json"));
            if (recs != null) {
                for (File rec : recs) {
                    String pair = rec.getName().replace(".json", "");
                    EnginePackStore.Status st = EnginePackStore.status(ctx, pair);
                    if (st != null && st.onnx()) out.add(pair);
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return out;
    }

    public static boolean available(Context ctx, String pair) {
        try {
            EnginePackStore.Status st = EnginePackStore.status(ctx, pair);
            return st != null && st.onnx() && st.dir != null;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Open a pair's MT. Throws when the pack isn't usable. */
    public static TextMt open(Context ctx, String pair) throws Exception {
        EnginePackStore.Status st = EnginePackStore.status(ctx, pair);
        if (st == null || !st.onnx() || st.dir == null) {
            throw new Exception("the " + pair + " translation pack isn't installed");
        }
        File mtDir = new File(st.dir, "mt");
        OrtEnvironment env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();
        SentencePiece sp = new SentencePiece(
                new File(mtDir, "sp_pieces.tsv"), new File(mtDir, "vocab.tsv"));
        return new TextMt(pair, new OpusMtOnnx(env, mtDir, sp));
    }

    /** Lines the loop guard has dropped so far. */
    public int droppedLoops() {
        return guard.dropped();
    }

    /**
     * Translate one line of text. Returns the translation, or ""
     * when the guard judged the decode a loop (the caller keeps the
     * line silent and the drop is counted for disclosure).
     */
    public String translate(String source) throws Exception {
        if (source == null || source.trim().isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (String block : BookTranslator.blocks(source)) {
            String t = mt.translate(block);
            if (t != null && !t.trim().isEmpty()) {
                if (out.length() > 0) out.append(' ');
                out.append(t.trim());
            }
        }
        String whole = out.toString().trim();
        if (guard.feed(source, whole) == MtLoopGuard.Verdict.DROP_LOOP) {
            return "";
        }
        return whole;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { mt.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerArm.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.AlarmManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Build;

/**
 * Arming the VCR timers (v0.11.0). The alarm is a POINTER at the
 * queue file, nothing more: it carries only the timer's id, and the
 * queue is re-read when it fires.
 *
 * Primary mechanism is the alarm-clock API (setAlarmClock): it needs
 * no exact-alarm permission, fires through doze, and is the platform's
 * own "wake me for this" contract — the digital VCR timer. When even
 * that is refused, the fallback lands inexact and the timer's row
 * says so in the open ("approximate" rides the timer record and is
 * printed on its face), never silently.
 */
public final class TimerArm {

    private TimerArm() {}

    public static final String ACTION_FIRE = "com.talacore.talatv.TIMER_FIRE";
    public static final String EXTRA_TIMER_ID = "timer_id";

    private static PendingIntent fireIntent(Context ctx, String timerId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, TimerReceiver.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_FIRE);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_TIMER_ID, timerId);
        int flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT;
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23) flags |= PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE;
        return PendingIntent.getBroadcast(ctx, timerId.hashCode(), i, flags);
    }

    /**
     * Arm one timer at its padded fire time. Returns the kind that
     * actually got armed: "exact" or "approximate".
     */
    public static String arm(Context ctx, TimerModel.Timer t) {
        AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
        if (am == null) return "approximate";
        PendingIntent pi = fireIntent(ctx, t.id);
        long at = t.fireMs();
        try {
            Intent show = new Intent(ctx, TimersActivity.class);
            int flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23) flags |= PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE;
            PendingIntent showPi = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                    ctx, ("show:" + t.id).hashCode(), show, flags);
            am.setAlarmClock(new AlarmManager.AlarmClockInfo(at, showPi), pi);
            return "exact";
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31 && !am.canScheduleExactAlarms()) {
                am.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, pi);
                return "approximate";
            }
            am.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, pi);
            return "exact";
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        try {
            am.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, pi);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return "approximate";
    }

    public static void disarm(Context ctx, String timerId) {
        AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
        if (am == null) return;
        try { am.cancel(fireIntent(ctx, timerId)); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    /** Can this phone promise exact alarms at all right now? */
    public static boolean exactAvailable(Context ctx) {
        AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
        if (am == null) return false;
        // setAlarmClock is always available to the app itself; the
        // exact-alarm permission only gates the fallback path.
        return true;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerFrame.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.TimeZone;

/**
 * The timer's time FRAME as one visible thing (v0.12.1, James's
 * field report on 0.11.0/0.11.1: "the timer will pick a day, but it
 * won't pick a time… needs to be a time frame, a set time frame").
 *
 * Pure math + text for the set-timer screen: date + start + end are
 * picked on ONE screen and the frame is summarized in one line
 * ("Tue Oct 20 · 8:00 PM – 9:30 PM") before anything is committed.
 * An end at or before the start is an OVERNIGHT frame: the end
 * rolls to the next day, and the summary prints both days so the
 * roll is unmistakable, never silent.
 */
public final class TimerFrame {

    private TimerFrame() {}

    public static final long DAY_MS = 24L * 3600_000L;

    /** Stop for a start + duration pick (minutes). */
    public static long stopFromDuration(long startMs, long durationMinutes) {
        return startMs + Math.max(1, durationMinutes) * 60_000L;
    }

    /** Whole minutes between start and stop (never negative). */
    public static long durationMinutes(long startMs, long stopMs) {
        return Math.max(0, (stopMs - startMs) / 60_000L);
    }

    /**
     * Compose a frame from a picked day and picked wall-clock times
     * (all in {@code zone}): start = day at startH:startM; end = day
     * at endH:endM, rolled +1 day when it lands at or before the
     * start (the overnight rule above).
     */
    public static long[] compose(long dayStartMs, int startH, int startM,
                                 int endH, int endM, TimeZone zone) {
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance(zone);
        c.setTimeInMillis(dayStartMs);
        c.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, startH);
        c.set(Calendar.MINUTE, startM);
        c.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        c.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        long start = c.getTimeInMillis();
        c.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, endH);
        c.set(Calendar.MINUTE, endM);
        long stop = c.getTimeInMillis();
        if (stop <= start) stop += DAY_MS;
        return new long[]{start, stop};
    }

    /** True when the frame's end falls on a later local day than its start. */
    public static boolean spansMidnight(long startMs, long stopMs, TimeZone zone) {
        return !GuideModel.formatDay(startMs, zone)
                .equals(GuideModel.formatDay(stopMs - 1, zone));
    }

    /**
     * The one-line frame summary the set-timer screen shows live and
     * the commit toast repeats: "Tue Oct 20 · 8:00 PM – 9:30 PM", or
     * with both days when the frame crosses midnight:
     * "Tue Oct 20 · 11:00 PM – Wed Oct 21 · 1:00 AM".
     */
    public static String summary(long startMs, long stopMs, TimeZone zone) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(GuideModel.formatDay(startMs, zone)).append(" · ")
          .append(GuideModel.formatTime(startMs, zone)).append(" – ");
        if (spansMidnight(startMs, stopMs, zone)) {
            sb.append(GuideModel.formatDay(stopMs, zone)).append(" · ");
        }
        sb.append(GuideModel.formatTime(stopMs, zone));
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerModel.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The VCR timer's pure core (v0.11.0): the timer record, its state
 * machine, and every decision that must be provable off-device —
 * conflict detection, fire-time math, storage estimates, and the
 * reconciliation a reopened (or rebooted) app runs over the queue.
 *
 * Two ways in, one queue (James's order, confirmed by the EPG
 * research): a timer is born from a guide programme OR set by hand
 * for any channel — the timer never depends on the guide existing.
 *
 * Honest end states, stated on the Recordings shelf and never
 * softened: RECORDED · PARTIAL_LATE (joined after the start) ·
 * PARTIAL_EARLY (stopped early — out of space) · FAILED_REFUSED
 * (the source refused) · FAILED_SPACE (not enough room, known
 * before firing) · MISSED_OFF (phone off / app dead at showtime) ·
 * MISSED_WAKE (the alarm fired but recording could not start).
 *
 * The queue is a FILE (timers.tsv behind the memory hook); alarms
 * are always re-derived from it, never the other way around.
 */
public final class TimerModel {

    private TimerModel() {}

    public static final long DEFAULT_PAD_BEFORE_MS = 60_000;
    public static final long DEFAULT_PAD_AFTER_MS = 120_000;
    /** Late-join needs at least this much programme left to be worth tape. */
    public static final long LATE_JOIN_MIN_REMAINING_MS = 5 * 60_000;
    /** Storage estimate when the playlist doesn't declare a bitrate. */
    public static final double DEFAULT_MBPS = 5.0;
    /** Pre-flight refuses to start when free space is under estimate × this. */
    public static final double SPACE_SAFETY = 1.2;

    public enum State {
        SET, RECORDING, RECORDED, PARTIAL_LATE, PARTIAL_EARLY,
        FAILED_REFUSED, FAILED_SPACE, MISSED_OFF, MISSED_WAKE, CANCELLED
    }

    /** One timer = one future (or finished) recording. */
    public static final class Timer {
        public String id = "";
        public String channelName = "";
        public String channelUrl = "";
        public String tvgId = "";
        public String title = "";
        /** Programme window (unpadded). */
        public long startMs, stopMs;
        public long padBeforeMs = DEFAULT_PAD_BEFORE_MS;
        public long padAfterMs = DEFAULT_PAD_AFTER_MS;
        public State state = State.SET;
        /** The honest why for terminal states, "" while live. */
        public String detail = "";
        /** "exact" (alarm clock) or "approximate" — shown on the row. */
        public String alarmKind = "exact";
        /** True when recording began after the padded start. */
        public boolean lateJoin = false;
        public long createdAtMs = 0;

        public long fireMs() { return startMs - padBeforeMs; }
        public long untilMs() { return stopMs + padAfterMs; }
        public boolean terminal() {
            return state != State.SET && state != State.RECORDING;
        }
    }

    public static String newId(long nowMs, int seq) {
        return "t" + Long.toString(nowMs, 36) + "x" + seq;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ TSV rows
    // timers.tsv columns (free-text fields URL-encoded, house style):
    // id, state, startMs, stopMs, padBeforeMs, padAfterMs, alarmKind,
    // lateJoin(0/1), createdAtMs, tvgId, title, channelName, channelUrl, detail

    public static String toRow(Timer t) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(enc(t.id)).append('\t')
          .append(t.state.name()).append('\t')
          .append(t.startMs).append('\t')
          .append(t.stopMs).append('\t')
          .append(t.padBeforeMs).append('\t')
          .append(t.padAfterMs).append('\t')
          .append(enc(t.alarmKind)).append('\t')
          .append(t.lateJoin ? '1' : '0').append('\t')
          .append(t.createdAtMs).append('\t')
          .append(enc(t.tvgId)).append('\t')
          .append(enc(t.title)).append('\t')
          .append(enc(t.channelName)).append('\t')
          .append(enc(t.channelUrl)).append('\t')
          .append(enc(t.detail));
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** One row back; null on a malformed row (skipped, never fatal). */
    public static Timer fromRow(String row) {
        if (row == null) return null;
        String[] c = row.split("\t", -1);
        if (c.length < 14) return null;
        try {
            Timer t = new Timer();
            t.id = dec(c[0]);
            t.state = State.valueOf(c[1]);
            t.startMs = Long.parseLong(c[2]);
            t.stopMs = Long.parseLong(c[3]);
            t.padBeforeMs = Long.parseLong(c[4]);
            t.padAfterMs = Long.parseLong(c[5]);
            t.alarmKind = dec(c[6]);
            t.lateJoin = "1".equals(c[7]);
            t.createdAtMs = Long.parseLong(c[8]);
            t.tvgId = dec(c[9]);
            t.title = dec(c[10]);
            t.channelName = dec(c[11]);
            t.channelUrl = dec(c[12]);
            t.detail = dec(c[13]);
            if (t.id.isEmpty() || t.stopMs <= t.startMs) return null;
            return t;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static String serialize(List<Timer> timers) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy recording timers - one row per timer; the queue is\n");
        sb.append("# this file (memory hook). Alarms re-derive from it.\n");
        for (Timer t : timers) sb.append(toRow(t)).append('\n');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static List<Timer> parse(String content) {
        List<Timer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (content == null) return out;
        for (String line : content.split("\n")) {
            // Never trim the row itself: the last field may be a
            // legitimately empty encoded value, and trim() would
            // eat its separator and shorten the row.
            String probe = line.trim();
            if (probe.isEmpty() || probe.startsWith("#")) continue;
            Timer t = fromRow(line.endsWith("\r")
                    ? line.substring(0, line.length() - 1) : line);
            if (t != null) out.add(t);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------- decisions

    /**
     * One recorder, one tape: two live timers conflict when their
     * PADDED windows overlap. Resolved at set time, in the open —
     * never silently at fire time.
     */
    public static Timer conflict(List<Timer> timers, Timer candidate) {
        for (Timer t : timers) {
            if (t.state != State.SET && t.state != State.RECORDING) continue;
            if (candidate.id.equals(t.id)) continue;
            if (candidate.fireMs() < t.untilMs() && t.fireMs() < candidate.untilMs()) {
                return t;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public enum Action { REARM, FIRE_NOW, FIRE_LATE, MARK_MISSED_OFF,
                         MARK_INTERRUPTED, NONE }

    public static final class Decision {
        public final Timer timer;
        public final Action action;
        Decision(Timer t, Action a) { timer = t; action = a; }
    }

    /**
     * What a reopened/rebooted app owes each SET timer at {@code nowMs}:
     * future → re-arm; inside its window with real programme left →
     * fire late (it joins mid-show and the shelf will say Partial);
     * window already gone without ever firing → missed, phone off —
     * the honest default, because a phone that was on and armed
     * leaves a RECORDING row behind, and this one has none.
     */
    public static List<Decision> reconcile(List<Timer> timers, long nowMs) {
        List<Decision> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Timer t : timers) {
            if (t.state == State.RECORDING) {
                // Was recording when the app/process died. Past its
                // window it can only be closed honestly: interrupted.
                out.add(new Decision(t, nowMs > t.untilMs()
                        ? Action.MARK_INTERRUPTED : Action.NONE));
                continue;
            }
            if (t.state != State.SET) { out.add(new Decision(t, Action.NONE)); continue; }
            if (nowMs < t.fireMs()) {
                out.add(new Decision(t, Action.REARM));
            } else if (nowMs < t.startMs) {
                // Woke inside the pad — the pad absorbed the
                // lateness; the show itself hasn't started.
                out.add(new Decision(t, Action.FIRE_NOW));
            } else if (nowMs <= t.stopMs - LATE_JOIN_MIN_REMAINING_MS) {
                out.add(new Decision(t, Action.FIRE_LATE));
            } else {
                out.add(new Decision(t, Action.MARK_MISSED_OFF));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** The terminal state a finished recording lands in. */
    public static State endState(boolean started, boolean lateJoin,
                                 boolean stoppedEarlySpace,
                                 boolean sourceRefused) {
        if (!started) return sourceRefused ? State.FAILED_REFUSED : State.MISSED_WAKE;
        if (stoppedEarlySpace) return State.PARTIAL_EARLY;
        if (lateJoin) return State.PARTIAL_LATE;
        return State.RECORDED;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ storage

    /** Bytes one hour at {@code mbps} occupies (Mbps × 0.45 GB/h). */
    public static long bytesForDuration(double mbps, long durationMs) {
        double hours = durationMs / 3_600_000.0;
        return (long) (mbps * 0.45 * hours * 1_000_000_000.0);
    }

    /** Pre-flight verdict: can this recording start, honestly? */
    public static boolean spaceOk(long freeBytes, double mbps, Timer t) {
        long need = bytesForDuration(mbps, t.untilMs() - t.fireMs());
        return freeBytes >= (long) (need * SPACE_SAFETY);
    }

    public static long neededBytes(double mbps, Timer t) {
        return (long) (bytesForDuration(mbps, t.untilMs() - t.fireMs())
                * SPACE_SAFETY);
    }

    /** Human size for rows and refusals ("2.3 GB"). */
    public static String sizeText(long bytes) {
        if (bytes >= 1_000_000_000L) {
            return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.1f GB",
                    bytes / 1_000_000_000.0);
        }
        if (bytes >= 1_000_000L) {
            return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.0f MB",
                    bytes / 1_000_000.0);
        }
        return Math.max(0, bytes / 1000) + " KB";
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- codec

    public static String enc(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        try {
            return URLEncoder.encode(s, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20");
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    public static String dec(String s) {
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) return "";
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(s, "UTF-8");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerReceiver.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

/**
 * The timer's doorbell (v0.11.0). Two rings only:
 *  - TIMER_FIRE (from TimerArm's alarm): start the recording
 *    service for that one timer id — the service re-reads the queue
 *    file, so a stale or cancelled timer fires nothing.
 *  - BOOT_COMPLETED: alarms die with the phone; the queue file
 *    doesn't. Run reconciliation — re-arm what's future, fire what
 *    can still be joined, mark what was missed while off.
 */
public final class TimerReceiver extends BroadcastReceiver {

    @Override
    public void onReceive(Context ctx, Intent intent) {
        if (intent == null) return;
        String action = intent.getAction();
        if (Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED.equals(action)) {
            TimerReconcile.run(ctx);
            return;
        }
        if (TimerArm.ACTION_FIRE.equals(action)) {
            String id = intent.getStringExtra(TimerArm.EXTRA_TIMER_ID);
            if (id == null) return;
            TimerModel.Timer t = TimerStore.get(ctx, id);
            if (t == null || t.state != TimerModel.State.SET) return;
            TimerReconcile.startService(ctx, id);
        }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerReconcile.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Build;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Reconciliation (v0.11.0): on every boot and every app open, the
 * filed queue is read and each live timer gets what TimerModel's
 * state machine says it is owed — re-arm the future, fire the
 * late-joinable, and mark the gone ones MISSED with the honest
 * reason. This is what makes "the phone was off" a stated outcome
 * instead of a silent hole, and what re-derives every alarm from
 * the file after a reboot (alarms do not survive one; the file does).
 */
public final class TimerReconcile {

    private TimerReconcile() {}

    public static void run(Context ctx) {
        try {
            List<TimerModel.Timer> timers = TimerStore.all(ctx);
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            boolean changed = false;
            for (TimerModel.Decision d : TimerModel.reconcile(timers, now)) {
                TimerModel.Timer t = d.timer;
                switch (d.action) {
                    case REARM:
                        String kind = TimerArm.arm(ctx, t);
                        if (!kind.equals(t.alarmKind)) {
                            t.alarmKind = kind;
                            changed = true;
                        }
                        break;
                    case FIRE_NOW:
                    case FIRE_LATE:
                        startService(ctx, t.id);
                        break;
                    case MARK_MISSED_OFF:
                        t.state = TimerModel.State.MISSED_OFF;
                        t.detail = "Missed — the phone was off";
                        changed = true;
                        break;
                    case MARK_INTERRUPTED:
                        t.state = TimerModel.State.PARTIAL_EARLY;
                        t.detail = "Partial — recording interrupted "
                                + "(the app was stopped)";
                        changed = true;
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
            }
            if (changed) TimerStore.save(ctx, timers);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    static void startService(Context ctx, String timerId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, TimerRecordService.class);
        i.putExtra(TimerArm.EXTRA_TIMER_ID, timerId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            else ctx.startService(i);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerRecordService.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.os.StatFs;

import androidx.media3.exoplayer.offline.Download;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * The VCR, running (v0.11.0): a foreground service that records one
 * timer's channel for its programme's duration and then files the
 * honest outcome. This is also the cure for the standing shortfall
 * that recordings pause when the app closes — a timer recording
 * lives here, in a service with a wake lock, not in an activity.
 *
 * The flow mirrors the proven record-now path exactly: Downloads
 * (media3) captures, stopKeep keeps the pieces, RecordingExport
 * assembles the one file into files/recording-export. What this
 * service adds is the schedule around it: pre-flight space check,
 * late-join honesty, the watchdog, and the end state written to
 * BOTH the timer queue and the recordings metadata file.
 */
public final class TimerRecordService extends Service {

    private static final String CHAN = "sandy_timers";
    private static final long SPACE_FLOOR_BYTES = 150L * 1000 * 1000;

    private volatile boolean stopped = false;
    private PowerManager.WakeLock wakeLock;

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return null; }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        String timerId = intent == null ? null
                : intent.getStringExtra(TimerArm.EXTRA_TIMER_ID);
        TimerModel.Timer t = timerId == null ? null : TimerStore.get(this, timerId);
        if (t == null || t.state != TimerModel.State.SET) {
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        Notification n = notification("Recording soon", t);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
            startForeground(notifId(t), n,
                    ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK);
        } else {
            startForeground(notifId(t), n);
        }
        final TimerModel.Timer timer = t;
        new Thread(() -> run(timer), "sandy-timer-rec").start();
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    private static int notifId(TimerModel.Timer t) {
        return 4100 + (Math.abs(t.id.hashCode()) % 3000);
    }

    private void run(TimerModel.Timer t) {
        Context ctx = getApplicationContext();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        try {
            // --- too late to matter: the programme already ended.
            if (now > t.stopMs) {
                finish(t, TimerModel.State.MISSED_WAKE,
                        "Missed — started too late, the programme had ended");
                return;
            }
            boolean lateJoin = now > t.startMs;

            // --- pre-flight: refuse honestly rather than die mid-tape.
            long free = freeBytes(ctx);
            if (!TimerModel.spaceOk(free, TimerModel.DEFAULT_MBPS, t)) {
                finish(t, TimerModel.State.FAILED_SPACE,
                        "Failed — not enough space (needs about "
                                + TimerModel.sizeText(TimerModel.neededBytes(
                                        TimerModel.DEFAULT_MBPS, t))
                                + ", phone has "
                                + TimerModel.sizeText(free) + " free)");
                return;
            }

            // --- metadata first, so the shelf knows it from birth.
            ChannelStore.putRecordMeta(ctx, t.channelUrl, t.channelName);
            MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta meta = new MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta();
            meta.id = t.channelUrl;
            meta.title = t.title.isEmpty() ? t.channelName : t.title;
            meta.channel = t.channelName;
            meta.airedStartMs = t.startMs;
            meta.airedStopMs = t.stopMs;
            meta.origin = "timer";
            meta.state = "";
            RecordingsMeta.upsert(ctx, meta);

            // --- start the capture.
            boolean ok = Downloads.start(ctx, t.channelUrl, guessHls(t.channelUrl));
            if (!ok && !Downloads.isRecording(ctx, t.channelUrl)) {
                finish(t, TimerModel.State.FAILED_REFUSED,
                        "Failed — the source refused the recording");
                return;
            }
            t.state = TimerModel.State.RECORDING;
            t.lateJoin = lateJoin;
            TimerStore.update(ctx, t);
            notifyText(t, "● Recording");

            PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(POWER_SERVICE);
            if (pm != null) {
                wakeLock = pm.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK,
                        "sandy:timer-rec");
                wakeLock.acquire(Math.max(60_000L, t.untilMs() - now + 120_000L));
            }

            // --- watchdog: sleep to the padded end; bail early on space.
            boolean spaceEarly = false;
            while (!stopped && System.currentTimeMillis() < t.untilMs()) {
                try { Thread.sleep(30_000L); } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    break;
                }
                if (freeBytes(ctx) < SPACE_FLOOR_BYTES) {
                    spaceEarly = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // --- stop, settle, assemble the one file.
            Downloads.stopKeep(ctx, t.channelUrl);
            Download d = settle(ctx, t.channelUrl);
            boolean caught = false;
            if (d != null && d.getBytesDownloaded() > 0
                    && d.state != Download.STATE_FAILED) {
                try {
                    File f = RecordingExport.export(ctx, d,
                            new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "recording-export"));
                    caught = f != null && f.isFile() && f.length() > 0;
                } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            }
            if (!caught) {
                boolean refused = d != null && d.state == Download.STATE_FAILED;
                finish(t, refused ? TimerModel.State.FAILED_REFUSED
                                : TimerModel.State.PARTIAL_EARLY,
                        refused ? "Failed — the source refused or the "
                                        + "connection dropped"
                                : "Partial — nothing could be assembled "
                                        + "from what was caught");
                return;
            }
            TimerModel.State end = TimerModel.endState(
                    true, lateJoin, spaceEarly, false);
            finish(t, end, spaceEarly
                    ? "Partial — stopped early, the phone ran out of space"
                    : lateJoin ? "Partial — started late"
                               : "Recorded");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                finish(t, TimerModel.State.MISSED_WAKE,
                        "Missed — the recording couldn't run ("
                                + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + ")");
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        } finally {
            if (wakeLock != null && wakeLock.isHeld()) wakeLock.release();
            stopForeground(true);
            stopSelf();
        }
    }

    /** Poll the download index until the capture settles out of motion. */
    private Download settle(Context ctx, String url) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            Download d = Downloads.get(ctx, url);
            if (d == null) return null;
            if (d.state != Download.STATE_DOWNLOADING
                    && d.state != Download.STATE_QUEUED
                    && d.state != Download.STATE_RESTARTING) return d;
            try { Thread.sleep(3000L); } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                return d;
            }
        }
        return Downloads.get(ctx, url);
    }

    /** Write the end state to the queue AND the recordings file, then say so. */
    private void finish(TimerModel.Timer t, TimerModel.State state, String detail) {
        Context ctx = getApplicationContext();
        t.state = state;
        t.detail = detail;
        TimerStore.update(ctx, t);
        MemoryFiles.RecordingMeta meta = RecordingsMeta.get(ctx, t.channelUrl);
        if (meta != null) {
            meta.state = state.name();
            RecordingsMeta.upsert(ctx, meta);
        }
        notifyText(t, detail);
    }

    private long freeBytes(Context ctx) {
        try {
            return new StatFs(ctx.getFilesDir().getPath()).getAvailableBytes();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return Long.MAX_VALUE; // unknown space must not fake a refusal
        }
    }

    /** The player's own HLS guess, same rule (PlayerActivity). */
    static boolean guessHls(String url) {
        if (url == null) return false;
        String lower = url.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.contains(".m3u8")) return true;
        String path = lower.split("\\?")[0];
