        return !path.substring(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1).contains(".");
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- notifications

    private Notification notification(String title, TimerModel.Timer t) {
        NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && nm != null) {
            nm.createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel(
                    CHAN, "Recording timers", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
        }
        Intent open = new Intent(this, TimersActivity.class);
        int flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT;
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23) flags |= PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE;
        PendingIntent pi = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                this, ("rec:" + t.id).hashCode(), open, flags);
        Notification.Builder b = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26
                ? new Notification.Builder(this, CHAN)
                : new Notification.Builder(this);
        return b.setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_media_play)
                .setContentTitle(title)
                .setContentText(t.title.isEmpty() ? t.channelName : t.title)
                .setContentIntent(pi)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .build();
    }

    private void notifyText(TimerModel.Timer t, String title) {
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            nm.notify(notifId(t), notification(title, t));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        stopped = true;
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The timer queue's store (v0.11.0): memory/timers.tsv behind the
 * memory hook, nothing else. The FILE is the queue — alarms are
 * re-derived from it at boot and on every open, so a timer set in
 * the app can never exist only inside AlarmManager's memory.
 */
public final class TimerStore {

    private TimerStore() {}

    public static synchronized List<TimerModel.Timer> all(Context ctx) {
        return TimerModel.parse(MemoryHook.read(ctx, MemoryHook.TIMERS));
    }

    public static synchronized void save(Context ctx,
                                         List<TimerModel.Timer> timers) {
        MemoryHook.write(ctx, MemoryHook.TIMERS, TimerModel.serialize(timers));
    }

    public static synchronized TimerModel.Timer get(Context ctx, String id) {
        for (TimerModel.Timer t : all(ctx)) if (t.id.equals(id)) return t;
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized void add(Context ctx, TimerModel.Timer t) {
        List<TimerModel.Timer> all = all(ctx);
        all.add(t);
        save(ctx, all);
    }

    /** Replace the row with the same id (or append when absent). */
    public static synchronized void update(Context ctx, TimerModel.Timer t) {
        List<TimerModel.Timer> all = all(ctx);
        boolean found = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < all.size(); i++) {
            if (all.get(i).id.equals(t.id)) { all.set(i, t); found = true; }
        }
        if (!found) all.add(t);
        save(ctx, all);
    }

    /** Live timers only (SET or RECORDING), soonest first. */
    public static synchronized List<TimerModel.Timer> live(Context ctx) {
        List<TimerModel.Timer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (TimerModel.Timer t : all(ctx)) {
            if (t.state == TimerModel.State.SET
                    || t.state == TimerModel.State.RECORDING) out.add(t);
        }
        out.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(a.startMs, b.startMs));
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimerUi.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.TimeZone;

/**
 * Setting a timer, shared by the guide and the Timers screen
 * (v0.11.0): build the record, check it against the queue IN THE
 * OPEN (one recorder, one tape — an overlap is resolved by the
 * person, here, never silently at fire time), file it, arm it,
 * and say what got armed. Also the two permission walks the
 * research requires, asked at set time and labeled honestly:
 * battery-optimization exemption, and — only when the fallback
 * path had to be used — the exact-alarm grant.
 */
public final class TimerUi {

    private TimerUi() {}

    public static TimerModel.Timer build(String channelName, String url,
                                         String tvgId, String title,
                                         long startMs, long stopMs) {
        TimerModel.Timer t = new TimerModel.Timer();
        t.id = TimerModel.newId(System.currentTimeMillis(),
                (int) (Math.random() * 100000));
        t.channelName = channelName == null ? "" : channelName;
        t.channelUrl = url == null ? "" : url;
        t.tvgId = tvgId == null ? "" : tvgId;
        t.title = title == null ? "" : title;
        t.startMs = startMs;
        t.stopMs = stopMs;
        t.createdAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        return t;
    }

    /** File + arm a timer, resolving any overlap with the person first. */
    public static void commit(Activity act, TimerModel.Timer t, Runnable done) {
        List<TimerModel.Timer> all = TimerStore.all(act);
        TimerModel.Timer clash = TimerModel.conflict(all, t);
        if (clash != null) {
            String when = GuideModel.formatDay(clash.startMs,
                    TimeZone.getDefault()) + " "
                    + GuideModel.formatTime(clash.startMs, TimeZone.getDefault());
            new AlertDialog.Builder(act)
                    .setTitle("That overlaps another timer")
                    .setMessage("“" + label(clash) + "” is set for " + when
                            + ". One recorder can only tape one thing "
                            + "at a time.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Cancel the other timer", (d, w) -> {
                        clash.state = TimerModel.State.CANCELLED;
                        TimerStore.update(act, clash);
                        TimerArm.disarm(act, clash.id);
                        commit(act, t, done);
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Don't set this one", (d, w) -> { })
                    .show();
            return;
        }
        TimerStore.add(act, t);
        t.alarmKind = TimerArm.arm(act, t);
        TimerStore.update(act, t);
        askBatteryExemption(act);
        if ("approximate".equals(t.alarmKind)) askExactAlarm(act);
        Toast.makeText(act, "⏰ Timer set — “" + label(t) + "” · "
                        + GuideModel.formatDay(t.startMs, TimeZone.getDefault())
                        + " " + GuideModel.formatTime(t.startMs,
                                TimeZone.getDefault()),
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        if (done != null) done.run();
    }

    public static String label(TimerModel.Timer t) {
        return t.title.isEmpty() ? t.channelName : t.title;
    }

    /** The state line a timer row shows, in the viewer's language where
     *  Sandy speaks it; the recorded detail rides verbatim after it. */
    public static String stateText(Context ctx, TimerModel.Timer t) {
        switch (t.state) {
            case SET:
                return "Set — " + GuideModel.formatDay(t.startMs,
                        TimeZone.getDefault()) + " "
                        + GuideModel.formatTime(t.startMs, TimeZone.getDefault())
                        + ("approximate".equals(t.alarmKind)
                                ? " · " + LangStore.tr(ctx, "timer_approx") : "");
            case RECORDING:
                return "● Recording…";
            case RECORDED:
                return LangStore.tr(ctx, "state_recorded");
            case PARTIAL_LATE:
            case PARTIAL_EARLY:
                return LangStore.tr(ctx, "state_partial")
                        + (t.detail.isEmpty() ? "" : " — " + t.detail);
            case FAILED_REFUSED:
            case FAILED_SPACE:
                return LangStore.tr(ctx, "state_failed")
                        + (t.detail.isEmpty() ? "" : " — " + t.detail);
            case MISSED_OFF:
            case MISSED_WAKE:
                return LangStore.tr(ctx, "state_missed")
                        + (t.detail.isEmpty() ? "" : " — " + t.detail);
            case CANCELLED:
                return "Cancelled";
            default:
                return t.state.name();
        }
    }

    private static void askBatteryExemption(Activity act) {
        try {
            if (act.getSharedPreferences("talatv", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getBoolean("timer_batt_asked", false)) return;
            act.getSharedPreferences("talatv", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putBoolean("timer_batt_asked", true).apply();
            PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) act.getSystemService(
                    Context.POWER_SERVICE);
            if (pm == null || Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 23
                    || pm.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(act.getPackageName())) {
                return;
            }
            new AlertDialog.Builder(act)
                    .setTitle("Let timers wake the phone")
                    .setMessage("So a timer can record while the phone "
                            + "sleeps, Sandy needs to be allowed to run "
                            + "in the background. Nothing else changes.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Allow", (d, w) -> {
                        try {
                            Intent i = new Intent(
                                    Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS);
                            i.setData(Uri.parse("package:" + act.getPackageName()));
                            act.startActivity(i);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Not now", (d, w) -> { })
                    .show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    private static void askExactAlarm(Activity act) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31) return;
            android.app.AlarmManager am = (android.app.AlarmManager)
                    act.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
            if (am == null || am.canScheduleExactAlarms()) return;
            new AlertDialog.Builder(act)
                    .setTitle("Timers may start late")
                    .setMessage("This phone hasn't given Sandy permission "
                            + "for exact alarms, so timers are approximate "
                            + "and may start late. You can allow exact "
                            + "alarms in the phone's settings.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Open settings", (d, w) -> {
                        try {
                            Intent i = new Intent(
                                    Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM);
                            i.setData(Uri.parse("package:" + act.getPackageName()));
                            act.startActivity(i);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Leave approximate", (d, w) -> { })
                    .show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimersActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.TimeZone;

/**
 * The VCR timer book (v0.11.0): every timer in the queue file —
 * what's set, what's recording, and how each finished one ended,
 * stated plainly. Two ways in, as ordered: from the TV Guide (tap a
 * future programme), or BY HAND here — any channel, any start, any
 * length, no guide required. The manual door matters: most of
 * Sandy's channels carry no guide data, and a timer must not depend
 * on the guide existing.
 */
public class TimersActivity extends Activity {

    private final List<TimerModel.Timer> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rowTitles = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> rowSub = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private TextView emptyView;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timers_title"));
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(19);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        TextView intro = new TextView(this);
        intro.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_manual_intro"));
        intro.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        intro.setTextSize(12);
        root.addView(intro);

        Button setBtn = new Button(this);
        setBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_set_btn"));
        // v0.12.1: the set flow is ONE screen with the whole frame
        // visible (SetTimerActivity) — the old four-dialog chain
        // stranded the time half behind a ~12,900-entry channel
        // picker (James's field report, 2026-10-18).
        setBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> startActivity(
                new android.content.Intent(this, SetTimerActivity.class)));
        root.addView(setBtn);

        emptyView = new TextView(this);
        emptyView.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "timers_empty"));
        emptyView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        emptyView.setTextSize(13);
        root.addView(emptyView);

        ListView listView = new ListView(this);
        listView.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.addView(listView, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<String>(this,
                android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, android.R.id.text1,
                rowTitles) {
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                View v = super.getView(pos, convertView, parent);
                TextView t1 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text1);
                t1.setText(rowTitles.get(pos));
                t1.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                TextView t2 = v.findViewById(android.R.id.text2);
                t2.setText(pos < rowSub.size() ? rowSub.get(pos) : "");
                t2.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                return v;
            }
            @Override public int getCount() { return rowTitles.size(); }
        };
        listView.setAdapter(adapter);
        listView.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            TimerModel.Timer t = rows.get(pos);
            if (t.state == TimerModel.State.SET) confirmCancel(t);
        });
        setContentView(root);
        bind();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        TimerReconcile.run(getApplicationContext());
        bind();
    }

    private void bind() {
        rows.clear();
        rows.addAll(TimerStore.all(this));
        rows.sort((a, b) -> {
            boolean aLive = a.state == TimerModel.State.SET
                    || a.state == TimerModel.State.RECORDING;
            boolean bLive = b.state == TimerModel.State.SET
                    || b.state == TimerModel.State.RECORDING;
            if (aLive != bLive) return aLive ? -1 : 1;
            return aLive ? Long.compare(a.startMs, b.startMs)
                    : Long.compare(b.startMs, a.startMs);
        });
        rowTitles.clear();
        rowSub.clear();
        TimeZone zone = TimeZone.getDefault();
        for (TimerModel.Timer t : rows) {
            rowTitles.add(TimerUi.label(t));
            rowSub.add(t.channelName + " · "
                    + GuideModel.formatDay(t.startMs, zone) + " "
                    + GuideModel.formatTime(t.startMs, zone) + "–"
                    + GuideModel.formatTime(t.stopMs, zone) + " · "
                    + TimerUi.stateText(this, t));
        }
        emptyView.setVisibility(rows.isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void confirmCancel(TimerModel.Timer t) {
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_cancel"))
                .setMessage("“" + TimerUi.label(t) + "” · " + t.channelName)
                .setPositiveButton(LangStore.tr(this, "timer_cancel"),
                        (d, w) -> {
                            t.state = TimerModel.State.CANCELLED;
                            TimerStore.update(this, t);
                            TimerArm.disarm(this, t.id);
                            bind();
                        })
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, (d, w) -> { })
                .show();
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimeshiftCache.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.media3.common.util.UnstableApi;
import androidx.media3.database.StandaloneDatabaseProvider;
import androidx.media3.datasource.DataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.DefaultHttpDataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.Cache;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.CacheDataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.CacheKeyFactory;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.LeastRecentlyUsedCacheEvictor;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.NoOpCacheEvictor;
import androidx.media3.datasource.cache.SimpleCache;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * The live timeshift buffer's disk layer (v0.4.0). Every live fetch
 * runs through a CacheDataSource over a size-capped SimpleCache, so
 * segments the player has pulled once are re-read from the phone, not
 * re-streamed: pause holds your place while the window keeps what it
 * fetched, rewind replays from disk, and a rough link stops mattering
 * the moment the video is local.
 *
 * Two honesty details, both load-bearing:
 *
 * 1. PLAYLISTS ARE NEVER SERVED FROM CACHE. A live manifest is a
 *    moving window; a cached copy would freeze the channel in the
 *    past. The CacheKeyFactory gives playlist-looking URLs a one-time
 *    key (a guaranteed miss; the tiny write is evicted as junk).
 *    SEGMENTS are generation-keyed since v0.14.1 (LiveSegmentKeys):
 *    the old stable keys let a source that recycles segment URLs be
 *    answered with Sandy's own earlier bytes — the same window
 *    replayed as if live. Now a segment address names the same
 *    content only within one fetch generation of one tune.
 *
 * 2. IT IS A BUFFER, NOT A RECORDING — with one family amendment
 *    (v0.5.0, item 8): the buffer is wiped when the channel CHANGES,
 *    but the LAST channel's buffer now survives the player closing,
 *    so the viewer can be offered their place back on reopen (the
 *    place is re-derived honestly by LiveResumeMath — the live edge
 *    moved while they were gone, and whatever rolled past the
 *    window is gone). Only the last channel is kept this way.
 *
 *    And when the kept buffer FILLS, the family's ruling is HOLD,
 *    DON'T SLIDE (Settings can switch it back to Roll): the capture
 *    stops and the beginning is preserved — the fall-asleep case:
 *    "when you wake up, hopefully you caught the whole episode." An
 *    episode longer than the window still loses its tail; hold saves
 *    the front, not the impossible. Hold is implemented as a
 *    no-evictor cache plus the player's fill watch (PlayerActivity
 *    latches the hold and stops capturing through the cache); Roll
 *    keeps the classic LRU slide.
 *
 * The byte cap comes from the minutes setting via TimeshiftMath
 * (nominal 3 Mbps): the cap, and the source's own live window, are
 * the two bounds on how far back — or forward — the buffer reaches.
 * Storage honesty: 60 minutes at the nominal rate is ~1.35 GB.
 */
@UnstableApi
public final class TimeshiftCache {

    private static SimpleCache cache;
    private static long cacheCapBytes = -1;
    private static boolean cacheHold = true;

    private TimeshiftCache() {}

    private static File dir(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "timeshift-cache");
    }

    private static synchronized SimpleCache cache(Context ctx, long capBytes) {
        boolean hold = ChannelStore.getBufferFullHold(ctx);
        if (cache != null && cacheCapBytes == capBytes && cacheHold == hold) return cache;
        releaseLocked();
        File d = dir(ctx);
        //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        d.mkdirs();
        // Hold: no evictor — the beginning is sacred; the PLAYER stops
        // the capture when the cap is reached (see keptFull). Roll:
        // LRU evictor slides the window as before.
        cache = hold
                ? new SimpleCache(d, new NoOpCacheEvictor(),
                        new StandaloneDatabaseProvider(ctx))
                : new SimpleCache(d, new LeastRecentlyUsedCacheEvictor(capBytes),
                        new StandaloneDatabaseProvider(ctx));
        cacheCapBytes = capBytes;
        cacheHold = hold;
        return cache;
    }

    private static void releaseLocked() {
        if (cache != null) {
            try { cache.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            cache = null;
            cacheCapBytes = -1;
        }
        keys = null;   // a released cache ends the tune (key salt dies with it)
    }

    /** Bytes the kept buffer currently holds (-1 when no cache is live). */
    public static synchronized long cacheSpaceBytes(Context ctx) {
        if (cache == null) return -1;
        try { return cache.getCacheSpace(); } catch (Exception e) { return -1; }
    }

    /**
     * Hold-mode fill test: the kept buffer has reached its cap, so
     * capture must stop and the front must be preserved. A 1% margin
     * keeps the latch from firing on the cap's own rounding.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean keptFull(Context ctx, int capMinutes) {
        if (cache == null) return false;
        long cap = TimeshiftMath.byteCapForMinutes(capMinutes);
        long space = cacheSpaceBytes(ctx);
        return space >= 0 && space >= (long) (cap * 0.99);
    }

    /**
     * A data-source factory for live playback: HTTP upstream (honoring
     * the channel's User-Agent when one was requested), reads/writes
     * through the timeshift cache.
     */
    public static synchronized DataSource.Factory liveFactory(Context ctx,
                                                              String userAgent,
                                                              int capMinutes) {
        Cache c = cache(ctx.getApplicationContext(),
                TimeshiftMath.byteCapForMinutes(capMinutes));
        DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory http = new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory()
                .setUserAgent(userAgent == null || userAgent.isEmpty()
                        ? "Sandy/0.14.1" : userAgent)
                // media3's defaults (8 s/8 s), stated on purpose
                // since v0.14.1: a segment leg that hangs longer
                // than this is a dead leg, and the continuity
                // machinery — not a long socket wait — owns what
                // happens next.
                .setConnectTimeoutMs(8000)
                .setReadTimeoutMs(8000)
                .setAllowCrossProtocolRedirects(true);
        CacheDataSource.Factory f = new CacheDataSource.Factory()
                .setCache(c)
                .setUpstreamDataSourceFactory(http)
                .setFlags(CacheDataSource.FLAG_IGNORE_CACHE_ON_ERROR)
                .setCacheKeyFactory(KEY_FACTORY);
        return f;
    }

    // The key law lives in LiveSegmentKeys (v0.14.1): playlists
    // get one-time keys (never a cache hit); segments get a
    // per-tune salt + a per-address generation, so a fetch can
    // never be answered with an earlier fetch's bytes — the
    // stable-key loop is closed. The generation counter's life
    // is the cache's: a wipe (channel change) starts a new tune.
    private static LiveSegmentKeys keys;

    private static synchronized LiveSegmentKeys keys() {
        if (keys == null) keys = new LiveSegmentKeys(System.nanoTime());
        return keys;
    }

    private static final CacheKeyFactory KEY_FACTORY = dataSpec -> {
        String url = dataSpec.uri.toString();
        LiveSegmentKeys k = keys();
        int before = k.generationOf(url);
        String key = k.keyFor(url);
        if (before >= 1 && cache != null) {
            // This address is being fetched AGAIN in this tune:
            // the previous generation's span is unreachable from
            // here on (that is the point), so don't let it sit in
            // the cache as weight — in Hold mode nothing else
            // would ever evict it.
            try {
                cache.removeResource(k.keyForGeneration(url, before - 1));
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                // a span in use stays; harmless either way
            }
        }
        return key;
    };

    /**
     * Drop the whole buffer — called on CHANNEL CHANGE only since
     * v0.5.0. Closing the player no longer wipes: the last channel's
     * buffer is the kept place (see the class doc, point 2).
     */
    public static synchronized void wipe(Context ctx) {
        releaseLocked();
        deleteTree(dir(ctx.getApplicationContext()));
    }

    private static void deleteTree(File f) {
        if (f == null || !f.exists()) return;
        File[] kids = f.listFiles();
        if (kids != null) for (File k : kids) deleteTree(k);
        //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TimeshiftMath.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * The arithmetic of the live timeshift buffer (v0.4.0), kept pure so
 * the JVM harness can prove it. The honest framing, stated in the
 * notes and in Settings: a "minutes" setting cannot be a promise —
 * streams arrive at different bitrates — so the setting converts to a
 * byte cap at a NOMINAL rate, and the player displays the MEASURED
 * lead (buffered position minus play position), never the nominal
 * number. The other hard bound is the source itself: a live playlist
 * only ever holds its own recent window, and no cache can fetch video
 * the source has already dropped.
 */
public final class TimeshiftMath {

    /** Nominal stream rate the minutes setting is converted at: 3 Mbps. */
    public static final long NOMINAL_BITS_PER_SEC = 3_000_000L;

    // ------------------------------------ the runway (v0.14.1)
    // The Reconnect Doctrine's numbers: the live buffer is the
    // runway recovery happens under. The loader defends a
    // minimum buffer of one full Hydra walk (30 s) so a dead
    // head is found and re-walked while the picture still has
    // seconds in hand; after a rebuffer, playback resumes with
    // 10 s in hand instead of 4. The ahead cap stays RAM-sane;
    // on a live source the real ahead bound is the source's own
    // playlist window, which no setting can widen.

    /** Minimum buffer the loader defends: one Hydra budget. */
    public static final int RUNWAY_MIN_BUFFER_MS = 30_000;
    /** Buffer required before playback resumes after a rebuffer. */
    public static final int REBUFFER_RESUME_MS = 10_000;
    /** Buffer required before playback first starts. */
    public static final int START_BUFFER_MS = 1_500;
    /** Furthest ahead the player may buffer, whatever the setting. */
    public static final int MAX_AHEAD_MS = 600_000;

    public static final int[] MINUTE_CHOICES = {10, 30, 60};
    public static final int DEFAULT_MINUTES = 30;

    private TimeshiftMath() {}

    /** Disk-capacity cap for a minutes setting, at the nominal rate. */
    public static long byteCapForMinutes(int minutes) {
        if (minutes <= 0) minutes = DEFAULT_MINUTES;
        return minutes * 60L * NOMINAL_BITS_PER_SEC / 8L;
    }

    /** Clamp a stored minutes value to one of the offered choices. */
    public static int clampMinutes(int minutes) {
        int best = DEFAULT_MINUTES;
        for (int c : MINUTE_CHOICES) if (c == minutes) return c;
        return best;
    }

    /**
     * Measured lead: how much not-yet-watched video the player is
     * holding ahead of the playhead. Negative/unknown readings clamp
     * to zero — the readout never invents buffer.
     */
    public static long leadMs(long bufferedPositionMs, long currentPositionMs) {
        if (bufferedPositionMs < 0 || currentPositionMs < 0) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, bufferedPositionMs - currentPositionMs);
    }

    /**
     * How far behind the live edge the playhead sits, when the window
     * has a known end (duration). The window's end is the live edge as
     * of the last playlist refresh — close, and labeled approximate in
     * the UI copy where it matters. TIME_UNSET durations (<=0 here)
     * yield -1 = "unknown, don't show".
     */
    public static long behindLiveMs(long durationMs, long currentPositionMs) {
        if (durationMs <= 0 || currentPositionMs < 0) return -1;
        return Math.max(0, durationMs - currentPositionMs);
    }

    /** "04:12" / "1:02:03" for the lead and behind-live readouts. */
    public static String formatClock(long ms) {
        if (ms < 0) ms = 0;
        long totalSec = ms / 1000;
        long h = totalSec / 3600;
        long m = (totalSec % 3600) / 60;
        long s = totalSec % 60;
        if (h > 0) return h + ":" + pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
        return pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
    }

    private static String pad(long v) {
        return v < 10 ? "0" + v : Long.toString(v);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TitleNames.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The names a title is looked up under (v0.10.0): its own name first,
 * then the alternate names TVmaze itself lists (the /akas record) —
 * never a translation we invent. A Spanish show filed as "La Casa de
 * Papel" is also findable as "Money Heist" because TVmaze says the
 * world calls it that; a Japanese show carries its Japanese AKA for
 * the same reason. Matching runs in the title's own language world,
 * with its own names.
 */
public final class TitleNames {

    /** Cap on the set — a show with 40 AKAs still only needs its best few. */
    public static final int MAX_NAMES = 8;

    public static final class Name {
        public final String name;
        public final String countryName;   // "" when TVmaze states none
        public Name(String name, String countryName) {
            this.name = name;
            this.countryName = countryName == null ? "" : countryName;
        }
    }

    private TitleNames() {}

    /** Original first, AKAs after, duplicates by normalized form dropped. */
    public static List<Name> buildSet(String original, List<TvMaze.Aka> akas) {
        List<Name> out = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        if (original != null && !original.trim().isEmpty()) {
            out.add(new Name(original, ""));
            seen.add(EpisodeKey.normalize(original));
        }
        if (akas != null) {
            for (TvMaze.Aka a : akas) {
                if (out.size() >= MAX_NAMES) break;
                if (a.name == null || a.name.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
                if (!seen.add(EpisodeKey.normalize(a.name))) continue;
                out.add(new Name(a.name, a.countryName));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Just the name strings, original first. */
    public static List<String> namesOf(List<Name> set) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Name n : set) out.add(n.name);
        return out;
    }

    /**
     * The name to retry the Archive under when the original name came
     * back weak: the AKA the English-speaking world uses (country US
     * or GB, or the country-less primary alternate — TVmaze lists
     * "Money Heist" with no country), else the first AKA. Null when
     * the set holds nothing beyond the original.
     */
    public static String archiveFallbackName(List<Name> set) {
        if (set == null || set.size() < 2) return null;
        for (int i = 1; i < set.size(); i++) {
            Name n = set.get(i);
            if (n.countryName.isEmpty()
                    || n.countryName.equalsIgnoreCase("United States")
                    || n.countryName.equalsIgnoreCase("United Kingdom")) {
                return n.name;
            }
        }
        return set.get(1).name;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TranslateGate.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

/**
 * The Translate sheet's decision table (v0.6.1) — pure logic, no
 * Android, so the JVM harness can pin EVERY row.
 *
 * Why this class exists: in 0.6.0 the sheet's only row was
 * "Cook a new translation…" and its tap disappeared into a single
 * fragile output surface; on James's phone (live channel, no
 * sidecars) the tap produced NO visible state at all — a silent
 * dead end, field-reported and screenshot-confirmed. The gates
 * themselves (Cooker.begin) were always correct; what failed was
 * that the decision lived inside UI code with exactly one place
 * to speak and no obligation to be heard.
 *
 * The rule from 0.6.1 on: the decision is made HERE, as data, and
 * every outcome is a SPOKEN state — the sheet carries it as its
 * message, the status bar repeats it, and a toast repeats it
 * again. There is no outcome named "nothing". The outcomes, in
 * precedence order:
 *
 *   EXISTING        a prepared dub / cooked sidecar is already here
 *   STREAM_HAS_LANG the stream itself already carries a text track
 *                   in the viewer's language (say so — don't offer
 *                   to cook what the viewer already has)
 *   NEEDS_PACK      no engine pack installed (shelf directions)
 *   PACK_UNBOUND    a pack is in, but this build cannot run it
 *                   (a CTranslate2 pack — the ONNX engine binds only
 *                   ONNX packs; resource honesty, UTX Law 5)
 *   ENGINE_FAILED   an ONNX pack is in, but the runtime would not
 *                   start on this device (reason carried in detail)
 *   LIVE_EDGE       engine bound + LIVE playback: live cannot cook
 *                   from the edge (Delwin's record-then-dub model) —
 *                   the door is ● Record; the action starts recording
 *   RECORDING_NEXT  engine bound + a recording playing back that
 *                   is still being made (v0.7.0 rewording: the
 *                   blocker is no longer "not built" — it is
 *                   "not finished catching yet; stop it first")
 *   (a SETTLED recording — stopped or finished, bytes caught —
 *   falls through to COOK: RecordingExport assembles its cached
 *   spans into one openable file and the cooker cooks from it)
 *   STREAM_COOK     engine bound + a network title: the on-phone
 *                   cooker cooks files on this phone; network titles
 *                   cook on the shelf, once, for every Sandy
 *   COOK            engine bound + a local file: cook it here, now
 */
public final class TranslateGate {

    public enum Outcome {
        EXISTING, STREAM_HAS_LANG, NEEDS_PACK, PACK_UNBOUND,
        ENGINE_FAILED, LIVE_EDGE, RECORDING_NEXT, STREAM_COOK, COOK
    }

    public static final class Decision {
        public final Outcome outcome;
        /** Extra fact for outcomes that carry one (engine failure reason). */
        public final String detail;
        Decision(Outcome o, String d) { outcome = o; detail = d; }
        /** True when the sheet's cook row becomes the ● Record door. */
        public boolean recordDoor() { return outcome == Outcome.LIVE_EDGE; }
        /** True when tapping the cook row should start a real cook. */
        public boolean startsCook() { return outcome == Outcome.COOK; }
    }

    private TranslateGate() {}

    /**
     * @param hasExisting   prepared dub or cooked sidecar attached
     * @param streamHasLang the playing stream itself carries a text
     *                      track in the viewer's language
     * @param packInstalled an engine pack is installed (any format)
     * @param packRunnable  the installed pack is an ONNX pack (the
     *                      only format this build's engine binds)
     * @param engineBound   the ONNX runtime started and the pack's
     *                      sessions can open on this device
     * @param engineFailWhy why the engine did not start ("" if n/a)
     * @param live          live playback (not a file / recording)
     * @param recording     playing back a recording (cache-backed)
     * @param recSettled    the recording is stopped/finished with
     *                      bytes caught (v0.7.0: only then can its
     *                      spans be assembled into a cookable file)
     * @param localSource   the title is a local file the audio
     *                      decoder can open (file path / content URI)
     */
    public static Decision decide(boolean hasExisting, boolean streamHasLang,
            boolean packInstalled, boolean packRunnable, boolean engineBound,
            String engineFailWhy, boolean live, boolean recording,
            boolean recSettled, boolean localSource) {
        if (hasExisting) return new Decision(Outcome.EXISTING, "");
        if (streamHasLang) return new Decision(Outcome.STREAM_HAS_LANG, "");
        if (!packInstalled) return new Decision(Outcome.NEEDS_PACK, "");
        if (!packRunnable) return new Decision(Outcome.PACK_UNBOUND, "");
        if (!engineBound) return new Decision(Outcome.ENGINE_FAILED,
                engineFailWhy == null ? "" : engineFailWhy);
        if (live) return new Decision(Outcome.LIVE_EDGE, "");
        if (recording && !recSettled) return new Decision(Outcome.RECORDING_NEXT, "");
        if (recording) return new Decision(Outcome.COOK, "");
        if (!localSource) return new Decision(Outcome.STREAM_COOK, "");
        return new Decision(Outcome.COOK, "");
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TranslatorActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * THE TRANSLATOR (v0.15.0) — two people, no shared language, one
 * phone passed between them. Turn-based by design (James's spec):
 * one side speaks or types → an honest working pause → the HEARD
 * words and the RENDERED words appear SIDE BY SIDE and stay
 * there (the verification rule: the text is the receipt) → the
 * rendering is spoken in the other side's language when the
 * output mode asks for a voice.
 *
 * Coverage is derived, never boasted (TranslatorCore over the
 * installed engine pairs): a pair with no real path is refused
 * BEFORE any words are captured, in plain words, and a route
 * through English is disclosed as a route through English —
 * intermediate text included. The conversation can be kept as
 * a file on the memory hook.
 */
public final class TranslatorActivity extends Activity {

    public static final String X_SEED_TEXT = "seed_text";
    public static final String X_SEED_LANG = "seed_lang";
    private static final String PREFS = "sandy_doors";
    private static final int REQ_MIC = 7;

    private final TranslatorCore.Conversation conv =
            new TranslatorCore.Conversation();
    private TranslatorCore.OutMode outMode = TranslatorCore.OutMode.BOTH;
    private final Map<String, TextMt> mtCache = new HashMap<>();
    private VoiceSpeaker speaker;
    private EarCapture ear;
    private List<VoiceLangs.Row> langs = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean capturing = false;

    private Button sideABtn, sideBBtn;
    private TextView routeLine;
    private TextView turnLine;
    private TextView heardView, renderedView, viaView;
    private TextView historyView;
    private TextView stateLine;
    private EditText typeBox;
    private Button speakBtn, useWordsBtn;
    private Button modeVoiceBtn, modeTextBtn, modeBothBtn;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "door_translator"));
        langs = VoiceLangs.load(this);
        conv.sideA = prefs().getString("tr_a", "en");
        conv.sideB = prefs().getString("tr_b", "");
        if (conv.sideB.isEmpty() || conv.sideB.equals(conv.sideA)) {
            conv.sideB = firstOtherThan(conv.sideA);
        }

        int pad = dp(16);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "door_translator"));
        title.setTextSize(24);
        root.addView(title);

        // the two sides
        LinearLayout sides = new LinearLayout(this);
        sides.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        LinearLayout colA = sideColumn(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_side_a"), true);
        LinearLayout colB = sideColumn(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_side_b"), false);
        sides.addView(colA, weight());
        sides.addView(colB, weight());
        root.addView(sides, topMargin(dp(10)));

        Button swapBtn = new Button(this);
        swapBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_swap"));
        swapBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        swapBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            conv.swapSides();
            persistSides();
            refreshSides();
        });
        root.addView(swapBtn, topMargin(dp(6)));

        routeLine = new TextView(this);
        routeLine.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(routeLine, topMargin(dp(6)));

        turnLine = new TextView(this);
        turnLine.setTextSize(19);
        root.addView(turnLine, topMargin(dp(12)));

        // output mode: text ALWAYS shows; the mode governs voice
        LinearLayout modes = new LinearLayout(this);
        modes.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        modeVoiceBtn = modeButton(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_mode_voice"),
                TranslatorCore.OutMode.VOICE);
        modeTextBtn = modeButton(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_mode_text"),
                TranslatorCore.OutMode.TEXT);
        modeBothBtn = modeButton(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_mode_both"),
                TranslatorCore.OutMode.BOTH);
        modes.addView(modeVoiceBtn, weight());
        modes.addView(modeTextBtn, weight());
        modes.addView(modeBothBtn, weight());
        root.addView(modes, topMargin(dp(8)));

        speakBtn = new Button(this);
        speakBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_speak_turn"));
        speakBtn.setTextSize(22);
        speakBtn.setMinHeight(dp(72));
        speakBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> startCapture());
        root.addView(speakBtn, topMargin(dp(10)));

        typeBox = new EditText(this);
        typeBox.setHint(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_type_hint"));
        typeBox.setTextSize(19);
        typeBox.setMinLines(2);
        root.addView(typeBox, topMargin(dp(8)));
        useWordsBtn = new Button(this);
        useWordsBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_use_words"));
        useWordsBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        useWordsBtn.setTextSize(17);
        useWordsBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String t = typeBox.getText().toString().trim();
            if (!t.isEmpty()) runTurn(t);
        });
        root.addView(useWordsBtn);

        stateLine = new TextView(this);
        stateLine.setTextSize(16);
        root.addView(stateLine, topMargin(dp(8)));

        // heard | rendered — side by side, always together
        LinearLayout pair = new LinearLayout(this);
        pair.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        LinearLayout heardCol = new LinearLayout(this);
        heardCol.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        TextView heardLabel = new TextView(this);
        heardLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_heard"));
        heardLabel.setTextSize(14);
        heardView = new TextView(this);
        heardView.setTextSize(21);
        heardCol.addView(heardLabel);
        heardCol.addView(heardView);
        LinearLayout rendCol = new LinearLayout(this);
        rendCol.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        TextView rendLabel = new TextView(this);
        rendLabel.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_rendered"));
        rendLabel.setTextSize(14);
        renderedView = new TextView(this);
        renderedView.setTextSize(21);
        rendCol.addView(rendLabel);
        rendCol.addView(renderedView);
        pair.addView(heardCol, weight());
        pair.addView(rendCol, weight());
        root.addView(pair, topMargin(dp(12)));

        viaView = new TextView(this);
        viaView.setTextSize(14);
        root.addView(viaView, topMargin(dp(4)));

        historyView = new TextView(this);
        historyView.setTextSize(15);
        root.addView(historyView, topMargin(dp(14)));

        LinearLayout foot = new LinearLayout(this);
        foot.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        Button saveBtn = new Button(this);
        saveBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_save"));
        saveBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        saveBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> saveConversation());
        Button newBtn = new Button(this);
        newBtn.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_new"));
        newBtn.setAllCaps(false);
        newBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            conv.reset();
            heardView.setText("");
            renderedView.setText("");
            viaView.setText("");
            historyView.setText("");
            stateLine.setText("");
            refreshSides();
        });
        foot.addView(saveBtn, weight());
        foot.addView(newBtn, weight());
        root.addView(foot, topMargin(dp(12)));

        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.addView(root);
        setContentView(scroll);

        speaker = new VoiceSpeaker(this);
        speaker.warmUp(this::refreshSides);
        ear = new EarCapture(this);
        ear.setListener(new EarCapture.Listener() {
            @Override public void onListening() {
                stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(TranslatorActivity.this,
                        "listen_state_listening"));
            }
            @Override public void onPartial(String text) {
                heardView.setText(text);
            }
            @Override public void onFinal(String text, ListenRecord.State state) {
                capturing = false;
                if (state == ListenRecord.State.HEARD
                        && text != null && !text.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    runTurn(text.trim());
                } else {
                    stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(TranslatorActivity.this,
                            "translator_not_heard"));
                }
            }
        });

        // words handed over from Listen For Me: they become the
        // current side's typed turn, visible before anything runs
        String seed = getIntent().getStringExtra(X_SEED_TEXT);
        String seedLang = getIntent().getStringExtra(X_SEED_LANG);
        if (seed != null && !seed.trim().isEmpty()) {
            if (seedLang != null && !seedLang.isEmpty()) {
                if (conv.nextSide() == 'A') conv.sideA = seedLang;
                else conv.sideB = seedLang;
            }
            typeBox.setText(seed);
        }
        refreshSides();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (ear != null) ear.stop();
        if (speaker != null) speaker.shutdown();
        for (TextMt mt : mtCache.values()) {
            try { mt.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        mtCache.clear();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ sides & route

    private LinearLayout sideColumn(String label, boolean isA) {
        LinearLayout col = new LinearLayout(this);
        col.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        TextView lab = new TextView(this);
        lab.setText(label);
        lab.setTextSize(14);
        col.addView(lab);
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setTextSize(18);
        b.setOnClickListener(v -> pickSide(isA));
        col.addView(b);
        if (isA) sideABtn = b; else sideBBtn = b;
        return col;
    }

    private Button modeButton(String label, TranslatorCore.OutMode m) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setAllCaps(false);
        b.setTextSize(15);
        b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            outMode = m;
            refreshModes();
        });
        return b;
    }

    private void refreshModes() {
        modeVoiceBtn.setEnabled(outMode != TranslatorCore.OutMode.VOICE);
        modeTextBtn.setEnabled(outMode != TranslatorCore.OutMode.TEXT);
        modeBothBtn.setEnabled(outMode != TranslatorCore.OutMode.BOTH);
    }

    private String firstOtherThan(String iso) {
        for (VoiceLangs.Row r : langs) {
            if (!r.iso1.isEmpty() && !r.iso1.equals(iso)) return r.iso1;
        }
        return "en";
    }

    private String langName(String iso) {
        VoiceLangs.Row r = VoiceLangs.byIso1(langs, iso);
        return r == null ? iso : r.tvName;
    }

    private void persistSides() {
        prefs().edit().putString("tr_a", conv.sideA)
                .putString("tr_b", conv.sideB).apply();
    }

    private void pickSide(boolean isA) {
        Set<String> pairs = TextMt.installedPairs(this);
        List<VoiceLangs.Row> pickable = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
        for (VoiceLangs.Row r : langs) {
            if (r.iso1.isEmpty()) continue;
            pickable.add(r);
            labels.add(r.tvName);
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, isA
                        ? "translator_side_a" : "translator_side_b"))
                .setItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]), (d, which) -> {
                    String iso = pickable.get(which).iso1;
                    if (isA) conv.sideA = iso; else conv.sideB = iso;
                    persistSides();
                    refreshSides();
                })
                .show();
    }

    /** The route truth for the CURRENT direction, refreshed
     *  whenever sides or the turn change. NONE disables capture:
     *  the refusal lands before a word is taken. */
    private TranslatorCore.Route currentRoute() {
        return DoorCoverage.route(conv.fromIso(), conv.toIso(),
                TextMt.installedPairs(this));
    }

    private void refreshSides() {
        sideABtn.setText(langName(conv.sideA));
        sideBBtn.setText(langName(conv.sideB));
        turnLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, conv.nextSide() == 'A'
                ? "translator_turn_a" : "translator_turn_b"));
        refreshModes();
        TranslatorCore.Route route = currentRoute();
        boolean canCapture = route.ok();
        speakBtn.setEnabled(canCapture);
        useWordsBtn.setEnabled(canCapture);
        typeBox.setEnabled(canCapture);
        switch (route.kind) {
            case NONE:
                routeLine.setText(String.format(
                        LangStore.tr(this, "translator_cant"),
                        langName(conv.fromIso()), langName(conv.toIso())));
                break;
            case PIVOT:
                routeLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_pivot"));
                break;
            case IDENTITY:
                routeLine.setText(langName(conv.fromIso())
                        + " → " + langName(conv.toIso()));
                break;
            default:
                routeLine.setText(langName(conv.fromIso())
                        + " → " + langName(conv.toIso()));
                break;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ the turn

    private void startCapture() {
        if (capturing) { ear.stop(); capturing = false; return; }
        if (!currentRoute().ok()) { refreshSides(); return; }
        if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO},
                    REQ_MIC);
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_no_mic"));
            return;
        }
        heardView.setText("");
        renderedView.setText("");
        viaView.setText("");
        if (ear.start(conv.fromIso())) {
            capturing = true;
        } else {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "listen_state_none"));
        }
    }

    /**
     * One full turn: heard words → (the honest pause) → rendered
     * words beside them → spoken in the other language when the
     * mode asks. Runs the MT on a worker; the state machine
     * (TranslatorCore.Conversation) records the turn only when a
     * real route carried it.
     */
    private void runTurn(final String heard) {
        final TranslatorCore.Route route = currentRoute();
        if (!route.ok()) { refreshSides(); return; }
        final String from = conv.fromIso();
        final String to = conv.toIso();
        stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_working"));
        heardView.setText(heard);
        renderedView.setText("");
        viaView.setText("");
        new Thread(() -> {
            String rendered = "";
            String via = "";
            String fail = "";
            try {
                switch (route.kind) {
                    case IDENTITY:
                        rendered = heard;
                        break;
                    case DIRECT:
                        rendered = mt(route.pair).translate(heard);
                        break;
                    case PIVOT:
                        via = mt(route.legIn).translate(heard);
                        if (via == null || via.trim().isEmpty()) {
                            throw new Exception("the first step said nothing");
                        }
                        rendered = mt(route.legOut).translate(via);
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
                if (rendered == null) rendered = "";
                if (rendered.trim().isEmpty()
                        && route.kind != TranslatorCore.RouteKind.IDENTITY) {
                    fail = LangStore.tr(this, "translator_not_heard");
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                fail = e.getMessage() == null ? "" : e.getMessage();
                if (fail.isEmpty()) {
                    fail = LangStore.tr(this, "translator_not_heard");
                }
            }
            final String fRendered = rendered;
            final String fVia = via;
            final String fFail = fail;
            runOnUiThread(() -> finishTurn(heard, fRendered, fVia, fFail,
                    route, from, to));
        }, "translator-turn").start();
    }

    private void finishTurn(String heard, String rendered, String via,
                            String fail, TranslatorCore.Route route,
                            String from, String to) {
        if (!fail.isEmpty()) {
            stateLine.setText(fail);
            return;
        }
        TranslatorCore.Turn turn =
                conv.addTurn(heard, rendered, via, outMode, route);
        if (turn == null) { refreshSides(); return; }
        heardView.setText(turn.heard);
        renderedView.setText(turn.rendered);
        viaView.setText(turn.via.isEmpty() ? ""
                : "via English: " + turn.via);
        stateLine.setText("");
        typeBox.setText("");
        appendHistory(turn);
        // speak the rendering in the OTHER side's language
        if (TranslatorCore.speaks(outMode)) {
            VoiceLangs.Row row = VoiceLangs.byIso1(langs, to);
            VoiceResolve.Result v = SpeakQueue.decide(row,
                    VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this), speaker.systemIso1());
            if (v.voice == VoiceResolve.Voice.NONE) {
                // no voice: the text stands (it always stands);
                // the missing voice is said, not hidden
                stateLine.setText(String.format(
                        LangStore.tr(this, "translator_voice_missing"),
                        langName(to)));
            } else {
                SpeakQueue q = new SpeakQueue();
                q.enqueue(turn.rendered, to);
                speaker.speak(q);
            }
        }
        refreshSides();
    }

    private void appendHistory(TranslatorCore.Turn t) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(historyView.getText());
        if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append("\n\n");
        sb.append(t.side).append(" · ").append(langName(t.fromIso))
                .append(" → ").append(langName(t.toIso)).append('\n');
        sb.append(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_heard"))
                .append(": ").append(t.heard).append('\n');
        if (!t.via.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("via English: ").append(t.via).append('\n');
        }
        sb.append(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_rendered"))
                .append(": ").append(t.rendered);
        historyView.setText(sb.toString());
    }

    private TextMt mt(String pair) throws Exception {
        TextMt m = mtCache.get(pair);
        if (m == null) {
            m = TextMt.open(this, pair);
            mtCache.put(pair, m);
        }
        return m;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ file out

    private void saveConversation() {
        if (conv.turns.isEmpty()) {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_not_heard"));
            return;
        }
        String stamp = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US)
                .format(new Date());
        try {
            MemoryHook.write(this, "translator_" + stamp + ".txt",
                    TranslatorCore.transcriptBody(conv));
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_saved"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stateLine.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "translator_not_heard"));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private SharedPreferences prefs() {
        return getSharedPreferences(PREFS, MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams topMargin(int m) {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = m;
        return lp;
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams weight() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TranslatorCore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * THE TRANSLATOR's core (v0.15.0) — the turn-based conversation
 * between two people who share no language, built exactly to
 * James's spec: one side speaks (or types), an honest pause,
 * the HEARD words and the RENDERED words side by side, then the
 * rendering spoken in the other side's language. UNDERSTOOD is
 * the floor — turn-taking is the shipped mode, never blocked on
 * anything live or simultaneous.
 *
 * Routes are derived from the machinery that truly exists: the
 * installed engine packs' MT pairs (TextMt.installedPairs).
 *   DIRECT    one installed pair carries from→to
 *   PIVOT     from→en and en→to are both installed; the hop
 *             through English is DISCLOSED on screen, never hid
 *   IDENTITY  both sides picked the same language — nothing to
 *             translate; the rendering is the words themselves
 *   NONE      no real path. The door refuses BEFORE any words
 *             are captured and names the missing direction —
 *             never faked, never silently routed elsewhere.
 *
 * The verification rule is structural here: a Turn always
 * carries heard AND rendered together, and the transcript file
 * writes both, every turn. Pure: the door and the harness drive
 * the same state machine.
 */
public final class TranslatorCore {

    public enum RouteKind { DIRECT, PIVOT, IDENTITY, NONE }

    public static final class Route {
        public RouteKind kind = RouteKind.NONE;
        /** The pair that carries the words (DIRECT), else "". */
        public String pair = "";
        /** PIVOT legs: from→en then en→to. */
        public String legIn = "";
        public String legOut = "";
        /** NONE: the direction that has no engine, e.g. "ja-fr". */
        public String missingPair = "";

        public boolean ok() { return kind != RouteKind.NONE; }
    }

    /** How a turn's rendering leaves the door. Text is ALWAYS
     *  shown (the verification rule); the mode only governs the
     *  spoken half. */
    public enum OutMode { VOICE, TEXT, BOTH }

    public static boolean speaks(OutMode m) { return m != OutMode.TEXT; }
    public static boolean showsText(OutMode m) { return true; }

    /** Derive the route for from→to from the installed pairs. */
    public static Route resolveRoute(String fromIso, String toIso,
                                     Set<String> installedPairs) {
        Route r = new Route();
        String f = fromIso == null ? "" : fromIso.trim().toLowerCase();
        String t = toIso == null ? "" : toIso.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (f.isEmpty() || t.isEmpty()) {
            r.missingPair = f + "-" + t;
            return r;
        }
        if (f.equals(t)) {
            r.kind = RouteKind.IDENTITY;
            return r;
        }
        Set<String> pairs = installedPairs == null
                ? java.util.Collections.emptySet() : installedPairs;
        String direct = f + "-" + t;
        if (pairs.contains(direct)) {
            r.kind = RouteKind.DIRECT;
            r.pair = direct;
            return r;
        }
        String in = f + "-en";
        String out = "en-" + t;
        if (!f.equals("en") && !t.equals("en")
                && pairs.contains(in) && pairs.contains(out)) {
            r.kind = RouteKind.PIVOT;
            r.legIn = in;
            r.legOut = out;
            return r;
        }
        r.missingPair = direct;
        return r;
    }

    /** One turn of the conversation. Heard and rendered travel
     *  together — there is no state in which a rendering exists
     *  without the words it came from. */
    public static final class Turn {
        public char side;              // 'A' or 'B'
        public String fromIso = "";
        public String toIso = "";
        public String heard = "";
        public String rendered = "";
        /** PIVOT only: the intermediate English text — the hop
         *  is disclosed, and so is what passed through it. */
        public String via = "";
        public OutMode mode = OutMode.BOTH;
        public RouteKind route = RouteKind.NONE;
    }

    /** The conversation: sides, turns, and whose turn it is. */
    public static final class Conversation {
        public String sideA = "en";
        public String sideB = "";
        public final List<Turn> turns = new ArrayList<>();
        private char next = 'A';

        public char nextSide() { return next; }

        public String fromIso() { return next == 'A' ? sideA : sideB; }
        public String toIso() { return next == 'A' ? sideB : sideA; }

        /** Record a completed turn; the floor passes to the
         *  other side. Refuses (null) when the route is NONE —
         *  a turn that can't be rendered is never recorded as
         *  if it had been. */
        public Turn addTurn(String heard, String rendered, OutMode mode,
                            Route route) {
            return addTurn(heard, rendered, "", mode, route);
        }

        public Turn addTurn(String heard, String rendered, String via,
                            OutMode mode, Route route) {
            if (route == null || !route.ok()) return null;
            Turn t = new Turn();
            t.side = next;
            t.fromIso = fromIso();
            t.toIso = toIso();
            t.heard = heard == null ? "" : heard;
            t.rendered = rendered == null ? "" : rendered;
            t.via = via == null ? "" : via;
            t.mode = mode == null ? OutMode.BOTH : mode;
            t.route = route.kind;
            turns.add(t);
            next = next == 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
            return t;
        }

        /** Swap the two sides' languages; turns already taken
         *  keep the directions they actually happened in. */
        public void swapSides() {
            String tmp = sideA;
            sideA = sideB;
            sideB = tmp;
        }

        public void reset() {
            turns.clear();
            next = 'A';
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ transcript file

    /** The conversation as a file body — both halves of every
     *  turn, with directions (the receipt, kept). */
    public static String transcriptBody(Conversation c) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Sandy — Translator conversation\n");
        sb.append("A: ").append(c.sideA).append('\n');
        sb.append("B: ").append(c.sideB).append('\n');
        sb.append("---\n");
        int n = 0;
        for (Turn t : c.turns) {
            n++;
            sb.append("TURN ").append(n).append(" | ").append(t.side)
                    .append(' ').append(t.fromIso).append("->").append(t.toIso)
                    .append(" | mode: ").append(t.mode.name())
                    .append(" | route: ").append(t.route.name()).append('\n');
            sb.append("HEARD: ").append(escape(t.heard)).append('\n');
            if (!t.via.isEmpty()) {
                sb.append("VIA: ").append(escape(t.via)).append('\n');
            }
            sb.append("RENDERED: ").append(escape(t.rendered)).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** Parse a transcript file body back into a conversation. */
    public static Conversation parseTranscript(String body) {
        Conversation c = new Conversation();
        if (body == null) return c;
        Turn cur = null;
        for (String line : body.split("\n", -1)) {
            if (line.startsWith("A: ") && cur == null && c.turns.isEmpty()) {
                c.sideA = line.substring(3).trim();
            } else if (line.startsWith("B: ") && cur == null && c.turns.isEmpty()) {
                c.sideB = line.substring(3).trim();
            } else if (line.startsWith("TURN ")) {
                cur = new Turn();
                cur.side = 'A';
                String[] p = line.split("\\|");
                if (p.length >= 2) {
                    String dir = p[1].trim();           // "A en->ja"
                    String[] d = dir.split("\\s+");
                    if (d.length >= 1 && d[0].length() == 1) cur.side = d[0].charAt(0);
                    if (d.length >= 2) {
                        String[] io = d[1].split("->");
                        if (io.length == 2) {
                            cur.fromIso = io[0].trim();
                            cur.toIso = io[1].trim();
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (p.length >= 3) {
                    String m = p[2].trim().replace("mode:", "").trim();
                    try { cur.mode = OutMode.valueOf(m); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                if (p.length >= 4) {
                    String m = p[3].trim().replace("route:", "").trim();
                    try { cur.route = RouteKind.valueOf(m); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                c.turns.add(cur);
                // keep the alternation where the file left it
                c.next = cur.side == 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
                if (!c.turns.isEmpty() && c.turns.size() == 1) {
                    // first turn defines nothing about the sides'
                    // languages beyond its own direction
                }
            } else if (line.startsWith("HEARD: ") && cur != null) {
                cur.heard = unescape(line.substring(7));
            } else if (line.startsWith("VIA: ") && cur != null) {
                cur.via = unescape(line.substring(5));
            } else if (line.startsWith("RENDERED: ") && cur != null) {
                cur.rendered = unescape(line.substring(10));
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    private static String escape(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "");
    }

    private static String unescape(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(i);
            if (ch == '\\' && i + 1 < s.length()) {
                char n = s.charAt(++i);
                out.append(n == 'n' ? '\n' : n);
            } else {
                out.append(ch);
            }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private TranslatorCore() {}
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TtsDubRenderer.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener;
import android.speech.tts.Voice;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/**
 * The voiced leg (v0.6.0) — a REAL on-device renderer, no seam:
 * Android's own speech engine speaks the cooked subtitle lines into
 * a .wav that rides beside the video like a prepared dub.
 *
 * Per line: the voice comes from the show's voice book (Delwin's
 * casting: this character = this voice, this pitch, this rate). A
 * line whose natural reading overruns its window is re-spoken faster
 * (up to 2x, two tries) — window fitting, the same contract the
 * desktop lab proved, done with the tools the phone actually has.
 * A line that still overruns is placed anyway and counted in the
 * report — the renderer never hides a misfit.
 *
 * What it is NOT: a diarizer. Lines carry speaker keys only when a
 * cooked record provides them; with no book and no speakers, every
 * line is one voice (the NOTES say so plainly).
 *
 * Runs on its own thread; progress reports COOKED SECONDS (the end
 * of the last finished line) so the cooker state machine can ride it.
 */
public final class TtsDubRenderer {

    public static final class Report {
        public int lines = 0;
        public int refits = 0;
        public int overran = 0;
        public int formatSkips = 0;
        public double spokenSec = 0;
        /** Per-line fit disclosure, aligned to the input lines
         *  (v0.12.0): 0 natural pace, 1 re-spoken faster to fit,
         *  2 still overran its window — the same numbers
         *  CookedSubs.Line.fit records, so a squeezed line is
         *  disclosed in the saved record, never hidden. */
        public int[] lineFit = new int[0];
    }

    public interface Callback {
        void onProgress(double cookedSec);
        void onDone(File wav, Report report);
        void onError(String why);
    }

    private final Context ctx;
    private volatile boolean cancelled = false;

    public TtsDubRenderer(Context ctx) {
        this.ctx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public void cancel() { cancelled = true; }

    /** Voice names the phone's speech engine offers (for casting). */
    public static void availableVoiceNames(Context ctx,
                                           java.util.function.Consumer<List<String>> cb) {
        final TextToSpeech[] holder = new TextToSpeech[1];
        holder[0] = new TextToSpeech(ctx.getApplicationContext(), status -> {
            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
            if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {
                try {
                    for (Voice v : holder[0].getVoices()) names.add(v.getName());
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            try { holder[0].shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            cb.accept(names);
        });
    }

    public void render(List<CookedSubs.Line> lines, VoiceBook.Book book,
                       String langCode, File outWav, Callback cb) {
        new Thread(() -> doRender(lines, book, langCode, outWav, cb),
                "tts-dub-render").start();
    }

    /**
     * The pack leg (v0.13.0): the same render, spoken by an
     * installed Sandy voice pack (OnnxVoiceSynth) instead of the
     * phone's speech engine. Casting rides the book exactly as on
     * the system leg — rate through the model's length scale,
     * pitch through a PCM resample — and the fit loop closes on
     * MEASURED PCM, the same contract: a line is re-spoken faster
     * (up to 2x, two tries), a line that still overruns is placed
     * anyway and counted, never hidden.
     */
    public void renderPack(List<CookedSubs.Line> lines, VoiceBook.Book book,
                           String packCode, File outWav, Callback cb) {
        new Thread(() -> doRenderPack(lines, book, packCode, outWav, cb),
                "pack-dub-render").start();
    }

    private void doRenderPack(List<CookedSubs.Line> lines, VoiceBook.Book book,
                              String packCode, File outWav, Callback cb) {
        Report report = new Report();
        report.lines = lines.size();
        report.lineFit = new int[lines.size()];
        VoicePackStore.Installed inst =
                VoicePackStore.installed(ctx).get(packCode);
        if (inst == null) {
            cb.onError("the voice pack is not installed");
            return;
        }
        try (OnnxVoiceSynth synth = OnnxVoiceSynth.open(inst.dir)) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream track = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            int sampleRate = OnnxVoiceSynth.SAMPLE_RATE, channels = 1;
            int byteRate = sampleRate * channels * 2;
            long cursorMs = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
                if (cancelled) { cb.onError("stopped"); return; }
                CookedSubs.Line line = lines.get(i);
                if (line.text == null || line.text.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    cb.onProgress(line.endMs / 1000.0);
                    continue;
                }
                VoiceBook.CastEntry cast = castFor(book, line, i);
                double windowSec = Math.max(0.4, (line.endMs - line.startMs) / 1000.0);
                byte[] pcm = null;
                double rateMult = 1.0;
                int fit = 0;
                for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
                    double castRate = cast != null ? cast.rate : 1.0;
                    double lengthScale = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.0,
                            castRate * rateMult));
                    float[] spoken = synth.synth(line.text, lengthScale);
                    if (cast != null) {
                        spoken = OnnxVoiceSynth.pitchShift(spoken, cast.pitch);
                    }
                    if (spoken.length == 0) { pcm = null; break; }
                    pcm = toPcm16(spoken);
                    double natural = (double) pcm.length / byteRate;
                    if (natural <= windowSec * 1.02 || attempt == 2) {
                        if (natural > windowSec * 1.02) { report.overran++; fit = 2; }
                        else if (attempt > 0) fit = 1;
                        break;
                    }
                    report.refits++;
                    rateMult = Math.min(2.0, rateMult * (natural / windowSec));
                }
                if (pcm != null) {
                    report.lineFit[i] = fit;
                    long gapMs = line.startMs - cursorMs;
                    if (gapMs > 0) {
                        int gapBytes = (int) (byteRate * gapMs / 1000);
                        track.write(new byte[gapBytes], 0, gapBytes);
                        cursorMs += gapMs;
                    }
                    track.write(pcm, 0, pcm.length);
                    cursorMs = line.startMs + (long) (pcm.length * 1000.0 / byteRate);
                    report.spokenSec = cursorMs / 1000.0;
                }
                cb.onProgress(line.endMs / 1000.0);
            }
            if (report.spokenSec == 0 && track.size() == 0) {
                cb.onError("the voice pack produced no usable audio");
                return;
            }
            writeWav(outWav, track.toByteArray(), sampleRate, channels);
            cb.onDone(outWav, report);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            cb.onError("voice pack rendering failed (" + e.getMessage() + ")");
        }
    }

    private static byte[] toPcm16(float[] in) {
        byte[] out = new byte[in.length * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < in.length; i++) {
            float v = Math.max(-1f, Math.min(1f, in[i]));
            int s = Math.round(v * 32767f);
            out[i * 2] = (byte) s;
            out[i * 2 + 1] = (byte) (s >> 8);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ core

    private void doRender(List<CookedSubs.Line> lines, VoiceBook.Book book,
                          String langCode, File outWav, Callback cb) {
        Report report = new Report();
        report.lines = lines.size();
        report.lineFit = new int[lines.size()];
