        final TextToSpeech[] holder = new TextToSpeech[1];
        final CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
        final boolean[] initOk = {false};
        holder[0] = new TextToSpeech(ctx, status -> {
            initOk[0] = status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS;
            initLatch.countDown();
        });
        try {
            if (!initLatch.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS) || !initOk[0]) {
                cb.onError("the phone's speech engine did not start");
                return;
            }
            TextToSpeech tts = holder[0];
            Locale loc = langCode == null || langCode.isEmpty()
                    ? Locale.getDefault() : Locale.forLanguageTag(langCode);
            tts.setLanguage(loc);

            Map<String, CountDownLatch> latches = new HashMap<>();
            Map<String, Boolean> errors = new HashMap<>();
            tts.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(new UtteranceProgressListener() {
                @Override public void onStart(String id) {}
                @Override public void onDone(String id) {
                    CountDownLatch l = latches.get(id);
                    if (l != null) l.countDown();
                }
                @Override public void onError(String id) {
                    errors.put(id, Boolean.TRUE);
                    CountDownLatch l = latches.get(id);
                    if (l != null) l.countDown();
                }
            });

            List<Voice> voices = new ArrayList<>();
            try { voices.addAll(tts.getVoices()); } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            File workDir = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "tts-dub");
            EnginePackStore.deleteTree(workDir);
            workDir.mkdirs();

            ByteArrayOutputStream track = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            int sampleRate = 0, channels = 0, byteRate = 0;
            long cursorMs = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
                if (cancelled) { cb.onError("stopped"); shutdown(tts); return; }
                CookedSubs.Line line = lines.get(i);
                if (line.text == null || line.text.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    cb.onProgress(line.endMs / 1000.0);
                    continue;
                }
                VoiceBook.CastEntry cast = castFor(book, line, i);
                applyCast(tts, cast, voices, book == null ? 0 : book.cast.indexOf(cast));
                double windowSec = Math.max(0.4, (line.endMs - line.startMs) / 1000.0);
                byte[] pcm = null;
                int[] fmt = null;
                double rateMult = 1.0;
                int fit = 0;
                for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
                    File uf = new File(workDir, "u" + i + "_" + attempt + ".wav");
                    String id = "u" + i + "_" + attempt;
                    CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
                    latches.put(id, latch);
                    tts.setSpeechRate((float) Math.max(0.5,
                            Math.min(2.0, (cast != null ? cast.rate : 1.0) * rateMult)));
                    Bundle params = new Bundle();
                    int r = tts.synthesizeToFile(line.text, params, uf, id);
                    if (r != TextToSpeech.SUCCESS
                            || !latch.await(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                            || errors.containsKey(id) || !uf.isFile()) {
                        pcm = null;
                        break;
                    }
                    WavData w = readWav(uf);
                    if (w == null) { pcm = null; break; }
                    fmt = new int[]{w.sampleRate, w.channels, w.byteRate};
                    pcm = w.pcm;
                    double natural = w.byteRate > 0
                            ? (double) w.pcm.length / w.byteRate : windowSec;
                    if (natural <= windowSec * 1.02 || attempt == 2) {
                        if (natural > windowSec * 1.02) { report.overran++; fit = 2; }
                        else if (attempt > 0) fit = 1;
                        break;
                    }
                    report.refits++;
                    rateMult = Math.min(2.0, rateMult * (natural / windowSec));
                }
                if (pcm != null) report.lineFit[i] = fit;
                if (pcm != null && fmt != null) {
                    if (sampleRate == 0) {
                        sampleRate = fmt[0]; channels = fmt[1]; byteRate = fmt[2];
                    }
                    if (fmt[0] == sampleRate && fmt[1] == channels && fmt[2] == byteRate) {
                        long gapMs = line.startMs - cursorMs;
                        if (gapMs > 0) {
                            int gapBytes = (int) (byteRate * gapMs / 1000);
                            track.write(new byte[gapBytes], 0, gapBytes);
                            cursorMs += gapMs;
                        }
                        track.write(pcm, 0, pcm.length);
                        cursorMs = line.startMs + (long) (pcm.length * 1000.0 / byteRate);
                        report.spokenSec = cursorMs / 1000.0;
                    } else {
                        report.formatSkips++;
                    }
                }
                cb.onProgress(line.endMs / 1000.0);
            }

            if (sampleRate == 0) {
                cb.onError("the speech engine produced no usable audio");
                shutdown(tts);
                return;
            }
            writeWav(outWav, track.toByteArray(), sampleRate, channels);
            shutdown(tts);
            cb.onDone(outWav, report);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try { shutdown(holder[0]); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            cb.onError("voice rendering failed (" + e.getMessage() + ")");
        }
    }

    private void shutdown(TextToSpeech tts) {
        if (tts != null) { try { tts.stop(); tts.shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {} }
    }

    private VoiceBook.CastEntry castFor(VoiceBook.Book book, CookedSubs.Line line,
                                        int lineIndex) {
        if (book == null || book.cast.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (line.speaker != null && !line.speaker.isEmpty()) {
            for (VoiceBook.CastEntry e : book.cast) {
                if (line.speaker.equals(e.speakerKey)) return e;
            }
        }
        return book.cast.get(0);
    }

    private void applyCast(TextToSpeech tts, VoiceBook.CastEntry cast,
                           List<Voice> voices, int castIndex) {
        if (cast == null) {
            tts.setPitch(1.0f);
            return;
        }
        tts.setPitch((float) cast.pitch);
        Voice chosen = null;
        if (cast.ttsVoice != null && !cast.ttsVoice.isEmpty()) {
            for (Voice v : voices) {
                if (cast.ttsVoice.equals(v.getName())) { chosen = v; break; }
            }
        }
        if (chosen == null && castIndex > 0 && !voices.isEmpty()) {
            // Unassigned extra cast members get a deterministic
            // different voice rather than the lead's.
            chosen = voices.get(Math.abs(castIndex) % voices.size());
        }
        if (chosen != null) {
            try { tts.setVoice(chosen); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ WAV io

    private static final class WavData {
        int sampleRate, channels, byteRate;
        byte[] pcm;
    }

    private static WavData readWav(File f) {
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] all = readAllBytes(in);
            if (all.length < 44 || all[0] != 'R' || all[1] != 'I') return null;
            WavData w = new WavData();
            int pos = 12;
            while (pos + 8 <= all.length) {
                String id = new String(all, pos, 4, "ASCII");
                long size = u32(all, pos + 4);
                if ("fmt ".equals(id)) {
                    w.channels = u16(all, pos + 10);
                    w.sampleRate = (int) u32(all, pos + 12);
                    w.byteRate = (int) u32(all, pos + 16);
                } else if ("data".equals(id)) {
                    int len = (int) Math.min(size, all.length - (pos + 8));
                    w.pcm = new byte[len];
                    System.arraycopy(all, pos + 8, w.pcm, 0, len);
                    return w.sampleRate > 0 ? w : null;
                }
                pos += 8 + size + (size % 2);
            }
            return null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void writeWav(File out, byte[] pcm, int sampleRate, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        int bits = 16;
        int byteRate = sampleRate * channels * bits / 8;
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(out)) {
            fos.write("RIFF".getBytes("ASCII"));
            fos.write(le32(36 + pcm.length));
            fos.write("WAVE".getBytes("ASCII"));
            fos.write("fmt ".getBytes("ASCII"));
            fos.write(le32(16));
            fos.write(le16(1));
            fos.write(le16(channels));
            fos.write(le32(sampleRate));
            fos.write(le32(byteRate));
            fos.write(le16(channels * bits / 8));
            fos.write(le16(bits));
            fos.write("data".getBytes("ASCII"));
            fos.write(le32(pcm.length));
            fos.write(pcm);
        }
    }

    private static byte[] readAllBytes(FileInputStream in) throws Exception {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int n;
        while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) bos.write(buf, 0, n);
        return bos.toByteArray();
    }

    private static int u16(byte[] b, int off) {
        return (b[off] & 0xff) | ((b[off + 1] & 0xff) << 8);
    }

    private static long u32(byte[] b, int off) {
        return (b[off] & 0xffL) | ((b[off + 1] & 0xffL) << 8)
                | ((b[off + 2] & 0xffL) << 16) | ((b[off + 3] & 0xffL) << 24);
    }

    private static byte[] le16(int v) {
        return new byte[]{(byte) v, (byte) (v >> 8)};
    }

    private static byte[] le32(int v) {
        return new byte[]{(byte) v, (byte) (v >> 8), (byte) (v >> 16), (byte) (v >> 24)};
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TvMaze.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * TVmaze public API (https://api.tvmaze.com — free, no key): the catalog.
 * Parse functions take raw JSON text and are pure (JVM-testable); fetching
 * lives in the activities via Net. Nothing here invents metadata: fields
 * TVmaze leaves null stay empty.
 */
public final class TvMaze {

    private static final String BASE = "https://api.tvmaze.com";

    public static final class Show {
        public int id;
        public String name = "";
        public String language = "";
        public String status = "";
        // v0.11.1: TVmaze's own show type (Scripted, Reality,
        // Animation, Documentary, News, Sports, Panel Show, Talk
        // Show, Game Show, Variety, Award Show…). Empty when TVmaze
        // lists none — the catalogue facet reads it as "not listed".
        public String type = "";
        public String premiered = "";
        public String summaryText = "";
        public String imageMedium = "";
        public String imageOriginal = "";
        public double rating = -1;   // -1 = TVmaze has no rating for it
        public List<String> genres = new ArrayList<>();
        // v0.10.0: where the show comes from — network.country first,
        // webChannel.country when there is no broadcast network. Empty
        // when TVmaze lists neither (a web show with no country stated).
        public String countryName = "";
        public String countryCode = "";
    }

    /** One person (GET /search/people): the actor-search face. */
    public static final class Person {
        public int id;
        public String name = "";
        public String imageMedium = "";
        public String countryName = "";
    }

    /** One alternate name TVmaze knows for a show (GET /shows/{id}/akas). */
    public static final class Aka {
        public String name = "";
        public String countryName = "";
        public String countryCode = "";
    }

    public static final class Episode {
        public int id;
        public int season;
        public int number;
        public String name = "";
        public String airdate = "";
        public int runtime;          // minutes, 0 = unknown
        public String summaryText = "";
    }

    private TvMaze() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- URLs

    public static String showUrl(int id) { return BASE + "/shows/" + id; }

    public static String akasUrl(int id) { return BASE + "/shows/" + id + "/akas"; }

    public static String episodesUrl(int id) { return BASE + "/shows/" + id + "/episodes"; }

    public static String showsPageUrl(int page) { return BASE + "/shows?page=" + page; }

    public static String scheduleUrl(String country, String dateIso) {
        return BASE + "/schedule?country=" + country + "&date=" + dateIso;
    }

    public static String searchUrl(String query) {
        try {
            return BASE + "/search/shows?q=" + URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8");
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return BASE + "/search/shows?q=" + query;
        }
    }

    /** /search/people — actor search rides TVmaze live at query
     *  time (v0.11.1); cast lists are never baked for 90k shows. */
    public static String peopleSearchUrl(String query) {
        try {
            return BASE + "/search/people?q=" + URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8");
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
            return BASE + "/search/people?q=" + query;
        }
    }

    /** /people/{id}/castcredits with the shows embedded. */
    public static String castCreditsUrl(int personId) {
        return BASE + "/people/" + personId + "/castcredits?embed=show";
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- parse

    public static Show parseShow(String json) throws Exception {
        return showFrom(new JSONObject(json));
    }

    /** /shows?page=N — a bare array of show objects. */
    public static List<Show> parseShows(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Show> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            out.add(showFrom(arr.getJSONObject(i)));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** /search/shows — an array of {score, show}. */
    public static List<Show> parseSearch(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Show> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject hit = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            if (hit.has("show")) out.add(showFrom(hit.getJSONObject("show")));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** /schedule — episode objects carrying their show (top-level "show",
     *  older responses used _embedded.show; both are accepted). */
    public static List<Show> parseScheduleShows(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Show> out = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<Integer> seen = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject ep = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            JSONObject showObj = ep.optJSONObject("show");
            if (showObj == null) {
                JSONObject embedded = ep.optJSONObject("_embedded");
                if (embedded != null) showObj = embedded.optJSONObject("show");
            }
            if (showObj == null) continue;
            Show s = showFrom(showObj);
            if (seen.add(s.id)) out.add(s);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static List<Episode> parseEpisodes(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Episode> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            Episode e = new Episode();
            e.id = o.optInt("id");
            e.season = o.optInt("season");
            e.number = o.optInt("number");
            e.name = o.optString("name", "");
            e.airdate = o.optString("airdate", "");
            e.runtime = o.optInt("runtime", 0);
            e.summaryText = stripHtml(o.optString("summary", ""));
            out.add(e);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static Show showFrom(JSONObject o) {
        Show s = new Show();
        s.id = o.optInt("id");
        s.name = o.optString("name", "");
        s.language = o.optString("language", "");
        s.status = o.optString("status", "");
        s.type = o.optString("type", "");
        s.premiered = o.optString("premiered", "");
        s.summaryText = stripHtml(o.optString("summary", ""));
        JSONObject rating = o.optJSONObject("rating");
        if (rating != null && !rating.isNull("average")) {
            s.rating = rating.optDouble("average", -1);
        }
        JSONObject image = o.optJSONObject("image");
        if (image != null) {
            s.imageMedium = image.optString("medium", "");
            s.imageOriginal = image.optString("original", "");
        }
        JSONArray genres = o.optJSONArray("genres");
        if (genres != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < genres.length(); i++) {
                String g = genres.optString(i, "");
                if (!g.isEmpty()) s.genres.add(g);
            }
        }
        JSONObject[] holders = {o.optJSONObject("network"), o.optJSONObject("webChannel")};
        for (JSONObject h : holders) {
            if (h == null) continue;
            JSONObject c = h.optJSONObject("country");
            if (c != null) {
                s.countryName = c.optString("name", "");
                s.countryCode = c.optString("code", "");
                if (!s.countryName.isEmpty()) break;
            }
        }
        return s;
    }

    /** /shows/{id}/akas — [{name, country:{name, code} | null}]. */
    public static List<Aka> parseAkas(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Aka> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            Aka a = new Aka();
            a.name = o.optString("name", "");
            JSONObject c = o.optJSONObject("country");
            if (c != null) {
                a.countryName = c.optString("name", "");
                a.countryCode = c.optString("code", "");
            }
            if (!a.name.isEmpty()) out.add(a);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** /search/people — an array of {score, person}. */
    public static List<Person> parsePeople(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Person> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject hit = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            JSONObject p = hit.optJSONObject("person");
            if (p == null) continue;
            Person person = new Person();
            person.id = p.optInt("id");
            person.name = p.optString("name", "");
            JSONObject image = p.optJSONObject("image");
            if (image != null) person.imageMedium = image.optString("medium", "");
            JSONObject c = p.optJSONObject("country");
            if (c != null) person.countryName = c.optString("name", "");
            if (person.id > 0 && !person.name.isEmpty()) out.add(person);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** /people/{id}/castcredits?embed=show — credit rows carrying
     *  their show under _embedded.show. Deduped by show id (a person
     *  can hold several roles in one show), TVmaze's own order kept. */
    public static List<Show> parseCastCredits(String json) throws Exception {
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(json);
        List<Show> out = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<Integer> seen = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject credit = arr.getJSONObject(i);
            JSONObject embedded = credit.optJSONObject("_embedded");
            if (embedded == null) continue;
            JSONObject showObj = embedded.optJSONObject("show");
            if (showObj == null) continue;
            Show s = showFrom(showObj);
            if (s.id > 0 && seen.add(s.id)) out.add(s);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** TVmaze summaries are HTML fragments; the app shows plain text. */
    public static String stripHtml(String html) {
        if (html == null || html.isEmpty()) return "";
        String noTags = html.replaceAll("<[^>]*>", " ");
        return noTags
                .replace("&nbsp;", " ")
                .replace("&amp;", "&")
                .replace("&lt;", "<")
                .replace("&gt;", ">")
                .replace("&quot;", "\"")
                .replace("&#39;", "'")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/TvShare.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Screen-share to a TV (v0.7.0, James's order) — the pure half:
 * what can be shared, where the bytes come from, the watching
 * page, and the small network facts (IPv4 text, HTTP ranges).
 * The Android half (ShareCast: routes, server, sockets) reads
 * like a script off these decisions, and the harness pins every
 * branch here.
 *
 * The three honest routes, as evaluated for this build:
 *  1. FLING — Android's remote-playback protocol (MediaRouter).
 *     A TV/receiver that speaks it takes the stream URL (or the
 *     page-share server's media URL) and plays it itself.
 *  2. PAGE — an in-app web server on the same Wi-Fi hands any
 *     TV browser a self-contained watching page. Local files
 *     are served by the phone; network streams are handed to
 *     the TV directly (a redirect — the TV pulls the stream
 *     itself, so live stays live).
 *  3. MIRROR — the phone's own screen mirroring, handed off to
 *     the system Cast settings (ShareCast). The app cannot do
 *     Miracast itself; it walks the viewer to the door.
 *
 * Google Cast (Chromecast) is deliberately NOT here: its SDK
 * requires Google Play services and a registered receiver app,
 * neither of which this sideloaded, Play-services-free build
 * can assume. The NOTES say so in plain words.
 */
public final class TvShare {

    /** Where /media bytes come from for a playing item. */
    public enum Kind {
        /** A file on this phone (library file, exported recording). */
        FILE,
        /** A network stream: the TV fetches it itself (redirect). */
        REDIRECT,
        /** Nothing playable to hand over (exotic scheme). */
        PAGE_ONLY
    }

    public static final class Plan {
        public final Kind kind;
        public final String url;
        Plan(Kind k, String u) { kind = k; url = u; }
    }

    private TvShare() {}

    public static Plan planFor(String url) {
        if (url == null || url.isEmpty()) return new Plan(Kind.PAGE_ONLY, url);
        if (url.startsWith("file://") || url.startsWith("content://")
                || url.startsWith("/")) {
            return new Plan(Kind.FILE, url);
        }
        if (url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://")) {
            return new Plan(Kind.REDIRECT, url);
        }
        return new Plan(Kind.PAGE_ONLY, url);
    }

    /**
     * The URL a remote-playback route should play, or null when
     * flinging isn't possible for this plan right now: a network
     * stream flings as itself; a phone file flings as the page
     * server's media URL (so the server must be running — the
     * caller starts it and passes its base).
     */
    public static String flingUrlFor(Plan plan, String serverBase) {
        if (plan == null) return null;
        switch (plan.kind) {
            case REDIRECT: return plan.url;
            case FILE: return serverBase == null ? null
                    : serverBase + "/media";
            default: return null;
        }
    }

    /** The watching-page address to show the viewer, big. */
    public static String watchUrl(String ip, int port, String token) {
        return "http://" + ip + ":" + port + "/watch?k=" + token;
    }

    /** The media address under a running page server. */
    public static String mediaUrl(String ip, int port, String token) {
        return "http://" + ip + ":" + port + "/media?k=" + token;
    }

    /** A fresh page-server token: 16 hex chars, from the given rng. */
    public static String newToken(Random rng) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(16);
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            sb.append("0123456789abcdef".charAt(rng.nextInt(16)));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** WifiManager-style little-endian int -> "192.168.1.20". */
    public static String formatIpv4(int littleEndian) {
        return (littleEndian & 0xff) + "."
                + ((littleEndian >> 8) & 0xff) + "."
                + ((littleEndian >> 16) & 0xff) + "."
                + ((littleEndian >> 24) & 0xff);
    }

    /** Address-order bytes (NetworkInterface style) -> dotted text. */
    public static String formatIpv4(byte[] b) {
        if (b == null || b.length != 4) return null;
        return (b[0] & 0xff) + "." + (b[1] & 0xff) + "."
                + (b[2] & 0xff) + "." + (b[3] & 0xff);
    }

    public static boolean isLoopback(String ip) {
        return ip == null || ip.startsWith("127.") || ip.equals("0.0.0.0");
    }

    /** Content type for a media URL/name; octet-stream when unsure. */
    public static String mimeFor(String urlOrName) {
        if (urlOrName == null) return "application/octet-stream";
        String s = urlOrName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        int q = s.indexOf('?');
        if (q >= 0) s = s.substring(0, q);
        if (s.endsWith(".m3u8")) return "application/vnd.apple.mpegurl";
        if (s.endsWith(".mp4") || s.endsWith(".m4v")) return "video/mp4";
        if (s.endsWith(".mkv")) return "video/x-matroska";
        if (s.endsWith(".webm")) return "video/webm";
        if (s.endsWith(".ts")) return "video/mp2t";
        if (s.endsWith(".mov")) return "video/quicktime";
        if (s.endsWith(".mp3")) return "audio/mpeg";
        if (s.endsWith(".m4a")) return "audio/mp4";
        if (s.endsWith(".wav")) return "audio/wav";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }

    /**
     * Parse an HTTP Range header against a known length.
     * Returns {start, endInclusive}, or null when the header is
     * absent, malformed, or unsatisfiable (the caller then
     * answers 200 with the whole body, the forgiving default).
     */
    public static long[] parseRange(String header, long length) {
        if (header == null || length <= 0) return null;
        String h = header.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (!h.startsWith("bytes=")) return null;
        String spec = h.substring(6).trim();
        int dash = spec.indexOf('-');
        if (dash < 0 || spec.indexOf(',') >= 0) return null;
        try {
            String a = spec.substring(0, dash).trim();
            String b = spec.substring(dash + 1).trim();
            long start, end;
            if (a.isEmpty()) {           // suffix range: last N bytes
                long n = Long.parseLong(b);
                if (n <= 0) return null;
                start = Math.max(0, length - n);
                end = length - 1;
            } else {
                start = Long.parseLong(a);
                end = b.isEmpty() ? length - 1 : Long.parseLong(b);
            }
            if (start < 0 || start >= length || end < start) return null;
            if (end >= length) end = length - 1;
            return new long[]{start, end};
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static String esc(String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        return s.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;")
                .replace(">", "&gt;").replace("\"", "&quot;");
    }

    /**
     * The self-contained watching page (James's compression
     * insight, put to work: the page carries its own player —
     * any browser that opens it is the projector). mediaPath is
     * the same-origin media address ("/media?k=…"), so the page
     * never holds a raw stream URL it shouldn't.
     */
    public static String playerPage(String title, String mediaPath,
                                    boolean playable) {
        String t = esc(title == null || title.isEmpty() ? "Sandy" : title);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\">");
        sb.append("<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,"
                + "initial-scale=1\">");
        sb.append("<title>").append(t).append(" — Sandy</title>");
        sb.append("<style>body{background:#101014;color:#fff;"
                + "font-family:sans-serif;margin:0;padding:24px;"
                + "text-align:center}h1{font-size:28px;font-weight:normal}"
                + "video{width:100%;max-width:1100px;background:#000}"
                + "p{color:#b9b9c4;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5}"
                + "</style></head><body>");
        sb.append("<h1>").append(t).append("</h1>");
        if (playable) {
            sb.append("<video controls autoplay playsinline src=\"")
                    .append(esc(mediaPath)).append("\"></video>");
            sb.append("<p>This TV is watching through Sandy, on the "
                    + "phone that shared this page. If the picture "
                    + "stalls, check that the TV and the phone are on "
                    + "the same Wi-Fi.</p>");
        } else {
            sb.append("<p>Sandy can show this page, but this title "
                    + "isn't a kind the TV can play from here. Try "
                    + "sharing a recording or a video file from the "
                    + "phone instead.</p>");
        }
        sb.append("</body></html>");
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/UiStrings.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Sandy's UI string tables (v0.5.0, Delwin #4 + James's in-vs-shelf
 * ruling: the major languages are baked IN, because a first-time user
 * who can't switch away from English won't stay).
 *
 * One table per language, positional against KEYS. These tables carry
 * the app's chrome — tab names, buttons, hints, player controls, the
 * settings labels, the recordings/language screens. Long explanatory
 * paragraphs (e.g. the Settings essays) are NOT in the tables in this
 * version and stay English; the NOTES say so plainly.
 *
 * Translations are machine-quality (written by Muse, not reviewed
 * by native speakers) — also stated in the NOTES. The tables are the
 * extension point for the pack slot: a language pack (LangPack) must
 * provide exactly these keys, and an installed pack's strings win
 * over the baked table for its language.
 *
 * Pure data + lookups (no Android imports) so the harness can verify
 * every table is complete against KEYS.
 */
public final class UiStrings {

    public static final String[] KEYS = {
            "home_catalog", "home_my_shows", "home_live_tv", "home_settings",
            "home_refresh", "home_search_shows_hint", "home_search_btn",

            "share_unavailable", "lib_books_btn", "books_title", "books_empty", "books_add_folder", "books_add_file", "books_rescan", "reader_pick_up", "reader_start_over", "reader_finished", "reader_play", "reader_pause", "reader_back", "reader_forward", "reader_speed", "reader_voice", "reader_read_in_english",  "lib_videos_btn", "files_title", "wall_available", "wall_catalog_only",

    ,
            "facet_genre",

    /** UI language code -> the iptv-org language-facet group name. */
    public static String facetFor(String code) {
        switch (code == null ? "" : code) {
            case "es": return "Spanish";
            case "fr": return "French";
            case "de": return "German";
            case "pt": return "Portuguese";
            case "it": return "Italian";
            case "ru": return "Russian";
            case "ar": return "Arabic";
            case "hi": return "Hindi";
            case "zh": return "Chinese";
            case "ja": return "Japanese";
            case "ko": return "Korean";
            case "fa": return "Persian";
            default: return "English";
        }
    }

ساخته‌شده", "ساخته‌شده از", "قفسهٔ قصه برای پر شدن به شبکه نیاز دارد", "روی صفحه بخوان", "تعریفش کن", "پروژهٔ گوتنبرگ — کتاب‌های رایگان مالکیت عمومی، در کتابخانه خوانده می‌شود", "کتابخانهٔ باز — فهرستی که در یافتن ویرایش‌ها کمکش می‌کند", "LibriVox — کتاب‌های صوتی رایگان مالکیت عمومی، خوانده‌شده توسط داوطلبان"});
    }

    private UiStrings() {}

    public static int keyIndex(String key) {
        for (int i = 0; i < KEYS.length; i++) {
            if (KEYS[i].equals(key)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /** Built-in table lookup: language -> English -> the key itself. */
    public static String lookup(String code, String key) {
        int idx = keyIndex(key);
        if (idx < 0) return key;
        String[] t = code == null ? null : TABLES.get(code);
        if (t != null && idx < t.length && t[idx] != null && !t[idx].isEmpty()) {
            return t[idx];
        }
        String[] en = TABLES.get("en");
        return en != null && idx < en.length ? en[idx] : key;
    }

    /** Every baked table complete against KEYS (harness-checked). */
    public static boolean tablesComplete() {
        for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> e : TABLES.entrySet()) {
            if (e.getValue().length != KEYS.length) return false;
            for (String v : e.getValue()) {
                if (v == null || v.isEmpty()) return false;
            }
        }
        return TABLES.size() == LANGUAGES.length;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/UnitMerge.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Fragment -> sentence-unit merge (v0.6.0). A faithful port of the
 * lab recipe's merge (work/dub-lab: lab_common.merge_units, copied
 * from cook_driver.py), so app-cooked units are shaped exactly like
 * the units the cook-rate and phone-bench numbers were measured on:
 *
 *   close the current unit when it ends a sentence (。！？…) and
 *   has run at least 3 s, or when the span would exceed ~12 s, or
 *   when the gap to the next fragment exceeds 2 s.
 *
 * Guard-flagged fragments mark their unit: uncertainty survives the
 * merge and is shown, never averaged away.
 *
 * Pure logic; the harness checks it against the bench's real
 * segment files and the bench's own merged unit counts.
 */
public final class UnitMerge {

    public static final class Unit {
        public double start, end;
        public String srcText = "";
        /** Any fragment in this unit was guard-flagged. */
        public boolean flagged = false;
        /** Diarization speaker key; "" until a diarizer names one. */
        public String speaker = "";
        public double duration() { return Math.max(0.0, end - start); }
    }

    private static final String SENT_END = "。！？…";

    private UnitMerge() {}

    public static List<Unit> merge(List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> segs,
                                   HallucinationGuard.Result guard) {
        List<Unit> units = new ArrayList<>();
        Unit cur = null;
        boolean curFlagged = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < segs.size(); i++) {
            HallucinationGuard.Segment s = segs.get(i);
            boolean fl = guard != null && guard.isFlagged(i);
            if (cur == null) {
                cur = new Unit();
                cur.start = s.start; cur.end = s.end; cur.srcText = s.text;
                curFlagged = fl;
                continue;
            }
            double span = s.end - cur.start;
            double gap = s.start - cur.end;
            String trimmed = cur.srcText == null ? "" : cur.srcText.replaceAll("\\s+$", "");
            boolean endsSentence = !trimmed.isEmpty()
                    && SENT_END.indexOf(trimmed.charAt(trimmed.length() - 1)) >= 0;
            if ((endsSentence && (cur.end - cur.start) >= 3.0) || span > 12.0 || gap > 2.0) {
                cur.flagged = curFlagged;
                units.add(cur);
                cur = new Unit();
                cur.start = s.start; cur.end = s.end; cur.srcText = s.text;
                curFlagged = fl;
            } else {
                cur.end = s.end;
                cur.srcText += s.text;
                curFlagged = curFlagged || fl;
            }
        }
        if (cur != null) {
            cur.flagged = curFlagged;
            units.add(cur);
        }
        return units;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VerifyPriority.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Where the re-verification budget walks first (v0.14.0 Addendum
 * 10(5)). Background re-checks are finite — a phone, a pipe, a
 * battery — so they are spent where people actually walk, in
 * this order:
 *
 *   1. KEPT PLACES — what someone is in the middle of;
 *   2. FAVORITES — the household's chosen shelves;
 *   3. RECENTLY WATCHED — still warm from the last visit;
 *   4. THE WIDER SHELVES — everything else, stalest first.
 *
 * Inside a class, the stalest verdict goes first. REALISM CAP,
 * stated plainly: the whole ocean is NOT re-probed; the queue is
 * bounded per run, and a link nobody walks near may sit unchecked
 * until someone walks near it — at which point its card shows the
 * honest "still checking" face until the check lands.
 */
public final class VerifyPriority {

    private VerifyPriority() {}

    public static final int CAT_KEPT = 0;
    public static final int CAT_FAVORITE = 1;
    public static final int CAT_RECENT = 2;
    public static final int CAT_SHELF = 3;

    public static int category(boolean kept, boolean favorite, boolean recent) {
        if (kept) return CAT_KEPT;
        if (favorite) return CAT_FAVORITE;
        if (recent) return CAT_RECENT;
        return CAT_SHELF;
    }

    public static final class Entry {
        public final String url, userAgent;
        public final int category;
        /** When the standing verdict was taken; 0 = never checked. */
        public final long checkedAt;

        public Entry(String url, String userAgent, int category, long checkedAt) {
            this.url = url; this.userAgent = userAgent;
            this.category = category; this.checkedAt = checkedAt;
        }
    }

    /** Category first; inside a class, a standing verdict going
     *  stale outranks a first look (checkedAt 0 = never checked
     *  walks last in its class), then stalest first. Capped. */
    public static List<Entry> order(List<Entry> in, int cap) {
        List<Entry> out = new ArrayList<>(in);
        out.sort((a, b) -> {
            if (a.category != b.category) {
                return Integer.compare(a.category, b.category);
            }
            boolean aNew = a.checkedAt == 0, bNew = b.checkedAt == 0;
            if (aNew != bNew) return aNew ? 1 : -1;
            return Long.compare(a.checkedAt, b.checkedAt);
        });
        if (cap > 0 && out.size() > cap) {
            return new ArrayList<>(out.subList(0, cap));
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VodActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.BaseAdapter;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Movies & VOD that already live inside the loaded playlists: entries on
 * Movies/Series/VOD shelves. Movies open the source picker (the entry
 * itself plus any archive matches); series episodes are grouped by show
 * and ordered by their parsed season/episode numbers.
 *
 * v0.3.0: health badges on every row (from the persisted probe record),
 * a "Working links only" toggle (hides only probe-proven dead links),
 * and a probe before a series episode plays directly — a dead tap is
 * marked ✗ and explained instead of handed to the player.
 */
public class VodActivity extends Activity {

    private static final Pattern MARKER =
            Pattern.compile("(?i)S\\d{1,2}[\\s._\\-]*E\\d{1,3}|\\b\\d{1,2}x\\d{1,3}\\b");

    /** Rows: String = section header, Channel = entry. */
    private final List<Object> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<M3uParser.Channel> rowChannels = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<M3uParser.Channel> allVod = new ArrayList<>();
    private final ExecutorService tapExec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private TextView sub;
    private CheckBox workingOnlyBox;
    private BaseAdapter adapter;
    private boolean probing = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12));

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText("Movies & VOD — from your playlists");
        title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        title.setTextSize(19);
        title.setTypeface(title.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        root.addView(title);

        sub = new TextView(this);
        sub.setTextColor(Color.rgb(170, 170, 180));
        sub.setTextSize(12);
        root.addView(sub);

        workingOnlyBox = new CheckBox(this);
        workingOnlyBox.setText("Working links only (hide proven-dead)");
        workingOnlyBox.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 210));
        workingOnlyBox.setChecked(ChannelStore.getWorkingFirst(this));
        workingOnlyBox.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, checked) -> {
            ChannelStore.setWorkingFirst(this, checked);
            buildRows();
        });
        root.addView(workingOnlyBox);

        ListView list = new ListView(this);
        list.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 20));
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));
        setContentView(root);

        List<M3uParser.Channel> channels = ChannelStore.loadCache(this);
        if (channels == null) {
            sub.setText("The channel guide hasn't been loaded yet — open Live TV once "
                    + "and this shelf fills from your playlists.");
            workingOnlyBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : channels) {
            if (SourceFinder.isVodEntry(c)) allVod.add(c);
        }

        adapter = new BaseAdapter() {
            @Override public int getCount() { return rows.size(); }
            @Override public Object getItem(int pos) { return rows.get(pos); }
            @Override public long getItemId(int pos) { return pos; }
            @Override public boolean isEnabled(int pos) {
                return rows.get(pos) instanceof M3uParser.Channel;
            }
            @Override public int getViewTypeCount() { return 2; }
            @Override public int getItemViewType(int pos) {
                return rows.get(pos) instanceof String ? 0 : 1;
            }
            @Override
            public View getView(int pos, View convertView, ViewGroup parent) {
                Object row = rows.get(pos);
                if (row instanceof String) {
                    TextView tv = convertView instanceof TextView
                            ? (TextView) convertView : new TextView(VodActivity.this);
                    tv.setText((String) row);
                    tv.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
                    tv.setTextSize(14);
                    tv.setTypeface(tv.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
                    tv.setPadding(dp(6), dp(12), dp(6), dp(4));
                    tv.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(24, 24, 30));
                    return tv;
                }
                M3uParser.Channel c = (M3uParser.Channel) row;
                LinearLayout ll;
                TextView main, subT;
                if (convertView instanceof LinearLayout) {
                    ll = (LinearLayout) convertView;
                    main = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(0);
                    subT = (TextView) ll.getChildAt(1);
                } else {
                    ll = new LinearLayout(VodActivity.this);
                    ll.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                    ll.setPadding(dp(8), dp(8), dp(8), dp(8));
                    main = new TextView(VodActivity.this);
                    main.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                    main.setTextSize(15);
                    subT = new TextView(VodActivity.this);
                    subT.setTextColor(Color.rgb(150, 150, 160));
                    subT.setTextSize(12);
                    ll.addView(main);
                    ll.addView(subT);
                }
                HealthStore.Health vh = HealthStore.get(VodActivity.this, c.url);
                main.setText(HealthStore.badgeSymbol(vh) + c.displayName());
                ll.setContentDescription(c.displayName());
                subT.setText((vh == null ? "? Not checked yet"
                        : HealthStore.badgeText(vh, System.currentTimeMillis())) + "  ·  "
                        + c.group + "  ·  " + c.source + "  ·  "
                        + EpisodeKey.qualityLabel(c.name + " " + c.url));
                return ll;
            }
        };
        list.setAdapter(adapter);

        list.setOnItemClickListener((p, v, pos, id) -> {
            M3uParser.Channel c = rowChannels.get(pos);
            if (c == null) return;
            if (EpisodeKey.parse(c.name) != null) {
                playDirect(c);
            } else {
                Intent i = new Intent(this, SourcesActivity.class);
                i.putExtra("mode", "movie");
                i.putExtra("movieTitle", SourceFinder.cleanTitleForSearch(c.name));
                i.putExtra("directUrl", c.url);
                i.putExtra("directName", c.name);
                i.putExtra("directUa", c.userAgent);
                startActivity(i);
            }
        });

        buildRows();
    }

    /** (Re)build the grouped rows from allVod, honoring the health toggle. */
    private void buildRows() {
        boolean workingOnly = workingOnlyBox != null && workingOnlyBox.isChecked();
        rows.clear();
        rowChannels.clear();

        List<M3uParser.Channel> movies = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<String, List<M3uParser.Channel>> series = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        int hiddenDead = 0;
        for (M3uParser.Channel c : allVod) {
            if (workingOnly) {
                HealthStore.Health h = HealthStore.get(this, c.url);
                if (h != null && h.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_DEAD) {
                    hiddenDead++;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            EpisodeKey key = EpisodeKey.parse(c.name);
            if (key == null) {
                movies.add(c);
            } else {
                String showTitle = showTitleOf(c.name);
                series.computeIfAbsent(showTitle, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(c);
            }
        }
        // Mom-first order for the flat movie list (v0.4.0): plays first,
        // connects-only and dead sink. Series keep S/E order — an
        // episode list out of order would be its own kind of broken.
        Collections.sort(movies, (a, b) -> {
            int ra = HealthStore.surfRank(HealthStore.get(this, a.url));
            int rb = HealthStore.surfRank(HealthStore.get(this, b.url));
            if (ra != rb) return Integer.compare(ra, rb);
            return a.name.compareToIgnoreCase(b.name);
        });

        int episodeTotal = 0;
        List<String> showNames = new ArrayList<>(series.keySet());
        Collections.sort(showNames, String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER);
        for (String sn : showNames) {
            List<M3uParser.Channel> eps = series.get(sn);
            Collections.sort(eps, (a, b) -> {
                EpisodeKey ka = EpisodeKey.parse(a.name);
                EpisodeKey kb = EpisodeKey.parse(b.name);
                int sa = ka == null ? 0 : ka.season, sb = kb == null ? 0 : kb.season;
                if (sa != sb) return sa - sb;
                int ea = ka == null ? 0 : ka.episode, eb = kb == null ? 0 : kb.episode;
                if (ea != eb) return ea - eb;
                return a.name.compareToIgnoreCase(b.name);
            });
            episodeTotal += eps.size();
            rows.add("SERIES — " + sn + "  (" + eps.size() + ")");
            rowChannels.add(null);
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : eps) {
                rows.add(c);
                rowChannels.add(c);
            }
        }
        if (!movies.isEmpty()) {
            rows.add("MOVIES  (" + movies.size() + ")");
            rowChannels.add(null);
            for (M3uParser.Channel c : movies) {
                rows.add(c);
                rowChannels.add(c);
            }
        }

        sub.setText(movies.size() + " movies · " + showNames.size() + " series · "
                + episodeTotal + " episodes found on your playlists' on-demand shelves. "
                + (workingOnly && hiddenDead > 0 ? hiddenDead + " dead hidden. " : "")
                + "The built-in directory is mostly live channels — this shelf grows "
                + "with playlists that carry VOD sections.");
        if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    /**
     * A series entry on a playlist is already a source — but probe it
     * before playing (v0.3.0): the player opens only when it answers.
     */
    private void playDirect(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        if (!LinkHealth.isRemote(c.url)) {
            launchDirect(c);
            return;
        }
        if (probing) return;
        probing = true;
        Toast.makeText(this, "Checking " + c.name + "…", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        tapExec.execute(() -> {
            LinkHealth.Result r = LinkHealth.probe(c.url, c.userAgent, 6000);
            HealthStore.record(this, c.url, r);
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                probing = false;
                if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
                if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_PLAYS) {
                    launchDirect(c);
                } else if (r.tier == LinkHealth.TIER_CONNECTS) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "That link answers, but its video is "
                            + "unproven — trying it.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    launchDirect(c);
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "That link is dead (" + r.detail + ") — marked ✗",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void launchDirect(M3uParser.Channel c) {
        List<M3uParser.Channel> queue = new ArrayList<>();
        queue.add(c);
        ChannelStore.playQueue = queue;
        ChannelStore.playIndex = 0;
        Intent i = new Intent(this, PlayerActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("url", c.url);
        i.putExtra("name", c.name);
        i.putExtra("ua", c.userAgent);
        i.putExtra("ckey", ChannelStore.titleKey(c.name));
        startActivity(i);
    }

    /** "Show Name S01E02 …" -> "Show Name" (marker and everything after it dropped). */
    static String showTitleOf(String entryName) {
        Matcher m = MARKER.matcher(entryName);
        if (m.find()) {
            String head = entryName.substring(0, m.start()).trim();
            head = head.replaceAll("[\\s._\\-]+$", "").trim();
            if (!head.isEmpty()) return head;
        }
        return entryName;
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VoiceBook.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The voice book (v0.6.0) — Delwin's spec: a character's voice is
 * SAVED ("it's just a string of code") so the same character keeps
 * the same voice episode to episode, season to season.
 *
 * One book per show. Each discovered speaker becomes a cast entry:
 *   - speakerKey   the diarizer's cluster label (e.g. SPEAKER_00)
 *   - voiceprint   the centroid embedding of the ORIGINAL voice
 *   - ttsVoice     the Android TTS voice assigned to the character
 *                  ("" = not assigned yet; the renderer falls back
 *                  to a numbered voice slot with its own pitch)
 *   - pitch, rate  the casting's sound
 *   - name         a human name for the character, when known
 *   - nearMatch    set when an assignment was a near call — flagged
 *                  for a human, never silently swapped (Delwin's
 *                  stated limits, built in)
 *
 * Matching is cosine similarity against the saved voiceprints:
 *   >= 0.82  the same speaker — reuse their voice
 *   0.70–0.82 near — assign NOTHING automatically; the entry is
 *             flagged and a human decides
 *   <  0.70  a new character — a new entry, a new voice
 * A recast actor (a genuinely different voice for an old role) lands
 * in NEW, which is the honest outcome: the book forks, it does not
 * force the old voice onto a new person.
 *
 * Pure logic + org.json; the harness drives the matching math with
 * synthetic voiceprints and round-trips the persistence format.
 */
public final class VoiceBook {

    public static final double MATCH_MIN = 0.82;
    public static final double NEAR_MIN = 0.70;

    public static final class CastEntry {
        public String speakerKey = "";
        public String name = "";
        public String ttsVoice = "";
        public double pitch = 1.0;
        public double rate = 1.0;
        public float[] voiceprint = new float[0];
        public boolean nearMatch = false;
        /** Display label before a name is known: "Voice 1", "Voice 2"… */
        public String label = "";
        /** Season this casting belongs to; 0 = the whole series.
         *  Profiles are scoped per show AND per season (James's
         *  rule): the series-wide entry is the character's voice
         *  everywhere; a season entry exists when that season's
         *  casting genuinely forked (a recast), and it governs
         *  only its own season — history is never rewritten. */
        public int season = 0;
    }

    public static final class Book {
        public String showKey = "";
        public String showTitle = "";
        public final List<CastEntry> cast = new ArrayList<>();
        /** This book's match calibration. Cosine scales are a
         *  property of the embedding model that made the prints,
         *  not a universal constant: books fed by the diarization
         *  pack carry the pack's measured numbers (written by the
         *  dub cook); books without a model keep the classic
         *  conservative defaults. */
        public double matchMin = MATCH_MIN;
        public double nearMin = NEAR_MIN;
    }

    public enum MatchKind { MATCH, NEAR, NEW }

    public static final class Match {
        public MatchKind kind;
        public CastEntry entry;   // null when kind == NEW
        public double score;
    }

    private VoiceBook() {}

    public static double cosine(float[] a, float[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || a.length == 0 || a.length != b.length) return 0;
        double dot = 0, na = 0, nb = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            dot += a[i] * b[i];
            na += a[i] * (double) a[i];
            nb += b[i] * (double) b[i];
        }
        if (na <= 0 || nb <= 0) return 0;
        return dot / (Math.sqrt(na) * Math.sqrt(nb));
    }

    /** Match a freshly heard speaker centroid against the book. */
    public static Match match(Book book, float[] centroid) {
        return match(book, centroid, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Season-aware match: the candidate pool is the series-wide
     * entries plus this season's own — a voice cast for season 2
     * never answers for season 1, and the series voice answers
     * everywhere it hasn't honestly forked.
     */
    public static Match match(Book book, float[] centroid, int season) {
        Match m = new Match();
        m.kind = MatchKind.NEW;
        m.score = 0;
        if (book == null || centroid == null || centroid.length == 0) return m;
        CastEntry best = null;
        double bestScore = -1;
        for (CastEntry e : book.cast) {
            if (e.season != 0 && e.season != season) continue;
            if (e.voiceprint == null || e.voiceprint.length != centroid.length) continue;
            double s = cosine(centroid, e.voiceprint);
            if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = e; }
        }
        if (best == null) return m;
        m.score = bestScore;
        if (bestScore >= book.matchMin) { m.kind = MatchKind.MATCH; m.entry = best; }
        else if (bestScore >= book.nearMin) { m.kind = MatchKind.NEAR; m.entry = best; }
        return m;
    }

    /** Enroll a speaker as a new cast entry (auto label "Voice N"). */
    public static CastEntry enroll(Book book, String speakerKey, float[] centroid) {
        return enroll(book, speakerKey, centroid, 0);
    }

    /** Enroll, scoped to a season (0 = the whole series). */
    public static CastEntry enroll(Book book, String speakerKey,
                                   float[] centroid, int season) {
        CastEntry e = new CastEntry();
        e.speakerKey = speakerKey == null ? "" : speakerKey;
        e.label = "Voice " + (book.cast.size() + 1);
        e.season = season;
        if (centroid != null) e.voiceprint = centroid.clone();
        book.cast.add(e);
        return e;
    }

    /**
     * Fold a confirmed re-hearing into a saved voiceprint (running
     * average) so the print tracks the actor, not one loud scene.
     * Only ever called on a MATCH — never on a NEAR.
     */
    public static void foldVoiceprint(CastEntry e, float[] centroid, double alpha) {
        if (e == null || centroid == null || e.voiceprint.length != centroid.length) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < centroid.length; i++) {
            e.voiceprint[i] = (float) (e.voiceprint[i] * (1 - alpha) + centroid[i] * alpha);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ JSON

    public static String toJson(Book b) throws Exception {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
        o.put("showKey", b.showKey);
        o.put("showTitle", b.showTitle);
        o.put("matchMin", b.matchMin);
        o.put("nearMin", b.nearMin);
        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
        for (CastEntry e : b.cast) {
            JSONObject eo = new JSONObject();
            eo.put("speakerKey", e.speakerKey);
            eo.put("name", e.name);
            eo.put("label", e.label);
            eo.put("ttsVoice", e.ttsVoice);
            eo.put("pitch", e.pitch);
            eo.put("rate", e.rate);
            eo.put("nearMatch", e.nearMatch);
            eo.put("season", e.season);
            JSONArray vp = new JSONArray();
            for (float f : e.voiceprint) vp.put((double) f);
            eo.put("voiceprint", vp);
            arr.put(eo);
        }
        o.put("cast", arr);
        return o.toString();
    }

    public static Book fromJson(String text) throws Exception {
        Book b = new Book();
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject(text);
        b.showKey = o.optString("showKey", "");
        b.showTitle = o.optString("showTitle", "");
        b.matchMin = o.optDouble("matchMin", MATCH_MIN);
        b.nearMin = o.optDouble("nearMin", NEAR_MIN);
        JSONArray arr = o.optJSONArray("cast");
        if (arr != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject eo = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                CastEntry e = new CastEntry();
                e.speakerKey = eo.optString("speakerKey", "");
                e.name = eo.optString("name", "");
                e.label = eo.optString("label", "");
                e.ttsVoice = eo.optString("ttsVoice", "");
                e.pitch = eo.optDouble("pitch", 1.0);
                e.rate = eo.optDouble("rate", 1.0);
                e.nearMatch = eo.optBoolean("nearMatch", false);
                e.season = eo.optInt("season", 0);
                JSONArray vp = eo.optJSONArray("voiceprint");
                if (vp != null) {
                    e.voiceprint = new float[vp.length()];
                    for (int j = 0; j < vp.length(); j++) {
                        e.voiceprint[j] = (float) vp.optDouble(j, 0);
                    }
                }
                b.cast.add(e);
            }
        }
        return b;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VoiceBookActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * The voice book screen (v0.6.0) — Delwin's casting desk.
 *
 * Every show that has a book is listed; inside a book, each cast
 * entry can be named (the character), assigned one of the phone's
 * own speech voices, and given a pitch. Assignments persist in the
 * book itself (VoiceBookStore) — set once, by a person, and every
 * later episode of that show casts from it.
 *
 * Honest edges, by design: entries appear when a voiced dub is made
 * for a show. This build does not diarize (no reliable on-device
 * diarizer exists in this build environment), so new books open
 * with a single narrator entry — per-character entries arrive with
 * cooked records that carry speakers, and near-match flags from the
 * matcher are shown, never silently resolved.
 */
public class VoiceBookActivity extends Activity {

    private LinearLayout root;
    private List<String> deviceVoices = new ArrayList<>();
    private VoiceBook.Book openBook;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(16, 16, 22));
        root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setPadding(dp(20), dp(16), dp(20), dp(24));
        scroll.addView(root);
        setContentView(scroll);
        TtsDubRenderer.availableVoiceNames(this, names -> {
            deviceVoices = names;
            if (openBook != null) showBook(openBook);
        });
        showList();
    }

    private void showList() {
        openBook = null;
        root.removeAllViews();
        root.addView(title(LangStore.tr(this, "vb_title")));
        List<VoiceBook.Book> books = VoiceBookStore.listAll(this);
        if (books.isEmpty()) {
            root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "vb_empty")));
            return;
        }
        for (VoiceBook.Book b : books) {
            Button btn = new Button(this);
            String name = b.showTitle != null && !b.showTitle.isEmpty()
                    ? b.showTitle : b.showKey;
            btn.setText(name + "  (" + b.cast.size() + ")");
            btn.setContentDescription(name);
            btn.setOnClickListener(v -> showBook(b));
            root.addView(btn);
        }
    }

    private void showBook(VoiceBook.Book book) {
        openBook = book;
        root.removeAllViews();
        Button back = new Button(this);
        back.setText("← " + LangStore.tr(this, "vb_title"));
        back.setOnClickListener(v -> showList());
        root.addView(back);
        String name = book.showTitle != null && !book.showTitle.isEmpty()
                ? book.showTitle : book.showKey;
        root.addView(title(name));
        if (book.cast.isEmpty()) {
            root.addView(body(LangStore.tr(this, "vb_empty")));
            return;
        }
        for (VoiceBook.CastEntry e : book.cast) {
            root.addView(castCard(book, e));
        }
        Button add = new Button(this);
        add.setText("+ Add a cast entry");
        add.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            VoiceBook.enroll(book, "", null);
            VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
            showBook(book);
        });
        root.addView(add);
    }

    private LinearLayout castCard(VoiceBook.Book book, VoiceBook.CastEntry e) {
        LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
        card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        card.setPadding(0, dp(10), 0, dp(6));

        TextView head = new TextView(this);
        String who = e.name != null && !e.name.isEmpty() ? e.name
                : (e.label != null && !e.label.isEmpty() ? e.label : "Voice");
        head.setText(who + (e.season > 0 ? "  · Season " + e.season : "")
                + (e.nearMatch
                ? "  ⚠ near match — a person should confirm this voice" : ""));
        head.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 200, 90));
        head.setTextSize(16);
        head.setTypeface(head.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        card.addView(head);

        EditText nameField = new EditText(this);
        nameField.setHint("Character name");
        nameField.setText(e.name == null ? "" : e.name);
        nameField.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        nameField.setHintTextColor(Color.rgb(120, 120, 130));
        nameField.setSingleLine(true);
        card.addView(nameField);
        Button saveName = new Button(this);
        saveName.setText("Save name");
        saveName.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            e.name = nameField.getText().toString().trim();
            VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
            Toast.makeText(this, "Saved.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            showBook(book);
        });
        card.addView(saveName);

        Button voiceBtn = new Button(this);
        voiceBtn.setText("Voice: " + (e.ttsVoice == null || e.ttsVoice.isEmpty()
                ? "(the phone's default)" : e.ttsVoice));
        voiceBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> pickVoice(book, e));
        card.addView(voiceBtn);

        LinearLayout pitchRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        pitchRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        pitchRow.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        TextView pitchLabel = new TextView(this);
        pitchLabel.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "Pitch %.1f  ", e.pitch));
        pitchLabel.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        pitchLabel.setTextSize(15);
        pitchRow.addView(pitchLabel);
        Button minus = new Button(this);
        minus.setText("−");
        minus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            e.pitch = Math.max(0.5, Math.round((e.pitch - 0.1) * 10) / 10.0);
            VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
            showBook(book);
        });
        pitchRow.addView(minus);
        Button plus = new Button(this);
        plus.setText("+");
        plus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            e.pitch = Math.min(2.0, Math.round((e.pitch + 0.1) * 10) / 10.0);
            VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
            showBook(book);
        });
        pitchRow.addView(plus);
        card.addView(pitchRow);
        return card;
    }

    private void pickVoice(VoiceBook.Book book, VoiceBook.CastEntry e) {
        if (deviceVoices.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "This phone's speech engine listed no "
                    + "voices to choose from.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>();
        labels.add("(the phone's default)");
        labels.addAll(deviceVoices);
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Voice for " + (e.name != null && !e.name.isEmpty()
                        ? e.name : e.label))
                .setItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]), (d, which) -> {
                    e.ttsVoice = which == 0 ? "" : deviceVoices.get(which - 1);
                    VoiceBookStore.save(this, book);
                    showBook(book);
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private TextView title(String text) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(text);
        t.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        t.setTextSize(22);
        t.setTypeface(t.getTypeface(), Typeface.BOLD);
        t.setPadding(0, 0, 0, dp(10));
        return t;
    }

    private TextView body(String text) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this);
        t.setText(text);
        t.setTextColor(Color.rgb(200, 200, 208));
        t.setTextSize(14);
        t.setPadding(0, 0, 0, dp(6));
        return t;
    }

    private int dp(int v) {
        return (int) (v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VoiceBookStore.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Voice-book persistence (v0.6.0; v0.12.0: moved under the memory
 * hook): one JSON file per show under files/memory/voicebook/, so
 * a show's cast survives episodes, seasons and app updates — the
 * cast catalog lives where the dub work happens, as files, behind
 * the one hook (James's file rule; the 0.11.0 convergence).
 *
 * Books written before 0.12.0 live in filesDir/voicebooks/; they
 * migrate forward the first time the store is touched (copied,
 * never moved — the old file stays until it is read from its new
 * home, and every later read/write uses the hook).
 */
public final class VoiceBookStore {

    private VoiceBookStore() {}

    private static File dir(Context ctx) {
        File d = new File(MemoryHook.root(ctx), "voicebook");
        if (!d.isDirectory()) d.mkdirs();
        migrate(ctx, d);
        return d;
    }

    private static File legacyDir(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), "voicebooks");
    }

    /** One-time copy of any pre-hook books into the hook root. */
    private static void migrate(Context ctx, File dir) {
        File legacy = legacyDir(ctx);
        if (!legacy.isDirectory()) return;
        File[] files = legacy.listFiles((d, n) -> n.endsWith(".json"));
        if (files == null) return;
        for (File f : files) {
            File dest = new File(dir, f.getName());
            if (dest.isFile()) continue;
            try {
                java.nio.file.Files.copy(f.toPath(), dest.toPath());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private static File fileFor(Context ctx, String showKey) {
        String safe = showKey == null ? "show" : showKey.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_");
        if (safe.isEmpty()) safe = "show";
        return new File(dir(ctx), safe + ".json");
    }

    public static VoiceBook.Book load(Context ctx, String showKey) {
        File f = fileFor(ctx, showKey);
        if (!f.isFile()) {
            VoiceBook.Book b = new VoiceBook.Book();
            b.showKey = showKey == null ? "" : showKey;
            return b;
        }
        try {
            return VoiceBook.fromJson(new String(EnginePackStore.readAll(f), "UTF-8"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            VoiceBook.Book b = new VoiceBook.Book();
            b.showKey = showKey == null ? "" : showKey;
            return b;
        }
    }

    public static void save(Context ctx, VoiceBook.Book book) {
        if (book == null) return;
        try {
            File f = fileFor(ctx, book.showKey);
            FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(f);
            fos.write(VoiceBook.toJson(book).getBytes("UTF-8"));
            fos.close();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Every book on the phone (headers + cast), for the casting UI. */
    public static List<VoiceBook.Book> listAll(Context ctx) {
        List<VoiceBook.Book> out = new ArrayList<>();
        File[] files = dir(ctx).listFiles((d, n) -> n.endsWith(".json"));
        if (files == null) return out;
        for (File f : files) {
            try {
                out.add(VoiceBook.fromJson(new String(
                        EnginePackStore.readAll(f), "UTF-8")));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return out;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VoiceCoverageActivity.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ListView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Voice coverage (v0.13.0) — the 83 catalogue languages, each
 * with THIS phone's honest state: a Sandy voice pack is in, the
 * phone's own voice can speak it, or there is no voice for it
 * yet. The system-voice column is probed live from the phone's
 * speech engine (availability is a fact of the device, never a
 * promise printed in the build). Reached from Settings ▸
 * Translation ▸ Voice packs.
 */
public final class VoiceCoverageActivity extends Activity {

    private final List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private ArrayAdapter<String> adapter;
    private List<VoiceLangs.Row> langs = new ArrayList<>();
    private Set<String> packCodes = new HashSet<>();
    private final Set<String> systemIso1 = new HashSet<>();
    private TextToSpeech probe;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setTitle(LangStore.tr(this, "voice_coverage_title"));

        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = (int) (14 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView head = new TextView(this);
        head.setTextSize(15);
        head.setText(LangStore.tr(this, "voice_coverage_title"));
        root.addView(head);

        ListView list = new ListView(this);
        adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, rows);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);
        root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1));
        setContentView(root);

        langs = VoiceLangs.load(this);
        packCodes = VoicePackStore.installedCodes(this);
        showRows();
        probeSystemVoices();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (probe != null) {
            try { probe.shutdown(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private void showRows() {
        rows.clear();
        for (VoiceLangs.Row r : langs) {
            VoiceResolve.Result v = VoiceResolve.resolve(r, packCodes, systemIso1);
            String state;
            switch (v.voice) {
                case PACK: state = LangStore.tr(this, "voice_state_pack"); break;
                case SYSTEM: state = LangStore.tr(this, "voice_state_system"); break;
                default: state = LangStore.tr(this, "voice_state_none");
            }
            rows.add(r.tvName + " — " + state);
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    /** Ask the phone's own engine which languages IT can speak. */
    private void probeSystemVoices() {
        final TextToSpeech[] holder = new TextToSpeech[1];
        holder[0] = new TextToSpeech(this, status -> {
            if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {
                try {
                    for (VoiceLangs.Row r : langs) {
                        if (r.iso1.isEmpty()) continue;
                        int a = holder[0].isLanguageAvailable(
                                Locale.forLanguageTag(r.iso1));
                        if (a >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) {
                            systemIso1.add(r.iso1);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            runOnUiThread(this::showRows);
        });
        probe = holder[0];
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/VoiceLangs.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The voice language table (v0.13.0) — the 83 languages of the
 * show catalogue (assets/lang_registry.tsv's named rows), each
 * with what the MEASUREMENT found for it (work/v130/coverage_table
 * .tsv, measured 2026-10-18 against the live model houses):
 *
 *   tvName     the catalogue's own name for the language
 *   packCode   the MMS-TTS model code (ISO 639-3) when a native-
 *              script model exists and a Sandy voice pack can be
 *              built for it; empty when no pack exists
 *   iso1       the two-letter tag the phone's speech engine and
 *              the translation pairs speak in
 *   kind       native — a native-script MMS model exists
 *              uroman — the MMS model was trained on romanized
 *                       text, so a pack would speak gibberish
 *                       from native text (Korean); no pack
 *              none   — no MMS model exists at all
 *
 * The table ships as assets/voice_langs.tsv, GENERATED from the
 * measured coverage table so the phone resolves from the same
 * rows the build NOTES print. Resolution itself lives in
 * VoiceResolve; this class is only the data and its lookups.
 */
public final class VoiceLangs {

    public static final class Row {
        public String tvName = "";
        public String packCode = "";
        public String iso1 = "";
        public String kind = "none";
    }

    private static List<Row> rows;

    private VoiceLangs() {}

    public static List<Row> load(Context ctx) {
        if (rows != null) return rows;
        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (InputStream in = ctx.getAssets().open("voice_langs.tsv");
             BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(
                     new InputStreamReader(in, "UTF-8"))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                Row r = parseLine(line);
