                Beam b = beams.get(bi);
                if (b.finished) {
                    cand.add(new Object[]{b.score, bi, null, null, null});
                    continue;
                }
                Object[] st = runStep(b.tokens[b.tokens.length - 1],
                        b.selfPast, crossT);
                float[] logits = (float[]) st[0];
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                FlatPast[] newSelf = (FlatPast[]) st[1];
                double[] lp = maskStep(logSoftmax(logits), b.tokens);
                for (int t : topK(lp, BEAM)) {
                    cand.add(new Object[]{b.score + lp[t], bi, t, newSelf, lp[t]});
                }
            }
            cand.sort((a, z) -> Double.compare((Double) z[0], (Double) a[0]));
            List<Beam> next = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Object[] c : cand) {
                if (next.size() >= BEAM) break;
                Beam src = beams.get((Integer) c[1]);
                Beam nb = new Beam();
                if (c[2] == null) {
                    nb.tokens = src.tokens;
                    nb.score = src.score;
                    nb.selfPast = src.selfPast;
                    nb.tokenLps = src.tokenLps;
                    nb.finished = true;
                } else {
                    int t = (Integer) c[2];
                    nb.tokens = Arrays.copyOf(src.tokens, src.tokens.length + 1);
                    nb.tokens[src.tokens.length] = t;
                    nb.score = (Double) c[0];
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    FlatPast[] np = (FlatPast[]) c[3];
                    nb.selfPast = np;
                    nb.tokenLps = new ArrayList<>(src.tokenLps);
                    nb.tokenLps.add((Double) c[4]);
                    nb.finished = (t == EOS);
                }
                next.add(nb);
            }
            beams = next;
        }
        Beam best = null;
        double bestMean = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (Beam b : beams) {
            if (b.tokens.length == 0) continue;
            double mean = b.score / b.tokens.length;
            if (mean > bestMean) { bestMean = mean; best = b; }
        }
        DecodeResult out = new DecodeResult();
        out.noSpeechProb = noSpeech;
        if (best != null) {
            out.tokens = best.tokens;
            out.lps = new double[best.tokenLps.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < out.lps.length; i++) out.lps[i] = best.tokenLps.get(i);
        }
        out.degenerate = isDegenerate(out.tokens, out.lps);
        return out;
    }

    private DecodeResult sampleDecode(float[] encFlat, double temp,
                                      long seed) throws Exception {
        Step0 s0 = runStep0(encFlat);
        OnnxTensor[] crossT = tensorizeCross(s0.crossPast);
        try {
            return sampleDecodeRun(s0, crossT, temp, seed);
        } finally {
            closeAll(crossT);
        }
    }

    private DecodeResult sampleDecodeRun(Step0 s0, OnnxTensor[] crossT,
                                         double temp, long seed) throws Exception {
        double noSpeech = Math.exp(s0.lpRaw[NO_SPEECH]);
        Random rng = new Random(seed);
        List<Integer> toks = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Double> lps = new ArrayList<>();
        double[] lp0 = s0.lpRaw.clone();
        for (int s : SUPPRESS) lp0[s] = NEG;
        for (int s : BEGIN_SUPPRESS) lp0[s] = NEG;
        lp0[NO_TIMESTAMPS] = NEG;
        for (int t = 0; t < TS_BASE; t++) lp0[t] = NEG;
        int t = draw(lp0, temp, rng);
        toks.add(t);
        lps.add(s0.lpRaw[t]);
        FlatPast[] selfPast = s0.selfPast;
        int maxGen = MAX_LENGTH - 3;
        for (int step = 1; step < maxGen; step++) {
            if (toks.get(toks.size() - 1) == EOS) break;
            Object[] st = runStep(toks.get(toks.size() - 1), selfPast, crossT);
            float[] logits = (float[]) st[0];
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            FlatPast[] newSelf = (FlatPast[]) st[1];
            selfPast = newSelf;
            double[] rawLp = logSoftmax(logits);
            int[] hist = new int[toks.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < hist.length; i++) hist[i] = toks.get(i);
            double[] masked = maskStep(rawLp.clone(), hist);
            t = draw(masked, temp, rng);
            toks.add(t);
            lps.add(rawLp[t]);
        }
        DecodeResult out = new DecodeResult();
        out.noSpeechProb = noSpeech;
        out.tokens = new int[toks.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.tokens.length; i++) out.tokens[i] = toks.get(i);
        out.lps = new double[lps.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.lps.length; i++) out.lps[i] = lps.get(i);
        out.degenerate = isDegenerate(out.tokens, out.lps);
        return out;
    }

    /** Draw one token from softmax(maskedLogprobs / temp). */
    private static int draw(double[] maskedLp, double temp, Random rng) {
        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (double v : maskedLp) {
            double z = v / temp;
            if (z > max) max = z;
        }
        double sum = 0;
        double[] w = new double[maskedLp.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
            w[i] = Math.exp(maskedLp[i] / temp - max);
            sum += w[i];
        }
        double x = rng.nextDouble() * sum;
        double acc = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
            acc += w[i];
            if (x <= acc) return i;
        }
        return w.length - 1;
    }

    /** The per-step masks: suppress list, no-timestamps token,
     *  timestamp window/monotonicity, then the timestamp mass rule. */
    private static double[] maskStep(double[] lp, int[] history) {
        for (int s : SUPPRESS) lp[s] = NEG;
        lp[NO_TIMESTAMPS] = NEG;
        int lastTs = -1;
        for (int i = history.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (history[i] >= TS_BASE) { lastTs = history[i]; break; }
        }
        for (int t = TS_BASE; t < lp.length; t++) {
            double ts = (t - TS_BASE) * 0.02;
            if (ts > 30.0 || (lastTs >= 0 && t < lastTs)) lp[t] = NEG;
        }
        // timestamp mass rule: if the timestamps' total mass beats
        // the best text token, only a timestamp may come next
        double tsMax = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (int t = TS_BASE; t < lp.length; t++) if (lp[t] > tsMax) tsMax = lp[t];
        if (tsMax > NEG / 2) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int t = TS_BASE; t < lp.length; t++) {
                if (lp[t] > NEG / 2) sum += Math.exp(lp[t] - tsMax);
            }
            double mass = tsMax + Math.log(sum);
            double bestText = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
            for (int t = 0; t < TS_BASE; t++) if (lp[t] > bestText) bestText = lp[t];
            if (mass > bestText) {
                for (int t = 0; t < TS_BASE; t++) lp[t] = NEG;
            }
        }
        return lp;
    }

    /** The degeneration test (see class doc). The compression ratio
     *  is computed on the decoded text (special tokens excluded,
     *  WhisperVocab's own decode). */
    private boolean isDegenerate(int[] tokens, double[] lps) {
        if (tokens.length == 0) return false;
        double sum = 0;
        for (double v : lps) sum += v;
        double mean = sum / tokens.length;
        if (mean < LOGPROB_LIMIT) return true;
        int nTs = 0;
        for (int t : tokens) if (t >= TS_BASE) nTs++;
        if (nTs >= 3) return false;
        String text = vocab.decode(tokens);
        byte[] raw = text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (raw.length == 0) return false;
        Deflater d = new Deflater();
        d.setInput(raw);
        d.finish();
        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        while (!d.finished()) {
            int n = d.deflate(buf);
            bos.write(buf, 0, n);
        }
        d.end();
        double ratio = raw.length / (double) Math.max(1, bos.size());
        return ratio > COMPRESSION_LIMIT;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ segments

    private List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> toSegments(DecodeResult dr,
                                                        double winStart) {
        List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> segs = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> curToks = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Double> curLps = new ArrayList<>();
        double curStart = -1, lastTs = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < dr.tokens.length; i++) {
            int t = dr.tokens[i];
            double lp = i < dr.lps.length ? dr.lps[i] : 0.0;
            if (t >= TS_BASE) {
                double ts = (t - TS_BASE) * 0.02;
                if (ts < lastTs) ts = lastTs;
                lastTs = ts;
                if (curStart < 0) {
                    curStart = ts;
                } else {
                    flushSeg(segs, curToks, curLps, winStart + curStart,
                            winStart + ts, dr.noSpeechProb);
                    curStart = ts;
                }
            } else if (t == EOS) {
                if (!curToks.isEmpty()) {
                    double end = lastTs > curStart ? lastTs : curStart + 0.02;
                    flushSeg(segs, curToks, curLps, winStart + curStart,
                            winStart + end, dr.noSpeechProb);
                    curStart = -1;
                }
            } else {
                if (curStart < 0) curStart = lastTs;
                curToks.add(t);
                curLps.add(lp);
            }
        }
        if (!curToks.isEmpty()) {
            double end = lastTs > curStart ? lastTs : curStart + 0.02;
            flushSeg(segs, curToks, curLps, winStart + curStart,
                    winStart + end, dr.noSpeechProb);
        }
        return segs;
    }

    private void flushSeg(List<HallucinationGuard.Segment> segs,
                          List<Integer> toks, List<Double> lps,
                          double start, double end, double noSpeech) {
        if (toks.isEmpty()) return;
        int[] arr = new int[toks.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) arr[i] = toks.get(i);
        String text = vocab.decode(arr).trim();
        if (!text.isEmpty()) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (double v : lps) sum += v;
            double avg = lps.isEmpty() ? 0.0 : sum / lps.size();
            segs.add(new HallucinationGuard.Segment(start, end, text, avg, noSpeech));
        }
        toks.clear();
        lps.clear();
    }

    private static double[] logSoftmax(float[] logits) {
        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (float v : logits) if (v > max) max = v;
        double sum = 0;
        double[] out = new double[logits.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
            out[i] = logits[i] - max;
            sum += Math.exp(out[i]);
        }
        double lse = Math.log(sum);
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] -= lse;
        return out;
    }

    private static int[] topK(double[] lp, int k) {
        int[] out = new int[k];
        boolean[] used = new boolean[lp.length];
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            int best = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < lp.length; i++) {
                if (!used[i] && (best < 0 || lp[i] > lp[best])) best = i;
            }
            used[best] = true;
            out[j] = best;
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        try { encoder.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { decoder.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try { decoderPast.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/WhisperVocab.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Whisper detokenization (v0.6.1): token id -> text.
 *
 * The pack carries asr/vocab.tsv (id \t token), exported at
 * pack-build time from the model's own tokenizer.json. Whisper's
 * tokens are byte-level BPE strings: each character in a token
 * string stands for one byte under the GPT-2 byte<->unicode map.
 * Decoding concatenates the token strings, maps every character
 * back to its byte, and reads the bytes as UTF-8. Special tokens
 * (id >= 50257: end-of-text, language and task markers, timestamps)
 * never render as text.
 */
public final class WhisperVocab {

    private final String[] tokens;
    private static final Map<Character, Integer> CHAR_TO_BYTE = buildCharToByte();

    public WhisperVocab(File vocabTsv) throws Exception {
        Map<Integer, String> byId = new HashMap<>();
        int max = -1;
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(
                new FileInputStream(vocabTsv), "UTF-8"))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
                int tab = line.indexOf('\t');
                if (tab < 0) continue;
                int id = Integer.parseInt(line.substring(0, tab));
                byId.put(id, line.substring(tab + 1));
                if (id > max) max = id;
            }
        }
        tokens = new String[max + 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> e : byId.entrySet()) {
            tokens[e.getKey()] = e.getValue();
        }
    }

    public String decode(int[] ids) {
        StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
        for (int id : ids) {
            if (id < 0 || id >= 50257 || id >= tokens.length) continue;
            String t = tokens[id];
            if (t != null) joined.append(t);
        }
        byte[] bytes = new byte[joined.length()];
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < joined.length(); i++) {
            Integer b = CHAR_TO_BYTE.get(joined.charAt(i));
            if (b != null) bytes[n++] = (byte) b.intValue();
        }
        return new String(bytes, 0, n, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    /** The GPT-2 bytes_to_unicode table, inverted. */
    private static Map<Character, Integer> buildCharToByte() {
        Map<Character, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        java.util.List<Integer> bs = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 33; i < 127; i++) bs.add(i);
        for (int i = 161; i < 173; i++) bs.add(i);
        for (int i = 174; i < 256; i++) bs.add(i);
        java.util.List<Integer> cs = new java.util.ArrayList<>(bs);
        int n = 0;
        for (int b = 0; b < 256; b++) {
            if (!bs.contains(b)) {
                bs.add(b);
                cs.add(256 + n);
                n++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < bs.size(); i++) {
            map.put((char) cs.get(i).intValue(), bs.get(i));
        }
        return map;
    }
}

app/src/com/talacore/talatv/XmltvParser.java

package com.talacore.talatv;

import org.xml.sax.Attributes;
import org.xml.sax.InputSource;
import org.xml.sax.SAXException;
import org.xml.sax.XMLReader;
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory;

/**
 * Streaming XMLTV reader (v0.11.0). SAX, never DOM — a full hosted
 * guide file is tens of megabytes and the phone never holds it.
 *
 * The join is by id and nothing else: the caller passes the guide
 * map's xml-id → Sandy tvg-id bridge for ONE source file, and only
 * programmes whose channel id is in that bridge are kept. A channel
 * whose id never appears contributes nothing — which is exactly how
 * a stale map row degrades to "no guide data" instead of a wrong
 * schedule: the file is the proof, the map only says where to look.
 */
public final class XmltvParser {

    private XmltvParser() {}

    private static final int MAX_DESC = 480;

    public static GuideModel.GuideData parse(InputStream in,
                                             Map<String, String> xmlIdToTvgId)
            throws Exception {
        SAXParserFactory factory = SAXParserFactory.newInstance();
        factory.setNamespaceAware(false);
        // Hosted XMLTV is plain data; no DTD processing wanted.
        try { factory.setFeature(
                "http://apache.org/xml/features/nonvalidating/load-external-dtd",
                false); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        XMLReader reader = factory.newSAXParser().getXMLReader();
        Handler h = new Handler(xmlIdToTvgId);
        reader.setContentHandler(h);
        reader.parse(new InputSource(in));
        h.data.finish();
        return h.data;
    }

    private static final class Handler extends DefaultHandler {
        final GuideModel.GuideData data = new GuideModel.GuideData();
        private final Map<String, String> bridge;

        private String channel;      // Sandy tvg-id for the open programme
        private String startRaw, stopRaw;
        private StringBuilder text;  // current element's character buffer
        private String inElement = "";
        private String title = "", desc = "", category = "";

        Handler(Map<String, String> bridge) { this.bridge = bridge; }

        @Override
        public void startElement(String uri, String localName, String qName,
                                 Attributes atts) {
            String name = (qName == null || qName.isEmpty()) ? localName : qName;
            if ("programme".equals(name)) {
                String xmlId = atts.getValue("channel");
                channel = xmlId == null ? null : bridge.get(xmlId);
                startRaw = atts.getValue("start");
                stopRaw = atts.getValue("stop");
                title = ""; desc = ""; category = "";
            } else if ("title".equals(name) || "desc".equals(name)
                    || "category".equals(name)) {
                inElement = name;
                text = new StringBuilder();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void characters(char[] ch, int start, int length) {
            if (text != null) text.append(ch, start, length);
        }

        @Override
        public void endElement(String uri, String localName, String qName)
                throws SAXException {
            String name = (qName == null || qName.isEmpty()) ? localName : qName;
            if (name.equals(inElement) && text != null) {
                String v = text.toString().trim();
                if ("title".equals(name)) title = v;
                else if ("desc".equals(name)) {
                    desc = v.length() > MAX_DESC ? v.substring(0, MAX_DESC) : v;
                } else if ("category".equals(name) && category.isEmpty()) {
                    category = v;
                }
                inElement = "";
                text = null;
            } else if ("programme".equals(name)) {
                if (channel != null) {
                    long st = GuideModel.parseXmltvTime(startRaw);
                    long sp = GuideModel.parseXmltvTime(stopRaw);
                    if (st >= 0 && sp > st) {
                        data.add(new GuideModel.Programme(
                                channel, st, sp, title, desc, category));
                    }
                }
                channel = null;
            }
        }
    }
}

build.sh

#!/bin/bash
# Manual APK build for Sandy 0.10.0 (package com.talacore.talatv) — same proven chain as Eater/Ripper:
# stage deps -> aapt2 compile/link (versions live in the manifest itself)
# -> javac -> d8 -> zipalign -> apksigner.
set -e
export PATH=$HOME/workspace/apk_build/jdk-17.0.11+9/bin:$PATH

APP=$HOME/workspace/tala-tv-2026-10-16/app
ROOT=$HOME/workspace/tala-tv-2026-10-16
SDK=$HOME/workspace/apk_build/android-sdk
BT=$SDK/build-tools/34.0.0
PLATFORM=$SDK/platforms/android-34/android.jar
BUILD=$ROOT/build
rm -rf "$BUILD"
mkdir -p "$BUILD/classes" "$BUILD/dex" "$BUILD/apk" "$BUILD/res" "$BUILD/gen"

echo "== stage media3 deps (closure pre-fetched from Google Maven)"
python3 "$ROOT/work/stage_deps.py"

echo "== collect jars"
AAR_JARS=$(find "$BUILD/aar" -name classes.jar | sort | tr '\n' ' ')
PLAIN_JARS=$(find "$BUILD/jars" -name "*.jar" | sort | tr '\n' ' ')
ALL_JARS="$AAR_JARS $PLAIN_JARS"
echo "$ALL_JARS" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -v '^$' | wc -l

echo "== aapt2 compile res (app + every AAR res/)"
"$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$APP/res" -o "$BUILD/res/app.zip"
RES_ARGS="-R $BUILD/res/app.zip"
for d in "$BUILD"/aar/*/; do
  if [ -d "$d/res" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$d/res" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    name=$(basename "$d")
    # v0.7.0: mediarouter's res serves only its AppCompat chooser
    # dialogs (styles parented on AppCompat themes). Sandy lists
    # routes itself and never loads those classes, so its res is
    # excluded — classes.jar only (see TvShare/ShareCast notes).
    if [ "$name" = "mediarouter-1.7.0" ]; then
      echo "  res: $name SKIPPED (dialog resources; not used)"
      continue
    fi
    "$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$d/res" -o "$BUILD/res/$name.zip"
    RES_ARGS="$RES_ARGS -R $BUILD/res/$name.zip"
    echo "  res: $name"
  fi
done

echo "== aapt2 link (NO version flags - AndroidManifest.xml is authoritative)"
"$BT/aapt2" link -o "$BUILD/apk/base.apk" \
  -I "$PLATFORM" \
  --manifest "$APP/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  -A "$APP/assets" \
  $RES_ARGS \
  --auto-add-overlay \
  --extra-packages "androidx.media3.ui:androidx.media3.exoplayer:androidx.core:androidx.core.ktx:androidx.media:androidx.recyclerview:androidx.lifecycle:androidx.annotation.experimental:androidx.customview.poolingcontainer:androidx.mediarouter" \
  --java "$BUILD/gen" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 \
  --target-sdk-version 34

echo "== javac (app sources + generated R classes)"
find "$APP/src" -name "*.java" > "$BUILD/sources.txt"
find "$BUILD/gen" -name "*.java" >> "$BUILD/sources.txt"
CP=$(echo $ALL_JARS | tr ' ' ':')
javac -nowarn -encoding UTF-8 -source 17 -target 17 \
  -classpath "$PLATFORM:$CP" \
  -d "$BUILD/classes" @"$BUILD/sources.txt"

echo "== d8"
"$BT/d8" --min-api 24 \
  --output "$BUILD/dex" \
  $(find "$BUILD/classes" -name "*.class" | tr '\n' ' ') \
  $ALL_JARS \
  --lib "$PLATFORM"

echo "== package dex"
cd "$BUILD/apk"
cp base.apk unsigned.apk
for dex in "$BUILD"/dex/classes*.dex; do
  b=$(basename "$dex")
  cp "$dex" "./$b"
  zip -q unsigned.apk "$b"
  rm "./$b"
done
ls "$BUILD"/dex/

echo "== package onnxruntime native libs (arm64-v8a only)"
mkdir -p "$BUILD/apk/lib/arm64-v8a"
cp "$BUILD/aar/onnxruntime-android-1.31.0/jni/arm64-v8a/libonnxruntime.so" \
   "$BUILD/apk/lib/arm64-v8a/"
cp "$BUILD/aar/onnxruntime-android-1.31.0/jni/arm64-v8a/libonnxruntime4j_jni.so" \
   "$BUILD/apk/lib/arm64-v8a/"
zip -q unsigned.apk lib/arm64-v8a/libonnxruntime.so \
  lib/arm64-v8a/libonnxruntime4j_jni.so

echo "== zipalign + sign"
if [ ! -f "$ROOT/app-signing.keystore" ]; then
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$ROOT/app-signing.keystore" -storepass android \
    -keypass android -alias talatvkey -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10950 \
    -dname "CN=TALA TV,O=TalaCore,C=US" 2>/dev/null
fi
"$BT/zipalign" -f 4 unsigned.apk aligned.apk
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$ROOT/app-signing.keystore" --ks-pass pass:android \
  --key-pass pass:android --out "$BUILD/sandy-0.10.0.apk" aligned.apk

echo "== verify"
"$BT/aapt2" dump badging "$BUILD/sandy-0.10.0.apk" | head -5
"$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$BUILD/sandy-0.10.0.apk" | head -3
ls -la "$BUILD/sandy-0.10.0.apk"
